# Price Scrubber desk

// ─── components/ui/price-scrubber.tsx ───

"use client"

import { useId, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { AxisTag } from "@/components/ui/chart-overlay"
import { SegmentedControl } from "@/components/ui/segmented-control"

/* Price Scrubber: the wide price chart (560px, the Price chart family's width).
   A magnet crosshair snaps to the real datum, the pointed price is tagged on the axis,
   and scrubbing reads the point into the header in place, recolouring the chart off the
   window's first price. A soft wash rides the cursor.
   2026-10-02 audit: brought into the one chart language. The header has the three tiers
   (spec 14.1): the name at /45 with the symbol at /90 on the right, the price at 26px with
   its cents at /35, then the move in its hue and the window ("past year", or the pointed
   time) at /45; a new `name` prop carries the company, and the sample is Broadcom (AVGO)
   so the two ends of the label row do not read the same. The pointed value is the shared
   AxisTag (it drew its own square badges) and the time badge on the foot is gone since the
   header reads the time. Gridlines are solid at 5%, the axis prints dollars at 9px /45,
   and the timeframe pills are the shared SegmentedControl in the header, not a hand made
   row under the plot.
   Formulas:
   · move = the pointed price (or the last) − the window's first price
   · percent = move ÷ the window's first price × 100 */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GREEN = "var(--chart-up)"
const RED = "var(--chart-down)"

const TF = ["1D", "1W", "1M", "1Y", "All"] as const
export type ScrubTimeframe = (typeof TF)[number]

const N: Record<ScrubTimeframe, number> = { "1D": 78, "1W": 84, "1M": 90, "1Y": 120, All: 150 }

/** Deterministic walk per timeframe (LCG); 1M trends down so red earns its keep. */
function makeSeries(tf: ScrubTimeframe): number[] {
  let s = 1000 + TF.indexOf(tf) * 733
  const n = N[tf]
  const drift = tf === "1M" ? -0.22 : 0.28
  let v = 178
  const out: number[] = []
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    s = (s * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7fffffff
    v += (s / 0x7fffffff - 0.5) * 2.2 + drift * 0.08
    out.push(v)
  }
  return out
}

function timeLabel(tf: ScrubTimeframe, f: number): string {
  const clamp = (x: number, top: number) => Math.max(0, Math.min(top, x))
  switch (tf) {
    case "1D": {
      const m = 570 + Math.round(f * 390)
      return `${String(Math.floor(m / 60)).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(m % 60).padStart(2, "0")}`
    }
    case "1W":
      return ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri"][clamp(Math.floor(f * 5), 4)]
    case "1M":
      return `Day ${1 + Math.round(f * 29)}`
    case "1Y":
      return ["Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec", "Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul"][clamp(Math.floor(f * 12), 11)]
    case "All":
      return `’${22 + clamp(Math.floor(f * 4), 4)}`
  }
}

const AXES: Record<ScrubTimeframe, string[]> = {
  "1D": ["09:30", "11:30", "13:30", "15:30"],
  "1W": ["Mon", "Wed", "Fri"],
  "1M": ["Wk 1", "Wk 2", "Wk 3", "Wk 4"],
  "1Y": ["Aug", "Nov", "Feb", "May"],
  All: ["’22", "’23", "’24", "’25", "’26"],
}

/** what the move is measured over, at rest */
const WINDOW: Record<ScrubTimeframe, string> = { "1D": "today", "1W": "past week", "1M": "past month", "1Y": "past year", All: "all time" }

const axisUsd = (n: number) => `$${Math.round(n).toLocaleString("en-US")}`
const fmtPrice = (n: number) => `$${n.toLocaleString("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}`

const W = 560
const H = 220
const PAD = { l: 10, r: 66, t: 18, b: 26 }
const PLOT_W = W - PAD.l - PAD.r
const PLOT_H = H - PAD.t - PAD.b

/* the hover wash: half-width of the falloff in svg units and how far the rest of
   the series drops back while it is lit; the ramp plateaus around the cursor
   and tails off steeply, peaking under 1 so it reads as brightness, not bloom */
const SPOT = 215
const SPOT_DIM = 0.2
const SPOT_STOPS: [number, number][] = [
  [0, 0],
  [0.1, 0],
  [0.22, 0.05],
  [0.32, 0.2],
  [0.4, 0.5],
  [0.5, 0.78],
  [0.6, 0.5],
  [0.68, 0.2],
  [0.78, 0.05],
  [0.9, 0],
  [1, 0],
]

/**
 * The scrub chart: a magnet crosshair snaps to the real datum with the price
 * tagged on the axis, and scrubbing updates the header, which recolours the
 * whole chart off the reference price. A soft wash rides the
 * cursor, so the line reads lighter under the pointer and settles back on the
 * far sides. Timeframe pills morph the chart in place.
 */
export function PriceScrubber({
  name = "Broadcom",
  symbol = "AVGO",
  timeframe = "1Y",
  className,
}: {
  /** the company or market's name, on the label row's left */
  name?: string
  symbol?: string
  /** the timeframe the chart opens on */
  timeframe?: ScrubTimeframe
  className?: string
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const uid = useId().replace(/:/g, "")
  const svgRef = useRef<SVGSVGElement>(null)
  const [tf, setTf] = useState<ScrubTimeframe>(timeframe)
  const [hi, setHi] = useState<number | null>(null)

  const data = useMemo(() => makeSeries(tf), [tf])
  const n = data.length
  const { min, max } = useMemo(() => {
    const lo = Math.min(...data)
    const top = Math.max(...data)
    const pad = (top - lo) * 0.08
    return { min: lo - pad, max: top + pad }
  }, [data])

  const x = (i: number) => PAD.l + (i / (n - 1)) * PLOT_W
  const y = (v: number) => PAD.t + (1 - (v - min) / (max - min || 1)) * PLOT_H

  const onMove = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    const el = svgRef.current
    if (!el) return
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect()
    const px = ((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width) * W
    setHi(Math.max(0, Math.min(n - 1, Math.round(((px - PAD.l) / PLOT_W) * (n - 1)))))
  }

  const reference = data[0]
  const activeIdx = hi ?? n - 1
  const activeVal = data[activeIdx]
  const delta = activeVal - reference
  const deltaPct = (delta / reference) * 100
  const up = delta >= 0
  const hue = up ? GREEN : RED

  const line = data.map((v, idx) => `${idx === 0 ? "M" : "L"}${x(idx).toFixed(1)},${y(v).toFixed(1)}`).join(" ")
  const area = `${line} L${x(n - 1).toFixed(1)},${H - PAD.b} L${x(0).toFixed(1)},${H - PAD.b} Z`
  const badgeY = y(activeVal)
  const crossX = x(activeIdx)
  const tagY = Math.max(PAD.t + 8, Math.min(H - PAD.b - 8, badgeY))
  const [whole, cents] = fmtPrice(activeVal).split(".")

  return (
    <div className={cn("w-[560px]", className)}>
      {/* the header, three tiers (spec 14.1); scrubbing reads the point in place, the timeframe switch sits on its right */}
      <div className="mb-3 flex items-baseline justify-between text-[12px]">
        <span className="truncate text-foreground/45">{name}</span>
        <span className="shrink-0 pl-3 font-medium text-foreground/90">{symbol}</span>
      </div>
      <div className="mb-2 flex items-end justify-between gap-4 tabular-nums" role="status">
        <div>
          <p className="m-0 text-[26px] font-semibold leading-none tracking-[-0.02em] text-foreground/90">
            {whole}
            <span className="text-foreground/35">.{cents}</span>
          </p>
          <p className="mb-0 mt-2 flex items-baseline gap-[7px] text-[12px] font-medium" style={{ color: hue }}>
            <span>
              {up ? "+" : "−"}
              {fmtPrice(Math.abs(delta))} · {up ? "+" : "−"}
              {Math.abs(deltaPct).toFixed(2)}%
            </span>
            <span className="font-normal text-foreground/45">{hi === null ? WINDOW[tf] : timeLabel(tf, activeIdx / (n - 1))}</span>
          </p>
        </div>
        <SegmentedControl
          options={[...TF]}
          value={tf}
          onChange={(v) => {
            setTf(v as ScrubTimeframe)
            setHi(null)
          }}
          label="Timeframe"
          className="shrink-0"
        />
      </div>

      <svg
        ref={svgRef}
        width={W}
        height={H}
        viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`}
        className="block cursor-crosshair touch-none"
        role="img"
        aria-label={`${name} (${symbol}) price over the ${WINDOW[tf]}, ${fmtPrice(data[n - 1])}`}
        onPointerMove={onMove}
        onPointerLeave={() => setHi(null)}
      >
        <defs>
          <linearGradient id={`${uid}-fill`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
            <stop offset="0%" stopColor={hue} stopOpacity="0.16" />
            <stop offset="100%" stopColor={hue} stopOpacity="0" />
          </linearGradient>
          <linearGradient id={`${uid}-hot`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
            <stop offset="0%" stopColor={hue} stopOpacity="0.24" />
            <stop offset="100%" stopColor={hue} stopOpacity="0" />
          </linearGradient>
        </defs>

        {[0.25, 0.5, 0.75].map((f) => {
          const gy = PAD.t + f * PLOT_H
          /* a figure steps aside while the pointed tag sits on it */
          const under = hi !== null && Math.abs(gy - tagY) < 12
          return (
            <g key={f}>
              <line x1={PAD.l} y1={gy} x2={W - PAD.r} y2={gy} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.05} />
              <text
                x={W - PAD.r + 8}
                y={gy + 3}
                fontSize={9}
                fill="var(--foreground)"
                fillOpacity={0.45}
                className="tabular-nums"
                style={{ opacity: under ? 0 : 1, transition: reduced ? "none" : "opacity 150ms" }}
              >
                {axisUsd(max - f * (max - min))}
              </text>
            </g>
          )
        })}

        {AXES[tf].map((t, idx, arr) => (
          <text key={t} x={PAD.l + (idx / (arr.length - 1)) * PLOT_W} y={H - 8} textAnchor={idx === 0 ? "start" : idx === arr.length - 1 ? "end" : "middle"} fontSize={9} fill="var(--foreground)" fillOpacity={0.45}>
            {t}
          </text>
        ))}

        {/* area and line, re-keyed on the timeframe so they redraw; they sit back while scrubbing */}
        <g opacity={hi === null ? 1 : SPOT_DIM} style={{ transition: reduced ? "none" : "opacity 0.22s" }}>
          <motion.path key={`a-${tf}`} d={area} fill={`url(#${uid}-fill)`} initial={{ opacity: reduced ? 1 : 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.4, ease: EASE, delay: 0.35 }} />
          <motion.path key={`l-${tf}`} d={line} fill="none" stroke={hue} strokeWidth={1.8} strokeLinejoin="round" initial={{ pathLength: reduced ? 1 : 0 }} animate={{ pathLength: 1 }} transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.85, ease: EASE }} />
        </g>

        {/* the wash: a full-strength copy revealed through a mask that rides the cursor */}
        <AnimatePresence>
          {hi !== null && (
            <motion.g key="spot" pointerEvents="none" initial={{ opacity: reduced ? 1 : 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, transition: { duration: reduced ? 0 : 0.16 } }} transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.2, ease: EASE }}>
              <defs>
                <linearGradient id={`${uid}-ramp`} gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x1={crossX - SPOT} y1="0" x2={crossX + SPOT} y2="0">
                  {SPOT_STOPS.map(([offset, o]) => (
                    // oxlint-disable-next-line shadcn/no-raw-colors -- mask stop: a mask reads luminance, so it stays white in both themes
                    <stop key={offset} offset={`${offset * 100}%`} stopColor="white" stopOpacity={o} />
                  ))}
                </linearGradient>
                <mask id={`${uid}-mask`} maskUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x={0} y={0} width={W} height={H}>
                  <rect x={0} y={0} width={W} height={H} fill={`url(#${uid}-ramp)`} />
                </mask>
              </defs>
              <g mask={`url(#${uid}-mask)`}>
                <path d={area} fill={`url(#${uid}-hot)`} />
                <path d={line} fill="none" stroke={hue} strokeWidth={1.8} strokeLinejoin="round" />
              </g>
            </motion.g>
          )}
        </AnimatePresence>

        {/* magnet crosshair: rule, snapped dot and the pointed price tagged on the axis (chart-overlay.tsx) */}
        {hi !== null && (
          <g pointerEvents="none">
            <line x1={crossX} y1={PAD.t} x2={crossX} y2={H - PAD.b} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.2} strokeWidth={1} />
            <line x1={PAD.l} y1={badgeY} x2={W - PAD.r} y2={badgeY} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.14} strokeDasharray="3 3" strokeWidth={1} />
            <circle cx={crossX} cy={badgeY} r={3.5} fill={hue} stroke="var(--background)" strokeWidth={1.75} />
            <AxisTag x={W - PAD.r + 4} y={tagY} width={58} color={hue}>
              {fmtPrice(activeVal)}
            </AxisTag>
          </g>
        )}
      </svg>
    </div>
  )
}


// ─── components/ui/chart-overlay.tsx ───

"use client"

import { type ReactNode } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

/* Chart overlay: the two parts every library chart reads a point with (2026-10-02). They
   came out of Candlestick, Volume Profile, the trading terminal and Price Scrubber, which
   had each drawn their own; this is the one copy. Shipped beside the charts that use it.

   AxisTag   the outlined tag on the value axis: the pointed value in its hue, or a named
             reference (POC, last close) in ink. A pill 16px high, 8.5px figures.
   ChartCard the card laid over the chart beside the cursor: a heading row (a time or a
             range) at /60, then label and value rows (labels 10px /60, values 11px /90),
             the one signed figure in its hue. It glides between points on a spring, fades
             in from 0.97 and out in 120ms, and flips to the cursor's left when told to.

   2026-10-02: the card looked out of place over the charts, so it now wears the library
   popover, the same as the sidebar's hover card: a hairline border at 8%, radius 12, the
   6% foreground mix and the popover shadow with no inset highlight (spec 14.6). */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GLIDE = { type: "spring", stiffness: 520, damping: 40 } as const

/** the outlined tag on a chart's value axis, centred on `y` */
export function AxisTag({
  x,
  y,
  width,
  color = "var(--foreground)",
  strong = true,
  hidden = false,
  children,
}: {
  /** the tag's left edge, in the chart's own units */
  x: number
  /** the value's line; the tag is centred on it */
  y: number
  width: number
  /** stroke and figure; ink for a named reference, the series hue for the pointed value */
  color?: string
  /** a quieter tag (a secondary reference) drops the weight and the stroke */
  strong?: boolean
  /** fades the tag out, for when the pointed value sits on it */
  hidden?: boolean
  children: ReactNode
}) {
  return (
    <g transform={`translate(${x}, ${y - 8})`} pointerEvents="none" style={{ opacity: hidden ? 0 : 1, transition: "opacity 150ms" }}>
      <rect width={width} height={16} rx={8} fill="var(--background)" stroke={color} strokeOpacity={strong ? 0.6 : 0.2} />
      <text x={width / 2} y={11} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={8.5} fontWeight={strong ? 600 : 500} fill={color} fillOpacity={strong ? 1 : 0.65}>
        {children}
      </text>
    </g>
  )
}

export interface ChartCardRow {
  label: string
  value: ReactNode
  /** only the one signed figure carries a hue */
  color?: string
}

/** the readout card over a chart; place it inside a `relative` box that holds the svg */
export function ChartCard({
  open,
  x,
  y = 4,
  flip = false,
  width = 148,
  heading,
  rows,
  footer,
}: {
  open: boolean
  /** the cursor's x inside the box: px, or a percentage string for a chart drawn to a viewBox */
  x: number | string
  /** the card's top inside the box, px */
  y?: number
  /** put the card on the cursor's left (past ~60% of the plot) */
  flip?: boolean
  width?: number
  heading: ReactNode
  rows: ChartCardRow[]
  /** a closing line under the rows, such as where the point sits */
  footer?: ReactNode
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {open && (
        <motion.div
          key="chart-card"
          role="status"
          className="pointer-events-none absolute z-10"
          initial={{ left: x, top: y, opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ left: x, top: y, opacity: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, transition: { duration: 0.12 } }}
          transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { left: GLIDE, top: GLIDE, opacity: { duration: 0.15 } }}
        >
          <motion.div
            className="rounded-[12px] border border-foreground/[0.08] px-3 py-2.5"
            style={{
              width,
              translate: flip ? "calc(-100% - 12px) 0" : "12px 0",
              transition: reduced ? undefined : "translate 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)",
              background: "var(--tip-fill, color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 6%, var(--background)))",
              boxShadow: "0 8px 24px var(--card-shadow, rgba(0,0,0,calc(0.35 * var(--shadow-k, 1))))",
            }}
            initial={reduced ? false : { scale: 0.97 }}
            animate={{ scale: 1 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
          >
            <div className="text-[10px] text-foreground/60">{heading}</div>
            <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-col gap-1">
              {rows.map((r) => (
                <div key={r.label} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-foreground/60">{r.label}</span>
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-foreground/90" style={r.color ? { color: r.color } : undefined}>
                    {r.value}
                  </span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            {footer && <div className="mt-1.5 text-[10px]">{footer}</div>}
          </motion.div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  )
}

export function PriceScrubber({
  name = "Broadcom",
  symbol = "AVGO",
  timeframe = "1Y",
  className,
}: {
  /** the company or market's name, on the label row's left */
  name?: string
  symbol?: string
  /** the timeframe the chart opens on */
  timeframe?: ScrubTimeframe
  className?: string
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const uid = useId().replace(/:/g, "")
  const svgRef = useRef<SVGSVGElement>(null)
  const [tf, setTf] = useState<ScrubTimeframe>(timeframe)
  const [hi, setHi] = useState<number | null>(null)

  const data = useMemo(() => makeSeries(tf), [tf])
  const n = data.length
  const { min, max } = useMemo(() => {
    const lo = Math.min(...data)
    const top = Math.max(...data)
    const pad = (top - lo) * 0.08
    return { min: lo - pad, max: top + pad }
  }, [data])

  const x = (i: number) => PAD.l + (i / (n - 1)) * PLOT_W
  const y = (v: number) => PAD.t + (1 - (v - min) / (max - min || 1)) * PLOT_H

  const onMove = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    const el = svgRef.current
    if (!el) return
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect()
    const px = ((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width) * W
    setHi(Math.max(0, Math.min(n - 1, Math.round(((px - PAD.l) / PLOT_W) * (n - 1)))))
  }

  const reference = data[0]
  const activeIdx = hi ?? n - 1
  const activeVal = data[activeIdx]
  const delta = activeVal - reference
  const deltaPct = (delta / reference) * 100
  const up = delta >= 0
  const hue = up ? GREEN : RED

  const line = data.map((v, idx) => `${idx === 0 ? "M" : "L"}${x(idx).toFixed(1)},${y(v).toFixed(1)}`).join(" ")
  const area = `${line} L${x(n - 1).toFixed(1)},${H - PAD.b} L${x(0).toFixed(1)},${H - PAD.b} Z`
  const badgeY = y(activeVal)
  const crossX = x(activeIdx)
  const tagY = Math.max(PAD.t + 8, Math.min(H - PAD.b - 8, badgeY))
  const [whole, cents] = fmtPrice(activeVal).split(".")

  return (
    <div className={cn("w-[560px]", className)}>
      {/* the header, three tiers (spec 14.1); scrubbing reads the point in place, the timeframe switch sits on its right */}
      <div className="mb-3 flex items-baseline justify-between text-[12px]">
        <span className="truncate text-foreground/45">{name}</span>
        <span className="shrink-0 pl-3 font-medium text-foreground/90">{symbol}</span>
      </div>
      <div className="mb-2 flex items-end justify-between gap-4 tabular-nums" role="status">
        <div>
          <p className="m-0 text-[26px] font-semibold leading-none tracking-[-0.02em] text-foreground/90">
            {whole}
            <span className="text-foreground/35">.{cents}</span>
          </p>
          <p className="mb-0 mt-2 flex items-baseline gap-[7px] text-[12px] font-medium" style={{ color: hue }}>
            <span>
              {up ? "+" : "−"}
              {fmtPrice(Math.abs(delta))} · {up ? "+" : "−"}
              {Math.abs(deltaPct).toFixed(2)}%
            </span>
            <span className="font-normal text-foreground/45">{hi === null ? WINDOW[tf] : timeLabel(tf, activeIdx / (n - 1))}</span>
          </p>
        </div>
        <SegmentedControl
          options={[...TF]}
          value={tf}
          onChange={(v) => {
            setTf(v as ScrubTimeframe)
            setHi(null)
          }}
          label="Timeframe"
          className="shrink-0"
        />
      </div>

      <svg
        ref={svgRef}
        width={W}
        height={H}
        viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`}
        className="block cursor-crosshair touch-none"
        role="img"
        aria-label={`${name} (${symbol}) price over the ${WINDOW[tf]}, ${fmtPrice(data[n - 1])}`}
        onPointerMove={onMove}
        onPointerLeave={() => setHi(null)}
      >
        <defs>
          <linearGradient id={`${uid}-fill`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
            <stop offset="0%" stopColor={hue} stopOpacity="0.16" />
            <stop offset="100%" stopColor={hue} stopOpacity="0" />
          </linearGradient>
          <linearGradient id={`${uid}-hot`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
            <stop offset="0%" stopColor={hue} stopOpacity="0.24" />
            <stop offset="100%" stopColor={hue} stopOpacity="0" />
          </linearGradient>
        </defs>

        {[0.25, 0.5, 0.75].map((f) => {
          const gy = PAD.t + f * PLOT_H
          /* a figure steps aside while the pointed tag sits on it */
          const under = hi !== null && Math.abs(gy - tagY) < 12
          return (
            <g key={f}>
              <line x1={PAD.l} y1={gy} x2={W - PAD.r} y2={gy} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.05} />
              <text
                x={W - PAD.r + 8}
                y={gy + 3}
                fontSize={9}
                fill="var(--foreground)"
                fillOpacity={0.45}
                className="tabular-nums"
                style={{ opacity: under ? 0 : 1, transition: reduced ? "none" : "opacity 150ms" }}
              >
                {axisUsd(max - f * (max - min))}
              </text>
            </g>
          )
        })}

        {AXES[tf].map((t, idx, arr) => (
          <text key={t} x={PAD.l + (idx / (arr.length - 1)) * PLOT_W} y={H - 8} textAnchor={idx === 0 ? "start" : idx === arr.length - 1 ? "end" : "middle"} fontSize={9} fill="var(--foreground)" fillOpacity={0.45}>
            {t}
          </text>
        ))}

        {/* area and line, re-keyed on the timeframe so they redraw; they sit back while scrubbing */}
        <g opacity={hi === null ? 1 : SPOT_DIM} style={{ transition: reduced ? "none" : "opacity 0.22s" }}>
          <motion.path key={`a-${tf}`} d={area} fill={`url(#${uid}-fill)`} initial={{ opacity: reduced ? 1 : 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.4, ease: EASE, delay: 0.35 }} />
          <motion.path key={`l-${tf}`} d={line} fill="none" stroke={hue} strokeWidth={1.8} strokeLinejoin="round" initial={{ pathLength: reduced ? 1 : 0 }} animate={{ pathLength: 1 }} transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.85, ease: EASE }} />
        </g>

        {/* the wash: a full-strength copy revealed through a mask that rides the cursor */}
        <AnimatePresence>
          {hi !== null && (
            <motion.g key="spot" pointerEvents="none" initial={{ opacity: reduced ? 1 : 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, transition: { duration: reduced ? 0 : 0.16 } }} transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.2, ease: EASE }}>
              <defs>
                <linearGradient id={`${uid}-ramp`} gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x1={crossX - SPOT} y1="0" x2={crossX + SPOT} y2="0">
                  {SPOT_STOPS.map(([offset, o]) => (
                    // oxlint-disable-next-line shadcn/no-raw-colors -- mask stop: a mask reads luminance, so it stays white in both themes
                    <stop key={offset} offset={`${offset * 100}%`} stopColor="white" stopOpacity={o} />
                  ))}
                </linearGradient>
                <mask id={`${uid}-mask`} maskUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x={0} y={0} width={W} height={H}>
                  <rect x={0} y={0} width={W} height={H} fill={`url(#${uid}-ramp)`} />
                </mask>
              </defs>
              <g mask={`url(#${uid}-mask)`}>
                <path d={area} fill={`url(#${uid}-hot)`} />
                <path d={line} fill="none" stroke={hue} strokeWidth={1.8} strokeLinejoin="round" />
              </g>
            </motion.g>
          )}
        </AnimatePresence>

        {/* magnet crosshair: rule, snapped dot and the pointed price tagged on the axis (chart-overlay.tsx) */}
        {hi !== null && (
          <g pointerEvents="none">
            <line x1={crossX} y1={PAD.t} x2={crossX} y2={H - PAD.b} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.2} strokeWidth={1} />
            <line x1={PAD.l} y1={badgeY} x2={W - PAD.r} y2={badgeY} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.14} strokeDasharray="3 3" strokeWidth={1} />
            <circle cx={crossX} cy={badgeY} r={3.5} fill={hue} stroke="var(--background)" strokeWidth={1.75} />
            <AxisTag x={W - PAD.r + 4} y={tagY} width={58} color={hue}>
              {fmtPrice(activeVal)}
            </AxisTag>
          </g>
        )}
      </svg>
    </div>
  )
}


// ─── components/ui/chart-overlay.tsx ───

"use client"

import { type ReactNode } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

/* Chart overlay: the two parts every library chart reads a point with (2026-10-02). They
   came out of Candlestick, Volume Profile, the trading terminal and Price Scrubber, which
   had each drawn their own; this is the one copy. Shipped beside the charts that use it.

   AxisTag   the outlined tag on the value axis: the pointed value in its hue, or a named
             reference (POC, last close) in ink. A pill 16px high, 8.5px figures.
   ChartCard the card laid over the chart beside the cursor: a heading row (a time or a
             range) at /60, then label and value rows (labels 10px /60, values 11px /90),
             the one signed figure in its hue. It glides between points on a spring, fades
             in from 0.97 and out in 120ms, and flips to the cursor's left when told to.

   2026-10-02: the card looked out of place over the charts, so it now wears the library
   popover, the same as the sidebar's hover card: a hairline border at 8%, radius 12, the
   6% foreground mix and the popover shadow with no inset highlight (spec 14.6). */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GLIDE = { type: "spring", stiffness: 520, damping: 40 } as const

/** the outlined tag on a chart's value axis, centred on `y` */
export function AxisTag({
  x,
  y,
  width,
  color = "var(--foreground)",
  strong = true,
  hidden = false,
  children,
}: {
  /** the tag's left edge, in the chart's own units */
  x: number
  /** the value's line; the tag is centred on it */
  y: number
  width: number
  /** stroke and figure; ink for a named reference, the series hue for the pointed value */
  color?: string
  /** a quieter tag (a secondary reference) drops the weight and the stroke */
  strong?: boolean
  /** fades the tag out, for when the pointed value sits on it */
  hidden?: boolean
  children: ReactNode
}) {
  return (
    <g transform={`translate(${x}, ${y - 8})`} pointerEvents="none" style={{ opacity: hidden ? 0 : 1, transition: "opacity 150ms" }}>
      <rect width={width} height={16} rx={8} fill="var(--background)" stroke={color} strokeOpacity={strong ? 0.6 : 0.2} />
      <text x={width / 2} y={11} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={8.5} fontWeight={strong ? 600 : 500} fill={color} fillOpacity={strong ? 1 : 0.65}>
        {children}
      </text>
    </g>
  )
}

export interface ChartCardRow {
  label: string
  value: ReactNode
  /** only the one signed figure carries a hue */
  color?: string
}

/** the readout card over a chart; place it inside a `relative` box that holds the svg */
export function ChartCard({
  open,
  x,
  y = 4,
  flip = false,
  width = 148,
  heading,
  rows,
  footer,
}: {
  open: boolean
  /** the cursor's x inside the box: px, or a percentage string for a chart drawn to a viewBox */
  x: number | string
  /** the card's top inside the box, px */
  y?: number
  /** put the card on the cursor's left (past ~60% of the plot) */
  flip?: boolean
  width?: number
  heading: ReactNode
  rows: ChartCardRow[]
  /** a closing line under the rows, such as where the point sits */
  footer?: ReactNode
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {open && (
        <motion.div
          key="chart-card"
          role="status"
          className="pointer-events-none absolute z-10"
          initial={{ left: x, top: y, opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ left: x, top: y, opacity: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, transition: { duration: 0.12 } }}
          transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { left: GLIDE, top: GLIDE, opacity: { duration: 0.15 } }}
        >
          <motion.div
            className="rounded-[12px] border border-foreground/[0.08] px-3 py-2.5"
            style={{
              width,
              translate: flip ? "calc(-100% - 12px) 0" : "12px 0",
              transition: reduced ? undefined : "translate 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)",
              background: "var(--tip-fill, color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 6%, var(--background)))",
              boxShadow: "0 8px 24px var(--card-shadow, rgba(0,0,0,calc(0.35 * var(--shadow-k, 1))))",
            }}
            initial={reduced ? false : { scale: 0.97 }}
            animate={{ scale: 1 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
          >
            <div className="text-[10px] text-foreground/60">{heading}</div>
            <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-col gap-1">
              {rows.map((r) => (
                <div key={r.label} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-foreground/60">{r.label}</span>
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-foreground/90" style={r.color ? { color: r.color } : undefined}>
                    {r.value}
                  </span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            {footer && <div className="mt-1.5 text-[10px]">{footer}</div>}
          </motion.div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  )
}


# Dotted Area Chart desk

// ─── components/ui/dotted-area-chart.tsx ───

"use client"

import { useId, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react"
import { motion, useInView, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { AxisTag } from "@/components/ui/chart-overlay"
import { LiveFigure } from "@/components/ui/live-figure"

/* Dotted Area Chart, rebuilt through the ssych-component skill (2026-09-29).
   What changed against the version before it (in git history), and why:
   · the line and the dot field are ink, not blue. Colour is kept for the change from the
     open, green or red
   · no raw colours in the source: the fade is an alpha mask on a token, so the white
     stops are gone, and the blue written as numbers is gone
   · the change is signed text, not a tinted chip
   · the scrub dot has no halo because there is no card colour under it
   Motion (2026-10-01): once the chart is in view the line and its dot field sweep in left to
   right through one clip (0.9s; they drew on mount, off screen too); a new series morphs the
   line and the field and glides the gridlines with their ticks.
   2026-10-02 audit: drawn at its real width, 560 (the Price chart family's width), so the
   type and the line no longer scale up by 1.22. The headline moved from under the plot to
   the three tier header on top: the name at /45 with the symbol at /90, the price at 26px
   with its cents at /35, then the move in its hue and the window or the pointed time at
   /45. The "96 bars" count is gone; the open is a dashed guide named on the axis ("$168
   Open", the price at /90, the name at /45) in place of a caption at /35. Gridlines are
   solid at 5%, the axis prints dollars at 9px /45, a row of times runs along the foot, and
   the pointed price is the shared AxisTag. The readout swaps only when a scrub starts or
   ends. New props: `name`, and `start` with `interval` to time the bars.
   Formulas:
   · move = the pointed price (or the last) − the open (the first price)
   · percent = move ÷ the open × 100
   · a bar's time = start + its index × interval
   2026-10-02 round 2: his notes, smaller dots and a lighter gradient at the top. The field's
   dots are 0.7px in radius on a 6px pitch (they were 1.15 on 8), so the texture reads finer,
   and the fade starts at 28% at the top (it was 42%), still falling to nothing at the floor. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GREEN = "var(--chart-up)"
const RED = "var(--chart-down)"
const INK = "var(--foreground)"

const W = 560
const H = 220
const PAD = { r: 60, t: 10, b: 24 }
/** pitch of the dot field under the line (round 2: 6, finer) */
const DOT = 6
/** a dot's radius in the field (round 2: 0.7, smaller) */
const DOT_R = 0.7
/** the fade's strength at the top of the plot (round 2: 0.28, lighter) */
const FADE_TOP = 0.28
/** what the stretch ahead of the pointer falls back to */
const DIM = 0.35

/** deterministic default series, a drifting session close */
const DEFAULT_PRICES: number[] = (() => {
  let s = 29
  let v = 168
  const out: number[] = []
  for (let i = 0; i < 96; i++) {
    s = (s * 16807) % 2147483647
    v = Math.max(120, v + (s / 2147483647 - 0.45) * 5.6)
    out.push(v)
  }
  return out
})()

export interface DottedAreaChartProps {
  /** the asset's name, on the label row's left */
  name?: string
  /** the symbol on the label row's right */
  symbol?: string
  /** series, oldest → latest; the headline and the change both derive from it */
  prices?: number[]
  /** the first bar's time, ms since epoch (UTC) */
  start?: number
  /** one bar's length, ms */
  interval?: number
  className?: string
}

const usd = (v: number) => `$${v.toLocaleString("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}`
const axisUsd = (v: number) => `$${Math.round(v).toLocaleString("en-US")}`
/** a time on the foot or in the header: the clock inside two days, the date past that */
const when = (t: number, span: number) =>
  span <= 2 * 86_400_000
    ? new Date(t).toLocaleTimeString("en-GB", { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", timeZone: "UTC" })
    : new Date(t).toLocaleDateString("en-US", { month: "short", day: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC" })
/** what the move is measured over, at rest */
const windowLabel = (span: number) => {
  const h = Math.round(span / 3_600_000)
  return h <= 48 ? `past ${h} hours` : `past ${Math.round(h / 24)} days`
}
/** how many times along the foot */
const FOOT = 5

/**
 * A price line standing on a field of dots: the area under it is filled with a dot
 * pattern that fades toward the floor, so the fill reads as texture instead of a slab.
 * Scrubbing splits the chart at the pointer, the stretch already passed stays lit while
 * the rest falls back, the price is tagged on the axis and the header reads that bar with
 * its move from the open.
 */
export function DottedAreaChart({
  name = "Bitcoin",
  symbol = "BTC",
  prices = DEFAULT_PRICES,
  start = Date.UTC(2026, 9, 1, 0, 0),
  interval = 15 * 60_000,
  className,
}: DottedAreaChartProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const svgRef = useRef<SVGSVGElement>(null)
  const [hover, setHover] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const uid = useId().replace(/:/g, "")
  /* the entrance plays once, when a third of the chart is in view; reduced motion lands at once */
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const seen = useInView(rootRef, { once: true, amount: 0.3 })
  const play = !!reduced || seen
  /** a change of data glides between the two states */
  const morph = reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.35, ease: EASE }

  const { data, n, min, max, x, y, line, area } = useMemo(() => {
    const data = prices.length ? prices : [0]
    const n = data.length
    const lo = Math.min(...data)
    const hi = Math.max(...data)
    const pad = (hi - lo) * 0.08 || 1
    const min = lo - pad
    const max = hi + pad
    const x = (i: number) => (i / Math.max(1, n - 1)) * (W - PAD.r)
    const y = (v: number) => PAD.t + (1 - (v - min) / (max - min || 1)) * (H - PAD.t - PAD.b)
    const line = data.map((v, i) => `${i === 0 ? "M" : "L"}${x(i).toFixed(1)},${y(v).toFixed(1)}`).join(" ")
    const area = `${line} L${x(n - 1).toFixed(1)},${H - PAD.b} L0,${H - PAD.b} Z`
    return { data, n, min, max, x, y, line, area }
  }, [prices])

  const open = data[0]
  const last = data[n - 1]
  const at = hover == null ? last : data[hover]
  const change = at - open
  const pct = (change / (open || 1)) * 100
  const up = change >= 0
  const hue = up ? GREEN : RED
  const sign = up ? "+" : "−"

  const onMove = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    const r = svgRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect()
    if (!r) return
    const px = ((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width) * W
    setHover(Math.max(0, Math.min(n - 1, Math.round((px / (W - PAD.r)) * (n - 1)))))
  }

  const ticks = [0.15, 0.5, 0.85].map((f) => max - f * (max - min))
  const span = Math.max(1, n - 1) * interval
  const time = (i: number) => start + i * interval
  /* even steps of the bar count, so a day of 96 quarter hours reads 00:00, 06:00, 12:00, 18:00 */
  const foot = Array.from({ length: FOOT }, (_, k) => Math.min(n - 1, Math.round((k * n) / (FOOT - 1))))
  const [whole, cents] = usd(at).split(".")
  /* the pointed tag, and the open's name on the axis, which steps aside under it */
  const tagY = hover == null ? 0 : Math.max(PAD.t + 8, Math.min(H - PAD.b - 8, y(at)))
  const openY = y(open)
  const openHidden = hover != null && Math.abs(openY - tagY) < 13

  return (
    <div ref={rootRef} className={cn("w-[560px] max-w-full tabular-nums", className)}>
      {/* the header, three tiers (spec 14.1); it swaps only when a scrub starts or ends, and follows the pointer in place */}
      <div className="mb-3 flex items-baseline justify-between text-[12px]">
        <span className="truncate text-foreground/45">{name}</span>
        <span className="shrink-0 pl-3 font-medium text-foreground/90">{symbol}</span>
      </div>
      <div role="status">
        <LiveFigure intent={hover == null ? null : "scrub"}>
          <p className="m-0 text-[26px] font-semibold leading-none tracking-[-0.02em] text-foreground/90">
            {whole}
            <span className="text-foreground/35">.{cents}</span>
          </p>
          <p className="mb-0 mt-2 flex items-baseline gap-[7px] text-[12px] font-medium" style={{ color: hue, transition: "color 160ms ease-out" }}>
            <span>
              {sign}
              {usd(Math.abs(change))} · {sign}
              {Math.abs(pct).toFixed(2)}%
            </span>
            <span className="font-normal text-foreground/45">{hover == null ? windowLabel(span) : when(time(hover), span)}</span>
          </p>
        </LiveFigure>
      </div>

      <svg
        ref={svgRef}
        width={W}
        height={H}
        viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`}
        className="mt-4 block h-auto w-full cursor-crosshair touch-none"
        onPointerMove={onMove}
        onPointerLeave={() => setHover(null)}
        role="img"
        aria-label={`${name} (${symbol}) price over the ${windowLabel(span)}, last ${usd(last)}, ${last >= open ? "up" : "down"} ${Math.abs(((last - open) / (open || 1)) * 100).toFixed(2)} percent from the open`}
      >
        <defs>
          {/* the dot field: one small dot of ink per 6px cell, the component's own texture */}
          <pattern id={`dots-${uid}`} x="0" y="0" width={DOT} height={DOT} patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
            <circle cx={DOT / 2} cy={DOT / 2} r={DOT_R} fill={INK} fillOpacity={0.9} />
          </pattern>
          {/* dots thin out toward the floor so the fill never reads as a block; the mask
              reads alpha, so its stops can be a token in both themes */}
          <linearGradient id={`fade-${uid}`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
            <stop offset="0%" stopColor={INK} stopOpacity={FADE_TOP} />
            <stop offset="100%" stopColor={INK} stopOpacity="0" />
          </linearGradient>
          <mask id={`mask-${uid}`} style={{ maskType: "alpha" }}>
            <rect x="0" y="0" width={W} height={H} fill={`url(#fade-${uid})`} />
          </mask>
          {/* everything left of the pointer stays lit; the rest falls back */}
          <clipPath id={`past-${uid}`}>
            <rect x="0" y="0" width={hover == null ? W : x(hover)} height={H} />
          </clipPath>
          {/* the one entrance: line and field sweep in left to right, a few px wider for the round caps */}
          <clipPath id={`reveal-${uid}`}>
            <motion.rect
              x={-4}
              y={0}
              height={H}
              initial={reduced ? false : { width: 0 }}
              animate={{ width: play ? W - PAD.r + 8 : 0 }}
              transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.9, ease: EASE }}
            />
          </clipPath>
        </defs>

        {/* gridlines and right-edge price ticks; a tick steps aside for the open's name or the pointed tag */}
        {ticks.map((v, i) => {
          const under = Math.abs(y(v) - openY) < 11 || (hover != null && Math.abs(y(v) - tagY) < 12)
          return (
            <g key={i}>
              <motion.line
                x1={0}
                x2={W - PAD.r}
                stroke={INK}
                strokeOpacity={0.05}
                strokeWidth={1}
                initial={false}
                animate={{ y1: y(v), y2: y(v) }}
                transition={morph}
              />
              <motion.text
                x={W - 4}
                textAnchor="end"
                fontSize={9}
                fill={INK}
                fillOpacity={0.45}
                className="tabular-nums"
                initial={false}
                animate={{ attrY: y(v) + 3 }}
                transition={morph}
                style={{ opacity: under ? 0 : 1, transition: "opacity 150ms" }}
              >
                {axisUsd(v)}
              </motion.text>
            </g>
          )
        })}

        {/* the open: a dashed guide, named on the axis as plain text (spec 14.7) */}
        <line x1={0} x2={W - PAD.r} y1={openY} y2={openY} stroke={INK} strokeOpacity={0.3} strokeDasharray="2 4" strokeWidth={1} />
        <text x={W - 4} y={openY + 3} textAnchor="end" fontSize={9} fill={INK} pointerEvents="none" style={{ opacity: openHidden ? 0 : 1, transition: "opacity 150ms" }}>
          <tspan fontWeight={500} fillOpacity={0.9}>
            {axisUsd(open)}
          </tspan>
          <tspan fillOpacity={0.45}> Open</tspan>
        </text>

        {/* times along the foot */}
        {foot.map((i, k) => (
          <text
            key={`${i}-${k}`}
            x={k === 0 ? 0 : k === FOOT - 1 ? W - PAD.r : x(i)}
            y={H - 6}
            textAnchor={k === 0 ? "start" : k === FOOT - 1 ? "end" : "middle"}
            fontSize={9}
            fill={INK}
            fillOpacity={0.45}
          >
            {when(time(i), span)}
          </text>
        ))}

        {/* resting state, and the bed the lit copy sits on while scrubbing; the group owns
            the hover dim (160ms), the clip owns the one sweep in, the paths morph on new data */}
        <g clipPath={`url(#reveal-${uid})`} style={{ opacity: hover == null ? 1 : DIM, transition: "opacity 160ms ease-out" }}>
          <motion.path
            fill={`url(#dots-${uid})`}
            mask={`url(#mask-${uid})`}
            initial={false}
            animate={{ d: area }}
            transition={morph}
          />
          <motion.path
            fill="none"
            stroke={INK}
            strokeOpacity={0.9}
            strokeWidth={1.8}
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
            initial={false}
            animate={{ d: line }}
            transition={morph}
          />
        </g>

        {/* the lit stretch behind the pointer */}
        {hover != null && (
          <g clipPath={`url(#past-${uid})`} pointerEvents="none">
            <path d={area} fill={`url(#dots-${uid})`} mask={`url(#mask-${uid})`} />
            <path d={line} fill="none" stroke={INK} strokeOpacity={0.9} strokeWidth={1.8} strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
          </g>
        )}

        {/* guide, the bar's own dot and its price tagged on the axis (chart-overlay.tsx) */}
        {hover != null && (
          <g pointerEvents="none">
            <line x1={x(hover)} y1={PAD.t} x2={x(hover)} y2={H - PAD.b} stroke={INK} strokeOpacity={0.16} strokeWidth={1} />
            <circle cx={x(hover)} cy={y(at)} r={3} fill={INK} />
            <AxisTag x={W - PAD.r + 4} y={tagY} width={PAD.r - 6} color={hue}>
              {usd(at)}
            </AxisTag>
          </g>
        )}
      </svg>

    </div>
  )
}


// ─── components/ui/chart-overlay.tsx ───

"use client"

import { type ReactNode } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

/* Chart overlay: the two parts every library chart reads a point with (2026-10-02). They
   came out of Candlestick, Volume Profile, the trading terminal and Price Scrubber, which
   had each drawn their own; this is the one copy. Shipped beside the charts that use it.

   AxisTag   the outlined tag on the value axis: the pointed value in its hue, or a named
             reference (POC, last close) in ink. A pill 16px high, 8.5px figures.
   ChartCard the card laid over the chart beside the cursor: a heading row (a time or a
             range) at /60, then label and value rows (labels 10px /60, values 11px /90),
             the one signed figure in its hue. It glides between points on a spring, fades
             in from 0.97 and out in 120ms, and flips to the cursor's left when told to.

   2026-10-02: the card looked out of place over the charts, so it now wears the library
   popover, the same as the sidebar's hover card: a hairline border at 8%, radius 12, the
   6% foreground mix and the popover shadow with no inset highlight (spec 14.6). */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GLIDE = { type: "spring", stiffness: 520, damping: 40 } as const

/** the outlined tag on a chart's value axis, centred on `y` */
export function AxisTag({
  x,
  y,
  width,
  color = "var(--foreground)",
  strong = true,
  hidden = false,
  children,
}: {
  /** the tag's left edge, in the chart's own units */
  x: number
  /** the value's line; the tag is centred on it */
  y: number
  width: number
  /** stroke and figure; ink for a named reference, the series hue for the pointed value */
  color?: string
  /** a quieter tag (a secondary reference) drops the weight and the stroke */
  strong?: boolean
  /** fades the tag out, for when the pointed value sits on it */
  hidden?: boolean
  children: ReactNode
}) {
  return (
    <g transform={`translate(${x}, ${y - 8})`} pointerEvents="none" style={{ opacity: hidden ? 0 : 1, transition: "opacity 150ms" }}>
      <rect width={width} height={16} rx={8} fill="var(--background)" stroke={color} strokeOpacity={strong ? 0.6 : 0.2} />
      <text x={width / 2} y={11} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={8.5} fontWeight={strong ? 600 : 500} fill={color} fillOpacity={strong ? 1 : 0.65}>
        {children}
      </text>
    </g>
  )
}

export interface ChartCardRow {
  label: string
  value: ReactNode
  /** only the one signed figure carries a hue */
  color?: string
}

/** the readout card over a chart; place it inside a `relative` box that holds the svg */
export function ChartCard({
  open,
  x,
  y = 4,
  flip = false,
  width = 148,
  heading,
  rows,
  footer,
}: {
  open: boolean
  /** the cursor's x inside the box: px, or a percentage string for a chart drawn to a viewBox */
  x: number | string
  /** the card's top inside the box, px */
  y?: number
  /** put the card on the cursor's left (past ~60% of the plot) */
  flip?: boolean
  width?: number
  heading: ReactNode
  rows: ChartCardRow[]
  /** a closing line under the rows, such as where the point sits */
  footer?: ReactNode
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {open && (
        <motion.div
          key="chart-card"
          role="status"
          className="pointer-events-none absolute z-10"
          initial={{ left: x, top: y, opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ left: x, top: y, opacity: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, transition: { duration: 0.12 } }}
          transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { left: GLIDE, top: GLIDE, opacity: { duration: 0.15 } }}
        >
          <motion.div
            className="rounded-[12px] border border-foreground/[0.08] px-3 py-2.5"
            style={{
              width,
              translate: flip ? "calc(-100% - 12px) 0" : "12px 0",
              transition: reduced ? undefined : "translate 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)",
              background: "var(--tip-fill, color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 6%, var(--background)))",
              boxShadow: "0 8px 24px var(--card-shadow, rgba(0,0,0,calc(0.35 * var(--shadow-k, 1))))",
            }}
            initial={reduced ? false : { scale: 0.97 }}
            animate={{ scale: 1 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
          >
            <div className="text-[10px] text-foreground/60">{heading}</div>
            <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-col gap-1">
              {rows.map((r) => (
                <div key={r.label} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-foreground/60">{r.label}</span>
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-foreground/90" style={r.color ? { color: r.color } : undefined}>
                    {r.value}
                  </span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            {footer && <div className="mt-1.5 text-[10px]">{footer}</div>}
          </motion.div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  )
}


// ─── components/ui/live-figure.tsx ───

"use client"

import { type ReactNode } from "react"
import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

/* Live figure: a figure fed by a live stream (2026-10-02, out of Tape Flow, where a price
   that re-entered on every print read as a flicker). The value changes in place on each
   tick; the figure swaps (4px, 2px blur, 150ms) only when `intent` changes: the pointer
   takes a point, lets it go, or a toggle flips. Pass the pointed point's id, or null for
   the live value. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const

export function LiveFigure({
  intent,
  className,
  children,
}: {
  /** what the figure is showing: a pointed point's id, or null while it follows the stream */
  intent: string | number | null
  className?: string
  children: ReactNode
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  return (
    <motion.div
      key={intent === null ? "live" : `at-${intent}`}
      className={cn(className)}
      initial={reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: 4, filter: "blur(2px)" }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, filter: "blur(0px)" }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
    >
      {children}
    </motion.div>
  )
}


# Dotted Area Chart mobile

// ─── components/ui/dotted-area-chart.tsx ───

"use client"

import { useId, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react"
import { motion, useInView, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { AxisTag } from "@/components/ui/chart-overlay"
import { LiveFigure } from "@/components/ui/live-figure"

/* Dotted Area Chart, rebuilt through the ssych-component skill (2026-09-29).
   What changed against the version before it (in git history), and why:
   · the line and the dot field are ink, not blue. Colour is kept for the change from the
     open, green or red
   · no raw colours in the source: the fade is an alpha mask on a token, so the white
     stops are gone, and the blue written as numbers is gone
   · the change is signed text, not a tinted chip
   · the scrub dot has no halo because there is no card colour under it
   Motion (2026-10-01): once the chart is in view the line and its dot field sweep in left to
   right through one clip (0.9s; they drew on mount, off screen too); a new series morphs the
   line and the field and glides the gridlines with their ticks.
   2026-10-02 audit: drawn at its real width, 560 (the Price chart family's width), so the
   type and the line no longer scale up by 1.22. The headline moved from under the plot to
   the three tier header on top: the name at /45 with the symbol at /90, the price at 26px
   with its cents at /35, then the move in its hue and the window or the pointed time at
   /45. The "96 bars" count is gone; the open is a dashed guide named on the axis ("$168
   Open", the price at /90, the name at /45) in place of a caption at /35. Gridlines are
   solid at 5%, the axis prints dollars at 9px /45, a row of times runs along the foot, and
   the pointed price is the shared AxisTag. The readout swaps only when a scrub starts or
   ends. New props: `name`, and `start` with `interval` to time the bars.
   Formulas:
   · move = the pointed price (or the last) − the open (the first price)
   · percent = move ÷ the open × 100
   · a bar's time = start + its index × interval
   2026-10-02 round 2: his notes, smaller dots and a lighter gradient at the top. The field's
   dots are 0.7px in radius on a 6px pitch (they were 1.15 on 8), so the texture reads finer,
   and the fade starts at 28% at the top (it was 42%), still falling to nothing at the floor. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GREEN = "var(--chart-up)"
const RED = "var(--chart-down)"
const INK = "var(--foreground)"

const W = 560
const H = 220
const PAD = { r: 60, t: 10, b: 24 }
/** pitch of the dot field under the line (round 2: 6, finer) */
const DOT = 6
/** a dot's radius in the field (round 2: 0.7, smaller) */
const DOT_R = 0.7
/** the fade's strength at the top of the plot (round 2: 0.28, lighter) */
const FADE_TOP = 0.28
/** what the stretch ahead of the pointer falls back to */
const DIM = 0.35

/** deterministic default series, a drifting session close */
const DEFAULT_PRICES: number[] = (() => {
  let s = 29
  let v = 168
  const out: number[] = []
  for (let i = 0; i < 96; i++) {
    s = (s * 16807) % 2147483647
    v = Math.max(120, v + (s / 2147483647 - 0.45) * 5.6)
    out.push(v)
  }
  return out
})()

export interface DottedAreaChartProps {
  /** the asset's name, on the label row's left */
  name?: string
  /** the symbol on the label row's right */
  symbol?: string
  /** series, oldest → latest; the headline and the change both derive from it */
  prices?: number[]
  /** the first bar's time, ms since epoch (UTC) */
  start?: number
  /** one bar's length, ms */
  interval?: number
  className?: string
}

const usd = (v: number) => `$${v.toLocaleString("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}`
const axisUsd = (v: number) => `$${Math.round(v).toLocaleString("en-US")}`
/** a time on the foot or in the header: the clock inside two days, the date past that */
const when = (t: number, span: number) =>
  span <= 2 * 86_400_000
    ? new Date(t).toLocaleTimeString("en-GB", { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", timeZone: "UTC" })
    : new Date(t).toLocaleDateString("en-US", { month: "short", day: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC" })
/** what the move is measured over, at rest */
const windowLabel = (span: number) => {
  const h = Math.round(span / 3_600_000)
  return h <= 48 ? `past ${h} hours` : `past ${Math.round(h / 24)} days`
}
/** how many times along the foot */
const FOOT = 5

/**
 * A price line standing on a field of dots: the area under it is filled with a dot
 * pattern that fades toward the floor, so the fill reads as texture instead of a slab.
 * Scrubbing splits the chart at the pointer, the stretch already passed stays lit while
 * the rest falls back, the price is tagged on the axis and the header reads that bar with
 * its move from the open.
 */
export function DottedAreaChart({
  name = "Bitcoin",
  symbol = "BTC",
  prices = DEFAULT_PRICES,
  start = Date.UTC(2026, 9, 1, 0, 0),
  interval = 15 * 60_000,
  className,
}: DottedAreaChartProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const svgRef = useRef<SVGSVGElement>(null)
  const [hover, setHover] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const uid = useId().replace(/:/g, "")
  /* the entrance plays once, when a third of the chart is in view; reduced motion lands at once */
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const seen = useInView(rootRef, { once: true, amount: 0.3 })
  const play = !!reduced || seen
  /** a change of data glides between the two states */
  const morph = reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.35, ease: EASE }

  const { data, n, min, max, x, y, line, area } = useMemo(() => {
    const data = prices.length ? prices : [0]
    const n = data.length
    const lo = Math.min(...data)
    const hi = Math.max(...data)
    const pad = (hi - lo) * 0.08 || 1
    const min = lo - pad
    const max = hi + pad
    const x = (i: number) => (i / Math.max(1, n - 1)) * (W - PAD.r)
    const y = (v: number) => PAD.t + (1 - (v - min) / (max - min || 1)) * (H - PAD.t - PAD.b)
    const line = data.map((v, i) => `${i === 0 ? "M" : "L"}${x(i).toFixed(1)},${y(v).toFixed(1)}`).join(" ")
    const area = `${line} L${x(n - 1).toFixed(1)},${H - PAD.b} L0,${H - PAD.b} Z`
    return { data, n, min, max, x, y, line, area }
  }, [prices])

  const open = data[0]
  const last = data[n - 1]
  const at = hover == null ? last : data[hover]
  const change = at - open
  const pct = (change / (open || 1)) * 100
  const up = change >= 0
  const hue = up ? GREEN : RED
  const sign = up ? "+" : "−"

  const onMove = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    const r = svgRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect()
    if (!r) return
    const px = ((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width) * W
    setHover(Math.max(0, Math.min(n - 1, Math.round((px / (W - PAD.r)) * (n - 1)))))
  }

  const ticks = [0.15, 0.5, 0.85].map((f) => max - f * (max - min))
  const span = Math.max(1, n - 1) * interval
  const time = (i: number) => start + i * interval
  /* even steps of the bar count, so a day of 96 quarter hours reads 00:00, 06:00, 12:00, 18:00 */
  const foot = Array.from({ length: FOOT }, (_, k) => Math.min(n - 1, Math.round((k * n) / (FOOT - 1))))
  const [whole, cents] = usd(at).split(".")
  /* the pointed tag, and the open's name on the axis, which steps aside under it */
  const tagY = hover == null ? 0 : Math.max(PAD.t + 8, Math.min(H - PAD.b - 8, y(at)))
  const openY = y(open)
  const openHidden = hover != null && Math.abs(openY - tagY) < 13

  return (
    <div ref={rootRef} className={cn("w-[560px] max-w-full tabular-nums", className)}>
      {/* the header, three tiers (spec 14.1); it swaps only when a scrub starts or ends, and follows the pointer in place */}
      <div className="mb-3 flex items-baseline justify-between text-[12px]">
        <span className="truncate text-foreground/45">{name}</span>
        <span className="shrink-0 pl-3 font-medium text-foreground/90">{symbol}</span>
      </div>
      <div role="status">
        <LiveFigure intent={hover == null ? null : "scrub"}>
          <p className="m-0 text-[26px] font-semibold leading-none tracking-[-0.02em] text-foreground/90">
            {whole}
            <span className="text-foreground/35">.{cents}</span>
          </p>
          <p className="mb-0 mt-2 flex items-baseline gap-[7px] text-[12px] font-medium" style={{ color: hue, transition: "color 160ms ease-out" }}>
            <span>
              {sign}
              {usd(Math.abs(change))} · {sign}
              {Math.abs(pct).toFixed(2)}%
            </span>
            <span className="font-normal text-foreground/45">{hover == null ? windowLabel(span) : when(time(hover), span)}</span>
          </p>
        </LiveFigure>
      </div>

      <svg
        ref={svgRef}
        width={W}
        height={H}
        viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`}
        className="mt-4 block h-auto w-full cursor-crosshair touch-none"
        onPointerMove={onMove}
        onPointerLeave={() => setHover(null)}
        role="img"
        aria-label={`${name} (${symbol}) price over the ${windowLabel(span)}, last ${usd(last)}, ${last >= open ? "up" : "down"} ${Math.abs(((last - open) / (open || 1)) * 100).toFixed(2)} percent from the open`}
      >
        <defs>
          {/* the dot field: one small dot of ink per 6px cell, the component's own texture */}
          <pattern id={`dots-${uid}`} x="0" y="0" width={DOT} height={DOT} patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
            <circle cx={DOT / 2} cy={DOT / 2} r={DOT_R} fill={INK} fillOpacity={0.9} />
          </pattern>
          {/* dots thin out toward the floor so the fill never reads as a block; the mask
              reads alpha, so its stops can be a token in both themes */}
          <linearGradient id={`fade-${uid}`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
            <stop offset="0%" stopColor={INK} stopOpacity={FADE_TOP} />
            <stop offset="100%" stopColor={INK} stopOpacity="0" />
          </linearGradient>
          <mask id={`mask-${uid}`} style={{ maskType: "alpha" }}>
            <rect x="0" y="0" width={W} height={H} fill={`url(#fade-${uid})`} />
          </mask>
          {/* everything left of the pointer stays lit; the rest falls back */}
          <clipPath id={`past-${uid}`}>
            <rect x="0" y="0" width={hover == null ? W : x(hover)} height={H} />
          </clipPath>
          {/* the one entrance: line and field sweep in left to right, a few px wider for the round caps */}
          <clipPath id={`reveal-${uid}`}>
            <motion.rect
              x={-4}
              y={0}
              height={H}
              initial={reduced ? false : { width: 0 }}
              animate={{ width: play ? W - PAD.r + 8 : 0 }}
              transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.9, ease: EASE }}
            />
          </clipPath>
        </defs>

        {/* gridlines and right-edge price ticks; a tick steps aside for the open's name or the pointed tag */}
        {ticks.map((v, i) => {
          const under = Math.abs(y(v) - openY) < 11 || (hover != null && Math.abs(y(v) - tagY) < 12)
          return (
            <g key={i}>
              <motion.line
                x1={0}
                x2={W - PAD.r}
                stroke={INK}
                strokeOpacity={0.05}
                strokeWidth={1}
                initial={false}
                animate={{ y1: y(v), y2: y(v) }}
                transition={morph}
              />
              <motion.text
                x={W - 4}
                textAnchor="end"
                fontSize={9}
                fill={INK}
                fillOpacity={0.45}
                className="tabular-nums"
                initial={false}
                animate={{ attrY: y(v) + 3 }}
                transition={morph}
                style={{ opacity: under ? 0 : 1, transition: "opacity 150ms" }}
              >
                {axisUsd(v)}
              </motion.text>
            </g>
          )
        })}

        {/* the open: a dashed guide, named on the axis as plain text (spec 14.7) */}
        <line x1={0} x2={W - PAD.r} y1={openY} y2={openY} stroke={INK} strokeOpacity={0.3} strokeDasharray="2 4" strokeWidth={1} />
        <text x={W - 4} y={openY + 3} textAnchor="end" fontSize={9} fill={INK} pointerEvents="none" style={{ opacity: openHidden ? 0 : 1, transition: "opacity 150ms" }}>
          <tspan fontWeight={500} fillOpacity={0.9}>
            {axisUsd(open)}
          </tspan>
          <tspan fillOpacity={0.45}> Open</tspan>
        </text>

        {/* times along the foot */}
        {foot.map((i, k) => (
          <text
            key={`${i}-${k}`}
            x={k === 0 ? 0 : k === FOOT - 1 ? W - PAD.r : x(i)}
            y={H - 6}
            textAnchor={k === 0 ? "start" : k === FOOT - 1 ? "end" : "middle"}
            fontSize={9}
            fill={INK}
            fillOpacity={0.45}
          >
            {when(time(i), span)}
          </text>
        ))}

        {/* resting state, and the bed the lit copy sits on while scrubbing; the group owns
            the hover dim (160ms), the clip owns the one sweep in, the paths morph on new data */}
        <g clipPath={`url(#reveal-${uid})`} style={{ opacity: hover == null ? 1 : DIM, transition: "opacity 160ms ease-out" }}>
          <motion.path
            fill={`url(#dots-${uid})`}
            mask={`url(#mask-${uid})`}
            initial={false}
            animate={{ d: area }}
            transition={morph}
          />
          <motion.path
            fill="none"
            stroke={INK}
            strokeOpacity={0.9}
            strokeWidth={1.8}
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
            initial={false}
            animate={{ d: line }}
            transition={morph}
          />
        </g>

        {/* the lit stretch behind the pointer */}
        {hover != null && (
          <g clipPath={`url(#past-${uid})`} pointerEvents="none">
            <path d={area} fill={`url(#dots-${uid})`} mask={`url(#mask-${uid})`} />
            <path d={line} fill="none" stroke={INK} strokeOpacity={0.9} strokeWidth={1.8} strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
          </g>
        )}

        {/* guide, the bar's own dot and its price tagged on the axis (chart-overlay.tsx) */}
        {hover != null && (
          <g pointerEvents="none">
            <line x1={x(hover)} y1={PAD.t} x2={x(hover)} y2={H - PAD.b} stroke={INK} strokeOpacity={0.16} strokeWidth={1} />
            <circle cx={x(hover)} cy={y(at)} r={3} fill={INK} />
            <AxisTag x={W - PAD.r + 4} y={tagY} width={PAD.r - 6} color={hue}>
              {usd(at)}
            </AxisTag>
          </g>
        )}
      </svg>

    </div>
  )
}


// ─── components/ui/chart-overlay.tsx ───

"use client"

import { type ReactNode } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

/* Chart overlay: the two parts every library chart reads a point with (2026-10-02). They
   came out of Candlestick, Volume Profile, the trading terminal and Price Scrubber, which
   had each drawn their own; this is the one copy. Shipped beside the charts that use it.

   AxisTag   the outlined tag on the value axis: the pointed value in its hue, or a named
             reference (POC, last close) in ink. A pill 16px high, 8.5px figures.
   ChartCard the card laid over the chart beside the cursor: a heading row (a time or a
             range) at /60, then label and value rows (labels 10px /60, values 11px /90),
             the one signed figure in its hue. It glides between points on a spring, fades
             in from 0.97 and out in 120ms, and flips to the cursor's left when told to.

   2026-10-02: the card looked out of place over the charts, so it now wears the library
   popover, the same as the sidebar's hover card: a hairline border at 8%, radius 12, the
   6% foreground mix and the popover shadow with no inset highlight (spec 14.6). */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GLIDE = { type: "spring", stiffness: 520, damping: 40 } as const

/** the outlined tag on a chart's value axis, centred on `y` */
export function AxisTag({
  x,
  y,
  width,
  color = "var(--foreground)",
  strong = true,
  hidden = false,
  children,
}: {
  /** the tag's left edge, in the chart's own units */
  x: number
  /** the value's line; the tag is centred on it */
  y: number
  width: number
  /** stroke and figure; ink for a named reference, the series hue for the pointed value */
  color?: string
  /** a quieter tag (a secondary reference) drops the weight and the stroke */
  strong?: boolean
  /** fades the tag out, for when the pointed value sits on it */
  hidden?: boolean
  children: ReactNode
}) {
  return (
    <g transform={`translate(${x}, ${y - 8})`} pointerEvents="none" style={{ opacity: hidden ? 0 : 1, transition: "opacity 150ms" }}>
      <rect width={width} height={16} rx={8} fill="var(--background)" stroke={color} strokeOpacity={strong ? 0.6 : 0.2} />
      <text x={width / 2} y={11} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={8.5} fontWeight={strong ? 600 : 500} fill={color} fillOpacity={strong ? 1 : 0.65}>
        {children}
      </text>
    </g>
  )
}

export interface ChartCardRow {
  label: string
  value: ReactNode
  /** only the one signed figure carries a hue */
  color?: string
}

/** the readout card over a chart; place it inside a `relative` box that holds the svg */
export function ChartCard({
  open,
  x,
  y = 4,
  flip = false,
  width = 148,
  heading,
  rows,
  footer,
}: {
  open: boolean
  /** the cursor's x inside the box: px, or a percentage string for a chart drawn to a viewBox */
  x: number | string
  /** the card's top inside the box, px */
  y?: number
  /** put the card on the cursor's left (past ~60% of the plot) */
  flip?: boolean
  width?: number
  heading: ReactNode
  rows: ChartCardRow[]
  /** a closing line under the rows, such as where the point sits */
  footer?: ReactNode
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {open && (
        <motion.div
          key="chart-card"
          role="status"
          className="pointer-events-none absolute z-10"
          initial={{ left: x, top: y, opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ left: x, top: y, opacity: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, transition: { duration: 0.12 } }}
          transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { left: GLIDE, top: GLIDE, opacity: { duration: 0.15 } }}
        >
          <motion.div
            className="rounded-[12px] border border-foreground/[0.08] px-3 py-2.5"
            style={{
              width,
              translate: flip ? "calc(-100% - 12px) 0" : "12px 0",
              transition: reduced ? undefined : "translate 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)",
              background: "var(--tip-fill, color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 6%, var(--background)))",
              boxShadow: "0 8px 24px var(--card-shadow, rgba(0,0,0,calc(0.35 * var(--shadow-k, 1))))",
            }}
            initial={reduced ? false : { scale: 0.97 }}
            animate={{ scale: 1 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
          >
            <div className="text-[10px] text-foreground/60">{heading}</div>
            <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-col gap-1">
              {rows.map((r) => (
                <div key={r.label} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-foreground/60">{r.label}</span>
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-foreground/90" style={r.color ? { color: r.color } : undefined}>
                    {r.value}
                  </span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            {footer && <div className="mt-1.5 text-[10px]">{footer}</div>}
          </motion.div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  )
}


// ─── components/ui/live-figure.tsx ───

"use client"

import { type ReactNode } from "react"
import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

/* Live figure: a figure fed by a live stream (2026-10-02, out of Tape Flow, where a price
   that re-entered on every print read as a flicker). The value changes in place on each
   tick; the figure swaps (4px, 2px blur, 150ms) only when `intent` changes: the pointer
   takes a point, lets it go, or a toggle flips. Pass the pointed point's id, or null for
   the live value. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const

export function LiveFigure({
  intent,
  className,
  children,
}: {
  /** what the figure is showing: a pointed point's id, or null while it follows the stream */
  intent: string | number | null
  className?: string
  children: ReactNode
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  return (
    <motion.div
      key={intent === null ? "live" : `at-${intent}`}
      className={cn(className)}
      initial={reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: 4, filter: "blur(2px)" }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, filter: "blur(0px)" }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
    >
      {children}
    </motion.div>
  )
}


# Market Snapshot desk
// ─── components/ui/market-snapshot.tsx ───

"use client"

import { useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent, type PointerEvent as ReactPointerEvent } from "react"
import { motion, useInView, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { RotateCw } from "lucide-react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { ICON_BUTTON, SEGMENT_OFF, THUMB, TRACK } from "@/components/ui/control-classes"

/* Market Snapshot, rebuilt through the ssych-component skill (2026-09-29).
   What changed against the version before it (in git history), and why:
   · no card: the 26px rounded ground is gone, it sits on the page. Pulling still moves the
     whole block down and the ssych mark draws itself in the room it leaves
   · one large size, 26px, for the price. The cents step back by ink, not by a second size
   · every figure is tabular, set once on the root
   · the line is 1.8px and draws in once on mount; the scrub mark is a plain dot, not a
     ring cut out of a card colour
   · nothing moves for longer than 400ms and nothing overshoots: the settle is 360ms and
     the period fill 250ms, both on the house ease (they were 480ms and 380ms)
   · the price and the move are a status readout, so scrubbing is read out in place
   Props are unchanged.
   Motion (2026-10-01): the line wipes in from the left once, 850ms, when the block first
   comes into view (each period used to wipe its own line in from blank). A period switch
   or a landed refresh now carries the old view into the new one in 380ms: the new line
   starts drawn at the old window's scale and position (the same prices sit where they sat)
   and eases to its own, so a longer period opens outward and a refresh slides the new
   price in from the right. The live dot rides the line's end. Reduced motion draws every
   state at once.
   2026-10-02 audit: the period switch is cut from the library's control material (TRACK,
   THUMB and SEGMENT_OFF from control-classes) in place of a hand made 8% fill, so it turns
   white on a raised light surface like every other switcher. The footer's two captions at
   /35 are gone: the exchange moved into the aria-label, and "Updated 1:54 PM" became a quiet
   refresh button at /60 that runs the same refresh as the pull, so a mouse user can find it.
   After a refresh lands it reads "Updated just now". Simple Chart no longer copies the pull
   machine, so nothing here is duplicated any more. */

const UP = "var(--chart-up)"
const DOWN = "var(--chart-down)"
const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const EASE_CSS = "cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)"

const PERIODS = ["1D", "1W", "1M", "3M", "YTD", "1Y", "All"] as const
type Period = (typeof PERIODS)[number]
const DEFAULT_VALUES = [178.52, 176.84, 180.15, 181.42, 179.96, 184.22, 187.61, 190.04, 188.72, 194.85, 202.14, 198.93, 211.75, 224.68, 219.42, 236.18, 248.06, 243.44, 268.31, 284.12, 276.88, 301.45]

/** window each period button represents, in days; drives the scrub date */
const WINDOW_DAYS: Record<Period, number> = { "1D": 1, "1W": 7, "1M": 30, "3M": 90, YTD: 210, "1Y": 365, All: 660 }
/** what the move line says the move is measured over, at rest */
const WINDOW_LABEL: Record<Period, string> = { "1D": "past day", "1W": "past week", "1M": "past month", "3M": "past 3 months", YTD: "year to date", "1Y": "past year", All: "all time" }

const VB_W = 100
const VB_H = 40
const PAD_Y = 6
const PULL_AT = 64
const PULL_MAX = 96
const PULL_HOLD = 56
const HOLD_MS = 1000
const SETTLE_MS = 360
/** the ssych mark (src/assets/library-mark.ts), copied in: a registry file is self-contained */
const MARK_VB = "0 0 437.287 529.764"
const MARK_D =
  "M354.084 0C374.63 8.50833 392.5 23.8578 403.922 44.9326C418.809 72.4024 419.569 103.739 408.683 130.599C372.855 219 258.635 211.309 206.626 211.71C145.919 212.178 96.2825 259.131 91.5504 318.731C95.9969 371.278 140.054 412.539 193.751 412.539C250.399 412.539 296.322 366.615 296.322 309.967C296.322 285.118 287.485 262.333 272.784 244.583C323.926 247.005 407.022 268.509 437.287 366.686C413.233 460.456 328.149 529.763 226.877 529.764C175.525 529.764 128.335 511.943 91.1539 482.149C67.7037 480.784 45.3008 488.644 28.0719 502.979C-6.1077 470.701 -9.49672 415.736 20.2223 379.638C12.3178 355.271 9.66566 330.28 9.66566 304.795C9.6658 186.402 110.21 87.5845 226.877 87.584C253.145 87.584 278.167 88.1909 302.354 75.083C331.715 59.1705 349.967 30.7466 354.084 0Z"

function mulberry32(seed: number) {
  return () => {
    seed |= 0
    seed = (seed + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0
    let t = Math.imul(seed ^ (seed >>> 15), 1 | seed)
    t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296
  }
}

/** Catmull-Rom through the samples, written as cubic Béziers, so the line reads as one smooth stroke */
function smoothPath(pts: { x: number; y: number }[]) {
  if (pts.length < 2) return ""
  let d = `M${pts[0].x.toFixed(2)} ${pts[0].y.toFixed(2)}`
  for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) {
    const p0 = pts[i - 1] ?? pts[i]
    const p1 = pts[i]
    const p2 = pts[i + 1]
    const p3 = pts[i + 2] ?? p2
    d += ` C${(p1.x + (p2.x - p0.x) / 6).toFixed(2)} ${(p1.y + (p2.y - p0.y) / 6).toFixed(2)} ${(p2.x - (p3.x - p1.x) / 6).toFixed(2)} ${(p2.y - (p3.y - p1.y) / 6).toFixed(2)} ${p2.x.toFixed(2)} ${p2.y.toFixed(2)}`
  }
  return d
}

const money = (n: number) => n.toLocaleString("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })

type Phase = "idle" | "pull" | "work" | "settle"

export interface MarketSnapshotProps {
  /** ticker shown top-right */
  symbol?: string
  /** company name above the price */
  name?: string
  /** full price series, oldest → latest (period buttons slice it) */
  values?: number[]
  /** where it trades; read in the aria-label (it was a footer caption before 2026-10-02) */
  exchange?: string
  /** the refresh button's label until a refresh lands */
  updatedAt?: string
  className?: string
}

/**
 * Market snapshot: the price over one smooth, period-sliced line. Scrubbing moves a dot
 * along the line with a faint guide, and the price, the move and the date all read that
 * point. The period tabs slide one fill between them. Pull the block down to refresh: the
