          style={{ left: `${point.x}%`, opacity: hover == null ? 0 : 0.18 }}
        />
        <i
          aria-hidden
          className="pointer-events-none absolute -ml-[3.5px] -mt-[3.5px] h-[7px] w-[7px] rounded-full bg-current"
          style={{
            left: `min(${point.x}%, calc(100% - 4px))`,
            top: `${((point.y / VB_H) * 100).toFixed(3)}%`,
            scale: hover == null ? 1 : 1.3,
            opacity: shown ? 1 : 0,
            transition: reduced ? "none" : `scale 160ms ${EASE_CSS}, opacity 250ms ${EASE_CSS} 350ms`,
          }}
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}


// ─── components/ui/control-classes.ts ───

/* Control classes: the library's control material for components that ship on their own
   (2026-10-02, the audit's pattern 11). src/components/library/controls.ts is the site's
   copy; components used to paste its look in as a flat 8% fill "so the file ships alone",
   and those copies never turned white on a raised light surface. These read the same
   tokens WITH a fallback, so they follow the site's raised-surface rule here and still
   draw correctly in a buyer's app that has no such tokens. Shipped beside every component
   that imports it (scripts/build-registry.mjs bundles ui helpers automatically).

   Whole class strings, never assembled from pieces: Tailwind reads this file as text. */

/** what is ON in a switcher. Light (his call, 2026-10-02, after the inline slider): a WHITE
 *  pill with a hairline and a soft shadow on the grey track. Dark: the 8% thumb */
export const THUMB =
  "bg-white shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--light-outline,rgba(0,0,0,0.09)),0_1px_3px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] dark:bg-[var(--control-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_8%,transparent))] dark:shadow-[var(--control-shadow,inset_0_1px_0_0_color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_6%,transparent))]"

/** what a switcher's options sit in; its 2px padding is the gap the thumb keeps. Light: a
 *  light grey track with no outline, the white pill sits in it. Dark: a hairline, no fill */
export const TRACK = "rounded-full border border-transparent bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_5%,var(--background))] p-0.5 dark:border-foreground/[0.04] dark:bg-transparent"

/** an option that is off: the label alone answers the pointer */
export const SEGMENT_OFF = "text-foreground/60 hover:text-foreground/90"

/** a secondary button: the thumb standing alone; size it with h-7 / h-9 and px */
export const BUTTON =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--control-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_8%,transparent))] shadow-[var(--control-shadow,inset_0_1px_0_0_color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_6%,transparent))] text-foreground/90 outline-none transition-[color,background-color,scale] duration-150 hover:bg-[var(--control-fill-hover,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_12%,transparent))] focus-visible:bg-[var(--control-fill-hover,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_12%,transparent))] active:scale-[0.97] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40 motion-reduce:active:scale-100"

/** an icon-only control: no fill at rest, a faint one under the pointer */
export const ICON_BUTTON =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-full text-foreground/60 outline-none transition-[color,background-color] duration-150 hover:bg-foreground/[0.06] hover:text-foreground/90 focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.06]"

/** a field: the track with just enough fill to read as somewhere to type */
export const FIELD =
  "rounded-full border border-foreground/[0.04] bg-[var(--field-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_5%,transparent))] text-foreground/90 outline-none transition-[background-color,border-color] duration-150 placeholder:text-foreground/45 focus:border-foreground/[0.12]"

/** the one loud button of a form: 48px, full width, the foreground filled (the dashboards'
 *  Modal primary). A ticket, a swap, a confirm: one of these and nothing louder */
export const BUTTON_PRIMARY =
  "inline-flex h-12 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-foreground/[0.92] text-[14px] font-medium text-background outline-none transition-[background-color,scale,opacity] duration-150 hover:bg-foreground focus-visible:bg-foreground active:scale-[0.98] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40 motion-reduce:active:scale-100"

/** a component's own card, field or block (spec 14.8). Dark: a #121212 fill on black. Light
 *  (his call, 2026-10-02: "on light the card background is too dark, it can just be white, a
 *  quiet outline and a small shadow"): white, a 1px hairline (Kraken's #e7e6e9, or 9% ink in an app without the token) and a
 *  barely there shadow,
 *  drawn as box shadows so the outline takes no layout */
export const SURFACE =
  "bg-background shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--light-outline,color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_9%,transparent)),0_1px_2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] dark:bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_7%,var(--background))] dark:shadow-none"

/** a block sitting ON a surface: a faint 4% grey inside a white card in light, #1f1f1f in dark */
export const RAISED = "bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_4%,var(--background))] dark:bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_12%,var(--background))]"


// ─── components/ui/live-figure.tsx ───

"use client"

import { type ReactNode } from "react"
import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

/* Live figure: a figure fed by a live stream (2026-10-02, out of Tape Flow, where a price
   that re-entered on every print read as a flicker). The value changes in place on each
   tick; the figure swaps (4px, 2px blur, 150ms) only when `intent` changes: the pointer
   takes a point, lets it go, or a toggle flips. Pass the pointed point's id, or null for
   the live value. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const

export function LiveFigure({
  intent,
  className,
  children,
}: {
  /** what the figure is showing: a pointed point's id, or null while it follows the stream */
  intent: string | number | null
  className?: string
  children: ReactNode
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  return (
    <motion.div
      key={intent === null ? "live" : `at-${intent}`}
      className={cn(className)}
      initial={reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: 4, filter: "blur(2px)" }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, filter: "blur(0px)" }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
    >
      {children}
    </motion.div>
  )
}


# Index Card desk
// ─── components/ui/index-card.tsx ───

"use client"

import { useId, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useInView, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { SEGMENT_OFF, SURFACE, THUMB, TRACK } from "@/components/ui/control-classes"
import { LiveFigure } from "@/components/ui/live-figure"

/* Index Card, rebuilt through the ssych-component skill (2026-09-29).
   What changed against the version before it (in git history), and why:
   · no card: the outline, the card ground, the header band and the two inner rules are
     gone, and so is the dotted paper behind the line. Three 1px gridlines at 5% ink stay
   · the caption is ink, not amber: colour is kept for up and down
   · every figure is tabular (the root sets it, so the tab names with digits line up too)
   · the session time is plain text beside the price while you scrub, not a bordered chip
     riding the pointer
   · the index switcher is a row of quiet pills with one fill that slides to the chosen
     one (it was an underline on a rule)
   · the line is 1.8px with round joins; the change is printed with a true minus sign
   · the chart names itself to a screen reader, with the index and its close
   Motion (2026-10-01): once the plot first comes into view the line and its fill are wiped
   in from the left by one clip, 850ms. Changing index morphs the line and the fill from the
   old session into the new one in 380ms (both walks are 48 samples, so the paths tween
   point for point) and the hue crosses over; it used to wipe out and redraw. Reduced
   motion draws every state at once.
   2026-10-02 audit: it sits in a box now (his call), the surface step at 7% with radius 24
   and a 10px padding, the type 16px in. The eyebrow and the 19px price gave way to the
   three tier header: the index's name at /45 with its symbol at /90, the level at 26px
   with its decimals at /35, then the change in its hue and "today" or the pointed time at
   /45. Index levels are points, so no dollar sign anywhere. Scrubbing changes the figures
   in place; they swap only when a scrub starts or ends or the index changes (they used to
   blur in again on every pointer step). The index switch is cut from the control material
   (TRACK, THUMB, SEGMENT_OFF) and glides on the tab ease; the note is 12px at /70, two
   lines at most. "Russel 2K" is spelled Russell 2000. IndexQuote gains optional `name`
   and `symbol` for the label row, and the pointed level is now anchored to the day's open
   so the move on the sub line is derivable.
   Formulas:
   · open = close − the change written in `delta`
   · level at a sample i = open + (close − open) × i ÷ 47 + 0.0004 × close × (w_i − w_0 −
     (w_47 − w_0) × i ÷ 47), where w is the index's seeded walk; it opens at the open and
     closes on the close exactly
   · pointed move = level − open; percent = move ÷ open × 100
   2026-10-02 round 2: his notes. The index switch is roomier: the box's padding is 6px
   instead of 10, so the track runs 328px wide, and each switch is 30px tall with 4px between
   them (corner 24 = the track's 18 + the 6px gap). The small caps index reads "Russell 2K"
   again on its switch and in the label row. The day's line runs the box's full width, edge
   to edge, with no side padding (the plot is 340 wide now, drawn 1:1); the type keeps its
   16px inset. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GREEN = "var(--chart-up)"
const RED = "var(--chart-down)"

/** the plot spans the box's full width, edge to edge (round 2) */
const W = 340
const H = 110
const SAMPLES = 48
/** fractions down the plot where a gridline sits */
const GRID = [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]
/** the walk's units, as a share of the close */
const WIGGLE = 0.0004

export interface IndexQuote {
  /** the short name on its switch */
  label: string
  /** the full name in the label row; falls back to `label` */
  name?: string
  /** the symbol on the label row's right, e.g. "SPX" */
  symbol?: string
  /** Already-formatted close in points, e.g. "5,648.40". */
  price: string
  /** Already-formatted change, e.g. "+63.97 (+1.15%)". A leading − flips the hue. */
  delta: string
  /** Deterministic seed for this index's intraday walk. */
  seed: number
  /** The short read under the line, two lines at most. */
  note: string
}

const DEFAULT_INDICES: IndexQuote[] = [
  {
    label: "S&P 500",
    symbol: "SPX",
    price: "5,648.40",
    delta: "+63.97 (+1.15%)",
    seed: 5,
    note: "Broad strength into the close; 8 of 11 sectors finished green, led by industrials and financials.",
  },
  {
    label: "Dow 30",
    name: "Dow Jones 30",
    symbol: "DJI",
    price: "41,563.08",
    delta: "+228.03 (+0.55%)",
    seed: 31,
    note: "Blue chips ground higher through the session on a soft landing read of the latest inflation print.",
  },
  {
    label: "Nasdaq",
    name: "Nasdaq Composite",
    symbol: "IXIC",
    price: "17,713.62",
    delta: "+197.19 (+1.13%)",
    seed: 77,
    note: "Megacap tech carried the tape; semis rebounded from early weakness to finish near session highs.",
  },
  {
    label: "Russell 2K",
    symbol: "RUT",
    price: "2,178.52",
    delta: "+14.10 (+0.65%)",
    seed: 111,
    note: "Consumer sentiment turned up for the first time in five months, and small caps took the hint.",
  },
]

/** Deterministic intraday walk: same seed, same shape, every render. */
function walk(seed: number, n: number) {
  let s = seed
  let v = 40
  const out: number[] = []
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    s = (s * 48271) % 2147483647
    v = Math.max(10, v + (s / 2147483647 - 0.42) * 5)
    out.push(v)
  }
  return out
}

/** Session clock across the samples, open to close, spread evenly. */
function timeAt(i: number, n: number, openMin: number, closeMin: number) {
  const m = openMin + Math.round((i / (n - 1)) * (closeMin - openMin))
  const h = Math.floor(m / 60)
  return `${((h + 11) % 12) + 1}:${String(m % 60).padStart(2, "0")} ${h < 12 ? "AM" : "PM"}`
}

const points = (v: number) => v.toLocaleString("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })
const signed = (v: number) => `${v >= 0 ? "+" : "−"}${points(Math.abs(v))}`

export interface IndexCardProps {
  /** what the indices are; read in the aria-label (it was a visible eyebrow before 2026-10-02) */
  eyebrow?: string
  /** One switch per index; four fit the 340px width. */
  indices?: IndexQuote[]
  /** Which index opens selected. */
  defaultIndex?: number
  /** Session bounds for the scrub readout, in minutes past midnight. */
  openMinutes?: number
  closeMinutes?: number
  /** Fires when an index is chosen. */
  onSelect?: (index: IndexQuote, i: number) => void
  className?: string
}

/**
 * Markets block in a box: one index level, the day's line you can scrub, a short read and
 * a switch to change index. Scrubbing snaps a rule to the nearest sample, reads that
 * level, its move from the open and its session time in the header, and dims the line to
 * the right of the pointer. Changing index swaps level, line and read together.
 */
export function IndexCard({
  eyebrow = "Markets",
  indices = DEFAULT_INDICES,
  defaultIndex = 3,
  openMinutes = 570,
  closeMinutes = 960,
  onSelect,
  className,
}: IndexCardProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion() ?? false
  const uid = useId().replace(/:/g, "")
  const [active, setActive] = useState(Math.min(Math.max(defaultIndex, 0), indices.length - 1))
  const idx = indices[active]

  const up = !idx.delta.trim().startsWith("-") && !idx.delta.trim().startsWith("−")
  const hue = up ? GREEN : RED
  /** the change as written, with every hyphen minus made a true minus */
  const delta = idx.delta.replace(/-(?=[\d.])/g, "−")

  /* the level at every sample, anchored to the day's open and its close (formulas above) */
  const close = parseFloat(idx.price.replace(/,/g, ""))
  const change = parseFloat(idx.delta.trim().replace(/^−/, "-").replace(/,/g, "").replace(/[^\d.+-].*$/, "")) || 0
  const open = close - change
  const data = useMemo(() => {
    const w = walk(idx.seed, SAMPLES)
    const n = w.length
    const drift = w[n - 1] - w[0]
    return w.map((v, i) => open + ((close - open) * i) / (n - 1) + WIGGLE * close * (v - w[0] - (drift * i) / (n - 1)))
  }, [idx.seed, open, close])
  const n = data.length
  const min = Math.min(...data)
  const max = Math.max(...data)
  const px = (i: number) => (i / (n - 1)) * W
  const py = (v: number) => 6 + (1 - (v - min) / (max - min || 1)) * (H - 12)
  const line = data.map((v, i) => `${px(i).toFixed(1)},${py(v).toFixed(1)}`).join(" L")

  // the rule snaps to the NEAREST sample and drives the readout at once
  const svgRef = useRef<SVGSVGElement>(null)
  const seen = useInView(svgRef, { once: true, amount: 0.3 })
  const shown = seen || reduced
  const [hover, setHover] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const onMove = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    const el = svgRef.current
    if (!el) return
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect()
    const x = ((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width) * W
    setHover(Math.max(0, Math.min(n - 1, Math.round((x / W) * (n - 1)))))
  }
  const onLeave = () => setHover(null)

  const pointed = hover == null || !Number.isFinite(close) ? null : data[hover]
  const [whole, decimals] = (pointed == null ? idx.price : points(pointed)).split(".")
  const move = pointed == null ? change : pointed - open
  const pct = open ? (move / open) * 100 : 0
  const moveText = pointed == null ? delta : `${signed(move)} (${pct >= 0 ? "+" : "−"}${Math.abs(pct).toFixed(2)}%)`
  const crossX = hover == null ? 0 : px(hover)

  return (
    <div
      className={cn("w-[340px] max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-[24px] p-1.5 tabular-nums", SURFACE, className)}
      role="group"
      aria-label={`${eyebrow}: ${idx.name ?? idx.label}, ${idx.price} points, ${delta} today`}
    >
      <div className="px-2.5 pt-2.5">
        {/* the header, three tiers (spec 14.1) */}
        <div className="mb-3 flex items-baseline justify-between text-[12px]">
          <span className="truncate text-foreground/45">{idx.name ?? idx.label}</span>
          {idx.symbol && <span className="shrink-0 pl-3 font-medium text-foreground/90">{idx.symbol}</span>}
        </div>
        <div role="status">
          {/* the figures swap only when a scrub starts or ends or the index changes */}
          <LiveFigure intent={`${active}-${hover == null ? "close" : "scrub"}`}>
            <p className="m-0 text-[26px] font-semibold leading-none tracking-[-0.02em] text-foreground/90">
              {whole}
              {decimals && <span className="text-foreground/35">.{decimals}</span>}
            </p>
            <p className="mb-0 mt-2 flex items-baseline gap-[7px] text-[12px] font-medium" style={{ color: move >= 0 ? GREEN : RED }}>
              <span>{moveText}</span>
              <span className="font-normal text-foreground/45">{hover == null ? "today" : timeAt(hover, n, openMinutes, closeMinutes)}</span>
            </p>
          </LiveFigure>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* the day's line; right of the pointer dims */}
      <svg
        ref={svgRef}
        viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`}
        className="-mx-1.5 mt-4 block w-[calc(100%+12px)] max-w-none cursor-crosshair touch-none overflow-visible"
        onPointerMove={onMove}
        onPointerLeave={onLeave}
        onPointerCancel={onLeave}
        role="img"
        aria-label={`${idx.name ?? idx.label} through the session, closing at ${idx.price} points, ${delta}`}
      >
        <defs>
          <linearGradient id={`${uid}-fill`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
            <stop offset="0%" stopColor={hue} stopOpacity="0.14" style={{ transition: reduced ? "none" : "stop-color 200ms" }} />
            <stop offset="100%" stopColor={hue} stopOpacity="0" style={{ transition: reduced ? "none" : "stop-color 200ms" }} />
          </linearGradient>
          {/* the entrance: one clip wipes the line and its fill in from the left, once */}
          <clipPath id={`${uid}-wipe`}>
            <motion.rect
              x={-4}
              y={-4}
              height={H + 8}
              initial={{ width: reduced ? W + 8 : 0 }}
              animate={{ width: shown ? W + 8 : 0 }}
              transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.85, ease: EASE }}
            />
          </clipPath>
          <clipPath id={`${uid}-left`}>
            <rect x={0} y={0} width={crossX} height={H} />
          </clipPath>
        </defs>

        {GRID.map((f) => (
          <line key={f} x1={0} x2={W} y1={f * H} y2={f * H} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.05} strokeWidth={1} />
        ))}

        {/* the whole line, which steps back while scrubbing; a new index morphs it in place */}
        <g clipPath={`url(#${uid}-wipe)`} opacity={hover == null ? 1 : 0.45} style={{ transition: reduced ? "none" : "opacity 200ms" }}>
          <motion.path
            initial={false}
            animate={{ d: `M${line} L ${W},${H} L 0,${H} Z` }}
            transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.38, ease: EASE }}
            fill={`url(#${uid}-fill)`}
          />
          <motion.path
            initial={false}
            animate={{ d: `M${line}` }}
            transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.38, ease: EASE }}
            fill="none"
            stroke={hue}
            strokeWidth={1.8}
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
            style={{ transition: reduced ? "none" : "stroke 200ms" }}
          />
        </g>

        {/* a full-strength copy, kept to the LEFT of the pointer */}
        {hover != null && (
          <g clipPath={`url(#${uid}-left)`} pointerEvents="none">
            <path d={`M${line} L ${W},${H} L 0,${H} Z`} fill={`url(#${uid}-fill)`} />
            <path d={`M${line}`} fill="none" stroke={hue} strokeWidth={1.8} strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
          </g>
        )}

        {hover != null && (
          <g pointerEvents="none">
            <line x1={crossX} x2={crossX} y1={0} y2={H} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.18} strokeWidth={1} />
            <circle cx={crossX} cy={py(data[hover])} r={3} fill={hue} stroke="var(--background)" strokeWidth={1.5} />
          </g>
        )}
      </svg>

      <AnimatePresence mode="wait" initial={false}>
        <motion.p
          key={idx.label}
          className="mx-2.5 mb-0 mt-3 line-clamp-2 text-[12px] leading-[1.5] text-foreground/70"
          initial={{ opacity: reduced ? 1 : 0 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, transition: { duration: reduced ? 0 : 0.1 } }}
          transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.3, ease: EASE }}
        >
          {idx.note}
        </motion.p>
      </AnimatePresence>

      {/* the index switch, in the control material; it sits on the box's edge so the corners
          nest: 30px switches + 2px padding + 1px border = 36 tall, corner 18; 18 + the 6px gap = 24 */}
      <div className={cn("mt-4 flex gap-1", TRACK)} role="group" aria-label="Index">
        {indices.map((ix, i) => (
          <button
            key={ix.label}
            type="button"
            aria-pressed={active === i}
            aria-label={`${ix.name ?? ix.label}, ${ix.price} points`}
            onClick={() => {
              setActive(i)
              onLeave()
              onSelect?.(ix, i)
            }}
            className={cn(
              "relative h-[30px] flex-1 whitespace-nowrap rounded-full px-2 text-center text-[11.5px] font-medium outline-none transition-colors duration-150 focus-visible:text-foreground/90",
              active === i ? "text-foreground/90" : SEGMENT_OFF,
            )}
          >
            {active === i &&
              (reduced ? (
                <span aria-hidden className={cn("absolute inset-0 rounded-full", THUMB)} />
              ) : (
                <motion.span
                  aria-hidden
                  layoutId={`${uid}-pill`}
                  className={cn("absolute inset-0 rounded-full", THUMB)}
                  transition={{ duration: 0.25, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] }}
                />
              ))}
            <span className="relative">{ix.label}</span>
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}


// ─── components/ui/control-classes.ts ───

/* Control classes: the library's control material for components that ship on their own
   (2026-10-02, the audit's pattern 11). src/components/library/controls.ts is the site's
   copy; components used to paste its look in as a flat 8% fill "so the file ships alone",
   and those copies never turned white on a raised light surface. These read the same
   tokens WITH a fallback, so they follow the site's raised-surface rule here and still
   draw correctly in a buyer's app that has no such tokens. Shipped beside every component
   that imports it (scripts/build-registry.mjs bundles ui helpers automatically).

   Whole class strings, never assembled from pieces: Tailwind reads this file as text. */

/** what is ON in a switcher. Light (his call, 2026-10-02, after the inline slider): a WHITE
 *  pill with a hairline and a soft shadow on the grey track. Dark: the 8% thumb */
export const THUMB =
  "bg-white shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--light-outline,rgba(0,0,0,0.09)),0_1px_3px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] dark:bg-[var(--control-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_8%,transparent))] dark:shadow-[var(--control-shadow,inset_0_1px_0_0_color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_6%,transparent))]"

/** what a switcher's options sit in; its 2px padding is the gap the thumb keeps. Light: a
 *  light grey track with no outline, the white pill sits in it. Dark: a hairline, no fill */
export const TRACK = "rounded-full border border-transparent bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_5%,var(--background))] p-0.5 dark:border-foreground/[0.04] dark:bg-transparent"

/** an option that is off: the label alone answers the pointer */
export const SEGMENT_OFF = "text-foreground/60 hover:text-foreground/90"

/** a secondary button: the thumb standing alone; size it with h-7 / h-9 and px */
export const BUTTON =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--control-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_8%,transparent))] shadow-[var(--control-shadow,inset_0_1px_0_0_color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_6%,transparent))] text-foreground/90 outline-none transition-[color,background-color,scale] duration-150 hover:bg-[var(--control-fill-hover,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_12%,transparent))] focus-visible:bg-[var(--control-fill-hover,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_12%,transparent))] active:scale-[0.97] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40 motion-reduce:active:scale-100"

/** an icon-only control: no fill at rest, a faint one under the pointer */
export const ICON_BUTTON =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-full text-foreground/60 outline-none transition-[color,background-color] duration-150 hover:bg-foreground/[0.06] hover:text-foreground/90 focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.06]"

/** a field: the track with just enough fill to read as somewhere to type */
export const FIELD =
  "rounded-full border border-foreground/[0.04] bg-[var(--field-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_5%,transparent))] text-foreground/90 outline-none transition-[background-color,border-color] duration-150 placeholder:text-foreground/45 focus:border-foreground/[0.12]"

/** the one loud button of a form: 48px, full width, the foreground filled (the dashboards'
 *  Modal primary). A ticket, a swap, a confirm: one of these and nothing louder */
export const BUTTON_PRIMARY =
  "inline-flex h-12 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-foreground/[0.92] text-[14px] font-medium text-background outline-none transition-[background-color,scale,opacity] duration-150 hover:bg-foreground focus-visible:bg-foreground active:scale-[0.98] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40 motion-reduce:active:scale-100"

/** a component's own card, field or block (spec 14.8). Dark: a #121212 fill on black. Light
 *  (his call, 2026-10-02: "on light the card background is too dark, it can just be white, a
 *  quiet outline and a small shadow"): white, a 1px hairline (Kraken's #e7e6e9, or 9% ink in an app without the token) and a
 *  barely there shadow,
 *  drawn as box shadows so the outline takes no layout */
export const SURFACE =
  "bg-background shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--light-outline,color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_9%,transparent)),0_1px_2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] dark:bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_7%,var(--background))] dark:shadow-none"

/** a block sitting ON a surface: a faint 4% grey inside a white card in light, #1f1f1f in dark */
export const RAISED = "bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_4%,var(--background))] dark:bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_12%,var(--background))]"


// ─── components/ui/live-figure.tsx ───

"use client"

import { type ReactNode } from "react"
import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

/* Live figure: a figure fed by a live stream (2026-10-02, out of Tape Flow, where a price
   that re-entered on every print read as a flicker). The value changes in place on each
   tick; the figure swaps (4px, 2px blur, 150ms) only when `intent` changes: the pointer
   takes a point, lets it go, or a toggle flips. Pass the pointed point's id, or null for
   the live value. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const

export function LiveFigure({
  intent,
  className,
  children,
}: {
  /** what the figure is showing: a pointed point's id, or null while it follows the stream */
  intent: string | number | null
  className?: string
  children: ReactNode
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  return (
    <motion.div
      key={intent === null ? "live" : `at-${intent}`}
      className={cn(className)}
      initial={reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: 4, filter: "blur(2px)" }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, filter: "blur(0px)" }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
    >
      {children}
    </motion.div>
  )
}

# Index Card mobile
// ─── components/ui/index-card.tsx ───

"use client"

import { useId, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useInView, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { SEGMENT_OFF, SURFACE, THUMB, TRACK } from "@/components/ui/control-classes"
import { LiveFigure } from "@/components/ui/live-figure"

/* Index Card, rebuilt through the ssych-component skill (2026-09-29).
   What changed against the version before it (in git history), and why:
   · no card: the outline, the card ground, the header band and the two inner rules are
     gone, and so is the dotted paper behind the line. Three 1px gridlines at 5% ink stay
   · the caption is ink, not amber: colour is kept for up and down
   · every figure is tabular (the root sets it, so the tab names with digits line up too)
   · the session time is plain text beside the price while you scrub, not a bordered chip
     riding the pointer
   · the index switcher is a row of quiet pills with one fill that slides to the chosen
     one (it was an underline on a rule)
   · the line is 1.8px with round joins; the change is printed with a true minus sign
   · the chart names itself to a screen reader, with the index and its close
   Motion (2026-10-01): once the plot first comes into view the line and its fill are wiped
   in from the left by one clip, 850ms. Changing index morphs the line and the fill from the
   old session into the new one in 380ms (both walks are 48 samples, so the paths tween
   point for point) and the hue crosses over; it used to wipe out and redraw. Reduced
   motion draws every state at once.
   2026-10-02 audit: it sits in a box now (his call), the surface step at 7% with radius 24
   and a 10px padding, the type 16px in. The eyebrow and the 19px price gave way to the
   three tier header: the index's name at /45 with its symbol at /90, the level at 26px
   with its decimals at /35, then the change in its hue and "today" or the pointed time at
   /45. Index levels are points, so no dollar sign anywhere. Scrubbing changes the figures
   in place; they swap only when a scrub starts or ends or the index changes (they used to
   blur in again on every pointer step). The index switch is cut from the control material
   (TRACK, THUMB, SEGMENT_OFF) and glides on the tab ease; the note is 12px at /70, two
   lines at most. "Russel 2K" is spelled Russell 2000. IndexQuote gains optional `name`
   and `symbol` for the label row, and the pointed level is now anchored to the day's open
   so the move on the sub line is derivable.
   Formulas:
   · open = close − the change written in `delta`
   · level at a sample i = open + (close − open) × i ÷ 47 + 0.0004 × close × (w_i − w_0 −
     (w_47 − w_0) × i ÷ 47), where w is the index's seeded walk; it opens at the open and
     closes on the close exactly
   · pointed move = level − open; percent = move ÷ open × 100
   2026-10-02 round 2: his notes. The index switch is roomier: the box's padding is 6px
   instead of 10, so the track runs 328px wide, and each switch is 30px tall with 4px between
   them (corner 24 = the track's 18 + the 6px gap). The small caps index reads "Russell 2K"
   again on its switch and in the label row. The day's line runs the box's full width, edge
   to edge, with no side padding (the plot is 340 wide now, drawn 1:1); the type keeps its
   16px inset. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GREEN = "var(--chart-up)"
const RED = "var(--chart-down)"

/** the plot spans the box's full width, edge to edge (round 2) */
const W = 340
const H = 110
const SAMPLES = 48
/** fractions down the plot where a gridline sits */
const GRID = [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]
/** the walk's units, as a share of the close */
const WIGGLE = 0.0004

export interface IndexQuote {
  /** the short name on its switch */
  label: string
  /** the full name in the label row; falls back to `label` */
  name?: string
  /** the symbol on the label row's right, e.g. "SPX" */
  symbol?: string
  /** Already-formatted close in points, e.g. "5,648.40". */
  price: string
  /** Already-formatted change, e.g. "+63.97 (+1.15%)". A leading − flips the hue. */
  delta: string
  /** Deterministic seed for this index's intraday walk. */
  seed: number
  /** The short read under the line, two lines at most. */
  note: string
}

const DEFAULT_INDICES: IndexQuote[] = [
  {
    label: "S&P 500",
    symbol: "SPX",
    price: "5,648.40",
    delta: "+63.97 (+1.15%)",
    seed: 5,
    note: "Broad strength into the close; 8 of 11 sectors finished green, led by industrials and financials.",
  },
  {
    label: "Dow 30",
    name: "Dow Jones 30",
    symbol: "DJI",
    price: "41,563.08",
    delta: "+228.03 (+0.55%)",
    seed: 31,
    note: "Blue chips ground higher through the session on a soft landing read of the latest inflation print.",
  },
  {
    label: "Nasdaq",
    name: "Nasdaq Composite",
    symbol: "IXIC",
    price: "17,713.62",
    delta: "+197.19 (+1.13%)",
    seed: 77,
    note: "Megacap tech carried the tape; semis rebounded from early weakness to finish near session highs.",
  },
  {
    label: "Russell 2K",
    symbol: "RUT",
    price: "2,178.52",
    delta: "+14.10 (+0.65%)",
    seed: 111,
    note: "Consumer sentiment turned up for the first time in five months, and small caps took the hint.",
  },
]

/** Deterministic intraday walk: same seed, same shape, every render. */
function walk(seed: number, n: number) {
  let s = seed
  let v = 40
  const out: number[] = []
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    s = (s * 48271) % 2147483647
    v = Math.max(10, v + (s / 2147483647 - 0.42) * 5)
    out.push(v)
  }
  return out
}

/** Session clock across the samples, open to close, spread evenly. */
function timeAt(i: number, n: number, openMin: number, closeMin: number) {
  const m = openMin + Math.round((i / (n - 1)) * (closeMin - openMin))
  const h = Math.floor(m / 60)
  return `${((h + 11) % 12) + 1}:${String(m % 60).padStart(2, "0")} ${h < 12 ? "AM" : "PM"}`
}

const points = (v: number) => v.toLocaleString("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })
const signed = (v: number) => `${v >= 0 ? "+" : "−"}${points(Math.abs(v))}`

export interface IndexCardProps {
  /** what the indices are; read in the aria-label (it was a visible eyebrow before 2026-10-02) */
  eyebrow?: string
  /** One switch per index; four fit the 340px width. */
  indices?: IndexQuote[]
  /** Which index opens selected. */
  defaultIndex?: number
  /** Session bounds for the scrub readout, in minutes past midnight. */
  openMinutes?: number
  closeMinutes?: number
  /** Fires when an index is chosen. */
  onSelect?: (index: IndexQuote, i: number) => void
  className?: string
}

/**
 * Markets block in a box: one index level, the day's line you can scrub, a short read and
 * a switch to change index. Scrubbing snaps a rule to the nearest sample, reads that
 * level, its move from the open and its session time in the header, and dims the line to
 * the right of the pointer. Changing index swaps level, line and read together.
 */
export function IndexCard({
  eyebrow = "Markets",
  indices = DEFAULT_INDICES,
  defaultIndex = 3,
  openMinutes = 570,
  closeMinutes = 960,
  onSelect,
  className,
}: IndexCardProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion() ?? false
  const uid = useId().replace(/:/g, "")
  const [active, setActive] = useState(Math.min(Math.max(defaultIndex, 0), indices.length - 1))
  const idx = indices[active]

  const up = !idx.delta.trim().startsWith("-") && !idx.delta.trim().startsWith("−")
  const hue = up ? GREEN : RED
  /** the change as written, with every hyphen minus made a true minus */
  const delta = idx.delta.replace(/-(?=[\d.])/g, "−")

  /* the level at every sample, anchored to the day's open and its close (formulas above) */
  const close = parseFloat(idx.price.replace(/,/g, ""))
  const change = parseFloat(idx.delta.trim().replace(/^−/, "-").replace(/,/g, "").replace(/[^\d.+-].*$/, "")) || 0
  const open = close - change
  const data = useMemo(() => {
    const w = walk(idx.seed, SAMPLES)
    const n = w.length
    const drift = w[n - 1] - w[0]
    return w.map((v, i) => open + ((close - open) * i) / (n - 1) + WIGGLE * close * (v - w[0] - (drift * i) / (n - 1)))
  }, [idx.seed, open, close])
  const n = data.length
  const min = Math.min(...data)
  const max = Math.max(...data)
  const px = (i: number) => (i / (n - 1)) * W
  const py = (v: number) => 6 + (1 - (v - min) / (max - min || 1)) * (H - 12)
  const line = data.map((v, i) => `${px(i).toFixed(1)},${py(v).toFixed(1)}`).join(" L")

  // the rule snaps to the NEAREST sample and drives the readout at once
  const svgRef = useRef<SVGSVGElement>(null)
  const seen = useInView(svgRef, { once: true, amount: 0.3 })
  const shown = seen || reduced
  const [hover, setHover] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const onMove = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    const el = svgRef.current
    if (!el) return
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect()
    const x = ((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width) * W
    setHover(Math.max(0, Math.min(n - 1, Math.round((x / W) * (n - 1)))))
  }
  const onLeave = () => setHover(null)

  const pointed = hover == null || !Number.isFinite(close) ? null : data[hover]
  const [whole, decimals] = (pointed == null ? idx.price : points(pointed)).split(".")
  const move = pointed == null ? change : pointed - open
  const pct = open ? (move / open) * 100 : 0
  const moveText = pointed == null ? delta : `${signed(move)} (${pct >= 0 ? "+" : "−"}${Math.abs(pct).toFixed(2)}%)`
  const crossX = hover == null ? 0 : px(hover)

  return (
    <div
      className={cn("w-[340px] max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-[24px] p-1.5 tabular-nums", SURFACE, className)}
      role="group"
      aria-label={`${eyebrow}: ${idx.name ?? idx.label}, ${idx.price} points, ${delta} today`}
    >
      <div className="px-2.5 pt-2.5">
        {/* the header, three tiers (spec 14.1) */}
        <div className="mb-3 flex items-baseline justify-between text-[12px]">
          <span className="truncate text-foreground/45">{idx.name ?? idx.label}</span>
          {idx.symbol && <span className="shrink-0 pl-3 font-medium text-foreground/90">{idx.symbol}</span>}
        </div>
        <div role="status">
          {/* the figures swap only when a scrub starts or ends or the index changes */}
          <LiveFigure intent={`${active}-${hover == null ? "close" : "scrub"}`}>
            <p className="m-0 text-[26px] font-semibold leading-none tracking-[-0.02em] text-foreground/90">
              {whole}
              {decimals && <span className="text-foreground/35">.{decimals}</span>}
            </p>
            <p className="mb-0 mt-2 flex items-baseline gap-[7px] text-[12px] font-medium" style={{ color: move >= 0 ? GREEN : RED }}>
              <span>{moveText}</span>
              <span className="font-normal text-foreground/45">{hover == null ? "today" : timeAt(hover, n, openMinutes, closeMinutes)}</span>
            </p>
          </LiveFigure>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* the day's line; right of the pointer dims */}
      <svg
        ref={svgRef}
        viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`}
        className="-mx-1.5 mt-4 block w-[calc(100%+12px)] max-w-none cursor-crosshair touch-none overflow-visible"
        onPointerMove={onMove}
        onPointerLeave={onLeave}
        onPointerCancel={onLeave}
        role="img"
        aria-label={`${idx.name ?? idx.label} through the session, closing at ${idx.price} points, ${delta}`}
      >
        <defs>
          <linearGradient id={`${uid}-fill`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
            <stop offset="0%" stopColor={hue} stopOpacity="0.14" style={{ transition: reduced ? "none" : "stop-color 200ms" }} />
            <stop offset="100%" stopColor={hue} stopOpacity="0" style={{ transition: reduced ? "none" : "stop-color 200ms" }} />
          </linearGradient>
          {/* the entrance: one clip wipes the line and its fill in from the left, once */}
          <clipPath id={`${uid}-wipe`}>
            <motion.rect
              x={-4}
              y={-4}
              height={H + 8}
              initial={{ width: reduced ? W + 8 : 0 }}
              animate={{ width: shown ? W + 8 : 0 }}
              transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.85, ease: EASE }}
            />
          </clipPath>
          <clipPath id={`${uid}-left`}>
            <rect x={0} y={0} width={crossX} height={H} />
          </clipPath>
        </defs>

        {GRID.map((f) => (
          <line key={f} x1={0} x2={W} y1={f * H} y2={f * H} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.05} strokeWidth={1} />
        ))}

        {/* the whole line, which steps back while scrubbing; a new index morphs it in place */}
        <g clipPath={`url(#${uid}-wipe)`} opacity={hover == null ? 1 : 0.45} style={{ transition: reduced ? "none" : "opacity 200ms" }}>
          <motion.path
            initial={false}
            animate={{ d: `M${line} L ${W},${H} L 0,${H} Z` }}
            transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.38, ease: EASE }}
            fill={`url(#${uid}-fill)`}
          />
          <motion.path
            initial={false}
            animate={{ d: `M${line}` }}
            transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.38, ease: EASE }}
            fill="none"
            stroke={hue}
            strokeWidth={1.8}
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
            style={{ transition: reduced ? "none" : "stroke 200ms" }}
          />
        </g>

        {/* a full-strength copy, kept to the LEFT of the pointer */}
        {hover != null && (
          <g clipPath={`url(#${uid}-left)`} pointerEvents="none">
            <path d={`M${line} L ${W},${H} L 0,${H} Z`} fill={`url(#${uid}-fill)`} />
            <path d={`M${line}`} fill="none" stroke={hue} strokeWidth={1.8} strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
          </g>
        )}

        {hover != null && (
          <g pointerEvents="none">
            <line x1={crossX} x2={crossX} y1={0} y2={H} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.18} strokeWidth={1} />
            <circle cx={crossX} cy={py(data[hover])} r={3} fill={hue} stroke="var(--background)" strokeWidth={1.5} />
          </g>
        )}
      </svg>

      <AnimatePresence mode="wait" initial={false}>
        <motion.p
          key={idx.label}
          className="mx-2.5 mb-0 mt-3 line-clamp-2 text-[12px] leading-[1.5] text-foreground/70"
          initial={{ opacity: reduced ? 1 : 0 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, transition: { duration: reduced ? 0 : 0.1 } }}
          transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.3, ease: EASE }}
        >
          {idx.note}
        </motion.p>
      </AnimatePresence>

      {/* the index switch, in the control material; it sits on the box's edge so the corners
          nest: 30px switches + 2px padding + 1px border = 36 tall, corner 18; 18 + the 6px gap = 24 */}
      <div className={cn("mt-4 flex gap-1", TRACK)} role="group" aria-label="Index">
        {indices.map((ix, i) => (
          <button
            key={ix.label}
            type="button"
            aria-pressed={active === i}
            aria-label={`${ix.name ?? ix.label}, ${ix.price} points`}
            onClick={() => {
              setActive(i)
              onLeave()
              onSelect?.(ix, i)
            }}
            className={cn(
              "relative h-[30px] flex-1 whitespace-nowrap rounded-full px-2 text-center text-[11.5px] font-medium outline-none transition-colors duration-150 focus-visible:text-foreground/90",
              active === i ? "text-foreground/90" : SEGMENT_OFF,
            )}
          >
            {active === i &&
              (reduced ? (
                <span aria-hidden className={cn("absolute inset-0 rounded-full", THUMB)} />
              ) : (
                <motion.span
                  aria-hidden
                  layoutId={`${uid}-pill`}
                  className={cn("absolute inset-0 rounded-full", THUMB)}
                  transition={{ duration: 0.25, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] }}
                />
              ))}
            <span className="relative">{ix.label}</span>
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}


// ─── components/ui/control-classes.ts ───

/* Control classes: the library's control material for components that ship on their own
   (2026-10-02, the audit's pattern 11). src/components/library/controls.ts is the site's
   copy; components used to paste its look in as a flat 8% fill "so the file ships alone",
   and those copies never turned white on a raised light surface. These read the same
   tokens WITH a fallback, so they follow the site's raised-surface rule here and still
   draw correctly in a buyer's app that has no such tokens. Shipped beside every component
   that imports it (scripts/build-registry.mjs bundles ui helpers automatically).

   Whole class strings, never assembled from pieces: Tailwind reads this file as text. */

/** what is ON in a switcher. Light (his call, 2026-10-02, after the inline slider): a WHITE
 *  pill with a hairline and a soft shadow on the grey track. Dark: the 8% thumb */
export const THUMB =
  "bg-white shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--light-outline,rgba(0,0,0,0.09)),0_1px_3px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] dark:bg-[var(--control-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_8%,transparent))] dark:shadow-[var(--control-shadow,inset_0_1px_0_0_color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_6%,transparent))]"

/** what a switcher's options sit in; its 2px padding is the gap the thumb keeps. Light: a
 *  light grey track with no outline, the white pill sits in it. Dark: a hairline, no fill */
export const TRACK = "rounded-full border border-transparent bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_5%,var(--background))] p-0.5 dark:border-foreground/[0.04] dark:bg-transparent"

/** an option that is off: the label alone answers the pointer */
export const SEGMENT_OFF = "text-foreground/60 hover:text-foreground/90"

/** a secondary button: the thumb standing alone; size it with h-7 / h-9 and px */
export const BUTTON =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--control-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_8%,transparent))] shadow-[var(--control-shadow,inset_0_1px_0_0_color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_6%,transparent))] text-foreground/90 outline-none transition-[color,background-color,scale] duration-150 hover:bg-[var(--control-fill-hover,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_12%,transparent))] focus-visible:bg-[var(--control-fill-hover,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_12%,transparent))] active:scale-[0.97] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40 motion-reduce:active:scale-100"

/** an icon-only control: no fill at rest, a faint one under the pointer */
export const ICON_BUTTON =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-full text-foreground/60 outline-none transition-[color,background-color] duration-150 hover:bg-foreground/[0.06] hover:text-foreground/90 focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.06]"

/** a field: the track with just enough fill to read as somewhere to type */
export const FIELD =
  "rounded-full border border-foreground/[0.04] bg-[var(--field-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_5%,transparent))] text-foreground/90 outline-none transition-[background-color,border-color] duration-150 placeholder:text-foreground/45 focus:border-foreground/[0.12]"

/** the one loud button of a form: 48px, full width, the foreground filled (the dashboards'
 *  Modal primary). A ticket, a swap, a confirm: one of these and nothing louder */
export const BUTTON_PRIMARY =
  "inline-flex h-12 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-foreground/[0.92] text-[14px] font-medium text-background outline-none transition-[background-color,scale,opacity] duration-150 hover:bg-foreground focus-visible:bg-foreground active:scale-[0.98] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40 motion-reduce:active:scale-100"

/** a component's own card, field or block (spec 14.8). Dark: a #121212 fill on black. Light
 *  (his call, 2026-10-02: "on light the card background is too dark, it can just be white, a
 *  quiet outline and a small shadow"): white, a 1px hairline (Kraken's #e7e6e9, or 9% ink in an app without the token) and a
 *  barely there shadow,
 *  drawn as box shadows so the outline takes no layout */
export const SURFACE =
  "bg-background shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--light-outline,color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_9%,transparent)),0_1px_2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] dark:bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_7%,var(--background))] dark:shadow-none"

/** a block sitting ON a surface: a faint 4% grey inside a white card in light, #1f1f1f in dark */
export const RAISED = "bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_4%,var(--background))] dark:bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_12%,var(--background))]"


// ─── components/ui/live-figure.tsx ───

"use client"

import { type ReactNode } from "react"
import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

/* Live figure: a figure fed by a live stream (2026-10-02, out of Tape Flow, where a price
   that re-entered on every print read as a flicker). The value changes in place on each
   tick; the figure swaps (4px, 2px blur, 150ms) only when `intent` changes: the pointer
   takes a point, lets it go, or a toggle flips. Pass the pointed point's id, or null for
   the live value. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const

export function LiveFigure({
  intent,
  className,
  children,
}: {
  /** what the figure is showing: a pointed point's id, or null while it follows the stream */
  intent: string | number | null
  className?: string
  children: ReactNode
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  return (
    <motion.div
      key={intent === null ? "live" : `at-${intent}`}
      className={cn(className)}
      initial={reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: 4, filter: "blur(2px)" }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, filter: "blur(0px)" }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
    >
      {children}
    </motion.div>
  )
}


# Candlestick Chart desk
// ─── components/ui/candlestick.tsx ───

"use client"

import { useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react"
import { useInView, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { useWidth } from "@/components/ui/use-width"
import { AxisTag, ChartCard } from "@/components/ui/chart-overlay"

/* Candlestick, in the trading terminal's chart language (user call, 2026-10-02: "fix the
   candlestick chart to be similar to the one on the trading terminal"). The version before
   this one is in git history. What it took from the terminal's price pane:
   · many thin candles, the wick a 1px line, the body ~62% of a slot; direction is the only hue
   · solid faint gridlines with dollar figures on the right
   · a dashed guide at the last close, across the whole plot
   · the crosshair: a rule on the candle, a dashed rule on its close, a dot where they meet,
     the close as an outlined tag on the axis, and a card beside the cursor reading the bar's
     time, open, high, low, close and change
   · a volume pane under its own hairline, the same hue at 0.6
   · dates along the foot
   The header reads the last close and the move across the whole run.
   2026-10-02: the header looked weird (symbol, price, move and a "15d" all on one small
   line), so it now has the library's three tiers like Market Snapshot (spec 14.1): the
   company name at /45 with the symbol on the right, the last close as the headline with its
   cents at /35, then the run's move in its hue and the window at /45. A new `name` prop
   carries the company name.
   2026-10-02 audit: the sample company is now Alphabet (GOOGL), because NVIDIA and NVDA
   read the same at both ends of the label row (his call). The last close guide is named on
   the axis as plain 9px text (the close at /90, "Last" at /45) and steps aside under the
   pointed tag, the price ticks are 9px like the dates, and the card gains a Volume row so
   the volume pane is readable; a new `volumeUnit` prop says how many shares one unit of
   `v` stands for.
   Formulas:
   · change on a bar    = (close − open) ÷ open × 100
   · move across the run = last close − first open, and ÷ first open × 100
   · volume bar height  = volume ÷ the run's largest volume × the pane's height
   · volume in the card = v × volumeUnit shares
   Motion (2026-10-01, kept): once the chart first comes into view every candle rises out of
   its own middle and every volume bar grows off the floor, left to right under one 380ms
   stagger. CSS transitions on transform. Reduced motion draws the end state. */

const EASE_CSS = "cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)"
const UP = "var(--chart-up)"
const DOWN = "var(--chart-candle-down, var(--chart-down))"

export interface Candle {
  o: number
  h: number
  l: number
  c: number
  /** relative volume, 0..1.5 */
  v: number
}

/** Deterministic walk so every render agrees (LCG, one seed): a slow climb with pullbacks. */
const DEFAULT_CANDLES: Candle[] = (() => {
  let s = 20260729
  const rnd = () => {
    s = (s * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7fffffff
    return s / 0x7fffffff
  }
  const out: Candle[] = []
  let close = 168
  for (let i = 0; i < 90; i++) {
    const o = close
    const move = (rnd() - 0.44) * 1.9
    const c = o + move
    const h = Math.max(o, c) + rnd() * 0.9
    const l = Math.min(o, c) - rnd() * 0.9
    const v = 0.35 + rnd() * 0.8 + Math.abs(move) * 0.18
    out.push({ o, h, l, c, v })
    close = c
  }
  return out
})()

/** the price axis on the right, the date row under the volume pane */
const AXIS_W = 52
const DATE_H = 20
const GAP = 10
const PRICE_TOP = 8
/** how many dates along the foot */
const DATES = 5

/** shares, compact: 18.4M */
const shares = (v: number) =>
  v >= 1e9 ? `${(v / 1e9).toFixed(2)}B` : v >= 1e6 ? `${(v / 1e6).toFixed(1)}M` : v >= 1e3 ? `${(v / 1e3).toFixed(1)}K` : `${Math.round(v)}`
const usd = (v: number) => `$${v.toLocaleString("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}`
const axisUsd = (v: number) => `$${Math.round(v).toLocaleString("en-US")}`
const day = (t: number) => new Date(t).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", { day: "numeric", month: "short", timeZone: "UTC" })
const stamp = (t: number) =>
  `${new Date(t).toLocaleDateString("en-US", { month: "short", day: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC" })} ${new Date(t).toLocaleTimeString("en-GB", { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", timeZone: "UTC" })} UTC`

/**
 * Candles over a volume pane that share one x. The crosshair snaps to the candle under the
 * pointer, keeps it full and dims the rest, tags its close on the axis and reads the bar in a
 * card beside the cursor. Green up, red down.
 */
export function Candlestick({
  name = "Alphabet",
  symbol = "GOOGL",
  candles = DEFAULT_CANDLES,
  start = Date.UTC(2026, 4, 12),
  interval = 4 * 3600_000,
  volumeUnit = 20_000_000,
  markers = [],
  height = 300,
  className,
}: {
  /** the chart's height in px (2026-10-06); the volume pane keeps its share */
  height?: number
  /** signals on the bars (2026-10-06): a buy sits under its bar's low, a sell over its high */
  markers?: { at: number; side: "buy" | "sell" }[]
  /** the company or market's name, read in the header's label row */
  name?: string
  symbol?: string
  /** open, high, low, close and a relative volume per bar */
  candles?: Candle[]
  /** the first bar's open time, ms since epoch (UTC) */
  start?: number
  /** one bar's length, ms */
  interval?: number
  /** shares one unit of a candle's `v` stands for; the card reads v × volumeUnit */
  volumeUnit?: number
  className?: string
}) {
  // laid out at the width it is given (2026-10-06), so the text keeps its size
  const [boxRef, W] = useWidth<HTMLDivElement>(560) // the default width, as before
  const PLOT_W = W - AXIS_W
  const H = height
  const VOL_H = Math.round(H * 0.18)
  const PRICE_BOT = H - DATE_H - VOL_H - GAP
  const VOL_BOT = H - DATE_H
  const reduced = useReducedMotion() ?? false
  const svgRef = useRef<SVGSVGElement>(null)
  const seen = useInView(svgRef, { once: true, amount: 0.3 })
  const shown = seen || reduced
  const [hi, setHi] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const n = candles.length

  const { pMin, pMax, vMax, ticks } = useMemo(() => {
    let lo = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY
    let top = Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY
    let vm = 0
    for (const d of candles) {
      lo = Math.min(lo, d.l)
      top = Math.max(top, d.h)
      vm = Math.max(vm, d.v)
    }
    const pad = (top - lo) * 0.06 || 1
    const a = lo - pad
    const b = top + pad
    return { pMin: a, pMax: b, vMax: vm || 1, ticks: [0.1, 0.37, 0.63, 0.9].map((f) => b - f * (b - a)) }
  }, [candles])

  const step = PLOT_W / Math.max(1, n)
  const bodyW = Math.max(1, Math.min(9, step * 0.62))
  const cx = (i: number) => (i + 0.5) * step
  const yP = (v: number) => PRICE_TOP + (1 - (v - pMin) / (pMax - pMin || 1)) * (PRICE_BOT - PRICE_TOP)
  const yV = (v: number) => VOL_BOT - (v / vMax) * (VOL_H - 4)
  const time = (i: number) => start + i * interval

  const onMove = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    const el = svgRef.current
    if (!el || n === 0) return
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect()
    const px = ((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width) * W
    setHi(px > PLOT_W ? n - 1 : Math.max(0, Math.min(n - 1, Math.floor(px / step))))
  }

  const first = candles[0] ?? { o: 0, h: 0, l: 0, c: 0, v: 0 }
  const last = candles[n - 1] ?? first
  const runMove = last.c - first.o
  const runPct = first.o ? (runMove / first.o) * 100 : 0
  const runUp = runMove >= 0
  const active = hi !== null ? candles[hi] : null
  const up = active ? active.c >= active.o : runUp
  const hue = up ? UP : DOWN
  const barPct = active && active.o ? ((active.c - active.o) / active.o) * 100 : 0
  const sign = (v: number) => (v >= 0 ? "+" : "−")
  const tagY = active ? Math.max(PRICE_TOP + 8, Math.min(PRICE_BOT - 8, yP(active.c))) : 0
  const fade = reduced ? "none" : "opacity 160ms"
  /* the entrance: every candle rises from its own middle, the whole run under 380ms */
  const stagger = Math.min(0.02, 0.38 / Math.max(1, n))
  const grow = (i: number) => (reduced ? "none" : `transform 0.45s ${EASE_CSS} ${(i * stagger).toFixed(3)}s, opacity 0.45s ${EASE_CSS} ${(i * stagger).toFixed(3)}s`)
  const dates = Array.from({ length: DATES }, (_, k) => Math.round((k / (DATES - 1)) * (n - 1)))
  /* the card sits right of the cursor, and flips left past 60% of the plot */
  const flip = hi !== null && cx(hi) > PLOT_W * 0.6
  const [closeWhole, closeCents] = usd(last.c).split(".")
  const windowDays = Math.round((n * interval) / 86_400_000)
  /* the last close, named on the axis; it and any tick under it step aside for the pointed tag */
  const lastY = yP(last.c)
  const lastHidden = active !== null && Math.abs(lastY - tagY) < 13

  return (
    <div ref={boxRef} className={cn("w-[560px] max-w-full tabular-nums", className)}>
      {/* the header, three tiers (spec 14.1): name and symbol, the last close, then the run's move and its window */}
      <div className="mb-3 flex items-baseline justify-between text-[12px]">
        <span className="truncate text-foreground/45">{name}</span>
        <span className="shrink-0 pl-3 font-medium text-foreground/90">{symbol}</span>
      </div>
      <p className="m-0 text-[26px] font-semibold leading-none tracking-[-0.02em] text-foreground/90">
        {closeWhole}
        <span className="text-foreground/35">.{closeCents}</span>
      </p>
      <p className="mb-4 mt-2 flex items-baseline gap-[7px] text-[12px] font-medium" style={{ color: runUp ? UP : DOWN }}>
        <span>
          {sign(runMove)}
          {usd(Math.abs(runMove))} · {sign(runPct)}
          {Math.abs(runPct).toFixed(1)}%
        </span>
        <span className="font-normal text-foreground/45">{windowDays === 1 ? "1 day" : `${windowDays} days`}</span>
      </p>

      <div className="relative">
        <svg
          ref={svgRef}
          width={W}
          height={H}
          viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`}
          className="block h-auto w-full cursor-crosshair touch-none"
          role="img"
          aria-label={`${name} (${symbol}) candlestick chart, ${n} bars. Last close ${usd(last.c)}, ${sign(runPct)}${Math.abs(runPct).toFixed(2)}% across the run`}
          onPointerMove={onMove}
          onPointerLeave={() => setHi(null)}
        >
          {/* price gridlines and the right-hand scale; a figure steps aside while the tag sits on it */}
          {ticks.map((t) => {
            const gy = yP(t)
            const under = (active !== null && Math.abs(gy - tagY) < 12) || Math.abs(gy - lastY) < 11
            return (
              <g key={t}>
                <line x1={0} x2={PLOT_W} y1={gy} y2={gy} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.05} strokeWidth={1} />
                <text x={W - 4} y={gy + 3} textAnchor="end" fontSize={9} fill="var(--foreground)" fillOpacity={0.45} style={{ opacity: under ? 0 : 1, transition: fade }}>
                  {axisUsd(t)}
                </text>
              </g>
            )
          })}
          {/* the volume pane's own floor rule */}
          <line x1={0} x2={W} y1={VOL_BOT + 0.5} y2={VOL_BOT + 0.5} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.06} strokeWidth={1} />

          {/* last-close guide, named on the axis as plain text (spec 14.7): the close at /90, its name at /45 */}
          <line x1={0} x2={PLOT_W} y1={lastY} y2={lastY} stroke={runUp ? UP : DOWN} strokeOpacity={0.4} strokeDasharray="2 4" strokeWidth={1} />
          <text
            x={W - 4}
            y={lastY + 3}
            textAnchor="end"
            fontSize={9}
            fill="var(--foreground)"
            pointerEvents="none"
            style={{ opacity: lastHidden ? 0 : 1, transition: fade }}
          >
            <tspan fontWeight={500} fillOpacity={0.9}>
              {axisUsd(last.c)}
            </tspan>
            <tspan fillOpacity={0.45}> Last</tspan>
          </text>

          {candles.map((d, i) => {
            const barHue = d.c >= d.o ? UP : DOWN
            const dim = hi !== null && hi !== i
            const top = yP(Math.max(d.o, d.c))
            const bodyH = Math.max(1, Math.abs(yP(d.o) - yP(d.c)))
            return (
              <g key={i} style={{ opacity: dim ? 0.45 : 1, transition: fade }}>
                {/* volume: the same hue at 0.6, growing off the pane's floor */}
                <rect
                  x={cx(i) - bodyW / 2}
                  y={yV(d.v)}
                  width={bodyW}
                  height={VOL_BOT - yV(d.v)}
                  fill={barHue}
                  fillOpacity={0.6}
                  style={{ transformOrigin: `0px ${VOL_BOT}px`, transform: shown ? "none" : "scaleY(0)", transition: grow(i) }}
                />
                {/* the candle rises out of its own middle, between its high and its low */}
                <g
                  style={{
                    transformOrigin: `0px ${((yP(d.h) + yP(d.l)) / 2).toFixed(1)}px`,
                    transform: shown ? "none" : "scaleY(0.6)",
                    opacity: shown ? 1 : 0,
                    transition: grow(i),
                  }}
                >
                  <line x1={cx(i)} y1={yP(d.h)} x2={cx(i)} y2={yP(d.l)} stroke={barHue} strokeWidth={1} />
                  <rect x={cx(i) - bodyW / 2} y={top} width={bodyW} height={bodyH} fill={barHue} />
                </g>
              </g>
            )
          })}

          {/* dates along the foot */}
          {dates.map((i, k) => (
            <text
              key={`${i}-${k}`}
              x={k === 0 ? 2 : k === DATES - 1 ? PLOT_W - 2 : cx(i)}
              y={H - 5}
              textAnchor={k === 0 ? "start" : k === DATES - 1 ? "end" : "middle"}
              fontSize={9}
              fill="var(--foreground)"
              fillOpacity={0.45}
            >
              {day(time(i))}
            </text>
          ))}

          {/* signal markers (2026-10-06): a small triangle pointing at the bar, in the side's hue */}
          {markers.filter((m) => m.at >= 0 && m.at < n).map((m) => {
            const d = candles[m.at]
            const x = cx(m.at)
            const y = m.side === "buy" ? yP(d.l) + 9 : yP(d.h) - 9
            const tip = m.side === "buy" ? -1 : 1
            return (
              <path
                key={`${m.side}${m.at}`}
                d={`M ${x} ${y + tip * 4} L ${x - 4.5} ${y - tip * 3.5} L ${x + 4.5} ${y - tip * 3.5} Z`}
                fill={m.side === "buy" ? UP : DOWN}
                style={{ opacity: shown ? 1 : 0, transition: fade }}
              />
            )
          })}

          {/* the crosshair: a rule on the candle, a dashed rule on its close, a dot, and the close tagged on the axis */}
          {active && hi !== null && (
            <g pointerEvents="none">
              <line x1={cx(hi)} y1={PRICE_TOP - 8} x2={cx(hi)} y2={VOL_BOT} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.18} strokeWidth={1} />
              <line x1={0} y1={yP(active.c)} x2={PLOT_W} y2={yP(active.c)} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.14} strokeDasharray="3 3" strokeWidth={1} />
              <circle cx={cx(hi)} cy={yP(active.c)} r={3} fill={hue} stroke="var(--background)" strokeWidth={1.5} />
              <AxisTag x={PLOT_W + 2} y={tagY} width={AXIS_W - 4} color={hue}>
                {axisUsd(active.c)}
              </AxisTag>
            </g>
          )}
        </svg>

        {/* the bar under the cursor, read out beside it (chart-overlay.tsx) */}
        <ChartCard
          open={active !== null && hi !== null}
          x={hi !== null ? `${(cx(hi) / W) * 100}%` : 0}
          flip={flip}
          heading={hi !== null ? stamp(time(hi)) : ""}
          rows={
            active
              ? [
                  { label: "Open", value: usd(active.o) },
                  { label: "High", value: usd(active.h) },
                  { label: "Low", value: usd(active.l) },
                  { label: "Close", value: usd(active.c) },
                  { label: "Volume", value: shares(active.v * volumeUnit) },
                  { label: "Change", value: `${sign(barPct)}${Math.abs(barPct).toFixed(2)}%`, color: hue },
                ]
              : []
          }
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}


// ─── components/ui/use-width.ts ───

"use client";

// The width a chart is given (2026-10-06, the Tradeboard case study). The charts used to lay
// out in a fixed box and stretch as a picture in a wider column, so their text grew with it;
// measured, they lay out at the real width and the text keeps its size. A chart left at its
// default class measures its own default width, so nothing changes where it is not stretched.
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

export function useWidth<T extends HTMLElement>(fallback: number, min = 280) {
  const ref = useRef<T>(null);
  const [w, setW] = useState(fallback);
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(([e]) => setW(Math.max(min, Math.round(e.contentRect.width)) || fallback));
    ro.observe(el);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, [fallback, min]);
  return [ref, w] as const;
}


// ─── components/ui/chart-overlay.tsx ───

"use client"

import { type ReactNode } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

/* Chart overlay: the two parts every library chart reads a point with (2026-10-02). They
   came out of Candlestick, Volume Profile, the trading terminal and Price Scrubber, which
   had each drawn their own; this is the one copy. Shipped beside the charts that use it.

   AxisTag   the outlined tag on the value axis: the pointed value in its hue, or a named
             reference (POC, last close) in ink. A pill 16px high, 8.5px figures.
   ChartCard the card laid over the chart beside the cursor: a heading row (a time or a
             range) at /60, then label and value rows (labels 10px /60, values 11px /90),
             the one signed figure in its hue. It glides between points on a spring, fades
             in from 0.97 and out in 120ms, and flips to the cursor's left when told to.

   2026-10-02: the card looked out of place over the charts, so it now wears the library
   popover, the same as the sidebar's hover card: a hairline border at 8%, radius 12, the
   6% foreground mix and the popover shadow with no inset highlight (spec 14.6). */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GLIDE = { type: "spring", stiffness: 520, damping: 40 } as const

/** the outlined tag on a chart's value axis, centred on `y` */
export function AxisTag({
  x,
  y,
  width,
  color = "var(--foreground)",
  strong = true,
  hidden = false,
  children,
}: {
  /** the tag's left edge, in the chart's own units */
  x: number
  /** the value's line; the tag is centred on it */
  y: number
  width: number
  /** stroke and figure; ink for a named reference, the series hue for the pointed value */
  color?: string
  /** a quieter tag (a secondary reference) drops the weight and the stroke */
  strong?: boolean
  /** fades the tag out, for when the pointed value sits on it */
  hidden?: boolean
  children: ReactNode
}) {
  return (
    <g transform={`translate(${x}, ${y - 8})`} pointerEvents="none" style={{ opacity: hidden ? 0 : 1, transition: "opacity 150ms" }}>
      <rect width={width} height={16} rx={8} fill="var(--background)" stroke={color} strokeOpacity={strong ? 0.6 : 0.2} />
      <text x={width / 2} y={11} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={8.5} fontWeight={strong ? 600 : 500} fill={color} fillOpacity={strong ? 1 : 0.65}>
        {children}
      </text>
    </g>
  )
}

export interface ChartCardRow {
  label: string
  value: ReactNode
  /** only the one signed figure carries a hue */
  color?: string
}

/** the readout card over a chart; place it inside a `relative` box that holds the svg */
export function ChartCard({
  open,
  x,
  y = 4,
  flip = false,
  width = 148,
  heading,
  rows,
  footer,
}: {
  open: boolean
  /** the cursor's x inside the box: px, or a percentage string for a chart drawn to a viewBox */
  x: number | string
  /** the card's top inside the box, px */
  y?: number
  /** put the card on the cursor's left (past ~60% of the plot) */
  flip?: boolean
  width?: number
  heading: ReactNode
  rows: ChartCardRow[]
  /** a closing line under the rows, such as where the point sits */
  footer?: ReactNode
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {open && (
        <motion.div
          key="chart-card"
          role="status"
          className="pointer-events-none absolute z-10"
          initial={{ left: x, top: y, opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ left: x, top: y, opacity: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, transition: { duration: 0.12 } }}
          transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { left: GLIDE, top: GLIDE, opacity: { duration: 0.15 } }}
        >
          <motion.div
            className="rounded-[12px] border border-foreground/[0.08] px-3 py-2.5"
            style={{
              width,
              translate: flip ? "calc(-100% - 12px) 0" : "12px 0",
              transition: reduced ? undefined : "translate 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)",
              background: "var(--tip-fill, color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 6%, var(--background)))",
              boxShadow: "0 8px 24px var(--card-shadow, rgba(0,0,0,calc(0.35 * var(--shadow-k, 1))))",
            }}
            initial={reduced ? false : { scale: 0.97 }}
            animate={{ scale: 1 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
          >
            <div className="text-[10px] text-foreground/60">{heading}</div>
            <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-col gap-1">
              {rows.map((r) => (
                <div key={r.label} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-foreground/60">{r.label}</span>
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-foreground/90" style={r.color ? { color: r.color } : undefined}>
                    {r.value}
                  </span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            {footer && <div className="mt-1.5 text-[10px]">{footer}</div>}
          </motion.div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  )
}


# Candlestick Chart mobile
// ─── components/ui/candlestick.tsx ───

"use client"

import { useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react"
import { useInView, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { useWidth } from "@/components/ui/use-width"
import { AxisTag, ChartCard } from "@/components/ui/chart-overlay"

/* Candlestick, in the trading terminal's chart language (user call, 2026-10-02: "fix the
   candlestick chart to be similar to the one on the trading terminal"). The version before
   this one is in git history. What it took from the terminal's price pane:
   · many thin candles, the wick a 1px line, the body ~62% of a slot; direction is the only hue
   · solid faint gridlines with dollar figures on the right
   · a dashed guide at the last close, across the whole plot
   · the crosshair: a rule on the candle, a dashed rule on its close, a dot where they meet,
     the close as an outlined tag on the axis, and a card beside the cursor reading the bar's
     time, open, high, low, close and change
   · a volume pane under its own hairline, the same hue at 0.6
   · dates along the foot
   The header reads the last close and the move across the whole run.
   2026-10-02: the header looked weird (symbol, price, move and a "15d" all on one small
   line), so it now has the library's three tiers like Market Snapshot (spec 14.1): the
   company name at /45 with the symbol on the right, the last close as the headline with its
   cents at /35, then the run's move in its hue and the window at /45. A new `name` prop
   carries the company name.
   2026-10-02 audit: the sample company is now Alphabet (GOOGL), because NVIDIA and NVDA
   read the same at both ends of the label row (his call). The last close guide is named on
   the axis as plain 9px text (the close at /90, "Last" at /45) and steps aside under the
   pointed tag, the price ticks are 9px like the dates, and the card gains a Volume row so
   the volume pane is readable; a new `volumeUnit` prop says how many shares one unit of
   `v` stands for.
   Formulas:
   · change on a bar    = (close − open) ÷ open × 100
   · move across the run = last close − first open, and ÷ first open × 100
   · volume bar height  = volume ÷ the run's largest volume × the pane's height
   · volume in the card = v × volumeUnit shares
   Motion (2026-10-01, kept): once the chart first comes into view every candle rises out of
   its own middle and every volume bar grows off the floor, left to right under one 380ms
   stagger. CSS transitions on transform. Reduced motion draws the end state. */

const EASE_CSS = "cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)"
const UP = "var(--chart-up)"
const DOWN = "var(--chart-candle-down, var(--chart-down))"

export interface Candle {
  o: number
  h: number
  l: number
  c: number
  /** relative volume, 0..1.5 */
  v: number
}

/** Deterministic walk so every render agrees (LCG, one seed): a slow climb with pullbacks. */
const DEFAULT_CANDLES: Candle[] = (() => {
  let s = 20260729
  const rnd = () => {
    s = (s * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7fffffff
    return s / 0x7fffffff
  }
  const out: Candle[] = []
  let close = 168
  for (let i = 0; i < 90; i++) {
    const o = close
    const move = (rnd() - 0.44) * 1.9
    const c = o + move
    const h = Math.max(o, c) + rnd() * 0.9
    const l = Math.min(o, c) - rnd() * 0.9
    const v = 0.35 + rnd() * 0.8 + Math.abs(move) * 0.18
    out.push({ o, h, l, c, v })
    close = c
  }
  return out
})()

/** the price axis on the right, the date row under the volume pane */
const AXIS_W = 52
const DATE_H = 20
const GAP = 10
const PRICE_TOP = 8
/** how many dates along the foot */
const DATES = 5

/** shares, compact: 18.4M */
const shares = (v: number) =>
  v >= 1e9 ? `${(v / 1e9).toFixed(2)}B` : v >= 1e6 ? `${(v / 1e6).toFixed(1)}M` : v >= 1e3 ? `${(v / 1e3).toFixed(1)}K` : `${Math.round(v)}`
const usd = (v: number) => `$${v.toLocaleString("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}`
const axisUsd = (v: number) => `$${Math.round(v).toLocaleString("en-US")}`
const day = (t: number) => new Date(t).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", { day: "numeric", month: "short", timeZone: "UTC" })
const stamp = (t: number) =>
  `${new Date(t).toLocaleDateString("en-US", { month: "short", day: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC" })} ${new Date(t).toLocaleTimeString("en-GB", { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", timeZone: "UTC" })} UTC`

/**
 * Candles over a volume pane that share one x. The crosshair snaps to the candle under the
 * pointer, keeps it full and dims the rest, tags its close on the axis and reads the bar in a
 * card beside the cursor. Green up, red down.
 */
export function Candlestick({
  name = "Alphabet",
  symbol = "GOOGL",
  candles = DEFAULT_CANDLES,
  start = Date.UTC(2026, 4, 12),
  interval = 4 * 3600_000,
  volumeUnit = 20_000_000,
  markers = [],
  height = 300,
  className,
}: {
  /** the chart's height in px (2026-10-06); the volume pane keeps its share */
  height?: number
  /** signals on the bars (2026-10-06): a buy sits under its bar's low, a sell over its high */
  markers?: { at: number; side: "buy" | "sell" }[]
  /** the company or market's name, read in the header's label row */
  name?: string
  symbol?: string
  /** open, high, low, close and a relative volume per bar */
  candles?: Candle[]
  /** the first bar's open time, ms since epoch (UTC) */
  start?: number
  /** one bar's length, ms */
  interval?: number
  /** shares one unit of a candle's `v` stands for; the card reads v × volumeUnit */
  volumeUnit?: number
  className?: string
}) {
  // laid out at the width it is given (2026-10-06), so the text keeps its size
  const [boxRef, W] = useWidth<HTMLDivElement>(560) // the default width, as before
  const PLOT_W = W - AXIS_W
  const H = height
  const VOL_H = Math.round(H * 0.18)
  const PRICE_BOT = H - DATE_H - VOL_H - GAP
  const VOL_BOT = H - DATE_H
  const reduced = useReducedMotion() ?? false
  const svgRef = useRef<SVGSVGElement>(null)
  const seen = useInView(svgRef, { once: true, amount: 0.3 })
  const shown = seen || reduced
  const [hi, setHi] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const n = candles.length

  const { pMin, pMax, vMax, ticks } = useMemo(() => {
    let lo = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY
    let top = Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY
    let vm = 0
    for (const d of candles) {
      lo = Math.min(lo, d.l)
      top = Math.max(top, d.h)
      vm = Math.max(vm, d.v)
    }
    const pad = (top - lo) * 0.06 || 1
    const a = lo - pad
    const b = top + pad
