    return { pMin: a, pMax: b, vMax: vm || 1, ticks: [0.1, 0.37, 0.63, 0.9].map((f) => b - f * (b - a)) }
  }, [candles])

  const step = PLOT_W / Math.max(1, n)
  const bodyW = Math.max(1, Math.min(9, step * 0.62))
  const cx = (i: number) => (i + 0.5) * step
  const yP = (v: number) => PRICE_TOP + (1 - (v - pMin) / (pMax - pMin || 1)) * (PRICE_BOT - PRICE_TOP)
  const yV = (v: number) => VOL_BOT - (v / vMax) * (VOL_H - 4)
  const time = (i: number) => start + i * interval

  const onMove = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    const el = svgRef.current
    if (!el || n === 0) return
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect()
    const px = ((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width) * W
    setHi(px > PLOT_W ? n - 1 : Math.max(0, Math.min(n - 1, Math.floor(px / step))))
  }

  const first = candles[0] ?? { o: 0, h: 0, l: 0, c: 0, v: 0 }
  const last = candles[n - 1] ?? first
  const runMove = last.c - first.o
  const runPct = first.o ? (runMove / first.o) * 100 : 0
  const runUp = runMove >= 0
  const active = hi !== null ? candles[hi] : null
  const up = active ? active.c >= active.o : runUp
  const hue = up ? UP : DOWN
  const barPct = active && active.o ? ((active.c - active.o) / active.o) * 100 : 0
  const sign = (v: number) => (v >= 0 ? "+" : "−")
  const tagY = active ? Math.max(PRICE_TOP + 8, Math.min(PRICE_BOT - 8, yP(active.c))) : 0
  const fade = reduced ? "none" : "opacity 160ms"
  /* the entrance: every candle rises from its own middle, the whole run under 380ms */
  const stagger = Math.min(0.02, 0.38 / Math.max(1, n))
  const grow = (i: number) => (reduced ? "none" : `transform 0.45s ${EASE_CSS} ${(i * stagger).toFixed(3)}s, opacity 0.45s ${EASE_CSS} ${(i * stagger).toFixed(3)}s`)
  const dates = Array.from({ length: DATES }, (_, k) => Math.round((k / (DATES - 1)) * (n - 1)))
  /* the card sits right of the cursor, and flips left past 60% of the plot */
  const flip = hi !== null && cx(hi) > PLOT_W * 0.6
  const [closeWhole, closeCents] = usd(last.c).split(".")
  const windowDays = Math.round((n * interval) / 86_400_000)
  /* the last close, named on the axis; it and any tick under it step aside for the pointed tag */
  const lastY = yP(last.c)
  const lastHidden = active !== null && Math.abs(lastY - tagY) < 13

  return (
    <div ref={boxRef} className={cn("w-[560px] max-w-full tabular-nums", className)}>
      {/* the header, three tiers (spec 14.1): name and symbol, the last close, then the run's move and its window */}
      <div className="mb-3 flex items-baseline justify-between text-[12px]">
        <span className="truncate text-foreground/45">{name}</span>
        <span className="shrink-0 pl-3 font-medium text-foreground/90">{symbol}</span>
      </div>
      <p className="m-0 text-[26px] font-semibold leading-none tracking-[-0.02em] text-foreground/90">
        {closeWhole}
        <span className="text-foreground/35">.{closeCents}</span>
      </p>
      <p className="mb-4 mt-2 flex items-baseline gap-[7px] text-[12px] font-medium" style={{ color: runUp ? UP : DOWN }}>
        <span>
          {sign(runMove)}
          {usd(Math.abs(runMove))} · {sign(runPct)}
          {Math.abs(runPct).toFixed(1)}%
        </span>
        <span className="font-normal text-foreground/45">{windowDays === 1 ? "1 day" : `${windowDays} days`}</span>
      </p>

      <div className="relative">
        <svg
          ref={svgRef}
          width={W}
          height={H}
          viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`}
          className="block h-auto w-full cursor-crosshair touch-none"
          role="img"
          aria-label={`${name} (${symbol}) candlestick chart, ${n} bars. Last close ${usd(last.c)}, ${sign(runPct)}${Math.abs(runPct).toFixed(2)}% across the run`}
          onPointerMove={onMove}
          onPointerLeave={() => setHi(null)}
        >
          {/* price gridlines and the right-hand scale; a figure steps aside while the tag sits on it */}
          {ticks.map((t) => {
            const gy = yP(t)
            const under = (active !== null && Math.abs(gy - tagY) < 12) || Math.abs(gy - lastY) < 11
            return (
              <g key={t}>
                <line x1={0} x2={PLOT_W} y1={gy} y2={gy} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.05} strokeWidth={1} />
                <text x={W - 4} y={gy + 3} textAnchor="end" fontSize={9} fill="var(--foreground)" fillOpacity={0.45} style={{ opacity: under ? 0 : 1, transition: fade }}>
                  {axisUsd(t)}
                </text>
              </g>
            )
          })}
          {/* the volume pane's own floor rule */}
          <line x1={0} x2={W} y1={VOL_BOT + 0.5} y2={VOL_BOT + 0.5} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.06} strokeWidth={1} />

          {/* last-close guide, named on the axis as plain text (spec 14.7): the close at /90, its name at /45 */}
          <line x1={0} x2={PLOT_W} y1={lastY} y2={lastY} stroke={runUp ? UP : DOWN} strokeOpacity={0.4} strokeDasharray="2 4" strokeWidth={1} />
          <text
            x={W - 4}
            y={lastY + 3}
            textAnchor="end"
            fontSize={9}
            fill="var(--foreground)"
            pointerEvents="none"
            style={{ opacity: lastHidden ? 0 : 1, transition: fade }}
          >
            <tspan fontWeight={500} fillOpacity={0.9}>
              {axisUsd(last.c)}
            </tspan>
            <tspan fillOpacity={0.45}> Last</tspan>
          </text>

          {candles.map((d, i) => {
            const barHue = d.c >= d.o ? UP : DOWN
            const dim = hi !== null && hi !== i
            const top = yP(Math.max(d.o, d.c))
            const bodyH = Math.max(1, Math.abs(yP(d.o) - yP(d.c)))
            return (
              <g key={i} style={{ opacity: dim ? 0.45 : 1, transition: fade }}>
                {/* volume: the same hue at 0.6, growing off the pane's floor */}
                <rect
                  x={cx(i) - bodyW / 2}
                  y={yV(d.v)}
                  width={bodyW}
                  height={VOL_BOT - yV(d.v)}
                  fill={barHue}
                  fillOpacity={0.6}
                  style={{ transformOrigin: `0px ${VOL_BOT}px`, transform: shown ? "none" : "scaleY(0)", transition: grow(i) }}
                />
                {/* the candle rises out of its own middle, between its high and its low */}
                <g
                  style={{
                    transformOrigin: `0px ${((yP(d.h) + yP(d.l)) / 2).toFixed(1)}px`,
                    transform: shown ? "none" : "scaleY(0.6)",
                    opacity: shown ? 1 : 0,
                    transition: grow(i),
                  }}
                >
                  <line x1={cx(i)} y1={yP(d.h)} x2={cx(i)} y2={yP(d.l)} stroke={barHue} strokeWidth={1} />
                  <rect x={cx(i) - bodyW / 2} y={top} width={bodyW} height={bodyH} fill={barHue} />
                </g>
              </g>
            )
          })}

          {/* dates along the foot */}
          {dates.map((i, k) => (
            <text
              key={`${i}-${k}`}
              x={k === 0 ? 2 : k === DATES - 1 ? PLOT_W - 2 : cx(i)}
              y={H - 5}
              textAnchor={k === 0 ? "start" : k === DATES - 1 ? "end" : "middle"}
              fontSize={9}
              fill="var(--foreground)"
              fillOpacity={0.45}
            >
              {day(time(i))}
            </text>
          ))}

          {/* signal markers (2026-10-06): a small triangle pointing at the bar, in the side's hue */}
          {markers.filter((m) => m.at >= 0 && m.at < n).map((m) => {
            const d = candles[m.at]
            const x = cx(m.at)
            const y = m.side === "buy" ? yP(d.l) + 9 : yP(d.h) - 9
            const tip = m.side === "buy" ? -1 : 1
            return (
              <path
                key={`${m.side}${m.at}`}
                d={`M ${x} ${y + tip * 4} L ${x - 4.5} ${y - tip * 3.5} L ${x + 4.5} ${y - tip * 3.5} Z`}
                fill={m.side === "buy" ? UP : DOWN}
                style={{ opacity: shown ? 1 : 0, transition: fade }}
              />
            )
          })}

          {/* the crosshair: a rule on the candle, a dashed rule on its close, a dot, and the close tagged on the axis */}
          {active && hi !== null && (
            <g pointerEvents="none">
              <line x1={cx(hi)} y1={PRICE_TOP - 8} x2={cx(hi)} y2={VOL_BOT} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.18} strokeWidth={1} />
              <line x1={0} y1={yP(active.c)} x2={PLOT_W} y2={yP(active.c)} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.14} strokeDasharray="3 3" strokeWidth={1} />
              <circle cx={cx(hi)} cy={yP(active.c)} r={3} fill={hue} stroke="var(--background)" strokeWidth={1.5} />
              <AxisTag x={PLOT_W + 2} y={tagY} width={AXIS_W - 4} color={hue}>
                {axisUsd(active.c)}
              </AxisTag>
            </g>
          )}
        </svg>

        {/* the bar under the cursor, read out beside it (chart-overlay.tsx) */}
        <ChartCard
          open={active !== null && hi !== null}
          x={hi !== null ? `${(cx(hi) / W) * 100}%` : 0}
          flip={flip}
          heading={hi !== null ? stamp(time(hi)) : ""}
          rows={
            active
              ? [
                  { label: "Open", value: usd(active.o) },
                  { label: "High", value: usd(active.h) },
                  { label: "Low", value: usd(active.l) },
                  { label: "Close", value: usd(active.c) },
                  { label: "Volume", value: shares(active.v * volumeUnit) },
                  { label: "Change", value: `${sign(barPct)}${Math.abs(barPct).toFixed(2)}%`, color: hue },
                ]
              : []
          }
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}


// ─── components/ui/use-width.ts ───

"use client";

// The width a chart is given (2026-10-06, the Tradeboard case study). The charts used to lay
// out in a fixed box and stretch as a picture in a wider column, so their text grew with it;
// measured, they lay out at the real width and the text keeps its size. A chart left at its
// default class measures its own default width, so nothing changes where it is not stretched.
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

export function useWidth<T extends HTMLElement>(fallback: number, min = 280) {
  const ref = useRef<T>(null);
  const [w, setW] = useState(fallback);
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(([e]) => setW(Math.max(min, Math.round(e.contentRect.width)) || fallback));
    ro.observe(el);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, [fallback, min]);
  return [ref, w] as const;
}


// ─── components/ui/chart-overlay.tsx ───

"use client"

import { type ReactNode } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

/* Chart overlay: the two parts every library chart reads a point with (2026-10-02). They
   came out of Candlestick, Volume Profile, the trading terminal and Price Scrubber, which
   had each drawn their own; this is the one copy. Shipped beside the charts that use it.

   AxisTag   the outlined tag on the value axis: the pointed value in its hue, or a named
             reference (POC, last close) in ink. A pill 16px high, 8.5px figures.
   ChartCard the card laid over the chart beside the cursor: a heading row (a time or a
             range) at /60, then label and value rows (labels 10px /60, values 11px /90),
             the one signed figure in its hue. It glides between points on a spring, fades
             in from 0.97 and out in 120ms, and flips to the cursor's left when told to.

   2026-10-02: the card looked out of place over the charts, so it now wears the library
   popover, the same as the sidebar's hover card: a hairline border at 8%, radius 12, the
   6% foreground mix and the popover shadow with no inset highlight (spec 14.6). */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GLIDE = { type: "spring", stiffness: 520, damping: 40 } as const

/** the outlined tag on a chart's value axis, centred on `y` */
export function AxisTag({
  x,
  y,
  width,
  color = "var(--foreground)",
  strong = true,
  hidden = false,
  children,
}: {
  /** the tag's left edge, in the chart's own units */
  x: number
  /** the value's line; the tag is centred on it */
  y: number
  width: number
  /** stroke and figure; ink for a named reference, the series hue for the pointed value */
  color?: string
  /** a quieter tag (a secondary reference) drops the weight and the stroke */
  strong?: boolean
  /** fades the tag out, for when the pointed value sits on it */
  hidden?: boolean
  children: ReactNode
}) {
  return (
    <g transform={`translate(${x}, ${y - 8})`} pointerEvents="none" style={{ opacity: hidden ? 0 : 1, transition: "opacity 150ms" }}>
      <rect width={width} height={16} rx={8} fill="var(--background)" stroke={color} strokeOpacity={strong ? 0.6 : 0.2} />
      <text x={width / 2} y={11} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={8.5} fontWeight={strong ? 600 : 500} fill={color} fillOpacity={strong ? 1 : 0.65}>
        {children}
      </text>
    </g>
  )
}

export interface ChartCardRow {
  label: string
  value: ReactNode
  /** only the one signed figure carries a hue */
  color?: string
}

/** the readout card over a chart; place it inside a `relative` box that holds the svg */
export function ChartCard({
  open,
  x,
  y = 4,
  flip = false,
  width = 148,
  heading,
  rows,
  footer,
}: {
  open: boolean
  /** the cursor's x inside the box: px, or a percentage string for a chart drawn to a viewBox */
  x: number | string
  /** the card's top inside the box, px */
  y?: number
  /** put the card on the cursor's left (past ~60% of the plot) */
  flip?: boolean
  width?: number
  heading: ReactNode
  rows: ChartCardRow[]
  /** a closing line under the rows, such as where the point sits */
  footer?: ReactNode
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {open && (
        <motion.div
          key="chart-card"
          role="status"
          className="pointer-events-none absolute z-10"
          initial={{ left: x, top: y, opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ left: x, top: y, opacity: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, transition: { duration: 0.12 } }}
          transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { left: GLIDE, top: GLIDE, opacity: { duration: 0.15 } }}
        >
          <motion.div
            className="rounded-[12px] border border-foreground/[0.08] px-3 py-2.5"
            style={{
              width,
              translate: flip ? "calc(-100% - 12px) 0" : "12px 0",
              transition: reduced ? undefined : "translate 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)",
              background: "var(--tip-fill, color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 6%, var(--background)))",
              boxShadow: "0 8px 24px var(--card-shadow, rgba(0,0,0,calc(0.35 * var(--shadow-k, 1))))",
            }}
            initial={reduced ? false : { scale: 0.97 }}
            animate={{ scale: 1 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
          >
            <div className="text-[10px] text-foreground/60">{heading}</div>
            <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-col gap-1">
              {rows.map((r) => (
                <div key={r.label} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-foreground/60">{r.label}</span>
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-foreground/90" style={r.color ? { color: r.color } : undefined}>
                    {r.value}
                  </span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            {footer && <div className="mt-1.5 text-[10px]">{footer}</div>}
          </motion.div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  )
}


# SMA Chart desk
// ─── components/ui/sma-chart.tsx ───

"use client"

import { useId, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react"
import { motion, useInView, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { AxisTag } from "@/components/ui/chart-overlay"
import { LiveFigure } from "@/components/ui/live-figure"

/* SMA Chart, rebuilt through the ssych-component skill (2026-09-29).
   What changed against the version before it (in git history), and why:
   · the price is ink; the two averages each carry their own hue (--chart-1, --chart-5) so
     they are told apart, in the line, the legend dot and the scrub dot (given back
     2026-09-30). The change stays green or red. Pointing at an average dims the other lines
   · no floating box over the chart: scrubbing puts the price in the summary and both
     averages in the legend, as plain text, in place
   · the price line is 1.8px, the averages 1.2px; the scrub dots have no halo because
     there is no card colour under them
   · the summary has no rule above it and the change is signed text, not a tinted chip
   · the chart names itself to a screen reader, every figure is tabular
   Props are unchanged.
   Motion (2026-10-01): once the chart is in view the price and both averages sweep in left
   to right through one clip (0.9s; they drew on mount, off screen too); a new series morphs
   all three lines and glides the gridlines with their ticks
   2026-10-02: it had too many headers and numbers, some printed twice (the symbol and name
   with the legend on top, then the price, a bar count, the change and a second bar count
   under the plot). Now it has the library's one header in three tiers like Market Snapshot
   (spec 14.1): the company name at /45 with the symbol on the right, the price as the
   headline with its cents at /35, then the change over the last 30 days in its hue and that
   window at /45. Scrubbing reads the pointed day into the same header, its change counted
   30 days back from it. The legend sits under the header (spec 14.3): a 10 by 2 line in each
   average's hue, its name at /60 and its value at /90. Under the plot only one line is left,
   blank at rest, that says how long ago the pointed day was (spec 13.1).
   2026-10-02 audit: the averages were mislabelled (a "60 SMA" computed over 14 bars and a
   "200 SMA" over 45), so they are now the 20 and 50 day averages, computed and labelled so.
   Scrubbing changes the headline and the legend values in place; the headline swaps only
   when a scrub starts or ends (it blurred in again on every step). The plot spans the
   root at 440 (it stopped 20px short of the header), the axis prints three round dollar
   ticks at 9px /45, dates run along the foot, and the pointed price is the shared AxisTag.
   The line under the plot is gone: while scrubbing, the window slot reads "30 days to" the
   pointed date. A new `end` prop dates the last close.
   Formulas:
   · an n day SMA at a day = the mean of that day's close and the n − 1 closes before it
     (fewer near the start of the series)
   · change = the shown close − the close 30 days before it; percent = change ÷ that close × 100
   · a bar's date = end − (the bars after it) days */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GREEN = "var(--chart-up)"
const RED = "var(--chart-down)"
const ink = (pct: number) => `color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) ${pct}%, transparent)`

const W = 440
const H = 200
const PAD = { r: 48, b: 20 }
/** how many dates along the foot */
const FOOT = 4
const DAY = 86_400_000
const axisUsd = (v: number) => `$${Math.round(v).toLocaleString("en-US")}`
const usd = (v: number) => `$${v.toLocaleString("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}`
const day = (t: number) => new Date(t).toLocaleDateString("en-US", { month: "short", day: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC" })
/** days (bars) the change in the header looks back over */
const LOOKBACK = 30

/** deterministic default series, a drifting daily close */
const DEFAULT_PRICES: number[] = (() => {
  let s = 61
  let v = 150
  const out: number[] = []
  for (let i = 0; i < 120; i++) {
    s = (s * 16807) % 2147483647
    v = Math.max(120, v + ((s / 2147483647) - 0.46) * 4.2)
    out.push(v)
  }
  return out
})()

const smaOf = (data: number[], win: number) => data.map((_, i) => {
  const from = Math.max(0, i - win + 1)
  const slice = data.slice(from, i + 1)
  return slice.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / slice.length
})

type Key = "fast" | "slow"
/** the two overlays: label, trailing window in bars, its own hue (categorical order) */
const AVERAGES: { key: Key; label: string; win: number; hue: string }[] = [
  { key: "fast", label: "20 SMA", win: 20, hue: "var(--chart-1)" },
  { key: "slow", label: "50 SMA", win: 50, hue: "var(--chart-5)" },
]

export interface SmaChartProps {
  /** ticker, on the right of the header's label row */
  symbol?: string
  /** company name, on the left of the header's label row */
  name?: string
  /** daily closes, oldest → latest (the two SMAs derive from it) */
  prices?: number[]
  /** the last close's date, ms since epoch (UTC); one bar is one day */
  end?: number
  className?: string
}

/**
 * Moving-average chart: one price line with its fast and slow averages as two quieter
 * inks and price ticks on the right edge. Scrubbing reads the bar under the pointer into
 * the header and the legend; pointing at an average in the legend picks it out.
 */
export function SmaChart({ symbol = "AMZN", name = "Amazon.com Inc.", prices = DEFAULT_PRICES, end = Date.UTC(2026, 8, 30), className }: SmaChartProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const svgRef = useRef<SVGSVGElement>(null)
  const [hover, setHover] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const [hot, setHot] = useState<Key | null>(null)
  const uid = useId().replace(/:/g, "")
  /* the entrance plays once, when a third of the chart is in view; reduced motion lands at once */
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const seen = useInView(rootRef, { once: true, amount: 0.3 })
  const play = !!reduced || seen
  /** a change of data glides between the two states */
  const morph = reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.35, ease: EASE }

  const { n, price, avg, min, max, x, y, path } = useMemo(() => {
    const price = prices.length ? prices : [0]
    const n = price.length
    const avg: Record<Key, number[]> = { fast: smaOf(price, AVERAGES[0].win), slow: smaOf(price, AVERAGES[1].win) }
    const all = [...price, ...avg.fast, ...avg.slow]
    const min = Math.min(...all)
    const max = Math.max(...all)
    const x = (i: number) => (i / Math.max(1, n - 1)) * (W - PAD.r)
    const y = (v: number) => 8 + (1 - (v - min) / (max - min || 1)) * (H - PAD.b - 16)
    const path = (d: number[]) => d.map((v, i) => `${i === 0 ? "M" : "L"}${x(i).toFixed(1)},${y(v).toFixed(1)}`).join(" ")
    return { n, price, avg, min, max, x, y, path }
  }, [prices])

  const last = price[n - 1]
  const shown = hover ?? n - 1
  /* the change in the header: the shown day against LOOKBACK days before it (fewer near the start) */
  const from = Math.max(0, shown - LOOKBACK)
  const back = shown - from
  const base = price[from]
  const change = price[shown] - base
  const pct = (change / (base || 1)) * 100
  const up = change >= 0
  const hue = up ? GREEN : RED
  const sign = up ? "+" : "−"
  /* the aria-label keeps the rest reading: the last close against LOOKBACK days back */
  const restBase = price[Math.max(0, n - 1 - LOOKBACK)]
  const restPct = ((last - restBase) / (restBase || 1)) * 100
  const [priceWhole, priceCents] = price[shown].toFixed(2).split(".")

  const onMove = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    const r = svgRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect()
    if (!r) return
    const px = ((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width) * W
    setHover(Math.max(0, Math.min(n - 1, Math.round((px / (W - PAD.r)) * (n - 1)))))
  }

  const fade = reduced ? "none" : "opacity 160ms, stroke 160ms"
  const date = (i: number) => end - (n - 1 - i) * DAY
  const foot = Array.from({ length: FOOT }, (_, k) => Math.round((k / (FOOT - 1)) * (n - 1)))
  const ticks = [0.15, 0.5, 0.85].map((f) => max - f * (max - min))
  const tagY = hover == null ? 0 : Math.max(16, Math.min(H - PAD.b - 8, y(price[hover])))

  return (
    <div ref={rootRef} className={cn("w-[440px] max-w-full tabular-nums", className)}>
      {/* the header, three tiers (spec 14.1): name and symbol, the price, then its change and window */}
      <div className="mb-3 flex items-baseline justify-between text-[12px]">
        <span className="truncate text-foreground/45">{name}</span>
        <span className="shrink-0 pl-3 font-medium text-foreground/90">{symbol}</span>
      </div>
      {/* the readout swaps only when a scrub starts or ends; while scrubbing it follows the pointer in place */}
      <div role="status">
        <LiveFigure intent={hover == null ? null : "scrub"}>
          <p className="m-0 text-[26px] font-semibold leading-none tracking-[-0.02em] text-foreground/90">
            ${Number(priceWhole).toLocaleString("en-US")}
            <span className="text-foreground/35">.{priceCents}</span>
          </p>
          <p className="mb-0 mt-2 flex items-baseline gap-[7px] text-[12px] font-medium" style={{ color: hue }}>
            <span>
              {sign}${Math.abs(change).toFixed(2)} · {sign}
              {Math.abs(pct).toFixed(1)}%
            </span>
            <span className="font-normal text-foreground/45">
              {back === 1 ? "1 day" : `${back} days`}
              {hover != null && ` to ${day(date(hover))}`}
            </span>
          </p>
        </LiveFigure>
      </div>

      {/* the legend (spec 14.3): a line in each average's hue, its name and its value at the shown day */}
      <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1" onPointerLeave={() => setHot(null)}>
        {AVERAGES.map((a) => (
          <button
            key={a.key}
            type="button"
            aria-label={`${a.label} ${avg[a.key][shown].toFixed(2)}`}
            onPointerEnter={() => setHot(a.key)}
            onFocus={() => setHot(a.key)}
            onBlur={() => setHot(null)}
            className={cn(
              "-mx-1 flex cursor-default items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full px-1 text-[11px] text-foreground/60 outline-none transition-opacity duration-200 focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.06] motion-reduce:transition-none",
              hot !== null && hot !== a.key && "opacity-35",
            )}
          >
            <span aria-hidden className="h-[2px] w-2.5 shrink-0 rounded-full" style={{ background: a.hue }} />
            {a.label}
            <span className="inline-block font-medium text-foreground/90">{avg[a.key][shown].toFixed(2)}</span>
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      <svg
        ref={svgRef}
        width={W}
        height={H}
        viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`}
        className="mt-3 block h-auto w-full cursor-crosshair touch-none"
        role="img"
        aria-label={`${name} (${symbol}) price with two moving averages, last $${last.toFixed(2)}, ${restPct >= 0 ? "+" : "−"}${Math.abs(restPct).toFixed(2)}% over ${LOOKBACK} days`}
        onPointerMove={onMove}
        onPointerLeave={() => setHover(null)}
      >
        <defs>
          {/* all three lines sweep in left to right, a few px wider than the plot for the round caps */}
          <clipPath id={`${uid}-reveal`}>
            <motion.rect
              x={-4}
              y={0}
              height={H}
              initial={reduced ? false : { width: 0 }}
              animate={{ width: play ? W - PAD.r + 8 : 0 }}
              transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.9, ease: EASE }}
            />
          </clipPath>
        </defs>

        {/* right-edge price ticks; new data glides each line and its figure, which steps aside under the pointed tag */}
        {ticks.map((v, i) => (
          <g key={i} style={{ opacity: hover != null && Math.abs(y(v) - tagY) < 12 ? 0 : 1, transition: fade }}>
            <motion.line
              x1={0}
              x2={W - PAD.r}
              stroke="var(--foreground)"
              strokeOpacity={0.05}
              strokeWidth={1}
              initial={false}
              animate={{ y1: y(v), y2: y(v) }}
              transition={morph}
            />
            <motion.text
              x={W - PAD.r + 8}
              fontSize={9}
              fill="var(--foreground)"
              fillOpacity={0.45}
              className="tabular-nums"
              initial={false}
              animate={{ attrY: y(v) + 3 }}
              transition={morph}
            >
              {axisUsd(v)}
            </motion.text>
          </g>
        ))}

        {/* averages first, price on top */}
        <g clipPath={`url(#${uid}-reveal)`}>
          {[...AVERAGES].reverse().map((a) => (
            <motion.path
              key={a.key}
              fill="none"
              stroke={a.hue}
              strokeWidth={1.2}
              strokeLinejoin="round"
              style={{ opacity: hot !== null && hot !== a.key ? 0.35 : 1, transition: fade }}
              initial={false}
              animate={{ d: path(avg[a.key]) }}
              transition={morph}
            />
          ))}
          <motion.path
            fill="none"
            stroke={ink(90)}
            strokeWidth={1.8}
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
            style={{ opacity: hot !== null ? 0.35 : 1, transition: fade }}
            initial={false}
            animate={{ d: path(price) }}
            transition={morph}
          />
        </g>

        {/* dates along the foot */}
        {foot.map((i, k) => (
          <text
            key={`${i}-${k}`}
            x={k === 0 ? 0 : k === FOOT - 1 ? W - PAD.r : x(i)}
            y={H - 5}
            textAnchor={k === 0 ? "start" : k === FOOT - 1 ? "end" : "middle"}
            fontSize={9}
            fill="var(--foreground)"
            fillOpacity={0.45}
          >
            {day(date(i))}
          </text>
        ))}

        {/* guide, one dot per line and the pointed close tagged on the axis (chart-overlay.tsx) */}
        {hover != null && (
          <g pointerEvents="none">
            <line x1={x(hover)} y1={8} x2={x(hover)} y2={H - PAD.b} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.16} strokeWidth={1} />
            {AVERAGES.map((a) => (
              <circle key={a.key} cx={x(hover)} cy={y(avg[a.key][hover])} r={2.2} fill={a.hue} />
            ))}
            <circle cx={x(hover)} cy={y(price[hover])} r={2.6} fill="var(--foreground)" />
            <AxisTag x={W - PAD.r + 2} y={tagY} width={PAD.r - 4}>
              {usd(price[hover])}
            </AxisTag>
          </g>
        )}
      </svg>
    </div>
  )
}


// ─── components/ui/chart-overlay.tsx ───

"use client"

import { type ReactNode } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

/* Chart overlay: the two parts every library chart reads a point with (2026-10-02). They
   came out of Candlestick, Volume Profile, the trading terminal and Price Scrubber, which
   had each drawn their own; this is the one copy. Shipped beside the charts that use it.

   AxisTag   the outlined tag on the value axis: the pointed value in its hue, or a named
             reference (POC, last close) in ink. A pill 16px high, 8.5px figures.
   ChartCard the card laid over the chart beside the cursor: a heading row (a time or a
             range) at /60, then label and value rows (labels 10px /60, values 11px /90),
             the one signed figure in its hue. It glides between points on a spring, fades
             in from 0.97 and out in 120ms, and flips to the cursor's left when told to.

   2026-10-02: the card looked out of place over the charts, so it now wears the library
   popover, the same as the sidebar's hover card: a hairline border at 8%, radius 12, the
   6% foreground mix and the popover shadow with no inset highlight (spec 14.6). */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GLIDE = { type: "spring", stiffness: 520, damping: 40 } as const

/** the outlined tag on a chart's value axis, centred on `y` */
export function AxisTag({
  x,
  y,
  width,
  color = "var(--foreground)",
  strong = true,
  hidden = false,
  children,
}: {
  /** the tag's left edge, in the chart's own units */
  x: number
  /** the value's line; the tag is centred on it */
  y: number
  width: number
  /** stroke and figure; ink for a named reference, the series hue for the pointed value */
  color?: string
  /** a quieter tag (a secondary reference) drops the weight and the stroke */
  strong?: boolean
  /** fades the tag out, for when the pointed value sits on it */
  hidden?: boolean
  children: ReactNode
}) {
  return (
    <g transform={`translate(${x}, ${y - 8})`} pointerEvents="none" style={{ opacity: hidden ? 0 : 1, transition: "opacity 150ms" }}>
      <rect width={width} height={16} rx={8} fill="var(--background)" stroke={color} strokeOpacity={strong ? 0.6 : 0.2} />
      <text x={width / 2} y={11} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={8.5} fontWeight={strong ? 600 : 500} fill={color} fillOpacity={strong ? 1 : 0.65}>
        {children}
      </text>
    </g>
  )
}

export interface ChartCardRow {
  label: string
  value: ReactNode
  /** only the one signed figure carries a hue */
  color?: string
}

/** the readout card over a chart; place it inside a `relative` box that holds the svg */
export function ChartCard({
  open,
  x,
  y = 4,
  flip = false,
  width = 148,
  heading,
  rows,
  footer,
}: {
  open: boolean
  /** the cursor's x inside the box: px, or a percentage string for a chart drawn to a viewBox */
  x: number | string
  /** the card's top inside the box, px */
  y?: number
  /** put the card on the cursor's left (past ~60% of the plot) */
  flip?: boolean
  width?: number
  heading: ReactNode
  rows: ChartCardRow[]
  /** a closing line under the rows, such as where the point sits */
  footer?: ReactNode
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {open && (
        <motion.div
          key="chart-card"
          role="status"
          className="pointer-events-none absolute z-10"
          initial={{ left: x, top: y, opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ left: x, top: y, opacity: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, transition: { duration: 0.12 } }}
          transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { left: GLIDE, top: GLIDE, opacity: { duration: 0.15 } }}
        >
          <motion.div
            className="rounded-[12px] border border-foreground/[0.08] px-3 py-2.5"
            style={{
              width,
              translate: flip ? "calc(-100% - 12px) 0" : "12px 0",
              transition: reduced ? undefined : "translate 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)",
              background: "var(--tip-fill, color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 6%, var(--background)))",
              boxShadow: "0 8px 24px var(--card-shadow, rgba(0,0,0,calc(0.35 * var(--shadow-k, 1))))",
            }}
            initial={reduced ? false : { scale: 0.97 }}
            animate={{ scale: 1 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
          >
            <div className="text-[10px] text-foreground/60">{heading}</div>
            <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-col gap-1">
              {rows.map((r) => (
                <div key={r.label} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-foreground/60">{r.label}</span>
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-foreground/90" style={r.color ? { color: r.color } : undefined}>
                    {r.value}
                  </span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            {footer && <div className="mt-1.5 text-[10px]">{footer}</div>}
          </motion.div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  )
}


// ─── components/ui/live-figure.tsx ───

"use client"

import { type ReactNode } from "react"
import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

/* Live figure: a figure fed by a live stream (2026-10-02, out of Tape Flow, where a price
   that re-entered on every print read as a flicker). The value changes in place on each
   tick; the figure swaps (4px, 2px blur, 150ms) only when `intent` changes: the pointer
   takes a point, lets it go, or a toggle flips. Pass the pointed point's id, or null for
   the live value. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const

export function LiveFigure({
  intent,
  className,
  children,
}: {
  /** what the figure is showing: a pointed point's id, or null while it follows the stream */
  intent: string | number | null
  className?: string
  children: ReactNode
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  return (
    <motion.div
      key={intent === null ? "live" : `at-${intent}`}
      className={cn(className)}
      initial={reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: 4, filter: "blur(2px)" }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, filter: "blur(0px)" }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
    >
      {children}
    </motion.div>
  )
}

# SMA Chart mobile
// ─── components/ui/sma-chart.tsx ───

"use client"

import { useId, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react"
import { motion, useInView, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { AxisTag } from "@/components/ui/chart-overlay"
import { LiveFigure } from "@/components/ui/live-figure"

/* SMA Chart, rebuilt through the ssych-component skill (2026-09-29).
   What changed against the version before it (in git history), and why:
   · the price is ink; the two averages each carry their own hue (--chart-1, --chart-5) so
     they are told apart, in the line, the legend dot and the scrub dot (given back
     2026-09-30). The change stays green or red. Pointing at an average dims the other lines
   · no floating box over the chart: scrubbing puts the price in the summary and both
     averages in the legend, as plain text, in place
   · the price line is 1.8px, the averages 1.2px; the scrub dots have no halo because
     there is no card colour under them
   · the summary has no rule above it and the change is signed text, not a tinted chip
   · the chart names itself to a screen reader, every figure is tabular
   Props are unchanged.
   Motion (2026-10-01): once the chart is in view the price and both averages sweep in left
   to right through one clip (0.9s; they drew on mount, off screen too); a new series morphs
   all three lines and glides the gridlines with their ticks
   2026-10-02: it had too many headers and numbers, some printed twice (the symbol and name
   with the legend on top, then the price, a bar count, the change and a second bar count
   under the plot). Now it has the library's one header in three tiers like Market Snapshot
   (spec 14.1): the company name at /45 with the symbol on the right, the price as the
   headline with its cents at /35, then the change over the last 30 days in its hue and that
   window at /45. Scrubbing reads the pointed day into the same header, its change counted
   30 days back from it. The legend sits under the header (spec 14.3): a 10 by 2 line in each
   average's hue, its name at /60 and its value at /90. Under the plot only one line is left,
   blank at rest, that says how long ago the pointed day was (spec 13.1).
   2026-10-02 audit: the averages were mislabelled (a "60 SMA" computed over 14 bars and a
   "200 SMA" over 45), so they are now the 20 and 50 day averages, computed and labelled so.
   Scrubbing changes the headline and the legend values in place; the headline swaps only
   when a scrub starts or ends (it blurred in again on every step). The plot spans the
   root at 440 (it stopped 20px short of the header), the axis prints three round dollar
   ticks at 9px /45, dates run along the foot, and the pointed price is the shared AxisTag.
   The line under the plot is gone: while scrubbing, the window slot reads "30 days to" the
   pointed date. A new `end` prop dates the last close.
   Formulas:
   · an n day SMA at a day = the mean of that day's close and the n − 1 closes before it
     (fewer near the start of the series)
   · change = the shown close − the close 30 days before it; percent = change ÷ that close × 100
   · a bar's date = end − (the bars after it) days */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GREEN = "var(--chart-up)"
const RED = "var(--chart-down)"
const ink = (pct: number) => `color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) ${pct}%, transparent)`

const W = 440
const H = 200
const PAD = { r: 48, b: 20 }
/** how many dates along the foot */
const FOOT = 4
const DAY = 86_400_000
const axisUsd = (v: number) => `$${Math.round(v).toLocaleString("en-US")}`
const usd = (v: number) => `$${v.toLocaleString("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}`
const day = (t: number) => new Date(t).toLocaleDateString("en-US", { month: "short", day: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC" })
/** days (bars) the change in the header looks back over */
const LOOKBACK = 30

/** deterministic default series, a drifting daily close */
const DEFAULT_PRICES: number[] = (() => {
  let s = 61
  let v = 150
  const out: number[] = []
  for (let i = 0; i < 120; i++) {
    s = (s * 16807) % 2147483647
    v = Math.max(120, v + ((s / 2147483647) - 0.46) * 4.2)
    out.push(v)
  }
  return out
})()

const smaOf = (data: number[], win: number) => data.map((_, i) => {
  const from = Math.max(0, i - win + 1)
  const slice = data.slice(from, i + 1)
  return slice.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / slice.length
})

type Key = "fast" | "slow"
/** the two overlays: label, trailing window in bars, its own hue (categorical order) */
const AVERAGES: { key: Key; label: string; win: number; hue: string }[] = [
  { key: "fast", label: "20 SMA", win: 20, hue: "var(--chart-1)" },
  { key: "slow", label: "50 SMA", win: 50, hue: "var(--chart-5)" },
]

export interface SmaChartProps {
  /** ticker, on the right of the header's label row */
  symbol?: string
  /** company name, on the left of the header's label row */
  name?: string
  /** daily closes, oldest → latest (the two SMAs derive from it) */
  prices?: number[]
  /** the last close's date, ms since epoch (UTC); one bar is one day */
  end?: number
  className?: string
}

/**
 * Moving-average chart: one price line with its fast and slow averages as two quieter
 * inks and price ticks on the right edge. Scrubbing reads the bar under the pointer into
 * the header and the legend; pointing at an average in the legend picks it out.
 */
export function SmaChart({ symbol = "AMZN", name = "Amazon.com Inc.", prices = DEFAULT_PRICES, end = Date.UTC(2026, 8, 30), className }: SmaChartProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const svgRef = useRef<SVGSVGElement>(null)
  const [hover, setHover] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const [hot, setHot] = useState<Key | null>(null)
  const uid = useId().replace(/:/g, "")
  /* the entrance plays once, when a third of the chart is in view; reduced motion lands at once */
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const seen = useInView(rootRef, { once: true, amount: 0.3 })
  const play = !!reduced || seen
  /** a change of data glides between the two states */
  const morph = reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.35, ease: EASE }

  const { n, price, avg, min, max, x, y, path } = useMemo(() => {
    const price = prices.length ? prices : [0]
    const n = price.length
    const avg: Record<Key, number[]> = { fast: smaOf(price, AVERAGES[0].win), slow: smaOf(price, AVERAGES[1].win) }
    const all = [...price, ...avg.fast, ...avg.slow]
    const min = Math.min(...all)
    const max = Math.max(...all)
    const x = (i: number) => (i / Math.max(1, n - 1)) * (W - PAD.r)
    const y = (v: number) => 8 + (1 - (v - min) / (max - min || 1)) * (H - PAD.b - 16)
    const path = (d: number[]) => d.map((v, i) => `${i === 0 ? "M" : "L"}${x(i).toFixed(1)},${y(v).toFixed(1)}`).join(" ")
    return { n, price, avg, min, max, x, y, path }
  }, [prices])

  const last = price[n - 1]
  const shown = hover ?? n - 1
  /* the change in the header: the shown day against LOOKBACK days before it (fewer near the start) */
  const from = Math.max(0, shown - LOOKBACK)
  const back = shown - from
  const base = price[from]
  const change = price[shown] - base
  const pct = (change / (base || 1)) * 100
  const up = change >= 0
  const hue = up ? GREEN : RED
  const sign = up ? "+" : "−"
  /* the aria-label keeps the rest reading: the last close against LOOKBACK days back */
  const restBase = price[Math.max(0, n - 1 - LOOKBACK)]
  const restPct = ((last - restBase) / (restBase || 1)) * 100
  const [priceWhole, priceCents] = price[shown].toFixed(2).split(".")

  const onMove = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    const r = svgRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect()
    if (!r) return
    const px = ((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width) * W
    setHover(Math.max(0, Math.min(n - 1, Math.round((px / (W - PAD.r)) * (n - 1)))))
  }

  const fade = reduced ? "none" : "opacity 160ms, stroke 160ms"
  const date = (i: number) => end - (n - 1 - i) * DAY
  const foot = Array.from({ length: FOOT }, (_, k) => Math.round((k / (FOOT - 1)) * (n - 1)))
  const ticks = [0.15, 0.5, 0.85].map((f) => max - f * (max - min))
  const tagY = hover == null ? 0 : Math.max(16, Math.min(H - PAD.b - 8, y(price[hover])))

  return (
    <div ref={rootRef} className={cn("w-[440px] max-w-full tabular-nums", className)}>
      {/* the header, three tiers (spec 14.1): name and symbol, the price, then its change and window */}
      <div className="mb-3 flex items-baseline justify-between text-[12px]">
        <span className="truncate text-foreground/45">{name}</span>
        <span className="shrink-0 pl-3 font-medium text-foreground/90">{symbol}</span>
      </div>
      {/* the readout swaps only when a scrub starts or ends; while scrubbing it follows the pointer in place */}
      <div role="status">
        <LiveFigure intent={hover == null ? null : "scrub"}>
          <p className="m-0 text-[26px] font-semibold leading-none tracking-[-0.02em] text-foreground/90">
            ${Number(priceWhole).toLocaleString("en-US")}
            <span className="text-foreground/35">.{priceCents}</span>
          </p>
          <p className="mb-0 mt-2 flex items-baseline gap-[7px] text-[12px] font-medium" style={{ color: hue }}>
            <span>
              {sign}${Math.abs(change).toFixed(2)} · {sign}
              {Math.abs(pct).toFixed(1)}%
            </span>
            <span className="font-normal text-foreground/45">
              {back === 1 ? "1 day" : `${back} days`}
              {hover != null && ` to ${day(date(hover))}`}
            </span>
          </p>
        </LiveFigure>
      </div>

      {/* the legend (spec 14.3): a line in each average's hue, its name and its value at the shown day */}
      <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1" onPointerLeave={() => setHot(null)}>
        {AVERAGES.map((a) => (
          <button
            key={a.key}
            type="button"
            aria-label={`${a.label} ${avg[a.key][shown].toFixed(2)}`}
            onPointerEnter={() => setHot(a.key)}
            onFocus={() => setHot(a.key)}
            onBlur={() => setHot(null)}
            className={cn(
              "-mx-1 flex cursor-default items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full px-1 text-[11px] text-foreground/60 outline-none transition-opacity duration-200 focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.06] motion-reduce:transition-none",
              hot !== null && hot !== a.key && "opacity-35",
            )}
          >
            <span aria-hidden className="h-[2px] w-2.5 shrink-0 rounded-full" style={{ background: a.hue }} />
            {a.label}
            <span className="inline-block font-medium text-foreground/90">{avg[a.key][shown].toFixed(2)}</span>
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      <svg
        ref={svgRef}
        width={W}
        height={H}
        viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`}
        className="mt-3 block h-auto w-full cursor-crosshair touch-none"
        role="img"
        aria-label={`${name} (${symbol}) price with two moving averages, last $${last.toFixed(2)}, ${restPct >= 0 ? "+" : "−"}${Math.abs(restPct).toFixed(2)}% over ${LOOKBACK} days`}
        onPointerMove={onMove}
        onPointerLeave={() => setHover(null)}
      >
        <defs>
          {/* all three lines sweep in left to right, a few px wider than the plot for the round caps */}
          <clipPath id={`${uid}-reveal`}>
            <motion.rect
              x={-4}
              y={0}
              height={H}
              initial={reduced ? false : { width: 0 }}
              animate={{ width: play ? W - PAD.r + 8 : 0 }}
              transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.9, ease: EASE }}
            />
          </clipPath>
        </defs>

        {/* right-edge price ticks; new data glides each line and its figure, which steps aside under the pointed tag */}
        {ticks.map((v, i) => (
          <g key={i} style={{ opacity: hover != null && Math.abs(y(v) - tagY) < 12 ? 0 : 1, transition: fade }}>
            <motion.line
              x1={0}
              x2={W - PAD.r}
              stroke="var(--foreground)"
              strokeOpacity={0.05}
              strokeWidth={1}
              initial={false}
              animate={{ y1: y(v), y2: y(v) }}
              transition={morph}
            />
            <motion.text
              x={W - PAD.r + 8}
              fontSize={9}
              fill="var(--foreground)"
              fillOpacity={0.45}
              className="tabular-nums"
              initial={false}
              animate={{ attrY: y(v) + 3 }}
              transition={morph}
            >
              {axisUsd(v)}
            </motion.text>
          </g>
        ))}

        {/* averages first, price on top */}
        <g clipPath={`url(#${uid}-reveal)`}>
          {[...AVERAGES].reverse().map((a) => (
            <motion.path
              key={a.key}
              fill="none"
              stroke={a.hue}
              strokeWidth={1.2}
              strokeLinejoin="round"
              style={{ opacity: hot !== null && hot !== a.key ? 0.35 : 1, transition: fade }}
              initial={false}
              animate={{ d: path(avg[a.key]) }}
              transition={morph}
            />
          ))}
          <motion.path
            fill="none"
            stroke={ink(90)}
            strokeWidth={1.8}
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
            style={{ opacity: hot !== null ? 0.35 : 1, transition: fade }}
            initial={false}
            animate={{ d: path(price) }}
            transition={morph}
          />
        </g>

        {/* dates along the foot */}
        {foot.map((i, k) => (
          <text
            key={`${i}-${k}`}
            x={k === 0 ? 0 : k === FOOT - 1 ? W - PAD.r : x(i)}
            y={H - 5}
            textAnchor={k === 0 ? "start" : k === FOOT - 1 ? "end" : "middle"}
            fontSize={9}
            fill="var(--foreground)"
            fillOpacity={0.45}
          >
            {day(date(i))}
          </text>
        ))}

        {/* guide, one dot per line and the pointed close tagged on the axis (chart-overlay.tsx) */}
        {hover != null && (
          <g pointerEvents="none">
            <line x1={x(hover)} y1={8} x2={x(hover)} y2={H - PAD.b} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.16} strokeWidth={1} />
            {AVERAGES.map((a) => (
              <circle key={a.key} cx={x(hover)} cy={y(avg[a.key][hover])} r={2.2} fill={a.hue} />
            ))}
            <circle cx={x(hover)} cy={y(price[hover])} r={2.6} fill="var(--foreground)" />
            <AxisTag x={W - PAD.r + 2} y={tagY} width={PAD.r - 4}>
              {usd(price[hover])}
            </AxisTag>
          </g>
        )}
      </svg>
    </div>
  )
}


// ─── components/ui/chart-overlay.tsx ───

"use client"

import { type ReactNode } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

/* Chart overlay: the two parts every library chart reads a point with (2026-10-02). They
   came out of Candlestick, Volume Profile, the trading terminal and Price Scrubber, which
   had each drawn their own; this is the one copy. Shipped beside the charts that use it.

   AxisTag   the outlined tag on the value axis: the pointed value in its hue, or a named
             reference (POC, last close) in ink. A pill 16px high, 8.5px figures.
   ChartCard the card laid over the chart beside the cursor: a heading row (a time or a
             range) at /60, then label and value rows (labels 10px /60, values 11px /90),
             the one signed figure in its hue. It glides between points on a spring, fades
             in from 0.97 and out in 120ms, and flips to the cursor's left when told to.

   2026-10-02: the card looked out of place over the charts, so it now wears the library
   popover, the same as the sidebar's hover card: a hairline border at 8%, radius 12, the
   6% foreground mix and the popover shadow with no inset highlight (spec 14.6). */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GLIDE = { type: "spring", stiffness: 520, damping: 40 } as const

/** the outlined tag on a chart's value axis, centred on `y` */
export function AxisTag({
  x,
  y,
  width,
  color = "var(--foreground)",
  strong = true,
  hidden = false,
  children,
}: {
  /** the tag's left edge, in the chart's own units */
  x: number
  /** the value's line; the tag is centred on it */
  y: number
  width: number
  /** stroke and figure; ink for a named reference, the series hue for the pointed value */
  color?: string
  /** a quieter tag (a secondary reference) drops the weight and the stroke */
  strong?: boolean
  /** fades the tag out, for when the pointed value sits on it */
  hidden?: boolean
  children: ReactNode
}) {
  return (
    <g transform={`translate(${x}, ${y - 8})`} pointerEvents="none" style={{ opacity: hidden ? 0 : 1, transition: "opacity 150ms" }}>
      <rect width={width} height={16} rx={8} fill="var(--background)" stroke={color} strokeOpacity={strong ? 0.6 : 0.2} />
      <text x={width / 2} y={11} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={8.5} fontWeight={strong ? 600 : 500} fill={color} fillOpacity={strong ? 1 : 0.65}>
        {children}
      </text>
    </g>
  )
}

export interface ChartCardRow {
  label: string
  value: ReactNode
  /** only the one signed figure carries a hue */
  color?: string
}

/** the readout card over a chart; place it inside a `relative` box that holds the svg */
export function ChartCard({
  open,
  x,
  y = 4,
  flip = false,
  width = 148,
  heading,
  rows,
  footer,
}: {
  open: boolean
  /** the cursor's x inside the box: px, or a percentage string for a chart drawn to a viewBox */
  x: number | string
  /** the card's top inside the box, px */
  y?: number
  /** put the card on the cursor's left (past ~60% of the plot) */
  flip?: boolean
  width?: number
  heading: ReactNode
  rows: ChartCardRow[]
  /** a closing line under the rows, such as where the point sits */
  footer?: ReactNode
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {open && (
        <motion.div
          key="chart-card"
          role="status"
          className="pointer-events-none absolute z-10"
          initial={{ left: x, top: y, opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ left: x, top: y, opacity: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, transition: { duration: 0.12 } }}
          transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { left: GLIDE, top: GLIDE, opacity: { duration: 0.15 } }}
        >
          <motion.div
            className="rounded-[12px] border border-foreground/[0.08] px-3 py-2.5"
            style={{
              width,
              translate: flip ? "calc(-100% - 12px) 0" : "12px 0",
              transition: reduced ? undefined : "translate 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)",
              background: "var(--tip-fill, color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 6%, var(--background)))",
              boxShadow: "0 8px 24px var(--card-shadow, rgba(0,0,0,calc(0.35 * var(--shadow-k, 1))))",
            }}
            initial={reduced ? false : { scale: 0.97 }}
            animate={{ scale: 1 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
          >
            <div className="text-[10px] text-foreground/60">{heading}</div>
            <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-col gap-1">
              {rows.map((r) => (
                <div key={r.label} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-foreground/60">{r.label}</span>
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-foreground/90" style={r.color ? { color: r.color } : undefined}>
                    {r.value}
                  </span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            {footer && <div className="mt-1.5 text-[10px]">{footer}</div>}
          </motion.div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  )
}


// ─── components/ui/live-figure.tsx ───

"use client"

import { type ReactNode } from "react"
import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

/* Live figure: a figure fed by a live stream (2026-10-02, out of Tape Flow, where a price
   that re-entered on every print read as a flicker). The value changes in place on each
   tick; the figure swaps (4px, 2px blur, 150ms) only when `intent` changes: the pointer
   takes a point, lets it go, or a toggle flips. Pass the pointed point's id, or null for
   the live value. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const

export function LiveFigure({
  intent,
  className,
  children,
}: {
  /** what the figure is showing: a pointed point's id, or null while it follows the stream */
  intent: string | number | null
  className?: string
  children: ReactNode
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  return (
    <motion.div
      key={intent === null ? "live" : `at-${intent}`}
      className={cn(className)}
      initial={reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: 4, filter: "blur(2px)" }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, filter: "blur(0px)" }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
    >
      {children}
    </motion.div>
  )
}


# Depth Chart desk
// ─── components/ui/depth-chart.tsx ───

"use client"

import { useId, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent, type PointerEvent } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, animate, motion, useInView, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { useWidth } from "@/components/ui/use-width"
import { ChartCard } from "@/components/ui/chart-overlay"
import { SegmentedControl } from "@/components/ui/segmented-control"

/* Depth Chart, written new through ssych-component (2026-09-29).
   What it is for: seeing how much size rests on each side of the mid, and how far the
   price has to travel to walk through a given amount of it.
   Read first: the mid price in the middle of the line above the chart.
   The pointer: scrub across the chart. The distance from the mid is mirrored, so both
   sides answer at once: the run inside that distance stays lit, the rest dims, and a card
   by the pointer reads the size resting down to the bid price and up to the ask price. The
   arrow keys do the same; the switcher sets how far from the mid the chart reaches.
   Sketch used: src/components/lab/DepthChartPro.tsx. Kept: the level shape (price, size),
   levels summed outward from the mid into a staircase that runs flat to the edge, the
   window set as a distance from the mid, and the mirrored readout. Changed: it is drawn in
   SVG, not on a canvas; the zoom is a row of pills, not the wheel; the readout is plain
   text above the chart, not labels floating on it; the feed is left to the caller.
   Reference ("depth chart" on browsable, listings only, no code read): the idea that the
   crosshair reports the size resting up to a price, not the size at it.
   Formulas:
   · mid          (best bid + best ask) ÷ 2
   · window       mid × reach ÷ 100 either side of the mid
   · bid depth    Σ size of bids priced at or above mid − distance
   · ask depth    Σ size of asks priced at or below mid + distance
   · distance     |pointer price − mid|, snapped to the tick, shown as distance ÷ mid × 100
   · at rest      distance is the whole window, so the figures are everything drawn
   · height       depth ÷ (the larger side's depth in the window × 1.15)
   · spread       best ask − best bid
   Motion (2026-10-01): once the chart first comes into view one clip opens both staircases
   outward from the mid, 800ms (it was a 400ms dash draw on mount). A new reach zooms: the
   window and the height scale ease from the old values to the new ones in 380ms (the window
   on a log scale, so the zoom reads even), and every frame between is a true redraw of the
   book at that window, levels entering and leaving at the edges. It writes four path
   attributes per frame, no React state. The size gridlines and the price labels cross-fade.
   Reduced motion draws every state at once.
   2026-10-02 audit: nine readout lines and six figures sat over the plot at rest, all at the
   same 13px, so nothing was read first. The header is now the library's three tiers: the
   symbol at /45 with the reach switcher (the shared SegmentedControl) on the right, the mid
   as the 26px headline, and the spread under it at /45. The window's totals left the rest
   state (they live in the aria-label); scrubbing reads the bid and ask depth in a card by
   the pointer (chart-overlay.tsx), the sides marked by the hued dots on the curves rather
   than green and red words. The size figures moved to the right edge, the dashed mid line
   is named on the price axis ("67,412.5 Mid", the price at /90 and the name at /45), axis
   text went from /35 to /45, the dimmed book rests at 0.45 while a run is read, and the
   width is 460 like the other non price charts. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GREEN = "var(--chart-up)"
const RED = "var(--chart-down)"

export interface DepthLevel {
  price: number
  /** size resting at this price, in the base unit */
  size: number
}

export interface DepthChartProps {
  symbol?: string
  /** the unit sizes are counted in */
  unit?: string
  bids?: DepthLevel[]
  asks?: DepthLevel[]
  /** the smallest price step of the market */
  tick?: number
  /** how far from the mid the chart can reach, in percent; the last is the opening one */
  reaches?: number[]
  /** the plot's height in px (2026-10-06), so it can fill the panel it shares with a price chart */
  height?: number
  priceDp?: number
  sizeDp?: number
  className?: string
}

const TICK = 0.5
/** 67,412.5 counted in half-dollar ticks */
const MID_TICKS = 134825

/** A seeded book: 60 levels a side across about one percent of the price, with a few walls. */
const DEFAULT_BOOK: { bids: DepthLevel[]; asks: DepthLevel[] } = (() => {
  let seed = 13482
  const rnd = () => {
    seed = (seed * 16807) % 2147483647
    return seed / 2147483647
  }
  const side = (dir: 1 | -1) => {
    const out: DepthLevel[] = []
    let t = MID_TICKS + dir
    for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
      const wall = rnd() < 0.08 ? 4.5 : 1
      out.push({ price: t * TICK, size: Math.round((0.2 + rnd() * 2.2) * wall * 1000) / 1000 })
      t += dir * (2 + Math.floor(rnd() * 40))
    }
    return out
  }
  return { bids: side(-1), asks: side(1) }
})()

const DEFAULT_REACHES = [0.25, 0.5, 1]

const W = 460
const H = 200
const PAD = { t: 8, b: 20 }
const FLOOR = H - PAD.b

const num = (n: number, dp: number) => n.toLocaleString("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: dp, maximumFractionDigits: dp })
const clamp = (v: number, lo: number, hi: number) => Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, v))
/** a round step for the size gridlines: 1, 2 or 5 times a power of ten */
const nice = (raw: number) => {
  if (!(raw > 0)) return 1
  const p = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(raw)))
  const f = raw / p
  return (f >= 5 ? 5 : f >= 2 ? 2 : 1) * p
}
/** the reach as the switcher writes it */
const reachLabel = (r: number) => `±${r}%`

type Step = { price: number; depth: number }

/** running depth of one side, from the touch outward */
function steps(levels: DepthLevel[]): Step[] {
  let depth = 0
  return levels.map((l) => {
    depth += l.size
    return { price: l.price, depth }
  })
}

/** Both staircases and their fills for a window `half` either side of the mid, scaled so
 *  `top` is the full height. The rest state is drawn with it, and so is every zoom frame. */
/** w and floor are the box the curves are drawn in (2026-10-06: passed in, so they follow the measured size) */
function drawBook(bids: DepthLevel[], asks: DepthLevel[], mid: number, half: number, top: number, w = W, floor = FLOOR) {
  const lo = mid - half
  const hi = mid + half
  const x = (p: number) => ((p - lo) / (hi - lo)) * w
  const y = (v: number) => PAD.t + (1 - v / top) * (floor - PAD.t)
  const stair = (pts: Step[], edge: number) => {
    if (!pts.length) return ""
    let d = `M ${x(pts[0].price).toFixed(1)} ${y(0).toFixed(1)}`
    let prev = 0
    for (const p of pts) {
      d += ` L ${x(p.price).toFixed(1)} ${y(prev).toFixed(1)} L ${x(p.price).toFixed(1)} ${y(p.depth).toFixed(1)}`
      prev = p.depth
    }
    return `${d} L ${x(edge).toFixed(1)} ${y(prev).toFixed(1)}`
  }
  const bidLine = stair(steps(bids.filter((l) => l.price >= lo)), lo)
  const askLine = stair(steps(asks.filter((l) => l.price <= hi)), hi)
  return {
    bidLine,
    askLine,
    bidArea: bidLine ? `${bidLine} L ${x(lo).toFixed(1)} ${y(0).toFixed(1)} Z` : "",
    askArea: askLine ? `${askLine} L ${x(hi).toFixed(1)} ${y(0).toFixed(1)} Z` : "",
  }
}

/**
 * Two staircases either side of the mid: bids climbing to the left, asks to the right,
 * each step the size resting from the touch out to that price. Scrubbing reads both sides
 * at the same distance from the mid, in the line above the chart.
 */
export function DepthChart({
  symbol = "BTC-USD",
  unit = "BTC",
  bids = DEFAULT_BOOK.bids,
  asks = DEFAULT_BOOK.asks,
  tick = TICK,
  reaches = DEFAULT_REACHES,
  priceDp = 1,
  sizeDp = 2,
  height = 200,
  className,
}: DepthChartProps) {
  // laid out at the width and height it is given (2026-10-06), so the text keeps its size
  const [widthRef, W] = useWidth<HTMLDivElement>(460)
  const H = height
  const FLOOR = H - PAD.b
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const uid = useId().replace(/:/g, "")
  const boxRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const [reach, setReach] = useState(reaches[reaches.length - 1] ?? 1)
  /** distance from the mid being pointed at, in price; null at rest */
  const [dist, setDist] = useState<number | null>(null)
  /** which side of the mid the pointer is on, so the card rides that crosshair */
  const [side, setSide] = useState<1 | -1>(1)

  const book = useMemo(() => {
    const b = [...bids].sort((x, y) => y.price - x.price)
    const a = [...asks].sort((x, y) => x.price - y.price)
    const mid = ((b[0]?.price ?? 0) + (a[0]?.price ?? 0)) / 2
    const half = Math.max(tick, (mid * reach) / 100)
    const lo = mid - half
    const hi = mid + half
    const bidSteps = steps(b.filter((l) => l.price >= lo))
    const askSteps = steps(a.filter((l) => l.price <= hi))
    const top = Math.max(bidSteps[bidSteps.length - 1]?.depth ?? 0, askSteps[askSteps.length - 1]?.depth ?? 0, 1e-9) * 1.15
    return { b, a, mid, half, lo, hi, bidSteps, askSteps, top }
  }, [bids, asks, reach, tick])
  const { b: sortedBids, a: sortedAsks, mid, half, lo, hi, bidSteps, askSteps, top } = book

  const x = (p: number) => ((p - lo) / (hi - lo)) * W
  const y = (v: number) => PAD.t + (1 - v / top) * (FLOOR - PAD.t)

  const { bidLine, askLine, bidArea, askArea } = useMemo(() => drawBook(sortedBids, sortedAsks, mid, half, top, W, FLOOR), [sortedBids, sortedAsks, mid, half, top, W, FLOOR])

  /* the entrance waits until the chart is on screen */
  const seen = useInView(boxRef, { once: true, amount: 0.3 })
  const shown = seen || !!reduced

  /* the zoom: the four live paths are redrawn at every window between the old reach and the
     new one. React renders the end state; this effect paints over it before the browser does,
     and lands on the same strings */
  const bidLineRef = useRef<SVGPathElement>(null)
  const askLineRef = useRef<SVGPathElement>(null)
  const bidAreaRef = useRef<SVGPathElement>(null)
  const askAreaRef = useRef<SVGPathElement>(null)
  const drawn = useRef({ half, top })
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const paint = (h: number, t: number) => {
      const g = drawBook(sortedBids, sortedAsks, mid, h, t, W, FLOOR)
      bidLineRef.current?.setAttribute("d", g.bidLine)
      askLineRef.current?.setAttribute("d", g.askLine)
      bidAreaRef.current?.setAttribute("d", g.bidArea)
      askAreaRef.current?.setAttribute("d", g.askArea)
      drawn.current = { half: h, top: t }
    }
    const from = drawn.current
    if (reduced || (from.half === half && from.top === top) || !(from.half > 0)) {
      paint(half, top)
      return
    }
    paint(from.half, from.top)
    const run = animate(0, 1, {
      duration: 0.38,
      ease: EASE,
      onUpdate: (k) => paint(from.half * Math.pow(half / from.half, k), from.top + (top - from.top) * k),
      onComplete: () => paint(half, top),
    })
    return () => run.stop()
  }, [sortedBids, sortedAsks, mid, half, top, reduced, W, FLOOR])

  /* the reading: at rest the distance is the whole window */
  const d = dist ?? half
  const bidPrice = mid - d
  const askPrice = mid + d
  const bidDepth = bidSteps.reduce((s, p) => (p.price >= bidPrice ? p.depth : s), 0)
  const askDepth = askSteps.reduce((s, p) => (p.price <= askPrice ? p.depth : s), 0)
  const pct = mid > 0 ? (d / mid) * 100 : 0
  const spread = (sortedAsks[0]?.price ?? 0) - (sortedBids[0]?.price ?? 0)
  const [midWhole, midDecimals] = (() => {
    const t = num(mid, priceDp)
    const at = t.indexOf(".")
    return at < 0 ? [t, ""] : [t.slice(0, at), t.slice(at)]
  })()
  /* the card rides the crosshair on the pointer's side and turns past 60% of the plot */
  const cardAt = side < 0 ? x(bidPrice) : x(askPrice)

  const snap = (v: number) => clamp(Math.round(v / tick) * tick, 0, half)
  const onMove = (e: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const el = boxRef.current
    if (!el) return
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect()
    const price = lo + clamp((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width, 0, 1) * (hi - lo)
    setSide(price < mid ? -1 : 1)
    setDist(snap(Math.abs(price - mid)))
  }
  const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (e.key === "Escape") return setDist(null)
    const dir = e.key === "ArrowRight" || e.key === "ArrowUp" ? 1 : e.key === "ArrowLeft" || e.key === "ArrowDown" ? -1 : 0
    if (!dir) return
    e.preventDefault()
    setDist((v) => snap((v ?? half / 2) + dir * (half / 40)))
  }

  const crossFade = {
    initial: { opacity: 0 },
    animate: { opacity: 1 },
    exit: { opacity: 0 },
    transition: reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.25, ease: EASE },
  }
  const gridStep = nice(top / 3.2)
  const grid = [1, 2, 3].map((k) => k * gridStep).filter((v) => v < top)
  const axis = [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1].map((k) => lo + k * (hi - lo))

  const curves = (live: boolean) => (
    <>
      {bidArea && <path ref={live ? bidAreaRef : undefined} d={bidArea} fill={`url(#${uid}-bid)`} />}
      {askArea && <path ref={live ? askAreaRef : undefined} d={askArea} fill={`url(#${uid}-ask)`} />}
      {bidLine && <path ref={live ? bidLineRef : undefined} d={bidLine} fill="none" stroke={GREEN} strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeLinecap="round" />}
      {askLine && <path ref={live ? askLineRef : undefined} d={askLine} fill="none" stroke={RED} strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeLinecap="round" />}
    </>
  )

  return (
    <div ref={widthRef} role="group" aria-label={`${symbol} depth`} className={cn("w-[460px] max-w-full tabular-nums", className)}>
      {/* the header, three tiers (spec 14.1): the symbol and the reach, the mid, the spread */}
      <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between text-[12px]">
        <span className="truncate text-foreground/45">{symbol}</span>
        <SegmentedControl
          label="Reach from the mid"
          options={reaches.map(reachLabel)}
          value={reachLabel(reach)}
          onChange={(v) => {
            const next = reaches.find((r) => reachLabel(r) === v)
            if (next === undefined) return
            setReach(next)
            setDist(null)
          }}
        />
      </div>
      <p className="m-0 text-[26px] font-semibold leading-none tracking-[-0.02em] text-foreground/90">
        {midWhole}
        <span className="text-foreground/35">{midDecimals}</span>
      </p>
      <p className="mb-0 mt-2 text-[12px] text-foreground/45">Spread {num(spread, priceDp)}</p>

      <div
        ref={boxRef}
        role="slider"
        tabIndex={0}
        aria-label="Distance from the mid price"
        aria-valuemin={0}
        aria-valuemax={Number(reach.toFixed(2))}
        aria-valuenow={Number(pct.toFixed(2))}
        aria-valuetext={`${pct.toFixed(2)}% from the mid: ${num(bidDepth, sizeDp)} ${unit} of bids, ${num(askDepth, sizeDp)} ${unit} of asks`}
        className="relative mt-4 cursor-crosshair touch-none outline-none"
        onPointerMove={onMove}
        onPointerDown={onMove}
        onPointerLeave={() => setDist(null)}
        onBlur={() => setDist(null)}
        onKeyDown={onKey}
      >
        <svg
          viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`}
          className="block w-full overflow-visible"
          role="img"
          aria-label={`${symbol} depth within ${reach}% of the mid ${num(mid, priceDp)}: ${num(bidSteps[bidSteps.length - 1]?.depth ?? 0, sizeDp)} ${unit} of bids, ${num(askSteps[askSteps.length - 1]?.depth ?? 0, sizeDp)} ${unit} of asks`}
        >
          <defs>
            <linearGradient id={`${uid}-bid`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
              <stop offset="0%" stopColor={GREEN} stopOpacity="0.3" />
              <stop offset="100%" stopColor={GREEN} stopOpacity="0.03" />
            </linearGradient>
            <linearGradient id={`${uid}-ask`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
              <stop offset="0%" stopColor={RED} stopOpacity="0.3" />
              <stop offset="100%" stopColor={RED} stopOpacity="0.03" />
            </linearGradient>
            {/* the entrance: one clip opens from the mid outward, once */}
            <clipPath id={`${uid}-wipe`}>
              <motion.rect
                y={-4}
                height={H + 8}
                initial={reduced ? { attrX: -4, width: W + 8 } : { attrX: W / 2, width: 0 }}
                animate={shown ? { attrX: -4, width: W + 8 } : { attrX: W / 2, width: 0 }}
                transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.8, ease: EASE }}
              />
            </clipPath>
            <clipPath id={`${uid}-run`}>
              <rect x={x(bidPrice)} y={0} width={Math.max(0, x(askPrice) - x(bidPrice))} height={FLOOR} />
            </clipPath>
          </defs>

          {/* a new reach cross-fades the size gridlines */}
          <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
            <motion.g key={`g${reach}`} {...crossFade}>
              {grid.map((v) => (
                <g key={v}>
                  <line x1={0} x2={W} y1={y(v)} y2={y(v)} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.05} strokeWidth="1" />
                  <text x={W} y={y(v) - 3} textAnchor="end" fontSize={9} fill="var(--foreground)" fillOpacity={0.45}>
                    {num(v, v < 10 && gridStep < 1 ? 1 : 0)}
                  </text>
                </g>
              ))}
            </motion.g>
          </AnimatePresence>
          <line x1={0} x2={W} y1={FLOOR} y2={FLOOR} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.05} strokeWidth="1" />
          <line x1={W / 2} x2={W / 2} y1={PAD.t} y2={FLOOR} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.16} strokeWidth="1" strokeDasharray="2 4" />

          {/* the whole book, dimmed while a run is being read */}
          <g clipPath={`url(#${uid}-wipe)`}>
            <g style={{ opacity: dist === null ? 1 : 0.45, transition: reduced ? "none" : "opacity 160ms" }}>{curves(true)}</g>
          </g>
          {/* the run inside the distance, at full strength */}
          {dist !== null && (
            <g clipPath={`url(#${uid}-run)`} pointerEvents="none">
              {curves(false)}
            </g>
          )}

          {dist !== null && (
            <g pointerEvents="none">
              <line x1={x(bidPrice)} x2={x(bidPrice)} y1={PAD.t} y2={FLOOR} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.28} strokeWidth="1" />
              <line x1={x(askPrice)} x2={x(askPrice)} y1={PAD.t} y2={FLOOR} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.28} strokeWidth="1" />
              <circle cx={x(bidPrice)} cy={y(bidDepth)} r="2.8" fill={GREEN} stroke="var(--background)" strokeWidth="1.5" />
              <circle cx={x(askPrice)} cy={y(askDepth)} r="2.8" fill={RED} stroke="var(--background)" strokeWidth="1.5" />
            </g>
          )}

          {/* and the price labels */}
          <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
            <motion.g key={`a${reach}`} {...crossFade}>
              {axis.map((p, i) => (
                <text
                  key={i}
                  x={i === 0 ? 0 : i === axis.length - 1 ? W : x(p)}
                  y={H - 5}
                  fontSize={9}
                  textAnchor={i === 0 ? "start" : i === axis.length - 1 ? "end" : "middle"}
                  fill="var(--foreground)"
                >
                  {/* the middle figure is the mid, named under its dashed line (spec 14.7) */}
                  {i === 2 ? (
                    <>
                      <tspan fontWeight={500} fillOpacity={0.9}>
                        {num(mid, priceDp)}
                      </tspan>
                      <tspan fillOpacity={0.45}> Mid</tspan>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <tspan fillOpacity={0.45}>{num(p, priceDp)}</tspan>
                  )}
                </text>
              ))}
            </motion.g>
          </AnimatePresence>
        </svg>

        {/* the run being read, in a card by the pointer (chart-overlay.tsx); the hued dots on
            the curves say which row is which side */}
        <ChartCard
          open={dist !== null}
          x={`${(cardAt / W) * 100}%`}
          flip={cardAt / W > 0.6}
          width={184}
          heading={`±${pct.toFixed(2)}% from the mid`}
          rows={[
            { label: `Bids to ${num(bidPrice, priceDp)}`, value: `${num(bidDepth, sizeDp)} ${unit}` },
            { label: `Asks to ${num(askPrice, priceDp)}`, value: `${num(askDepth, sizeDp)} ${unit}` },
          ]}
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}


// ─── components/ui/use-width.ts ───

"use client";

// The width a chart is given (2026-10-06, the Tradeboard case study). The charts used to lay
// out in a fixed box and stretch as a picture in a wider column, so their text grew with it;
// measured, they lay out at the real width and the text keeps its size. A chart left at its
// default class measures its own default width, so nothing changes where it is not stretched.
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

export function useWidth<T extends HTMLElement>(fallback: number, min = 280) {
  const ref = useRef<T>(null);
  const [w, setW] = useState(fallback);
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(([e]) => setW(Math.max(min, Math.round(e.contentRect.width)) || fallback));
    ro.observe(el);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, [fallback, min]);
