  return [ref, w] as const;
}


// ─── components/ui/chart-overlay.tsx ───

"use client"

import { type ReactNode } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

/* Chart overlay: the two parts every library chart reads a point with (2026-10-02). They
   came out of Candlestick, Volume Profile, the trading terminal and Price Scrubber, which
   had each drawn their own; this is the one copy. Shipped beside the charts that use it.

   AxisTag   the outlined tag on the value axis: the pointed value in its hue, or a named
             reference (POC, last close) in ink. A pill 16px high, 8.5px figures.
   ChartCard the card laid over the chart beside the cursor: a heading row (a time or a
             range) at /60, then label and value rows (labels 10px /60, values 11px /90),
             the one signed figure in its hue. It glides between points on a spring, fades
             in from 0.97 and out in 120ms, and flips to the cursor's left when told to.

   2026-10-02: the card looked out of place over the charts, so it now wears the library
   popover, the same as the sidebar's hover card: a hairline border at 8%, radius 12, the
   6% foreground mix and the popover shadow with no inset highlight (spec 14.6). */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GLIDE = { type: "spring", stiffness: 520, damping: 40 } as const

/** the outlined tag on a chart's value axis, centred on `y` */
export function AxisTag({
  x,
  y,
  width,
  color = "var(--foreground)",
  strong = true,
  hidden = false,
  children,
}: {
  /** the tag's left edge, in the chart's own units */
  x: number
  /** the value's line; the tag is centred on it */
  y: number
  width: number
  /** stroke and figure; ink for a named reference, the series hue for the pointed value */
  color?: string
  /** a quieter tag (a secondary reference) drops the weight and the stroke */
  strong?: boolean
  /** fades the tag out, for when the pointed value sits on it */
  hidden?: boolean
  children: ReactNode
}) {
  return (
    <g transform={`translate(${x}, ${y - 8})`} pointerEvents="none" style={{ opacity: hidden ? 0 : 1, transition: "opacity 150ms" }}>
      <rect width={width} height={16} rx={8} fill="var(--background)" stroke={color} strokeOpacity={strong ? 0.6 : 0.2} />
      <text x={width / 2} y={11} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={8.5} fontWeight={strong ? 600 : 500} fill={color} fillOpacity={strong ? 1 : 0.65}>
        {children}
      </text>
    </g>
  )
}

export interface ChartCardRow {
  label: string
  value: ReactNode
  /** only the one signed figure carries a hue */
  color?: string
}

/** the readout card over a chart; place it inside a `relative` box that holds the svg */
export function ChartCard({
  open,
  x,
  y = 4,
  flip = false,
  width = 148,
  heading,
  rows,
  footer,
}: {
  open: boolean
  /** the cursor's x inside the box: px, or a percentage string for a chart drawn to a viewBox */
  x: number | string
  /** the card's top inside the box, px */
  y?: number
  /** put the card on the cursor's left (past ~60% of the plot) */
  flip?: boolean
  width?: number
  heading: ReactNode
  rows: ChartCardRow[]
  /** a closing line under the rows, such as where the point sits */
  footer?: ReactNode
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {open && (
        <motion.div
          key="chart-card"
          role="status"
          className="pointer-events-none absolute z-10"
          initial={{ left: x, top: y, opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ left: x, top: y, opacity: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, transition: { duration: 0.12 } }}
          transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { left: GLIDE, top: GLIDE, opacity: { duration: 0.15 } }}
        >
          <motion.div
            className="rounded-[12px] border border-foreground/[0.08] px-3 py-2.5"
            style={{
              width,
              translate: flip ? "calc(-100% - 12px) 0" : "12px 0",
              transition: reduced ? undefined : "translate 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)",
              background: "var(--tip-fill, color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 6%, var(--background)))",
              boxShadow: "0 8px 24px var(--card-shadow, rgba(0,0,0,calc(0.35 * var(--shadow-k, 1))))",
            }}
            initial={reduced ? false : { scale: 0.97 }}
            animate={{ scale: 1 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
          >
            <div className="text-[10px] text-foreground/60">{heading}</div>
            <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-col gap-1">
              {rows.map((r) => (
                <div key={r.label} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-foreground/60">{r.label}</span>
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-foreground/90" style={r.color ? { color: r.color } : undefined}>
                    {r.value}
                  </span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            {footer && <div className="mt-1.5 text-[10px]">{footer}</div>}
          </motion.div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  )
}

# Depth Chart mobile
// ─── components/ui/depth-chart.tsx ───

"use client"

import { useId, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent, type PointerEvent } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, animate, motion, useInView, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { useWidth } from "@/components/ui/use-width"
import { ChartCard } from "@/components/ui/chart-overlay"
import { SegmentedControl } from "@/components/ui/segmented-control"

/* Depth Chart, written new through ssych-component (2026-09-29).
   What it is for: seeing how much size rests on each side of the mid, and how far the
   price has to travel to walk through a given amount of it.
   Read first: the mid price in the middle of the line above the chart.
   The pointer: scrub across the chart. The distance from the mid is mirrored, so both
   sides answer at once: the run inside that distance stays lit, the rest dims, and a card
   by the pointer reads the size resting down to the bid price and up to the ask price. The
   arrow keys do the same; the switcher sets how far from the mid the chart reaches.
   Sketch used: src/components/lab/DepthChartPro.tsx. Kept: the level shape (price, size),
   levels summed outward from the mid into a staircase that runs flat to the edge, the
   window set as a distance from the mid, and the mirrored readout. Changed: it is drawn in
   SVG, not on a canvas; the zoom is a row of pills, not the wheel; the readout is plain
   text above the chart, not labels floating on it; the feed is left to the caller.
   Reference ("depth chart" on browsable, listings only, no code read): the idea that the
   crosshair reports the size resting up to a price, not the size at it.
   Formulas:
   · mid          (best bid + best ask) ÷ 2
   · window       mid × reach ÷ 100 either side of the mid
   · bid depth    Σ size of bids priced at or above mid − distance
   · ask depth    Σ size of asks priced at or below mid + distance
   · distance     |pointer price − mid|, snapped to the tick, shown as distance ÷ mid × 100
   · at rest      distance is the whole window, so the figures are everything drawn
   · height       depth ÷ (the larger side's depth in the window × 1.15)
   · spread       best ask − best bid
   Motion (2026-10-01): once the chart first comes into view one clip opens both staircases
   outward from the mid, 800ms (it was a 400ms dash draw on mount). A new reach zooms: the
   window and the height scale ease from the old values to the new ones in 380ms (the window
   on a log scale, so the zoom reads even), and every frame between is a true redraw of the
   book at that window, levels entering and leaving at the edges. It writes four path
   attributes per frame, no React state. The size gridlines and the price labels cross-fade.
   Reduced motion draws every state at once.
   2026-10-02 audit: nine readout lines and six figures sat over the plot at rest, all at the
   same 13px, so nothing was read first. The header is now the library's three tiers: the
   symbol at /45 with the reach switcher (the shared SegmentedControl) on the right, the mid
   as the 26px headline, and the spread under it at /45. The window's totals left the rest
   state (they live in the aria-label); scrubbing reads the bid and ask depth in a card by
   the pointer (chart-overlay.tsx), the sides marked by the hued dots on the curves rather
   than green and red words. The size figures moved to the right edge, the dashed mid line
   is named on the price axis ("67,412.5 Mid", the price at /90 and the name at /45), axis
   text went from /35 to /45, the dimmed book rests at 0.45 while a run is read, and the
   width is 460 like the other non price charts. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GREEN = "var(--chart-up)"
const RED = "var(--chart-down)"

export interface DepthLevel {
  price: number
  /** size resting at this price, in the base unit */
  size: number
}

export interface DepthChartProps {
  symbol?: string
  /** the unit sizes are counted in */
  unit?: string
  bids?: DepthLevel[]
  asks?: DepthLevel[]
  /** the smallest price step of the market */
  tick?: number
  /** how far from the mid the chart can reach, in percent; the last is the opening one */
  reaches?: number[]
  /** the plot's height in px (2026-10-06), so it can fill the panel it shares with a price chart */
  height?: number
  priceDp?: number
  sizeDp?: number
  className?: string
}

const TICK = 0.5
/** 67,412.5 counted in half-dollar ticks */
const MID_TICKS = 134825

/** A seeded book: 60 levels a side across about one percent of the price, with a few walls. */
const DEFAULT_BOOK: { bids: DepthLevel[]; asks: DepthLevel[] } = (() => {
  let seed = 13482
  const rnd = () => {
    seed = (seed * 16807) % 2147483647
    return seed / 2147483647
  }
  const side = (dir: 1 | -1) => {
    const out: DepthLevel[] = []
    let t = MID_TICKS + dir
    for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
      const wall = rnd() < 0.08 ? 4.5 : 1
      out.push({ price: t * TICK, size: Math.round((0.2 + rnd() * 2.2) * wall * 1000) / 1000 })
      t += dir * (2 + Math.floor(rnd() * 40))
    }
    return out
  }
  return { bids: side(-1), asks: side(1) }
})()

const DEFAULT_REACHES = [0.25, 0.5, 1]

const W = 460
const H = 200
const PAD = { t: 8, b: 20 }
const FLOOR = H - PAD.b

const num = (n: number, dp: number) => n.toLocaleString("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: dp, maximumFractionDigits: dp })
const clamp = (v: number, lo: number, hi: number) => Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, v))
/** a round step for the size gridlines: 1, 2 or 5 times a power of ten */
const nice = (raw: number) => {
  if (!(raw > 0)) return 1
  const p = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(raw)))
  const f = raw / p
  return (f >= 5 ? 5 : f >= 2 ? 2 : 1) * p
}
/** the reach as the switcher writes it */
const reachLabel = (r: number) => `±${r}%`

type Step = { price: number; depth: number }

/** running depth of one side, from the touch outward */
function steps(levels: DepthLevel[]): Step[] {
  let depth = 0
  return levels.map((l) => {
    depth += l.size
    return { price: l.price, depth }
  })
}

/** Both staircases and their fills for a window `half` either side of the mid, scaled so
 *  `top` is the full height. The rest state is drawn with it, and so is every zoom frame. */
/** w and floor are the box the curves are drawn in (2026-10-06: passed in, so they follow the measured size) */
function drawBook(bids: DepthLevel[], asks: DepthLevel[], mid: number, half: number, top: number, w = W, floor = FLOOR) {
  const lo = mid - half
  const hi = mid + half
  const x = (p: number) => ((p - lo) / (hi - lo)) * w
  const y = (v: number) => PAD.t + (1 - v / top) * (floor - PAD.t)
  const stair = (pts: Step[], edge: number) => {
    if (!pts.length) return ""
    let d = `M ${x(pts[0].price).toFixed(1)} ${y(0).toFixed(1)}`
    let prev = 0
    for (const p of pts) {
      d += ` L ${x(p.price).toFixed(1)} ${y(prev).toFixed(1)} L ${x(p.price).toFixed(1)} ${y(p.depth).toFixed(1)}`
      prev = p.depth
    }
    return `${d} L ${x(edge).toFixed(1)} ${y(prev).toFixed(1)}`
  }
  const bidLine = stair(steps(bids.filter((l) => l.price >= lo)), lo)
  const askLine = stair(steps(asks.filter((l) => l.price <= hi)), hi)
  return {
    bidLine,
    askLine,
    bidArea: bidLine ? `${bidLine} L ${x(lo).toFixed(1)} ${y(0).toFixed(1)} Z` : "",
    askArea: askLine ? `${askLine} L ${x(hi).toFixed(1)} ${y(0).toFixed(1)} Z` : "",
  }
}

/**
 * Two staircases either side of the mid: bids climbing to the left, asks to the right,
 * each step the size resting from the touch out to that price. Scrubbing reads both sides
 * at the same distance from the mid, in the line above the chart.
 */
export function DepthChart({
  symbol = "BTC-USD",
  unit = "BTC",
  bids = DEFAULT_BOOK.bids,
  asks = DEFAULT_BOOK.asks,
  tick = TICK,
  reaches = DEFAULT_REACHES,
  priceDp = 1,
  sizeDp = 2,
  height = 200,
  className,
}: DepthChartProps) {
  // laid out at the width and height it is given (2026-10-06), so the text keeps its size
  const [widthRef, W] = useWidth<HTMLDivElement>(460)
  const H = height
  const FLOOR = H - PAD.b
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const uid = useId().replace(/:/g, "")
  const boxRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const [reach, setReach] = useState(reaches[reaches.length - 1] ?? 1)
  /** distance from the mid being pointed at, in price; null at rest */
  const [dist, setDist] = useState<number | null>(null)
  /** which side of the mid the pointer is on, so the card rides that crosshair */
  const [side, setSide] = useState<1 | -1>(1)

  const book = useMemo(() => {
    const b = [...bids].sort((x, y) => y.price - x.price)
    const a = [...asks].sort((x, y) => x.price - y.price)
    const mid = ((b[0]?.price ?? 0) + (a[0]?.price ?? 0)) / 2
    const half = Math.max(tick, (mid * reach) / 100)
    const lo = mid - half
    const hi = mid + half
    const bidSteps = steps(b.filter((l) => l.price >= lo))
    const askSteps = steps(a.filter((l) => l.price <= hi))
    const top = Math.max(bidSteps[bidSteps.length - 1]?.depth ?? 0, askSteps[askSteps.length - 1]?.depth ?? 0, 1e-9) * 1.15
    return { b, a, mid, half, lo, hi, bidSteps, askSteps, top }
  }, [bids, asks, reach, tick])
  const { b: sortedBids, a: sortedAsks, mid, half, lo, hi, bidSteps, askSteps, top } = book

  const x = (p: number) => ((p - lo) / (hi - lo)) * W
  const y = (v: number) => PAD.t + (1 - v / top) * (FLOOR - PAD.t)

  const { bidLine, askLine, bidArea, askArea } = useMemo(() => drawBook(sortedBids, sortedAsks, mid, half, top, W, FLOOR), [sortedBids, sortedAsks, mid, half, top, W, FLOOR])

  /* the entrance waits until the chart is on screen */
  const seen = useInView(boxRef, { once: true, amount: 0.3 })
  const shown = seen || !!reduced

  /* the zoom: the four live paths are redrawn at every window between the old reach and the
     new one. React renders the end state; this effect paints over it before the browser does,
     and lands on the same strings */
  const bidLineRef = useRef<SVGPathElement>(null)
  const askLineRef = useRef<SVGPathElement>(null)
  const bidAreaRef = useRef<SVGPathElement>(null)
  const askAreaRef = useRef<SVGPathElement>(null)
  const drawn = useRef({ half, top })
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const paint = (h: number, t: number) => {
      const g = drawBook(sortedBids, sortedAsks, mid, h, t, W, FLOOR)
      bidLineRef.current?.setAttribute("d", g.bidLine)
      askLineRef.current?.setAttribute("d", g.askLine)
      bidAreaRef.current?.setAttribute("d", g.bidArea)
      askAreaRef.current?.setAttribute("d", g.askArea)
      drawn.current = { half: h, top: t }
    }
    const from = drawn.current
    if (reduced || (from.half === half && from.top === top) || !(from.half > 0)) {
      paint(half, top)
      return
    }
    paint(from.half, from.top)
    const run = animate(0, 1, {
      duration: 0.38,
      ease: EASE,
      onUpdate: (k) => paint(from.half * Math.pow(half / from.half, k), from.top + (top - from.top) * k),
      onComplete: () => paint(half, top),
    })
    return () => run.stop()
  }, [sortedBids, sortedAsks, mid, half, top, reduced, W, FLOOR])

  /* the reading: at rest the distance is the whole window */
  const d = dist ?? half
  const bidPrice = mid - d
  const askPrice = mid + d
  const bidDepth = bidSteps.reduce((s, p) => (p.price >= bidPrice ? p.depth : s), 0)
  const askDepth = askSteps.reduce((s, p) => (p.price <= askPrice ? p.depth : s), 0)
  const pct = mid > 0 ? (d / mid) * 100 : 0
  const spread = (sortedAsks[0]?.price ?? 0) - (sortedBids[0]?.price ?? 0)
  const [midWhole, midDecimals] = (() => {
    const t = num(mid, priceDp)
    const at = t.indexOf(".")
    return at < 0 ? [t, ""] : [t.slice(0, at), t.slice(at)]
  })()
  /* the card rides the crosshair on the pointer's side and turns past 60% of the plot */
  const cardAt = side < 0 ? x(bidPrice) : x(askPrice)

  const snap = (v: number) => clamp(Math.round(v / tick) * tick, 0, half)
  const onMove = (e: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const el = boxRef.current
    if (!el) return
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect()
    const price = lo + clamp((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width, 0, 1) * (hi - lo)
    setSide(price < mid ? -1 : 1)
    setDist(snap(Math.abs(price - mid)))
  }
  const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (e.key === "Escape") return setDist(null)
    const dir = e.key === "ArrowRight" || e.key === "ArrowUp" ? 1 : e.key === "ArrowLeft" || e.key === "ArrowDown" ? -1 : 0
    if (!dir) return
    e.preventDefault()
    setDist((v) => snap((v ?? half / 2) + dir * (half / 40)))
  }

  const crossFade = {
    initial: { opacity: 0 },
    animate: { opacity: 1 },
    exit: { opacity: 0 },
    transition: reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.25, ease: EASE },
  }
  const gridStep = nice(top / 3.2)
  const grid = [1, 2, 3].map((k) => k * gridStep).filter((v) => v < top)
  const axis = [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1].map((k) => lo + k * (hi - lo))

  const curves = (live: boolean) => (
    <>
      {bidArea && <path ref={live ? bidAreaRef : undefined} d={bidArea} fill={`url(#${uid}-bid)`} />}
      {askArea && <path ref={live ? askAreaRef : undefined} d={askArea} fill={`url(#${uid}-ask)`} />}
      {bidLine && <path ref={live ? bidLineRef : undefined} d={bidLine} fill="none" stroke={GREEN} strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeLinecap="round" />}
      {askLine && <path ref={live ? askLineRef : undefined} d={askLine} fill="none" stroke={RED} strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeLinecap="round" />}
    </>
  )

  return (
    <div ref={widthRef} role="group" aria-label={`${symbol} depth`} className={cn("w-[460px] max-w-full tabular-nums", className)}>
      {/* the header, three tiers (spec 14.1): the symbol and the reach, the mid, the spread */}
      <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between text-[12px]">
        <span className="truncate text-foreground/45">{symbol}</span>
        <SegmentedControl
          label="Reach from the mid"
          options={reaches.map(reachLabel)}
          value={reachLabel(reach)}
          onChange={(v) => {
            const next = reaches.find((r) => reachLabel(r) === v)
            if (next === undefined) return
            setReach(next)
            setDist(null)
          }}
        />
      </div>
      <p className="m-0 text-[26px] font-semibold leading-none tracking-[-0.02em] text-foreground/90">
        {midWhole}
        <span className="text-foreground/35">{midDecimals}</span>
      </p>
      <p className="mb-0 mt-2 text-[12px] text-foreground/45">Spread {num(spread, priceDp)}</p>

      <div
        ref={boxRef}
        role="slider"
        tabIndex={0}
        aria-label="Distance from the mid price"
        aria-valuemin={0}
        aria-valuemax={Number(reach.toFixed(2))}
        aria-valuenow={Number(pct.toFixed(2))}
        aria-valuetext={`${pct.toFixed(2)}% from the mid: ${num(bidDepth, sizeDp)} ${unit} of bids, ${num(askDepth, sizeDp)} ${unit} of asks`}
        className="relative mt-4 cursor-crosshair touch-none outline-none"
        onPointerMove={onMove}
        onPointerDown={onMove}
        onPointerLeave={() => setDist(null)}
        onBlur={() => setDist(null)}
        onKeyDown={onKey}
      >
        <svg
          viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`}
          className="block w-full overflow-visible"
          role="img"
          aria-label={`${symbol} depth within ${reach}% of the mid ${num(mid, priceDp)}: ${num(bidSteps[bidSteps.length - 1]?.depth ?? 0, sizeDp)} ${unit} of bids, ${num(askSteps[askSteps.length - 1]?.depth ?? 0, sizeDp)} ${unit} of asks`}
        >
          <defs>
            <linearGradient id={`${uid}-bid`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
              <stop offset="0%" stopColor={GREEN} stopOpacity="0.3" />
              <stop offset="100%" stopColor={GREEN} stopOpacity="0.03" />
            </linearGradient>
            <linearGradient id={`${uid}-ask`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
              <stop offset="0%" stopColor={RED} stopOpacity="0.3" />
              <stop offset="100%" stopColor={RED} stopOpacity="0.03" />
            </linearGradient>
            {/* the entrance: one clip opens from the mid outward, once */}
            <clipPath id={`${uid}-wipe`}>
              <motion.rect
                y={-4}
                height={H + 8}
                initial={reduced ? { attrX: -4, width: W + 8 } : { attrX: W / 2, width: 0 }}
                animate={shown ? { attrX: -4, width: W + 8 } : { attrX: W / 2, width: 0 }}
                transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.8, ease: EASE }}
              />
            </clipPath>
            <clipPath id={`${uid}-run`}>
              <rect x={x(bidPrice)} y={0} width={Math.max(0, x(askPrice) - x(bidPrice))} height={FLOOR} />
            </clipPath>
          </defs>

          {/* a new reach cross-fades the size gridlines */}
          <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
            <motion.g key={`g${reach}`} {...crossFade}>
              {grid.map((v) => (
                <g key={v}>
                  <line x1={0} x2={W} y1={y(v)} y2={y(v)} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.05} strokeWidth="1" />
                  <text x={W} y={y(v) - 3} textAnchor="end" fontSize={9} fill="var(--foreground)" fillOpacity={0.45}>
                    {num(v, v < 10 && gridStep < 1 ? 1 : 0)}
                  </text>
                </g>
              ))}
            </motion.g>
          </AnimatePresence>
          <line x1={0} x2={W} y1={FLOOR} y2={FLOOR} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.05} strokeWidth="1" />
          <line x1={W / 2} x2={W / 2} y1={PAD.t} y2={FLOOR} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.16} strokeWidth="1" strokeDasharray="2 4" />

          {/* the whole book, dimmed while a run is being read */}
          <g clipPath={`url(#${uid}-wipe)`}>
            <g style={{ opacity: dist === null ? 1 : 0.45, transition: reduced ? "none" : "opacity 160ms" }}>{curves(true)}</g>
          </g>
          {/* the run inside the distance, at full strength */}
          {dist !== null && (
            <g clipPath={`url(#${uid}-run)`} pointerEvents="none">
              {curves(false)}
            </g>
          )}

          {dist !== null && (
            <g pointerEvents="none">
              <line x1={x(bidPrice)} x2={x(bidPrice)} y1={PAD.t} y2={FLOOR} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.28} strokeWidth="1" />
              <line x1={x(askPrice)} x2={x(askPrice)} y1={PAD.t} y2={FLOOR} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.28} strokeWidth="1" />
              <circle cx={x(bidPrice)} cy={y(bidDepth)} r="2.8" fill={GREEN} stroke="var(--background)" strokeWidth="1.5" />
              <circle cx={x(askPrice)} cy={y(askDepth)} r="2.8" fill={RED} stroke="var(--background)" strokeWidth="1.5" />
            </g>
          )}

          {/* and the price labels */}
          <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
            <motion.g key={`a${reach}`} {...crossFade}>
              {axis.map((p, i) => (
                <text
                  key={i}
                  x={i === 0 ? 0 : i === axis.length - 1 ? W : x(p)}
                  y={H - 5}
                  fontSize={9}
                  textAnchor={i === 0 ? "start" : i === axis.length - 1 ? "end" : "middle"}
                  fill="var(--foreground)"
                >
                  {/* the middle figure is the mid, named under its dashed line (spec 14.7) */}
                  {i === 2 ? (
                    <>
                      <tspan fontWeight={500} fillOpacity={0.9}>
                        {num(mid, priceDp)}
                      </tspan>
                      <tspan fillOpacity={0.45}> Mid</tspan>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <tspan fillOpacity={0.45}>{num(p, priceDp)}</tspan>
                  )}
                </text>
              ))}
            </motion.g>
          </AnimatePresence>
        </svg>

        {/* the run being read, in a card by the pointer (chart-overlay.tsx); the hued dots on
            the curves say which row is which side */}
        <ChartCard
          open={dist !== null}
          x={`${(cardAt / W) * 100}%`}
          flip={cardAt / W > 0.6}
          width={184}
          heading={`±${pct.toFixed(2)}% from the mid`}
          rows={[
            { label: `Bids to ${num(bidPrice, priceDp)}`, value: `${num(bidDepth, sizeDp)} ${unit}` },
            { label: `Asks to ${num(askPrice, priceDp)}`, value: `${num(askDepth, sizeDp)} ${unit}` },
          ]}
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}


// ─── components/ui/use-width.ts ───

"use client";

// The width a chart is given (2026-10-06, the Tradeboard case study). The charts used to lay
// out in a fixed box and stretch as a picture in a wider column, so their text grew with it;
// measured, they lay out at the real width and the text keeps its size. A chart left at its
// default class measures its own default width, so nothing changes where it is not stretched.
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

export function useWidth<T extends HTMLElement>(fallback: number, min = 280) {
  const ref = useRef<T>(null);
  const [w, setW] = useState(fallback);
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(([e]) => setW(Math.max(min, Math.round(e.contentRect.width)) || fallback));
    ro.observe(el);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, [fallback, min]);
  return [ref, w] as const;
}


// ─── components/ui/chart-overlay.tsx ───

"use client"

import { type ReactNode } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

/* Chart overlay: the two parts every library chart reads a point with (2026-10-02). They
   came out of Candlestick, Volume Profile, the trading terminal and Price Scrubber, which
   had each drawn their own; this is the one copy. Shipped beside the charts that use it.

   AxisTag   the outlined tag on the value axis: the pointed value in its hue, or a named
             reference (POC, last close) in ink. A pill 16px high, 8.5px figures.
   ChartCard the card laid over the chart beside the cursor: a heading row (a time or a
             range) at /60, then label and value rows (labels 10px /60, values 11px /90),
             the one signed figure in its hue. It glides between points on a spring, fades
             in from 0.97 and out in 120ms, and flips to the cursor's left when told to.

   2026-10-02: the card looked out of place over the charts, so it now wears the library
   popover, the same as the sidebar's hover card: a hairline border at 8%, radius 12, the
   6% foreground mix and the popover shadow with no inset highlight (spec 14.6). */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GLIDE = { type: "spring", stiffness: 520, damping: 40 } as const

/** the outlined tag on a chart's value axis, centred on `y` */
export function AxisTag({
  x,
  y,
  width,
  color = "var(--foreground)",
  strong = true,
  hidden = false,
  children,
}: {
  /** the tag's left edge, in the chart's own units */
  x: number
  /** the value's line; the tag is centred on it */
  y: number
  width: number
  /** stroke and figure; ink for a named reference, the series hue for the pointed value */
  color?: string
  /** a quieter tag (a secondary reference) drops the weight and the stroke */
  strong?: boolean
  /** fades the tag out, for when the pointed value sits on it */
  hidden?: boolean
  children: ReactNode
}) {
  return (
    <g transform={`translate(${x}, ${y - 8})`} pointerEvents="none" style={{ opacity: hidden ? 0 : 1, transition: "opacity 150ms" }}>
      <rect width={width} height={16} rx={8} fill="var(--background)" stroke={color} strokeOpacity={strong ? 0.6 : 0.2} />
      <text x={width / 2} y={11} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={8.5} fontWeight={strong ? 600 : 500} fill={color} fillOpacity={strong ? 1 : 0.65}>
        {children}
      </text>
    </g>
  )
}

export interface ChartCardRow {
  label: string
  value: ReactNode
  /** only the one signed figure carries a hue */
  color?: string
}

/** the readout card over a chart; place it inside a `relative` box that holds the svg */
export function ChartCard({
  open,
  x,
  y = 4,
  flip = false,
  width = 148,
  heading,
  rows,
  footer,
}: {
  open: boolean
  /** the cursor's x inside the box: px, or a percentage string for a chart drawn to a viewBox */
  x: number | string
  /** the card's top inside the box, px */
  y?: number
  /** put the card on the cursor's left (past ~60% of the plot) */
  flip?: boolean
  width?: number
  heading: ReactNode
  rows: ChartCardRow[]
  /** a closing line under the rows, such as where the point sits */
  footer?: ReactNode
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {open && (
        <motion.div
          key="chart-card"
          role="status"
          className="pointer-events-none absolute z-10"
          initial={{ left: x, top: y, opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ left: x, top: y, opacity: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, transition: { duration: 0.12 } }}
          transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { left: GLIDE, top: GLIDE, opacity: { duration: 0.15 } }}
        >
          <motion.div
            className="rounded-[12px] border border-foreground/[0.08] px-3 py-2.5"
            style={{
              width,
              translate: flip ? "calc(-100% - 12px) 0" : "12px 0",
              transition: reduced ? undefined : "translate 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)",
              background: "var(--tip-fill, color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 6%, var(--background)))",
              boxShadow: "0 8px 24px var(--card-shadow, rgba(0,0,0,calc(0.35 * var(--shadow-k, 1))))",
            }}
            initial={reduced ? false : { scale: 0.97 }}
            animate={{ scale: 1 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
          >
            <div className="text-[10px] text-foreground/60">{heading}</div>
            <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-col gap-1">
              {rows.map((r) => (
                <div key={r.label} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-foreground/60">{r.label}</span>
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-foreground/90" style={r.color ? { color: r.color } : undefined}>
                    {r.value}
                  </span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            {footer && <div className="mt-1.5 text-[10px]">{footer}</div>}
          </motion.div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  )
}

# Volume Profile
// ─── components/ui/volume-profile.tsx ───

"use client"

import { useRef, useState } from "react"
import { useInView, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { AxisTag, ChartCard } from "@/components/ui/chart-overlay"

/* Volume Profile, new through ssych-component (2026-09-29).
   What it is for: seeing at which prices the trading actually happened, so the fair
   range and the thin edges of a session read at a glance.
   Read first: the longest bar, the point of control, named on the price axis.
   The pointer: scrubbing up and down the profile turns the level under it the accent,
   dims the rest and reads its price range, volume and share of the session in the line
   above the bars.
   Reference: "volume profile" on browsable returned candle charts with a volume pane and
   no true profile, so no source was read. The one idea kept from those listings is the
   price axis on the right with the marks hugging it. The rest is the trading convention:
   point of control, value area, bars by price.
   Colour: volume has no direction, so it is one ink at three strengths: the point of
   control strongest, the value area full, everything outside it dimmer.
   Formulas, all from `levels`, `step` and `share`:
   · total            = sum of volume over every level
   · point of control = the level with the most volume
   · value area       = start at the point of control and keep adding the neighbouring
                        level (above or below) with the larger volume until the sum
                        reaches share × total; it runs from the lowest level taken to
                        the top of the highest one (price + step)
   · bar length       = volume / volume at the point of control
   · share of volume  = volume / total × 100
   Restyle (user call, 2026-10-02: "more similar to the rest of the UI", the readout line
   above the bars removed): the library's chart language from Candlestick and Price
   Scrubber. Dollar figures on the right with solid faint gridlines; the value area's
   edges tagged VAH and VAL on the axis; the point of control a
   dashed rule across with an outlined tag. Pointing at a level lights its bar in the
   accent, dims the rest, draws a rule across, tags its price on the axis and lays a card
   over the chart (its range, volume, share and where it sits), which glides from row to
   row; the card leaves with a fade.
   Motion (2026-10-01): the bars grow out from the left once the profile is a third in view,
   top row first, 15ms apart (capped at 360ms) over 450ms, as CSS transitions; reduced motion
   shows them grown. No data changes here, so nothing else moves.
   2026-10-02: the outlined POC, VAH and VAL pills on the right looked out of place, so the
   three references are now plain axis text at 9px (spec 14.7): the point of control's price
   in medium at /90 with its name at /45 after it, the value area's edges wholly at /45. The
   outlined tag in the accent stays for the one pointed price only, on any row, and a
   reference next to it fades aside while it is there.
   2026-10-02 audit: the card's closing line was set in the accent, and the accent is never
   for text, so it now reads in ink at /60 (the point of control at /90). The value area's
   soft band was a 4% fill that vanished on white and on black; the bar strengths already
   mark the value area, so the band is gone.
   2026-10-02 round 2: his notes, it still did not feel like his. The bars are straight on
   the left, where they grow from the axis, and fully round on the right, and thinner (6px
   in a 12px row, they were 9). Styled after Market Heatmap and Price Scrubber: when a level
   carries its buy volume (the new optional `buy` on VolumeLevel, which the sample now has)
   its bar is a soft tint of the level's net side, up hue where buyers led and down hue where
   sellers did, stronger the more one side led, with no outline, like the heatmap's tiles;
   bars outside the value area step back to 55%. Without `buy` the bars keep the ink
   strengths. Pointing a level lays a soft wash across its whole row, rounded, which glides
   from row to row on transform only (180ms ease out), dims the other bars to 35% (the
   heatmap's dim) and tags its price on the axis in the bar's hue; the accent blue and the
   dashed rule across are gone. The card is parked clear of the pointed row, above it in the
   lower half and below it in the upper half, against the plot's right edge, so it never
   covers the level it reads; it adds the level's delta in its hue.
   Formulas, added:
   · delta            = buy − (volume − buy) = 2 × buy − volume
   · lead             = |delta| ÷ volume
   · bar tint         = the up hue (delta ≥ 0) or the down hue at 22 + min(lead ÷ 0.3, 1) × 48
                        percent, over nothing */

const CSS_EASE = "cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)"
const UP = "var(--chart-up)"
const DOWN = "var(--chart-down)"
const INK = "var(--foreground)"
/** a hue as text: its lightness capped in light so small figures reach AA (Market Heatmap's
 *  rule; `--ink-l` is set on the root per theme) */
const textHue = (c: string) => `oklch(from ${c} min(l, var(--ink-l, 1)) c h)`

export interface VolumeLevel {
  /** lower edge of the price bucket */
  price: number
  /** volume traded inside the bucket, in units of the asset */
  volume: number
  /** the part of `volume` that buyers initiated; when given, the bar is tinted by the net side */
  buy?: number
}

export interface VolumeProfileProps {
  /** one entry per price bucket, any order */
  levels?: VolumeLevel[]
  /** height of one bucket, in price */
  step?: number
  /** the part of all volume the value area has to hold, 0 to 1 */
  share?: number
  symbol?: string
  title?: string
  className?: string
}

/** Deterministic session (Lehmer): one high-volume node and a smaller shelf under it. */
const DEFAULT_LEVELS: VolumeLevel[] = (() => {
  let s = 3050
  const rnd = () => {
    s = (s * 16807) % 2147483647
    return s / 2147483647
  }
  return Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, i) => {
    const node = Math.exp(-((i - 14) ** 2) / 18)
    const shelf = 0.45 * Math.exp(-((i - 5) ** 2) / 8)
    const volume = Math.round((node + shelf + 0.08 + rnd() * 0.12) * 2400)
    /* buyers absorb the lows and sellers lean on the highs, with some noise level to level */
    const lean = Math.max(0.22, Math.min(0.78, 0.5 + ((12 - i) / 24) * 0.3 + Math.sin(i / 2.6) * 0.07 + (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.12))
    return { price: 2940 + i * 10, volume, buy: Math.round(volume * lean) }
  })
})()

const W = 440
const ROW = 12
/** the right-hand axis, wide enough for a reference like "$3,090 POC" */
const AXIS = 86
/** air between the longest bar and the axis */
const BAR_W = W - AXIS - 10
/** round 2: thinner bars, 6px in a 12px row */
const BAR_H = 6
const TOP = 6
const CARD_W = 168
/** the card's height from its fixed type: heading, three rows and the closing line */
const CARD_H = 124
/** the hover dim, the heatmap's */
const DIM = 0.35

/** a bar straight on the left (the axis it grows from) and fully round on the right */
const barPath = (x0: number, y0: number, len: number, h: number) => {
  const r = h / 2
  const l = Math.max(len, h)
  return `M${x0},${y0} H${x0 + l - r} A${r},${r} 0 0 1 ${x0 + l - r},${y0 + h} H${x0} Z`
}

/** the tint of a level's net side: the hue at 22 to 70 percent, stronger the more one side led */
const sideFill = (volume: number, buy: number) => {
  const delta = 2 * buy - volume
  const lead = volume ? Math.abs(delta) / volume : 0
  return `color-mix(in srgb, ${delta >= 0 ? UP : DOWN} ${Math.round(22 + Math.min(lead / 0.3, 1) * 48)}%, transparent)`
}

const ink = (pct: number) => `color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) ${pct}%, transparent)`
const whole = (v: number) => v.toLocaleString("en-US", { maximumFractionDigits: 2 })
const usd = (v: number) => `$${whole(v)}`

function valueArea(vols: number[], share: number) {
  const total = vols.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0)
  const poc = vols.reduce((best, v, i) => (v > vols[best] ? i : best), 0)
  let lo = poc
  let hi = poc
  let held = vols[poc] ?? 0
  while (held < total * share && (lo > 0 || hi < vols.length - 1)) {
    const below = lo > 0 ? vols[lo - 1] : -1
    const above = hi < vols.length - 1 ? vols[hi + 1] : -1
    if (above >= below) {
      hi += 1
      held += above
    } else {
      lo -= 1
      held += below
    }
  }
  return { total, poc, lo, hi, held }
}

/**
 * Volume by price: one bar per price level, the point of control named, the value area at
 * full strength inside its band and the thin edges dimmer. Pointing at a level reads it in
 * a card over the chart.
 */
export function VolumeProfile({
  levels = DEFAULT_LEVELS,
  step = 10,
  share = 0.7,
  symbol = "ETH",
  title = "Volume profile",
  className,
}: VolumeProfileProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const svgRef = useRef<SVGSVGElement>(null)
  /* the bars wait until the profile is a third in view, then grow once */
  const play = useInView(svgRef, { once: true, amount: 0.3 }) || !!reduced
  const [hot, setHot] = useState<number | null>(null)

  /* lowest price first, so index 0 is the bottom row */
  const rows = [...levels].sort((a, b) => a.price - b.price)
  const n = rows.length
  const H = TOP * 2 + Math.max(1, n) * ROW
  const { total, poc, lo, hi } = valueArea(
    rows.map((r) => r.volume),
    share,
  )
  const top = Math.max(1e-6, rows[poc]?.volume ?? 0)
  const y = (i: number) => TOP + (n - 1 - i) * ROW
  const mid = (i: number) => y(i) + ROW / 2
  const len = (v: number) => Math.max(2, (v / top) * BAR_W)

  const onMove = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    const el = svgRef.current
    if (!el || n === 0) return
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect()
    const py = ((e.clientY - r.top) / r.height) * H
    const row = Math.floor((py - TOP) / ROW)
    setHot(n - 1 - Math.max(0, Math.min(n - 1, row)))
  }

  /* the axis: a figure every fourth level, and plain references for the three that matter */
  const tags = new Map<number, string>([
    [hi, "VAH"],
    [lo, "VAL"],
    [poc, "POC"],
  ])
  const shown = hot !== null ? rows[hot] : null
  const where = (i: number) => (i === poc ? "Point of control" : i >= lo && i <= hi ? "Inside the value area" : "Outside the value area")
  /* the card is parked clear of the pointed row, against the plot's right edge: above the row
     in the lower half, below it in the upper half, kept inside the chart */
  const cardX = BAR_W + 4 - CARD_W
  const cardY =
    hot !== null
      ? Math.max(0, Math.min(H - CARD_H, mid(hot) > H / 2 ? y(hot) - 6 - CARD_H : y(hot) + ROW + 6))
      : 0
  const shownDelta = shown?.buy != null ? 2 * shown.buy - shown.volume : null
  const shownHue = shownDelta == null ? INK : textHue(shownDelta >= 0 ? UP : DOWN)
  /* the wash keeps its last row while it fades out, so it never slides home on the way out */
  const lastHot = useRef(0)
  if (hot !== null) lastHot.current = hot

  return (
    <div role="group" aria-label={`${symbol} ${title.toLowerCase()}`} className={cn("w-[440px] max-w-full tabular-nums [--ink-l:0.5] dark:[--ink-l:1]", className)}>
      <div className="relative">
        <svg
          ref={svgRef}
          width={W}
          height={H}
          viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`}
          className="block h-auto max-w-full cursor-crosshair touch-none"
          role="img"
          aria-label={`${symbol} ${title.toLowerCase()}, point of control ${usd(rows[poc]?.price ?? 0)}, value area ${usd(rows[lo]?.price ?? 0)} to ${usd((rows[hi]?.price ?? 0) + step)}`}
          onPointerMove={onMove}
          onPointerLeave={() => setHot(null)}
        >
          {/* gridlines on every fourth level, the figures on the right */}
          {rows.map((r, i) =>
            /* a figure next to a reference steps aside for it */
            i % 4 === 0 && ![...tags.keys()].some((t) => Math.abs(mid(t) - mid(i)) < 16) ? (
              <g key={`g-${r.price}`}>
                <line x1={0} x2={BAR_W + 4} y1={mid(i)} y2={mid(i)} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.05} />
                <text
                  x={W - 4}
                  y={mid(i) + 3}
                  textAnchor="end"
                  fontSize={9}
                  fill="var(--foreground)"
                  fillOpacity={0.45}
                  style={{ opacity: hot !== null && Math.abs(mid(i) - mid(hot)) < 11 ? 0 : 1, transition: "opacity 150ms" }}
                >
                  {usd(r.price)}
                </text>
              </g>
            ) : null,
          )}

          {/* the pointed row: a soft wash across the whole row, gliding row to row on transform only */}
          <rect
            x={0}
            y={0}
            width={BAR_W + 4}
            height={ROW}
            rx={ROW / 2}
            fill={INK}
            fillOpacity={0.06}
            pointerEvents="none"
            style={{
              opacity: hot !== null ? 1 : 0,
              transform: `translateY(${y(hot ?? lastHot.current)}px)`,
              transition: reduced ? "opacity 150ms" : `opacity 150ms, transform 180ms ${CSS_EASE}`,
            }}
          />

          {/* the point of control, a dashed rule across */}
          {n > 0 && <line x1={0} x2={BAR_W + 4} y1={mid(poc)} y2={mid(poc)} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.3} strokeDasharray="2 4" />}

          {rows.map((r, i) => {
            const on = hot === i
            const inside = i >= lo && i <= hi
            const sided = r.buy != null
            const fill = sided ? sideFill(r.volume, r.buy ?? 0) : on ? ink(92) : i === poc ? ink(92) : inside ? ink(55) : ink(20)
            const rest = sided && !inside ? 0.55 : 1
            return (
              <path
                key={r.price}
                d={barPath(0, mid(i) - BAR_H / 2, len(r.volume), BAR_H)}
                fill={fill}
                style={{
                  opacity: hot !== null && !on ? rest * DIM : on ? 1 : rest,
                  transformBox: "fill-box",
                  transformOrigin: "0% 50%",
                  transform: play ? "none" : "scaleX(0)",
                  transition: reduced
                    ? "fill 150ms, opacity 150ms"
                    : `fill 150ms, opacity 150ms, transform 450ms ${CSS_EASE} ${Math.min(0.36, (n - 1 - i) * 0.015).toFixed(3)}s`,
                }}
              />
            )
          })}

          {/* the references, plain text on the axis: POC's price at /90 with its name at /45,
              the value area's edges at /45; one fades aside while the pointed tag sits on it */}
          {[...tags].map(([i, name]) => {
            const r = rows[i]
            if (!r) return null
            const named = name === "POC"
            return (
              <text
                key={name}
                x={W - 4}
                y={mid(i) + 3}
                textAnchor="end"
                fontSize={9}
                fill="var(--foreground)"
                pointerEvents="none"
                style={{ opacity: hot !== null && Math.abs(mid(i) - mid(hot)) < 13 ? 0 : 1, transition: "opacity 150ms" }}
              >
                <tspan fontWeight={named ? 500 : 400} fillOpacity={named ? 0.9 : 0.45}>
                  {usd(r.price)}
                </tspan>
                <tspan fillOpacity={0.45}> {name}</tspan>
              </text>
            )
          })}

          {/* the pointed price tagged on the axis in the bar's hue, ink without sides (chart-overlay.tsx) */}
          {hot !== null && shown && (
            <AxisTag x={BAR_W + 14} y={mid(hot)} width={AXIS - 14} color={shownHue}>
              {usd(shown.price)}
            </AxisTag>
          )}
        </svg>

        {/* the level under the pointer, read out in a card over the chart (chart-overlay.tsx);
            it glides from row to row */}
        <ChartCard
          open={hot !== null && shown !== null}
          x={cardX - 12}
          y={cardY}
          width={CARD_W}
          heading={shown ? `${usd(shown.price)} to ${usd(shown.price + step)}` : ""}
          rows={
            shown
              ? [
                  { label: "Volume", value: `${whole(shown.volume)} ${symbol}` },
                  ...(shownDelta != null
                    ? [{ label: "Delta", value: `${shownDelta >= 0 ? "+" : "−"}${whole(Math.abs(shownDelta))} ${symbol}`, color: shownHue }]
                    : []),
                  { label: "Share", value: `${((shown.volume / (total || 1)) * 100).toFixed(1)}%` },
                ]
              : []
          }
          footer={
            hot !== null && (
              <span className={hot === poc ? "text-foreground/90" : "text-foreground/60"}>{where(hot)}</span>
            )
          }
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}


// ─── components/ui/chart-overlay.tsx ───

"use client"

import { type ReactNode } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

/* Chart overlay: the two parts every library chart reads a point with (2026-10-02). They
   came out of Candlestick, Volume Profile, the trading terminal and Price Scrubber, which
   had each drawn their own; this is the one copy. Shipped beside the charts that use it.

   AxisTag   the outlined tag on the value axis: the pointed value in its hue, or a named
             reference (POC, last close) in ink. A pill 16px high, 8.5px figures.
   ChartCard the card laid over the chart beside the cursor: a heading row (a time or a
             range) at /60, then label and value rows (labels 10px /60, values 11px /90),
             the one signed figure in its hue. It glides between points on a spring, fades
             in from 0.97 and out in 120ms, and flips to the cursor's left when told to.

   2026-10-02: the card looked out of place over the charts, so it now wears the library
   popover, the same as the sidebar's hover card: a hairline border at 8%, radius 12, the
   6% foreground mix and the popover shadow with no inset highlight (spec 14.6). */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GLIDE = { type: "spring", stiffness: 520, damping: 40 } as const

/** the outlined tag on a chart's value axis, centred on `y` */
export function AxisTag({
  x,
  y,
  width,
  color = "var(--foreground)",
  strong = true,
  hidden = false,
  children,
}: {
  /** the tag's left edge, in the chart's own units */
  x: number
  /** the value's line; the tag is centred on it */
  y: number
  width: number
  /** stroke and figure; ink for a named reference, the series hue for the pointed value */
  color?: string
  /** a quieter tag (a secondary reference) drops the weight and the stroke */
  strong?: boolean
  /** fades the tag out, for when the pointed value sits on it */
  hidden?: boolean
  children: ReactNode
}) {
  return (
    <g transform={`translate(${x}, ${y - 8})`} pointerEvents="none" style={{ opacity: hidden ? 0 : 1, transition: "opacity 150ms" }}>
      <rect width={width} height={16} rx={8} fill="var(--background)" stroke={color} strokeOpacity={strong ? 0.6 : 0.2} />
      <text x={width / 2} y={11} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={8.5} fontWeight={strong ? 600 : 500} fill={color} fillOpacity={strong ? 1 : 0.65}>
        {children}
      </text>
    </g>
  )
}

export interface ChartCardRow {
  label: string
  value: ReactNode
  /** only the one signed figure carries a hue */
  color?: string
}

/** the readout card over a chart; place it inside a `relative` box that holds the svg */
export function ChartCard({
  open,
  x,
  y = 4,
  flip = false,
  width = 148,
  heading,
  rows,
  footer,
}: {
  open: boolean
  /** the cursor's x inside the box: px, or a percentage string for a chart drawn to a viewBox */
  x: number | string
  /** the card's top inside the box, px */
  y?: number
  /** put the card on the cursor's left (past ~60% of the plot) */
  flip?: boolean
  width?: number
  heading: ReactNode
  rows: ChartCardRow[]
  /** a closing line under the rows, such as where the point sits */
  footer?: ReactNode
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {open && (
        <motion.div
          key="chart-card"
          role="status"
          className="pointer-events-none absolute z-10"
          initial={{ left: x, top: y, opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ left: x, top: y, opacity: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, transition: { duration: 0.12 } }}
          transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { left: GLIDE, top: GLIDE, opacity: { duration: 0.15 } }}
        >
          <motion.div
            className="rounded-[12px] border border-foreground/[0.08] px-3 py-2.5"
            style={{
              width,
              translate: flip ? "calc(-100% - 12px) 0" : "12px 0",
              transition: reduced ? undefined : "translate 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)",
              background: "var(--tip-fill, color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 6%, var(--background)))",
              boxShadow: "0 8px 24px var(--card-shadow, rgba(0,0,0,calc(0.35 * var(--shadow-k, 1))))",
            }}
            initial={reduced ? false : { scale: 0.97 }}
            animate={{ scale: 1 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
          >
            <div className="text-[10px] text-foreground/60">{heading}</div>
            <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-col gap-1">
              {rows.map((r) => (
                <div key={r.label} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-foreground/60">{r.label}</span>
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-foreground/90" style={r.color ? { color: r.color } : undefined}>
                    {r.value}
                  </span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            {footer && <div className="mt-1.5 text-[10px]">{footer}</div>}
          </motion.div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  )
}


# Range Navigator
// ─── components/ui/range-navigator.tsx ───

"use client"

import { useEffect, useId, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react"
import { motion, useInView, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { AxisTag } from "@/components/ui/chart-overlay"

/* Range Navigator, rebuilt through the ssych-component skill (2026-09-29).
   What changed against the version before it (in git history), and why:
   · the line is ink, not blue. CHANGED DEFAULT: `color` now defaults to the foreground at
     90% (it was var(--chart-1)); pass a colour to get the old look. The accent is only on
     the point being pointed at
   · the readout is plain text beside the title: the last price of the window and the
     window's signed change at rest, the pointed price and its date while you scrub. The
     bordered card that floated over the chart is gone
   · the window on the mini-map is a faint fill with two ink grips, no outline; the history
     outside it is the same line at a lower strength, not a veil of the page colour
   · the detail line is 1.8px and draws in once; it no longer flickers on every pan
   · both charts name themselves to a screen reader, and the window can be moved from the
     keyboard: arrows pan, shift + arrows pan by ten, + and − zoom
   Motion (2026-10-01): once the chart is in view the detail line and its fill sweep in left
   to right through one clip (0.9s); a new series glides both lines into place; panning and
   zooming the window stay 1:1 with the pointer, a tween there would trail the grip
   2026-10-02 audit: the title was an instruction ("drag to navigate") and the one figure
   was 11px. The header is now the library's three tiers: the name at /45 with the symbol
   (a new `symbol` prop) at /90, the window's close as the 26px headline, and under it the
   window's change in its hue then the window's dates at /45. Pointing the detail chart
   puts a dot in the line's own ink and an outlined tag on the price axis, and the header
   reads that day: its price, the change from the window's first day to it, and its date.
   The two end dates under the map went, since the header says them once. The window on the
   map is the control thumb's fill and its grips are the slider handle, a 2 by 10 bar in
   ink that no longer turns the accent while held. Axis figures are 9px at /45.
   Formulas:
   · window change  = (close of the window's last day − close of its first day) ÷ first × 100
   · pointed change = (pointed close − close of the window's first day) ÷ first × 100
   · price ticks    = the window's min and max padded by a tenth of their range, cut in four
   2026-10-02 round 2: his notes, more roundness and a window that clearly reads as a
   container you can grab. The map now lies in its own lane, the surface step (7%) with a
   14px corner; the window is a raised block on it (white in light, 12% in dark) with a 1px
   ink edge at 14% (28% under the pointer or held), a 12px corner (14 = 12 + the 2px gap)
   so it stands off the lane. Its grips sit inside it, 6px in from each
   edge, as 2 by 12 bars, and the cursor turns to a closed hand while it is held. The lines
   have round caps. Focus on the map is an inset 1px ink ring on the lane's own edge. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GREEN = "var(--chart-up)"
const RED = "var(--chart-down)"
/** the map's lane: the surface step (spec 14.8) */
const LANE_FILL = "color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 7%, var(--background))"
/** the window: the raised step on the lane, white in light, 12% in dark (spec 14.8) */
const RAISED_FILL = "fill-background dark:fill-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_12%,var(--background))]"
/** the lane's corner, and the window's: 14 = 12 + the 2px gap between them */
const LANE_R = 14
const WIN_R = 12
const WIN_GAP = 2
const INK = "color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 90%, transparent)"

const W = 560 // component width: both charts share one coordinate space
const MAIN_H = 168
const NAV_H = 46
const PAD = { l: 8, r: 54, t: 12, b: 8 }
const PLOT_W = W - PAD.l - PAD.r
/** Fractions down the plot where the price axis puts a tick. */
const AXIS_TICKS = [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1]
const DAY_MS = 86_400_000

const clamp = (v: number, lo: number, hi: number) => Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, v))

/** Deterministic price walk: same series every render. */
function walk(len: number, seed = 5) {
  let s = seed
  const rnd = () => {
    s = (s * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7fffffff
    return s / 0x7fffffff
  }
  const out: number[] = []
  let v = 120
  for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
    v += (rnd() - 0.48) * 3 + Math.sin(i / 22) * 0.6
    out.push(v)
  }
  return out
}

const DEFAULT_VALUES = walk(240)
/** Fixed anchor day so the date axis never drifts between server and client. */
const DEFAULT_END_DATE = new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 6, 30))

export interface RangeNavigatorProps {
  /** The name in the header's label row. */
  title?: string
  /** The symbol on the right of the label row. */
  symbol?: string
  /** The series, oldest → newest. Defaults to a deterministic sample walk. */
  values?: number[]
  /** Date of the last sample; every earlier point steps back one day. */
  endDate?: Date
  /** How many trailing points the window opens on. */
  initialWindow?: number
  /** Narrowest the window can be pulled, in points. */
  minWindow?: number
  /** The one series colour. Defaults to ink. */
  color?: string
  /** Number formatting for the price axis and the readout. */
  locale?: string
  currency?: string
  /** Fires with the point range whenever the window is panned or zoomed. */
  onWindowChange?: (range: { start: number; end: number }) => void
  className?: string
}

/**
 * Focus and context: a detail chart over a compressed map of the whole history. Drag the
 * window to pan, pull a grip to zoom, and the detail chart re-windows as you go. Pointing
 * at the detail chart drops a rule on the nearest real point, tags its price on the axis
 * and reads it in the header. The price ticks and the two end dates come from the current window.
 */
export function RangeNavigator({
  title = "Price history",
  symbol = "NVDA",
  values,
  endDate = DEFAULT_END_DATE,
  initialWindow = 72,
  minWindow = 12,
  color = INK,
  locale = "en-US",
  currency = "USD",
  onWindowChange,
  className,
}: RangeNavigatorProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const uid = useId().replace(/:/g, "")
  const series = values?.length ? values : DEFAULT_VALUES
  const len = series.length

  const [win, setWin] = useState({
    start: clamp(len - 1 - initialWindow, 0, Math.max(0, len - 1 - minWindow)),
    end: len - 1,
  })
  /** Hovered index WITHIN the window slice, not the full series. */
  const [hover, setHover] = useState<number | null>(null)
  /** which part of the mini-map is under the pointer or held */
  const [grip, setGrip] = useState<"move" | "left" | "right" | null>(null)
  /** the window is held (the cursor closes) */
  const [held, setHeld] = useState(false)
  /** the map has keyboard focus: its lane's edge brightens */
  const [focusRing, setFocusRing] = useState(false)
  const navRef = useRef<SVGSVGElement>(null)
  const mainRef = useRef<SVGSVGElement>(null)
  const drag = useRef<{ mode: "move" | "left" | "right"; startIdx: number; s: number; e: number } | null>(null)
  /* the entrance plays once, when a third of the chart is in view; reduced motion lands at once */
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const seen = useInView(rootRef, { once: true, amount: 0.3 })
  const play = !!reduced || seen
  /* a new series glides; a moved window follows the hand at once */
  const lastWin = useRef(win)
  const windowMoved = lastWin.current !== win
  useEffect(() => {
    lastWin.current = win
  }, [win])
  const morph = reduced || windowMoved ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.35, ease: EASE }

  /** Currency with a true minus (U+2212). */
  const money = useMemo(() => {
    const fmt = (precision: number) =>
      new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, {
        style: "currency",
        currency,
        minimumFractionDigits: precision,
        maximumFractionDigits: precision,
      })
    const cache = new Map<number, Intl.NumberFormat>()
    return (n: number, precision = 2) => {
      if (!cache.has(precision)) cache.set(precision, fmt(precision))
      return (n < 0 ? "−" : "") + cache.get(precision)!.format(Math.abs(n))
    }
  }, [locale, currency])

  const last = endDate.getTime()
  const dayAt = (i: number) => new Date(last - (len - 1 - i) * DAY_MS)
  const fmtDay = (i: number, withYear = false) =>
    dayAt(i).toLocaleDateString(locale, {
      month: "short",
      day: "numeric",
      year: withYear ? "2-digit" : undefined,
      timeZone: "UTC",
    })

  const pxToIdx = (clientX: number) => {
    const r = navRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect()
    if (!r) return 0
    return ((clientX - r.left) / r.width) * (len - 1)
  }

  // The mini-map captures the pointer on press, so the pull keeps tracking when the
  // pointer leaves it, and it works in any document (an iframe never forwards its
  // pointer events to the parent window).
  const onNavMove = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    const d = drag.current
    if (!d) return
    const delta = Math.round(pxToIdx(e.clientX) - d.startIdx)
    if (d.mode === "move") {
      const width = d.e - d.s
      const start = clamp(d.s + delta, 0, len - 1 - width)
      setWin({ start, end: start + width })
    } else if (d.mode === "left") {
      setWin({ start: clamp(d.s + delta, 0, d.e - minWindow), end: d.e })
    } else {
      setWin({ start: d.s, end: clamp(d.e + delta, d.s + minWindow, len - 1) })
    }
  }
  const endDrag = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    drag.current = null
    setGrip(null)
    setHeld(false)
    if (navRef.current?.hasPointerCapture(e.pointerId)) navRef.current.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId)
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    onWindowChange?.(win)
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [win.start, win.end])

  const startDrag = (mode: "move" | "left" | "right") => (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    e.stopPropagation()
    navRef.current?.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)
    drag.current = { mode, startIdx: pxToIdx(e.clientX), s: win.start, e: win.end }
    setGrip(mode)
    setHeld(true)
  }
  const point = (mode: "move" | "left" | "right" | null) => () => {
    if (!drag.current) setGrip(mode)
  }

  /** the same moves from the keyboard: pan with the arrows, zoom with + and − */
  const onNavKey = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    const step = e.shiftKey ? 10 : 1
    const width = win.end - win.start
    if (e.key === "ArrowLeft" || e.key === "ArrowRight") {
      const start = clamp(win.start + (e.key === "ArrowLeft" ? -step : step), 0, len - 1 - width)
      setWin({ start, end: start + width })
    } else if (e.key === "+" || e.key === "=") {
      setWin({ start: clamp(win.start + step, 0, win.end - minWindow), end: win.end })
    } else if (e.key === "-" || e.key === "−") {
      setWin({ start: clamp(win.start - step, 0, win.end - minWindow), end: win.end })
    } else if (e.key === "Home") {
      setWin({ start: 0, end: width })
    } else if (e.key === "End") {
      setWin({ start: len - 1 - width, end: len - 1 })
    } else return
    e.preventDefault()
  }

  // Detail-chart geometry over the selected window.
  const detail = useMemo(() => {
    const slice = series.slice(win.start, win.end + 1)
    const lo = Math.min(...slice)
    const hi = Math.max(...slice)
    const pad = (hi - lo) * 0.1 || 1
    const min = lo - pad
    const max = hi + pad
    const n = slice.length
    const x = (i: number) => PAD.l + (i / Math.max(1, n - 1)) * PLOT_W
    const y = (v: number) => PAD.t + (1 - (v - min) / (max - min)) * (MAIN_H - PAD.t - PAD.b)
    const line = slice.map((v, i) => `${i === 0 ? "M" : "L"}${x(i).toFixed(1)},${y(v).toFixed(1)}`).join(" ")
    const area = `${line} L${x(n - 1).toFixed(1)},${MAIN_H - PAD.b} L${x(0).toFixed(1)},${MAIN_H - PAD.b} Z`
    // Tight windows span a couple of dollars: keep the cents so ticks stay distinct.
    const axisPrecision = max - min >= 6 ? 0 : 2
    return { line, area, min, max, slice, n, x, y, axisPrecision }
  }, [win, series])

  // The rule on the detail chart: pointer x snaps to the nearest real point.
  const onMainMove = (e: React.PointerEvent<SVGSVGElement>) => {
    const r = mainRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect()
    if (!r) return
    const px = ((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width) * W
    setHover(clamp(Math.round(((px - PAD.l) / PLOT_W) * (detail.n - 1)), 0, detail.n - 1))
  }
  const hv =
    hover != null && hover < detail.n
      ? { i: hover, v: detail.slice[hover], x: detail.x(hover), y: detail.y(detail.slice[hover]) }
      : null

  // Mini-map geometry over the full series.
  const nav = useMemo(() => {
    const lo = Math.min(...series)
    const hi = Math.max(...series)
    const nx = (i: number) => PAD.l + (i / Math.max(1, len - 1)) * PLOT_W
    const ny = (v: number) => 4 + (1 - (v - lo) / (hi - lo || 1)) * (NAV_H - 8)
    const line = series.map((v, i) => `${i === 0 ? "M" : "L"}${nx(i).toFixed(1)},${ny(v).toFixed(1)}`).join(" ")
    return { line, nx }
  }, [series, len])

  const wx0 = nav.nx(win.start)
  const wx1 = nav.nx(win.end)
  // End labels track the window; the year only appears when the window straddles one.
  const crossesYear = dayAt(win.start).getUTCFullYear() !== dayAt(win.end).getUTCFullYear()

  /** the window's own move: (last − first) / first, in percent */
  const first = series[win.start]
  const close = series[win.end]
  const change = first ? ((close - first) / Math.abs(first)) * 100 : 0
  const signed = (pct: number) => `${pct >= 0 ? "+" : "−"}${Math.abs(pct).toFixed(1)}%`
  const changeText = signed(change)
  /* the header reads the pointed day while scrubbing, the window's close at rest */
  const shownPrice = hv ? hv.v : close
  const shownChange = hv && first ? ((hv.v - first) / Math.abs(first)) * 100 : change
  const [headWhole, headDecimals] = (() => {
    const t = money(shownPrice)
    const at = t.lastIndexOf(".")
    return at < 0 ? [t, ""] : [t.slice(0, at), t.slice(at)]
  })()
  const span = `${fmtDay(win.start, crossesYear)} to ${fmtDay(win.end, crossesYear)}`

  return (
    <div ref={rootRef} className={cn("w-[560px] tabular-nums", className)}>
      {/* the header, three tiers (spec 14.1): name and symbol, the price, the move and its window */}
      <div className="mb-3 flex items-baseline justify-between text-[12px]">
        <span className="truncate text-foreground/45">{title}</span>
        <span className="shrink-0 pl-3 font-medium text-foreground/90">{symbol}</span>
      </div>
      {/* going between the window's close and the pointed day, the readout crosses over
          (4px, 2px blur, 150ms); while scrubbing it follows the pointer in place */}
      <div role="status">
        <motion.div
          key={hv ? "scrub" : "rest"}
          initial={reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: 4, filter: "blur(2px)" }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, filter: "blur(0px)" }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
        >
          <p className="m-0 text-[26px] font-semibold leading-none tracking-[-0.02em] text-foreground/90">
            {headWhole}
            <span className="text-foreground/35">{headDecimals}</span>
          </p>
          <p className="mb-0 mt-2 flex items-baseline gap-[7px] text-[12px] font-medium" style={{ color: shownChange >= 0 ? GREEN : RED }}>
            <span>{signed(shownChange)}</span>
            <span className="font-normal text-foreground/45">{hv ? fmtDay(win.start + hv.i, crossesYear) : span}</span>
          </p>
        </motion.div>
      </div>

      {/* detail chart */}
      <svg
        ref={mainRef}
        width={W}
        height={MAIN_H}
        viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${MAIN_H}`}
        className="mt-4 block cursor-crosshair touch-none"
        onPointerMove={onMainMove}
        onPointerLeave={() => setHover(null)}
        onPointerCancel={() => setHover(null)}
        role="img"
        aria-label={`Price from ${span}: ${money(close)} at the end, ${changeText} over the window`}
      >
        <defs>
          <linearGradient id={`${uid}-fill`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
            <stop offset="0%" stopColor={color} stopOpacity="0.1" />
            <stop offset="100%" stopColor={color} stopOpacity="0" />
          </linearGradient>
          {/* the line and its fill sweep in left to right, a few px wide of the plot for the round caps */}
          <clipPath id={`${uid}-reveal`}>
            <motion.rect
              x={0}
              y={0}
              height={MAIN_H}
              initial={reduced ? false : { width: 0 }}
              animate={{ width: play ? W - PAD.r + 4 : 0 }}
              transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.9, ease: EASE }}
            />
          </clipPath>
        </defs>

        {/* price axis: ticks derived from the windowed min and max */}
        {AXIS_TICKS.map((f) => {
          const ty = PAD.t + f * (MAIN_H - PAD.t - PAD.b)
          return (
            <g key={f}>
              {f > 0 && f < 1 && (
                <line x1={PAD.l} y1={ty} x2={W - PAD.r} y2={ty} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.05} strokeWidth={1} />
              )}
              <text
                x={W - PAD.r + 8}
                y={ty + (f === 0 ? 4 : f === 1 ? 0 : 3)}
                fontSize={9}
                fill="var(--foreground)"
                fillOpacity={0.45}
                /* a figure under the pointed tag fades aside for it */
                style={{ opacity: hv && Math.abs(hv.y - ty) < 12 ? 0 : 1, transition: "opacity 150ms" }}
              >
                {money(detail.max - f * (detail.max - detail.min), detail.axisPrecision)}
              </text>
            </g>
          )
        })}

        <g clipPath={`url(#${uid}-reveal)`}>
          <motion.path fill={`url(#${uid}-fill)`} initial={false} animate={{ d: detail.area }} transition={morph} />
          <motion.path
            fill="none"
            stroke={color}
            strokeWidth={1.8}
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
            initial={false}
            animate={{ d: detail.line }}
            transition={morph}
          />
        </g>

        {hv && (
          <g pointerEvents="none">
            <line x1={hv.x} y1={PAD.t} x2={hv.x} y2={MAIN_H - PAD.b} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.22} strokeWidth={1} />
            <circle cx={hv.x} cy={hv.y} r={3} fill={color} stroke="var(--background)" strokeWidth={1.5} />
            <AxisTag x={W - PAD.r + 4} y={hv.y} width={PAD.r - 6} color={color}>
              {money(hv.v, detail.axisPrecision)}
            </AxisTag>
          </g>
        )}
      </svg>

      {/* mini-map: the whole history, with the window drawn over it */}
      <div
        tabIndex={0}
        role="slider"
        aria-label="Window over the price history. Arrow keys pan, plus and minus zoom"
        aria-valuemin={0}
        aria-valuemax={len - 1}
        aria-valuenow={win.start}
        aria-valuetext={span}
        onKeyDown={onNavKey}
        onFocus={(e) => setFocusRing(e.currentTarget.matches(":focus-visible"))}
        onBlur={() => setFocusRing(false)}
        className="mt-2 outline-none"
      >
        <svg
          ref={navRef}
          width={W}
          height={NAV_H}
          viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${NAV_H}`}
          className="block touch-none select-none"
          style={held ? { cursor: grip === "move" ? "grabbing" : "ew-resize" } : undefined}
          onPointerMove={onNavMove}
          onPointerUp={endDrag}
          onPointerCancel={endDrag}
          onPointerLeave={point(null)}
          role="img"
          aria-label={`Whole history, ${len} days. Window: ${span}`}
        >
          <defs>
            <clipPath id={`${uid}-win`}>
              <rect x={wx0} y={WIN_GAP} width={Math.max(0, wx1 - wx0)} height={NAV_H - WIN_GAP * 2} rx={WIN_R} />
            </clipPath>
          </defs>
          {/* the lane the whole history lies in, 2px wider than the plot each side so the
              window keeps the same gap at its ends as above and below; keyboard focus rings
              the lane's own edge, inset, in ink */}
          <rect
            x={PAD.l - WIN_GAP}
            y={0}
            width={PLOT_W + WIN_GAP * 2}
            height={NAV_H}
            rx={LANE_R}
            fill={LANE_FILL}
          />
          {focusRing && (
            <rect
              x={PAD.l - WIN_GAP + 0.5}
              y={0.5}
              width={PLOT_W + WIN_GAP * 2 - 1}
              height={NAV_H - 1}
              rx={LANE_R - 0.5}
              fill="none"
              stroke="var(--foreground)"
              strokeOpacity={0.3}
              strokeWidth={1}
              pointerEvents="none"
            />
          )}
          {/* the history outside the window is the same line, a step back */}
          <motion.path
            fill="none"
            stroke="var(--foreground)"
            strokeOpacity={0.2}
            strokeWidth={1}
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
            initial={false}
            animate={{ d: nav.line }}
            transition={morph}
          />
          {/* the window itself, a raised block on the lane: grab anywhere inside to pan */}
          <rect
            x={wx0}
            y={WIN_GAP}
            width={Math.max(0, wx1 - wx0)}
            height={NAV_H - WIN_GAP * 2}
            rx={WIN_R}
            className={RAISED_FILL}
            stroke="var(--foreground)"
            strokeOpacity={grip === "move" || grip === "left" || grip === "right" ? 0.28 : 0.14}
            strokeWidth={1}
            onPointerDown={startDrag("move")}
            onPointerEnter={point("move")}
            style={{ cursor: held ? "grabbing" : "grab", transition: "stroke-opacity 150ms ease-out" }}
          />
          <motion.path
            fill="none"
            stroke="var(--foreground)"
            strokeOpacity={0.9}
            strokeWidth={1.2}
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
            clipPath={`url(#${uid}-win)`}
            pointerEvents="none"
            initial={false}
            animate={{ d: nav.line }}
            transition={morph}
          />
          {/* grips: pull to zoom; each handle sits inside the window, 6px in from its edge */}
          {[
            { x: wx0, mode: "left" as const, hx: wx0 + 6 },
            { x: wx1, mode: "right" as const, hx: wx1 - 6 },
          ].map(({ x, mode, hx }) => (
            <g key={mode} onPointerDown={startDrag(mode)} onPointerEnter={point(mode)} style={{ cursor: "ew-resize" }}>
              <rect x={mode === "left" ? x - 6 : x - 10} y={0} width={16} height={NAV_H} fill="transparent" />
              {/* the handle: a 2 by 12 bar in ink, a step stronger under the pointer */}
              <rect
                x={hx - 1}
                y={NAV_H / 2 - 6}
                width={2}
                height={12}
                rx={1}
                fill="var(--foreground)"
                fillOpacity={grip === mode ? 0.9 : 0.5}
                pointerEvents="none"
                style={{ transition: "fill-opacity 150ms ease-out" }}
              />
            </g>
          ))}
        </svg>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}


// ─── components/ui/chart-overlay.tsx ───

"use client"

import { type ReactNode } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

/* Chart overlay: the two parts every library chart reads a point with (2026-10-02). They
   came out of Candlestick, Volume Profile, the trading terminal and Price Scrubber, which
   had each drawn their own; this is the one copy. Shipped beside the charts that use it.

   AxisTag   the outlined tag on the value axis: the pointed value in its hue, or a named
             reference (POC, last close) in ink. A pill 16px high, 8.5px figures.
   ChartCard the card laid over the chart beside the cursor: a heading row (a time or a
             range) at /60, then label and value rows (labels 10px /60, values 11px /90),
             the one signed figure in its hue. It glides between points on a spring, fades
             in from 0.97 and out in 120ms, and flips to the cursor's left when told to.

   2026-10-02: the card looked out of place over the charts, so it now wears the library
   popover, the same as the sidebar's hover card: a hairline border at 8%, radius 12, the
   6% foreground mix and the popover shadow with no inset highlight (spec 14.6). */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GLIDE = { type: "spring", stiffness: 520, damping: 40 } as const

/** the outlined tag on a chart's value axis, centred on `y` */
export function AxisTag({
  x,
  y,
  width,
  color = "var(--foreground)",
  strong = true,
  hidden = false,
  children,
}: {
  /** the tag's left edge, in the chart's own units */
  x: number
  /** the value's line; the tag is centred on it */
  y: number
  width: number
  /** stroke and figure; ink for a named reference, the series hue for the pointed value */
  color?: string
  /** a quieter tag (a secondary reference) drops the weight and the stroke */
  strong?: boolean
  /** fades the tag out, for when the pointed value sits on it */
  hidden?: boolean
  children: ReactNode
}) {
  return (
    <g transform={`translate(${x}, ${y - 8})`} pointerEvents="none" style={{ opacity: hidden ? 0 : 1, transition: "opacity 150ms" }}>
      <rect width={width} height={16} rx={8} fill="var(--background)" stroke={color} strokeOpacity={strong ? 0.6 : 0.2} />
      <text x={width / 2} y={11} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={8.5} fontWeight={strong ? 600 : 500} fill={color} fillOpacity={strong ? 1 : 0.65}>
        {children}
      </text>
    </g>
  )
