                  <span className="text-[11px] text-foreground/90" style={r.color ? { color: r.color } : undefined}>
                    {r.value}
                  </span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            {footer && <div className="mt-1.5 text-[10px]">{footer}</div>}
          </motion.div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  )
}

# Equity & Drawdown
// ─── components/ui/equity-drawdown.tsx ───

"use client"

import { useId, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react"
import { motion, useInView, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { AxisTag, ChartCard } from "@/components/ui/chart-overlay"

/* Equity Drawdown, rebuilt through the ssych-component skill (2026-09-29).
   What changed against the version before it (in git history), and why:
   · tabular figures are set once on the root, so the axis figure that missed them lines up
   · the readout is complete and in place: equity, the return to that point, the drawdown
     there and how long it has been under the peak. Before, only the equity was written
   · the outlined badge on the axis is plain text; an axis figure steps aside under it
   · the equity line follows the direction of the whole return, green for a gain and red
     for a loss (it was always green); the drawdown stays red
   · the dots carry no ring, the drawdown axis uses a true minus
   Motion (2026-10-01): once the chart first comes into view one clip wipes both panels in
   from the left, the equity line, its fill, the underwater line and its fill together, 900ms
   (it was a 400ms dash draw on mount). A new series of the same length morphs both lines and
   both fills point for point in 380ms; a series of another length is drawn at once. Reduced
   motion draws every state at once.
   2026-10-02 audit: the header has the three tiers (spec 14.1): the name at /45 with the
   window at /90, the last equity at 26px with its cents at /35, then the total return in its
   hue and "since start" at /45. The max drawdown left the header for the aria-label, and the
   pointed day reads in the shared ChartCard beside the cursor (equity, return, drawdown, days
   below the peak) instead of re-keying the header on every crosshair step and printing a
   sentence at 10px. The pointed equity is the shared AxisTag in the line's hue, gridlines
   are solid at 5%, axis figures are 9px /45 with dollars on the equity axis, and the chart
   is 460 wide (the other charts' width) with a viewBox and a w-full svg. A new `name` prop
   names the curve.
   Formulas:
   · return at a day = (equity − the first equity) ÷ the first equity × 100
   · drawdown at a day = (equity − the running peak) ÷ the running peak × 100
   · days below the peak = the day − the day of the last running peak
   · max drawdown = the lowest drawdown in the series */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GREEN = "var(--chart-up)"
const RED = "var(--chart-down)"

const N = 96

/** Deterministic equity walk so every render agrees (LCG, one seed). */
const DEFAULT_EQUITY: number[] = (() => {
  let s = 42
  const rnd = () => {
    s = (s * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7fffffff
    return s / 0x7fffffff
  }
  const out: number[] = []
  let v = 10000
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    v *= 1 + (rnd() - 0.42) * 0.022
    out.push(v)
  }
  return out
})()

/** compact or currency formatting with a real minus */
const fmt = (n: number, o: { compact?: boolean; currency?: boolean; precision?: number } = {}) => {
  const digits = o.precision ?? (o.compact ? 1 : 2)
  const body = new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US", {
    notation: o.compact ? "compact" : "standard",
    minimumFractionDigits: digits,
    maximumFractionDigits: digits,
    style: o.currency ? "currency" : "decimal",
    currency: "USD",
  }).format(Math.abs(n))
  return (n < 0 ? "−" : "") + body
}

const signedPct = (v: number, dp = 1) => `${v >= 0 ? "+" : "−"}${Math.abs(v).toFixed(dp)}%`

/** running drawdown and the index of the high-water mark, for any equity series */
function drawdownOf(eq: number[]) {
  const dd: number[] = []
  const lastHigh: number[] = []
  let top = Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY
  let topIdx = 0
  eq.forEach((v, i) => {
    if (v >= top) {
      top = v
      topIdx = i
    }
    dd.push(((v - top) / top) * 100)
    lastHigh.push(topIdx)
  })
  return { dd, lastHigh }
}

const W = 460
const H = 240
const PAD = { l: 8, r: 58, t: 16, b: 20 }
const PLOT_W = W - PAD.l - PAD.r
const DD_H = 54
const GAP = 14
const EQ_TOP = PAD.t
const EQ_BOT = H - PAD.b - DD_H - GAP
const DD_TOP = EQ_BOT + GAP
const DD_BOT = H - PAD.b

/**
 * A cumulative equity curve over its underwater panel (percent off the running peak). One
 * crosshair drives both and reads equity, the return to that point, the drawdown there
 * and how long it has been below the high-water mark. Every number is derivable: drawdown
 * is (value − peak) ÷ peak, the return is (value − first) ÷ first.
 */
export function EquityDrawdown({
  name = "Equity",
  base,
  series,
  className,
}: {
  /** what the curve is, on the label row's left */
  name?: string
  /** pin the demo curve so its last value is this number; a scale, so the drawdown pane stays identical */
  base?: number
  /** draw this series instead of the demo walk; any length */
  series?: number[]
  className?: string
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const uid = useId().replace(/:/g, "")
  const svgRef = useRef<SVGSVGElement>(null)
  const seen = useInView(svgRef, { once: true, amount: 0.3 })
  const shown = seen || !!reduced
  const [hi, setHi] = useState<number | null>(null)

  const { eq, n, dd, lastHigh, eqMin, eqMax, ddMin } = useMemo(() => {
    let eq: number[]
    if (series && series.length >= 2) eq = series
    else {
      const k = base != null && DEFAULT_EQUITY[N - 1] !== 0 ? base / DEFAULT_EQUITY[N - 1] : 1
      eq = k === 1 ? DEFAULT_EQUITY : DEFAULT_EQUITY.map((v) => v * k)
    }
    const { dd, lastHigh } = drawdownOf(eq)
    return {
      eq,
      n: eq.length,
      dd,
      lastHigh,
      eqMin: Math.min(...eq) * 0.998,
      eqMax: Math.max(...eq) * 1.002,
      ddMin: Math.min(...dd) * 1.1 || -1,
    }
  }, [base, series])

  const x = (i: number) => PAD.l + (i / (n - 1)) * PLOT_W
  const yEq = (v: number) => EQ_TOP + (1 - (v - eqMin) / (eqMax - eqMin || 1)) * (EQ_BOT - EQ_TOP)
  const yDd = (v: number) => DD_TOP + (v / ddMin) * (DD_BOT - DD_TOP)

  const geo = useMemo(() => {
    const eqLine = eq.map((v, i) => `${i === 0 ? "M" : "L"}${x(i).toFixed(1)},${yEq(v).toFixed(1)}`).join(" ")
    const eqArea = `${eqLine} L${x(n - 1).toFixed(1)},${EQ_BOT} L${x(0).toFixed(1)},${EQ_BOT} Z`
    const ddLine = dd.map((v, i) => `${i === 0 ? "M" : "L"}${x(i).toFixed(1)},${yDd(v).toFixed(1)}`).join(" ")
    const ddArea = `${ddLine} L${x(n - 1).toFixed(1)},${DD_TOP} L${x(0).toFixed(1)},${DD_TOP} Z`
    return { eqLine, eqArea, ddLine, ddArea }
    // the scales are derived from eq and dd; listing them keeps the memo honest
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [eq, dd, eqMin, eqMax, ddMin, n])

  const onMove = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    const el = svgRef.current
    if (!el) return
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect()
    const px = ((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width) * W
    setHi(Math.max(0, Math.min(n - 1, Math.round(((px - PAD.l) / PLOT_W) * (n - 1)))))
  }

  const active = hi ?? n - 1
  const retAt = (i: number) => ((eq[i] - eq[0]) / eq[0]) * 100
  const totalRet = retAt(n - 1)
  const maxDd = Math.min(...dd)
  const daysDown = active - lastHigh[active]
  const lineHue = totalRet >= 0 ? GREEN : RED
  const valueY = Math.max(EQ_TOP + 8, Math.min(EQ_BOT - 8, yEq(eq[active])))
  const fade = reduced ? "none" : "opacity 160ms"
  const morph = reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.38, ease: EASE }
  const [whole, cents] = fmt(eq[n - 1], { currency: true }).split(".")
  const retHue = (v: number) => (v >= 0 ? GREEN : RED)

  return (
    <div className={cn("w-[460px] max-w-full tabular-nums", className)}>
      {/* the header, three tiers (spec 14.1); the pointed day reads in the card, not here */}
      <div className="mb-3 flex items-baseline justify-between text-[12px]">
        <span className="truncate text-foreground/45">{name}</span>
        <span className="shrink-0 pl-3 font-medium text-foreground/90">{n} days</span>
      </div>
      <p className="m-0 text-[26px] font-semibold leading-none tracking-[-0.02em] text-foreground/90">
        {whole}
        {cents && <span className="text-foreground/35">.{cents}</span>}
      </p>
      <p className="mb-4 mt-2 flex items-baseline gap-[7px] text-[12px] font-medium" style={{ color: retHue(totalRet) }}>
        <span>{signedPct(totalRet, 2)}</span>
        <span className="font-normal text-foreground/45">since start</span>
      </p>

      <div className="relative">
        <svg
          ref={svgRef}
          width={W}
          height={H}
          viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`}
          className="block h-auto w-full cursor-crosshair touch-none"
          role="img"
          aria-label={`${name} curve with drawdown over ${n} days. Equity ${fmt(eq[n - 1], { currency: true, precision: 0 })}, return ${signedPct(totalRet)}, max drawdown ${signedPct(maxDd)}`}
          onPointerMove={onMove}
          onPointerLeave={() => setHi(null)}
        >
          <defs>
            <linearGradient id={`${uid}-eq`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
              <stop offset="0%" stopColor={lineHue} stopOpacity="0.16" style={{ transition: reduced ? "none" : "stop-color 200ms" }} />
              <stop offset="100%" stopColor={lineHue} stopOpacity="0" style={{ transition: reduced ? "none" : "stop-color 200ms" }} />
            </linearGradient>
            <linearGradient id={`${uid}-dd`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
              <stop offset="0%" stopColor={RED} stopOpacity="0.02" />
              <stop offset="100%" stopColor={RED} stopOpacity="0.22" />
            </linearGradient>
            {/* the entrance: one clip wipes both panels in from the left, once */}
            <clipPath id={`${uid}-wipe`}>
              <motion.rect
                x={0}
                y={0}
                height={H}
                initial={{ width: reduced ? W - PAD.r + 4 : 0 }}
                animate={{ width: shown ? W - PAD.r + 4 : 0 }}
                transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.9, ease: EASE }}
              />
            </clipPath>
          </defs>

          {[0, 0.5, 1].map((f) => {
            const gy = EQ_TOP + f * (EQ_BOT - EQ_TOP)
            const under = hi !== null && Math.abs(gy - valueY) < 11
            return (
              <g key={f}>
                <line x1={PAD.l} y1={gy} x2={W - PAD.r} y2={gy} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.05} strokeWidth={1} />
                <text
                  x={W - PAD.r + 8}
                  y={gy + 3}
                  fontSize={9}
                  fill="var(--foreground)"
                  fillOpacity={0.45}
                  style={{ opacity: under ? 0 : 1, transition: fade }}
                >
                  {fmt(eqMax - f * (eqMax - eqMin), { compact: true, currency: true })}
                </text>
              </g>
            )
          })}

          {/* drawdown panel: the zero line is the only solid gridline; it sits under the curves */}
          <line x1={PAD.l} y1={DD_TOP} x2={W - PAD.r} y2={DD_TOP} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.05} strokeWidth={1} />
          <text x={W - PAD.r + 8} y={DD_TOP + 3} fontSize={9} fill="var(--foreground)" fillOpacity={0.45}>
            0%
          </text>
          <text x={W - PAD.r + 8} y={DD_BOT + 2} fontSize={9} fill="var(--foreground)" fillOpacity={0.45}>
            {`${ddMin < 0 ? "−" : ""}${Math.abs(ddMin).toFixed(0)}%`}
          </text>

          {/* keyed by length: same-length series morph point for point, another length is drawn at once */}
          <g key={n} clipPath={`url(#${uid}-wipe)`}>
            <motion.path initial={false} animate={{ d: geo.eqArea }} transition={morph} fill={`url(#${uid}-eq)`} />
            <motion.path
              initial={false}
              animate={{ d: geo.eqLine }}
              transition={morph}
              fill="none"
              stroke={lineHue}
              strokeWidth={1.8}
              strokeLinecap="round"
              strokeLinejoin="round"
              style={{ transition: reduced ? "none" : "stroke 200ms" }}
            />
            <motion.path initial={false} animate={{ d: geo.ddArea }} transition={morph} fill={`url(#${uid}-dd)`} />
            <motion.path
              initial={false}
              animate={{ d: geo.ddLine }}
              transition={morph}
              fill="none"
              stroke={RED}
              strokeOpacity={0.8}
              strokeWidth={1.2}
              strokeLinejoin="round"
            />
          </g>

          {/* the current underwater episode, from the high-water mark to the cursor */}
          {hi !== null && daysDown > 0 && (
            <g pointerEvents="none">
              <rect
                x={x(lastHigh[active])}
                y={DD_TOP}
                width={x(active) - x(lastHigh[active])}
                height={DD_BOT - DD_TOP}
                fill={`color-mix(in srgb, ${RED} 8%, transparent)`}
              />
              <line
                x1={x(lastHigh[active])}
                y1={yEq(eq[lastHigh[active]])}
                x2={x(active)}
                y2={yEq(eq[lastHigh[active]])}
                stroke={`color-mix(in srgb, ${RED} 45%, transparent)`}
                strokeWidth={1}
                strokeDasharray="3 3"
              />
              <circle cx={x(lastHigh[active])} cy={yEq(eq[lastHigh[active]])} r={2.4} fill="var(--foreground)" fillOpacity={0.45} />
            </g>
          )}

          {/* one crosshair across both panels, the equity tagged on the axis (chart-overlay.tsx) */}
          {hi !== null && (
            <g pointerEvents="none">
              <line x1={x(active)} y1={EQ_TOP} x2={x(active)} y2={DD_BOT} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.2} strokeWidth={1} />
              <circle cx={x(active)} cy={yEq(eq[active])} r={3} fill={lineHue} stroke="var(--background)" strokeWidth={1.5} />
              <circle cx={x(active)} cy={yDd(dd[active])} r={2.6} fill={RED} />
              <AxisTag x={W - PAD.r + 4} y={valueY} width={PAD.r - 6} color={lineHue}>
                {fmt(eq[active], { compact: true, currency: true })}
              </AxisTag>
            </g>
          )}
        </svg>

        {/* the pointed day, read beside the cursor; it flips left past 60% of the plot */}
        <ChartCard
          open={hi !== null}
          x={`${(x(active) / W) * 100}%`}
          flip={x(active) > PAD.l + PLOT_W * 0.6}
          heading={`Day ${active + 1} of ${n}`}
          rows={[
            { label: "Equity", value: fmt(eq[active], { currency: true }) },
            { label: "Return", value: signedPct(retAt(active), 2), color: retHue(retAt(active)) },
            { label: "Drawdown", value: signedPct(dd[active], 2) },
            { label: "Below peak", value: daysDown > 0 ? `${daysDown} ${daysDown === 1 ? "day" : "days"}` : "At the peak" },
          ]}
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}


// ─── components/ui/chart-overlay.tsx ───

"use client"

import { type ReactNode } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

/* Chart overlay: the two parts every library chart reads a point with (2026-10-02). They
   came out of Candlestick, Volume Profile, the trading terminal and Price Scrubber, which
   had each drawn their own; this is the one copy. Shipped beside the charts that use it.

   AxisTag   the outlined tag on the value axis: the pointed value in its hue, or a named
             reference (POC, last close) in ink. A pill 16px high, 8.5px figures.
   ChartCard the card laid over the chart beside the cursor: a heading row (a time or a
             range) at /60, then label and value rows (labels 10px /60, values 11px /90),
             the one signed figure in its hue. It glides between points on a spring, fades
             in from 0.97 and out in 120ms, and flips to the cursor's left when told to.

   2026-10-02: the card looked out of place over the charts, so it now wears the library
   popover, the same as the sidebar's hover card: a hairline border at 8%, radius 12, the
   6% foreground mix and the popover shadow with no inset highlight (spec 14.6). */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GLIDE = { type: "spring", stiffness: 520, damping: 40 } as const

/** the outlined tag on a chart's value axis, centred on `y` */
export function AxisTag({
  x,
  y,
  width,
  color = "var(--foreground)",
  strong = true,
  hidden = false,
  children,
}: {
  /** the tag's left edge, in the chart's own units */
  x: number
  /** the value's line; the tag is centred on it */
  y: number
  width: number
  /** stroke and figure; ink for a named reference, the series hue for the pointed value */
  color?: string
  /** a quieter tag (a secondary reference) drops the weight and the stroke */
  strong?: boolean
  /** fades the tag out, for when the pointed value sits on it */
  hidden?: boolean
  children: ReactNode
}) {
  return (
    <g transform={`translate(${x}, ${y - 8})`} pointerEvents="none" style={{ opacity: hidden ? 0 : 1, transition: "opacity 150ms" }}>
      <rect width={width} height={16} rx={8} fill="var(--background)" stroke={color} strokeOpacity={strong ? 0.6 : 0.2} />
      <text x={width / 2} y={11} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={8.5} fontWeight={strong ? 600 : 500} fill={color} fillOpacity={strong ? 1 : 0.65}>
        {children}
      </text>
    </g>
  )
}

export interface ChartCardRow {
  label: string
  value: ReactNode
  /** only the one signed figure carries a hue */
  color?: string
}

/** the readout card over a chart; place it inside a `relative` box that holds the svg */
export function ChartCard({
  open,
  x,
  y = 4,
  flip = false,
  width = 148,
  heading,
  rows,
  footer,
}: {
  open: boolean
  /** the cursor's x inside the box: px, or a percentage string for a chart drawn to a viewBox */
  x: number | string
  /** the card's top inside the box, px */
  y?: number
  /** put the card on the cursor's left (past ~60% of the plot) */
  flip?: boolean
  width?: number
  heading: ReactNode
  rows: ChartCardRow[]
  /** a closing line under the rows, such as where the point sits */
  footer?: ReactNode
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {open && (
        <motion.div
          key="chart-card"
          role="status"
          className="pointer-events-none absolute z-10"
          initial={{ left: x, top: y, opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ left: x, top: y, opacity: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, transition: { duration: 0.12 } }}
          transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { left: GLIDE, top: GLIDE, opacity: { duration: 0.15 } }}
        >
          <motion.div
            className="rounded-[12px] border border-foreground/[0.08] px-3 py-2.5"
            style={{
              width,
              translate: flip ? "calc(-100% - 12px) 0" : "12px 0",
              transition: reduced ? undefined : "translate 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)",
              background: "var(--tip-fill, color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 6%, var(--background)))",
              boxShadow: "0 8px 24px var(--card-shadow, rgba(0,0,0,calc(0.35 * var(--shadow-k, 1))))",
            }}
            initial={reduced ? false : { scale: 0.97 }}
            animate={{ scale: 1 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
          >
            <div className="text-[10px] text-foreground/60">{heading}</div>
            <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-col gap-1">
              {rows.map((r) => (
                <div key={r.label} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-foreground/60">{r.label}</span>
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-foreground/90" style={r.color ? { color: r.color } : undefined}>
                    {r.value}
                  </span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            {footer && <div className="mt-1.5 text-[10px]">{footer}</div>}
          </motion.div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  )
}

# Performance Chart
// ─── components/ui/performance-chart.tsx ───

"use client"

import { useId, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useInView, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { AxisTag, ChartCard } from "@/components/ui/chart-overlay"
import { SegmentedControl } from "@/components/ui/segmented-control"
import { ChartMenu } from "@/components/ui/performance-chart-menu"

/* Performance Chart, written new through ssych-component (2026-09-29).
   What it is for: your return against a benchmark over the same window. Both start at
   zero on the first day and share one axis, so every crossing is real.
   Read first: the solid line. It is green where you lead the benchmark and red where
   you trail it; the dotted line is the benchmark.
   The pointer: scrubbing reads your return, the benchmark's and the gap between them on
   that day, and everything to the right of the pointer dims. The pills change the
   benchmark and the window. The arrow keys step a session at a time on the chart.
   Sketch used: src/components/lab/PerformanceChart.tsx. Kept: both series rebased to the
   window's first day, the lead and lag split with its colour changing exactly on the
   crossing, the dim to the right of the pointer, the two invented benchmarks, the average
   daily move.
   Changed: it was 652px in a card; it is 500px on the page. The benchmark line is ink (it
   was yellow), its logo is gone, the floating readout became a line of text in place, and
   the right side is dimmed by drawing it at lower strength, not by laying a veil over it.
   Numbers fixed: the longest window was labelled 5Y over 260 sessions, which is one
   trading year; it is 1Y now. 6M is 126 sessions (it was 130).
   2026-10-02 audit: a lot of numbers and a legend with little hierarchy (his call). Four
   figures of equal weight in an 11px row gave way to one header in tiers (spec 14.1): the
   legend in the label row (a 10 by 2 line for you in green and red, the benchmark's dotted
   line, names at /60, no values) with the window switch on the right (the shared
   SegmentedControl, moved up from under the plot), then your return at 26px with its
   decimals at /35, then the gap to the benchmark in its hue with the window at /45. The
   benchmark's name in the legend is the benchmark picker, a menu in the dashboards'
   dropdown look (performance-chart-menu.tsx), in place of a second pill row. "Average a
   day" is gone. The pointed session reads in the shared ChartCard (you, the benchmark, the
   gap in its hue) with your return tagged on the axis, and the header holds still while
   scrubbing. Gridlines are solid at 5%, axis figures 9px /45.
   Formulas, over the sessions in the window:
   · return(i)   walk(i) − walk(first day of the window), in percent
   · gap         your return − the benchmark's, in percentage points
   · crossing    where the gap changes sign, placed between the two sessions by
                 a ÷ (a − c) for the gaps a and c on either side (since 2026-10-01 drawn by
                 a clip whose edge is the gap × STEEP, which meets the plot at that point)
   2026-09-30: the benchmark is the second thing on the surface to tell apart, so it takes
   var(--chart-1) (the first telling-apart colour; green and red already mean lead and
   trail here) in its line, its legend dots, its figure and its scrub dot. The lines wipe
   in once from the left on mount (400ms); a new benchmark or window cross-fades them and
   swaps the readout in place; scrubbing and the arrow keys move at once.
   2026-10-01: the visible title is gone (it names the chart for screen readers) and the key
   row under the chart moved into the readout, each mark by its series' name and figure.
   Motion (2026-10-01): the lines sweep in from the left once the chart is a third in view
   (one clip, 900ms); a new benchmark or window tweens both lines, the lead and trail split
   and the zero line to the new state (400ms) where they cross-faded before, and the tick
   figures fade to their new values; reduced motion shows each state at once.
   2026-10-02 round 2: the two benchmarks are named S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 in place of the
   invented Meridian 500 and Vector 100, so an equity buyer reads them at once. Their walks
   (seed, drift, volatility) are unchanged, so every figure and crossing stays as it was. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GREEN = "var(--chart-up)"
const RED = "var(--chart-down)"
const BENCH = "var(--chart-1)"
const SESSIONS = 260
/** how far the lead and trail clip is pushed per point of gap, in plot units */
const STEEP = 20000

export interface PerformanceWalk {
  seed: number
  /** mean daily move, in percent */
  drift: number
  /** size of the daily noise, in percent */
  vol: number
}

export interface PerformanceBenchmark extends PerformanceWalk {
  key: string
  label: string
}

export interface PerformanceTimeframe {
  key: string
  /** trading sessions in the window */
  days: number
}

export interface PerformanceChartProps {
  /** names the chart for screen readers */
  title?: string
  you?: PerformanceWalk
  /** the indices to compare against, by name only (no index marks are drawn) */
  benchmarks?: PerformanceBenchmark[]
  timeframes?: PerformanceTimeframe[]
  defaultBenchmark?: number
  defaultTimeframe?: number
  className?: string
}

const DEFAULT_YOU: PerformanceWalk = { seed: 3, drift: 0.055, vol: 0.9 }

const DEFAULT_BENCHMARKS: PerformanceBenchmark[] = [
  { key: "spx", label: "S&P 500", seed: 7, drift: 0.045, vol: 0.75 },
  { key: "ndx", label: "Nasdaq 100", seed: 21, drift: 0.06, vol: 1.05 },
]

const DEFAULT_TIMEFRAMES: PerformanceTimeframe[] = [
  { key: "1M", days: 22 },
  { key: "3M", days: 66 },
  { key: "6M", days: 126 },
  { key: "YTD", days: 138 },
  { key: "1Y", days: 260 },
]

/** The same walk on every render. */
function walk({ seed, drift, vol }: PerformanceWalk, n = SESSIONS): number[] {
  let s = seed >>> 0
  const rnd = () => {
    s = (s * 1664525 + 1013904223) >>> 0
    return s / 2 ** 32 - 0.5
  }
  const out = [0]
  for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) out.push(out[i - 1] + drift + rnd() * vol + Math.sin(i / 9) * 0.12)
  return out
}

const W = 500
const H = 200
const PAD = { t: 10, r: 48, b: 8, l: 2 }
/** what a window measures over, in words; an unknown key reads as itself */
const WINDOW_WORDS: Record<string, string> = { "1M": "past month", "3M": "past 3 months", "6M": "past 6 months", YTD: "year to date", "1Y": "past year" }

const signed = (v: number) => `${v >= 0 ? "+" : "−"}${Math.abs(v).toFixed(2)}`

/** a window's line through every session, always written with `m` vertices (a short window
 *  repeats its sessions), so a new window tweens the path instead of redrawing it */
function trace(vals: number[], m: number, px: (i: number) => number, py: (v: number) => number) {
  const n = vals.length
  let d = ""
  for (let k = 0; k < m; k++) {
    const i = m > 1 && n > 1 ? Math.round((k * (n - 1)) / (m - 1)) : 0
    d += `${k ? " L" : "M"}${px(i).toFixed(1)} ${py(vals[i]).toFixed(1)}`
  }
  return d
}
/** A hue as text: its lightness is capped in the light theme so small figures stay readable. */
const ink = (c: string) => `oklch(from ${c} min(l, var(--ink-l, 1)) c h)`

/**
 * Your return as a solid line over a dotted benchmark, both from zero at the start of the
 * window. The line is green while you lead and red while you trail.
 */
export function PerformanceChart({
  title = "Performance",
  you: yours = DEFAULT_YOU,
  benchmarks = DEFAULT_BENCHMARKS,
  timeframes = DEFAULT_TIMEFRAMES,
  defaultBenchmark = 0,
  defaultTimeframe = 2,
  className,
}: PerformanceChartProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const uid = useId().replace(/:/g, "")
  const boxRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  /* the sweep waits until the plot is a third in view, then plays once */
  const play = useInView(boxRef, { once: true, amount: 0.3 }) || !!reduced
  const tween = reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.4, ease: EASE }
  const [bench, setBench] = useState(defaultBenchmark)
  const [tf, setTf] = useState(defaultTimeframe)
  const [hi, setHi] = useState<number | null>(null)

  const b = benchmarks[bench] ?? benchmarks[0]
  const frame = timeframes[tf] ?? timeframes[0]
  const days = Math.max(2, Math.min(SESSIONS, frame.days))

  const { series, you } = useMemo(() => {
    const cut = (full: number[]) => {
      const win = full.slice(full.length - days)
      return win.map((v) => v - win[0])
    }
    return { series: cut(walk(b)), you: cut(walk(yours)) }
  }, [b, yours, days])

  const last = days - 1
  const min = Math.min(...series, ...you)
  const max = Math.max(...series, ...you)
  const x = (i: number) => PAD.l + (i / last) * (W - PAD.l - PAD.r)
  const y = (v: number) => PAD.t + (1 - (v - min) / (max - min || 1)) * (H - PAD.t - PAD.b)
  const benchD = trace(series, SESSIONS, x, y)
  const youD = trace(you, SESSIONS, x, y)
  /* the lead and trail split: your line is drawn twice, green clipped to the days you lead
     and red to the days you trail. Each clip is the gap pushed STEEP units per point off the
     middle of the plot, so its edge crosses the plot within a hair of the crossing and the
     colour turns where the lines meet; written with the same vertices as the lines, it tweens
     with them. */
  const gaps = you.map((v, i) => v - series[i])
  /* day one is always level, so it takes its side from the first day that separates */
  gaps[0] = (gaps.find((g) => g !== 0) ?? 0) >= 0 ? 0.01 : -0.01
  const gy = (g: number) => H / 2 - g * STEEP
  const edge = trace(gaps, SESSIONS, x, gy).slice(1)
  const lim = (H + STEEP * Math.max(...gaps.map(Math.abs)) + 10).toFixed(0)
  const ga = gy(gaps[0]).toFixed(1)
  const gz = gy(gaps[last]).toFixed(1)
  const leadD = `M-10 ${ga} L${edge} L${W + 10} ${gz} L${W + 10} ${lim} L-10 ${lim} Z`
  const trailD = `M-10 ${ga} L${edge} L${W + 10} ${gz} L${W + 10} -${lim} L-10 -${lim} Z`

  const at = hi ?? last
  const gap = you[at] - series[at]
  const tone = gap >= 0 ? GREEN : RED
  const restGap = you[last] - series[last]
  const split = hi === null ? W : x(hi)
  const ticks = [0.1, 0.5, 0.9].map((f) => min + (max - min) * f)
  const tagY = hi === null ? 0 : Math.max(PAD.t + 8, Math.min(H - PAD.b - 8, y(you[hi])))
  const [retWhole, retDec] = signed(you[last]).split(".")
  const ago = last - at

  const onMove = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    const r = boxRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect()
    if (!r) return
    const px = ((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width) * W
    setHi(Math.max(0, Math.min(last, Math.round(((px - PAD.l) / (W - PAD.l - PAD.r)) * last))))
  }

  const lines = (
    <>
      <motion.path initial={false} animate={{ d: benchD }} transition={tween} stroke={BENCH} strokeOpacity={0.85} strokeWidth="1.6" strokeLinecap="round" strokeDasharray="0.1 5" />
      <g clipPath={`url(#${uid}-lead)`}>
        <motion.path initial={false} animate={{ d: youD }} transition={tween} stroke={GREEN} strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
      </g>
      <g clipPath={`url(#${uid}-trail)`}>
        <motion.path initial={false} animate={{ d: youD }} transition={tween} stroke={RED} strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
      </g>
    </>
  )

  return (
    <div className={cn("w-[500px] max-w-full tabular-nums [--ink-l:0.5] dark:[--ink-l:1]", className)}>
      {/* the label row: the legend (no values, the headline holds yours) and the window switch */}
      <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-3 text-[11px]">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-foreground/60">
            {/* your line is green while it leads and red while it trails, so its mark carries both */}
            <span aria-hidden className="h-[2px] w-2.5 shrink-0 rounded-full" style={{ background: `linear-gradient(90deg, ${GREEN} 50%, ${RED} 50%)` }} />
            You
          </span>
          <span className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1.5">
            <span aria-hidden className="flex w-2.5 shrink-0 justify-between">
              <span className="h-[2px] w-[2px] rounded-full" style={{ background: BENCH }} />
              <span className="h-[2px] w-[2px] rounded-full" style={{ background: BENCH }} />
              <span className="h-[2px] w-[2px] rounded-full" style={{ background: BENCH }} />
            </span>
            {/* the benchmark's name is its picker */}
            <ChartMenu
              label={`Benchmark, ${b.label}`}
              options={benchmarks.map((m) => ({ value: m.key, label: m.label }))}
              value={b.key}
              onPick={(k) => {
                setBench(Math.max(0, benchmarks.findIndex((m) => m.key === k)))
                setHi(null)
              }}
              triggerClassName="-mx-1.5 h-7 rounded-full px-1.5 text-foreground/60 transition-colors duration-150 hover:bg-foreground/[0.06] hover:text-foreground/90 focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.06]"
            >
              <span className="truncate">{b.label}</span>
            </ChartMenu>
          </span>
        </div>
        <SegmentedControl
          options={timeframes.map((t) => t.key)}
          value={frame.key}
          onChange={(k) => {
            setTf(Math.max(0, timeframes.findIndex((t) => t.key === k)))
            setHi(null)
          }}
          label="Window"
          className="shrink-0"
        />
      </div>

      {/* a new benchmark or window swaps the figures in place (4px, 2px blur, 150ms); the pointer never does */}
      <motion.div
        role="status"
        key={`${b.key}-${frame.key}`}
        initial={reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: 4, filter: "blur(2px)" }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, filter: "blur(0px)" }}
        transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
      >
        <p className="m-0 text-[26px] font-semibold leading-none tracking-[-0.02em] text-foreground/90">
          {retWhole}
          <span className="text-foreground/35">.{retDec}%</span>
        </p>
        <p className="mb-0 mt-2 flex items-baseline gap-[7px] text-[12px] font-medium" style={{ color: ink(restGap >= 0 ? GREEN : RED) }}>
          <span>
            {signed(restGap)} pts vs {b.label}
          </span>
          <span className="font-normal text-foreground/45">{WINDOW_WORDS[frame.key] ?? frame.key}</span>
        </p>
      </motion.div>

      <div className="relative mt-4">
        <div
          ref={boxRef}
          className="cursor-crosshair touch-none outline-none"
          tabIndex={0}
          onPointerMove={onMove}
          onPointerLeave={() => setHi(null)}
          onBlur={() => setHi(null)}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key !== "ArrowLeft" && e.key !== "ArrowRight") return
            e.preventDefault()
            setHi(Math.max(0, Math.min(last, (hi ?? last) + (e.key === "ArrowLeft" ? -1 : 1))))
          }}
        >
          <svg
            width={W}
            height={H}
            viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`}
            className="block h-auto w-full"
            fill="none"
            role="img"
            aria-label={`${title}: your return ${signed(you[last])}% against ${b.label} ${signed(series[last])}% over ${frame.key}, ${signed(you[last] - series[last])} points ${you[last] - series[last] >= 0 ? "ahead" : "behind"}`}
          >
            <defs>
              {/* the days you lead and the days you trail, tweened with the lines */}
              <clipPath id={`${uid}-lead`}>
                <motion.path initial={false} animate={{ d: leadD }} transition={tween} />
              </clipPath>
              <clipPath id={`${uid}-trail`}>
                <motion.path initial={false} animate={{ d: trailD }} transition={tween} />
              </clipPath>
              {/* the entrance: one clip that opens from the left edge, once */}
              <clipPath id={`${uid}-draw`}>
                <motion.rect
                  x={0}
                  y={0}
                  height={H}
                  initial={reduced ? false : { width: 0 }}
                  animate={{ width: play ? W : 0 }}
                  transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.9, ease: EASE }}
                />
              </clipPath>
              <clipPath id={`${uid}-past`}>
                <rect x={0} y={0} width={split} height={H} />
              </clipPath>
              <clipPath id={`${uid}-ahead`}>
                <rect x={split} y={0} width={Math.max(0, W - split)} height={H} />
              </clipPath>
            </defs>

            {ticks.map((v, i) => {
              const t = `${signed(v).replace(/\.\d+$/, (m) => m.slice(0, 2))}%`
              return (
                <g key={i}>
                  <line x1={PAD.l} x2={W - PAD.r} y1={y(v)} y2={y(v)} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.05} strokeWidth="1" />
                  {/* the ticks hold their places; a new figure fades in over the old one */}
                  <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
                    <motion.text
                      key={t}
                      x={W - PAD.r + 6}
                      y={y(v) + 3}
                      fontSize={9}
                      fill="var(--foreground)"
                      initial={{ fillOpacity: 0 }}
                      animate={{ fillOpacity: 0.45 }}
                      style={{ opacity: hi !== null && Math.abs(y(v) - tagY) < 12 ? 0 : 1, transition: reduced ? "none" : "opacity 150ms" }}
                      exit={{ fillOpacity: 0 }}
                      transition={tween}
                    >
                      {t}
                    </motion.text>
                  </AnimatePresence>
                </g>
              )
            })}
            {/* level with the start of the window: the only solid gridline; it rides to its new
                height with the lines (a CSS transform, so it is placed before any script runs) */}
            <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
              {min < 0 && max > 0 && (
                <motion.g key="zero" initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }} transition={tween}>
                  <line
                    x1={PAD.l}
                    x2={W - PAD.r}
                    y1={0}
                    y2={0}
                    stroke="var(--foreground)"
                    strokeOpacity={0.1}
                    strokeWidth="1"
                    style={{ transform: `translateY(${y(0).toFixed(1)}px)`, transition: reduced ? "none" : "transform 400ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)" }}
                  />
                </motion.g>
              )}
            </AnimatePresence>

            <g clipPath={`url(#${uid}-draw)`}>
              <g clipPath={`url(#${uid}-past)`}>{lines}</g>
              <g clipPath={`url(#${uid}-ahead)`} opacity={0.35}>
                {lines}
              </g>
            </g>

            {hi !== null && (
              <g pointerEvents="none">
                <line x1={x(hi)} y1={PAD.t} x2={x(hi)} y2={H - PAD.b} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.18} strokeWidth="1" />
                <circle cx={x(hi)} cy={y(series[hi])} r="2.4" fill={BENCH} />
                <circle cx={x(hi)} cy={y(you[hi])} r="3" fill={tone} stroke="var(--background)" strokeWidth={1.5} />
                <AxisTag x={W - PAD.r + 2} y={tagY} width={PAD.r - 2} color={tone}>
                  {signed(you[hi])}%
                </AxisTag>
              </g>
            )}
          </svg>
        </div>

        {/* the pointed session, read beside the cursor (chart-overlay.tsx); it flips left past 60% */}
        <ChartCard
          open={hi !== null}
          x={`${(split / W) * 100}%`}
          flip={hi !== null && x(hi) > (W - PAD.r) * 0.6}
          heading={ago === 0 ? "Last session" : ago === 1 ? "1 session ago" : `${ago} sessions ago`}
          rows={[
            { label: "You", value: `${signed(you[at])}%` },
            { label: b.label, value: `${signed(series[at])}%` },
            { label: "Gap", value: `${signed(gap)} pts`, color: ink(tone) },
          ]}
          width={168}
        />
      </div>

    </div>
  )
}


// ─── components/ui/chart-overlay.tsx ───

"use client"

import { type ReactNode } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

/* Chart overlay: the two parts every library chart reads a point with (2026-10-02). They
   came out of Candlestick, Volume Profile, the trading terminal and Price Scrubber, which
   had each drawn their own; this is the one copy. Shipped beside the charts that use it.

   AxisTag   the outlined tag on the value axis: the pointed value in its hue, or a named
             reference (POC, last close) in ink. A pill 16px high, 8.5px figures.
   ChartCard the card laid over the chart beside the cursor: a heading row (a time or a
             range) at /60, then label and value rows (labels 10px /60, values 11px /90),
             the one signed figure in its hue. It glides between points on a spring, fades
             in from 0.97 and out in 120ms, and flips to the cursor's left when told to.

   2026-10-02: the card looked out of place over the charts, so it now wears the library
   popover, the same as the sidebar's hover card: a hairline border at 8%, radius 12, the
   6% foreground mix and the popover shadow with no inset highlight (spec 14.6). */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GLIDE = { type: "spring", stiffness: 520, damping: 40 } as const

/** the outlined tag on a chart's value axis, centred on `y` */
export function AxisTag({
  x,
  y,
  width,
  color = "var(--foreground)",
  strong = true,
  hidden = false,
  children,
}: {
  /** the tag's left edge, in the chart's own units */
  x: number
  /** the value's line; the tag is centred on it */
  y: number
  width: number
  /** stroke and figure; ink for a named reference, the series hue for the pointed value */
  color?: string
  /** a quieter tag (a secondary reference) drops the weight and the stroke */
  strong?: boolean
  /** fades the tag out, for when the pointed value sits on it */
  hidden?: boolean
  children: ReactNode
}) {
  return (
    <g transform={`translate(${x}, ${y - 8})`} pointerEvents="none" style={{ opacity: hidden ? 0 : 1, transition: "opacity 150ms" }}>
      <rect width={width} height={16} rx={8} fill="var(--background)" stroke={color} strokeOpacity={strong ? 0.6 : 0.2} />
      <text x={width / 2} y={11} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={8.5} fontWeight={strong ? 600 : 500} fill={color} fillOpacity={strong ? 1 : 0.65}>
        {children}
      </text>
    </g>
  )
}

export interface ChartCardRow {
  label: string
  value: ReactNode
  /** only the one signed figure carries a hue */
  color?: string
}

/** the readout card over a chart; place it inside a `relative` box that holds the svg */
export function ChartCard({
  open,
  x,
  y = 4,
  flip = false,
  width = 148,
  heading,
  rows,
  footer,
}: {
  open: boolean
  /** the cursor's x inside the box: px, or a percentage string for a chart drawn to a viewBox */
  x: number | string
  /** the card's top inside the box, px */
  y?: number
  /** put the card on the cursor's left (past ~60% of the plot) */
  flip?: boolean
  width?: number
  heading: ReactNode
  rows: ChartCardRow[]
  /** a closing line under the rows, such as where the point sits */
  footer?: ReactNode
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {open && (
        <motion.div
          key="chart-card"
          role="status"
          className="pointer-events-none absolute z-10"
          initial={{ left: x, top: y, opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ left: x, top: y, opacity: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, transition: { duration: 0.12 } }}
          transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { left: GLIDE, top: GLIDE, opacity: { duration: 0.15 } }}
        >
          <motion.div
            className="rounded-[12px] border border-foreground/[0.08] px-3 py-2.5"
            style={{
              width,
              translate: flip ? "calc(-100% - 12px) 0" : "12px 0",
              transition: reduced ? undefined : "translate 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)",
              background: "var(--tip-fill, color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 6%, var(--background)))",
              boxShadow: "0 8px 24px var(--card-shadow, rgba(0,0,0,calc(0.35 * var(--shadow-k, 1))))",
            }}
            initial={reduced ? false : { scale: 0.97 }}
            animate={{ scale: 1 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
          >
            <div className="text-[10px] text-foreground/60">{heading}</div>
            <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-col gap-1">
              {rows.map((r) => (
                <div key={r.label} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-foreground/60">{r.label}</span>
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-foreground/90" style={r.color ? { color: r.color } : undefined}>
                    {r.value}
                  </span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            {footer && <div className="mt-1.5 text-[10px]">{footer}</div>}
          </motion.div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  )
}


// ─── components/ui/performance-chart-menu.tsx ───

"use client"

import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent, type ReactNode } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"
import { Check, ChevronDown } from "lucide-react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { RAISED } from "@/components/ui/control-classes"

/* Chart menu (2026-10-02 audit): the dashboards' dropdown look (src/components/lab/screen/
   Select.tsx), copied here because a library component cannot import lab files. A trigger
   that opens a solid menu under it, never the browser's native list: radius 18 holding 12px
   rows at a 6px padding (18 = 12 + 6), the raised step (white in light, a 12% foreground mix in dark),
   a hairline at 8% and the popover shadow. It starts closed and opens on a press. Keyboard:
   Enter, Space or the down arrow opens it, the arrows move, Enter picks, Escape closes.
   Written for Performance Chart (the benchmark) and used by Graph Comparison (the add
   list); it is generic, so it could become a shared part. */

export interface ChartMenuOption {
  value: string
  label: string
  /** a mark before the label, such as a company or token mark */
  icon?: ReactNode
  /** a quiet figure or note on the right */
  hint?: string
  disabled?: boolean
}

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const

export function ChartMenu({
  label,
  options,
  value,
  onPick,
  children,
  align = "left",
  disabled = false,
  chevron = true,
  className,
  triggerClassName,
}: {
  /** the accessible name of the trigger and the list */
  label: string
  options: ChartMenuOption[]
  /** the chosen option, ticked in the list; leave out for an action menu */
  value?: string
  onPick: (value: string) => void
  /** what the trigger shows */
  children: ReactNode
  /** which edge of the trigger the menu lines up with */
  align?: "left" | "right"
  /** the trigger cannot open the menu, such as when there is nothing to add */
  disabled?: boolean
  /** the chevron after the trigger's content; off for an icon-only trigger */
  chevron?: boolean
  className?: string
  triggerClassName?: string
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const uid = useId()
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const [hi, setHi] = useState(0)
  const root = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const btn = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return
    const doc = root.current?.ownerDocument ?? document
    const away = (e: Event) => {
      if (!root.current?.contains(e.target as Node)) setOpen(false)
    }
    doc.addEventListener("pointerdown", away)
    return () => doc.removeEventListener("pointerdown", away)
  }, [open])

  const firstFree = (from: number, step: number) => {
    for (let k = 0, i = from; k < options.length; k++, i = (i + step + options.length) % options.length) if (!options[i]?.disabled) return i
    return from
  }
  const show = () => {
    const at = options.findIndex((o) => o.value === value)
    setHi(firstFree(at >= 0 ? at : 0, 1))
    setOpen(true)
  }
  const pick = (v: string) => {
    onPick(v)
    setOpen(false)
    btn.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true })
  }
  const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (disabled) return
    if (!open) {
      if (e.key === "ArrowDown" || e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {
        e.preventDefault()
        show()
      }
      return
    }
    if (e.key === "Escape") {
      e.preventDefault()
      e.stopPropagation()
      setOpen(false)
      btn.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true })
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
      e.preventDefault()
      setHi((h) => firstFree((h + 1) % options.length, 1))
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
      e.preventDefault()
      setHi((h) => firstFree((h - 1 + options.length) % options.length, -1))
    } else if ((e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") && options[hi] && !options[hi].disabled) {
      e.preventDefault()
      pick(options[hi].value)
    } else if (e.key === "Tab") setOpen(false)
  }

  return (
    <div ref={root} className={cn("relative", className)} onKeyDown={onKey}>
      <button
        ref={btn}
        type="button"
        aria-haspopup="listbox"
        aria-expanded={open}
        aria-controls={open ? `${uid}-list` : undefined}
        aria-label={label}
        disabled={disabled}
        onClick={() => (open ? setOpen(false) : show())}
        className={cn("inline-flex items-center gap-1 outline-none", triggerClassName)}
      >
        {children}
        {chevron && <ChevronDown aria-hidden className={cn("size-3 shrink-0 text-foreground/60 transition-transform duration-200 motion-reduce:transition-none", open && "rotate-180")} strokeWidth={2} />}
      </button>
      <AnimatePresence>
        {open && (
          <motion.div
            id={`${uid}-list`}
            role="listbox"
            aria-label={label}
            className={cn(
              "absolute top-full z-20 mt-1.5 min-w-[184px] rounded-[18px] border border-foreground/[0.08] p-1.5 text-foreground",
              RAISED,
              align === "right" ? "right-0 origin-top-right" : "left-0 origin-top-left",
            )}
            style={{ boxShadow: "0 8px 24px var(--card-shadow, rgba(0,0,0,calc(0.35 * var(--shadow-k, 1))))" }}
            initial={reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, scale: 0.97, y: -2 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, transition: { duration: 0.12 } }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
          >
            {options.map((o, i) => (
              <button
                key={o.value}
                type="button"
                role="option"
                aria-selected={o.value === value}
                aria-disabled={o.disabled || undefined}
                tabIndex={-1}
                disabled={o.disabled}
                onClick={() => pick(o.value)}
                onPointerEnter={() => setHi(i)}
                className={cn(
                  "flex h-9 w-full items-center gap-2.5 rounded-[12px] px-2.5 text-left text-[12.5px] outline-none transition-colors duration-150 disabled:opacity-40",
                  i === hi && !o.disabled && "bg-foreground/[0.06]",
                )}
              >
                {o.icon}
                <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-foreground/90">{o.label}</span>
                {o.hint && <span className="shrink-0 tabular-nums text-foreground/60">{o.hint}</span>}
                {value !== undefined && <span className="grid w-4 shrink-0 place-items-center">{o.value === value && <Check aria-hidden className="size-3.5 text-foreground/70" />}</span>}
              </button>
            ))}
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  )
}


// ─── components/ui/control-classes.ts ───

/* Control classes: the library's control material for components that ship on their own
   (2026-10-02, the audit's pattern 11). src/components/library/controls.ts is the site's
   copy; components used to paste its look in as a flat 8% fill "so the file ships alone",
   and those copies never turned white on a raised light surface. These read the same
   tokens WITH a fallback, so they follow the site's raised-surface rule here and still
   draw correctly in a buyer's app that has no such tokens. Shipped beside every component
   that imports it (scripts/build-registry.mjs bundles ui helpers automatically).

   Whole class strings, never assembled from pieces: Tailwind reads this file as text. */

/** what is ON in a switcher. Light (his call, 2026-10-02, after the inline slider): a WHITE
 *  pill with a hairline and a soft shadow on the grey track. Dark: the 8% thumb */
export const THUMB =
  "bg-white shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--light-outline,rgba(0,0,0,0.09)),0_1px_3px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] dark:bg-[var(--control-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_8%,transparent))] dark:shadow-[var(--control-shadow,inset_0_1px_0_0_color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_6%,transparent))]"

/** what a switcher's options sit in; its 2px padding is the gap the thumb keeps. Light: a
 *  light grey track with no outline, the white pill sits in it. Dark: a hairline, no fill */
export const TRACK = "rounded-full border border-transparent bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_5%,var(--background))] p-0.5 dark:border-foreground/[0.04] dark:bg-transparent"

/** an option that is off: the label alone answers the pointer */
export const SEGMENT_OFF = "text-foreground/60 hover:text-foreground/90"

/** a secondary button: the thumb standing alone; size it with h-7 / h-9 and px */
export const BUTTON =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--control-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_8%,transparent))] shadow-[var(--control-shadow,inset_0_1px_0_0_color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_6%,transparent))] text-foreground/90 outline-none transition-[color,background-color,scale] duration-150 hover:bg-[var(--control-fill-hover,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_12%,transparent))] focus-visible:bg-[var(--control-fill-hover,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_12%,transparent))] active:scale-[0.97] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40 motion-reduce:active:scale-100"

/** an icon-only control: no fill at rest, a faint one under the pointer */
export const ICON_BUTTON =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-full text-foreground/60 outline-none transition-[color,background-color] duration-150 hover:bg-foreground/[0.06] hover:text-foreground/90 focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.06]"

/** a field: the track with just enough fill to read as somewhere to type */
export const FIELD =
  "rounded-full border border-foreground/[0.04] bg-[var(--field-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_5%,transparent))] text-foreground/90 outline-none transition-[background-color,border-color] duration-150 placeholder:text-foreground/45 focus:border-foreground/[0.12]"

/** the one loud button of a form: 48px, full width, the foreground filled (the dashboards'
 *  Modal primary). A ticket, a swap, a confirm: one of these and nothing louder */
export const BUTTON_PRIMARY =
  "inline-flex h-12 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-foreground/[0.92] text-[14px] font-medium text-background outline-none transition-[background-color,scale,opacity] duration-150 hover:bg-foreground focus-visible:bg-foreground active:scale-[0.98] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40 motion-reduce:active:scale-100"

/** a component's own card, field or block (spec 14.8). Dark: a #121212 fill on black. Light
 *  (his call, 2026-10-02: "on light the card background is too dark, it can just be white, a
 *  quiet outline and a small shadow"): white, a 1px hairline (Kraken's #e7e6e9, or 9% ink in an app without the token) and a
 *  barely there shadow,
 *  drawn as box shadows so the outline takes no layout */
export const SURFACE =
  "bg-background shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--light-outline,color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_9%,transparent)),0_1px_2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] dark:bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_7%,var(--background))] dark:shadow-none"

/** a block sitting ON a surface: a faint 4% grey inside a white card in light, #1f1f1f in dark */
export const RAISED = "bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_4%,var(--background))] dark:bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_12%,var(--background))]"

# Graph Comparison
// ─── components/ui/graph-comparison.tsx ───

"use client"

import { useId, useRef, useState } from "react"
import type { KeyboardEvent, PointerEvent, ReactNode } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useInView, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"
import { Plus } from "lucide-react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { useWidth } from "@/components/ui/use-width"
import { BUTTON, ICON_BUTTON } from "@/components/ui/control-classes"
import { ChartCard } from "@/components/ui/chart-overlay"
import { SegmentedControl } from "@/components/ui/segmented-control"
import { ChartMenu } from "@/components/ui/performance-chart-menu"

/* Graph Comparison, promoted from a lab sketch through ssych-component (2026-09-29).
   What it is for: building a comparison. Up to four series are on the plot; the rest wait
   in a row under them, one press from being added.
   Read first: the row of series on the plot, each with its move over the window.
   The pointer: a series on the plot is a button. Pointing at it keeps its line full and
   dims the rest; pressing it takes it off the plot. A waiting series is a button that
   adds it. Scrubbing the plot reads every series at that close. Left and right arrows
   walk the closes, Escape lets go.
   Sketch: lab/GraphComparisonPanel. Kept: a set of series that can be added to and taken
   from, four at most, the suggestions, the window tabs, lines that draw in, a legend.
   Changed: the card, the side panel and every outline are gone and the parts stack in
   one column 480 wide (the sketch was 920 with a 238px side panel); each series on the
   plot has its own colour, in the house order blue, lilac, copper, amber, yellow (teal is
   skipped: green means up in the moves beside them), and a series keeps its colour while
   it is on the plot; pointing at one keeps it full and dims the rest; the list of series and
   the legend were two copies of one thing and are one row now; the funnel button that
   hid the suggestions is gone; the heading tag is gone, and since 2026-10-01 the title, the
   "n of 4 on the plot" count and the "Add" caption are gone too (the title is the group's
   aria-label, the caption the add row's); since 2026-10-01 the "Dec 26 · indexed to Jan 3"
   line is for screen readers only, the series sit in one row of tighter chips that
   scrolls sideways rather than wrapping, and each colour key is a dot, not a dash; at four
   series adding is closed (the sketch dropped the oldest without saying so).
   Fixed in the sample numbers: the sketch drew a different random walk for each window,
   so 1M was not the tail of 1Y. There is one series of 52 weekly closes for each symbol
   and a window is a cut of it. "TYT" is not a listing; it is MSFT here.
   Against fresh/CompareLines: that compares a fixed set; here the set is the point.
   2026-10-02 audit: one row at the top. The series on the plot are h-7 chips at 11.5px in the
   control material with the 6px series dot (it turns into a cross under the pointer, since
   a press takes the series off) and an optional company mark through a new `renderIcon`
   slot; the second row of waiting series became one "Add" button at the row's end that
   opens a menu of them (the dashboards' dropdown look, performance-chart-menu.tsx), and the
   window switch is the shared SegmentedControl on the row's right, not a hand made one
   centred under the plot. The chips no longer carry figures: scrubbing reads every series'
   move in the shared ChartCard beside the cursor, highest first, and the lines past the
   pointer dim to 0.45. Gridlines are solid at 5% with the 0% line the stronger one, axis
   figures at /45. 500 wide, the Comparison family's width; three series open on the plot
   so the row has room for a fourth.
   Formulas:
   · index at close i = close at i ÷ close at the window's first close × 100
   · move = index − 100, in percent
   · order = by index at the last close of the window, highest first
   · colour = the first free slot of the palette when the series is put on the plot
   · axis lines = the smallest step of 2, 5, 10, 25 or 50 points that gives five lines or
     fewer; 100, written 0%, is the only solid one
   Motion (2026-10-01): the lines sweep in from the left once the chart is a third in view
   (one clip, 900ms); a new window or a series added or taken off tweens every line and the
   axis lines to the new scale (400ms), an added series fades in and a removed one fades
   out; reduced motion shows each state at once. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const CSS_EASE = "cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)"
/** one colour per series, in the house order; teal (--chart-2) is left out because green
 *  already means up on this surface. Past the palette a series is the one "Other" ink. */
const PALETTE = ["var(--chart-1)", "var(--chart-5)", "var(--chart-3)", "var(--chart-amber)", "var(--chart-4)"]
const OTHER = "color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 22%, transparent)"
/** the lift spring, for presses */
const PRESS = { type: "spring", stiffness: 500, damping: 30 } as const
/** the lowest palette slot the other series on the plot do not hold */
const freeSlot = (taken: Record<string, number>, on: string[]) => {
  const used = new Set(on.map((sym) => taken[sym]))
  let k = 0
  while (used.has(k)) k++
  return k
}

export interface ComparisonSeries {
  symbol: string
  /** what the closes measure, such as "Share price" */
  label: string
  /** weekly closes, oldest first */
  closes: number[]
}

export interface GraphComparisonProps {
  series?: ComparisonSeries[]
  /** one label for each close */
  labels?: string[]
  /** the symbols on the plot on arrival */
  selected?: string[]
  /** how many series the plot holds */
  max?: number
  title?: string
  /** draws a series' mark (a company or token logo) in its chip and in the add menu */
  renderIcon?: (symbol: string, size: number) => ReactNode
  /** the plot's height in px (2026-10-06); 180 left out */
  height?: number
  /** the windows and their close counts; weekly left out, daily is 31 / 92 / 183 / 365 */
  periods?: readonly ComparisonPeriod[]
  className?: string
}

const MONTHS = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"]
const DAYS_IN = [31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]
/** a day of a 365-day year as "Mar 25"; 0 is Jan 1 */
const dayLabel = (d: number) => {
  let m = 0
  let r = d
  while (m < 11 && r >= DAYS_IN[m]) {
    r -= DAYS_IN[m]
    m++
  }
  return `${MONTHS[m]} ${r + 1}`
}

const CLOSES = 52
/* 52 Fridays of 2025, Jan 3 to Dec 26 */
const DEFAULT_LABELS = Array.from({ length: CLOSES }, (_, i) => dayLabel(2 + i * 7))

/** weekly closes from a seeded walk; the first close is the given price */
const walk = (seed: number, start: number, drift: number, vol: number) => {
  let s = seed
  let v = start
  const out = [start]
  for (let i = 1; i < CLOSES; i++) {
    s = (s * 16807) % 2147483647
    v = Math.max(start * 0.4, v * (1 + drift + (s / 2147483647 - 0.5) * vol))
    out.push(Number(v.toFixed(2)))
  }
  return out
}

const DEFAULT_SERIES: ComparisonSeries[] = [
  { symbol: "NVDA", label: "Share price", closes: walk(7, 138.3, 0.007, 0.09) },
  { symbol: "AMZN", label: "Share price", closes: walk(17, 224.2, 0.004, 0.06) },
  { symbol: "SPY", label: "Share price", closes: walk(31, 591.9, 0.003, 0.035) },
  { symbol: "MSFT", label: "Share price", closes: walk(47, 423.4, 0.003, 0.05) },
  { symbol: "VIX", label: "Index", closes: walk(67, 16.1, 0, 0.16) },
  { symbol: "AAPL", label: "Share price", closes: walk(83, 243.4, 0.002, 0.055) },
]

const DEFAULT_SELECTED = ["NVDA", "AMZN", "SPY"]

/** how many weekly closes each window holds (the default; pass `periods` for daily data) */
const PERIODS = [
  { key: "1M", closes: 5 },
  { key: "3M", closes: 14 },
  { key: "6M", closes: 27 },
  { key: "1Y", closes: 52 },
] as const
type PeriodKey = (typeof PERIODS)[number]["key"]
/** a window and how many closes it holds; daily data is 31 / 92 / 183 / 365 (2026-10-06) */
export type ComparisonPeriod = { key: PeriodKey; closes: number }

const PAD = { r: 40, t: 10, b: 20 }

const signed = (v: number) => `${v >= 0 ? "+" : "−"}${Math.abs(v).toFixed(1)}%`

/** a window's line through every close, always written with `m` vertices (a short window
 *  repeats its closes), so a new window tweens the path instead of redrawing it */
function linePath(vals: number[], m: number, px: (j: number) => number, py: (v: number) => number) {
  const n = vals.length
  let d = ""
  for (let k = 0; k < m; k++) {
    const j = m > 1 && n > 1 ? Math.round((k * (n - 1)) / (m - 1)) : 0
    d += `${k ? " L" : "M"}${px(j).toFixed(1)},${py(vals[j]).toFixed(1)}`
  }
  return d
}

/**
 * A comparison that is put together by hand: series on the plot can be taken off, waiting
 * ones added from a menu, four at most. Lines are indexed to the start of the window.
 */
export function GraphComparison({
  series = DEFAULT_SERIES,
  labels = DEFAULT_LABELS,
  selected = DEFAULT_SELECTED,
  max = 4,
  title = "Graph comparison",
  renderIcon,
  height = 180,
  periods = PERIODS,
  className,
}: GraphComparisonProps) {
  // laid out at the width it is given (2026-10-06), so the text keeps its size when stretched
  const [boxRef, W] = useWidth<HTMLDivElement>(500)
  const H = height
  const PLOT = W - PAD.r
  const PLOT_H = H - PAD.t - PAD.b
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const uid = useId().replace(/:/g, "")
  const svgRef = useRef<SVGSVGElement>(null)
  /* the sweep waits until the plot is a third in view, then plays once */
  const play = useInView(svgRef, { once: true, amount: 0.3 }) || !!reduced
  const tween = reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.4, ease: EASE }
  const room = Math.max(1, max)
  const [shown, setShown] = useState<string[]>(() => selected.slice(0, room))
  /** which palette slot each series holds; a series keeps it while it is on the plot */
  const [slots, setSlots] = useState<Record<string, number>>(() => Object.fromEntries(selected.slice(0, room).map((sym, k) => [sym, k])))
  const [period, setPeriod] = useState<PeriodKey>("1Y")
  const [hot, setHot] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [at, setAt] = useState<number | null>(null)

  const usable = series.filter((s) => s.closes.length > 1)
  const on = usable.filter((s) => shown.includes(s.symbol))
  const waiting = usable.filter((s) => !shown.includes(s.symbol))
  const full = on.length >= room

  const len = usable.length ? Math.min(...usable.map((s) => s.closes.length)) : 2
  const n = Math.max(2, Math.min(len, periods.find((p) => p.key === period)?.closes ?? len))
  const start = len - n
  const cut = on.map((s) => {
    const base = s.closes[start] || 1
    const prices = s.closes.slice(start, start + n)
    return { ...s, prices, idx: prices.map((v) => (v / base) * 100) }
  })
  const order = [...cut.keys()].sort((a, b) => cut[b].idx[n - 1] - cut[a].idx[n - 1])
  const inkOf = (i: number) => PALETTE[slots[cut[i].symbol] ?? PALETTE.length] ?? OTHER

  const all = cut.flatMap((s) => s.idx)
  const lo = all.length ? Math.min(...all, 100) : 90
  const hi = all.length ? Math.max(...all, 100) : 110
  const pad = (hi - lo || 1) * 0.06
  const min = lo - pad
  const top = hi + pad
  const x = (i: number) => (i / (n - 1)) * PLOT
  const y = (v: number) => PAD.t + (1 - (v - min) / (top - min || 1)) * PLOT_H
  const step = [2, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100].find((st) => (top - min) / st <= 5) ?? 200
  const grid: number[] = []
  for (let v = Math.ceil(min / step) * step; v <= top; v += step) grid.push(v)

  const i = Math.min(at ?? n - 1, n - 1)
  const label = (k: number) => labels[start + k] ?? `close ${start + k + 1}`

  const remove = (symbol: string) => {
    setShown((list) => (list.length > 1 ? list.filter((x2) => x2 !== symbol) : list))
    setHot(null)
  }
  const add = (symbol: string) => {
    if (shown.length >= room || shown.includes(symbol)) return
    setSlots((t) => ({ ...t, [symbol]: freeSlot(t, shown) }))
    setShown([...shown, symbol])
  }

  const onMove = (e: PointerEvent<SVGSVGElement>) => {
    const r = svgRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect()
    if (!r) return
    const px = ((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width) * W
    setAt(Math.max(0, Math.min(n - 1, Math.round((px / PLOT) * (n - 1)))))
  }
  const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent<SVGSVGElement>) => {
    const d = e.key === "ArrowLeft" ? -1 : e.key === "ArrowRight" ? 1 : 0
    if (d) {
      e.preventDefault()
      setAt((c) => Math.max(0, Math.min(n - 1, (c ?? n - 1) + d)))
    } else if (e.key === "Escape") setAt(null)
  }
  const dateTicks = [...new Set([0, Math.round((n - 1) / 2), n - 1])]
  /* the lines left of the pointer stay full, the rest dims to 0.45 */
  const split = at === null ? W + 8 : x(i)
  const lineGroup = (key: string) => (
    <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
      {cut.map((s, k) => {
        const lit = hot === s.symbol
        return (
          /* the group owns the dim and the fade of a series coming or going; the line
             inside tweens its path */
          <motion.g
            key={`${key}-${s.symbol}`}
            initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
            animate={{ opacity: hot !== null && !lit ? 0.35 : 1 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
            transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.16, ease: EASE }}
          >
            <motion.path
              initial={false}
              animate={{ d: linePath(s.idx, len, x, y) }}
              transition={tween}
              fill="none"
              stroke={inkOf(k)}
              strokeWidth={lit ? 2.1 : 1.8}
              strokeLinecap="round"
              strokeLinejoin="round"
            />
          </motion.g>
        )
      })}
    </AnimatePresence>
  )

  return (
    <div ref={boxRef} role="group" aria-label={title} className={cn("w-[500px] max-w-full tabular-nums", className)}>
      {/* the title is the group's label only: the series row says what is compared.
          the close being read stays for screen readers only (2026-10-01): the axis shows the dates */}
      <span role="status" className="sr-only">
        {label(i)}, indexed to {label(0)}
      </span>

      {/* one row at the top: the series on the plot and the add menu */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
        <div
          className="-my-1 flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-nowrap items-center gap-1 overflow-x-auto py-1 [scrollbar-width:none] [&::-webkit-scrollbar]:hidden"
          role="group"
          aria-label="On the plot"
          onPointerLeave={() => setHot(null)}
        >
          {order.map((k) => {
            const s = cut[k]
            const last = on.length <= 1
            return (
              <motion.button
                key={s.symbol}
                type="button"
                disabled={last}
                initial={reduced ? false : { opacity: 0, scale: 0.97 }}
                animate={{ opacity: hot !== null && hot !== s.symbol ? 0.4 : 1, scale: 1 }}
                whileTap={reduced ? undefined : { scale: 0.97 }}
                transition={{ duration: 0.2, ease: EASE, scale: reduced ? { duration: 0 } : PRESS }}
                aria-label={`${s.symbol}, ${s.label.toLowerCase()}${last ? "" : ". Press to take it off the plot"}`}
                onPointerEnter={() => setHot(s.symbol)}
                onFocus={() => setHot(s.symbol)}
                onBlur={() => setHot(null)}
                onClick={() => remove(s.symbol)}
                className={cn(BUTTON, "group h-7 shrink-0 gap-1 pl-2.5 pr-2.5 text-[11.5px] font-medium disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-100")}
              >
                {/* the series dot; under the pointer it turns into a cross, since a press takes it off */}
                <span aria-hidden className="relative grid size-2 shrink-0 place-items-center">
                  <span className={cn("size-1.5 rounded-full transition-opacity duration-150", !last && "group-hover:opacity-0 group-focus-visible:opacity-0")} style={{ background: inkOf(k) }} />
                  {!last && (
                    <svg width="8" height="8" viewBox="0 0 8 8" fill="none" className="absolute inset-0 text-foreground/60 opacity-0 transition-opacity duration-150 group-hover:opacity-100 group-focus-visible:opacity-100">
                      <path d="M1.5 1.5l5 5M6.5 1.5l-5 5" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.2" strokeLinecap="round" />
                    </svg>
                  )}
                </span>
                {renderIcon?.(s.symbol, 14)}
                <span>{s.symbol}</span>
              </motion.button>
            )
          })}
        </div>
        {waiting.length > 0 && (
          <ChartMenu
            label={full ? `Add a series, take one off first (${room} at most)` : "Add a series"}
            options={waiting.map((s) => ({ value: s.symbol, label: s.symbol, hint: s.label, icon: renderIcon?.(s.symbol, 16) }))}
            onPick={add}
            disabled={full}
            className="shrink-0"
            triggerClassName={cn(ICON_BUTTON, "size-7 disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40")}
            chevron={false}
          >
            <Plus aria-hidden className="size-3.5" strokeWidth={2} />
          </ChartMenu>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="relative mt-4">
        <svg
          ref={svgRef}
          viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`}
          className="block w-full cursor-crosshair touch-none overflow-visible outline-none"
          role="img"
          tabIndex={0}
          aria-label={`${title} over ${period}, indexed to 100 on ${label(0)}. ${order.map((k) => `${cut[k].symbol} ${signed(cut[k].idx[n - 1] - 100)}`).join(", ")}`}
          onPointerMove={onMove}
          onPointerLeave={() => setAt(null)}
          onBlur={() => setAt(null)}
          onKeyDown={onKey}
        >
          <defs>
            {/* the entrance: one clip that opens from the left edge, once */}
            <clipPath id={`${uid}-draw`}>
              <motion.rect
                x={-4}
                y={-4}
                height={H + 8}
                initial={reduced ? false : { width: 0 }}
                animate={{ width: play ? W + 8 : 0 }}
                transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.9, ease: EASE }}
              />
            </clipPath>
            <clipPath id={`${uid}-past`}>
              <rect x={-4} y={-4} width={split + 4} height={H + 8} />
            </clipPath>
            <clipPath id={`${uid}-ahead`}>
              <rect x={split} y={-4} width={Math.max(0, W + 8 - split)} height={H + 8} />
            </clipPath>
          </defs>

          {/* an axis line rides to its new height when the scale changes (a CSS transform, so it
              is placed before any script runs); a new step fades in and an old one out */}
          <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
            {grid.map((v) => (
              <motion.g key={v} initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }} transition={tween}>
                <g style={{ transform: `translateY(${y(v).toFixed(1)}px)`, transition: reduced ? "none" : `transform 400ms ${CSS_EASE}` }}>
                  <line x1={0} y1={0} x2={PLOT} y2={0} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={v === 100 ? 0.12 : 0.05} strokeWidth={1} />
                  <text x={PLOT + 6} y={3} fontSize={9} fill="var(--foreground)" fillOpacity={0.45}>
                    {v === 100 ? "0%" : `${v > 100 ? "+" : "−"}${Math.abs(v - 100)}%`}
                  </text>
                </g>
              </motion.g>
            ))}
          </AnimatePresence>

          {dateTicks.map((k) => (
            <text key={k} x={x(k)} y={H - 5} fontSize={9} fill="var(--foreground)" fillOpacity={0.45} textAnchor={k === 0 ? "start" : k === n - 1 ? "end" : "middle"}>
              {label(k)}
            </text>
          ))}

          <g clipPath={`url(#${uid}-draw)`}>
            <g clipPath={`url(#${uid}-past)`}>{lineGroup("past")}</g>
            <g clipPath={`url(#${uid}-ahead)`} opacity={0.45}>
              {lineGroup("ahead")}
            </g>
          </g>

          {at !== null && (
            <g pointerEvents="none">
              <line x1={x(i)} y1={PAD.t} x2={x(i)} y2={PAD.t + PLOT_H} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.18} strokeWidth={1} />
              {cut.map((s, k) => (
                <circle
                  key={s.symbol}
                  cx={x(i)}
                  cy={y(s.idx[i])}
                  r={hot === s.symbol ? 3.2 : 2.6}
                  fill={inkOf(k)}
                  fillOpacity={hot !== null && hot !== s.symbol ? 0.35 : 1}
                  stroke="var(--background)"
                  strokeWidth={1.5}
                />
              ))}
            </g>
          )}
        </svg>

        {/* the pointed close, every series' move from the window's start, highest first */}
        <ChartCard
          open={at !== null}
          x={`${(x(i) / W) * 100}%`}
          flip={x(i) > PLOT * 0.6}
          heading={label(i)}
          rows={[...cut.keys()]
            .sort((a, b) => cut[b].idx[i] - cut[a].idx[i])
            .map((k) => ({ label: cut[k].symbol, value: signed(cut[k].idx[i] - 100) }))}
          width={140}
        />
      </div>

      {/* the window switch under the plot (2026-10-02): on the top row it took the room a fourth
          series needs, so the series row overflowed and scrolled when one was added */}
      <div className="mt-3 flex justify-center">
        <SegmentedControl
          options={periods.map((p) => p.key)}
          value={period}
          onChange={(k) => {
            setPeriod(k as PeriodKey)
            setAt(null)
          }}
          label="Window"
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}


// ─── components/ui/use-width.ts ───

"use client";

// The width a chart is given (2026-10-06, the Tradeboard case study). The charts used to lay
// out in a fixed box and stretch as a picture in a wider column, so their text grew with it;
// measured, they lay out at the real width and the text keeps its size. A chart left at its
// default class measures its own default width, so nothing changes where it is not stretched.
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

export function useWidth<T extends HTMLElement>(fallback: number, min = 280) {
  const ref = useRef<T>(null);
  const [w, setW] = useState(fallback);
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
