    const ro = new ResizeObserver(([e]) => setW(Math.max(min, Math.round(e.contentRect.width)) || fallback));
    ro.observe(el);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, [fallback, min]);
  return [ref, w] as const;
}


// ─── components/ui/control-classes.ts ───

/* Control classes: the library's control material for components that ship on their own
   (2026-10-02, the audit's pattern 11). src/components/library/controls.ts is the site's
   copy; components used to paste its look in as a flat 8% fill "so the file ships alone",
   and those copies never turned white on a raised light surface. These read the same
   tokens WITH a fallback, so they follow the site's raised-surface rule here and still
   draw correctly in a buyer's app that has no such tokens. Shipped beside every component
   that imports it (scripts/build-registry.mjs bundles ui helpers automatically).

   Whole class strings, never assembled from pieces: Tailwind reads this file as text. */

/** what is ON in a switcher. Light (his call, 2026-10-02, after the inline slider): a WHITE
 *  pill with a hairline and a soft shadow on the grey track. Dark: the 8% thumb */
export const THUMB =
  "bg-white shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--light-outline,rgba(0,0,0,0.09)),0_1px_3px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] dark:bg-[var(--control-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_8%,transparent))] dark:shadow-[var(--control-shadow,inset_0_1px_0_0_color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_6%,transparent))]"

/** what a switcher's options sit in; its 2px padding is the gap the thumb keeps. Light: a
 *  light grey track with no outline, the white pill sits in it. Dark: a hairline, no fill */
export const TRACK = "rounded-full border border-transparent bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_5%,var(--background))] p-0.5 dark:border-foreground/[0.04] dark:bg-transparent"

/** an option that is off: the label alone answers the pointer */
export const SEGMENT_OFF = "text-foreground/60 hover:text-foreground/90"

/** a secondary button: the thumb standing alone; size it with h-7 / h-9 and px */
export const BUTTON =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--control-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_8%,transparent))] shadow-[var(--control-shadow,inset_0_1px_0_0_color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_6%,transparent))] text-foreground/90 outline-none transition-[color,background-color,scale] duration-150 hover:bg-[var(--control-fill-hover,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_12%,transparent))] focus-visible:bg-[var(--control-fill-hover,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_12%,transparent))] active:scale-[0.97] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40 motion-reduce:active:scale-100"

/** an icon-only control: no fill at rest, a faint one under the pointer */
export const ICON_BUTTON =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-full text-foreground/60 outline-none transition-[color,background-color] duration-150 hover:bg-foreground/[0.06] hover:text-foreground/90 focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.06]"

/** a field: the track with just enough fill to read as somewhere to type */
export const FIELD =
  "rounded-full border border-foreground/[0.04] bg-[var(--field-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_5%,transparent))] text-foreground/90 outline-none transition-[background-color,border-color] duration-150 placeholder:text-foreground/45 focus:border-foreground/[0.12]"

/** the one loud button of a form: 48px, full width, the foreground filled (the dashboards'
 *  Modal primary). A ticket, a swap, a confirm: one of these and nothing louder */
export const BUTTON_PRIMARY =
  "inline-flex h-12 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-foreground/[0.92] text-[14px] font-medium text-background outline-none transition-[background-color,scale,opacity] duration-150 hover:bg-foreground focus-visible:bg-foreground active:scale-[0.98] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40 motion-reduce:active:scale-100"

/** a component's own card, field or block (spec 14.8). Dark: a #121212 fill on black. Light
 *  (his call, 2026-10-02: "on light the card background is too dark, it can just be white, a
 *  quiet outline and a small shadow"): white, a 1px hairline (Kraken's #e7e6e9, or 9% ink in an app without the token) and a
 *  barely there shadow,
 *  drawn as box shadows so the outline takes no layout */
export const SURFACE =
  "bg-background shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--light-outline,color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_9%,transparent)),0_1px_2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] dark:bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_7%,var(--background))] dark:shadow-none"

/** a block sitting ON a surface: a faint 4% grey inside a white card in light, #1f1f1f in dark */
export const RAISED = "bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_4%,var(--background))] dark:bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_12%,var(--background))]"


// ─── components/ui/chart-overlay.tsx ───

"use client"

import { type ReactNode } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

/* Chart overlay: the two parts every library chart reads a point with (2026-10-02). They
   came out of Candlestick, Volume Profile, the trading terminal and Price Scrubber, which
   had each drawn their own; this is the one copy. Shipped beside the charts that use it.

   AxisTag   the outlined tag on the value axis: the pointed value in its hue, or a named
             reference (POC, last close) in ink. A pill 16px high, 8.5px figures.
   ChartCard the card laid over the chart beside the cursor: a heading row (a time or a
             range) at /60, then label and value rows (labels 10px /60, values 11px /90),
             the one signed figure in its hue. It glides between points on a spring, fades
             in from 0.97 and out in 120ms, and flips to the cursor's left when told to.

   2026-10-02: the card looked out of place over the charts, so it now wears the library
   popover, the same as the sidebar's hover card: a hairline border at 8%, radius 12, the
   6% foreground mix and the popover shadow with no inset highlight (spec 14.6). */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GLIDE = { type: "spring", stiffness: 520, damping: 40 } as const

/** the outlined tag on a chart's value axis, centred on `y` */
export function AxisTag({
  x,
  y,
  width,
  color = "var(--foreground)",
  strong = true,
  hidden = false,
  children,
}: {
  /** the tag's left edge, in the chart's own units */
  x: number
  /** the value's line; the tag is centred on it */
  y: number
  width: number
  /** stroke and figure; ink for a named reference, the series hue for the pointed value */
  color?: string
  /** a quieter tag (a secondary reference) drops the weight and the stroke */
  strong?: boolean
  /** fades the tag out, for when the pointed value sits on it */
  hidden?: boolean
  children: ReactNode
}) {
  return (
    <g transform={`translate(${x}, ${y - 8})`} pointerEvents="none" style={{ opacity: hidden ? 0 : 1, transition: "opacity 150ms" }}>
      <rect width={width} height={16} rx={8} fill="var(--background)" stroke={color} strokeOpacity={strong ? 0.6 : 0.2} />
      <text x={width / 2} y={11} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={8.5} fontWeight={strong ? 600 : 500} fill={color} fillOpacity={strong ? 1 : 0.65}>
        {children}
      </text>
    </g>
  )
}

export interface ChartCardRow {
  label: string
  value: ReactNode
  /** only the one signed figure carries a hue */
  color?: string
}

/** the readout card over a chart; place it inside a `relative` box that holds the svg */
export function ChartCard({
  open,
  x,
  y = 4,
  flip = false,
  width = 148,
  heading,
  rows,
  footer,
}: {
  open: boolean
  /** the cursor's x inside the box: px, or a percentage string for a chart drawn to a viewBox */
  x: number | string
  /** the card's top inside the box, px */
  y?: number
  /** put the card on the cursor's left (past ~60% of the plot) */
  flip?: boolean
  width?: number
  heading: ReactNode
  rows: ChartCardRow[]
  /** a closing line under the rows, such as where the point sits */
  footer?: ReactNode
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {open && (
        <motion.div
          key="chart-card"
          role="status"
          className="pointer-events-none absolute z-10"
          initial={{ left: x, top: y, opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ left: x, top: y, opacity: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, transition: { duration: 0.12 } }}
          transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { left: GLIDE, top: GLIDE, opacity: { duration: 0.15 } }}
        >
          <motion.div
            className="rounded-[12px] border border-foreground/[0.08] px-3 py-2.5"
            style={{
              width,
              translate: flip ? "calc(-100% - 12px) 0" : "12px 0",
              transition: reduced ? undefined : "translate 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)",
              background: "var(--tip-fill, color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 6%, var(--background)))",
              boxShadow: "0 8px 24px var(--card-shadow, rgba(0,0,0,calc(0.35 * var(--shadow-k, 1))))",
            }}
            initial={reduced ? false : { scale: 0.97 }}
            animate={{ scale: 1 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
          >
            <div className="text-[10px] text-foreground/60">{heading}</div>
            <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-col gap-1">
              {rows.map((r) => (
                <div key={r.label} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-foreground/60">{r.label}</span>
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-foreground/90" style={r.color ? { color: r.color } : undefined}>
                    {r.value}
                  </span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            {footer && <div className="mt-1.5 text-[10px]">{footer}</div>}
          </motion.div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  )
}


// ─── components/ui/performance-chart-menu.tsx ───

"use client"

import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent, type ReactNode } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"
import { Check, ChevronDown } from "lucide-react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { RAISED } from "@/components/ui/control-classes"

/* Chart menu (2026-10-02 audit): the dashboards' dropdown look (src/components/lab/screen/
   Select.tsx), copied here because a library component cannot import lab files. A trigger
   that opens a solid menu under it, never the browser's native list: radius 18 holding 12px
   rows at a 6px padding (18 = 12 + 6), the raised step (white in light, a 12% foreground mix in dark),
   a hairline at 8% and the popover shadow. It starts closed and opens on a press. Keyboard:
   Enter, Space or the down arrow opens it, the arrows move, Enter picks, Escape closes.
   Written for Performance Chart (the benchmark) and used by Graph Comparison (the add
   list); it is generic, so it could become a shared part. */

export interface ChartMenuOption {
  value: string
  label: string
  /** a mark before the label, such as a company or token mark */
  icon?: ReactNode
  /** a quiet figure or note on the right */
  hint?: string
  disabled?: boolean
}

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const

export function ChartMenu({
  label,
  options,
  value,
  onPick,
  children,
  align = "left",
  disabled = false,
  chevron = true,
  className,
  triggerClassName,
}: {
  /** the accessible name of the trigger and the list */
  label: string
  options: ChartMenuOption[]
  /** the chosen option, ticked in the list; leave out for an action menu */
  value?: string
  onPick: (value: string) => void
  /** what the trigger shows */
  children: ReactNode
  /** which edge of the trigger the menu lines up with */
  align?: "left" | "right"
  /** the trigger cannot open the menu, such as when there is nothing to add */
  disabled?: boolean
  /** the chevron after the trigger's content; off for an icon-only trigger */
  chevron?: boolean
  className?: string
  triggerClassName?: string
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const uid = useId()
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const [hi, setHi] = useState(0)
  const root = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const btn = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return
    const doc = root.current?.ownerDocument ?? document
    const away = (e: Event) => {
      if (!root.current?.contains(e.target as Node)) setOpen(false)
    }
    doc.addEventListener("pointerdown", away)
    return () => doc.removeEventListener("pointerdown", away)
  }, [open])

  const firstFree = (from: number, step: number) => {
    for (let k = 0, i = from; k < options.length; k++, i = (i + step + options.length) % options.length) if (!options[i]?.disabled) return i
    return from
  }
  const show = () => {
    const at = options.findIndex((o) => o.value === value)
    setHi(firstFree(at >= 0 ? at : 0, 1))
    setOpen(true)
  }
  const pick = (v: string) => {
    onPick(v)
    setOpen(false)
    btn.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true })
  }
  const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (disabled) return
    if (!open) {
      if (e.key === "ArrowDown" || e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {
        e.preventDefault()
        show()
      }
      return
    }
    if (e.key === "Escape") {
      e.preventDefault()
      e.stopPropagation()
      setOpen(false)
      btn.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true })
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
      e.preventDefault()
      setHi((h) => firstFree((h + 1) % options.length, 1))
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
      e.preventDefault()
      setHi((h) => firstFree((h - 1 + options.length) % options.length, -1))
    } else if ((e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") && options[hi] && !options[hi].disabled) {
      e.preventDefault()
      pick(options[hi].value)
    } else if (e.key === "Tab") setOpen(false)
  }

  return (
    <div ref={root} className={cn("relative", className)} onKeyDown={onKey}>
      <button
        ref={btn}
        type="button"
        aria-haspopup="listbox"
        aria-expanded={open}
        aria-controls={open ? `${uid}-list` : undefined}
        aria-label={label}
        disabled={disabled}
        onClick={() => (open ? setOpen(false) : show())}
        className={cn("inline-flex items-center gap-1 outline-none", triggerClassName)}
      >
        {children}
        {chevron && <ChevronDown aria-hidden className={cn("size-3 shrink-0 text-foreground/60 transition-transform duration-200 motion-reduce:transition-none", open && "rotate-180")} strokeWidth={2} />}
      </button>
      <AnimatePresence>
        {open && (
          <motion.div
            id={`${uid}-list`}
            role="listbox"
            aria-label={label}
            className={cn(
              "absolute top-full z-20 mt-1.5 min-w-[184px] rounded-[18px] border border-foreground/[0.08] p-1.5 text-foreground",
              RAISED,
              align === "right" ? "right-0 origin-top-right" : "left-0 origin-top-left",
            )}
            style={{ boxShadow: "0 8px 24px var(--card-shadow, rgba(0,0,0,calc(0.35 * var(--shadow-k, 1))))" }}
            initial={reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, scale: 0.97, y: -2 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, transition: { duration: 0.12 } }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
          >
            {options.map((o, i) => (
              <button
                key={o.value}
                type="button"
                role="option"
                aria-selected={o.value === value}
                aria-disabled={o.disabled || undefined}
                tabIndex={-1}
                disabled={o.disabled}
                onClick={() => pick(o.value)}
                onPointerEnter={() => setHi(i)}
                className={cn(
                  "flex h-9 w-full items-center gap-2.5 rounded-[12px] px-2.5 text-left text-[12.5px] outline-none transition-colors duration-150 disabled:opacity-40",
                  i === hi && !o.disabled && "bg-foreground/[0.06]",
                )}
              >
                {o.icon}
                <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-foreground/90">{o.label}</span>
                {o.hint && <span className="shrink-0 tabular-nums text-foreground/60">{o.hint}</span>}
                {value !== undefined && <span className="grid w-4 shrink-0 place-items-center">{o.value === value && <Check aria-hidden className="size-3.5 text-foreground/70" />}</span>}
              </button>
            ))}
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  )
}

# Ratings Radar
// ─── components/ui/ratings-radar.tsx ───

"use client"

import { useRef, useState } from "react"
import { motion, useInView, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { LiveFigure } from "@/components/ui/live-figure"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

/* Ratings Radar, rebuilt through the ssych-component skill (2026-09-29).
   What changed against the version before it (in git history), and why:
   · it answers the pointer: pointing at an axis or its label keeps that rating full, dims
     the others, grows its point and reads the count and its share where the caption is
   · the labels are real buttons with their own names, the chart names itself
   · the shape's colour now means something: green when buy ratings outweigh sell ratings,
     red when they do not, ink when the labels say neither
   · the shape fades in and its outline draws, it no longer scales up from the middle
   · every figure is tabular; the sample labels are in sentence case
   Motion (2026-10-01): the fade, the outline draw and the points now wait until the chart
   is in view (they played on mount, off screen too), all landed by 0.65s; new counts morph
   the shape and glide each point along its spoke
   2026-10-02: the radar does not need a header (spec 14.1: no single figure to read first,
   its axis labels name it), so the visible "Analyst ratings" title is gone; the `title`
   prop still names the chart in its aria-label. The line over the chart stays: blank at
   rest, it reads the pointed rating's count and share.
   2026-10-02 audit: the sample axes run in the scale's order, Strong buy at the top and then
   Buy, Neutral, Sell and Strong sell clockwise, so a buy lean pulls the shape up and to the
   right (Strong sell used to sit beside Strong buy, so the shape meant nothing). The axis
   labels are 11px with the name at /60 and the count at /90. The line over the chart no
   longer repeats the label and count printed at the axis: it reads only the new figure,
   the share ("31.0% of 87 analysts"), 11px /60 with the share /90, and it swaps through the
   shared LiveFigure.
   Formulas, all from `ratings`: total = sum of counts; share = count / total × 100, 1dp;
   point radius = 6 + count / largest count × 96; the hue = green when the buy counts are
   at least the sell counts, red when not, ink when the labels say neither. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GREEN = "var(--chart-up)"
const RED = "var(--chart-down)"
const INK = "var(--foreground)"

export interface RadarRating {
  label: string
  count: number
}

const DEFAULT_RATINGS: RadarRating[] = [
  { label: "Strong buy", count: 38 },
  { label: "Buy", count: 27 },
  { label: "Neutral", count: 11 },
  { label: "Sell", count: 8 },
  { label: "Strong sell", count: 3 },
]

const SIZE_W = 300
const SIZE_H = 252
const CX = 150
const CY = 128
const R = 102
const RINGS = 4

const BULL = /buy|outperform|overweight/i
const BEAR = /sell|underperform|underweight/i

/**
 * Analyst ratings as a pentagon: hairline rings and spokes, one shape pulled toward the
 * dominant rating, counts beside their labels. Pointing at an axis reads that rating's
 * share of all analysts in place of the caption.
 */
export function RatingsRadar({
  ratings = DEFAULT_RATINGS,
  title = "Analyst ratings",
  caption,
  className,
}: {
  /** One axis per rating, drawn clockwise from the top. */
  ratings?: RadarRating[]
  /** names the chart to a screen reader; not printed */
  title?: string
  /** a line shown over the chart at rest; blank by default */
  caption?: string
  className?: string
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const [hot, setHot] = useState<number | null>(null)
  /* the entrance plays once, when a third of the chart is in view; reduced motion lands at once */
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const seen = useInView(rootRef, { once: true, amount: 0.3 })
  const play = !!reduced || seen
  /** a change of data glides between the two states */
  const morph = reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.35, ease: EASE }
  const max = Math.max(...ratings.map((r) => r.count), 1)
  const total = ratings.reduce((a, r) => a + r.count, 0)

  /* the lean: buy counts minus sell counts, read from the labels */
  const bull = ratings.filter((r) => BULL.test(r.label)).reduce((a, r) => a + r.count, 0)
  const bear = ratings.filter((r) => BEAR.test(r.label)).reduce((a, r) => a + r.count, 0)
  const hue = bull + bear === 0 ? INK : bull >= bear ? GREEN : RED

  const pt = (i: number, r: number) => {
    const a = -Math.PI / 2 + (i / Math.max(1, ratings.length)) * Math.PI * 2
    return [CX + Math.cos(a) * r, CY + Math.sin(a) * r] as const
  }
  const xy = (p: readonly [number, number]) => `${p[0].toFixed(1)},${p[1].toFixed(1)}`
  const wedge = ratings.map((r, i) => pt(i, 6 + (r.count / max) * (R - 6)))
  const shape = `M${wedge.map(xy).join(" L")} Z`
  const top = ratings.reduce((a, r) => (r.count > a.count ? r : a), ratings[0] ?? { label: "", count: 0 })
  const share = (n: number) => (total ? (n / total) * 100 : 0).toFixed(1)

  return (
    <div ref={rootRef} className={cn("w-[300px] tabular-nums", className)}>
      <div className="text-center">
        <div role="status" className="text-[11px] text-foreground/60">
          {/* the line swaps in place when the pointed rating changes (LiveFigure: 4px, 2px blur, 150ms) */}
          <LiveFigure intent={hot}>
            {hot !== null && ratings[hot] ? (
              <>
                <span className="font-medium text-foreground/90">{share(ratings[hot].count)}%</span>
                {` of ${total} analysts`}
              </>
            ) : (
              (caption ?? "\u00a0") /* no summary at rest (user call, 2026-10-02) */
            )}
          </LiveFigure>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="relative mt-1" style={{ width: SIZE_W, height: SIZE_H }} onPointerLeave={() => setHot(null)}>
        <svg
          width={SIZE_W}
          height={SIZE_H}
          viewBox={`0 0 ${SIZE_W} ${SIZE_H}`}
          className="block overflow-visible"
          role="img"
          aria-label={`${title}, ${total} analysts. Most common: ${top.label} ${top.count}, ${share(top.count)}%`}
        >
          {Array.from({ length: RINGS }, (_, ri) => {
            const rr = ((ri + 1) / RINGS) * R
            const d = `M${ratings.map((_, i) => xy(pt(i, rr))).join(" L")} Z`
            return <path key={ri} d={d} fill="none" stroke={INK} strokeOpacity={0.05} strokeWidth={1} />
          })}
          {ratings.map((r, i) => {
            const [x2, y2] = pt(i, R)
            return (
              <line
                key={r.label}
                x1={CX}
                y1={CY}
                x2={x2}
                y2={y2}
                stroke={INK}
                strokeOpacity={hot === i ? 0.28 : 0.05}
                strokeWidth={1}
                style={{ transition: reduced ? "none" : "stroke-opacity 160ms" }}
              />
            )
          })}

          <motion.path
            fill={hue}
            fillOpacity={0.16}
            initial={reduced ? false : { opacity: 0, d: shape }}
            animate={{ opacity: play ? 1 : 0, d: shape }}
            transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { opacity: { duration: 0.3, ease: EASE, delay: 0.1 }, d: morph }}
          />
          <motion.path
            fill="none"
            stroke={hue}
            strokeWidth={1.8}
            strokeLinejoin="round"
            initial={reduced ? false : { pathLength: 0, d: shape }}
            animate={{ pathLength: play ? 1 : 0, d: shape }}
            transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { pathLength: { duration: 0.4, ease: EASE }, d: morph }}
          />

          {wedge.map((p, i) => (
            /* the group carries the point to its place, so new counts glide it along the spoke */
            <motion.g
              key={ratings[i].label}
              initial={reduced ? false : { opacity: 0, x: p[0], y: p[1] }}
              animate={{ opacity: play ? 1 : 0, x: p[0], y: p[1] }}
              transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { opacity: { duration: 0.3, ease: EASE, delay: 0.2 + i * 0.035 }, default: morph }}
            >
              {/* the point grows by a transform about its own centre (2 → 3.2), never a radius tween */}
              <circle
                cx={0}
                cy={0}
                r={2}
                fill={hue}
                style={{
                  opacity: hot === null || hot === i ? 1 : 0.4,
                  transform: hot === i ? "scale(1.6)" : "scale(1)",
                  transformBox: "fill-box",
                  transformOrigin: "center",
                  transition: reduced ? "opacity 160ms" : "transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), opacity 160ms",
                }}
              />
            </motion.g>
          ))}

          {/* one slice of the pentagon per rating, so pointing anywhere near an axis picks it */}
          {ratings.map((r, i) => (
            <path
              key={r.label}
              d={`M${CX},${CY} L${xy(pt(i - 0.5, R + 8))} L${xy(pt(i, R + 8))} L${xy(pt(i + 0.5, R + 8))} Z`}
              fill="transparent"
              onPointerEnter={() => setHot(i)}
            />
          ))}
        </svg>

        {ratings.map((r, i) => {
          const [x, y] = pt(i, R + 18)
          const shift = Math.abs(x - CX) < 8 ? "-50%" : x > CX ? "0%" : "-100%"
          return (
            <button
              key={r.label}
              type="button"
              aria-label={`${r.label}: ${r.count} analysts, ${share(r.count)}%`}
              onPointerEnter={() => setHot(i)}
              onFocus={() => setHot(i)}
              onBlur={() => setHot(null)}
              onClick={() => setHot(i)}
              className="absolute whitespace-nowrap rounded-full text-[11px] outline-none transition-opacity duration-200 focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.06]"
              style={{
                left: x,
                top: y,
                transform: `translate(${shift}, -50%)`,
                opacity: hot === null || hot === i ? 1 : 0.4,
              }}
            >
              <span className={hot === i ? "text-foreground/90" : "text-foreground/60"}>{r.label} </span>
              {r.count > 0 && <span className="font-medium text-foreground/90">{r.count}</span>}
            </button>
          )
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}


// ─── components/ui/live-figure.tsx ───

"use client"

import { type ReactNode } from "react"
import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

/* Live figure: a figure fed by a live stream (2026-10-02, out of Tape Flow, where a price
   that re-entered on every print read as a flicker). The value changes in place on each
   tick; the figure swaps (4px, 2px blur, 150ms) only when `intent` changes: the pointer
   takes a point, lets it go, or a toggle flips. Pass the pointed point's id, or null for
   the live value. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const

export function LiveFigure({
  intent,
  className,
  children,
}: {
  /** what the figure is showing: a pointed point's id, or null while it follows the stream */
  intent: string | number | null
  className?: string
  children: ReactNode
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  return (
    <motion.div
      key={intent === null ? "live" : `at-${intent}`}
      className={cn(className)}
      initial={reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: 4, filter: "blur(2px)" }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, filter: "blur(0px)" }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
    >
      {children}
    </motion.div>
  )
}

```tsx
  }
  const xy = (p: readonly [number, number]) => `${p[0].toFixed(1)},${p[1].toFixed(1)}`
  const wedge = ratings.map((r, i) => pt(i, 6 + (r.count / max) * (R - 6)))
  const shape = `M${wedge.map(xy).join(" L")} Z`
  const top = ratings.reduce((a, r) => (r.count > a.count ? r : a), ratings[0] ?? { label: "", count: 0 })
  const share = (n: number) => (total ? (n / total) * 100 : 0).toFixed(1)

  return (
    <div ref={rootRef} className={cn("w-[300px] tabular-nums", className)}>
      <div className="text-center">
        <div role="status" className="text-[11px] text-foreground/60">
          {/* the line swaps in place when the pointed rating changes (LiveFigure: 4px, 2px blur, 150ms) */}
          <LiveFigure intent={hot}>
            {hot !== null && ratings[hot] ? (
              <>
                <span className="font-medium text-foreground/90">{share(ratings[hot].count)}%</span>
                {` of ${total} analysts`}
              </>
            ) : (
              (caption ?? "\u00a0") /* no summary at rest (user call, 2026-10-02) */
            )}
          </LiveFigure>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="relative mt-1" style={{ width: SIZE_W, height: SIZE_H }} onPointerLeave={() => setHot(null)}>
        <svg
          width={SIZE_W}
          height={SIZE_H}
          viewBox={`0 0 ${SIZE_W} ${SIZE_H}`}
          className="block overflow-visible"
          role="img"
          aria-label={`${title}, ${total} analysts. Most common: ${top.label} ${top.count}, ${share(top.count)}%`}
        >
          {Array.from({ length: RINGS }, (_, ri) => {
            const rr = ((ri + 1) / RINGS) * R
            const d = `M${ratings.map((_, i) => xy(pt(i, rr))).join(" L")} Z`
            return <path key={ri} d={d} fill="none" stroke={INK} strokeOpacity={0.05} strokeWidth={1} />
          })}
          {ratings.map((r, i) => {
            const [x2, y2] = pt(i, R)
            return (
              <line
                key={r.label}
                x1={CX}
                y1={CY}
                x2={x2}
                y2={y2}
                stroke={INK}
                strokeOpacity={hot === i ? 0.28 : 0.05}
                strokeWidth={1}
                style={{ transition: reduced ? "none" : "stroke-opacity 160ms" }}
              />
            )
          })}

          <motion.path
            fill={hue}
            fillOpacity={0.16}
            initial={reduced ? false : { opacity: 0, d: shape }}
            animate={{ opacity: play ? 1 : 0, d: shape }}
            transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { opacity: { duration: 0.3, ease: EASE, delay: 0.1 }, d: morph }}
          />
          <motion.path
            fill="none"
            stroke={hue}
            strokeWidth={1.8}
            strokeLinejoin="round"
            initial={reduced ? false : { pathLength: 0, d: shape }}
            animate={{ pathLength: play ? 1 : 0, d: shape }}
            transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { pathLength: { duration: 0.4, ease: EASE }, d: morph }}
          />

          {wedge.map((p, i) => (
            /* the group carries the point to its place, so new counts glide it along the spoke */
            <motion.g
              key={ratings[i].label}
              initial={reduced ? false : { opacity: 0, x: p[0], y: p[1] }}
              animate={{ opacity: play ? 1 : 0, x: p[0], y: p[1] }}
              transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { opacity: { duration: 0.3, ease: EASE, delay: 0.2 + i * 0.035 }, default: morph }}
            >
              {/* the point grows by a transform about its own centre (2 → 3.2), never a radius tween */}
              <circle
                cx={0}
                cy={0}
                r={2}
                fill={hue}
                style={{
                  opacity: hot === null || hot === i ? 1 : 0.4,
                  transform: hot === i ? "scale(1.6)" : "scale(1)",
                  transformBox: "fill-box",
                  transformOrigin: "center",
                  transition: reduced ? "opacity 160ms" : "transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), opacity 160ms",
                }}
              />
            </motion.g>
          ))}

          {/* one slice of the pentagon per rating, so pointing anywhere near an axis picks it */}
          {ratings.map((r, i) => (
            <path
              key={r.label}
              d={`M${CX},${CY} L${xy(pt(i - 0.5, R + 8))} L${xy(pt(i, R + 8))} L${xy(pt(i + 0.5, R + 8))} Z`}
              fill="transparent"
              onPointerEnter={() => setHot(i)}
            />
          ))}
        </svg>

        {ratings.map((r, i) => {
          const [x, y] = pt(i, R + 18)
          const shift = Math.abs(x - CX) < 8 ? "-50%" : x > CX ? "0%" : "-100%"
          return (
            <button
              key={r.label}
              type="button"
              aria-label={`${r.label}: ${r.count} analysts, ${share(r.count)}%`}
              onPointerEnter={() => setHot(i)}
              onFocus={() => setHot(i)}
              onBlur={() => setHot(null)}
              onClick={() => setHot(i)}
              className="absolute whitespace-nowrap rounded-full text-[11px] outline-none transition-opacity duration-200 focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.06]"
              style={{
                left: x,
                top: y,
                transform: `translate(${shift}, -50%)`,
                opacity: hot === null || hot === i ? 1 : 0.4,
              }}
            >
              <span className={hot === i ? "text-foreground/90" : "text-foreground/60"}>{r.label} </span>
              {r.count > 0 && <span className="font-medium text-foreground/90">{r.count}</span>}
            </button>
          )
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

// ─── components/ui/live-figure.tsx ───

```tsx
"use client"

import { type ReactNode } from "react"
import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

/* Live figure: a figure fed by a live stream (2026-10-02, out of Tape Flow, where a price
   that re-entered on every print read as a flicker). The value changes in place on each
   tick; the figure swaps (4px, 2px blur, 150ms) only when `intent` changes: the pointer
   takes a point, lets it go, or a toggle flips. Pass the pointed point's id, or null for
   the live value. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const

export function LiveFigure({
  intent,
  className,
  children,
}: {
  /** what the figure is showing: a pointed point's id, or null while it follows the stream */
  intent: string | number | null
  className?: string
  children: ReactNode
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  return (
    <motion.div
      key={intent === null ? "live" : `at-${intent}`}
      className={cn(className)}
      initial={reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: 4, filter: "blur(2px)" }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, filter: "blur(0px)" }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
    >
      {children}
    </motion.div>
  )
}
```

# Analyst Radar (analyst-radar)
> A factor score radar chart for equity research, comparing a company with its sector on value, growth, profit, momentum and quality.

// ─── components/ui/analyst-radar.tsx ───

```tsx
"use client"

import { useRef, useState } from "react"
import { motion, useInView, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

/* Analyst Radar: a subject's factor scores against its sector, 0 to 100 per axis.
   Formulas: a vertex sits at score / 100 × the radius along its axis; the legend reads the
   pointed axis's two scores as given, nothing is derived.
   Motion (2026-10-01): once the chart is in view the sector shape, then the company shape,
   fades and settles from 0.9 about the centre (it was 0.6 on mount, off screen too), landed
   by 0.7s; the legend now fades a series out and back instead of remounting it, and new
   scores morph each shape in place.
   2026-10-02 audit: rebuilt to sit beside Ratings Radar. A radar has no single figure, so
   the title and the "company vs sector" caption are gone from view (title and caption still
   name the chart in its aria-label). The legend moved from a strip under the plot to the
   label row at the top, as 14.3 items: a 6px dot for the company, a dotted 10 by 2 line for
   the dashed sector, the name at /60, and the pointed axis's score at /90 (it replaces the
   old readout of two bare coloured numbers); each item stays a real toggle with
   aria-pressed. The second series is --chart-5 (the second categorical colour) instead of
   amber. Labels are 11px at /60 on the foreground ladder, the pointed one /90, never bold.
   Each axis has a slice target and a real button label, so the keyboard and touch read an
   axis the same way the mouse does, and the chart names both series to a screen reader.
   The plot is 300 by 252, level with Ratings Radar. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const BLUE = "var(--chart-1)"
const LILAC = "var(--chart-5)"
const INK = "var(--foreground)"

const W = 300
const H = 252
const CX = 150
const CY = 128
const R = 92
/** where the axis labels sit, past the outer ring */
const LABEL_R = R + 16

const DEFAULT_AXES = ["Value", "Growth", "Profit", "Momentum", "Health", "Quality"]
const DEFAULT_PRIMARY = [78, 64, 82, 55, 71, 68]
const DEFAULT_SECONDARY = [60, 58, 65, 62, 55, 60]

export interface AnalystRadarProps {
  /** names the chart to a screen reader; not printed since 2026-10-02 */
  title?: string
  /** read to a screen reader after the title; not printed since 2026-10-02 (the legend reads the pointed axis) */
  caption?: string
  /** Up to 8 axis names — the polygon carries one vertex per axis. */
  axes?: string[]
  /** Subject series, 0–100 per axis. */
  primary?: number[]
  /** Comparison series (peer group / sector), 0–100 per axis. */
  secondary?: number[]
  primaryLabel?: string
  secondaryLabel?: string
  primaryColor?: string
  secondaryColor?: string
  className?: string
}

/**
 * Multivariate score with two series overlaid — the subject against its peer
 * group — across up to 8 axes indexed 0–100. Pointing at an axis (or tabbing to
 * its label) reads both scores in the legend; a legend item mutes its series so
 * the other can be read alone. Subject is a filled polygon, peers a dashed outline.
 */
export function AnalystRadar({
  title = "Factor scores",
  caption = "company vs sector",
  axes = DEFAULT_AXES,
  primary = DEFAULT_PRIMARY,
  secondary = DEFAULT_SECONDARY,
  primaryLabel = "Company",
  secondaryLabel = "Sector",
  primaryColor = BLUE,
  secondaryColor = LILAC,
  className,
}: AnalystRadarProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const [hot, setHot] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const [show, setShow] = useState({ primary: true, secondary: true })
  /* the entrance plays once, when a third of the chart is in view; reduced motion lands at once */
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const seen = useInView(rootRef, { once: true, amount: 0.3 })
  const play = !!reduced || seen

  const n = axes.length
  const angle = (i: number) => -Math.PI / 2 + (i * 2 * Math.PI) / Math.max(1, n)
  /** a point at radius r (px) along axis i, which may be fractional for slice edges */
  const at = (i: number, r: number) => [CX + r * Math.cos(angle(i)), CY + r * Math.sin(angle(i))] as const
  const pt = (v: number, i: number) => at(i, (v / 100) * R)
  const xy = (p: readonly [number, number]) => `${p[0].toFixed(1)},${p[1].toFixed(1)}`
  const poly = (vals: number[]) => vals.map((v, i) => pt(v, i).join(",")).join(" ")
  /** the same polygon as a path, so a change of scores can morph it */
  const shapeOf = (vals: number[]) => `M${vals.map((v, i) => pt(v, i).map((c) => c.toFixed(2)).join(",")).join(" L")} Z`
  /** the chart centre as a fraction of the shape's own box, so the settle scales about it */
  const originOf = (vals: number[]) => {
    const ps = vals.map((v, i) => pt(v, i))
    const xs = ps.map((p) => p[0])
    const ys = ps.map((p) => p[1])
    const x0 = Math.min(...xs)
    const y0 = Math.min(...ys)
    return {
      originX: (CX - x0) / (Math.max(...xs) - x0 || 1),
      originY: (CY - y0) / (Math.max(...ys) - y0 || 1),
    }
  }
  /** settle in on view, fade on a legend toggle, morph on new scores */
  const shapeMotion = (vals: number[], on: boolean, delay: number) => {
    const d = shapeOf(vals)
    return {
      style: { ...originOf(vals), pointerEvents: "none" as const },
      initial: reduced ? (false as const) : { opacity: 0, scale: 0.9, d },
      animate: { opacity: play && on ? 1 : 0, scale: play ? 1 : 0.9, d },
      transition: reduced
        ? { duration: 0 }
        : {
            opacity: { duration: 0.4, ease: EASE, delay },
            scale: { duration: 0.6, ease: EASE, delay },
            d: { duration: 0.35, ease: EASE },
          },
    }
  }

  const series = [
    { key: "primary", color: primaryColor, label: primaryLabel, values: primary, dashed: false },
    { key: "secondary", color: secondaryColor, label: secondaryLabel, values: secondary, dashed: true },
  ] as const
  const summary = axes.map((ax, i) => `${ax} ${primary[i] ?? 0} and ${secondary[i] ?? 0}`).join(", ")

  return (
    <div ref={rootRef} className={cn("w-[300px] tabular-nums", className)}>
      {/* the legend in the label row: a toggle per series, the pointed axis's score after its name */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-3 text-[11px]">
        {series.map((s) => {
          const active = show[s.key]
          return (
            <button
              key={s.key}
              type="button"
              aria-pressed={active}
              aria-label={`${active ? "Hide" : "Show"} ${s.label}`}
              onClick={() => setShow((v) => ({ ...v, [s.key]: !v[s.key] }))}
              className="-mx-1.5 flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full px-1.5 outline-none transition-[opacity,background-color] duration-150 hover:bg-foreground/[0.04] focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.06]"
              style={{ opacity: active ? 1 : 0.4 }}
            >
              {s.dashed ? (
                <svg width={10} height={2} aria-hidden className="shrink-0">
                  <line x1={0} y1={1} x2={10} y2={1} stroke={s.color} strokeWidth={2} strokeDasharray="3 2" />
                </svg>
              ) : (
                <span aria-hidden className="size-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full" style={{ background: s.color }} />
              )}
              <span className="text-foreground/60">{s.label}</span>
              {/* the score holds its width, so pointing never shifts the row */}
              <span className="inline-block min-w-[1.9em] text-left font-medium text-foreground/90">
                {hot !== null ? (s.values[hot] ?? "") : " "}
              </span>
            </button>
          )
        })}
      </div>

      <div className="relative mt-1" style={{ width: W, height: H }} onPointerLeave={() => setHot(null)}>
        <svg
          width={W}
          height={H}
          viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`}
          className="block overflow-visible"
          role="img"
          aria-label={`${title}, ${caption}: ${primaryLabel} against ${secondaryLabel} out of 100. ${summary}`}
        >
          {/* grid rings */}
          {[25, 50, 75, 100].map((ring) => (
            <polygon key={ring} points={poly(axes.map(() => ring))} fill="none" stroke={INK} strokeOpacity={0.05} strokeWidth={1} />
          ))}

          {/* spokes; the pointed one firms up */}
          {axes.map((ax, i) => {
            const [ex, ey] = pt(100, i)
            return (
              <line
                key={ax}
                x1={CX}
                y1={CY}
                x2={ex}
                y2={ey}
                stroke={INK}
                strokeOpacity={hot === i ? 0.16 : 0.06}
                strokeWidth={1}
                style={{ transition: reduced ? "none" : "stroke-opacity 150ms" }}
              />
            )
          })}

          {/* comparison series — dashed outline, sits behind; muting fades it rather than removing it */}
          <motion.path
            fill={`color-mix(in srgb, ${secondaryColor} 8%, transparent)`}
            stroke={secondaryColor}
            strokeOpacity={0.7}
            strokeWidth={1.4}
            strokeDasharray="3 2"
            {...shapeMotion(secondary, show.secondary, 0)}
          />

          {/* subject series — filled */}
          <motion.path
            fill={`color-mix(in srgb, ${primaryColor} 16%, transparent)`}
            stroke={primaryColor}
            strokeWidth={1.8}
            {...shapeMotion(primary, show.primary, 0.08)}
          />

          {/* vertex dots on the pointed axis */}
          {hot !== null && (
            <g pointerEvents="none">
              {show.primary && <circle cx={pt(primary[hot] ?? 0, hot)[0]} cy={pt(primary[hot] ?? 0, hot)[1]} r={3.2} fill={primaryColor} />}
              {show.secondary && <circle cx={pt(secondary[hot] ?? 0, hot)[0]} cy={pt(secondary[hot] ?? 0, hot)[1]} r={2.8} fill={secondaryColor} />}
            </g>
          )}

          {/* one slice of the polygon per axis, so pointing anywhere near an axis picks it */}
          {axes.map((ax, i) => (
            <path
              key={ax}
              d={`M${CX},${CY} L${xy(at(i - 0.5, R + 8))} L${xy(at(i, R + 8))} L${xy(at(i + 0.5, R + 8))} Z`}
              fill="transparent"
              onPointerEnter={() => setHot(i)}
            />
          ))}
        </svg>

        {/* the axis names are real buttons: focus and a tap read the axis like the pointer does */}
        {axes.map((ax, i) => {
          const [x, y] = at(i, LABEL_R)
          const shift = Math.abs(x - CX) < 8 ? "-50%" : x > CX ? "0%" : "-100%"
          return (
            <button
              key={ax}
              type="button"
              aria-label={`${ax}: ${primaryLabel} ${primary[i] ?? 0}, ${secondaryLabel} ${secondary[i] ?? 0}`}
              onPointerEnter={() => setHot(i)}
              onFocus={() => setHot(i)}
              onBlur={() => setHot(null)}
              onClick={() => setHot(i)}
              className={cn(
                "absolute whitespace-nowrap rounded-full text-[11px] outline-none transition-colors duration-150 focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.06]",
                hot === i ? "text-foreground/90" : "text-foreground/60",
              )}
              style={{ left: x, top: y, transform: `translate(${shift}, -50%)` }}
            >
              {ax}
            </button>
          )
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

# Scatter Plot (scatter-plot)
> A risk and return scatter plot of stocks by volatility and yearly return, naming each point with a hairline to both axes.

// ─── components/ui/scatter-plot.tsx ───

```tsx
"use client"

import { useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react"
import { motion, useInView, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { ChartCard } from "@/components/ui/chart-overlay"

/* Scatter Plot, written new through ssych-component (2026-09-29).
   What it is for: many things on two measures at once, to see which sit apart (risk
   against return, cost against quality, latency against load).
   Read first: the solid zero line. Above it gained, below it lost; how far right is how
   rough the ride was.
   The pointer: anywhere on the plot the nearest point is taken, so the reading never
   blinks out between points; it keeps full strength, drops hairlines to both axes, dims
   the rest and is read in a card beside it. Tabbing to a point does the same. A press
   holds the point until it is pressed again.
   Reference: none usable, written from nothing.
   Formulas:
   · position     = the two values as given, on linear axes
   · axis bounds  = the lowest and highest value, rounded out to the gridline step
   · gridline step = the smallest of 1, 2, 2.5, 5, 10 × a power of ten that covers the
                     range in five steps or fewer
   · colour       = the sign of the vertical value: green at zero or above, red below
   Motion (2026-10-01): once the plot is a third in view the points fade in and settle 4px,
   left to right by their horizontal value, 30ms apart over 450ms (under 900ms in all; CSS
   transitions, no script per frame); reduced motion shows them placed. No data changes here.
   2026-10-02 audit: the reading of a point was a 10.5px /45 sentence in the corner with dots
   between its parts, and the pointer fell into the gaps between the 20px buttons. Now a card
   beside the point (chart-overlay.tsx) reads it: the symbol at /90 and the name after it,
   then the two measures, the vertical one in its hue; and the whole plot snaps to the nearest
   point (the buttons stay for the keyboard and the press). The grid is horizontal only and
   solid at 5% with the zero line the strong one, the x ticks are text alone, every tick
   carries its unit (new `xUnit` and `yUnit` props, "%" by default), the lone "1 year"
   caption folded into the axis name ("Return, 1y"), axis text is at /45, and the width is
   460 like the other non price charts.
   · nearest point = the smallest straight distance from the pointer, in drawn pixels */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const CSS_EASE = "cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)"
const GREEN = "var(--chart-up)"
const RED = "var(--chart-down)"

export interface ScatterPoint {
  /** short name drawn beside the point */
  name: string
  /** longer name for the readout */
  detail?: string
  x: number
  y: number
}

export interface ScatterPlotProps {
  points?: ScatterPoint[]
  /** the plot's screen-reader name; the axes name the two measures on screen */
  title?: string
  /** the period, written into the vertical axis's name ("Return, 1y") */
  caption?: string
  /** unit after each horizontal tick */
  xUnit?: string
  /** unit after each vertical tick */
  yUnit?: string
  /** what the rows are, plural */
  noun?: string
  xLabel?: string
  yLabel?: string
  formatX?: (v: number) => string
  formatY?: (v: number) => string
  /** colour points by the sign of y; off, every point is ink */
  direction?: boolean
  className?: string
}

/* volatility and total return over one year, in percent: 9 up, 5 down */
const DEFAULT_POINTS: ScatterPoint[] = [
  { name: "NVDA", detail: "NVIDIA", x: 48.2, y: 62.4 },
  { name: "AVGO", detail: "Broadcom", x: 41.3, y: 47.5 },
  { name: "META", detail: "Meta Platforms", x: 34.8, y: 38.9 },
  { name: "WMT", detail: "Walmart", x: 16.9, y: 28.4 },
  { name: "JPM", detail: "JPMorgan Chase", x: 19.8, y: 24.2 },
  { name: "AMZN", detail: "Amazon", x: 29.4, y: 21.7 },
  { name: "AAPL", detail: "Apple", x: 24.6, y: 18.3 },
  { name: "MSFT", detail: "Microsoft", x: 22.1, y: 14.8 },
  { name: "GOOGL", detail: "Alphabet", x: 28.3, y: 9.6 },
  { name: "XOM", detail: "Exxon Mobil", x: 21.4, y: -4.3 },
  { name: "AMD", detail: "Advanced Micro Devices", x: 46.5, y: -8.1 },
  { name: "TSLA", detail: "Tesla", x: 58.7, y: -12.4 },
  { name: "UNH", detail: "UnitedHealth", x: 27.2, y: -18.7 },
  { name: "INTC", detail: "Intel", x: 44.9, y: -31.6 },
]

const W = 460
const H = 290
const PAD = { l: 6, r: 40, t: 16, b: 22 }

const plain = (v: number) => `${v.toFixed(1)}%`
const signedPct = (v: number) => `${v >= 0 ? "+" : "−"}${Math.abs(v).toFixed(1)}%`
/** tick text: no decimals unless the step needs them, a true minus */
const tick = (v: number) => `${v < 0 ? "−" : ""}${Number(Math.abs(v).toFixed(2))}`

/** bounds rounded out to the step, and the gridlines between them */
function axis(vals: number[], want = 5) {
  const lo = vals.length ? Math.min(...vals) : 0
  const hi = vals.length ? Math.max(...vals) : 1
  const span = hi - lo || 1
  const pow = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(span / want)))
  const step = [1, 2, 2.5, 5, 10].map((m) => m * pow).find((st) => span / st <= want) ?? 10 * pow
  const min = Math.floor(lo / step) * step
  const max = Math.max(min + step, Math.ceil(hi / step) * step)
  const ticks: number[] = []
  for (let v = min; v <= max + step / 2; v += step) ticks.push(Number(v.toFixed(6)))
  return { min, max, ticks }
}

/**
 * Points on two measures over a quiet grid, the zero line the only solid one. Points
 * come in once, a few milliseconds apart. Pointing at one names it, measures it against
 * both axes with a hairline each way, and lets the rest step back.
 */
export function ScatterPlot({
  points = DEFAULT_POINTS,
  title = "Risk and return",
  caption = "1y",
  xUnit = "%",
  yUnit = "%",
  noun = "stocks",
  xLabel = "Volatility",
  yLabel = "Return",
  formatX = plain,
  formatY = signedPct,
  direction = true,
  className,
}: ScatterPlotProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const boxRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  /* the points wait until the plot is a third in view, then settle in once */
  const play = useInView(boxRef, { once: true, amount: 0.3 }) || !!reduced
  const [hover, setHover] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const [pin, setPin] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const hot = hover ?? pin

  const { ax, ay } = useMemo(() => ({ ax: axis(points.map((p) => p.x)), ay: axis(points.map((p) => p.y)) }), [points])
  const x = (v: number) => PAD.l + ((v - ax.min) / (ax.max - ax.min || 1)) * (W - PAD.l - PAD.r)
  const y = (v: number) => PAD.t + (1 - (v - ay.min) / (ay.max - ay.min || 1)) * (H - PAD.t - PAD.b)
  const hueOf = (p: ScatterPoint) => (direction ? (p.y >= 0 ? GREEN : RED) : "var(--foreground)")
  /** each point's place left to right, the order they come in */
  const column = useMemo(() => {
    const byX = points.map((p, i) => ({ x: p.x, i })).sort((a, b) => a.x - b.x)
    const out: number[] = []
    byX.forEach((p, k) => (out[p.i] = k))
    return out
  }, [points])

  const shown = hot !== null ? points[hot] : null
  /* the card beside the pointed point, on its left past 60% of the plot, kept inside it */
  const flip = shown !== null && x(shown.x) / W > 0.6
  const cardY = shown ? Math.max(0, Math.min(H - 92, y(shown.y) - 24)) : 0

  /* anywhere on the plot the nearest point owns the pointer, so the reading never blinks out */
  const onMove = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    const el = boxRef.current
    if (!el || !points.length) return
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect()
    const px = ((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width) * W
    const py = ((e.clientY - r.top) / r.height) * H
    let best = 0
    let dist = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY
    points.forEach((p, i) => {
      const d = Math.hypot(x(p.x) - px, y(p.y) - py)
      if (d < dist) {
        dist = d
        best = i
      }
    })
    setHover(best)
  }

  return (
    <div className={cn("w-[480px] max-w-full tabular-nums", className)}>
      <div ref={boxRef} className="relative cursor-crosshair" onPointerMove={onMove} onPointerLeave={() => setHover(null)}>
        <svg
          viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`}
          className="block w-full overflow-visible"
          role="img"
          aria-label={`${title}, ${caption}: ${yLabel.toLowerCase()} against ${xLabel.toLowerCase()}, ${points.length} ${noun}, ${points.filter((p) => p.y >= 0).length} at zero or above`}
        >
          {ay.ticks.map((v) => (
            <g key={`y${v}`}>
              <line
                x1={PAD.l}
                y1={y(v)}
                x2={W - PAD.r}
                y2={y(v)}
                stroke="var(--foreground)"
                strokeOpacity={v === 0 ? 0.14 : 0.05}
                strokeWidth={1}
              />
              <text x={W - PAD.r + 8} y={y(v) + 3} fontSize={9} fill="var(--foreground)" fillOpacity={0.45}>
                {tick(v)}
                {yUnit}
              </text>
            </g>
          ))}
          {/* the horizontal measure: its ticks as text only, no vertical rules */}
          {ax.ticks.map((v) => (
            <text key={`x${v}`} x={x(v)} y={H - 6} fontSize={9} textAnchor="middle" fill="var(--foreground)" fillOpacity={0.45}>
              {tick(v)}
              {xUnit}
            </text>
          ))}
          {/* the axes name themselves at their far ends, inside the plot */}
          <text x={PAD.l + 4} y={PAD.t - 6} fontSize={9} fill="var(--foreground)" fillOpacity={0.45}>
            {caption ? `${yLabel}, ${caption}` : yLabel}
          </text>
          <text x={W - PAD.r - 4} y={H - PAD.b - 6} fontSize={9} textAnchor="end" fill="var(--foreground)" fillOpacity={0.45}>
            {xLabel}
          </text>

          {shown && (
            <g pointerEvents="none">
              <line x1={x(shown.x)} y1={y(shown.y)} x2={x(shown.x)} y2={H - PAD.b} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.28} strokeWidth={1} />
              <line x1={x(shown.x)} y1={y(shown.y)} x2={W - PAD.r} y2={y(shown.y)} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.28} strokeWidth={1} />
            </g>
          )}

          {points.map((p, i) => {
            const on = hot === i
            return (
              /* the group owns the dim so it never fights the entrance inside */
              <g key={p.name} style={{ opacity: hot !== null && !on ? 0.35 : 1, transition: reduced ? "none" : "opacity 160ms" }}>
                <circle
                  cx={x(p.x)}
                  cy={y(p.y)}
                  fill={hueOf(p)}
                  fillOpacity={direction ? 1 : 0.9}
                  stroke="var(--background)"
                  strokeWidth={1}
                  r={3.4}
                  /* each point fades in and settles 4px, left to right, 30ms apart (the stagger
                     is capped at 390ms however many points there are) */
                  style={{
                    opacity: play ? 1 : 0,
                    transform: play ? "none" : "translateY(4px)",
                    transition: reduced
                      ? "none"
                      : `opacity 450ms ${CSS_EASE} ${Math.min(0.39, column[i] * 0.03)}s, transform 450ms ${CSS_EASE} ${Math.min(0.39, column[i] * 0.03)}s`,
                  }}
                />
                {on && (
                  <motion.circle
                    cx={x(p.x)}
                    cy={y(p.y)}
                    r={6.5}
                    fill="none"
                    stroke={hueOf(p)}
                    strokeWidth={1.5}
                    pointerEvents="none"
                    style={{ transformBox: "fill-box", transformOrigin: "center" }}
                    initial={reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, scale: 0.8 }}
                    animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
                    transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
                  />
                )}
              </g>
            )
          })}
        </svg>

        {/* the pointed point, read in a card beside it (chart-overlay.tsx) */}
        <ChartCard
          open={shown !== null}
          x={shown ? `${((x(shown.x) + (flip ? -4 : 4)) / W) * 100}%` : 0}
          y={cardY}
          flip={flip}
          width={168}
          heading={
            shown ? (
              <span className="flex min-w-0 gap-1.5">
                <span className="shrink-0 font-medium text-foreground/90">{shown.name}</span>
                {shown.detail && <span className="truncate">{shown.detail}</span>}
              </span>
            ) : (
              ""
            )
          }
          rows={
            shown
              ? [
                  { label: xLabel, value: formatX(shown.x) },
                  { label: yLabel, value: formatY(shown.y), color: direction ? hueOf(shown) : undefined },
                ]
              : []
          }
        />

        {/* one real button over each point: the target is larger than the mark */}
        {points.map((p, i) => (
          <button
            key={p.name}
            type="button"
            aria-label={`${p.name}${p.detail ? `, ${p.detail}` : ""}: ${xLabel.toLowerCase()} ${formatX(p.x)}, ${yLabel.toLowerCase()} ${formatY(p.y)}`}
            aria-pressed={pin === i}
            onPointerEnter={() => setHover(i)}
            onFocus={() => setHover(i)}
            onBlur={() => setHover(null)}
            onClick={() => setPin((k) => (k === i ? null : i))}
            className="absolute -ml-[10px] -mt-[10px] h-5 w-5 cursor-pointer rounded-full outline-none"
            style={{ left: `${(x(p.x) / W) * 100}%`, top: `${(y(p.y) / H) * 100}%`, zIndex: hot === i ? 2 : 1 }}
          />
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

```

// ─── components/ui/chart-overlay.tsx ───

```tsx
"use client"

import { type ReactNode } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

/* Chart overlay: the two parts every library chart reads a point with (2026-10-02). They
   came out of Candlestick, Volume Profile, the trading terminal and Price Scrubber, which
   had each drawn their own; this is the one copy. Shipped beside the charts that use it.

   AxisTag   the outlined tag on the value axis: the pointed value in its hue, or a named
             reference (POC, last close) in ink. A pill 16px high, 8.5px figures.
   ChartCard the card laid over the chart beside the cursor: a heading row (a time or a
             range) at /60, then label and value rows (labels 10px /60, values 11px /90),
             the one signed figure in its hue. It glides between points on a spring, fades
             in from 0.97 and out in 120ms, and flips to the cursor's left when told to.

   2026-10-02: the card looked out of place over the charts, so it now wears the library
   popover, the same as the sidebar's hover card: a hairline border at 8%, radius 12, the
   6% foreground mix and the popover shadow with no inset highlight (spec 14.6). */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GLIDE = { type: "spring", stiffness: 520, damping: 40 } as const

/** the outlined tag on a chart's value axis, centred on `y` */
export function AxisTag({
  x,
  y,
  width,
  color = "var(--foreground)",
  strong = true,
  hidden = false,
  children,
}: {
  /** the tag's left edge, in the chart's own units */
  x: number
  /** the value's line; the tag is centred on it */
  y: number
  width: number
  /** stroke and figure; ink for a named reference, the series hue for the pointed value */
  color?: string
  /** a quieter tag (a secondary reference) drops the weight and the stroke */
  strong?: boolean
  /** fades the tag out, for when the pointed value sits on it */
  hidden?: boolean
  children: ReactNode
}) {
  return (
    <g transform={`translate(${x}, ${y - 8})`} pointerEvents="none" style={{ opacity: hidden ? 0 : 1, transition: "opacity 150ms" }}>
      <rect width={width} height={16} rx={8} fill="var(--background)" stroke={color} strokeOpacity={strong ? 0.6 : 0.2} />
      <text x={width / 2} y={11} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={8.5} fontWeight={strong ? 600 : 500} fill={color} fillOpacity={strong ? 1 : 0.65}>
        {children}
      </text>
    </g>
  )
}

export interface ChartCardRow {
  label: string
  value: ReactNode
  /** only the one signed figure carries a hue */
  color?: string
}

/** the readout card over a chart; place it inside a `relative` box that holds the svg */
export function ChartCard({
  open,
  x,
  y = 4,
  flip = false,
  width = 148,
  heading,
  rows,
  footer,
}: {
  open: boolean
  /** the cursor's x inside the box: px, or a percentage string for a chart drawn to a viewBox */
  x: number | string
  /** the card's top inside the box, px */
  y?: number
  /** put the card on the cursor's left (past ~60% of the plot) */
  flip?: boolean
  width?: number
  heading: ReactNode
  rows: ChartCardRow[]
  /** a closing line under the rows, such as where the point sits */
  footer?: ReactNode
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {open && (
        <motion.div
          key="chart-card"
          role="status"
          className="pointer-events-none absolute z-10"
          initial={{ left: x, top: y, opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ left: x, top: y, opacity: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, transition: { duration: 0.12 } }}
          transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { left: GLIDE, top: GLIDE, opacity: { duration: 0.15 } }}
        >
          <motion.div
            className="rounded-[12px] border border-foreground/[0.08] px-3 py-2.5"
            style={{
              width,
              translate: flip ? "calc(-100% - 12px) 0" : "12px 0",
              transition: reduced ? undefined : "translate 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)",
              background: "var(--tip-fill, color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 6%, var(--background)))",
              boxShadow: "0 8px 24px var(--card-shadow, rgba(0,0,0,calc(0.35 * var(--shadow-k, 1))))",
            }}
            initial={reduced ? false : { scale: 0.97 }}
            animate={{ scale: 1 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
          >
            <div className="text-[10px] text-foreground/60">{heading}</div>
            <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-col gap-1">
              {rows.map((r) => (
                <div key={r.label} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-foreground/60">{r.label}</span>
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-foreground/90" style={r.color ? { color: r.color } : undefined}>
                    {r.value}
                  </span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            {footer && <div className="mt-1.5 text-[10px]">{footer}</div>}
          </motion.div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  )
}
```

# Market Heatmap (market-heatmap)
> A stock market heatmap with tiles sized by market cap and tinted by the daily move, for market overview and trading dashboards.

// ─── components/ui/market-heatmap.tsx ───

```tsx
"use client"

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react"
import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { ChartCard } from "@/components/ui/chart-overlay"
import { parkBeside, squarify } from "@/components/ui/market-heatmap-squarify"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

/* Market Heatmap: the market as one block of ground, tiles sized by market cap and tinted
   on a diverging scale by the day's move, so scale and direction read at once.
   Formulas, all from `data`:
   · tile area   = cap / sum of caps × 460 × 280 (squarified, largest first)
   · tile fill   = the up or down hue at min(|chg| / 3, 1) × 48 + 9 percent, over nothing
   · card Price  = price, 2dp · Change = chg, 2dp, signed · Cap = cap in trillions, 2dp
   2026-10-02 audit: his call was more roundness and colours that fit the rest, so tiles are
   fills only with a 6px corner and a 2px gap (no outline, no rounded frame round the map),
   up is var(--chart-up) instead of the teal, text sits on the foreground ladder and tickers
   are weight 500. The title and its explainer line are gone from view (the title prop now
   names the map in the aria-label only, with the sizing note). The pointed tile reads in the
   shared ChartCard, parked clear of the tile as before. Each tile is a real button, so focus
   reads like hover and a press pins the card; Escape lets it go. The entrance stagger runs on
   the entrance only; the hover dim answers in 150ms with no delay. The squarifier is the one
   the Treemap family shares (market-heatmap-squarify). */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const UP = "var(--chart-up)"
const DOWN = "var(--chart-down)"

/** A hue as text: in the light theme its lightness is capped so small figures reach AA
 *  while the chroma stays; in dark it is native (`--ink-l` flips per theme on the root). */
const ink = (c: string) => `oklch(from ${c} min(l, var(--ink-l, 1)) c h)`

export interface HeatmapCo {
  sym: string
  name: string
  /** market cap in trillions — drives tile area */
  cap: number
  /** percent change on the day — drives tile hue */
  chg: number
  price: number
}

export interface MarketHeatmapProps {
  /** one tile per company, any length; areas rescale to fill the box */
  data?: HeatmapCo[]
  /** the map's name; since 2026-10-02 read to assistive tech only (no visible title) */
  title?: string
  /** the map's height in px (2026-10-06); left out it follows the width, 280 at the default 460 */
  height?: number
  /** what the tile size measures, read in the card ("Cap" left out) */
  sizeLabel?: string
  /** how that size is written in the card (trillions of dollars left out) */
  formatSize?: (v: number) => string
  className?: string
}

const DEFAULT_DATA: HeatmapCo[] = [
  { sym: "AAPL", name: "Apple", cap: 3.4, chg: 0.8, price: 228.5 },
  { sym: "MSFT", name: "Microsoft", cap: 3.1, chg: 1.2, price: 441.2 },
  { sym: "NVDA", name: "NVIDIA", cap: 2.9, chg: 3.1, price: 179.8 },
  { sym: "GOOGL", name: "Alphabet", cap: 2.1, chg: -0.6, price: 182.4 },
  { sym: "AMZN", name: "Amazon", cap: 1.9, chg: 1.5, price: 201.3 },
  { sym: "META", name: "Meta", cap: 1.3, chg: -1.2, price: 512.7 },
  { sym: "AVGO", name: "Broadcom", cap: 0.8, chg: 2.2, price: 168.1 },
  { sym: "TSLA", name: "Tesla", cap: 0.78, chg: -2.4, price: 244.9 },
  { sym: "JPM", name: "JPMorgan", cap: 0.62, chg: 0.3, price: 214.6 },
  { sym: "V", name: "Visa", cap: 0.55, chg: 0.1, price: 289.0 },
  { sym: "WMT", name: "Walmart", cap: 0.5, chg: -0.4, price: 69.4 },
  { sym: "XOM", name: "Exxon", cap: 0.48, chg: -1.1, price: 118.2 },
  { sym: "UNH", name: "UnitedHealth", cap: 0.45, chg: 0.9, price: 528.3 },
  { sym: "MA", name: "Mastercard", cap: 0.42, chg: 0.2, price: 471.5 },
  { sym: "HD", name: "Home Depot", cap: 0.38, chg: -0.7, price: 361.8 },
  { sym: "PG", name: "P&G", cap: 0.35, chg: 0.5, price: 167.9 },
]

const W = 460
const H = 280
/** half the 2px gap: every tile gives up 1px on each side */
const INSET = 1
const RADIUS = 6

type Tile = { x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number; co: HeatmapCo }

/** diverging: one hue per direction, magnitude as the mix percentage */
const tileFill = (chg: number) =>
  `color-mix(in srgb, ${chg >= 0 ? UP : DOWN} ${Math.round(Math.min(Math.abs(chg) / 3, 1) * 48 + 9)}%, transparent)`

const signedPct = (v: number, dp: number) => `${v >= 0 ? "+" : "−"}${Math.abs(v).toFixed(dp)}%`

/** the ChartCard's size: 148 wide (its default), and its height from its fixed type
 *  (10px heading, three 11px rows, 10px padding top and bottom) */
const TIP_W = 148
const TIP_H = 102

/**
 * The market as one block of ground: tiles sized by market cap and tinted on a
 * diverging scale by the day's move, so scale and direction read at once.
 * Pointing at a tile (or tabbing to it) dims the rest and parks a card beside it
 * with price, change and cap; pressing pins that card in place.
 */
export function MarketHeatmap({
  data = DEFAULT_DATA,
  title = "Market map, today",
  height,
  sizeLabel = "Cap",
  formatSize = (v: number) => `$${v.toFixed(2)}T`,
  className,
}: MarketHeatmapProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const [hover, setHover] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [pin, setPin] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const hot = pin ?? hover
  /* laid out at the width it is given (2026-10-06): the tiles fill the box and the text keeps
     its size. At the default class that is 460 × 280, as before */
  const boxRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const [box, setBox] = useState({ w: W, h: height ?? H })
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = boxRef.current
    if (!el) return
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(([e]) => {
      const w = Math.round(e.contentRect.width) || W
      setBox({ w, h: height ?? Math.round(Math.min(440, Math.max(H, w * 0.5))) })
    })
    ro.observe(el)
    return () => ro.disconnect()
  }, [height])
  const tiles = useMemo<Tile[]>(
    () => squarify(data, (c) => c.cap, box.w, box.h).map((t) => ({ x: t.x, y: t.y, w: t.w, h: t.h, co: t.item })),
    [data, box.w, box.h],
  )
  const hotTile = tiles.find((t) => t.co.sym === hot)
  /* parked clear of the tile it reads: above, below, right, left, then the far corner */
  const tip = hotTile ? parkBeside(hotTile, TIP_W, TIP_H, box.w, box.h) : null

  return (
    <div ref={boxRef} className={cn("w-[460px] max-w-full tabular-nums [--ink-l:0.5] dark:[--ink-l:1]", className)}>
      <div className="relative" style={{ width: box.w, height: box.h }} onPointerLeave={() => setHover(null)}>
        <svg width={box.w} height={box.h} viewBox={`0 0 ${box.w} ${box.h}`} className="block" role="img" aria-label={`${title}: ${tiles.length} companies sized by market cap, tinted by the day's move`}>
          {tiles.map((t, i) => {
            const on = hot === t.co.sym
            const dim = hot !== null && !on
            const big = t.w > 52 && t.h > 30
            const w = Math.max(0, t.w - INSET * 2)
            const h = Math.max(0, t.h - INSET * 2)
            const hue = t.co.chg >= 0 ? UP : DOWN
            return (
              /* the outer group runs the entrance once; the inner one owns the dim, so a hover never waits on a stagger */
              <motion.g
                key={t.co.sym}
                initial={reduced ? false : { opacity: 0 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
                transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.35, ease: EASE, delay: i * 0.02 }}
              >
                <g style={{ opacity: dim ? 0.35 : 1, transition: reduced ? "none" : "opacity 150ms" }}>
                  <rect x={t.x + INSET} y={t.y + INSET} width={w} height={h} rx={Math.min(RADIUS, w / 2, h / 2)} fill={tileFill(t.co.chg)} />
                  {big && (
                    <>
                      <text x={t.x + 8} y={t.y + 18} fontSize={11} fontWeight={500} fill="var(--foreground)" fillOpacity={0.9}>
                        {t.co.sym}
                      </text>
                      <text x={t.x + 8} y={t.y + 30} fontSize={9.5} fontWeight={500} fill={ink(hue)}>
                        {signedPct(t.co.chg, 1)}
                      </text>
                    </>
                  )}
                  {!big && t.w > 26 && (
                    <text x={t.x + t.w / 2} y={t.y + t.h / 2 + 3} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={8.5} fontWeight={500} fill="var(--foreground)" fillOpacity={0.7}>
                      {t.co.sym}
                    </text>
                  )}
                </g>
              </motion.g>
            )
          })}
        </svg>

        {/* one real button per tile over the drawing: the pointer, focus and touch all read the
            same tile, a press pins its card and Escape lets it go */}
        {tiles.map((t) => (
          <button
            key={t.co.sym}
            type="button"
            aria-label={`${t.co.sym} ${t.co.name}, $${t.co.price.toFixed(2)}, ${signedPct(t.co.chg, 2)}, cap $${t.co.cap.toFixed(2)}T`}
            aria-pressed={pin === t.co.sym}
            onPointerEnter={() => {
              if (!pin) setHover(t.co.sym)
            }}
            onFocus={() => {
              if (!pin) setHover(t.co.sym)
            }}
            onBlur={() => setHover(null)}
            onClick={() => setPin((p) => (p === t.co.sym ? null : t.co.sym))}
            onKeyDown={(e) => {
              if (e.key === "Escape") setPin(null)
            }}
            className="absolute cursor-pointer outline-none"
            style={{ left: t.x + INSET, top: t.y + INSET, width: Math.max(0, t.w - INSET * 2), height: Math.max(0, t.h - INSET * 2), borderRadius: RADIUS }}
          />
        ))}

        {/* never over the tile it describes, never outside the box; ChartCard sits 12px right of x */}
        <ChartCard
          open={!!hotTile && !!tip}
          x={(tip?.left ?? 0) - 12}
          y={tip?.top ?? 0}
          width={TIP_W}
          heading={
            hotTile ? (
              <>
                <span className="font-medium text-foreground/90">{hotTile.co.sym}</span> {hotTile.co.name}
              </>
            ) : null
          }
          rows={
            hotTile
              ? [
                  { label: "Price", value: `$${hotTile.co.price.toFixed(2)}` },
                  { label: "Change", value: signedPct(hotTile.co.chg, 2), color: ink(hotTile.co.chg >= 0 ? UP : DOWN) },
                  { label: sizeLabel, value: formatSize(hotTile.co.cap) },
                ]
              : []
          }
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```
