// ─── components/ui/chart-overlay.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { type ReactNode } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

/* Chart overlay: the two parts every library chart reads a point with (2026-10-02). They
   came out of Candlestick, Volume Profile, the trading terminal and Price Scrubber, which
   had each drawn their own; this is the one copy. Shipped beside the charts that use it.

   AxisTag   the outlined tag on the value axis: the pointed value in its hue, or a named
             reference (POC, last close) in ink. A pill 16px high, 8.5px figures.
   ChartCard the card laid over the chart beside the cursor: a heading row (a time or a
             range) at /60, then label and value rows (labels 10px /60, values 11px /90),
             the one signed figure in its hue. It glides between points on a spring, fades
             in from 0.97 and out in 120ms, and flips to the cursor's left when told to.

   2026-10-02: the card looked out of place over the charts, so it now wears the library
   popover, the same as the sidebar's hover card: a hairline border at 8%, radius 12, the
   6% foreground mix and the popover shadow with no inset highlight (spec 14.6). */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GLIDE = { type: "spring", stiffness: 520, damping: 40 } as const

/** the outlined tag on a chart's value axis, centred on `y` */
export function AxisTag({
  x,
  y,
  width,
  color = "var(--foreground)",
  strong = true,
  hidden = false,
  children,
}: {
  /** the tag's left edge, in the chart's own units */
  x: number
  /** the value's line; the tag is centred on it */
  y: number
  width: number
  /** stroke and figure; ink for a named reference, the series hue for the pointed value */
  color?: string
  /** a quieter tag (a secondary reference) drops the weight and the stroke */
  strong?: boolean
  /** fades the tag out, for when the pointed value sits on it */
  hidden?: boolean
  children: ReactNode
}) {
  return (
    <g transform={`translate(${x}, ${y - 8})`} pointerEvents="none" style={{ opacity: hidden ? 0 : 1, transition: "opacity 150ms" }}>
      <rect width={width} height={16} rx={8} fill="var(--background)" stroke={color} strokeOpacity={strong ? 0.6 : 0.2} />
      <text x={width / 2} y={11} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={8.5} fontWeight={strong ? 600 : 500} fill={color} fillOpacity={strong ? 1 : 0.65}>
        {children}
      </text>
    </g>
  )
}

export interface ChartCardRow {
  label: string
  value: ReactNode
  /** only the one signed figure carries a hue */
  color?: string
}

/** the readout card over a chart; place it inside a `relative` box that holds the svg */
export function ChartCard({
  open,
  x,
  y = 4,
  flip = false,
  width = 148,
  heading,
  rows,
  footer,
}: {
  open: boolean
  /** the cursor's x inside the box: px, or a percentage string for a chart drawn to a viewBox */
  x: number | string
  /** the card's top inside the box, px */
  y?: number
  /** put the card on the cursor's left (past ~60% of the plot) */
  flip?: boolean
  width?: number
  heading: ReactNode
  rows: ChartCardRow[]
  /** a closing line under the rows, such as where the point sits */
  footer?: ReactNode
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {open && (
        <motion.div
          key="chart-card"
          role="status"
          className="pointer-events-none absolute z-10"
          initial={{ left: x, top: y, opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ left: x, top: y, opacity: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, transition: { duration: 0.12 } }}
          transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { left: GLIDE, top: GLIDE, opacity: { duration: 0.15 } }}
        >
          <motion.div
            className="rounded-[12px] border border-foreground/[0.08] px-3 py-2.5"
            style={{
              width,
              translate: flip ? "calc(-100% - 12px) 0" : "12px 0",
              transition: reduced ? undefined : "translate 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)",
              background: "var(--tip-fill, color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 6%, var(--background)))",
              boxShadow: "0 8px 24px var(--card-shadow, rgba(0,0,0,calc(0.35 * var(--shadow-k, 1))))",
            }}
            initial={reduced ? false : { scale: 0.97 }}
            animate={{ scale: 1 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
          >
            <div className="text-[10px] text-foreground/60">{heading}</div>
            <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-col gap-1">
              {rows.map((r) => (
                <div key={r.label} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-foreground/60">{r.label}</span>
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-foreground/90" style={r.color ? { color: r.color } : undefined}>
                    {r.value}
                  </span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            {footer && <div className="mt-1.5 text-[10px]">{footer}</div>}
          </motion.div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  )
}
```

# Net Flow Bars (flow-bars)
> A net flow bar chart for daily ETF, exchange or wallet inflows and outflows, where dragging across days sums the run.

// ─── components/ui/flow-bars.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react"
import type { KeyboardEvent, PointerEvent } from "react"
import { motion, useInView, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { AxisTag, ChartCard } from "@/components/ui/chart-overlay"
import { ICON_BUTTON } from "@/components/ui/control-classes"
import { Tip } from "@/components/ui/browser-window-tip"

/* Flow Bars, promoted from a lab sketch through ssych-component (2026-09-29).
   What it is for: money in and out by the day. Thin signed bars off a zero line, twelve
   weeks to a page.
   Read first: the net for the window, the headline.
   The pointer: moving over the plot reads one day in a card by the cursor. Dragging sums a
   run of days in the same card, and that run stays until the next press. Left and right
   arrows walk the days, Escape lets go. The two arrows in the header page the window back
   and forward through time.
   Sketch: lab/FlowBars. Kept: 84 signed bars to a page over a seeded series of three
   pages, the zero axis, the hover reading, drag to sum a window, the pager.
   Changed: inflow is green and outflow red (it was ink and amber); the reading is a line
   of text above the plot, not a box floating over the bars; the brushed window is an
   ink band, not blue; the pager buttons lost their outlines.
   Fixed in the sample numbers: the sketch's headline, 40.02B, came from nowhere while the
   bars were in thousands, so the headline is now the net of the bars on the page; the
   four quarter names under the plot never changed with the page, so the axis now carries
   the dates of the days drawn. The unit is millions of dollars throughout.
   Formulas:
   · net of a window = the sum of its daily flows
   · days in = the count of days with a flow of zero or more
   · axis top = the first step at or above the largest flow, either sign, over the whole
     series, so the scale holds still from page to page
   · bar height = |flow| ÷ axis top × half the plot
   Motion (2026-10-01): once the plot first comes into view the bars grow off the zero line,
   inflows up and outflows down, left to right under one 300ms stagger, done by about 750ms.
   A page turn tweens every bar from the old day's flow to the new one in 350ms, crossing the
   zero line when the sign flips, and the dates under the plot cross-fade. Each bar is drawn
   at half the plot and scaled to its flow, so all of it is CSS transitions on transform.
   Reduced motion draws every state at once.
   2026-10-02 audit: a summary line sat where the headline belongs and every reading was a
   line of text above the plot. The header is now the library's three tiers: the title at
   /45 with the window's dates at /90 and the pager on the right (two icon buttons with a
   tip each, Earlier and Later, the "page 1 of 3" text gone), the net of the window as the
   26px headline, and a sub line saying in its hue whether the window netted in or out, then
   its length at /45. Hovering a day draws the crosshair, tags the day's flow on the axis and
   reads it in a card by the cursor; a dragged run reads its range, net and days in in the
   same card. Gridlines are solid at 5%, figures carry the dollar sign (a new `prefix`
   prop, "$" by default) and axis text is at /45. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const EASE_CSS = "cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)"
const GREEN = "var(--chart-up)"
const RED = "var(--chart-down)"

export interface FlowBarsProps {
  /** one signed flow for each day, oldest first */
  data?: number[]
  /** one label for each day */
  labels?: string[]
  /** days drawn at once */
  perPage?: number
  title?: string
  /** written after every figure */
  unit?: string
  /** written before every figure, after the sign */
  prefix?: string
  className?: string
}

const MONTHS = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"]
const DAYS_IN = [31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]
/** a day of a 365-day year as "Mar 25"; 0 is Jan 1 */
const dayLabel = (d: number) => {
  let m = 0
  let r = d
  while (m < 11 && r >= DAYS_IN[m]) {
    r -= DAYS_IN[m]
    m++
  }
  return `${MONTHS[m]} ${r + 1}`
}

const N = 252
/** 252 days of net flow in millions of dollars, Jan 1 to Sep 9 2025, seeded */
const DEFAULT_DATA: number[] = (() => {
  let s = 29
  const out: number[] = []
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    s = (s * 48271) % 2147483647
    const r = s / 2147483647 - 0.485
    const spike = i % 67 === 0 ? 2.6 : i % 41 === 0 ? 1.8 : 1
    out.push(Number((r * 9 * spike).toFixed(1)))
  }
  return out
})()
const DEFAULT_LABELS = Array.from({ length: N }, (_, i) => dayLabel(i))

const W = 480
const H = 170
const PAD = { l: 0, r: 40, t: 8, b: 20 }
const PLOT_W = W - PAD.l - PAD.r
const PLOT_H = H - PAD.t - PAD.b

const niceStep = (raw: number) => {
  const pow = 10 ** Math.floor(Math.log10(Math.max(raw, 1e-9)))
  const n = raw / pow
  return (n <= 1 ? 1 : n <= 2 ? 2 : n <= 5 ? 5 : 10) * pow
}
const CHEVRON_LEFT = "M6.5 1.5L3 5l3.5 3.5"
const CHEVRON_RIGHT = "M3.5 1.5L7 5 3.5 8.5"

/**
 * Daily net flows as thin signed bars: green above the zero line, red below. Hover reads
 * a day, a drag sums a run of days, the arrows page through time.
 */
export function FlowBars({
  data = DEFAULT_DATA,
  labels = DEFAULT_LABELS,
  perPage = 84,
  title = "Daily net flows",
  unit = "M",
  prefix = "$",
  className,
}: FlowBarsProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const size = Math.max(1, Math.min(perPage, data.length))
  const pages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(data.length / size))
  const [page, setPage] = useState(pages - 1)
  const [hover, setHover] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const [sel, setSel] = useState<{ a: number; b: number } | null>(null)
  const dragging = useRef(false)
  const svgRef = useRef<SVGSVGElement>(null)
  /* the bars grow off the zero line once, when the plot is first on screen; later changes tween */
  const seen = useInView(svgRef, { once: true, amount: 0.3 })
  const shown = seen || !!reduced
  const [grown, setGrown] = useState(false)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!seen) return
    const t = setTimeout(() => setGrown(true), 800)
    return () => clearTimeout(t)
  }, [seen])

  /* pages are counted back from the newest day, so the last page is always full */
  const at = Math.min(page, pages - 1)
  const end = data.length - (pages - 1 - at) * size
  const from = Math.max(0, end - size)
  const days = data.slice(from, end)
  const n = days.length
  const label = (i: number) => labels[from + i] ?? `day ${from + i + 1}`

  const peak = Math.max(1e-6, ...data.map((v) => Math.abs(v)))
  const step = niceStep(peak / 2)
  const top = Math.ceil(peak / step) * step
  const ticks: number[] = []
  for (let v = -top; v <= top + step / 2; v += step) ticks.push(Number(v.toFixed(6)))
  const zero = PAD.t + PLOT_H / 2
  const scale = PLOT_H / 2 / top
  const slot = PLOT_W / n

  const brush = sel ? { lo: Math.min(sel.a, sel.b), hi: Math.max(sel.a, sel.b) } : null
  const sum = (lo: number, hi: number) => days.slice(lo, hi + 1).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)
  const net = sum(0, n - 1)
  const daysIn = days.filter((v) => v >= 0).length

  const idxAt = (e: PointerEvent<SVGSVGElement>) => {
    const r = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect()
    const px = ((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width) * W
    return Math.max(0, Math.min(n - 1, Math.floor((px - PAD.l) / slot)))
  }
  const onDown = (e: PointerEvent<SVGSVGElement>) => {
    const i = idxAt(e)
    dragging.current = true
    setHover(null)
    setSel({ a: i, b: i })
    e.currentTarget.setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId)
  }
  const onMove = (e: PointerEvent<SVGSVGElement>) => {
    const i = idxAt(e)
    if (dragging.current) setSel((s) => (s ? { ...s, b: i } : { a: i, b: i }))
    else setHover(i)
  }
  const endDrag = () => {
    dragging.current = false
    /* a press with no drag clears the window */
    setSel((s) => (s && s.a === s.b ? null : s))
  }
  const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent<SVGSVGElement>) => {
    const d = e.key === "ArrowLeft" ? -1 : e.key === "ArrowRight" ? 1 : 0
    if (d) {
      e.preventDefault()
      setHover((h) => Math.max(0, Math.min(n - 1, (h ?? (d > 0 ? -1 : n)) + d)))
    } else if (e.key === "Escape") {
      setHover(null)
      setSel(null)
    }
  }
  const turn = (d: number) => {
    setGrown(true)
    setPage(Math.max(0, Math.min(pages - 1, at + d)))
    setHover(null)
    setSel(null)
  }

  /** "+$12.3M": the sign, the prefix, one decimal, the unit */
  const money = (v: number) => `${v >= 0 ? "+" : "−"}${prefix}${Math.abs(v).toFixed(1)}${unit}`
  /** the axis tag drops the unit to fit the axis column: "+$4.2" */
  const tagText = (v: number) => `${v >= 0 ? "+" : "−"}${prefix}${Math.abs(v).toFixed(1)}`
  const axis = [...new Set([0, Math.round((n - 1) / 3), Math.round(((n - 1) * 2) / 3), n - 1])]
  /** the dragged run, once it spans two days or more */
  const run = brush && brush.hi > brush.lo ? brush : null
  const brushing = run !== null
  /* the card: the dragged run, else the hovered day; it rides the run's end or the day and
     turns to the left past 60% of the plot */
  const cardAt = run ? run.hi : hover
  const flip = cardAt !== null && (cardAt + 0.5) / n > 0.6
  const cardX = cardAt === null ? 0 : PAD.l + (run && flip ? run.lo * slot : (cardAt + (flip ? 0 : 1)) * slot)
  const hoverY = hover !== null ? zero - days[hover] * scale : 0
  const [netWhole, netDecimals] = (() => {
    const t = money(net)
    const at = t.lastIndexOf(".")
    return at < 0 ? [t, ""] : [t.slice(0, at), t.slice(at)]
  })()
  /* 84 bars share one 300ms stagger, so the last starts by 300ms */
  const stagger = Math.min(0.02, 0.3 / Math.max(1, n))
  const half = PLOT_H / 2

  return (
    <div role="group" aria-label={title} className={cn("w-[480px] max-w-full tabular-nums", className)}>
      {/* the header, three tiers (spec 14.1): title, window and pager; the net; in or out */}
      <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-[12px]">
        <span className="truncate text-foreground/45">{title}</span>
        <span className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1">
          <span className="mr-1 font-medium text-foreground/90">
            {label(0)} to {label(n - 1)}
          </span>
          {[
            { d: -1, tip: "Earlier", path: CHEVRON_LEFT, off: at === 0 },
            { d: 1, tip: "Later", path: CHEVRON_RIGHT, off: at === pages - 1 },
          ].map((b) => (
            <Tip key={b.tip} tip={b.tip} side="top" disabled={b.off}>
              <button
                type="button"
                aria-label={`${b.tip} days`}
                onClick={() => turn(b.d)}
                disabled={b.off}
                className={cn(ICON_BUTTON, "h-7 w-7 active:scale-[0.97] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-35 motion-reduce:active:scale-100")}
              >
                <svg width="10" height="10" viewBox="0 0 10 10" fill="none" aria-hidden>
                  <path d={b.path} stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.3" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
                </svg>
              </button>
            </Tip>
          ))}
        </span>
      </div>
      <div role="status">
        {/* a page turn swaps the net in place (4px, 2px blur, 150ms) */}
        <motion.div
          key={at}
          initial={reduced || !grown ? false : { opacity: 0, y: 4, filter: "blur(2px)" }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, filter: "blur(0px)" }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
        >
          <p className="m-0 text-[26px] font-semibold leading-none tracking-[-0.02em] text-foreground/90">
            {netWhole}
            <span className="text-foreground/35">{netDecimals}</span>
          </p>
          <p className="mb-0 mt-2 flex items-baseline gap-[7px] text-[12px] font-medium" style={{ color: net >= 0 ? GREEN : RED }}>
            <span>{net >= 0 ? "Net inflow" : "Net outflow"}</span>
            <span className="font-normal text-foreground/45">over {n === 1 ? "1 day" : `${n} days`}</span>
          </p>
        </motion.div>
      </div>

      <div className="relative mt-4">
      <svg
        ref={svgRef}
        viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`}
        className="block w-full cursor-crosshair touch-none select-none overflow-visible outline-none"
        role="img"
        tabIndex={0}
        aria-label={`${title}, ${label(0)} to ${label(n - 1)}: net ${money(net)} over ${n} days, ${daysIn} of them in`}
        onPointerDown={onDown}
        onPointerMove={onMove}
        onPointerUp={endDrag}
        onPointerLeave={() => {
          setHover(null)
          if (dragging.current) endDrag()
        }}
        onBlur={() => setHover(null)}
        onKeyDown={onKey}
      >
        {brush && brush.hi > brush.lo && (
          <rect
            x={PAD.l + brush.lo * slot}
            y={PAD.t}
            width={(brush.hi - brush.lo + 1) * slot}
            height={PLOT_H}
            rx={2}
            fill="var(--foreground)"
            fillOpacity={0.06}
          />
        )}

        {ticks.map((v) => (
          <g key={v}>
            <line
              x1={PAD.l}
              y1={zero - v * scale}
              x2={W - PAD.r}
              y2={zero - v * scale}
              stroke="var(--foreground)"
              strokeOpacity={v === 0 ? 0.14 : 0.05}
              strokeWidth={1}
            />
            <text
              x={W - PAD.r + 6}
              y={zero - v * scale + 3}
              fontSize={9}
              fill="var(--foreground)"
              fillOpacity={0.45}
              /* a figure under the hovered day's tag fades aside for it */
              style={{ opacity: hover !== null && !brushing && Math.abs(zero - v * scale - hoverY) < 12 ? 0 : 1, transition: "opacity 150ms" }}
            >
              {v === 0 ? `${prefix}0` : `${v > 0 ? "+" : "−"}${prefix}${Math.abs(v)}${unit}`}
            </text>
          </g>
        ))}

        {/* every bar is the upper half of the plot scaled about the zero line: a positive scale is
            an inflow, a negative one folds it under the line as an outflow, so a page turn can
            tween one day's flow into another's. ry is divided by the scale so the corner lands at
            0.8 after it; SVG clamps it to half the bar just as before */}
        <g>
          {days.map((v, i) => {
            const up = v >= 0
            const h = Math.max(1, Math.abs(v) * scale)
            const k = ((up ? 1 : -1) * h) / half
            const lit = brush && brush.hi > brush.lo ? i >= brush.lo && i <= brush.hi : hover === null || hover === i
            return (
              <rect
                key={i}
                x={PAD.l + i * slot + slot * 0.2}
                y={zero - half}
                width={Math.max(1.4, slot * 0.6)}
                height={half}
                rx={0.8}
                ry={0.8 / Math.abs(k)}
                opacity={lit ? 1 : 0.35}
                style={{
                  fill: up ? GREEN : RED,
                  transformOrigin: `0px ${zero}px`,
                  transform: `scaleY(${shown ? k.toFixed(4) : 0})`,
                  transition: reduced
                    ? "none"
                    : `transform ${grown ? 0.35 : 0.45}s ${EASE_CSS} ${grown ? 0 : (i * stagger).toFixed(3)}s, fill 200ms, opacity 140ms`,
                }}
              />
            )
          })}
        </g>

        {/* the crosshair on the hovered day, its flow tagged on the axis in its hue */}
        {hover !== null && !brushing && (
          <g pointerEvents="none">
            <line
              x1={PAD.l + hover * slot + slot / 2}
              y1={PAD.t}
              x2={PAD.l + hover * slot + slot / 2}
              y2={PAD.t + PLOT_H}
              stroke="var(--foreground)"
              strokeOpacity={0.18}
              strokeWidth={1}
            />
            <AxisTag x={W - PAD.r + 2} y={hoverY} width={PAD.r - 2} color={days[hover] >= 0 ? GREEN : RED}>
              {tagText(days[hover])}
            </AxisTag>
          </g>
        )}

        {/* the dates cross-fade on a page turn */}
        {axis.map((i, k) => (
          <motion.text
            key={`${i}-${label(i)}`}
            x={PAD.l + i * slot + (k === 0 ? 0 : k === axis.length - 1 ? slot : slot / 2)}
            y={H - 5}
            textAnchor={k === 0 ? "start" : k === axis.length - 1 ? "end" : "middle"}
            fontSize={9}
            fill="var(--foreground)"
            fillOpacity={0.45}
            initial={reduced || !grown ? false : { opacity: 0 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.25, ease: EASE }}
          >
            {label(i)}
          </motion.text>
        ))}
      </svg>


      {/* the hovered day or the dragged run, read in a card by the cursor (chart-overlay.tsx) */}
      <ChartCard
        open={cardAt !== null}
        x={`${(cardX / W) * 100}%`}
        flip={flip}
        width={brushing ? 168 : 132}
        heading={run ? `${label(run.lo)} to ${label(run.hi)}` : hover !== null ? label(hover) : ""}
        rows={
          run
            ? [
                { label: "Net", value: money(sum(run.lo, run.hi)), color: sum(run.lo, run.hi) >= 0 ? GREEN : RED },
                { label: "In days", value: `${days.slice(run.lo, run.hi + 1).filter((v) => v >= 0).length} of ${run.hi - run.lo + 1}` },
              ]
            : hover !== null
              ? [{ label: "Net", value: money(days[hover]), color: days[hover] >= 0 ? GREEN : RED }]
              : []
        }
      />
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

```tsx
"use client"

import { type ReactNode } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

/* Chart overlay: the two parts every library chart reads a point with (2026-10-02). They
   came out of Candlestick, Volume Profile, the trading terminal and Price Scrubber, which
   had each drawn their own; this is the one copy. Shipped beside the charts that use it.

   AxisTag   the outlined tag on the value axis: the pointed value in its hue, or a named
             reference (POC, last close) in ink. A pill 16px high, 8.5px figures.
   ChartCard the card laid over the chart beside the cursor: a heading row (a time or a
             range) at /60, then label and value rows (labels 10px /60, values 11px /90),
             the one signed figure in its hue. It glides between points on a spring, fades
             in from 0.97 and out in 120ms, and flips to the cursor's left when told to.

   2026-10-02: the card looked out of place over the charts, so it now wears the library
   popover, the same as the sidebar's hover card: a hairline border at 8%, radius 12, the
   6% foreground mix and the popover shadow with no inset highlight (spec 14.6). */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GLIDE = { type: "spring", stiffness: 520, damping: 40 } as const

/** the outlined tag on a chart's value axis, centred on `y` */
export function AxisTag({
  x,
  y,
  width,
  color = "var(--foreground)",
  strong = true,
  hidden = false,
  children,
}: {
  /** the tag's left edge, in the chart's own units */
  x: number
  /** the value's line; the tag is centred on it */
  y: number
  width: number
  /** stroke and figure; ink for a named reference, the series hue for the pointed value */
  color?: string
  /** a quieter tag (a secondary reference) drops the weight and the stroke */
  strong?: boolean
  /** fades the tag out, for when the pointed value sits on it */
  hidden?: boolean
  children: ReactNode
}) {
  return (
    <g transform={`translate(${x}, ${y - 8})`} pointerEvents="none" style={{ opacity: hidden ? 0 : 1, transition: "opacity 150ms" }}>
      <rect width={width} height={16} rx={8} fill="var(--background)" stroke={color} strokeOpacity={strong ? 0.6 : 0.2} />
      <text x={width / 2} y={11} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={8.5} fontWeight={strong ? 600 : 500} fill={color} fillOpacity={strong ? 1 : 0.65}>
        {children}
      </text>
    </g>
  )
}

export interface ChartCardRow {
  label: string
  value: ReactNode
  /** only the one signed figure carries a hue */
  color?: string
}

/** the readout card over a chart; place it inside a `relative` box that holds the svg */
export function ChartCard({
  open,
  x,
  y = 4,
  flip = false,
  width = 148,
  heading,
  rows,
  footer,
}: {
  open: boolean
  /** the cursor's x inside the box: px, or a percentage string for a chart drawn to a viewBox */
  x: number | string
  /** the card's top inside the box, px */
  y?: number
  /** put the card on the cursor's left (past ~60% of the plot) */
  flip?: boolean
  width?: number
  heading: ReactNode
  rows: ChartCardRow[]
  /** a closing line under the rows, such as where the point sits */
  footer?: ReactNode
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {open && (
        <motion.div
          key="chart-card"
          role="status"
          className="pointer-events-none absolute z-10"
          initial={{ left: x, top: y, opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ left: x, top: y, opacity: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, transition: { duration: 0.12 } }}
          transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { left: GLIDE, top: GLIDE, opacity: { duration: 0.15 } }}
        >
          <motion.div
            className="rounded-[12px] border border-foreground/[0.08] px-3 py-2.5"
            style={{
              width,
              translate: flip ? "calc(-100% - 12px) 0" : "12px 0",
              transition: reduced ? undefined : "translate 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)",
              background: "var(--tip-fill, color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 6%, var(--background)))",
              boxShadow: "0 8px 24px var(--card-shadow, rgba(0,0,0,calc(0.35 * var(--shadow-k, 1))))",
            }}
            initial={reduced ? false : { scale: 0.97 }}
            animate={{ scale: 1 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
          >
            <div className="text-[10px] text-foreground/60">{heading}</div>
            <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-col gap-1">
              {rows.map((r) => (
                <div key={r.label} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-foreground/60">{r.label}</span>
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-foreground/90" style={r.color ? { color: r.color } : undefined}>
                    {r.value}
                  </span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            {footer && <div className="mt-1.5 text-[10px]">{footer}</div>}
          </motion.div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  )
}
```

```tsx
/* Control classes: the library's control material for components that ship on their own
   (2026-10-02, the audit's pattern 11). src/components/library/controls.ts is the site's
   copy; components used to paste its look in as a flat 8% fill "so the file ships alone",
   and those copies never turned white on a raised light surface. These read the same
   tokens WITH a fallback, so they follow the site's raised-surface rule here and still
   draw correctly in a buyer's app that has no such tokens. Shipped beside every component
   that imports it (scripts/build-registry.mjs bundles ui helpers automatically).

   Whole class strings, never assembled from pieces: Tailwind reads this file as text. */

/** what is ON in a switcher. Light (his call, 2026-10-02, after the inline slider): a WHITE
 *  pill with a hairline and a soft shadow on the grey track. Dark: the 8% thumb */
export const THUMB =
  "bg-white shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--light-outline,rgba(0,0,0,0.09)),0_1px_3px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] dark:bg-[var(--control-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_8%,transparent))] dark:shadow-[var(--control-shadow,inset_0_1px_0_0_color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_6%,transparent))]"

/** what a switcher's options sit in; its 2px padding is the gap the thumb keeps. Light: a
 *  light grey track with no outline, the white pill sits in it. Dark: a hairline, no fill */
export const TRACK = "rounded-full border border-transparent bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_5%,var(--background))] p-0.5 dark:border-foreground/[0.04] dark:bg-transparent"

/** an option that is off: the label alone answers the pointer */
export const SEGMENT_OFF = "text-foreground/60 hover:text-foreground/90"

/** a secondary button: the thumb standing alone; size it with h-7 / h-9 and px */
export const BUTTON =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--control-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_8%,transparent))] shadow-[var(--control-shadow,inset_0_1px_0_0_color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_6%,transparent))] text-foreground/90 outline-none transition-[color,background-color,scale] duration-150 hover:bg-[var(--control-fill-hover,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_12%,transparent))] focus-visible:bg-[var(--control-fill-hover,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_12%,transparent))] active:scale-[0.97] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40 motion-reduce:active:scale-100"

/** an icon-only control: no fill at rest, a faint one under the pointer */
export const ICON_BUTTON =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-full text-foreground/60 outline-none transition-[color,background-color] duration-150 hover:bg-foreground/[0.06] hover:text-foreground/90 focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.06]"

/** a field: the track with just enough fill to read as somewhere to type */
export const FIELD =
  "rounded-full border border-foreground/[0.04] bg-[var(--field-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_5%,transparent))] text-foreground/90 outline-none transition-[background-color,border-color] duration-150 placeholder:text-foreground/45 focus:border-foreground/[0.12]"

/** the one loud button of a form: 48px, full width, the foreground filled (the dashboards'
 *  Modal primary). A ticket, a swap, a confirm: one of these and nothing louder */
export const BUTTON_PRIMARY =
  "inline-flex h-12 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-foreground/[0.92] text-[14px] font-medium text-background outline-none transition-[background-color,scale,opacity] duration-150 hover:bg-foreground focus-visible:bg-foreground active:scale-[0.98] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40 motion-reduce:active:scale-100"

/** a component's own card, field or block (spec 14.8). Dark: a #121212 fill on black. Light
 *  (his call, 2026-10-02: "on light the card background is too dark, it can just be white, a
 *  quiet outline and a small shadow"): white, a 1px hairline (Kraken's #e7e6e9, or 9% ink in an app without the token) and a
 *  barely there shadow,
 *  drawn as box shadows so the outline takes no layout */
export const SURFACE =
  "bg-background shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--light-outline,color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_9%,transparent)),0_1px_2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] dark:bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_7%,var(--background))] dark:shadow-none"

/** a block sitting ON a surface: a faint 4% grey inside a white card in light, #1f1f1f in dark */
export const RAISED = "bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_4%,var(--background))] dark:bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_12%,var(--background))]"
```

// ─── components/ui/browser-window-tip.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

/* Tip: the library's small tooltip for an icon control or a cut-off name (2026-10-02 audit).
   Written once for Browser Window and shared by Alert Stack, so each of them
   still installs in one command (the registry ships an imported ui helper beside them).
   The look is the library popover (spec 14.6): radius 12, the 8% hairline, a 6% fill over
   the page and the popover shadow; text 11px /90, sentence case. It waits a beat so a
   pointer crossing the component opens nothing (`delay`), opens on keyboard focus too,
   closes on leave, blur and Escape, and it is the only tooltip: no native `title` beside it.
   It never takes the pointer, so it cannot get in the way of the control under it. */

const POPOVER_BG = "var(--tip-fill, color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 6%, var(--background)))"
const POPOVER_SHADOW = "0 8px 24px var(--card-shadow, rgba(0,0,0,0.35))"

const SIDE = {
  top: "bottom-full left-1/2 mb-1.5 -translate-x-1/2",
  bottom: "top-full left-1/2 mt-1.5 -translate-x-1/2",
  left: "right-full top-1/2 mr-1.5 -translate-y-1/2",
} as const

export function Tip({
  tip,
  children,
  side = "top",
  delay = 320,
  disabled = false,
  className,
}: {
  tip: ReactNode
  children: ReactNode
  side?: keyof typeof SIDE
  /** ms the pointer rests before it opens; a long hover reveal uses ~700 */
  delay?: number
  /** nothing to reveal (the name is not cut off): never opens */
  disabled?: boolean
  className?: string
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const timer = useRef<number | undefined>(undefined)
  const id = useId()
  useEffect(() => () => window.clearTimeout(timer.current), [])
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return
    const esc = (e: KeyboardEvent) => e.key === "Escape" && setOpen(false)
    window.addEventListener("keydown", esc)
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", esc)
  }, [open])
  const show = () => {
    if (disabled) return
    window.clearTimeout(timer.current)
    timer.current = window.setTimeout(() => setOpen(true), delay)
  }
  const hide = () => {
    window.clearTimeout(timer.current)
    setOpen(false)
  }
  return (
    <span
      className={cn("relative inline-flex", className)}
      aria-describedby={open ? id : undefined}
      onPointerEnter={(e) => e.pointerType !== "touch" && show()}
      onPointerLeave={hide}
      onPointerDown={hide}
      onFocus={show}
      onBlur={hide}
    >
      {children}
      {open && (
        <span
          id={id}
          role="tooltip"
          className={cn(
            "pointer-events-none absolute z-50 w-max max-w-[260px] rounded-[12px] border border-foreground/[0.08] px-2.5 py-1.5 text-left text-[11px] font-normal leading-[1.4] text-foreground/90",
            SIDE[side],
          )}
          style={{ background: POPOVER_BG, boxShadow: POPOVER_SHADOW }}
        >
          {tip}
        </span>
      )}
    </span>
  )
}
```

# Sankey Diagram (sankey-flow)
> A Sankey diagram for cash flow, budgets and fund flows, where income pools in one hub and each ribbon width stands for the amount.

// ─── components/ui/sankey-flow.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useId, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react"
import { motion, useInView, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

/* Sankey Flow, rebuilt through the ssych-component skill (2026-09-29).
   What changed against the version before it (in git history), and why:
   · every ribbon is a filled shape between two curves. They were strokes as thick as the
     amount (up to 158px), which is why the thin-lines rule failed
   · one ink at several strengths, strongest for the largest amount on each side. It was
     blue, yellow, green, purple and amber, none of which meant a direction. The node being
     pointed at takes the one accent, and so do the strands that run through it.
     `FlowNode.color` stays in the type so callers do not change, but it is not painted
   · the readout is plain text beside the title: the total at rest, the pointed node's
     amount and its share of the total while you point
   · every node is a real button laid over the drawing, so it can be reached and pinned
     from the keyboard; Escape lets a pin go
   · the hub has no outline; ribbons fade in once, one after another
   Colour pass (2026-09-30): the sources have to be told apart as their money runs through
   the hub, so each source takes its own colour in the house order (chart 1, 5, 3, amber,
   2, 4; past six one Other) and every band and strand it feeds carries that colour. The
   uses stay ink at their strengths; the readout swaps in place and dots the source
   Motion (2026-10-01): once the diagram is in view the ribbons sweep in left to right
   through one clip, sources to hub to uses, in 0.9s (they faded in on mount, off screen
   too); the nodes and the hub are there on arrival. New amounts morph every ribbon and
   glide each node, hub band and label to its new place and depth
   2026-10-02 audit: the header printed the total twice at rest ("$9,300 in · $9,300 out")
   beside a 13px title, and the node amounts were too small to read. The header is now the
   library's three tiers: the title at /45, the total as the 26px headline with its cents at
   /35, and a sub line that reads only the pointed node (its name and amount, then its share
   at /45) and keeps its height with a blank at rest. Node amounts are 10.5px at /60, the hub
   label 10px at weight 500, and the diagram is 480 wide with 80px label columns so it sits
   with the other charts.
   Formulas:
   · total = the sum of the sources (the uses sum to the same)
   · share = a node's amount ÷ total × 100
   · depth = amount × (plot height − the gaps) ÷ total
   2026-10-02 round 2: the sample is an exchange's month in place of a personal budget.
   Trading fees $5.3M, staking $1.8M, listing fees $1.2M and market data $0.7M come in
   (total $9.0M); payroll $2.7M, operations $2.1M, treasury $1.9M, buybacks $1.5M and
   market maker rebates $0.8M go out (the same $9.0M). The smallest source is still about
   20px deep: 0.7M × (292 − 3 × 9) ÷ 9.0M = 20.6. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
/** the house order for things that must be told apart; nothing on this surface means up */
const PALETTE = ["var(--chart-1)", "var(--chart-5)", "var(--chart-3)", "var(--chart-amber)", "var(--chart-2)", "var(--chart-4)"]
const OTHER = "color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 22%, transparent)"
const hueAt = (i: number) => PALETTE[i] ?? OTHER
/** node strength by rank of amount, largest first; past the end they stay at the last step */
const STEPS = [90, 68, 52, 40, 30, 24]
const inkAt = (pct: number) => `color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) ${pct}%, transparent)`
const mixAt = (hue: string, pct: number) => `color-mix(in srgb, ${hue} ${pct}%, transparent)`

export interface FlowNode {
  id: string
  label: string
  value: number
  /** Kept for callers. Not painted: sources take the house order by position, uses stay ink. */
  color: string
}

export interface SankeyFlowProps {
  /** what comes in; ribbon thickness is proportional to value */
  sources?: FlowNode[]
  /** where it goes out; the two sides must sum to the same total */
  uses?: FlowNode[]
  /** heading above the diagram */
  title?: string
  className?: string
}

const DEFAULT_SOURCES: FlowNode[] = [
  { id: "fees", label: "Trading fees", value: 5300000, color: "var(--chart-1)" },
  { id: "staking", label: "Staking", value: 1800000, color: "var(--chart-4)" },
  { id: "listings", label: "Listing fees", value: 1200000, color: "var(--chart-2)" },
  { id: "data", label: "Market data", value: 700000, color: "var(--chart-5)" },
]
const DEFAULT_USES: FlowNode[] = [
  { id: "payroll", label: "Payroll", value: 2700000, color: "var(--chart-1)" },
  { id: "ops", label: "Operations", value: 2100000, color: "var(--chart-amber)" },
  { id: "treasury", label: "Treasury", value: 1900000, color: "var(--chart-3)" },
  { id: "buybacks", label: "Buybacks", value: 1500000, color: "var(--chart-5)" },
  { id: "rebates", label: "MM rebates", value: 800000, color: "var(--chart-2)" },
]

const W = 480
const H = 320
const PAD = { t: 14, b: 14, x: 4 }
const NODE_W = 11
const GAP = 9
/** the room a label takes beside its node */
const LABEL_W = 80
const contentH = H - PAD.t - PAD.b

const leftX = PAD.x + LABEL_W
const rightX = W - PAD.x - LABEL_W - NODE_W
const midX = W / 2 - NODE_W / 2

type Placed = FlowNode & { top: number; h: number; mid: number; ink: number; hue: string }

/** Walk both sides as partitions of the same [0, total] interval: every overlap
 *  between an inbound band and an outbound band is one real source→use strand,
 *  so nothing appears or vanishes at the hub. */
function decompose(sources: FlowNode[], uses: FlowNode[]) {
  const out: { src: string; use: string; value: number }[] = []
  let si = 0
  let ui = 0
  let sRem = sources[0].value
  let uRem = uses[0].value
  while (si < sources.length && ui < uses.length) {
    const value = Math.min(sRem, uRem)
    out.push({ src: sources[si].id, use: uses[ui].id, value })
    sRem -= value
    uRem -= value
    if (sRem <= 0) sRem = sources[++si]?.value ?? 0
    if (uRem <= 0) uRem = uses[++ui]?.value ?? 0
  }
  return out
}

/** a ribbon `w` deep from (x0, y0) to (x1, y1), both given at its centre line, as one
 *  closed shape: the top edge out, the bottom edge back */
function ribbon(x0: number, y0: number, x1: number, y1: number, w: number) {
  const xc = ((x0 + x1) / 2).toFixed(2)
  const h = Math.max(1, w) / 2
  const f = (n: number) => n.toFixed(2)
  return [
    `M${f(x0)},${f(y0 - h)}`,
    `C${xc},${f(y0 - h)} ${xc},${f(y1 - h)} ${f(x1)},${f(y1 - h)}`,
    `L${f(x1)},${f(y1 + h)}`,
    `C${xc},${f(y1 + h)} ${xc},${f(y0 + h)} ${f(x0)},${f(y0 + h)}`,
    "Z",
  ].join(" ")
}

const usd = (n: number) => `$${n.toLocaleString("en-US")}`
const pctOf = (part: number, whole: number) => `${((part / (whole || 1)) * 100).toFixed(1)}%`
const cents = (n: number) => n.toLocaleString("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })

/**
 * A fund-flow diagram where income pools in one hub and fans out into uses, node and
 * ribbon depth standing for amount. Flow is conserved through the middle, so pointing at
 * any node lights the strands that pass through it the whole way across, dims the rest and
 * reads its amount and share under the total. Pressing pins it.
 */
export function SankeyFlow({
  sources = DEFAULT_SOURCES,
  uses = DEFAULT_USES,
  title = "Exchange cash flow, September",
  className,
}: SankeyFlowProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const [hover, setHover] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [pin, setPin] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const hot = pin ?? hover
  const enter = (id: string) => {
    if (!pin) setHover(id)
  }
  const toggle = (id: string) => setPin((p) => (p === id ? null : id))
  const uid = useId().replace(/:/g, "")
  /* the entrance plays once, when a third of the diagram is in view; reduced motion lands at once */
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const seen = useInView(rootRef, { once: true, amount: 0.3 })
  const play = !!reduced || seen
  /** a change of data glides between the two states */
  const morph = reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.35, ease: EASE }

  const { total, left, right, mid, inFlows, outFlows, bands, seams } = useMemo(() => {
    const total = sources.reduce((a, b) => a + b.value, 0)
    const scale = (contentH - Math.max(sources.length, uses.length) * GAP) / (total || 1)

    const stack = (nodes: FlowNode[]): Placed[] => {
      // strength follows amount, so the largest node is the strongest wherever it sits
      const rank = [...nodes.keys()].sort((a, b) => nodes[b].value - nodes[a].value)
      const totalH = nodes.reduce((a, n) => a + n.value * scale, 0) + (nodes.length - 1) * GAP
      let y = PAD.t + (contentH - totalH) / 2
      return nodes.map((n, i) => {
        const h = n.value * scale
        const top = y
        y += h + GAP
        return { ...n, top, h, mid: top + h / 2, ink: STEPS[Math.min(rank.indexOf(i), STEPS.length - 1)], hue: hueAt(i) }
      })
    }

    const left = stack(sources)
    const right = stack(uses)
    const byUse = Object.fromEntries(right.map((n) => [n.id, n])) as Record<string, Placed>
    const bySrc = Object.fromEntries(left.map((n) => [n.id, n])) as Record<string, Placed>
    const midH = total * scale
    const midTop = PAD.t + (contentH - midH) / 2
    const mid = { top: midTop, h: midH, mid: midTop + midH / 2 }

    let inCum = 0
    const inFlows = left.map((n) => {
      const w = n.value * scale
      const y1 = midTop + inCum + w / 2
      inCum += w
      return { id: `${n.id}~mid`, src: n.id, w, y0: n.mid, y1, hue: n.hue }
    })

    /* a strand leaves the hub at the offset its source arrived at and lands
       stacked inside its use, so depths line up on both faces */
    let outCum = 0
    const filled: Record<string, number> = {}
    const outFlows = decompose(sources, uses).map((f) => {
      const use = byUse[f.use]
      const w = f.value * scale
      const y0 = midTop + outCum * scale + w / 2
      outCum += f.value
      const done = filled[f.use] ?? 0
      const y1 = use.top + done * scale + w / 2
      filled[f.use] = done + f.value
      return { id: `mid~${f.use}~${f.src}`, src: f.src, use: f.use, w, y0, y1, hue: bySrc[f.src].hue }
    })

    let bandCum = 0
    const bands = left.map((n) => {
      const h = n.value * scale
      const y = midTop + bandCum
      bandCum += h
      return { id: n.id, y, h, hue: n.hue }
    })
    let seamCum = 0
    const seams = uses.slice(0, -1).map((n) => {
      seamCum += n.value * scale
      return { id: n.id, y: midTop + seamCum }
    })

    return { total, left, right, mid, inFlows, outFlows, bands, seams }
  }, [sources, uses])

  /** a source and a use are on the same path when a strand joins them */
  const joined = (a: string | null, b: string) =>
    a !== null && outFlows.some((f) => (f.src === a && f.use === b) || (f.use === a && f.src === b))

  const nodeOn = (id: string) => hot === null || hot === "mid" || hot === id || joined(hot, id)
  const inOn = (l: { src: string }) => hot === null || hot === "mid" || hot === l.src || joined(hot, l.src)
  const outOn = (f: { src: string; use: string }) => hot === null || hot === "mid" || hot === f.src || hot === f.use

  const nodes = [...left.map((n) => ({ n, side: "l" as const })), ...right.map((n) => ({ n, side: "r" as const }))]
  const hotNode = nodes.find(({ n }) => n.id === hot)
  const fade = reduced ? "none" : "opacity 160ms, fill 160ms"
  /* ribbons get their opacity from motion, so only the fill eases in CSS */
  const fillFade = reduced ? "none" : "fill 160ms"
  /* a strand is its source's colour, stronger while it is the one pointed through */
  const ribbonFill = (hue: string, lit: boolean) => mixAt(hue, lit && hot !== null ? 55 : 32)
  /* the dim and the morph run on their own clocks */
  const ribbonTransition = reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { opacity: { duration: 0.16, ease: EASE }, d: morph }
  /* the sweep covers the ribbons only, from the source faces to the use faces */
  const sweepX = leftX + NODE_W

  return (
    <div
      ref={rootRef}
      className={cn("w-[480px] max-w-full tabular-nums", className)}
      onKeyDown={(e) => {
        if (e.key === "Escape") setPin(null)
      }}
    >
      {/* the header, three tiers (spec 14.1): the title, the total, the pointed node */}
      <div className="mb-3 flex items-baseline justify-between text-[12px]">
        <span className="truncate text-foreground/45">{title}</span>
      </div>
      <p className="m-0 text-[26px] font-semibold leading-none tracking-[-0.02em] text-foreground/90">
        ${cents(total).split(".")[0]}
        <span className="text-foreground/35">.{cents(total).split(".")[1]}</span>
      </p>
      {/* the sub line reads only the pointed node and keeps its height at rest; it swaps in
          place when the pointer takes another node (4px, 2px blur, 150ms) */}
      <div role="status" className="mt-2 text-[12px]">
        <motion.p
          key={hot ?? "rest"}
          className="m-0 flex items-baseline gap-[7px] whitespace-nowrap"
          initial={reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: 4, filter: "blur(2px)" }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, filter: "blur(0px)" }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
        >
          {hot === "mid" ? (
            <>
              <span className="font-medium text-foreground/90">Cash</span>
              <span className="text-foreground/45">all of it passes through</span>
            </>
          ) : hotNode ? (
            <>
              {hotNode.side === "l" && (
                <span aria-hidden className="h-1.5 w-1.5 shrink-0 self-center rounded-full" style={{ background: hotNode.n.hue }} />
              )}
              <span className="font-medium text-foreground/90">
                {hotNode.n.label} {usd(hotNode.n.value)}
              </span>
              <span className="text-foreground/45">
                {pctOf(hotNode.n.value, total)} of what {hotNode.side === "l" ? "comes in" : "goes out"}
              </span>
            </>
          ) : (
            "\u00a0"
          )}
        </motion.p>
      </div>

      <div className="relative mt-4" onPointerLeave={() => setHover(null)}>
        <svg
          viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`}
          className="block h-auto w-full"
          role="img"
          aria-label={`${title}: ${sources.length} sources into ${uses.length} uses, ${usd(total)} through`}
        >
          <defs>
            <clipPath id={`${uid}-sweep`}>
              <motion.rect
                x={sweepX}
                y={0}
                height={H}
                initial={reduced ? false : { width: 0 }}
                animate={{ width: play ? rightX - sweepX : 0 }}
                transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.9, ease: EASE }}
              />
            </clipPath>
          </defs>

          <g clipPath={`url(#${uid}-sweep)`}>
            {inFlows.map((l) => (
              <motion.path
                key={l.id}
                fill={ribbonFill(l.hue, inOn(l))}
                style={{ transition: fillFade }}
                initial={false}
                animate={{ opacity: inOn(l) ? 1 : 0.35, d: ribbon(leftX + NODE_W, l.y0, midX, l.y1, l.w) }}
                transition={ribbonTransition}
              />
            ))}

            {outFlows.map((f) => (
              <motion.path
                key={f.id}
                fill={ribbonFill(f.hue, outOn(f))}
                style={{ transition: fillFade }}
                initial={false}
                animate={{ opacity: outOn(f) ? 1 : 0.35, d: ribbon(midX + NODE_W, f.y0, rightX, f.y1, f.w) }}
                transition={ribbonTransition}
              />
            ))}
          </g>

          {/* the hub: one band per source, scored where it divides between uses */}
          <g>
            {bands.map((b) => (
              <motion.rect
                key={b.id}
                x={midX}
                width={NODE_W}
                fill={b.hue}
                opacity={nodeOn(b.id) ? 1 : 0.35}
                style={{ transition: fade }}
                initial={false}
                animate={{ attrY: b.y, height: b.h }}
                transition={morph}
              />
            ))}
            {seams.map((s) => (
              <motion.rect
                key={s.id}
                x={midX}
                width={NODE_W}
                height={1}
                fill="var(--background)"
                initial={false}
                animate={{ attrY: s.y - 0.5 }}
                transition={morph}
              />
            ))}
            {pin === "mid" && (
              <rect
                x={midX - 3}
                y={mid.top - 3}
                width={NODE_W + 6}
                height={mid.h + 6}
                rx={4}
                fill="none"
                stroke="var(--foreground)"
                strokeOpacity={0.45}
                strokeWidth={1}
              />
            )}
            <motion.text
              x={midX + NODE_W / 2}
              initial={false}
              animate={{ attrY: mid.top - 6 }}
              transition={morph}
              textAnchor="middle"
              fontSize={10}
              fontWeight={500}
              fill="var(--foreground)"
              fillOpacity={0.9}
            >
              Cash
            </motion.text>
          </g>

          {nodes.map(({ n, side }) => {
            const x = side === "l" ? leftX : rightX
            const on = nodeOn(n.id)
            const tx = side === "l" ? x - 7 : x + NODE_W + 7
            const anchor = side === "l" ? "end" : "start"
            return (
              <g key={`${side}-${n.id}`} opacity={on ? 1 : 0.35} style={{ transition: fade }}>
                {pin === n.id && (
                  <rect
                    x={x - 3}
                    y={n.top - 3}
                    width={NODE_W + 6}
                    height={n.h + 6}
                    rx={4}
                    fill="none"
                    stroke="var(--foreground)"
                    strokeOpacity={0.45}
                    strokeWidth={1}
                  />
                )}
                <motion.rect
                  x={x}
                  width={NODE_W}
                  rx={2}
                  fill={side === "l" ? n.hue : inkAt(hot === n.id ? 90 : n.ink)}
                  style={{ transition: fade }}
                  initial={false}
                  animate={{ attrY: n.top, height: n.h }}
                  transition={morph}
                />
                <motion.text
                  x={tx}
                  textAnchor={anchor}
                  fontSize={10}
                  fontWeight={500}
                  fill="var(--foreground)"
                  fillOpacity={0.9}
                  initial={false}
                  animate={{ attrY: n.mid - 3 }}
                  transition={morph}
                >
                  {n.label}
                </motion.text>
                <motion.text
                  x={tx}
                  textAnchor={anchor}
                  fontSize={10.5}
                  fill="var(--foreground)"
                  fillOpacity={0.6}
                  initial={false}
                  animate={{ attrY: n.mid + 10 }}
                  transition={morph}
                >
                  {usd(n.value)}
                </motion.text>
              </g>
            )
          })}
        </svg>

        {/* the pressable parts, laid over the drawing in its own proportions */}
        <button
          type="button"
          aria-label={`Cash, ${usd(total)} through`}
          aria-pressed={pin === "mid"}
          onClick={() => toggle("mid")}
          onPointerEnter={() => enter("mid")}
          onPointerLeave={() => setHover(null)}
          onFocus={() => enter("mid")}
          onBlur={() => setHover(null)}
          className="absolute cursor-pointer rounded-[4px] outline-none focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.06]"
          style={{
            left: `${((midX - 8) / W) * 100}%`,
            width: `${((NODE_W + 16) / W) * 100}%`,
            top: `${((mid.top - 18) / H) * 100}%`,
            height: `${((mid.h + 22) / H) * 100}%`,
          }}
        />
        {nodes.map(({ n, side }) => (
          <button
            key={`${side}-${n.id}`}
            type="button"
            aria-label={`${n.label}, ${usd(n.value)}, ${pctOf(n.value, total)} of ${side === "l" ? "what comes in" : "what goes out"}`}
            aria-pressed={pin === n.id}
            onClick={() => toggle(n.id)}
            onPointerEnter={() => enter(n.id)}
            onPointerLeave={() => setHover(null)}
            onFocus={() => enter(n.id)}
            onBlur={() => setHover(null)}
            className="absolute cursor-pointer rounded-[4px] outline-none focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.06]"
            style={{
              left: `${((side === "l" ? PAD.x : rightX - 4) / W) * 100}%`,
              width: `${((LABEL_W + NODE_W + 4) / W) * 100}%`,
              top: `${((n.top - GAP / 2) / H) * 100}%`,
              height: `${((n.h + GAP) / H) * 100}%`,
            }}
          />
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

```


# Comb Rows (comb-rows)
> A peer comparison chart that draws each company as a ruler of ticks, for valuation metrics like P/E across a sector.

// ─── components/ui/comb-rows.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { type ReactNode, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react"
import { motion, useInView, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { LiveFigure } from "@/components/ui/live-figure"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

/* Comb Rows, rebuilt through the ssych-component skill (2026-09-29).
   What changed against the version before it (in git history), and why:
   · the accent comes from the token, not from a typed colour: the comb of the subject, or
     of the row being pointed at, takes it, every other comb is ink
   · every figure is tabular, the one in the caption included
   · pointing at a row, or tabbing to it, keeps it full and dims the others, and the
     caption turns into that row's readout: its value and how far it sits from the subject
   · the comparison names itself to a screen reader, every row carries its own label
   Motion (2026-10-01): once the rows first come into view they settle in 4px apart by 40ms
   and their ticks grow out of the middle line left to right, 4ms apart, all in about 800ms.
   A new value walks the cursor tick: heights and inks tween over 300ms. The ticks are CSS
   transitions on transform, not 230 motion nodes. Reduced motion draws the end state.
   2026-10-02 audit: the typed caption "AMZN is 95% above sector average" is gone, since no
   sector average is in the data; at rest the readout line is blank (an nbsp holds its
   height) and a pointed row reads against the subject there, under the rows. The centred
   title and caption became the left label row of spec 14.1: the title 12px /45 on the left,
   the subject and its value /90 on the right. A `renderIcon(symbol, size)` slot draws a real
   16px mark before each ticker (the preview passes BrandIcon); left out, the tickers stand
   alone as before. Off rows' labels and values are /60.
   Formulas: the cursor tick = round(value / max × 46); the pointed row against the subject
   = (row value / subject value − 1) × 100, whole percent, "above" or "below". */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const ACCENT = "var(--chart-1)"
const ink = (pct: number) => `color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) ${pct}%, transparent)`

export interface CombRow {
  label: string
  value: number
}

const DEFAULT_ROWS: CombRow[] = [
  { label: "EBAY", value: 10.7 },
  { label: "GOOGL", value: 22.9 },
  { label: "META", value: 28.9 },
  { label: "MSFT", value: 36 },
  { label: "AMZN", value: 42.2 },
]

const TICKS = 46
const EASE_CSS = "cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)"
/** every tick is drawn at the cursor height and scaled down to its own, so a height change is a transform */
const TALL = 13

/**
 * A comparison in the Ink register: every row is a ruler of ticks, the cursor tick
 * stands taller at the value, and the subject row's comb carries the accent. Pointing at
 * another row hands it the accent, dims the rest and reads it against the subject in
 * the line under the rows. The ticks grow in row by row once in view.
 */
export function CombRows({
  title = "P/E ratio",
  caption,
  rows = DEFAULT_ROWS,
  subject = "AMZN",
  max = 50,
  renderIcon,
  className,
}: {
  title?: string
  /** a line shown under the rows at rest; none by default (2026-10-02: no typed claim the data cannot back) */
  caption?: string
  /** a company mark before each ticker, e.g. (s, size) => <BrandIcon name={s} size={size} />; 16px */
  renderIcon?: (symbol: string, size: number) => ReactNode
  rows?: CombRow[]
  /** the row that carries the accent while nothing is hovered */
  subject?: string
  /** the value at the end of the ruler */
  max?: number
  className?: string
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const seen = useInView(rootRef, { once: true, amount: 0.3 })
  const shown = seen || !!reduced
  /* once the grow-in has landed, a value change tweens at once instead of on the stagger */
  const [settled, setSettled] = useState(false)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!seen) return
    const t = setTimeout(() => setSettled(true), 900)
    return () => clearTimeout(t)
  }, [seen])
  const [hot, setHot] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const base = rows.find((r) => r.label === subject)
  const pointed = rows.find((r) => r.label === hot)
  /* the pointed row against the subject: value ÷ subject's value − 1 */
  const readout: ReactNode = (() => {
    if (!pointed || pointed.label === subject) return caption ?? "\u00a0"
    if (!base || base.value === 0) return <><span className="font-medium text-foreground/90">{pointed.label}</span> of {max}</>
    const gap = (pointed.value / base.value - 1) * 100
    return (
      <>
        <span className="font-medium text-foreground/90">{pointed.label}</span> {Math.abs(gap).toFixed(0)}% {gap < 0 ? "below" : "above"} {subject}
      </>
    )
  })()

  return (
    <div ref={rootRef} className={cn("w-[320px] tabular-nums", className)} role="group" aria-label={`${title}, ${rows.length} rows${base ? `, ${subject} ${base.value}` : ""}`}>
      {/* the label row: the measure on the left, the subject and its value on the right */}
      <div className="mb-3 flex items-baseline justify-between text-[12px]">
        <span className="text-foreground/45">{title}</span>
        {base && (
          <span className="font-medium text-foreground/90">
            {subject} {base.value}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-col" role="list" onPointerLeave={() => setHot(null)}>
        {rows.map((r, ri) => {
          const cursor = Math.round((r.value / max) * TICKS)
          const active = hot === r.label || (hot === null && r.label === subject)
          const dim = hot !== null && hot !== r.label
          return (
            /* the outer row owns the dim so it never fights the entrance inside */
            <div
              key={r.label}
              role="listitem"
              tabIndex={0}
              aria-label={`${r.label} ${r.value} of ${max}`}
              onPointerEnter={() => setHot(r.label)}
              onFocus={() => setHot(r.label)}
              onBlur={() => setHot(null)}
              className="-mx-2 rounded-[4px] outline-none transition-[opacity,background-color] duration-200 focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.06]"
              style={{ opacity: dim ? 0.45 : 1 }}
            >
              <motion.div
                className="flex items-center gap-3 px-2 py-[7px]"
                initial={reduced ? false : { opacity: 0, y: 4 }}
                animate={shown ? { opacity: 1, y: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: 4 }}
                transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.4, ease: EASE, delay: ri * 0.04 }}
              >
                <span className={cn("flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 text-[11.5px] font-medium transition-colors duration-150", renderIcon ? "w-[74px]" : "w-[52px]", active ? "text-foreground/90" : "text-foreground/60")}>
                  {renderIcon?.(r.label, 16)}
                  {r.label}
                </span>
                <span className="flex h-4 flex-1 items-center gap-[2.5px]" aria-hidden>
                  {Array.from({ length: TICKS }, (_, t) => {
                    const isCursor = t === cursor
                    const filled = t < cursor
                    const h = isCursor ? TALL : filled ? 8 : 5
                    return (
                      <span
                        key={t}
                        className="w-px rounded-full"
                        style={{
                          height: TALL,
                          transform: `scaleY(${shown ? h / TALL : 0})`,
                          background: isCursor
                            ? active
                              ? ACCENT
                              : ink(85)
                            : filled
                              ? active
                                ? `color-mix(in srgb, ${ACCENT} 55%, transparent)`
                                : ink(28)
                              : ink(10),
                          /* the grow-in carries the stagger; after it lands a value change tweens at once */
                          transition: reduced
                            ? "none"
                            : settled
                              ? `transform 0.3s ${EASE_CSS}, background 150ms`
                              : `transform 0.45s ${EASE_CSS} ${(ri * 0.04 + t * 0.004).toFixed(3)}s, background 150ms`,
                        }}
                      />
                    )
                  })}
                </span>
                <span className={cn("w-[36px] shrink-0 text-right text-[11px] transition-colors duration-150", active ? "text-foreground/90" : "text-foreground/60")}>{r.value}</span>
              </motion.div>
            </div>
          )
        })}
      </div>

      {/* the pointed row against the subject; blank at rest, it keeps its height */}
      <div role="status" className="mt-3 text-[11px] text-foreground/60">
        <LiveFigure intent={pointed && pointed.label !== subject ? pointed.label : null}>{readout}</LiveFigure>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

```

// ─── components/ui/live-figure.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { type ReactNode } from "react"
import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

/* Live figure: a figure fed by a live stream (2026-10-02, out of Tape Flow, where a price
   that re-entered on every print read as a flicker). The value changes in place on each
   tick; the figure swaps (4px, 2px blur, 150ms) only when `intent` changes: the pointer
   takes a point, lets it go, or a toggle flips. Pass the pointed point's id, or null for
   the live value. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const

export function LiveFigure({
  intent,
  className,
  children,
}: {
  /** what the figure is showing: a pointed point's id, or null while it follows the stream */
  intent: string | number | null
  className?: string
  children: ReactNode
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  return (
    <motion.div
      key={intent === null ? "live" : `at-${intent}`}
      className={cn(className)}
      initial={reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: 4, filter: "blur(2px)" }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, filter: "blur(0px)" }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
    >
      {children}
    </motion.div>
  )
}
```
