# Health Gauge (health-gauge)
> A gauge chart for margin ratio, fear and greed or liquidity scores, on a 270 degree dial that counts up and cycles metrics on click.

// ─── components/ui/health-gauge.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react"
import { animate, motion, useInView, useMotionValue, useReducedMotion, useTransform } from "motion/react"

import { SegmentedControl } from "@/components/ui/segmented-control"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

/* Health Gauge, the multi-metric variant of Radial Gauge.
   What it is for: one score out of 100 at a time, from a few metrics you switch between,
   read against the zones it is judged by.
   Read first: the number in the middle; the zone word under it says what it means.
   2026-10-02 audit (redesign): it now shares Radial Gauge's dial so the Gauge family is one
   look at one width: 240 wide, the same 270 degree ring 7px deep and the same thin band
   scale outside it, drawn by the same ring() shape. The number stands at its value at 26px
   (it counted up from 0 at 34px); only the arc sweeps. The zone word sits under it in its
   hue at weight 500. The three unlabelled dots and the press on the dial that cycled
   metrics are gone: a SegmentedControl with the metric names sits in the label row above
   the dial, and the dial is not a button. The quiet sub line ("margin ratio") is cut; the
   `sub` field is still accepted and is read to a screen reader only. The 0 and 100 ticks
   and the end dot went with the old dial. A metric may carry a `short` name for the
   control, since three full names do not fit 240px.
   Zones (amber given back 2026-09-30, it is the warning state): at risk below 40 in red,
   caution from 40 to 69 in amber, healthy from 70 in green; the scale shows all three, the
   one reached strongest.
   Formulas, all from `metrics`:
   · the number = round(value), clamped to 0 to 100
   · sweep of the arc = 270° × value / 100
   · zone = the first zone whose end the value is under (40, 70, 100)
   Motion: the arc sweeps from the left shoulder to the value once the dial is a third in
   view (900ms); switching metric sweeps it from the old value to the new one (400ms);
   nothing counts. Reduced motion draws the arc at its value at once. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GREEN = "var(--chart-up)"
const RED = "var(--chart-down)"
const AMBER = "var(--chart-amber)"

export interface HealthMetric {
  /** 0–100, the position on the dial */
  value: number
  label: string
  /** read to a screen reader after the label; no longer printed (2026-10-02) */
  sub: string
  /** the metric's name in the switcher, when the label is too long for it; defaults to the label */
  short?: string
}

export interface HealthGaugeProps {
  /** one dial per metric; the switcher above the dial picks one */
  metrics?: HealthMetric[]
  className?: string
}

const DEFAULT_METRICS: HealthMetric[] = [
  { value: 74, label: "Account health", sub: "margin ratio", short: "Health" },
  { value: 38, label: "Fear and Greed", sub: "market sentiment", short: "Sentiment" },
  { value: 61, label: "Liquidity", sub: "depth score" },
]

/* Radial Gauge's dial, value for value: a 270° ring open at the bottom, 7px deep, and a
   2px band scale just outside it */
const SIZE = 180
const MID = SIZE / 2
const H = 150
const SWEEP = 270
const START = 135
const R_OUT = 66
const R_IN = 59
const CAP = (R_OUT - R_IN) / 2
const S_OUT = 74
const S_IN = 72
/** the gap between two zones of the scale, in degrees */
const GAP = 2

const at = (deg: number, r: number) => {
  const a = (deg * Math.PI) / 180
  return `${(MID + r * Math.cos(a)).toFixed(2)} ${(MID + r * Math.sin(a)).toFixed(2)}`
}

/** a band of the ring as a closed shape, `from` to `to` degrees of sweep, round at both ends */
function ring(from: number, to: number, rOut: number, rIn: number, cap: number) {
  const a = START + from
  const b = START + Math.max(from + 0.01, to)
  const large = b - a > 180 ? 1 : 0
  return `M ${at(a, rOut)} A ${rOut} ${rOut} 0 ${large} 1 ${at(b, rOut)} A ${cap} ${cap} 0 0 1 ${at(b, rIn)} A ${rIn} ${rIn} 0 ${large} 0 ${at(a, rIn)} A ${cap} ${cap} 0 0 1 ${at(a, rOut)} Z`
}

/* the zone tints the value arc, its word and its part of the scale, never the ground */
const ZONES = [
  { from: 0, to: 40, color: RED, label: "At risk" },
  { from: 40, to: 70, color: AMBER, label: "Caution" },
  { from: 70, to: 100, color: GREEN, label: "Healthy" },
]
const zoneIndex = (v: number) => {
  const i = ZONES.findIndex((z) => v < z.to)
  return i === -1 ? ZONES.length - 1 : i
}
const mix = (c: string, pct: number) => `color-mix(in srgb, ${c} ${pct}%, transparent)`
const clamp = (v: number) => Math.max(0, Math.min(100, v))

/**
 * A bounded score dial with a metric switcher: the arc sweeps round to the score over a
 * thin scale of the zones it is judged by; the number and the zone word stand still.
 * Picking another metric sweeps the arc from the old score to the new one.
 */
export function HealthGauge({ metrics = DEFAULT_METRICS, className }: HealthGaugeProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const [mi, setMi] = useState(0)
  const metric = metrics[Math.min(mi, metrics.length - 1)] ?? DEFAULT_METRICS[0]
  const value = clamp(metric.value)
  const zi = zoneIndex(value)
  const zone = ZONES[zi]
  const names = metrics.map((m) => m.short ?? m.label)

  const dialRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  /* the sweep waits until the dial is a third in view, then plays once */
  const inView = useInView(dialRef, { once: true, amount: 0.3 })
  /** the first sweep is the entrance; later ones follow a switch of metric */
  const swept = useRef(false)
  const drawn = useMotionValue(reduced ? value / 100 : 0)
  const d = useTransform(drawn, (v) => ring(0, SWEEP * v, R_OUT, R_IN, CAP))
  useEffect(() => {
    if (reduced) {
      drawn.set(value / 100)
      return
    }
    if (!inView) return
    const run = animate(drawn, value / 100, {
      duration: swept.current ? 0.4 : 0.9,
      ease: EASE,
      onComplete: () => {
        swept.current = true
      },
    })
    return () => run.stop()
  }, [drawn, value, reduced, inView])

  return (
    <div className={cn("flex w-[240px] max-w-full flex-col items-center tabular-nums", className)}>
      {/* the label row is the switcher: the metric names, one picked */}
      <SegmentedControl
        options={names}
        value={names[mi]}
        onChange={(name) => setMi(Math.max(0, names.indexOf(name)))}
        className="[&>button]:px-2.5"
      />

      <div ref={dialRef} className="relative mt-3" style={{ width: SIZE, height: H }}>
        <svg
          width={SIZE}
          height={H}
          viewBox={`0 0 ${SIZE} ${H}`}
          role="img"
          aria-label={`${metric.label}, ${metric.sub}: ${Math.round(value)} out of 100, ${zone.label}`}
        >
          <path d={ring(0, SWEEP, R_OUT, R_IN, CAP)} fill="var(--foreground)" fillOpacity={0.08} />
          <motion.path d={d} fill={zone.color} style={{ transition: reduced ? "none" : "fill 160ms" }} />
          {ZONES.map((z, i) => {
            const from = (z.from / 100) * SWEEP + (i === 0 ? 0 : GAP / 2)
            const to = (z.to / 100) * SWEEP - (i === ZONES.length - 1 ? 0 : GAP / 2)
            return (
              <path
                key={z.label}
                d={ring(from, to, S_OUT, S_IN, (S_OUT - S_IN) / 2)}
                fill={mix(z.color, i === zi ? 70 : 35)}
                style={{ transition: reduced ? "none" : "fill 160ms" }}
              />
            )
          })}
        </svg>

        <div role="status" className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 flex flex-col items-center" style={{ top: MID - 20 }}>
          <span className="text-[26px] font-semibold leading-none tracking-[-0.02em] text-foreground/90">{Math.round(value)}</span>
          <span className="mt-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium" style={{ color: zone.color, transition: reduced ? "none" : "color 160ms" }}>
            {zone.label}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

```


# Radial Gauge (radial-gauge)
> A radial gauge for pass rates like model evals, health checks or compliance tests, with fail, watch and pass bands you can read.

// ─── components/ui/radial-gauge.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react"
import { animate, motion, useInView, useMotionValue, useReducedMotion, useTransform } from "motion/react"

import { LiveFigure } from "@/components/ui/live-figure"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

/* Radial Gauge, promoted from a lab sketch through ssych-component (2026-09-29).
   What it is for: a pass rate against the bands it is judged by. 412 of 480 eval cases.
   Read first: the percent in the middle; the count it came from reads when the dial is pointed at.
   The pointer: pointing at a band, on the thin outer scale or in the list under the dial,
   brings it to full strength, dims the others and reads that band's range above the dial, in
   percent and in whole checks.
   Sketch: lab/RadialGauge. Kept: the 270 degree dial open at the bottom, the draw from
   the left shoulder, percent over count, the three bands.
   Changed: the ring is a filled shape 7px deep, not an 8px stroke; the card, its header
   band and inner shadow are gone; the arc is ink and only the band name carries colour
   (green for the top band, red for the bottom one, the middle one is ink; amber is gone);
   the bands are drawn on the dial as a scale, so the thresholds can be seen, not only
   listed; the legend is sentence case.
   Formulas:
   · percent = value ÷ max, rounded                          412 ÷ 480 = 86%
   · sweep of the arc = 270° × value ÷ max
   · a band holds from its own start up to the next band's start
   · first whole count of a band = ceil(start% × max)        ceil(0.85 × 480) = 408
   · last whole count of a band = the next band's first − 1, or max for the top band
   Colour given back (2026-09-30): landing in a band is a threshold crossed, so the arc
   takes the tone of the band it reached (green in pass, red in fail, ink where the band
   has no tone), and each band of the scale and its key carry their own tone, strongest for
   the band reached. Pointing at a band brings it to full strength in its own colour.
   Motion (2026-10-01): the arc sweeps from the left shoulder to the share once the dial is a
   third in view (900ms); a new value sweeps on from where the arc stands (400ms); reduced
   motion draws the arc at its share at once.
   2026-10-02 audit: his question was whether the checks under 72% are needed; they are not
   at rest, so the count left the dial and reads in the line above it while the dial is
   pointed at or focused ("18 of 25 checks"). At rest that line is blank (an nbsp holds its
   height), since the key already marks the band reached; a pointed band reads "Pass, 70%
   and over, 18 to 25 checks" with commas, not dot separators. The box is 240 wide, the Gauge
   family's width (it was 320 round a 180px dial). The key is legend items: 11px, 12px apart,
   the names at /60 and the band reached at /90. The line swaps through LiveFigure.
   2026-10-02 round 2: the sample is an LLM eval pass rate in place of generic checks: 412
   of 480 test cases (86%), judged by Fail under 70%, Watch from 70% and Pass from 85%, so
   the bands read 0 to 335, 336 to 407 and 408 to 480 cases. The noun is "cases" so the
   pointed band's line fits the 240 box on one line. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GREEN = "var(--chart-up)"
const RED = "var(--chart-down)"
const ink = (pct: number) => `color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) ${pct}%, transparent)`

export interface GaugeBand {
  name: string
  /** where the band starts, in percent; it runs to the start of the next one */
  from: number
  /** what landing here means: green, red or no colour */
  tone?: "up" | "down" | "none"
}

export interface RadialGaugeProps {
  value?: number
  max?: number
  label?: string
  /** what is being counted, written after the numbers */
  noun?: string
  /** lowest first */
  bands?: GaugeBand[]
  className?: string
}

const DEFAULT_BANDS: GaugeBand[] = [
  { name: "Fail", from: 0, tone: "down" },
  { name: "Watch", from: 70, tone: "none" },
  { name: "Pass", from: 85, tone: "up" },
]

const SIZE = 180
const MID = SIZE / 2
const H = 150
const SWEEP = 270
const START = 135
const R_OUT = 66
const R_IN = 59
const CAP = (R_OUT - R_IN) / 2

const at = (deg: number, r: number) => {
  const a = (deg * Math.PI) / 180
  return `${(MID + r * Math.cos(a)).toFixed(2)} ${(MID + r * Math.sin(a)).toFixed(2)}`
}

/** a band of the ring as a closed shape, `from` to `to` degrees of sweep, round at both ends */
function ring(from: number, to: number, rOut: number, rIn: number, cap: number) {
  const a = START + from
  const b = START + Math.max(from + 0.01, to)
  const large = b - a > 180 ? 1 : 0
  return `M ${at(a, rOut)} A ${rOut} ${rOut} 0 ${large} 1 ${at(b, rOut)} A ${cap} ${cap} 0 0 1 ${at(b, rIn)} A ${rIn} ${rIn} 0 ${large} 0 ${at(a, rIn)} A ${cap} ${cap} 0 0 1 ${at(a, rOut)} Z`
}

/** a band's range in words: "40 to 69%", "70% and over" */
const span = (b: { from: number; to: number }) => (b.to >= 100 ? `${b.from}% and over` : `${b.from} to ${b.to - 1}%`)

const toneOf = (t: GaugeBand["tone"]) => (t === "up" ? GREEN : t === "down" ? RED : ink(90))
/** a band's mark at a strength: its own hue mixed toward nothing, ink for a band with no tone */
const markOf = (t: GaugeBand["tone"], pct: number) =>
  t === "up" || t === "down" ? `color-mix(in srgb, ${toneOf(t)} ${pct}%, transparent)` : ink(Math.round(pct * 0.6))

/**
 * A dial for a rate: the arc draws on from the left shoulder to the share reached, over a
 * thin scale of the bands it is judged by. Pointing at a band reads its range.
 */
export function RadialGauge({
  value = 412,
  max = 480,
  label = "Eval pass rate",
  noun = "cases",
  bands = DEFAULT_BANDS,
  className,
}: RadialGaugeProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  /** a band of the scale by index, or the dial itself, which reads the count */
  const [hot, setHot] = useState<number | "dial" | null>(null)

  const share = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, value / Math.max(1, max)))
  const pct = Math.round(share * 100)

  const dialRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  /* the sweep waits until the dial is a third in view, then plays once */
  const inView = useInView(dialRef, { once: true, amount: 0.3 })
  /** the first sweep is the entrance; later ones follow a new value */
  const swept = useRef(false)
  const drawn = useMotionValue(reduced ? share : 0)
  const d = useTransform(drawn, (v) => ring(0, SWEEP * v, R_OUT, R_IN, CAP))
  useEffect(() => {
    if (reduced) {
      drawn.set(share)
      return
    }
    if (!inView) return
    const run = animate(drawn, share, {
      duration: swept.current ? 0.4 : 0.9,
      ease: EASE,
      onComplete: () => {
        swept.current = true
      },
    })
    return () => run.stop()
  }, [drawn, share, reduced, inView])

  const sorted = [...bands].sort((a, b) => a.from - b.from)
  const ranges = sorted.map((b, i) => {
    const to = sorted[i + 1]?.from ?? 100
    const first = Math.ceil((b.from / 100) * max)
    const last = i === sorted.length - 1 ? max : Math.ceil((to / 100) * max) - 1
    return { ...b, to, first, last }
  })
  /* the band the value has landed in: the last one whose start it has reached */
  const mine = ranges.reduce((k, b, i) => (share * 100 >= b.from ? i : k), 0)
  const shown = typeof hot === "number" ? ranges[hot] : null

  return (
    <div role="group" aria-label={label} className={cn("flex w-[240px] max-w-full flex-col items-center tabular-nums", className)}>
      {/* no visible title (2026-10-01); blank at rest (2026-10-02), it reads what is pointed at */}
      <div className="flex w-full items-baseline justify-center">
        <div role="status" className="whitespace-nowrap text-[11px] text-foreground/60">
          <LiveFigure intent={hot}>
            {shown ? (
              <>
                <span className="font-medium text-foreground/90">{shown.name}</span>, {span(shown)}, {shown.first} to {shown.last} {noun}
              </>
            ) : hot === "dial" ? (
              <>
                <span className="font-medium text-foreground/90">{value}</span> of {max} {noun}
              </>
            ) : (
              "\u00a0"
            )}
          </LiveFigure>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div ref={dialRef} className="relative mt-3" style={{ width: SIZE, height: H }}>
        <svg
          width={SIZE}
          height={H}
          viewBox={`0 0 ${SIZE} ${H}`}
          role="img"
          aria-label={`${label}: ${pct} percent, ${value} of ${max} ${noun}, ${ranges[mine]?.name ?? ""}`}
          onPointerLeave={() => setHot(null)}
        >
          {/* the ring and the arc read the count when pointed at */}
          <path d={ring(0, SWEEP, R_OUT, R_IN, CAP)} fill={ink(8)} onPointerEnter={() => setHot("dial")} />
          <motion.path d={d} fill={markOf(ranges[mine]?.tone, 100)} style={{ transition: reduced ? "none" : "fill 160ms" }} onPointerEnter={() => setHot("dial")} />
          {/* no outer zone scale (his call, 2026-10-02: "remove the outer outline"); the key under
              the dial names the zones and pointing at one still lights its range above */}
        </svg>

        {/* the middle of the dial is a real button, so focus and a tap read the count like the pointer does */}
        <button
          type="button"
          aria-label={`${pct}%, ${value} of ${max} ${noun}`}
          onPointerEnter={() => setHot("dial")}
          onPointerLeave={() => setHot(null)}
          onFocus={() => setHot("dial")}
          onBlur={() => setHot(null)}
          onClick={() => setHot("dial")}
          className="absolute rounded-full outline-none"
          style={{ left: MID - R_IN, top: MID - R_IN, width: R_IN * 2, height: R_IN * 2 }}
        />
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 flex flex-col items-center" style={{ top: MID - 13 }}>
          <span className="text-[26px] font-semibold leading-none tracking-[-0.02em] text-foreground/90">{pct}%</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="-mt-1 flex items-center gap-3" onPointerLeave={() => setHot(null)}>
        {ranges.map((b, i) => (
          <button
            key={b.name}
            type="button"
            aria-label={`${b.name}: ${span(b)}, ${b.first} to ${b.last} ${noun}${i === mine ? ", the band reached" : ""}`}
            onPointerEnter={() => setHot(i)}
            onFocus={() => setHot(i)}
            onBlur={() => setHot(null)}
            className={cn(
              "-mx-1.5 flex h-6 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full px-1.5 text-[11px] outline-none transition-[opacity,background-color] duration-200 hover:bg-foreground/[0.04] focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.08]",
              typeof hot === "number" && hot !== i && "opacity-40",
            )}
          >
            <span
              aria-hidden
              className="h-[2px] w-2.5 rounded-full"
              style={{ background: markOf(b.tone, hot === i ? 100 : i === mine ? 70 : 35), transition: reduced ? "none" : "background-color 160ms" }}
            />
            {/* the key is the band names only (2026-10-01): the ranges wrapped at this width; they stay in the
                aria-label and in the readout above the dial when a band is pointed at */}
            <span className={i === mine ? "font-medium text-foreground/90" : "text-foreground/60"}>{b.name}</span>
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

# Order Book (order-book)
> A crypto exchange order book with bids, asks and depth bars, reading the cumulative size and value up to any price level.

// ─── components/ui/order-book.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react"
import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { LiveFigure } from "@/components/ui/live-figure"
import { SegmentedControl } from "@/components/ui/segmented-control"
import { usePointed } from "@/components/ui/use-pointed"

/* Order Book, written new through ssych-component (2026-09-29).
   What it is for: reading how much size rests at each price on both sides of a market,
   and how much of it you would walk through to reach a given level.
   Read first: the mid price on the row between the two sides.
   The pointer: point at a level, or tab to it, and every level from the touch out to it
   stays lit while the rest dim; the middle row then reads the size and the money resting
   up to that price. The grouping pills merge levels into wider price steps.
   Sketch used: src/components/lab/OrderBookPro.tsx. Kept: the level shape (price, size),
   grouping into a price step, depth that accumulates from the touch outward, bars scaled
   to the largest total on screen, spread and mid taken from the ungrouped touch, and the
   hover total. Left out: the card and its hairlines, the capital column heads.
   Reference ("order book" on browsable, listings only, no code read): the idea of a
   bid against ask balance under the ladder.
   2026-10-02 audit: his call was that the book should animate and do things on hover, so
   while the pointer is on it (usePointed) a seeded feed nudges sizes and adds or pulls
   levels every 600ms; sizes change in place, a changed row flashes once in its side's hue
   and the bars ease to their new length; the feed stops when the pointer leaves, and the
   book at rest is the still, complete seeded one. The footer captions that summed the book
   up at rest are gone: the balance rule stays, and pointing at it (or tabbing to it) reads
   the split in the middle row; the split is also in the aria-label. The price step uses the
   shared SegmentedControl, the heads are 10.5px, the mid is 15px so it wins over the 13px
   symbol, the readouts lost their middle dots, and the default shows 6 levels a side.
   Formulas:
   · bucket      a bid falls to floor(price / step) × step, an ask rises to ceil(price / step) × step,
                 so a grouped book never crosses
   · total       Σ size from the best level out to this one, on its own side
   · bar width   total ÷ the largest total among the rows shown
   · mid         (best bid + best ask) ÷ 2, ungrouped
   · spread      best ask − best bid, and in bps: spread ÷ mid × 10,000
   · money       Σ price × size over the same levels as the total
   · balance     bid total shown ÷ (bid total shown + ask total shown)
   · feed        each 600ms tick, 3 levels a side within the first 12 take size × (0.55 to 1.55);
                 one tick in four a level past the touch is pulled or a new one is added in a gap
                 (the best bid and ask keep their price, so the mid holds) */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GREEN = "var(--chart-up)"
const RED = "var(--chart-down)"
const FEED_MS = 600

export interface OrderBookLevel {
  price: number
  /** size resting at this price, in the base unit */
  size: number
}

export interface OrderBookProps {
  symbol?: string
  /** the unit sizes are counted in */
  unit?: string
  /** any order; the best bid is the highest price */
  bids?: OrderBookLevel[]
  /** any order; the best ask is the lowest price */
  asks?: OrderBookLevel[]
  /** the smallest price step of the market */
  tick?: number
  /** price steps the ladder can be grouped into; the first is the opening one */
  groupings?: number[]
  /** levels shown on each side */
  rows?: number
  priceDp?: number
  sizeDp?: number
  /** run the seeded demo feed while the book is pointed at; turn it off when you pass live levels */
  feed?: boolean
  className?: string
}

const TICK = 0.5
/** 67,412.5 counted in half-dollar ticks */
const MID_TICKS = 134825

/** A seeded book: 48 levels a side, one tick off the mid, with gaps and a few walls. */
const DEFAULT_BOOK: { bids: OrderBookLevel[]; asks: OrderBookLevel[] } = (() => {
  let seed = 67412
  const rnd = () => {
    seed = (seed * 16807) % 2147483647
    return seed / 2147483647
  }
  const side = (dir: 1 | -1) => {
    const out: OrderBookLevel[] = []
    let t = MID_TICKS + dir
    for (let i = 0; i < 48; i++) {
      const wall = rnd() < 0.1 ? 3.2 : 1
      out.push({ price: t * TICK, size: Math.round((0.06 + rnd() * 1.4 * (1 + i / 24)) * wall * 1000) / 1000 })
      t += dir * (1 + Math.floor(rnd() * 3))
    }
    return out
  }
  return { bids: side(-1), asks: side(1) }
})()

const DEFAULT_GROUPINGS = [0.5, 1, 5, 10]

type Side = "bid" | "ask"
type Row = { price: number; size: number; total: number; money: number }

/** one side grouped into `step`, best level first, with running totals */
function ladder(levels: OrderBookLevel[], side: Side, step: number, tick: number): Row[] {
  const g = Math.max(1, Math.round(step / tick))
  const sums = new Map<number, { size: number; money: number }>()
  for (const l of levels) {
    const t = Math.round(l.price / tick)
    const b = side === "bid" ? Math.floor(t / g) * g : Math.ceil(t / g) * g
    const at = sums.get(b) ?? { size: 0, money: 0 }
    at.size += l.size
    at.money += l.size * l.price
    sums.set(b, at)
  }
  const sorted = Array.from(sums.entries()).sort((a, b) => (side === "bid" ? b[0] - a[0] : a[0] - b[0]))
  let total = 0
  let money = 0
  return sorted.map(([t, v]) => {
    total += v.size
    money += v.money
    return { price: t * tick, size: v.size, total, money }
  })
}

/** one feed step on one side: nudge a few sizes, sometimes pull or add a level past the touch */
function stepSide(levels: OrderBookLevel[], side: Side, tick: number, rnd: () => number): OrderBookLevel[] {
  const sorted = [...levels].sort((a, b) => (side === "bid" ? b.price - a.price : a.price - b.price))
  const reach = Math.min(12, sorted.length)
  for (let k = 0; k < 3 && reach > 0; k++) {
    const i = Math.floor(rnd() * reach)
    const l = sorted[i]
    sorted[i] = { price: l.price, size: Math.max(0.01, Math.round(l.size * (0.55 + rnd()) * 1000) / 1000) }
  }
  if (rnd() < 0.25 && reach > 3) {
    const i = 1 + Math.floor(rnd() * (reach - 1))
    if (rnd() < 0.5) sorted.splice(i, 1)
    else {
      /* a new level in the gap behind level i-1, when there is one */
      const dir = side === "bid" ? -1 : 1
      const p = sorted[i - 1].price + dir * tick
      if (Math.abs(p - sorted[i].price) > tick / 2) sorted.splice(i, 0, { price: p, size: Math.round((0.08 + rnd() * 0.9) * 1000) / 1000 })
    }
  }
  return sorted
}

const num = (n: number, dp: number) => n.toLocaleString("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: dp, maximumFractionDigits: dp })
const compact = (n: number) =>
  n >= 1e6 ? `$${(n / 1e6).toFixed(2)}M` : n >= 1e4 ? `$${(n / 1e3).toFixed(1)}K` : `$${num(n, 0)}`

/** A hue as text: its lightness is capped in the light theme so small figures stay readable. */
const ink = (c: string) => `oklch(from ${c} min(l, var(--ink-l, 1)) c h)`

/**
 * A two sided ladder: asks above, bids below, the mid and the spread on the row between
 * them. Each level carries a bar of everything resting from the touch out to it. Pointing
 * at a level lights the run up to it and reads its size and money in the middle row.
 * While the book is pointed at, a demo feed moves it.
 */
export function OrderBook({
  symbol = "BTC-USD",
  unit = "BTC",
  bids = DEFAULT_BOOK.bids,
  asks = DEFAULT_BOOK.asks,
  tick = TICK,
  groupings = DEFAULT_GROUPINGS,
  rows = 6,
  priceDp = 1,
  sizeDp = 3,
  feed = true,
  className,
}: OrderBookProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const { ref, live, bind } = usePointed()
  const [step, setStep] = useState(groupings[0] ?? tick)
  const [hot, setHot] = useState<{ side: Side; i: number } | null>(null)
  const [balanceOn, setBalanceOn] = useState(false)

  /* the book the ladder draws: the caller's levels, moved by the demo feed while pointed at */
  const [book, setBook] = useState({ bids, asks })
  useEffect(() => setBook({ bids, asks }), [bids, asks])
  const seed = useRef(4211)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!feed || !live) return
    const rnd = () => {
      seed.current = (seed.current * 16807) % 2147483647
      return seed.current / 2147483647
    }
    const id = window.setInterval(() => {
      setBook((b) => ({ bids: stepSide(b.bids, "bid", tick, rnd), asks: stepSide(b.asks, "ask", tick, rnd) }))
    }, FEED_MS)
    return () => window.clearInterval(id)
  }, [feed, live, tick])

  const bidRows = useMemo(() => ladder(book.bids, "bid", step, tick).slice(0, rows), [book.bids, step, tick, rows])
  const askRows = useMemo(() => ladder(book.asks, "ask", step, tick).slice(0, rows), [book.asks, step, tick, rows])

  /* a row whose size changed on a feed tick flashes once; a new step is a change of view, not a tick */
  const prev = useRef<{ step: number; sizes: Map<string, number> } | null>(null)
  const [flashes, setFlashes] = useState<Record<string, number>>({})
  useEffect(() => {
    const sizes = new Map<string, number>()
    for (const r of bidRows) sizes.set(`bid-${r.price}`, r.size)
    for (const r of askRows) sizes.set(`ask-${r.price}`, r.size)
    const before = prev.current
    prev.current = { step, sizes }
    if (!before || before.step !== step) return
    const changed: string[] = []
    sizes.forEach((s, k) => {
      if (before.sizes.get(k) !== s) changed.push(k)
    })
    if (changed.length) setFlashes((f) => {
      const next = { ...f }
      for (const k of changed) next[k] = (next[k] ?? 0) + 1
      return next
    })
  }, [bidRows, askRows, step])

  /* the touch is read from the ungrouped book, so a wide step never moves the mid */
  const bestBid = book.bids.length ? Math.max(...book.bids.map((l) => l.price)) : 0
  const bestAsk = book.asks.length ? Math.min(...book.asks.map((l) => l.price)) : 0
  const mid = (bestBid + bestAsk) / 2
  const spread = bestAsk - bestBid
  const bps = mid > 0 ? (spread / mid) * 10000 : 0
  /* an odd number of ticks between the two puts the mid half a tick off the grid */
  const midDp = Math.round(spread / tick) % 2 === 1 ? priceDp + 1 : priceDp

  const bidTotal = bidRows[bidRows.length - 1]?.total ?? 0
  const askTotal = askRows[askRows.length - 1]?.total ?? 0
  const largest = Math.max(bidTotal, askTotal, 1e-9)
  const bidShare = bidTotal + askTotal > 0 ? (bidTotal / (bidTotal + askTotal)) * 100 : 50

  const shown = hot ? (hot.side === "bid" ? bidRows : askRows)[hot.i] : null

  const level = (r: Row, side: Side, i: number) => {
    const hue = side === "bid" ? GREEN : RED
    const lit = hot !== null && hot.side === side && i <= hot.i
    const dim = hot !== null && !lit
    const k = `${side}-${r.price}`
    const pulse = flashes[k]
    return (
      <button
        key={k}
        type="button"
        aria-label={`${side === "bid" ? "Bid" : "Ask"} ${num(r.price, priceDp)}, size ${num(r.size, sizeDp)}, ${num(r.total, sizeDp)} ${unit} resting up to it`}
        onPointerEnter={() => setHot({ side, i })}
        onFocus={() => setHot({ side, i })}
        onBlur={() => setHot(null)}
        className="relative grid w-full grid-cols-3 items-center px-2 py-[3px] text-left text-[11px] outline-none transition-opacity duration-150"
        style={{ opacity: dim ? 0.4 : 1 }}
      >
        <motion.span
          aria-hidden
          className="absolute inset-y-px right-0 w-full rounded-[2px]"
          style={{
            originX: 1,
            background: `color-mix(in srgb, ${hue} ${lit ? 30 : 15}%, transparent)`,
            transition: "background 150ms",
          }}
          initial={reduced ? false : { scaleX: 0 }}
          animate={{ scaleX: r.total / largest }}
          transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.35, ease: EASE }}
        />
        {/* the flash: one wash in the side's hue each time this level's size changes */}
        {pulse ? (
          <motion.span
            key={pulse}
            aria-hidden
            className="absolute inset-y-px inset-x-0 rounded-[2px]"
            style={{ background: `color-mix(in srgb, ${hue} 22%, transparent)` }}
            initial={{ opacity: 1 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 0 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.6, ease: EASE }}
          />
        ) : null}
        <span className="relative font-medium" style={{ color: ink(hue) }}>
          {num(r.price, priceDp)}
        </span>
        <span className="relative text-right text-foreground/90">{num(r.size, sizeDp)}</span>
        <span className="relative text-right text-foreground/45">{num(r.total, sizeDp)}</span>
      </button>
    )
  }

  const stepLabels = groupings.map((g) => num(g, priceDp))

  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      {...bind}
      className={cn("w-[320px] max-w-full tabular-nums [--ink-l:0.5] dark:[--ink-l:1]", className)}
      role="group"
      aria-label={`${symbol} order book, mid ${num(mid, midDp)}, spread ${num(spread, priceDp)}, bids ${bidShare.toFixed(1)}% of the size shown, asks ${(100 - bidShare).toFixed(1)}%`}
    >
      <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between pl-2">
        <span className="text-[13px] font-medium text-foreground/90">{symbol}</span>
        <SegmentedControl
          options={stepLabels}
          value={num(step, priceDp)}
          onChange={(v) => {
            const g = groupings[stepLabels.indexOf(v)]
            if (g !== undefined) setStep(g)
          }}
        />
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 px-2 pb-1 text-[10.5px] text-foreground/45">
        <span>Price</span>
        <span className="text-right">Size</span>
        <span className="text-right">Total</span>
      </div>

      <div onPointerLeave={() => setHot(null)}>
        {/* asks: the deepest at the top, the best ask against the middle row */}
        <div className="flex flex-col-reverse">{askRows.map((r, i) => level(r, "ask", i))}</div>

        <div role="status" className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-3 px-2 py-2">
          {/* the mid follows the feed in place */}
          <span className="text-[15px] font-semibold text-foreground/90">{num(mid, midDp)}</span>
          {/* the readout swaps only when what is pointed at changes; feed ticks change it in place */}
          <LiveFigure
            intent={hot ? `${hot.side}-${hot.i}` : balanceOn ? "balance" : null}
            className="flex items-baseline gap-2 text-[10.5px] text-foreground/45"
          >
            {shown && hot ? (
              <>
                <span className="font-medium text-foreground/90">
                  {num(shown.total, sizeDp)} {unit}
                </span>
                <span>
                  {compact(shown.money)} {hot.side === "ask" ? "up" : "down"} to {num(shown.price, priceDp)}
                </span>
              </>
            ) : balanceOn ? (
              <>
                <span style={{ color: ink(GREEN) }}>Bids {bidShare.toFixed(1)}%</span>
                <span style={{ color: ink(RED) }}>Asks {(100 - bidShare).toFixed(1)}%</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              <span>
                Spread {num(spread, priceDp)}, {bps.toFixed(2)} bps
              </span>
            )}
          </LiveFigure>
        </div>

        {/* bids: the best bid at the top, falling away below */}
        <div className="flex flex-col">{bidRows.map((r, i) => level(r, "bid", i))}</div>
      </div>

      {/* the balance: both sides span the rule and a clip cuts each to its share, so the split
          moves without animating a width. Pointing at it reads the split in the middle row. */}
      <div
        tabIndex={0}
        aria-label={`Bids ${bidShare.toFixed(1)}%, ${num(bidTotal, sizeDp)} ${unit}; asks ${(100 - bidShare).toFixed(1)}%, ${num(askTotal, sizeDp)} ${unit}`}
        onPointerEnter={() => setBalanceOn(true)}
        onPointerLeave={() => setBalanceOn(false)}
        onFocus={() => setBalanceOn(true)}
        onBlur={() => setBalanceOn(false)}
        className="mt-1 rounded-full px-2 py-2.5 outline-none focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.04]"
      >
        <div aria-hidden className="relative h-[3px]">
          <span
            className="absolute inset-0 rounded-full transition-[clip-path] duration-200 ease-[cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)] motion-reduce:transition-none"
            style={{ background: `color-mix(in srgb, ${GREEN} 70%, transparent)`, clipPath: `inset(0 ${(100 - bidShare).toFixed(2)}% 0 0 round 999px)` }}
          />
          <span
            className="absolute inset-0 rounded-full transition-[clip-path] duration-200 ease-[cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)] motion-reduce:transition-none"
            style={{ background: `color-mix(in srgb, ${RED} 70%, transparent)`, clipPath: `inset(0 0 0 calc(${bidShare.toFixed(2)}% + 2px) round 999px)` }}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

// ─── components/ui/use-pointed.ts ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react"

/* usePointed: live content runs only while it is being looked at (his call, 2026-10-02:
   "it should start animating only when you start hovering on it; anything with numbers
   that change can start once you hover on the component"). Spread `bind` on the
   component's root; `live` is true while the pointer is on it or focus is inside it, and
   stays true for `linger` ms after it leaves so a pass across the edge does not stop and
   start the feed. On a device with no hover (touch) it is true while the component is at
   least half in view instead, since a finger cannot point without pressing. */
export function usePointed<T extends HTMLElement = HTMLDivElement>({ linger = 600 } = {}) {
  const ref = useRef<T>(null)
  const [pointed, setPointed] = useState(false)
  const [seen, setSeen] = useState(false)
  const [touch] = useState(() => typeof matchMedia === "function" && !matchMedia("(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)").matches)
  const timer = useRef<number | undefined>(undefined)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!touch || !ref.current || typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined") return
    const io = new IntersectionObserver(([e]) => setSeen(e.isIntersecting), { threshold: 0.5 })
    io.observe(ref.current)
    return () => io.disconnect()
  }, [touch])
  useEffect(() => () => window.clearTimeout(timer.current), [])

  const on = () => {
    window.clearTimeout(timer.current)
    setPointed(true)
  }
  const off = () => {
    window.clearTimeout(timer.current)
    timer.current = window.setTimeout(() => setPointed(false), linger)
  }

  return {
    ref,
    live: touch ? seen : pointed,
    bind: {
      onPointerEnter: on,
      onPointerLeave: off,
      onFocus: on,
      onBlur: (e: React.FocusEvent) => {
        if (!e.currentTarget.contains(e.relatedTarget as Node | null)) off()
      },
    },
  }
}
```

# Positions Table (positions-table)
> An open positions table for futures and margin trading with entry, mark, liquidation price and unrealised P&L, plus hold to close.

// ─── components/ui/positions-table.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useState, type ReactNode } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"
import { ChevronDown, ChevronUp } from "lucide-react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { BUTTON } from "@/components/ui/control-classes"
import { RowAction, rowExit, rowWash, useRowExit } from "@/components/ui/row-action"

/* Positions Table, written new through ssych-component (2026-09-29).
   What it is for: every open position in one read: what it is, how big, where it was
   opened, where it is marked, where it would be liquidated and what it has made or lost.
   Read first: the unrealised P&L, signed and coloured, at the right of each row.
   The pointer: point at a row, or tab to its Close, and the others dim while a Close
   button comes up at the row's end (always shown where there is no hover). The column
   heads sort both ways. No totals above or below the rows (user call, 2026-10-02).
   Sketch used: src/components/lab/PositionsBlotterPro.tsx. Kept: the position shape
   (symbol, side, size, entry, mark, leverage), P&L worked from size and the two prices,
   liquidation worked from leverage, sorting on any measure, closing from the row.
   Changed: no card, no pill around the side, no amber; the liquidation price is printed,
   with its distance under it, where the sketch drew a coloured bar; the marks do not tick
   on their own, the caller passes new ones.
   No reference was named for this one.
   Formulas:
   · value         size × mark
   · margin        size × entry ÷ leverage
   · P&L           size × (mark − entry) for a long, size × (entry − mark) for a short
   · on margin     P&L ÷ margin × 100
   · liquidation   entry × (1 − 1 ÷ leverage + maintenance) for a long,
                   entry × (1 + 1 ÷ leverage − maintenance) for a short
   · away          |mark − liquidation| ÷ mark × 100
   · the label     Σ P&L of the open rows, read out in the table's name
   Motion (2026-09-30, the close 2026-10-02): a re-sort glides the rows to their new places
   by a layout transform (250ms). Close comes up from 4px over 150ms. Pressing it holds the
   row for 420ms: a wash in the colour of its P&L, the button turned to a tick and
   "Closed"; then the row slides 16px right as it fades and folds its height away (300ms)
   while the rows under it close up. Reduced motion keeps the wash and drops the travel.
   2026-10-02 audit: each market carries its token's mark through a renderIcon slot (the
   preview draws the real marks, as Holdings Table does with company marks); the entry
   price is /60 since a trader reads it, value and distance read 10.5px /60, hairlines are
   4%, and an optional Reset (the `resettable` prop, on in the preview) brings the closed
   rows back from the empty state so the close can be replayed. The row Close stays. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const SMOOTH = [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] as const
const GREEN = "var(--chart-up)"
const RED = "var(--chart-down)"

export interface Position {
  symbol: string
  name: string
  side: "long" | "short"
  /** in units of the asset */
  size: number
  entry: number
  mark: number
  leverage: number
}

export interface PositionsTableProps {
  positions?: Position[]
  title?: string
  /** maintenance margin rate, as a fraction of the entry price */
  maintenance?: number
  /** fired when a position's Close is pressed; the row leaves the table */
  onClose?: (position: Position) => void
  /** draws the token's real mark at `size` px; the symbol stands alone without it */
  renderIcon?: (symbol: string, size: number) => ReactNode
  /** show a Reset in the empty state that brings the closed rows back (demos) */
  resettable?: boolean
  className?: string
}

const DEFAULT_POSITIONS: Position[] = [
  { symbol: "BTC", name: "Bitcoin", side: "long", size: 0.85, entry: 64120, mark: 67412.5, leverage: 5 },
  { symbol: "ETH", name: "Ethereum", side: "short", size: 12, entry: 3482.4, mark: 3391.15, leverage: 4 },
  { symbol: "SOL", name: "Solana", side: "long", size: 420, entry: 152.3, mark: 148.62, leverage: 3 },
  { symbol: "AVAX", name: "Avalanche", side: "short", size: 900, entry: 27.84, mark: 28.91, leverage: 2 },
  { symbol: "DOGE", name: "Dogecoin", side: "long", size: 150000, entry: 0.1182, mark: 0.1247, leverage: 10 },
]

type SortKey = "symbol" | "value" | "away" | "pnl"
/* the last column is the Close button's (row-action.tsx), so it never sits over a figure */
const COLS = "grid-cols-[1fr_1fr_1fr_1fr_1.15fr_56px]"

const num = (n: number, dp: number) => n.toLocaleString("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: dp, maximumFractionDigits: dp })
/** prices keep the places their size needs: four under a dollar, two above */
const price = (n: number) => num(n, Math.abs(n) < 1 ? 4 : 2)
const size = (n: number) => n.toLocaleString("en-US", { maximumFractionDigits: 4 })
const usd = (n: number) => (Math.abs(n) >= 1e4 ? `$${(Math.abs(n) / 1e3).toFixed(1)}K` : `$${num(Math.abs(n), 2)}`)
const signedUsd = (n: number) => `${n >= 0 ? "+" : "−"}$${num(Math.abs(n), 2)}`
const signedPct = (n: number) => `${n >= 0 ? "+" : "−"}${Math.abs(n).toFixed(1)}%`
/** A hue as text: its lightness is capped in the light theme so small figures stay readable. */
const ink = (c: string) => `oklch(from ${c} min(l, var(--ink-l, 1)) c h)`

/**
 * The open book as rows on the page: market and side, size, entry over mark, the
 * liquidation price with its distance, and the unrealised P&L. Pointing at a row dims the
 * rest and brings up its Close.
 */
export function PositionsTable({
  positions = DEFAULT_POSITIONS,
  title = "Positions",
  maintenance = 0.005,
  onClose,
  renderIcon,
  resettable = false,
  className,
}: PositionsTableProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const [sort, setSort] = useState<{ key: SortKey; dir: 1 | -1 }>({ key: "pnl", dir: -1 })
  const [hover, setHover] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [closed, setClosed] = useState<string[]>([])
  const { leaving: closing, start } = useRowExit()

  const idOf = (p: Position) => `${p.symbol}-${p.side}`
  const valueOf = (p: Position) => p.size * p.mark
  const marginOf = (p: Position) => (p.size * p.entry) / p.leverage
  const pnlOf = (p: Position) => (p.side === "long" ? 1 : -1) * p.size * (p.mark - p.entry)
  const liqOf = (p: Position) =>
    Math.max(0, p.side === "long" ? p.entry * (1 - 1 / p.leverage + maintenance) : p.entry * (1 + 1 / p.leverage - maintenance))
  const awayOf = (p: Position) => (p.mark > 0 ? (Math.abs(p.mark - liqOf(p)) / p.mark) * 100 : 0)

  const open = positions.filter((p) => !closed.includes(idOf(p)))
  const measure = (p: Position) => (sort.key === "value" ? valueOf(p) : sort.key === "away" ? awayOf(p) : pnlOf(p))
  const rows = [...open].sort((a, b) =>
    sort.key === "symbol" ? a.symbol.localeCompare(b.symbol) * sort.dir : (measure(a) - measure(b)) * sort.dir,
  )

  const totalPnl = open.reduce((s, p) => s + pnlOf(p), 0)
  const hot = closing ?? hover

  const close = (p: Position) => {
    if (closing) return
    const id = idOf(p)
    onClose?.(p)
    start(id, () => {
      setClosed((c) => [...c, id])
      setHover(null)
    })
  }

  const head = (key: SortKey | null, label: string, first = false) => {
    const on = key !== null && sort.key === key
    const cls = cn("flex items-center gap-0.5 whitespace-nowrap text-[10.5px]", !first && "justify-end")
    if (key === null)
      return (
        <span role="columnheader" className={cn(cls, "text-foreground/45")}>
          {label}
        </span>
      )
    return (
      <span role="columnheader" aria-sort={on ? (sort.dir === 1 ? "ascending" : "descending") : "none"} className="flex">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setSort((s) => ({ key, dir: s.key === key ? (s.dir === 1 ? -1 : 1) : -1 }))}
          aria-label={`Sort by ${label.toLowerCase()}`}
          className={cn(
            cls,
            "w-full rounded-full outline-none transition-colors duration-200",
            on ? "text-foreground/90" : "text-foreground/45 hover:text-foreground/90 focus-visible:text-foreground/90",
          )}
        >
          {label}
          {on && (sort.dir === -1 ? <ChevronDown size={10} strokeWidth={1.8} aria-hidden /> : <ChevronUp size={10} strokeWidth={1.8} aria-hidden />)}
        </button>
      </span>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div
      className={cn("w-full max-w-[560px] tabular-nums [--ink-l:0.5] dark:[--ink-l:1]", className)}
      role="table"
      aria-label={`${title}, ${open.length} open, unrealised ${signedUsd(totalPnl)}`}
    >
      {/* no visible title (2026-10-01) and no totals (2026-10-02): the column heads say what
          this is, and the name and the summed P&L live in the table's aria-label */}
      <div role="row" className={cn("grid gap-2 px-3 pb-2", COLS)}>
        {head("symbol", "Market", true)}
        {head("value", "Size")}
        {head(null, "Entry / mark")}
        {head("away", "Liquidation")}
        {head("pnl", "Unrealised P&L")}
        <span role="columnheader" className="sr-only">
          Close
        </span>
      </div>

      <div role="rowgroup" onPointerLeave={() => setHover(null)}>
        <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
        {rows.map((p, i) => {
          const id = idOf(p)
          const pnl = pnlOf(p)
          const on = hot === id
          const dim = hot !== null && hot !== undefined && !on
          const hue = p.side === "long" ? GREEN : RED
          return (
            /* the wrapper owns the re-sort glide and the exit, the row the dim, the inside the entrance */
            <motion.div
              key={id}
              layout={reduced ? false : "position"}
              className="overflow-hidden"
              exit={rowExit(reduced)}
              transition={{ layout: { duration: 0.25, ease: SMOOTH } }}
            >
            <div
              role="row"
              onPointerEnter={() => setHover(id)}
              onFocus={() => setHover(id)}
              onBlur={() => setHover(null)}
              className="group border-t border-foreground/[0.04] transition-[opacity,background-color] duration-200 hover:bg-foreground/[0.03] focus-within:bg-foreground/[0.03]"
              style={{
                opacity: dim ? 0.45 : 1,
                /* the closed row washes in the colour of what it made or lost */
                background: closing === id ? rowWash(pnl >= 0 ? GREEN : RED) : undefined,
              }}
            >
              <motion.div
                className={cn("grid items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2", COLS)}
                initial={reduced ? false : { opacity: 0, y: 4 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.35, ease: EASE, delay: Math.min(i, 7) * 0.035 }}
              >
                <span role="cell" className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2">
                  {renderIcon && (
                    <span aria-hidden className="grid h-6 w-6 shrink-0 place-items-center">
                      {renderIcon(p.symbol, 24)}
                    </span>
                  )}
                  <span className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-0.5">
                    <span className="truncate text-[12px] font-semibold text-foreground/90">{p.symbol}</span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-medium" style={{ color: ink(hue) }}>
                      {p.side === "long" ? "Long" : "Short"} {p.leverage}×
                    </span>
                  </span>
                </span>
                <span role="cell" className="flex flex-col items-end gap-0.5">
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-foreground/90">{size(p.size)}</span>
                  <span className="text-[10.5px] text-foreground/60">{usd(valueOf(p))}</span>
                </span>
                <span role="cell" className="flex flex-col items-end gap-0.5">
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-foreground/60">{price(p.entry)}</span>
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-foreground/90">{price(p.mark)}</span>
                </span>
                <span role="cell" className="flex flex-col items-end gap-0.5">
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-foreground/90">{price(liqOf(p))}</span>
                  <span className="text-[10.5px] text-foreground/60">{awayOf(p).toFixed(1)}% away</span>
                </span>
                <span role="cell" className="flex flex-col items-end gap-0.5" style={{ color: ink(pnl >= 0 ? GREEN : RED) }}>
                  <span className="text-[11.5px] font-semibold">{signedUsd(pnl)}</span>
                  <span className="text-[10px]">{signedPct(marginOf(p) > 0 ? (pnl / marginOf(p)) * 100 : 0)}</span>
                </span>
                <span role="cell" className="flex justify-end">
                  <RowAction
                    done={closing === id}
                    disabled={closing !== null}
                    onClick={() => close(p)}
                    tone={ink(pnl >= 0 ? GREEN : RED)}
                    aria-label={closing === id ? `${p.symbol} ${p.side} closed` : `Close ${p.symbol} ${p.side}, ${signedUsd(pnl)}`}
                  />
                </span>
              </motion.div>
            </div>
            </motion.div>
          )
        })}
        </AnimatePresence>
      </div>

      <AnimatePresence>
        {open.length === 0 && (
          <motion.div
            role="status"
            className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3 border-t border-foreground/[0.04] px-3 pt-4 text-center text-[11px] text-foreground/60"
            initial={reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: 4 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.25, ease: EASE, delay: reduced ? 0 : 0.3 }}
          >
            No open positions
            {resettable && (
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setClosed([])} className={cn(BUTTON, "h-7 px-3 text-[11.5px]")}>
                Reset
              </button>
            )}
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  )
}
```

```tsx
/* Control classes: the library's control material for components that ship on their own
   (2026-10-02, the audit's pattern 11). src/components/library/controls.ts is the site's
   copy; components used to paste its look in as a flat 8% fill "so the file ships alone",
   and those copies never turned white on a raised light surface. These read the same
   tokens WITH a fallback, so they follow the site's raised-surface rule here and still
   draw correctly in a buyer's app that has no such tokens. Shipped beside every component
   that imports it (scripts/build-registry.mjs bundles ui helpers automatically).

   Whole class strings, never assembled from pieces: Tailwind reads this file as text. */

/** what is ON in a switcher. Light (his call, 2026-10-02, after the inline slider): a WHITE
 *  pill with a hairline and a soft shadow on the grey track. Dark: the 8% thumb */
export const THUMB =
  "bg-white shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--light-outline,rgba(0,0,0,0.09)),0_1px_3px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] dark:bg-[var(--control-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_8%,transparent))] dark:shadow-[var(--control-shadow,inset_0_1px_0_0_color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_6%,transparent))]"

/** what a switcher's options sit in; its 2px padding is the gap the thumb keeps. Light: a
 *  light grey track with no outline, the white pill sits in it. Dark: a hairline, no fill */
export const TRACK = "rounded-full border border-transparent bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_5%,var(--background))] p-0.5 dark:border-foreground/[0.04] dark:bg-transparent"

/** an option that is off: the label alone answers the pointer */
export const SEGMENT_OFF = "text-foreground/60 hover:text-foreground/90"

/** a secondary button: the thumb standing alone; size it with h-7 / h-9 and px */
export const BUTTON =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--control-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_8%,transparent))] shadow-[var(--control-shadow,inset_0_1px_0_0_color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_6%,transparent))] text-foreground/90 outline-none transition-[color,background-color,scale] duration-150 hover:bg-[var(--control-fill-hover,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_12%,transparent))] focus-visible:bg-[var(--control-fill-hover,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_12%,transparent))] active:scale-[0.97] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40 motion-reduce:active:scale-100"

/** an icon-only control: no fill at rest, a faint one under the pointer */
export const ICON_BUTTON =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-full text-foreground/60 outline-none transition-[color,background-color] duration-150 hover:bg-foreground/[0.06] hover:text-foreground/90 focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.06]"

/** a field: the track with just enough fill to read as somewhere to type */
export const FIELD =
  "rounded-full border border-foreground/[0.04] bg-[var(--field-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_5%,transparent))] text-foreground/90 outline-none transition-[background-color,border-color] duration-150 placeholder:text-foreground/45 focus:border-foreground/[0.12]"

/** the one loud button of a form: 48px, full width, the foreground filled (the dashboards'
 *  Modal primary). A ticket, a swap, a confirm: one of these and nothing louder */
export const BUTTON_PRIMARY =
  "inline-flex h-12 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-foreground/[0.92] text-[14px] font-medium text-background outline-none transition-[background-color,scale,opacity] duration-150 hover:bg-foreground focus-visible:bg-foreground active:scale-[0.98] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40 motion-reduce:active:scale-100"

/** a component's own card, field or block (spec 14.8). Dark: a #121212 fill on black. Light
 *  (his call, 2026-10-02: "on light the card background is too dark, it can just be white, a
 *  quiet outline and a small shadow"): white, a 1px hairline (Kraken's #e7e6e9, or 9% ink in an app without the token) and a
 *  barely there shadow,
 *  drawn as box shadows so the outline takes no layout */
export const SURFACE =
  "bg-background shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--light-outline,color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_9%,transparent)),0_1px_2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] dark:bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_7%,var(--background))] dark:shadow-none"

/** a block sitting ON a surface: a faint 4% grey inside a white card in light, #1f1f1f in dark */
export const RAISED = "bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_4%,var(--background))] dark:bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_12%,var(--background))]"
```

// ─── components/ui/row-action.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react"
import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"
import { Check } from "lucide-react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

/* Row action: an action that lives on a table row, and the way the row leaves after it
   (2026-10-02, out of Positions Table and the trading terminal).

   RowAction   a real button in the row's own last column, so it never sits over a figure.
               It comes up (4px, 150ms) on row hover or keyboard focus (the row carries
               `group`), and is always shown where there is no hover. Once pressed it turns
               to a tick and the past tense ("Closed").
   useRowExit  the hold: the row washes in the colour of its result and keeps its "Closed"
               for 420ms, then `onDone` takes it out of the list.
   rowExit     the motion the row's wrapper leaves with: 16px right as it fades while its
               height folds away (300ms), so the rows under it close up. Reduced motion
               keeps a fade.
   rowWash     the 10% wash in the result's colour. */

const LIFT_SPRING = { type: "spring", stiffness: 500, damping: 30 } as const
const SMOOTH = [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] as const
/** how long a finished row holds its "Closed" before it leaves */
export const ROW_HOLD_MS = 420

export function useRowExit(hold = ROW_HOLD_MS) {
  const [leaving, setLeaving] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const timer = useRef<number | undefined>(undefined)
  useEffect(() => () => window.clearTimeout(timer.current), [])
  /** hold row `id` in its finished state, then run `onDone` (which removes it) */
  const start = useCallback(
    (id: string, onDone: () => void) => {
      if (leaving) return
      setLeaving(id)
      timer.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
        onDone()
        setLeaving(null)
      }, hold)
    },
    [hold, leaving],
  )
  return { leaving, start }
}

export const rowExit = (reduced: boolean | null) =>
  reduced
    ? { opacity: 0, transition: { duration: 0.15 } }
    : { opacity: 0, x: 16, height: 0, transition: { duration: 0.3, ease: SMOOTH, height: { duration: 0.3, ease: SMOOTH, delay: 0.08 } } }

export const rowWash = (color: string) => `color-mix(in srgb, ${color} 10%, transparent)`

export function RowAction({
  done,
  disabled,
  onClick,
  label = "Close",
  doneLabel = "Closed",
  tone = "var(--foreground)",
  "aria-label": ariaLabel,
  children,
}: {
  /** the action has gone through: the button reads the past tense with a tick */
  done: boolean
  disabled?: boolean
  onClick: () => void
  label?: string
  doneLabel?: string
  /** the tick's colour: the result's hue */
  tone?: string
  "aria-label"?: string
  children?: ReactNode
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  return (
    <motion.button
      type="button"
      onClick={onClick}
      disabled={disabled}
      aria-label={ariaLabel}
      whileTap={reduced ? undefined : { scale: 0.97, transition: LIFT_SPRING }}
      className={cn(
        "inline-flex h-6 items-center gap-1 rounded-full px-2.5 text-[10.5px] font-medium text-foreground/90 outline-none",
        "transition-[opacity,transform,translate,background-color,color] duration-150 ease-out",
        done
          ? "translate-y-0 opacity-100"
          : "translate-y-1 bg-foreground/[0.08] opacity-0 hover:bg-foreground/[0.14] focus-visible:translate-y-0 focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.14] focus-visible:opacity-100 group-hover:translate-y-0 group-hover:opacity-100 [@media(hover:none)]:translate-y-0 [@media(hover:none)]:opacity-100",
      )}
    >
      {done ? (
        <>
          <Check size={11} strokeWidth={2.2} aria-hidden style={{ color: tone }} />
          {doneLabel}
        </>
      ) : (
        children ?? label
      )}
    </motion.button>
  )
}
```

# Holdings Table (holdings-table)
> A fund holdings table with market value, price, YTD return and portfolio weight bars, sortable by any column, for ETF and wealth apps.

// ─── components/ui/holdings-table.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useState, type ReactNode } from "react"
import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"
import { ChevronDown, ChevronUp } from "lucide-react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

/* Holdings Table, rebuilt through the ssych-component skill (2026-09-29).
   What changed against the version before it (in git history), and why:
   · no card, outline, inner shadow or header band: rows sit on the page and part by one
     hairline above each; the coin is a fill, not a ring
   · amber is gone. The weight and its comb are ink, and the comb of the row being pointed
     at takes the one accent
   · the return is signed and coloured by direction: green for a gain, red for a loss. It
     was always green in a green pill, whatever the sign
   · pointing at a row, or tabbing to it, dims the others and hands its comb the accent.
     No line under the table (user call, 2026-10-02): the count and the summed weight are
     read out in the table's name
   · the company's own mark beside its symbol through `renderIcon` (2026-10-02); two
     letters on ink where none is given
   · it is a real table to a screen reader: rows, column heads and cells are named
   2026-10-02 audit: the first head was the 13px title "Top 10 holdings" over 6 rows; it is
   now a plain "Holding" head like the others and the title (default "Holdings", never a
   count) lives in the aria-label only. Every head sorts on a click like Positions Table's,
   the sorted one /90 with a chevron, weight (largest first) by default. The company name
   sits under the symbol at 11px /60 since it is read, row figures are 12px /90, hairlines
   are 4%, and the width is 560, the same as Positions Table, its family.
   Formulas:
   · the comb      round(weight ÷ maxWeight × 24) of its 24 ticks are lit
   · the label     Σ weight of the rows, read out in the table's name
   · money sorts   "$52.10B" is read as 52.10 × 10^9 (K, M, B, T suffixes) */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GREEN = "var(--chart-up)"
const RED = "var(--chart-down)"
const ACCENT = "var(--chart-1)"

export interface Holding {
  symbol: string
  name: string
  marketValue: string
  price: string
  ytd: number
  weight: number
}

const DEFAULT_HOLDINGS: Holding[] = [
  { symbol: "AAPL", name: "Apple Inc", marketValue: "$52.10B", price: "$228.02", ytd: 18.4, weight: 8.91 },
  { symbol: "MSFT", name: "Microsoft Corp", marketValue: "$48.66B", price: "$415.60", ytd: 14.2, weight: 8.32 },
  { symbol: "NVDA", name: "NVIDIA Corp", marketValue: "$41.02B", price: "$122.85", ytd: 42.1, weight: 7.01 },
  { symbol: "AMZN", name: "Amazon.com Inc", marketValue: "$35.73B", price: "$178.52", ytd: 12.49, weight: 6.11 },
  { symbol: "META", name: "Meta Platforms", marketValue: "$29.48B", price: "$514.29", ytd: 22.8, weight: 5.04 },
  { symbol: "GOOGL", name: "Alphabet Inc", marketValue: "$27.91B", price: "$163.24", ytd: 9.7, weight: 4.77 },
]

const COMB_TICKS = 24
const COLS = "grid-cols-[1.45fr_0.9fr_0.85fr_0.75fr_1.35fr]"

type SortKey = "symbol" | "value" | "price" | "ytd" | "weight"
const SUFFIX: Record<string, number> = { K: 1e3, M: 1e6, B: 1e9, T: 1e12 }
/** "$52.10B" → 52,100,000,000, so the string money columns sort by what they say */
const moneyOf = (s: string) => {
  const m = s.replace(/[$,\s]/g, "").match(/^(-?[\d.]+)([KMBT])?$/i)
  return m ? parseFloat(m[1]) * (m[2] ? SUFFIX[m[2].toUpperCase()] : 1) : 0
}
const SORT_VALUE: Record<Exclude<SortKey, "symbol">, (h: Holding) => number> = {
  value: (h) => moneyOf(h.marketValue),
  price: (h) => moneyOf(h.price),
  ytd: (h) => h.ytd,
  weight: (h) => h.weight,
}

const signed = (v: number) => `${v >= 0 ? "+" : "−"}${Math.abs(v).toFixed(2)}%`
const ink = (pct: number) => `color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) ${pct}%, transparent)`

/**
 * Fund-holdings register in the Ink register: the company's mark, symbol beside its muted name,
 * tabular money columns, the signed return, and the weight trailed by a tick-comb bar.
 * Pointing at a row dims the rest and hands its comb the accent. The four column labels
 * are props, so a book that is not a fund can name what its return and weight actually
 * measure (return since entry, share of gross exposure) without a fork.
 */
export function HoldingsTable({
  holdings = DEFAULT_HOLDINGS,
  title = "Holdings",
  maxWeight = 10,
  valueLabel = "Market value",
  priceLabel = "Current price",
  returnLabel = "YTD returns",
  weightLabel = "Percentage of fund",
  renderIcon,
  className,
}: {
  holdings?: Holding[]
  /** the table's name, read out in its aria-label (no visible title) */
  title?: string
  /** Weight that fills the whole tick comb. */
  maxWeight?: number
  /** Column header over `marketValue`. */
  valueLabel?: string
  /** Column header over `price`. */
  priceLabel?: string
  /** Column header over the return: name the window the number covers. */
  returnLabel?: string
  /** Column header over the weight comb: name the base the share is taken of. */
  weightLabel?: string
  /** draws the company's real mark at `size` px; two letters on ink without it */
  renderIcon?: (symbol: string, size: number) => ReactNode
  className?: string
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const [hot, setHot] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [sort, setSort] = useState<{ key: SortKey; dir: 1 | -1 }>({ key: "weight", dir: -1 })
  /* the weight of everything listed, summed from the rows */
  const total = holdings.reduce((s, h) => s + h.weight, 0)
  const rows = [...holdings].sort((a, b) =>
    sort.key === "symbol" ? a.symbol.localeCompare(b.symbol) * sort.dir : (SORT_VALUE[sort.key](a) - SORT_VALUE[sort.key](b)) * sort.dir,
  )

  const head = (key: SortKey, label: string, first = false) => {
    const on = sort.key === key
    return (
      <span key={key} role="columnheader" aria-sort={on ? (sort.dir === 1 ? "ascending" : "descending") : "none"} className="flex">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setSort((s) => ({ key, dir: s.key === key ? (s.dir === 1 ? -1 : 1) : -1 }))}
          aria-label={`Sort by ${label.toLowerCase()}`}
          className={cn(
            "flex w-full items-center gap-0.5 whitespace-nowrap rounded-full text-[10.5px] outline-none transition-colors duration-200",
            !first && "justify-end",
            on ? "text-foreground/90" : "text-foreground/45 hover:text-foreground/90 focus-visible:text-foreground/90",
          )}
        >
          {label}
          {on && (sort.dir === -1 ? <ChevronDown size={10} strokeWidth={1.8} aria-hidden /> : <ChevronUp size={10} strokeWidth={1.8} aria-hidden />)}
        </button>
      </span>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className={cn("w-full max-w-[560px] tabular-nums", className)} role="table" aria-label={`${title}, ${holdings.length} holdings, ${total.toFixed(2)}% in all`}>
      <div role="row" className={cn("grid gap-2 px-3 pb-2", COLS)}>
        {head("symbol", "Holding", true)}
        {head("value", valueLabel)}
        {head("price", priceLabel)}
        {head("ytd", returnLabel)}
        {head("weight", weightLabel)}
      </div>

      <div role="rowgroup" onPointerLeave={() => setHot(null)}>
        {rows.map((h, i) => {
          const cursor = Math.round((h.weight / maxWeight) * COMB_TICKS)
          const on = hot === h.symbol
          const dim = hot !== null && !on
          return (
            /* the outer row owns the dim so it never fights the entrance inside */
            <div
              key={h.symbol}
              role="row"
              tabIndex={0}
              onPointerEnter={() => setHot(h.symbol)}
              onFocus={() => setHot(h.symbol)}
              onBlur={() => setHot(null)}
              className="border-t border-foreground/[0.04] outline-none transition-[opacity,background-color] duration-200 hover:bg-foreground/[0.03] focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.06]"
              style={{ opacity: dim ? 0.45 : 1 }}
            >
              <motion.div
                className={cn("grid items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2.5", COLS)}
                initial={reduced ? false : { opacity: 0, y: 4 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.35, ease: EASE, delay: Math.min(i, 7) * 0.035 }}
              >
                <span role="cell" className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2.5">
                  {renderIcon ? (
                    <span aria-hidden className="grid h-6 w-6 shrink-0 place-items-center">
                      {renderIcon(h.symbol, 24)}
                    </span>
                  ) : (
                    <span aria-hidden className="grid h-6 w-6 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full bg-foreground/[0.06] text-[8.5px] font-semibold text-foreground/70">
                      {h.symbol.slice(0, 2)}
                    </span>
                  )}
                  <span className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-0.5">
                    <span className="truncate text-[12px] font-semibold text-foreground/90">{h.symbol}</span>
                    <span className="truncate text-[11px] text-foreground/60">{h.name}</span>
                  </span>
                </span>
                <span role="cell" className="text-right text-[12px] text-foreground/90">
                  {h.marketValue}
                </span>
                <span role="cell" className="text-right text-[12px] text-foreground/90">
                  {h.price}
                </span>
                <span role="cell" className="text-right text-[12px] font-medium" style={{ color: h.ytd >= 0 ? GREEN : RED }}>
                  {signed(h.ytd)}
                </span>
                <span role="cell" className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2.5">
                  <span className="text-[12px] text-foreground/90">{h.weight.toFixed(2)}%</span>
                  <span aria-hidden className="flex h-3 items-center gap-[2px]">
                    {Array.from({ length: COMB_TICKS }, (_, t) => (
                      <span
                        key={t}
                        className="w-px rounded-full"
                        style={{
                          height: t < cursor ? 9 : 5,
                          background: t < cursor ? (on ? ACCENT : ink(55)) : ink(12),
                          transition: "background 150ms",
                        }}
                      />
                    ))}
                  </span>
                </span>
              </motion.div>
            </div>
          )
        })}
      </div>

    </div>
  )
}
```
