# Trade Journal Table (trade-journal-table)
> A trade journal table for crypto and stock traders, with the open position lit and every closed trade settled to a win or loss.

// ─── components/ui/trade-journal-table.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useEffect, useState, type ReactNode } from "react"
import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"
import { ChevronDown, ChevronUp } from "lucide-react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { SegmentedControl } from "@/components/ui/segmented-control"

/* Trade Journal Table, rebuilt through the ssych-component skill (2026-09-29).
   What changed against the version before it (in git history), and why:
   · no card, outline or drop shadow: rows sit on the page and part by one hairline
   · the title is plain 13px text, not a heading tag; the page owns the headings
   · the side and the outcome lost their pills, and the check and cross icons with their
     3px strokes are gone. Long and short are coloured words, and so is the outcome: a
     win is green and a loss red (2026-09-30, the pass and fail colour came back)
   · the net P&L formula moved out of a browser tooltip into the line under the table,
     where pointing at a row, or tabbing to it, writes it out; at rest that line sums the
     net of the trades on screen
   · pointing at a row dims the others
   · the range switcher is the quiet pill: 28px tall, one sliding fill at 8% ink
   2026-10-02 audit: the line under the table no longer sums the trades at rest; it reads
   only the pointed row's formula, wraps to a second line inside a fixed two line height so
   a long formula is never cut, and keeps its height empty at rest (the net total and the
   count stay in the aria-label). The count beside the title is gone. The range switch is
   the shared SegmentedControl. Heads are 10.5px /45 and sort on a click, the sorted one /90
   with a chevron, date (newest first) by default. An open trade shows an en dash under
   Net P&L, since it has no net yet; its entry fee is in its pointed formula.
   Formulas:
   · fees  0.05% × notional per side: 2 sides on a closed trade, 1 on an open one
   · net   gross P&L − fees (closed trades)
   · range the trades opened within 7 or 30 days of the newest one */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GREEN = "var(--chart-up)"
const RED = "var(--chart-down)"

export type TradeSide = "Long" | "Short"
export type TradeOutcome = "Open" | "Win" | "Loss"

export interface JournalRow {
  id: string
  /** ISO date; shown as "Aug 23, 15:09" */
  at: string
  asset: string
  side: TradeSide
  /** position size in units and its notional in $ */
  qty: number
  notional: number
  entry: number
  exit: number | null
  /** gross P&L in $; null while open */
  pnl: number | null
  /** slippage in % of notional */
  slippage: number
  /** hold time in minutes; null while open */
  holdMin: number | null
  status: TradeOutcome
}

/* fees are one flat rule so net is always derivable: net = gross − 0.05% of
   notional per side (two sides on a closed trade, one on an open one) */
const FEE_RATE = 0.0005
const fees = (r: JournalRow) => r.notional * FEE_RATE * (r.status === "Open" ? 1 : 2)
const net = (r: JournalRow) => (r.pnl ?? 0) - fees(r)

const DEFAULT_ROWS: JournalRow[] = [
  { id: "t-1041877-6", at: "2026-08-23T15:09:00", asset: "BTC", side: "Long", qty: 0.1546, notional: 11951, entry: 77288, exit: null, pnl: null, slippage: 0, holdMin: null, status: "Open" },
  { id: "t-1041877-5", at: "2026-07-30T11:22:00", asset: "BTC", side: "Long", qty: 0.08, notional: 5167, entry: 64590, exit: 72660, pnl: 645.6, slippage: 0, holdMin: 1445, status: "Win" },
  { id: "t-1041877-4", at: "2026-07-27T16:11:00", asset: "BTC", side: "Short", qty: 0.05, notional: 3261, entry: 65220, exit: 64914, pnl: 15.3, slippage: 0.292, holdMin: 16, status: "Win" },
  { id: "t-1041877-3", at: "2026-07-20T17:27:00", asset: "BTC", side: "Short", qty: 0.02, notional: 1298, entry: 64890, exit: 65963, pnl: -21.46, slippage: 0, holdMin: 966, status: "Loss" },
  { id: "t-1041877-2", at: "2026-07-20T16:18:00", asset: "BTC", side: "Long", qty: 0.06, notional: 3884, entry: 64734, exit: 65000, pnl: 15.96, slippage: 0, holdMin: 887, status: "Win" },
]

/** a range keeps the trades opened within that many days of the newest one */
const RANGES = [
  { label: "7D", days: 7 },
  { label: "30D", days: 30 },
  { label: "All", days: Infinity },
] as const
type Range = (typeof RANGES)[number]["label"]

const COLS = "96px minmax(0,1fr) 52px 64px 84px 84px 56px"
const DAY_MS = 86_400_000

const MONTHS = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"]
function fmtDate(iso: string) {
  const [d, t] = iso.split("T")
  const [, m, day] = d.split("-").map(Number)
  return `${MONTHS[m - 1]} ${day}, ${t.slice(0, 5)}`
}
const money = (n: number, dp = 2) =>
  `$${Math.abs(n).toLocaleString("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: dp, maximumFractionDigits: dp })}`
const signed = (n: number) => `${n < 0 ? "−" : "+"}${money(n)}`

/** the formula behind one row's net, written out with its inputs */
const formula = (r: JournalRow) =>
  r.status === "Open"
    ? `fees so far ${money(fees(r))} = 0.05% × ${money(r.notional, 0)} × 1 side, net when it closes`
    : `gross ${signed(r.pnl ?? 0)} − fees ${money(fees(r))} (0.05% × ${money(r.notional, 0)} × 2 sides)`

type SortKey = "date" | "asset" | "side" | "size" | "entry" | "net" | "status"
const SORT_VALUE: Record<SortKey, (r: JournalRow) => number | string> = {
  date: (r) => Date.parse(r.at),
  asset: (r) => r.asset,
  side: (r) => r.side,
  size: (r) => r.qty,
  entry: (r) => r.entry,
  /* an open trade has no net yet: it sorts below every closed one */
  net: (r) => (r.status === "Open" ? -Infinity : net(r)),
  status: (r) => r.status,
}

/**
 * Trade journal in the Ink register: a title and a range switcher, one sortable column
 * head, and rows that read date, asset, side, size, entry, net P&L and outcome. The
 * range keeps the trades opened within 7 or 30 days of the newest one. Pointing at a
 * row dims the rest and writes its net P&L formula under the table: gross minus 0.05%
 * of notional per side.
 */
export function TradeJournalTable({
  rows = DEFAULT_ROWS,
  title = "Trade journal",
  renderIcon,
  className,
}: {
  rows?: JournalRow[]
  title?: string
  /** draws an asset's mark (a token or company logo) before its name (2026-10-06); none left out */
  renderIcon?: (symbol: string, size: number) => ReactNode
  className?: string
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const [range, setRange] = useState<Range>("All")
  const [sort, setSort] = useState<{ key: SortKey; dir: 1 | -1 }>({ key: "date", dir: -1 })
  const [hot, setHot] = useState<string | null>(null)
  /* rows rise in once on mount, 40ms apart and capped at eight; after that a row that a
     range brings in rises alone and the hover dim is quick */
  const [landed, setLanded] = useState(false)
  useEffect(() => {
    const t = setTimeout(() => setLanded(true), reduced ? 0 : 8 * 40 + 320)
    return () => clearTimeout(t)
  }, [reduced])

  const newest = Math.max(...rows.map((r) => Date.parse(r.at)))
  const days = RANGES.find((r) => r.label === range)!.days
  const by = SORT_VALUE[sort.key]
  const shown = [...rows]
    .filter((r) => newest - Date.parse(r.at) <= days * DAY_MS)
    .sort((a, b) => {
      const x = by(a)
      const y = by(b)
      const c = typeof x === "string" ? x.localeCompare(String(y)) : x === y ? 0 : x < (y as number) ? -1 : 1
      /* ties fall back to the newest first */
      return c * sort.dir || Date.parse(b.at) - Date.parse(a.at)
    })
  /* the net of every trade on screen, each one gross minus its own fees */
  const total = shown.reduce((s, r) => s + net(r), 0)
  const count = `${shown.length} ${shown.length === 1 ? "trade" : "trades"}`
  const pointed = shown.find((r) => r.id === hot)

  const head = (key: SortKey, label: string, right = false) => {
    const on = sort.key === key
    return (
      <span role="columnheader" aria-sort={on ? (sort.dir === 1 ? "ascending" : "descending") : "none"} className="flex">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setSort((s) => ({ key, dir: s.key === key ? (s.dir === 1 ? -1 : 1) : -1 }))}
          aria-label={`Sort by ${label.toLowerCase()}`}
          className={cn(
            "flex w-full items-center gap-0.5 whitespace-nowrap rounded-full text-[10.5px] outline-none transition-colors duration-200",
            right && "justify-end",
            on ? "text-foreground/90" : "text-foreground/45 hover:text-foreground/90 focus-visible:text-foreground/90",
          )}
        >
          {label}
          {on && (sort.dir === -1 ? <ChevronDown size={10} strokeWidth={1.8} aria-hidden /> : <ChevronUp size={10} strokeWidth={1.8} aria-hidden />)}
        </button>
      </span>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className={cn("w-full max-w-[640px] tabular-nums", className)} role="table" aria-label={`${title}, ${count}, net ${signed(total)} after fees`}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-3 pb-3">
        <span className="text-[13px] font-medium text-foreground/90">{title}</span>
        <SegmentedControl options={RANGES.map((r) => r.label)} value={range} onChange={(v) => setRange(v as Range)} />
      </div>

      <div role="row" className="grid gap-3 border-b border-foreground/[0.04] px-3 pb-2" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: COLS }}>
        {head("date", "Date")}
        {head("asset", "Asset")}
        {head("side", "Side")}
        {head("size", "Size", true)}
        {head("entry", "Entry", true)}
        {head("net", "Net P&L", true)}
        {head("status", "Status", true)}
      </div>

      <div role="rowgroup" onPointerLeave={() => setHot(null)}>
        {shown.map((r, i) => {
          const open = r.status === "Open"
          const n = net(r)
          const dim = hot !== null && hot !== r.id
          return (
            <motion.div
              initial={reduced ? false : { opacity: 0, y: 6 }}
              animate={{ opacity: dim ? 0.45 : 1, y: 0 }}
              transition={
                reduced
                  ? { duration: 0.2 }
                  : landed
                    ? { duration: 0.2, ease: EASE }
                    : { duration: 0.3, ease: EASE, delay: Math.min(i, 7) * 0.04 }
              }
              role="row"
              tabIndex={0}
              onPointerEnter={() => setHot(r.id)}
              onFocus={() => setHot(r.id)}
              onBlur={() => setHot(null)}
              className="grid items-center gap-3 border-b border-foreground/[0.04] px-3 py-2.5 outline-none transition-[background-color] duration-200 hover:bg-foreground/[0.03] focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.06]"
              key={r.id}
              style={{ gridTemplateColumns: COLS }}
            >
              <span role="cell" className="whitespace-nowrap text-[11px] text-foreground/60">
                {fmtDate(r.at)}
              </span>
              <span role="cell" className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2 text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-foreground/90">
                {renderIcon && <span aria-hidden className="grid h-5 w-5 shrink-0 place-items-center">{renderIcon(r.asset, 20)}</span>}
                <span className="truncate">{r.asset}</span>
              </span>
              <span role="cell" className="text-[11px] font-medium" style={{ color: r.side === "Long" ? GREEN : RED }}>
                {r.side}
              </span>
              <span role="cell" className="text-right text-[12px] text-foreground/90">
                {r.qty.toFixed(4)}
              </span>
              <span role="cell" className="text-right text-[12px] text-foreground/90">
                {r.entry.toLocaleString("en-US")}
              </span>
              {/* net = gross − fees; fees = 0.05% of notional per side */}
              <span
                role="cell"
                className={cn("text-right text-[12px] font-medium", open && "text-foreground/45")}
                style={{ color: open ? undefined : n < 0 ? RED : GREEN }}
              >
                {open ? "–" : signed(n)}
              </span>
              {/* the outcome is a pass or a fail: win in green, loss in red, open stays muted */}
              <span
                role="cell"
                className={cn("text-right text-[11px]", open && "text-foreground/45")}
                style={{ color: open ? undefined : r.status === "Win" ? GREEN : RED }}
              >
                {r.status}
              </span>
            </motion.div>
          )
        })}
      </div>

      {/* the pointed row's formula only; two lines tall so a long one wraps and is never
          cut, and empty at rest (2026-10-02 audit). It swaps in place when the row changes */}
      <div role="status" className="h-[38px] px-3 pt-2 text-[10.5px] leading-[15px] text-foreground/60">
        {pointed ? (
          <motion.span
            key={pointed.id}
            className="block"
            initial={reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: 4, filter: "blur(2px)" }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, filter: "blur(0px)" }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
          >
            {pointed.status === "Open" ? (
              <>
                <span className="font-medium text-foreground/90">open</span> {formula(pointed)}
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <span className="font-medium text-foreground/90">net {signed(net(pointed))}</span> = {formula(pointed)}
              </>
            )}
          </motion.span>
        ) : (
          <span aria-hidden>&nbsp;</span>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

```


# Fills Blotter (fills-blotter)
> A live order fills blotter for brokers and trading desks, streaming executions that land as working and resolve to filled or rejected.

// ─── components/ui/fills-blotter.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { LiveToggle } from "@/components/ui/live-toggle"
import { usePointed } from "@/components/ui/use-pointed"

/* Fills Blotter, rebuilt through the ssych-component skill (2026-09-29).
   What changed against the version before it (in git history), and why:
   · no card or outline: rows sit on the page and part by one hairline
   · the title is plain 13px text, not a heading tag; the page owns the headings
   · the side and the status lost their pills, and the check and cross icons with their
     3px strokes are gone. Buy and sell are coloured words; a fill is green, a rejection is
     red, a working order is muted with its pulsing amber dot (colour pass, 2026-09-30)
   · the pause control is a round fill, not an outlined square. Its icon stays, it is the
     control's meaning
   · pointing at a row, or tabbing to it, keeps it full, dims the others and unfolds its
     detail line
   · the flash on a status flip and the row entrance settle in 400ms, the shake is smaller,
     the detail line unfolds on grid rows, not height
   · the count's formula moved out of a browser tooltip into the label a screen reader
     gets; the edge fades are cut from a token, not a hex
   2026-10-02 audit: his call that anything streaming runs only while pointed at, so the
   blotter rests on its 5 seeded fills and the feed runs while the pointer is on the table
   (usePointed); the round pause button became the shared IconToggle at a fixed width, a
   filled play mark reading "Play" or a pulsing green dot reading "Live", which pins the
   feed on or pauses it while the pointer stays. The "19 today" count beside the title is
   gone (it stays in the aria-label). Heads are 10.5px. The detail line no longer unfolds
   under a pointed row and pushes the rows below down: venue, order id and fee swap in
   place inside the row, after the symbol, at 10.5px /60, gap-3 apart with no dots.
   2026-10-02 round 2: his note "broken on hover". Pointing at the table started the feed,
   and every arrival pushed the rows down under a still pointer: the lit row with its detail
   slid away while the row under the pointer stayed dimmed, the table grew from 5 rows
   toward its 360px cap (re-centring itself in the stage), a scrollbar could appear and
   narrow the columns, the detail was clipped mid word in a 200px column, and rows trimmed
   off the end were popped out of the clipped list (popLayout, which also breaks inside the
   preview iframe) and flashed under it. Now the list is a fixed 300px with no scrollbar and
   8 seeded rows of a fixed 40px, so nothing grows; pointing at a row (or focusing it) holds
   the arrivals, so the row being read never moves, while working orders still resolve in
   place; the feed runs while the pointer is on the title or heads, or when Live is pinned
   and the pointer is away from the rows. The fixed columns are trimmed to their content
   so the symbol column has room for venue, order id and fee, and a narrow host fades the
   detail at its right edge instead of cutting it. The top edge fades only once the list is
   scrolled, so the newest row is never half faded. The toggle is the shared LiveToggle.
   Formulas:
   · today = 18 settled before the window + the seeded rows + every arrival since */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GREEN = "var(--chart-up)"
const RED = "var(--chart-down)"
const AMBER = "var(--chart-amber)"

/** the visual-regression runner freezes every feed */
const isSnapshot = () => typeof navigator !== "undefined" && /\bChromatic\b/.test(navigator.userAgent)

export type FillEvent = {
  id: string
  /** wall-clock label, already formatted (deterministic feed) */
  time: string
  symbol: string
  side: "buy" | "sell"
  qty: number
  price: number
  /** ms after arrival when the working order resolves */
  resolveMs: number
  outcome: "filled" | "rejected"
  venue: string
  orderId: string
  fee: number
}

type Status = "working" | "filled" | "rejected"
type Row = { key: string; ev: FillEvent; status: Status }

/** deterministic demo feed, replayed in order, never randomized */
const DEFAULT_EVENTS: FillEvent[] = [
  { id: "f01", time: "14:29:47", symbol: "AAPL", side: "buy", qty: 200, price: 229.41, resolveMs: 2400, outcome: "filled", venue: "NASDAQ", orderId: "ord-84121", fee: 1.04 },
  { id: "f02", time: "14:30:02", symbol: "NVDA", side: "sell", qty: 50, price: 1189.2, resolveMs: 2000, outcome: "filled", venue: "ARCA", orderId: "ord-84127", fee: 2.31 },
  { id: "f03", time: "14:30:18", symbol: "TSLA", side: "buy", qty: 120, price: 244.87, resolveMs: 3000, outcome: "rejected", venue: "IEX", orderId: "ord-84130", fee: 0 },
  { id: "f04", time: "14:30:31", symbol: "MSFT", side: "buy", qty: 80, price: 428.55, resolveMs: 2200, outcome: "filled", venue: "NASDAQ", orderId: "ord-84133", fee: 0.86 },
  { id: "f05", time: "14:30:49", symbol: "AMZN", side: "sell", qty: 150, price: 186.12, resolveMs: 2600, outcome: "filled", venue: "EDGX", orderId: "ord-84139", fee: 1.12 },
  { id: "f06", time: "14:31:04", symbol: "META", side: "buy", qty: 60, price: 512.3, resolveMs: 2200, outcome: "filled", venue: "NASDAQ", orderId: "ord-84142", fee: 0.77 },
  { id: "f07", time: "14:31:19", symbol: "SPY", side: "sell", qty: 300, price: 549.66, resolveMs: 2800, outcome: "filled", venue: "ARCA", orderId: "ord-84150", fee: 4.12 },
  { id: "f08", time: "14:31:35", symbol: "COIN", side: "buy", qty: 40, price: 231.09, resolveMs: 3200, outcome: "rejected", venue: "MEMX", orderId: "ord-84154", fee: 0 },
  { id: "f09", time: "14:31:52", symbol: "GOOG", side: "buy", qty: 90, price: 176.44, resolveMs: 2200, outcome: "filled", venue: "NASDAQ", orderId: "ord-84158", fee: 0.63 },
  { id: "f10", time: "14:32:08", symbol: "AMD", side: "sell", qty: 220, price: 158.9, resolveMs: 2600, outcome: "filled", venue: "BATS", orderId: "ord-84163", fee: 1.4 },
  { id: "f11", time: "14:32:24", symbol: "NFLX", side: "buy", qty: 25, price: 689.75, resolveMs: 2400, outcome: "filled", venue: "IEX", orderId: "ord-84169", fee: 0.51 },
  { id: "f12", time: "14:32:41", symbol: "QQQ", side: "sell", qty: 180, price: 481.23, resolveMs: 3000, outcome: "rejected", venue: "EDGX", orderId: "ord-84174", fee: 0 },
  { id: "f13", time: "14:32:57", symbol: "PLTR", side: "buy", qty: 500, price: 28.64, resolveMs: 2000, outcome: "filled", venue: "MEMX", orderId: "ord-84180", fee: 1.9 },
  { id: "f14", time: "14:33:12", symbol: "ORCL", side: "sell", qty: 110, price: 141.37, resolveMs: 2600, outcome: "filled", venue: "NYSE", orderId: "ord-84186", fee: 0.94 },
]

const COLS = "56px minmax(0,1fr) 40px 52px 72px 76px"
const SEED = 8 // rows already resolved on screen at load, enough to fill the list
const ROW_H = 40
/** the list holds 7.5 rows, so the half row at the bottom says there is more */
const LIST_H = 300
const DAY_BASE = 18 // fills settled before the visible window (count = DAY_BASE + seed + streamed)
const MAX_ROWS = 18
/** the soft fade at the bottom edge, and at the top once the list is scrolled */
const edgeFade = (top: boolean) =>
  `linear-gradient(180deg, ${top ? "transparent 0, black 26px" : "black 0"}, black calc(100% - 26px), transparent 100%)`
/** the detail fades out at the right edge of a narrow symbol column instead of being cut */
const DETAIL_FADE = "linear-gradient(90deg, black calc(100% - 16px), transparent)"

const sideColor = (s: FillEvent["side"]) => (s === "buy" ? GREEN : RED)
const tint = (c: string, pct = 10) => `color-mix(in srgb, ${c} ${pct}%, transparent)`
const STATUS_WORD: Record<Status, string> = { working: "Working", filled: "Filled", rejected: "Rejected" }

/** the status as a word; a flip is a text swap in place, 4px out of a 2px blur over 150ms
    (the row never remounts). Filled is green, rejected red, working muted with an amber dot */
function StatusWord({ status, frozen }: { status: Status; frozen: boolean }) {
  return (
    <span className="flex justify-end">
      <motion.span
        key={status}
        initial={frozen ? false : { opacity: 0, y: 4, filter: "blur(2px)" }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, filter: "blur(0px)" }}
        transition={frozen ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
        className={cn("inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium", status === "working" && "text-foreground/45")}
        style={status === "rejected" ? { color: RED } : status === "filled" ? { color: GREEN } : undefined}
      >
        {status === "working" && (
          <motion.span
            aria-hidden
            className="h-[5px] w-[5px] rounded-full"
            style={{ background: AMBER }}
            animate={frozen ? undefined : { opacity: [1, 0.3, 1] }}
            transition={{ duration: 1.1, repeat: Infinity, ease: "easeInOut" }}
          />
        )}
        {STATUS_WORD[status]}
      </motion.span>
    </span>
  )
}

function FillRow({ row, hovered, dim, onHover, frozen }: { row: Row; hovered: boolean; dim: boolean; onHover: (key: string | null) => void; frozen: boolean }) {
  const { ev, status } = row
  const side = sideColor(ev.side)
  const flashColor = status === "rejected" ? RED : GREEN
  return (
    <motion.div
      layout={frozen ? false : "position"}
      initial={frozen ? false : { opacity: 0, y: -8 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
      transition={frozen ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.4, ease: EASE }}
      className="relative border-b border-foreground/[0.05] outline-none focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.06]"
      role="row"
      tabIndex={0}
      aria-label={`${ev.time} ${ev.side} ${ev.qty.toLocaleString("en-US")} ${ev.symbol} at ${ev.price.toFixed(2)}, ${STATUS_WORD[status]}, ${ev.venue}, ${ev.orderId}, fee $${ev.fee.toFixed(2)}`}
      onPointerEnter={() => onHover(row.key)}
      onFocus={() => onHover(row.key)}
      onBlur={() => onHover(null)}
    >
      {/* the flash on a status flip: opacity keyframes over a still tint, no remount */}
      <motion.span
        aria-hidden
        className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0"
        style={{ background: tint(flashColor, 9) }}
        initial={false}
        animate={status}
        variants={{
          working: { opacity: 0 },
          filled: frozen ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: [0, 1, 0], transition: { duration: 0.4, ease: "easeOut" } },
          rejected: frozen ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: [0, 1, 0], transition: { duration: 0.4, ease: "easeOut" } },
        }}
      />
      <motion.div
        initial={false}
        animate={status}
        variants={{
          working: { x: 0 },
          filled: { x: 0 },
          rejected: frozen ? { x: 0 } : { x: [0, -3, 3, -2, 2, 0], transition: { duration: 0.35 } },
        }}
        className="transition-colors duration-150 hover:bg-foreground/[0.03]"
      >
        {/* the grid owns the dim, so it never fights the entrance or the shake around it */}
        <div className="grid items-center gap-3 px-3 transition-opacity duration-200" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: COLS, height: ROW_H - 1, opacity: dim ? 0.45 : 1 }}>
          <span role="cell" className="text-[11px] text-foreground/45">
            {ev.time}
          </span>
          {/* the pointed row reads its venue, order id and fee in place, after the symbol: no
              row moves (2026-10-02 audit); the extras swap in (4px, 2px blur, 150ms) */}
          <span role="cell" className="flex min-w-0 items-baseline gap-3 whitespace-nowrap">
            <span className="shrink-0 text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-foreground/90">{ev.symbol}</span>
            <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
              {hovered && (
                <motion.span
                  key="detail"
                  data-detail
                  aria-hidden
                  className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-baseline gap-3 overflow-hidden text-[10.5px] text-foreground/60"
                  style={{ maskImage: DETAIL_FADE, WebkitMaskImage: DETAIL_FADE }}
                  initial={frozen ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: 4, filter: "blur(2px)" }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, filter: "blur(0px)" }}
                  exit={{ opacity: 0, transition: { duration: 0.1 } }}
                  transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
                >
                  <span className="shrink-0">{ev.venue}</span>
                  <span className="shrink-0">fee ${ev.fee.toFixed(2)}</span>
                  <span className="shrink-0">{ev.orderId}</span>
                </motion.span>
              )}
            </AnimatePresence>
          </span>
          <span role="cell" className="text-[11px] font-medium" style={{ color: side }}>
            {ev.side === "buy" ? "Buy" : "Sell"}
          </span>
          <span role="cell" className="text-right text-[12px] text-foreground/90">
            {ev.qty.toLocaleString("en-US")}
          </span>
          <span role="cell" className="text-right text-[12px] text-foreground/90">
            {ev.price.toFixed(2)}
          </span>
          <span role="cell">
            <StatusWord status={status} frozen={frozen} />
          </span>
        </div>
      </motion.div>
    </motion.div>
  )
}

/**
 * Streaming order-fills table in the Ink register. New fills enter at the top with a
 * slide-down that pushes older rows down, arrive as working with a pulsing dot, then
 * resolve in place to filled (a brief green ground) or rejected (red, a brief shake)
 * after a deterministic per-event delay. The list is a fixed height with a soft fade at
 * the bottom; pointing at a row dims the rest, reads its venue, fee and order id in place
 * and holds the arrivals so the row never moves. The feed is a fixed event array replayed
 * on an interval while the table is pointed at (or pinned on from the header), and still
 * under reduced motion unless pinned on. The "today" count, in the aria-label, is derivable: settled before the
 * window, plus the seeded rows, plus every arrival since.
 */
export function FillsBlotter({
  title = "Fills",
  events = DEFAULT_EVENTS,
  intervalMs = 1800,
  className,
}: {
  title?: string
  events?: FillEvent[]
  /** ms between arrivals */
  intervalMs?: number
  className?: string
}) {
  const frozen = (useReducedMotion() ?? false) || isSnapshot()
  const seedCount = Math.min(SEED, events.length)
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<Row[]>(() =>
    events
      .slice(0, seedCount)
      .map((ev): Row => ({ key: ev.id, ev, status: ev.outcome }))
      .reverse(),
  )
  const [streamed, setStreamed] = useState(0)
  const snapshot = isSnapshot()
  const pointed = usePointed()
  /* "auto" streams while pointed at, "on" is pinned by the toggle, "off" is paused by it
     until the pointer leaves (then it goes back to auto) */
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<"auto" | "on" | "off">("auto")
  const playing = !snapshot && (mode === "on" || (mode === "auto" && pointed.live && !frozen))
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!pointed.live && mode === "off") setMode("auto")
  }, [pointed.live, mode])
  const [hovered, setHovered] = useState<string | null>(null)
  /* reading a row holds the arrivals, so the row under the pointer never slides away */
  const streaming = playing && hovered === null
  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false)
  const ptrRef = useRef(seedCount)
  const timeoutsRef = useRef<Set<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>>(new Set())

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!streaming) return
    const iv = setInterval(() => {
      const ptr = ptrRef.current
      ptrRef.current += 1
      const ev = events[ptr % events.length]
      const key = `${ev.id}·${Math.floor(ptr / events.length)}`
      setRows((rs) => [{ key, ev, status: "working" as Status }, ...rs].slice(0, MAX_ROWS))
      setStreamed((n) => n + 1)
      const to = setTimeout(() => {
        timeoutsRef.current.delete(to)
        setRows((rs) => rs.map((r) => (r.key === key ? { ...r, status: ev.outcome } : r)))
      }, ev.resolveMs)
      timeoutsRef.current.add(to)
    }, intervalMs)
    return () => clearInterval(iv)
  }, [streaming, intervalMs, events])

  useEffect(() => {
    const pending = timeoutsRef.current
    return () => pending.forEach(clearTimeout)
  }, [])

  /* derivable: DAY_BASE settled earlier + seed rows + streamed arrivals */
  const today = DAY_BASE + seedCount + streamed

  return (
    <div
      ref={pointed.ref}
      {...pointed.bind}
      className={cn("w-full max-w-[640px] tabular-nums", className)}
      role="table"
      aria-label={`${title}, ${today} today: ${DAY_BASE} settled before this window, ${seedCount} seeded, ${streamed} arrived`}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-3 pb-3">
        <span className="text-[13px] font-medium text-foreground/90">{title}</span>
        {/* live-toggle.tsx, the tape family's toggle; its signal moves only while fills land */}
        <span className="-mr-2">
          <LiveToggle
            live={playing}
            onLiveChange={(next) => setMode(next ? "on" : "off")}
            animate={streaming}
            aria-label={playing ? "Live, press to pause the feed" : "Paused, press to play the feed"}
          />
        </span>
      </div>
      <div role="row" className="grid gap-3 border-b border-foreground/[0.05] px-3 pb-2 text-[10.5px] text-foreground/45" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: COLS }}>
        <span role="columnheader">Time</span>
        <span role="columnheader">Symbol</span>
        <span role="columnheader">Side</span>
        <span role="columnheader" className="text-right">
          Qty
        </span>
        <span role="columnheader" className="text-right">
          Price
        </span>
        <span role="columnheader" className="text-right">
          Status
        </span>
      </div>
      {/* a fixed height with no scrollbar: arrivals never grow the table or narrow its columns */}
      <div
        role="rowgroup"
        className="no-scrollbar relative overflow-y-auto [scrollbar-width:none] [&::-webkit-scrollbar]:hidden"
        onPointerLeave={() => setHovered(null)}
        onScroll={(e) => setScrolled(e.currentTarget.scrollTop > 2)}
        /* scrollbarWidth inline too: a host page with an unlayered global scrollbar rule (this site's
           index.css) beats the utility, and a scrollbar showed on the browse wall (his call, 2026-10-02) */
        style={{ height: LIST_H, overflowAnchor: "none", scrollbarWidth: "none", WebkitMaskImage: edgeFade(scrolled), maskImage: edgeFade(scrolled) }}
      >
        <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
          {rows.map((row) => (
            <FillRow key={row.key} row={row} hovered={hovered === row.key} dim={hovered !== null && hovered !== row.key} onHover={setHovered} frozen={frozen} />
          ))}
        </AnimatePresence>
        {/* bottom breathing room so the last row clears the mask fade */}
        <div className="h-5" />
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

```tsx
"use client"

import { createContext, useContext, type ReactNode } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { THUMB } from "@/components/ui/control-classes"

/* Live Toggle: the one play and pause control of the streaming components (Tape Flow,
   Trade Tape, Fills Blotter, New Items Pill).
   2026-10-02 round 2: his call, "I don't like the green dot in there, I feel like it should
   be better design ... still minimal. Give me a couple of options". Four options, all in
   ink on the control material, none with a dot, each a fixed width so the control never
   resizes between its two states:
   · a  Bars   a 28px pill; while live three thin bars rise and fall out of phase
              like an equaliser beside "Live"; paused, a filled play mark beside "Paused"
   · b  Line   a 28px pill; a hairline under the label carries a short glint gliding along it
              while live, a pause mark says what a press does; paused, a play mark
   · c  Morph  (default, his pick 2026-10-02) icon only, 28px round; the play mark morphs into the two pause bars, which
              breathe in turn while live
   · d  Word   text only; "Live" breathes in its letter weight (a variable font eases it,
              a static one steps), "Paused" sits still at /60
   Live takes the THUMB fill and full ink; paused is bare ink at /60 with a faint fill under
   the pointer. The label swaps in place (4px, 2px blur, 150ms). The signal moves only while
   `animate` is true (data is actually flowing) and never under reduced motion. Motion is
   transform only for a, b and c; d animates the weight. A page switches every toggle below
   it with <LiveToggleVariant variant="c">. */

export type LiveToggleVariantName = "a" | "b" | "c" | "d"

const VariantContext = createContext<LiveToggleVariantName>("c")

/** sets the look of every LiveToggle below it that does not name its own variant */
export function LiveToggleVariant({ variant, children }: { variant: LiveToggleVariantName; children: ReactNode }) {
  return <VariantContext.Provider value={variant}>{children}</VariantContext.Provider>
}

/** the variant in force here (the nearest LiveToggleVariant, or "c") */
export const useLiveToggleVariant = () => useContext(VariantContext)

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const

/** fixed widths: the longer label ("Paused") plus its mark and 12px sides */
const WIDTH: Record<LiveToggleVariantName, number> = { a: 88, b: 88, c: 28, d: 68 }

/* keyframes for the signals; each toggle carries the same small rule set */
const KEYFRAMES = `
@keyframes lt-eq { 0%, 100% { transform: scaleY(0.35) } 50% { transform: scaleY(1) } }
@keyframes lt-glint { 0% { transform: translateX(-100%) } 100% { transform: translateX(300%) } }
@keyframes lt-breathe { 0%, 100% { transform: scaleY(1) } 50% { transform: scaleY(0.62) } }
@keyframes lt-weight { 0%, 100% { font-weight: 460 } 50% { font-weight: 640 } }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .lt-sig { animation: none !important } }
`

const PILL =
  "relative inline-flex h-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[11px] outline-none transition-[color,background-color,scale] duration-150 focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.08] active:scale-[0.97] motion-reduce:active:scale-100"
const ON = `${THUMB} text-foreground/90`
const OFF = "text-foreground/60 hover:bg-foreground/[0.04] hover:text-foreground/90"

function PlayMark() {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 12 12" width={10} height={10} aria-hidden>
      <path d="M3.2 1.8 L10.2 6 L3.2 10.2 Z" fill="currentColor" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={1.2} strokeLinejoin="round" />
    </svg>
  )
}

function PauseMark() {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 12 12" width={10} height={10} aria-hidden>
      <rect x={2.6} y={2} width={2.4} height={8} rx={0.8} fill="currentColor" />
      <rect x={7} y={2} width={2.4} height={8} rx={0.8} fill="currentColor" />
    </svg>
  )
}

/** a: three 2px bars out of phase, the equaliser of something playing */
function Bars({ moving }: { moving: boolean }) {
  const bars = [
    { d: 1.05, delay: 0, rest: 0.55 },
    { d: 0.85, delay: -0.35, rest: 1 },
    { d: 1.25, delay: -0.7, rest: 0.7 },
  ]
  return (
    <span aria-hidden className="flex h-[10px] items-center gap-[2px]">
      {bars.map((b, i) => (
        <span
          key={i}
          className="lt-sig block h-full w-[2px] rounded-full bg-current"
          style={
            moving
              ? { animation: `lt-eq ${b.d}s ease-in-out ${b.delay}s infinite`, transformOrigin: "center" }
              : { transform: `scaleY(${b.rest})`, transition: "transform 250ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)" }
          }
        />
      ))}
    </span>
  )
}

/* c: play and pause drawn as the same two four-point shapes, so one morphs into the other.
   Points run top left, top right, bottom right, bottom left. */
const quad = (p: number[]) => `M${p[0]} ${p[1]} L${p[2]} ${p[3]} L${p[4]} ${p[5]} L${p[6]} ${p[7]} Z`
const PAUSE_L = quad([2.6, 2, 5, 2, 5, 10, 2.6, 10])
const PAUSE_R = quad([7, 2, 9.4, 2, 9.4, 10, 7, 10])
const PLAY_L = quad([3.2, 1.8, 7, 4.08, 7, 7.92, 3.2, 10.2])
const PLAY_R = quad([6.9, 4.02, 10.2, 6, 10.2, 6, 6.9, 7.98])

function Morph({ live, moving, reduced }: { live: boolean; moving: boolean; reduced: boolean }) {
  const t = reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.25, ease: EASE }
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 12 12" width={12} height={12} aria-hidden className="overflow-visible">
      {[
        { on: PAUSE_L, off: PLAY_L, delay: 0 },
        { on: PAUSE_R, off: PLAY_R, delay: -0.7 },
      ].map((s, i) => (
        <g
          key={i}
          className="lt-sig"
          style={{
            transformBox: "fill-box",
            transformOrigin: "center",
            animation: live && moving ? `lt-breathe 1.4s ease-in-out ${s.delay}s infinite` : undefined,
          }}
        >
          <motion.path initial={false} animate={{ d: live ? s.on : s.off }} transition={t} fill="currentColor" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={0.6} strokeLinejoin="round" />
        </g>
      ))}
    </svg>
  )
}

/** the label, swapped in place inside the fixed width */
function Label({ text, reduced, style, className }: { text: string; reduced: boolean; style?: React.CSSProperties; className?: string }) {
  return (
    <motion.span
      key={text}
      initial={reduced ? false : { opacity: 0, y: 4, filter: "blur(2px)" }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, filter: "blur(0px)" }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
      className={cn("whitespace-nowrap", className)}
      style={style}
    >
      {text}
    </motion.span>
  )
}

/** a mark that swaps through a 0.6 scale and a fade (150ms) */
function Swap({ k, children, reduced }: { k: string; children: ReactNode; reduced: boolean }) {
  return (
    <span aria-hidden className="relative grid h-3 w-3 shrink-0 place-items-center">
      <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
        <motion.span
          key={k}
          className="absolute inset-0 grid place-items-center"
          initial={reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, scale: 0.6 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
          exit={reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, scale: 0.6 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
        >
          {children}
        </motion.span>
      </AnimatePresence>
    </span>
  )
}

export interface LiveToggleProps {
  /** the feed is on */
  live: boolean
  onLiveChange: (next: boolean) => void
  /** the look; defaults to the nearest LiveToggleVariant, then "c" */
  variant?: LiveToggleVariantName
  /** the signal moves only while data is actually flowing; defaults to `live` */
  animate?: boolean
  labels?: { on: string; off: string }
  /** a fixed width in px, when the labels are longer than the defaults */
  width?: number
  "aria-label"?: string
  className?: string
}

/**
 * The live control of a streaming component: a press pauses the feed or plays it. Four
 * looks share one API (see the header); none of them changes width between states.
 */
export function LiveToggle({
  live,
  onLiveChange,
  variant,
  animate,
  labels = { on: "Live", off: "Paused" },
  width,
  "aria-label": ariaLabel,
  className,
}: LiveToggleProps) {
  const fromContext = useContext(VariantContext)
  const v = variant ?? fromContext
  const reduced = useReducedMotion() ?? false
  const moving = (animate ?? live) && !reduced
  const text = live ? labels.on : labels.off
  const w = width ?? WIDTH[v]

  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      aria-pressed={live}
      aria-label={ariaLabel ?? (live ? `${labels.on}, press to pause` : `${labels.off}, press to play`)}
      onClick={() => onLiveChange(!live)}
      className={cn(PILL, v !== "c" && "gap-1.5 px-3", live ? ON : OFF, className)}
      style={{ width: w }}
    >
      {/* inline, not hoisted: a preview frame or a shadow root gets its own copy */}
      <style>{KEYFRAMES}</style>

      {v === "a" && (
        <>
          <Swap k={live ? "bars" : "play"} reduced={reduced}>
            {live ? <Bars moving={moving} /> : <PlayMark />}
          </Swap>
          <Label text={text} reduced={reduced} />
        </>
      )}

      {v === "b" && (
        <>
          <Swap k={live ? "pause" : "play"} reduced={reduced}>
            {live ? <PauseMark /> : <PlayMark />}
          </Swap>
          <Label text={text} reduced={reduced} />
          {/* the hairline sits inside the straight run of the bottom edge, clear of the round ends */}
          <span aria-hidden className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-3 bottom-[4px] h-px overflow-hidden rounded-full">
            <span
              className="absolute inset-0 bg-current transition-opacity duration-200"
              style={{ opacity: live ? 0.12 : 0 }}
            />
            {moving && (
              <span
                className="lt-sig absolute inset-y-0 left-0 w-1/3 rounded-full"
                style={{
                  background: "linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, currentColor, transparent)",
                  opacity: 0.7,
                  animation: "lt-glint 1.8s cubic-bezier(0.45, 0, 0.55, 1) infinite",
                }}
              />
            )}
          </span>
        </>
      )}

      {v === "c" && <Morph live={live} moving={moving} reduced={reduced} />}

      {v === "d" && (
        <Label
          text={text}
          reduced={reduced}
          className="lt-sig"
          style={live && moving ? { animation: "lt-weight 2.4s ease-in-out infinite" } : { fontWeight: live ? 560 : 500 }}
        />
      )}
    </button>
  )
}
```

// ─── components/ui/use-pointed.ts ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react"

/* usePointed: live content runs only while it is being looked at (his call, 2026-10-02:
   "it should start animating only when you start hovering on it; anything with numbers
   that change can start once you hover on the component"). Spread `bind` on the
   component's root; `live` is true while the pointer is on it or focus is inside it, and
   stays true for `linger` ms after it leaves so a pass across the edge does not stop and
   start the feed. On a device with no hover (touch) it is true while the component is at
   least half in view instead, since a finger cannot point without pressing. */
export function usePointed<T extends HTMLElement = HTMLDivElement>({ linger = 600 } = {}) {
  const ref = useRef<T>(null)
  const [pointed, setPointed] = useState(false)
  const [seen, setSeen] = useState(false)
  const [touch] = useState(() => typeof matchMedia === "function" && !matchMedia("(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)").matches)
  const timer = useRef<number | undefined>(undefined)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!touch || !ref.current || typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined") return
    const io = new IntersectionObserver(([e]) => setSeen(e.isIntersecting), { threshold: 0.5 })
    io.observe(ref.current)
    return () => io.disconnect()
  }, [touch])
  useEffect(() => () => window.clearTimeout(timer.current), [])

  const on = () => {
    window.clearTimeout(timer.current)
    setPointed(true)
  }
  const off = () => {
    window.clearTimeout(timer.current)
    timer.current = window.setTimeout(() => setPointed(false), linger)
  }

  return {
    ref,
    live: touch ? seen : pointed,
    bind: {
      onPointerEnter: on,
      onPointerLeave: off,
      onFocus: on,
      onBlur: (e: React.FocusEvent) => {
        if (!e.currentTarget.contains(e.relatedTarget as Node | null)) off()
      },
    },
  }
}
```

# Trade Tape (trade-tape)
> A live time and sales tape for trading terminals, streaming prints coloured by side and sized by volume, with block trades highlighted.

// ─── components/ui/trade-tape.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { LiveToggle } from "@/components/ui/live-toggle"
import { usePointed } from "@/components/ui/use-pointed"

/* Trade Tape, rebuilt through the ssych-component skill (2026-09-29).
   What changed against the version before it (in git history), and why:
   · no card, outline or inner shadow: the tape sits on the page. `flush` stays as a prop and
     now only lifts the width cap, since there is no card left to drop
   · the clock is a fixed session clock that steps with each print, so two mounts print the
     same times (it read the wall clock before)
   · sentence case: the symbol, the column heads and the block mark are no longer set in
     capitals or letter-spaced
   · pointing at a print keeps it full and dims the rest
   · the tape names itself to a screen reader, every figure is tabular
   2026-10-02 audit: his call reversed the hover. The tape rests on its seeded prints and
   streams only while the pointer is on it (usePointed); it used to stream from mount and
   pause on hover. The text Pause button and the "Paused, 3 waiting" word that changed width
   became one IconToggle at a fixed width, the same as Tape Flow's: a pulsing green dot
   reading "Live", a filled play mark reading "Play"; it pins the feed on, or pauses it while
   the pointer stays. No prints queue any more, since a stopped feed prints nothing. The
   "Trade tape" title is gone (the name is in the aria-label) and the symbol reads 12px /90;
   heads are 10.5px /45, the time /45, the block mark 9.5px. The width is 440, shared with
   Tape Flow, its family.
   2026-10-02 round 2: his note on the Live control, no green dot. The toggle is the shared
   LiveToggle (live-toggle.tsx), the same as Tape Flow's, in ink without a dot, its look
   picked by the LiveToggleVariant around it; it pins and pauses the feed as before.
   Formulas:
   · a print's price  = the price before × (1 ± r × 0.035%), up on a buy, down on a sell
   · block            a print of 10 × the median size (120) or more
   · edge bar         opacity 25% + size ÷ (6 × median), at most 100% */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GREEN = "var(--chart-up)"
const RED = "var(--chart-down)"

type Print = { id: number; t: string; price: number; size: number; side: "buy" | "sell"; block: boolean }

const MAX_ROWS = 12
const MEDIAN = 120
/** the session clock the first print is stamped with, in seconds: 14:30:00 */
const CLOCK_START = 14 * 3600 + 30 * 60

function mulberry32(seed: number) {
  return () => {
    seed |= 0
    seed = (seed + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0
    let t = Math.imul(seed ^ (seed >>> 15), 1 | seed)
    t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296
  }
}

const two = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, "0")
const stamp = (sec: number) => {
  const s = sec % 86400
  return `${two(Math.floor(s / 3600))}:${two(Math.floor((s % 3600) / 60))}:${two(s % 60)}`
}

/** a print from the host's own feed (2026-10-06): time in ms since epoch, newest first */
export type TapePrint = { id: number | string; time: number; price: number; size: number; side: "buy" | "sell" }

export interface TradeTapeProps {
  /** real prints, newest first (2026-10-06): given, the tape shows them instead of its seeded
   *  walk and the live toggle leaves, since the host owns the feed. Blocks are ten times the
   *  feed's own median size */
  feed?: TapePrint[]
  /** places the size is written to; 0 for whole shares, more for crypto */
  sizeDp?: number
  symbol?: string
  /** the price the seeded walk starts from */
  base?: number
  priceDp?: number
  /** lift the width cap, so the tape fills whatever pane holds it */
  flush?: boolean
  /** take the pane's full height; the row count answers to it, so prints reach the bottom edge */
  fill?: boolean
  /** show the symbol beside the toggle; false when the host already names the pane */
  label?: boolean
  /** start with the feed pinned on; at rest (false) it streams only while pointed at */
  initialLive?: boolean
  className?: string
}

/**
 * Live time and sales. Prints stream in at the top while the tape is pointed at, coloured
 * by the aggressor and weighed by a thin bar at the edge; block trades of ten times the
 * median or more get a faint ground across the row. Pointing at a print dims the rest.
 * Demo feed, seeded, so two mounts print the same walk.
 */
export function TradeTape({
  feed,
  sizeDp = 0,
  symbol = "AAPL",
  base = 228.02,
  priceDp = 2,
  flush = false,
  fill = false,
  label = true,
  initialLive = false,
  className,
}: TradeTapeProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const pointed = usePointed()
  const [hot, setHot] = useState<number | null>(null)
  /* "auto" streams while pointed at, "on" is pinned by the toggle, "off" is paused by it
     until the pointer leaves (then it goes back to auto) */
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<"auto" | "on" | "off">(initialLive ? "on" : "auto")
  const live = mode === "on" || (mode === "auto" && pointed.live)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!pointed.live && mode === "off") setMode("auto")
  }, [pointed.live, mode])
  const idRef = useRef(1)
  const clockRef = useRef(CLOCK_START)
  const priceRef = useRef(base)

  /* one generator for the whole life of the tape, so a taller pane never restarts the price */
  const makeRef = useRef<(() => Print) | null>(null)
  if (!makeRef.current) {
    const rand = mulberry32(47)
    makeRef.current = () => {
      const side: "buy" | "sell" = rand() > 0.5 ? "buy" : "sell"
      priceRef.current = +(priceRef.current * (1 + (side === "buy" ? 1 : -1) * rand() * 0.00035)).toFixed(priceDp)
      const block = rand() < 0.06
      const size = block ? Math.round(MEDIAN * (10 + rand() * 25)) : Math.round(8 + rand() * rand() * 340)
      const id = idRef.current++
      /* the clock steps one to three seconds a print, by the print's number */
      clockRef.current += 1 + (id % 3)
      return { id, t: stamp(clockRef.current), price: priceRef.current, size, side, block }
    }
  }
  /* the seeded prints are there from the first frame: the still state at rest */
  const [prints, setPrints] = useState<Print[]>(() => Array.from({ length: MAX_ROWS }, makeRef.current!).reverse())
  /** the seeded batch rises in once, 35ms apart for the first 8; after that every print
   *  lands alone and the hover dim answers without a delay */
  const [intro, setIntro] = useState(true)
  useEffect(() => {
    const t = setTimeout(() => setIntro(false), 600)
    return () => clearTimeout(t)
  }, [])

  /* fill mode: the list is a flex-1 box, so its height is the pane's; measure it
     and one row, and the row count falls out of height ÷ rowHeight */
  const listRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const [rows, setRows] = useState(MAX_ROWS)
  const rowsRef = useRef(MAX_ROWS)
  rowsRef.current = rows
  const seeded = prints.length > 0
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const box = listRef.current
    if (!fill || !box || !seeded || typeof ResizeObserver === "undefined") return
    const measure = () => {
      const rowH = (box.firstElementChild as HTMLElement | null)?.getBoundingClientRect().height ?? 0
      if (!rowH) return
      /* floor, so every print on screen is a whole one */
      setRows(Math.max(4, Math.floor(box.clientHeight / rowH)))
    }
    measure()
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(measure)
    ro.observe(box)
    return () => ro.disconnect()
  }, [fill, seeded])

  useEffect(() => {
    const make = makeRef.current
    if (!make || !live) return
    const id = setInterval(() => setPrints((prev) => [make(), ...prev].slice(0, rowsRef.current)), reduced ? 2200 : 700)
    return () => clearInterval(id)
  }, [live, reduced])

  /* a taller pane asks for more prints than the tape holds: top up at the old end */
  useEffect(() => {
    const make = makeRef.current
    if (!make) return
    setPrints((prev) => (prev.length >= rows ? prev.slice(0, rows) : [...prev, ...Array.from({ length: rows - prev.length }, make)]))
  }, [rows])

  /* the host's feed, when given: its own median sets the block size and the weight bars */
  const sizes = feed ? [...feed.map((f) => f.size)].sort((a, b) => a - b) : []
  const median = feed ? sizes[Math.floor(sizes.length / 2)] || 1 : MEDIAN
  const shown: Print[] = feed
    ? feed.slice(0, rows).map((f, i) => ({
        id: typeof f.id === "number" ? f.id : i + 1,
        t: new Date(f.time).toLocaleTimeString("en-GB", { hour12: false }),
        price: f.price,
        size: f.size,
        side: f.side,
        block: f.size >= median * 10,
      }))
    : prints

  return (
    <div
      ref={pointed.ref}
      {...pointed.bind}
      className={cn("w-full overflow-hidden tabular-nums", fill && "flex h-full min-h-0 flex-col", !flush && "max-w-[440px]", className)}
      role="group"
      aria-label={`Trade tape, ${symbol}${shown[0] ? `, last ${shown[0].price.toFixed(priceDp)}` : ""}${feed ? "" : `, ${live ? "live" : "paused"}`}`}
      onPointerLeave={() => {
        pointed.bind.onPointerLeave()
        setHot(null)
      }}
    >
      <div className={cn("flex shrink-0 items-center px-3 pb-2", label ? "justify-between" : "justify-end")}>
        {label && <span className="text-[12px] font-medium text-foreground/90">{symbol}</span>}
        {/* live-toggle.tsx, the same toggle as Tape Flow: ink only, one fixed width */}
        {!feed && (
          <span className="-mr-2">
            <LiveToggle live={live} onLiveChange={(next) => setMode(next ? "on" : "off")} />
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="grid shrink-0 grid-cols-3 border-b border-foreground/[0.05] px-3 pb-1.5 text-[10.5px] text-foreground/45">
        <span>Time</span>
        <span className="text-right">Price</span>
        <span className="text-right">Size</span>
      </div>

      <div ref={listRef} className={fill ? "min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-hidden" : "pt-1"} role="log" aria-label={`${symbol} prints`} aria-live="off">
        <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
          {shown.map((p, i) => {
            const hue = p.side === "buy" ? GREEN : RED
            const dim = hot !== null && hot !== p.id
            const delay = intro ? Math.min(i, 7) * 0.035 : 0
            return (
              <motion.div
                key={p.id}
                layout={!reduced}
                initial={reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: -8 }}
                animate={{ opacity: dim ? 0.45 : 1, y: 0 }}
                transition={
                  reduced
                    ? { duration: 0.15, delay }
                    : { duration: 0.28, ease: EASE, delay, opacity: { duration: 0.18, ease: EASE, delay } }
                }
                onPointerEnter={() => setHot(p.id)}
                className="relative grid grid-cols-3 items-center px-3 py-[3px] text-[10.5px]"
                style={p.block ? { background: `color-mix(in srgb, ${hue} 8%, transparent)` } : undefined}
              >
                {/* the print's weight: the same hue, stronger for a larger size */}
                <span aria-hidden className="absolute inset-y-[2px] left-0 w-[2px] rounded-full" style={{ background: hue, opacity: Math.min(1, 0.25 + p.size / (median * 6)) }} />
                <span className="text-foreground/45">{p.t}</span>
                <span className="text-right" style={{ color: hue }}>
                  {p.price.toFixed(priceDp)}
                </span>
                <span className={cn("text-right", p.block ? "font-semibold text-foreground/90" : "text-foreground/60")}>
                  {p.size.toLocaleString("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: sizeDp, maximumFractionDigits: sizeDp })}
                  {p.block && (
                    <span className="ms-1 text-[9.5px] font-medium" style={{ color: hue }}>
                      block
                    </span>
                  )}
                </span>
              </motion.div>
            )
          })}
        </AnimatePresence>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

// ─── components/ui/live-toggle.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { createContext, useContext, type ReactNode } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { THUMB } from "@/components/ui/control-classes"

/* Live Toggle: the one play and pause control of the streaming components (Tape Flow,
   Trade Tape, Fills Blotter, New Items Pill).
   2026-10-02 round 2: his call, "I don't like the green dot in there, I feel like it should
   be better design ... still minimal. Give me a couple of options". Four options, all in
   ink on the control material, none with a dot, each a fixed width so the control never
   resizes between its two states:
   · a  Bars   a 28px pill; while live three thin bars rise and fall out of phase
              like an equaliser beside "Live"; paused, a filled play mark beside "Paused"
   · b  Line   a 28px pill; a hairline under the label carries a short glint gliding along it
              while live, a pause mark says what a press does; paused, a play mark
   · c  Morph  (default, his pick 2026-10-02) icon only, 28px round; the play mark morphs into the two pause bars, which
              breathe in turn while live
   · d  Word   text only; "Live" breathes in its letter weight (a variable font eases it,
              a static one steps), "Paused" sits still at /60
   Live takes the THUMB fill and full ink; paused is bare ink at /60 with a faint fill under
   the pointer. The label swaps in place (4px, 2px blur, 150ms). The signal moves only while
   `animate` is true (data is actually flowing) and never under reduced motion. Motion is
   transform only for a, b and c; d animates the weight. A page switches every toggle below
   it with <LiveToggleVariant variant="c">. */

export type LiveToggleVariantName = "a" | "b" | "c" | "d"

const VariantContext = createContext<LiveToggleVariantName>("c")

/** sets the look of every LiveToggle below it that does not name its own variant */
export function LiveToggleVariant({ variant, children }: { variant: LiveToggleVariantName; children: ReactNode }) {
  return <VariantContext.Provider value={variant}>{children}</VariantContext.Provider>
}

/** the variant in force here (the nearest LiveToggleVariant, or "c") */
export const useLiveToggleVariant = () => useContext(VariantContext)

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const

/** fixed widths: the longer label ("Paused") plus its mark and 12px sides */
const WIDTH: Record<LiveToggleVariantName, number> = { a: 88, b: 88, c: 28, d: 68 }

/* keyframes for the signals; each toggle carries the same small rule set */
const KEYFRAMES = `
@keyframes lt-eq { 0%, 100% { transform: scaleY(0.35) } 50% { transform: scaleY(1) } }
@keyframes lt-glint { 0% { transform: translateX(-100%) } 100% { transform: translateX(300%) } }
@keyframes lt-breathe { 0%, 100% { transform: scaleY(1) } 50% { transform: scaleY(0.62) } }
@keyframes lt-weight { 0%, 100% { font-weight: 460 } 50% { font-weight: 640 } }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .lt-sig { animation: none !important } }
`

const PILL =
  "relative inline-flex h-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[11px] outline-none transition-[color,background-color,scale] duration-150 focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.08] active:scale-[0.97] motion-reduce:active:scale-100"
const ON = `${THUMB} text-foreground/90`
const OFF = "text-foreground/60 hover:bg-foreground/[0.04] hover:text-foreground/90"

function PlayMark() {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 12 12" width={10} height={10} aria-hidden>
      <path d="M3.2 1.8 L10.2 6 L3.2 10.2 Z" fill="currentColor" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={1.2} strokeLinejoin="round" />
    </svg>
  )
}

function PauseMark() {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 12 12" width={10} height={10} aria-hidden>
      <rect x={2.6} y={2} width={2.4} height={8} rx={0.8} fill="currentColor" />
      <rect x={7} y={2} width={2.4} height={8} rx={0.8} fill="currentColor" />
    </svg>
  )
}

/** a: three 2px bars out of phase, the equaliser of something playing */
function Bars({ moving }: { moving: boolean }) {
  const bars = [
    { d: 1.05, delay: 0, rest: 0.55 },
    { d: 0.85, delay: -0.35, rest: 1 },
    { d: 1.25, delay: -0.7, rest: 0.7 },
  ]
  return (
    <span aria-hidden className="flex h-[10px] items-center gap-[2px]">
      {bars.map((b, i) => (
        <span
          key={i}
          className="lt-sig block h-full w-[2px] rounded-full bg-current"
          style={
            moving
              ? { animation: `lt-eq ${b.d}s ease-in-out ${b.delay}s infinite`, transformOrigin: "center" }
              : { transform: `scaleY(${b.rest})`, transition: "transform 250ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)" }
          }
        />
      ))}
    </span>
  )
}

/* c: play and pause drawn as the same two four-point shapes, so one morphs into the other.
   Points run top left, top right, bottom right, bottom left. */
const quad = (p: number[]) => `M${p[0]} ${p[1]} L${p[2]} ${p[3]} L${p[4]} ${p[5]} L${p[6]} ${p[7]} Z`
const PAUSE_L = quad([2.6, 2, 5, 2, 5, 10, 2.6, 10])
const PAUSE_R = quad([7, 2, 9.4, 2, 9.4, 10, 7, 10])
const PLAY_L = quad([3.2, 1.8, 7, 4.08, 7, 7.92, 3.2, 10.2])
const PLAY_R = quad([6.9, 4.02, 10.2, 6, 10.2, 6, 6.9, 7.98])

function Morph({ live, moving, reduced }: { live: boolean; moving: boolean; reduced: boolean }) {
  const t = reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.25, ease: EASE }
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 12 12" width={12} height={12} aria-hidden className="overflow-visible">
      {[
        { on: PAUSE_L, off: PLAY_L, delay: 0 },
        { on: PAUSE_R, off: PLAY_R, delay: -0.7 },
      ].map((s, i) => (
        <g
          key={i}
          className="lt-sig"
          style={{
            transformBox: "fill-box",
            transformOrigin: "center",
            animation: live && moving ? `lt-breathe 1.4s ease-in-out ${s.delay}s infinite` : undefined,
          }}
        >
          <motion.path initial={false} animate={{ d: live ? s.on : s.off }} transition={t} fill="currentColor" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={0.6} strokeLinejoin="round" />
        </g>
      ))}
    </svg>
  )
}

/** the label, swapped in place inside the fixed width */
function Label({ text, reduced, style, className }: { text: string; reduced: boolean; style?: React.CSSProperties; className?: string }) {
  return (
    <motion.span
      key={text}
      initial={reduced ? false : { opacity: 0, y: 4, filter: "blur(2px)" }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, filter: "blur(0px)" }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
      className={cn("whitespace-nowrap", className)}
      style={style}
    >
      {text}
    </motion.span>
  )
}

/** a mark that swaps through a 0.6 scale and a fade (150ms) */
function Swap({ k, children, reduced }: { k: string; children: ReactNode; reduced: boolean }) {
  return (
    <span aria-hidden className="relative grid h-3 w-3 shrink-0 place-items-center">
      <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
        <motion.span
          key={k}
          className="absolute inset-0 grid place-items-center"
          initial={reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, scale: 0.6 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
          exit={reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, scale: 0.6 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
        >
          {children}
        </motion.span>
      </AnimatePresence>
    </span>
  )
}

export interface LiveToggleProps {
  /** the feed is on */
  live: boolean
  onLiveChange: (next: boolean) => void
  /** the look; defaults to the nearest LiveToggleVariant, then "c" */
  variant?: LiveToggleVariantName
  /** the signal moves only while data is actually flowing; defaults to `live` */
  animate?: boolean
  labels?: { on: string; off: string }
  /** a fixed width in px, when the labels are longer than the defaults */
  width?: number
  "aria-label"?: string
  className?: string
}

/**
 * The live control of a streaming component: a press pauses the feed or plays it. Four
 * looks share one API (see the header); none of them changes width between states.
 */
export function LiveToggle({
  live,
  onLiveChange,
  variant,
  animate,
  labels = { on: "Live", off: "Paused" },
  width,
  "aria-label": ariaLabel,
  className,
}: LiveToggleProps) {
  const fromContext = useContext(VariantContext)
  const v = variant ?? fromContext
  const reduced = useReducedMotion() ?? false
  const moving = (animate ?? live) && !reduced
  const text = live ? labels.on : labels.off
  const w = width ?? WIDTH[v]

  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      aria-pressed={live}
      aria-label={ariaLabel ?? (live ? `${labels.on}, press to pause` : `${labels.off}, press to play`)}
      onClick={() => onLiveChange(!live)}
      className={cn(PILL, v !== "c" && "gap-1.5 px-3", live ? ON : OFF, className)}
      style={{ width: w }}
    >
      {/* inline, not hoisted: a preview frame or a shadow root gets its own copy */}
      <style>{KEYFRAMES}</style>

      {v === "a" && (
        <>
          <Swap k={live ? "bars" : "play"} reduced={reduced}>
            {live ? <Bars moving={moving} /> : <PlayMark />}
          </Swap>
          <Label text={text} reduced={reduced} />
        </>
      )}

      {v === "b" && (
        <>
          <Swap k={live ? "pause" : "play"} reduced={reduced}>
            {live ? <PauseMark /> : <PlayMark />}
          </Swap>
          <Label text={text} reduced={reduced} />
          {/* the hairline sits inside the straight run of the bottom edge, clear of the round ends */}
          <span aria-hidden className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-3 bottom-[4px] h-px overflow-hidden rounded-full">
            <span
              className="absolute inset-0 bg-current transition-opacity duration-200"
              style={{ opacity: live ? 0.12 : 0 }}
            />
            {moving && (
              <span
                className="lt-sig absolute inset-y-0 left-0 w-1/3 rounded-full"
                style={{
                  background: "linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, currentColor, transparent)",
                  opacity: 0.7,
                  animation: "lt-glint 1.8s cubic-bezier(0.45, 0, 0.55, 1) infinite",
                }}
              />
            )}
          </span>
        </>
      )}

      {v === "c" && <Morph live={live} moving={moving} reduced={reduced} />}

      {v === "d" && (
        <Label
          text={text}
          reduced={reduced}
          className="lt-sig"
          style={live && moving ? { animation: "lt-weight 2.4s ease-in-out infinite" } : { fontWeight: live ? 560 : 500 }}
        />
      )}
    </button>
  )
}
```

// ─── components/ui/use-pointed.ts ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react"

/* usePointed: live content runs only while it is being looked at (his call, 2026-10-02:
   "it should start animating only when you start hovering on it; anything with numbers
   that change can start once you hover on the component"). Spread `bind` on the
   component's root; `live` is true while the pointer is on it or focus is inside it, and
   stays true for `linger` ms after it leaves so a pass across the edge does not stop and
   start the feed. On a device with no hover (touch) it is true while the component is at
   least half in view instead, since a finger cannot point without pressing. */
export function usePointed<T extends HTMLElement = HTMLDivElement>({ linger = 600 } = {}) {
  const ref = useRef<T>(null)
  const [pointed, setPointed] = useState(false)
  const [seen, setSeen] = useState(false)
  const [touch] = useState(() => typeof matchMedia === "function" && !matchMedia("(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)").matches)
  const timer = useRef<number | undefined>(undefined)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!touch || !ref.current || typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined") return
    const io = new IntersectionObserver(([e]) => setSeen(e.isIntersecting), { threshold: 0.5 })
    io.observe(ref.current)
    return () => io.disconnect()
  }, [touch])
  useEffect(() => () => window.clearTimeout(timer.current), [])

  const on = () => {
    window.clearTimeout(timer.current)
    setPointed(true)
  }
  const off = () => {
    window.clearTimeout(timer.current)
    timer.current = window.setTimeout(() => setPointed(false), linger)
  }

  return {
    ref,
    live: touch ? seen : pointed,
    bind: {
      onPointerEnter: on,
      onPointerLeave: off,
      onFocus: on,
      onBlur: (e: React.FocusEvent) => {
        if (!e.currentTarget.contains(e.relatedTarget as Node | null)) off()
      },
    },
  }
}
```

```tsx
/* Control classes: the library's control material for components that ship on their own
   (2026-10-02, the audit's pattern 11). src/components/library/controls.ts is the site's
   copy; components used to paste its look in as a flat 8% fill "so the file ships alone",

   tokens WITH a fallback, so they follow the site's raised-surface rule here and still

   that imports it (scripts/build-registry.mjs bundles ui helpers automatically).

   Whole class strings, never assembled from pieces: Tailwind reads this file as text. */

/** an option that is off: the label alone answers the pointer */

/** the one loud button of a form: 48px, full width, the foreground filled (the dashboards'
```
