# Order Flow (tape-flow)
> An order flow chart of the last 48 trades as bars sized by volume and coloured by side, for crypto and futures trading terminals.

// ─── components/ui/tape-flow.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { LiveToggle } from "@/components/ui/live-toggle"
import { LiveFigure } from "@/components/ui/live-figure"
import { usePointed } from "@/components/ui/use-pointed"

/* Tape Flow, promoted from a lab sketch through ssych-component (2026-09-29).
   Motion pass (user call, 2026-10-02: "fix the animations and transitions … add icons"):
   the tape now SLIDES one slot left as each print lands (x over the beat, linear, so the
   row reads as one moving tape), the oldest bar sinks out at the left edge, the new one
   rises in at the right; Boost grows and shrinks the bars (height 300ms) instead of
   snapping; the buttons carry icons (a bolt that fills while Boost is on; a pulsing green
   dot while Live, a pause mark while Paused) and their labels swap in place without the
   button changing width; the buy/sell bar eases to its new split.
   What it is for: the last prints of one market as a row of bars, tall for size, green
   when buyers pressed and red when sellers did, so a burst on one side is seen at once.
   Read first: the price. It is the one large figure; the change on that print sits beside it.
   The pointer: scrub the bars and the pointed print stays full while the rest dim; the
   price, the change and the line under the bars become that print's. Press a bar to hold
   it, press it again or Escape to let go; with focus on the bars the arrow keys step
   through them. The feed runs while the tape is pointed at; the toggle pins it on or pauses it.
   Lab sketch: src/components/lab/TapeFlow.tsx. Kept: the data shape, 48 prints in the
   buffer, colour by buy share, hover and press, the live switch and the boost. Changed:
   no card, shadow, dotted ground, gradient bars or glow; no capitals and no mono; the
   live feed drew from Math.random and the clock, it now continues the same seeded walk,
   so two mounts print the same tape. "Flow ratio 64% buy" was typed in; it is worked out
   from the buffer. "Volume × 120 units" meant nothing; volume is BTC. "60 fps" is gone.
   2026-10-02 audit: his calls first. The tape is still at rest and its feed runs only while
   the pointer is on it (usePointed); the toggle pins it on, and while paused it shows a
   filled play mark reading "Play", while live the pulsing green dot reading "Live", inside
   one fixed width. Boost is gone, it only rescaled the bars, so there is one toggle (the
   gain is 1). The header is the three tier one (label row "Order flow" and the symbol,
   26px price with its cents at /35, the change in its hue then the print's time), and the
   line under the bars reads only the pointed print and keeps its height at rest; the buy
   share of the buffer moved to the aria-label. The width is 440, shared with Trade Tape.
   2026-10-02 round 2: his note on the Live control, no green dot. The toggle is the shared
   LiveToggle (live-toggle.tsx), the same in every streaming component: four looks, all in
   ink and without a dot, picked by the LiveToggleVariant around it; it plays and pauses the
   feed exactly as before.
   Formulas:
   · change on a print  = price − price of the print before
   · buy share, a print = 0.5 + change / 25, held between 5% and 95%
   · bar height         = min(1, volume / 10 BTC)
   · bar strength       = 35% + |buy share − 50%| × 2 × 60% of the hue
   · buy share, buffer  = Σ (volume × buy share) / Σ volume; sell share = 100% − buy share
   · traded, buffer     = Σ volume */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GREEN = "var(--chart-up)"
const RED = "var(--chart-down)"

const M = 2147483647
const BUFFER = 48
/** one print every 400 ms */
const BEAT = 400
/** the volume that fills a bar, in BTC */
const FULL = 10

const W = 520
const H = 112
const GAP = 2
const BW = (W - (BUFFER - 1) * GAP) / BUFFER

export interface TickBar {
  id: number
  /** hh:mm:ss */
  timestamp: string
  /** size of the print, in BTC */
  volume: number
  /** 0 to 1, the share of the print that lifted the offer */
  buyRatio: number
  price: number
  /** change against the print before, in dollars */
  delta: number
}

export interface TapeFlowProps {
  symbol?: string
  /** the price the walk starts from */
  base?: number
  /** seed of the walk; the same seed prints the same tape */
  seed?: number
  /** start with the feed pinned on; at rest (false) it runs only while pointed at */
  initialLive?: boolean
  className?: string
}

const two = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, "0")
/** the tape opens at 09:30:00 and prints every 400 ms */
const clock = (id: number) => {
  const s = 9 * 3600 + 30 * 60 + Math.floor((id * BEAT) / 1000)
  return `${two(Math.floor(s / 3600) % 24)}:${two(Math.floor(s / 60) % 60)}:${two(s % 60)}`
}

/** the next print of the walk, and the seed it leaves behind */
function grow(prev: { id: number; price: number }, seed: number): { tick: TickBar; seed: number } {
  const a = (seed * 16807) % M
  const b = (a * 16807) % M
  const delta = Math.round((a / M - 0.48) * 12.5 * 100) / 100
  const id = prev.id + 1
  return {
    seed: b,
    tick: {
      id,
      timestamp: clock(id),
      volume: (15 + (b % 80)) / 10,
      buyRatio: Math.min(0.95, Math.max(0.05, 0.5 + delta / 25)),
      price: Math.round((prev.price + delta) * 100) / 100,
      delta,
    },
  }
}

function seedTape(base: number, seed: number) {
  const ticks: TickBar[] = []
  let at = { id: -1, price: base }
  let s = seed
  for (let i = 0; i < BUFFER; i++) {
    const g = grow(at, s)
    ticks.push(g.tick)
    at = g.tick
    s = g.seed
  }
  return { ticks, seed: s }
}

const usd = (v: number) => v.toLocaleString("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })
const signed = (v: number) => `${v >= 0 ? "+" : "−"}${Math.abs(v).toFixed(2)}`
const pct = (v: number) => `${Math.round(v * 100)}%`
const fill = (t: TickBar) => `color-mix(in srgb, ${t.buyRatio >= 0.5 ? GREEN : RED} ${Math.round(35 + Math.abs(t.buyRatio - 0.5) * 2 * 60)}%, transparent)`

/**
 * Order flow as a row of bars: height is size, hue is the side that pressed, strength is
 * how one-sided the print was. Scrubbing reads any print in place of the latest one.
 */
export function TapeFlow({ symbol = "BTC-USD", base = 64280.5, seed = 42, initialLive = false, className }: TapeFlowProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const uid = useId().replace(/:/g, "")
  const box = useRef<SVGSVGElement>(null)
  const pointed = usePointed()
  const [feed, setFeed] = useState(() => seedTape(base, seed))
  /* "auto" runs while pointed at, "on" is pinned by the toggle, "off" is paused by it until
     the pointer leaves (then it goes back to auto) */
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<"auto" | "on" | "off">(initialLive ? "on" : "auto")
  /* reduced motion never starts the feed on its own: only the toggle runs it */
  const live = mode === "on" || (mode === "auto" && pointed.live && !reduced)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!pointed.live && mode === "off") setMode("auto")
  }, [pointed.live, mode])
  const [hover, setHover] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const [pin, setPin] = useState<number | null>(null)
  /* the first tape rises in once, 6ms a bar (48 bars inside 300ms); after that each new
     print rises alone as it lands */
  const [landed, setLanded] = useState(false)
  useEffect(() => {
    const t = setTimeout(() => setLanded(true), reduced ? 0 : BUFFER * 6 + 320)
    return () => clearTimeout(t)
  }, [reduced])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!live) return
    const t = setInterval(() => {
      setFeed((f) => {
        const g = grow(f.ticks[f.ticks.length - 1], f.seed)
        return { ticks: [...f.ticks.slice(1), g.tick], seed: g.seed }
      })
    }, BEAT)
    return () => clearInterval(t)
  }, [live])

  const { ticks } = feed
  const latest = ticks[ticks.length - 1]
  const hotId = hover ?? pin
  const hot = ticks.find((t) => t.id === hotId) ?? null
  const shown = hot ?? latest

  const traded = ticks.reduce((s, t) => s + t.volume, 0)
  const bought = ticks.reduce((s, t) => s + t.volume * t.buyRatio, 0) / (traded || 1)

  /* the sell share is what is left of 100, so the two always add up */
  const buy = hot ? Math.round(hot.buyRatio * 100) : 0
  const [whole, cents] = usd(shown.price).split(".")

  const at = (clientX: number) => {
    const r = box.current?.getBoundingClientRect()
    if (!r) return null
    const i = Math.max(0, Math.min(ticks.length - 1, Math.floor(((clientX - r.left) / r.width) * ticks.length)))
    return ticks[i].id
  }

  const onKey = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key === "Escape") setPin(null)
    if (e.key !== "ArrowLeft" && e.key !== "ArrowRight") return
    e.preventDefault()
    const i = ticks.findIndex((t) => t.id === (pin ?? latest.id))
    const next = Math.max(0, Math.min(ticks.length - 1, (i < 0 ? ticks.length - 1 : i) + (e.key === "ArrowLeft" ? -1 : 1)))
    setPin(ticks[next].id)
  }

  return (
    <div ref={pointed.ref} {...pointed.bind} className={cn("w-[440px] max-w-full tabular-nums", className)}>
      <div className="mb-3 flex items-baseline justify-between text-[12px]">
        <span className="text-foreground/45">Order flow</span>
        <span className="font-medium text-foreground/90">{symbol}</span>
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-end justify-between gap-3 pb-3">
        <div role="status">
          {/* the live price changes in place (live-figure.tsx): it swaps only when the pointer
              takes a print or lets it go, never on each print (user call, 2026-10-02) */}
          <LiveFigure intent={hot ? hot.id : null}>
            <p className="m-0 text-[26px] font-semibold leading-none tracking-[-0.02em] text-foreground/90">
              ${whole}
              <span className="text-foreground/35">.{cents}</span>
            </p>
            <p className="mb-0 mt-2 flex items-baseline gap-1.5 text-[12px] font-medium" style={{ color: shown.delta >= 0 ? GREEN : RED }}>
              <span>{signed(shown.delta)}</span>
              <span className="font-normal text-foreground/45">{shown.timestamp}</span>
            </p>
          </LiveFigure>
        </div>

        {/* live-toggle.tsx: the family's play and pause control, ink only, one fixed width */}
        <LiveToggle live={live} onLiveChange={(next) => setMode(next ? "on" : "off")} />
      </div>

      <div
        tabIndex={0}
        role="group"
        aria-label="Prints, arrow keys step through them"
        onKeyDown={onKey}
        className="rounded-[4px] outline-none focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.03]"
      >
        <svg
          ref={box}
          viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H + 6}`}
          className="block w-full cursor-crosshair touch-none overflow-visible"
          role="img"
          aria-label={`${symbol} order flow, last ${ticks.length} prints, ${traded.toFixed(1)} BTC traded, ${pct(bought)} bought and ${100 - Math.round(bought * 100)}% sold, latest $${usd(latest.price)}`}
          onPointerMove={(e) => setHover(at(e.clientX))}
          onPointerLeave={() => setHover(null)}
          onClick={(e) => {
            const id = at(e.clientX)
            setPin((p) => (p === id ? null : id))
          }}
        >
          <line x1={0} x2={W} y1={H + 0.5} y2={H + 0.5} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.05} strokeWidth={1} />
          <g key={uid}>
            {/* each bar owns its place by id: when a print lands every bar glides one slot
                left over the beat, the oldest sinks out at the edge and the new one rises in */}
            <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
              {ticks.map((t, i) => {
                const h = Math.max(2, Math.min(1, t.volume / FULL) * H)
                const x = i * (BW + GAP)
                return (
                  <motion.rect
                    key={t.id}
                    initial={reduced ? false : landed ? { x: x + BW + GAP, y: H, height: 0 } : { x, y: H, height: 0 }}
                    animate={{ x, y: H - h, height: h }}
                    exit={reduced ? { opacity: 0, transition: { duration: 0 } } : { x: x - BW - GAP, y: H, height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
                    transition={
                      reduced
                        ? { duration: 0 }
                        : {
                            x: { duration: BEAT / 1000, ease: "linear" },
                            y: { duration: 0.3, ease: EASE, delay: landed ? 0 : i * 0.006 },
                            height: { duration: 0.3, ease: EASE, delay: landed ? 0 : i * 0.006 },
                            opacity: { duration: 0.2 },
                          }
                    }
                    width={BW}
                    rx={2}
                    fill={fill(t)}
                    style={{ opacity: hotId !== null && hot && hot.id !== t.id ? 0.4 : 1, transition: "opacity 150ms" }}
                  />
                )
              })}
            </AnimatePresence>
          </g>
          {ticks.map((t, i) => (pin === t.id ? <rect key={t.id} x={i * (BW + GAP)} y={H + 3} width={BW} height={2} rx={1} fill="var(--foreground)" /> : null))}
        </svg>
      </div>

      {/* the pointed print only; at rest the line keeps its height empty */}
      <div role="status" className="mt-2 flex h-4 items-center justify-between gap-3 text-[10.5px] text-foreground/60">
        {hot ? (
          <>
            <span className="truncate">
              <span className="text-foreground/90">{hot.volume.toFixed(1)} BTC</span> at {hot.timestamp}
            </span>
            <span className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2">
              <span style={{ color: GREEN }}>{buy}% buy</span>
              <span style={{ color: RED }}>{100 - buy}% sell</span>
              <span aria-hidden className="flex h-[3px] w-16 overflow-hidden rounded-full">
                <span style={{ width: `${hot.buyRatio * 100}%`, background: GREEN, transition: reduced ? undefined : "width 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)" }} />
                <span className="flex-1" style={{ background: RED }} />
              </span>
            </span>
          </>
        ) : (
          <span aria-hidden>&nbsp;</span>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

// ─── components/ui/live-toggle.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { createContext, useContext, type ReactNode } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { THUMB } from "@/components/ui/control-classes"

/* Live Toggle: the one play and pause control of the streaming components (Tape Flow,
   Trade Tape, Fills Blotter, New Items Pill).
   2026-10-02 round 2: his call, "I don't like the green dot in there, I feel like it should
   be better design ... still minimal. Give me a couple of options". Four options, all in
   ink on the control material, none with a dot, each a fixed width so the control never
   resizes between its two states:
   · a  Bars   a 28px pill; while live three thin bars rise and fall out of phase
              like an equaliser beside "Live"; paused, a filled play mark beside "Paused"
   · b  Line   a 28px pill; a hairline under the label carries a short glint gliding along it
              while live, a pause mark says what a press does; paused, a play mark
   · c  Morph  (default, his pick 2026-10-02) icon only, 28px round; the play mark morphs into the two pause bars, which
              breathe in turn while live
   · d  Word   text only; "Live" breathes in its letter weight (a variable font eases it,
              a static one steps), "Paused" sits still at /60
   Live takes the THUMB fill and full ink; paused is bare ink at /60 with a faint fill under
   the pointer. The label swaps in place (4px, 2px blur, 150ms). The signal moves only while
   `animate` is true (data is actually flowing) and never under reduced motion. Motion is
   transform only for a, b and c; d animates the weight. A page switches every toggle below
   it with <LiveToggleVariant variant="c">. */

export type LiveToggleVariantName = "a" | "b" | "c" | "d"

const VariantContext = createContext<LiveToggleVariantName>("c")

/** sets the look of every LiveToggle below it that does not name its own variant */
export function LiveToggleVariant({ variant, children }: { variant: LiveToggleVariantName; children: ReactNode }) {
  return <VariantContext.Provider value={variant}>{children}</VariantContext.Provider>
}

/** the variant in force here (the nearest LiveToggleVariant, or "c") */
export const useLiveToggleVariant = () => useContext(VariantContext)

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const

/** fixed widths: the longer label ("Paused") plus its mark and 12px sides */
const WIDTH: Record<LiveToggleVariantName, number> = { a: 88, b: 88, c: 28, d: 68 }

/* keyframes for the signals; each toggle carries the same small rule set */
const KEYFRAMES = `
@keyframes lt-eq { 0%, 100% { transform: scaleY(0.35) } 50% { transform: scaleY(1) } }
@keyframes lt-glint { 0% { transform: translateX(-100%) } 100% { transform: translateX(300%) } }
@keyframes lt-breathe { 0%, 100% { transform: scaleY(1) } 50% { transform: scaleY(0.62) } }
@keyframes lt-weight { 0%, 100% { font-weight: 460 } 50% { font-weight: 640 } }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .lt-sig { animation: none !important } }
`

const PILL =
  "relative inline-flex h-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[11px] outline-none transition-[color,background-color,scale] duration-150 focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.08] active:scale-[0.97] motion-reduce:active:scale-100"
const ON = `${THUMB} text-foreground/90`
const OFF = "text-foreground/60 hover:bg-foreground/[0.04] hover:text-foreground/90"

function PlayMark() {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 12 12" width={10} height={10} aria-hidden>
      <path d="M3.2 1.8 L10.2 6 L3.2 10.2 Z" fill="currentColor" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={1.2} strokeLinejoin="round" />
    </svg>
  )
}

function PauseMark() {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 12 12" width={10} height={10} aria-hidden>
      <rect x={2.6} y={2} width={2.4} height={8} rx={0.8} fill="currentColor" />
      <rect x={7} y={2} width={2.4} height={8} rx={0.8} fill="currentColor" />
    </svg>
  )
}

/** a: three 2px bars out of phase, the equaliser of something playing */
function Bars({ moving }: { moving: boolean }) {
  const bars = [
    { d: 1.05, delay: 0, rest: 0.55 },
    { d: 0.85, delay: -0.35, rest: 1 },
    { d: 1.25, delay: -0.7, rest: 0.7 },
  ]
  return (
    <span aria-hidden className="flex h-[10px] items-center gap-[2px]">
      {bars.map((b, i) => (
        <span
          key={i}
          className="lt-sig block h-full w-[2px] rounded-full bg-current"
          style={
            moving
              ? { animation: `lt-eq ${b.d}s ease-in-out ${b.delay}s infinite`, transformOrigin: "center" }
              : { transform: `scaleY(${b.rest})`, transition: "transform 250ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)" }
          }
        />
      ))}
    </span>
  )
}

/* c: play and pause drawn as the same two four-point shapes, so one morphs into the other.
   Points run top left, top right, bottom right, bottom left. */
const quad = (p: number[]) => `M${p[0]} ${p[1]} L${p[2]} ${p[3]} L${p[4]} ${p[5]} L${p[6]} ${p[7]} Z`
const PAUSE_L = quad([2.6, 2, 5, 2, 5, 10, 2.6, 10])
const PAUSE_R = quad([7, 2, 9.4, 2, 9.4, 10, 7, 10])
const PLAY_L = quad([3.2, 1.8, 7, 4.08, 7, 7.92, 3.2, 10.2])
const PLAY_R = quad([6.9, 4.02, 10.2, 6, 10.2, 6, 6.9, 7.98])

function Morph({ live, moving, reduced }: { live: boolean; moving: boolean; reduced: boolean }) {
  const t = reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.25, ease: EASE }
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 12 12" width={12} height={12} aria-hidden className="overflow-visible">
      {[
        { on: PAUSE_L, off: PLAY_L, delay: 0 },
        { on: PAUSE_R, off: PLAY_R, delay: -0.7 },
      ].map((s, i) => (
        <g
          key={i}
          className="lt-sig"
          style={{
            transformBox: "fill-box",
            transformOrigin: "center",
            animation: live && moving ? `lt-breathe 1.4s ease-in-out ${s.delay}s infinite` : undefined,
          }}
        >
          <motion.path initial={false} animate={{ d: live ? s.on : s.off }} transition={t} fill="currentColor" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={0.6} strokeLinejoin="round" />
        </g>
      ))}
    </svg>
  )
}

/** the label, swapped in place inside the fixed width */
function Label({ text, reduced, style, className }: { text: string; reduced: boolean; style?: React.CSSProperties; className?: string }) {
  return (
    <motion.span
      key={text}
      initial={reduced ? false : { opacity: 0, y: 4, filter: "blur(2px)" }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, filter: "blur(0px)" }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
      className={cn("whitespace-nowrap", className)}
      style={style}
    >
      {text}
    </motion.span>
  )
}

/** a mark that swaps through a 0.6 scale and a fade (150ms) */
function Swap({ k, children, reduced }: { k: string; children: ReactNode; reduced: boolean }) {
  return (
    <span aria-hidden className="relative grid h-3 w-3 shrink-0 place-items-center">
      <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
        <motion.span
          key={k}
          className="absolute inset-0 grid place-items-center"
          initial={reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, scale: 0.6 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
          exit={reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, scale: 0.6 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
        >
          {children}
        </motion.span>
      </AnimatePresence>
    </span>
  )
}

export interface LiveToggleProps {
  /** the feed is on */
  live: boolean
  onLiveChange: (next: boolean) => void
  /** the look; defaults to the nearest LiveToggleVariant, then "c" */
  variant?: LiveToggleVariantName
  /** the signal moves only while data is actually flowing; defaults to `live` */
  animate?: boolean
  labels?: { on: string; off: string }
  /** a fixed width in px, when the labels are longer than the defaults */
  width?: number
  "aria-label"?: string
  className?: string
}

/**
 * The live control of a streaming component: a press pauses the feed or plays it. Four
 * looks share one API (see the header); none of them changes width between states.
 */
export function LiveToggle({
  live,
  onLiveChange,
  variant,
  animate,
  labels = { on: "Live", off: "Paused" },
  width,
  "aria-label": ariaLabel,
  className,
}: LiveToggleProps) {
  const fromContext = useContext(VariantContext)
  const v = variant ?? fromContext
  const reduced = useReducedMotion() ?? false
  const moving = (animate ?? live) && !reduced
  const text = live ? labels.on : labels.off
  const w = width ?? WIDTH[v]

  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      aria-pressed={live}
      aria-label={ariaLabel ?? (live ? `${labels.on}, press to pause` : `${labels.off}, press to play`)}
      onClick={() => onLiveChange(!live)}
      className={cn(PILL, v !== "c" && "gap-1.5 px-3", live ? ON : OFF, className)}
      style={{ width: w }}
    >
      {/* inline, not hoisted: a preview frame or a shadow root gets its own copy */}
      <style>{KEYFRAMES}</style>

      {v === "a" && (
        <>
          <Swap k={live ? "bars" : "play"} reduced={reduced}>
            {live ? <Bars moving={moving} /> : <PlayMark />}
          </Swap>
          <Label text={text} reduced={reduced} />
        </>
      )}

      {v === "b" && (
        <>
          <Swap k={live ? "pause" : "play"} reduced={reduced}>
            {live ? <PauseMark /> : <PlayMark />}
          </Swap>
          <Label text={text} reduced={reduced} />
          {/* the hairline sits inside the straight run of the bottom edge, clear of the round ends */}
          <span aria-hidden className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-3 bottom-[4px] h-px overflow-hidden rounded-full">
            <span
              className="absolute inset-0 bg-current transition-opacity duration-200"
              style={{ opacity: live ? 0.12 : 0 }}
            />
            {moving && (
              <span
                className="lt-sig absolute inset-y-0 left-0 w-1/3 rounded-full"
                style={{
                  background: "linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, currentColor, transparent)",
                  opacity: 0.7,
                  animation: "lt-glint 1.8s cubic-bezier(0.45, 0, 0.55, 1) infinite",
                }}
              />
            )}
          </span>
        </>
      )}

      {v === "c" && <Morph live={live} moving={moving} reduced={reduced} />}

      {v === "d" && (
        <Label
          text={text}
          reduced={reduced}
          className="lt-sig"
          style={live && moving ? { animation: "lt-weight 2.4s ease-in-out infinite" } : { fontWeight: live ? 560 : 500 }}
        />
      )}
    </button>
  )
}
```

```tsx
"use client"

import { type ReactNode } from "react"
import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

/* Live figure: a figure fed by a live stream (2026-10-02, out of Tape Flow, where a price
   that re-entered on every print read as a flicker). The value changes in place on each
   tick; the figure swaps (4px, 2px blur, 150ms) only when `intent` changes: the pointer
   takes a point, lets it go, or a toggle flips. Pass the pointed point's id, or null for
   the live value. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const

export function LiveFigure({
  intent,
  className,
  children,
}: {
  /** what the figure is showing: a pointed point's id, or null while it follows the stream */
  intent: string | number | null
  className?: string
  children: ReactNode
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  return (
    <motion.div
      key={intent === null ? "live" : `at-${intent}`}
      className={cn(className)}
      initial={reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: 4, filter: "blur(2px)" }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, filter: "blur(0px)" }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
    >
      {children}
    </motion.div>
  )
}
```

// ─── components/ui/use-pointed.ts ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react"

/* usePointed: live content runs only while it is being looked at (his call, 2026-10-02:
   "it should start animating only when you start hovering on it; anything with numbers
   that change can start once you hover on the component"). Spread `bind` on the
   component's root; `live` is true while the pointer is on it or focus is inside it, and
   stays true for `linger` ms after it leaves so a pass across the edge does not stop and
   start the feed. On a device with no hover (touch) it is true while the component is at
   least half in view instead, since a finger cannot point without pressing. */
export function usePointed<T extends HTMLElement = HTMLDivElement>({ linger = 600 } = {}) {
  const ref = useRef<T>(null)
  const [pointed, setPointed] = useState(false)
  const [seen, setSeen] = useState(false)
  const [touch] = useState(() => typeof matchMedia === "function" && !matchMedia("(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)").matches)
  const timer = useRef<number | undefined>(undefined)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!touch || !ref.current || typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined") return
    const io = new IntersectionObserver(([e]) => setSeen(e.isIntersecting), { threshold: 0.5 })
    io.observe(ref.current)
    return () => io.disconnect()
  }, [touch])
  useEffect(() => () => window.clearTimeout(timer.current), [])

  const on = () => {
    window.clearTimeout(timer.current)
    setPointed(true)
  }
  const off = () => {
    window.clearTimeout(timer.current)
    timer.current = window.setTimeout(() => setPointed(false), linger)
  }

  return {
    ref,
    live: touch ? seen : pointed,
    bind: {
      onPointerEnter: on,
      onPointerLeave: off,
      onFocus: on,
      onBlur: (e: React.FocusEvent) => {
        if (!e.currentTarget.contains(e.relatedTarget as Node | null)) off()
      },
    },
  }
}
```

```tsx
/* Control classes: the library's control material for components that ship on their own
   (2026-10-02, the audit's pattern 11). src/components/library/controls.ts is the site's
   copy; components used to paste its look in as a flat 8% fill "so the file ships alone",
   and those copies never turned white on a raised light surface. These read the same
   tokens WITH a fallback, so they follow the site's raised-surface rule here and still
   draw correctly in a buyer's app that has no such tokens. Shipped beside every component
   that imports it (scripts/build-registry.mjs bundles ui helpers automatically).

   Whole class strings, never assembled from pieces: Tailwind reads this file as text. */

/** what is ON in a switcher. Light (his call, 2026-10-02, after the inline slider): a WHITE
 *  pill with a hairline and a soft shadow on the grey track. Dark: the 8% thumb */
export const THUMB =
  "bg-white shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--light-outline,rgba(0,0,0,0.09)),0_1px_3px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] dark:bg-[var(--control-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_8%,transparent))] dark:shadow-[var(--control-shadow,inset_0_1px_0_0_color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_6%,transparent))]"

/** what a switcher's options sit in; its 2px padding is the gap the thumb keeps. Light: a
 *  light grey track with no outline, the white pill sits in it. Dark: a hairline, no fill */
export const TRACK = "rounded-full border border-transparent bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_5%,var(--background))] p-0.5 dark:border-foreground/[0.04] dark:bg-transparent"

/** an option that is off: the label alone answers the pointer */
export const SEGMENT_OFF = "text-foreground/60 hover:text-foreground/90"

/** a secondary button: the thumb standing alone; size it with h-7 / h-9 and px */
export const BUTTON =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--control-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_8%,transparent))] shadow-[var(--control-shadow,inset_0_1px_0_0_color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_6%,transparent))] text-foreground/90 outline-none transition-[color,background-color,scale] duration-150 hover:bg-[var(--control-fill-hover,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_12%,transparent))] focus-visible:bg-[var(--control-fill-hover,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_12%,transparent))] active:scale-[0.97] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40 motion-reduce:active:scale-100"

/** an icon-only control: no fill at rest, a faint one under the pointer */
export const ICON_BUTTON =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-full text-foreground/60 outline-none transition-[color,background-color] duration-150 hover:bg-foreground/[0.06] hover:text-foreground/90 focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.06]"

/** a field: the track with just enough fill to read as somewhere to type */
export const FIELD =
  "rounded-full border border-foreground/[0.04] bg-[var(--field-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_5%,transparent))] text-foreground/90 outline-none transition-[background-color,border-color] duration-150 placeholder:text-foreground/45 focus:border-foreground/[0.12]"

/** the one loud button of a form: 48px, full width, the foreground filled (the dashboards'
 *  Modal primary). A ticket, a swap, a confirm: one of these and nothing louder */
export const BUTTON_PRIMARY =
  "inline-flex h-12 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-foreground/[0.92] text-[14px] font-medium text-background outline-none transition-[background-color,scale,opacity] duration-150 hover:bg-foreground focus-visible:bg-foreground active:scale-[0.98] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40 motion-reduce:active:scale-100"

/** a component's own card, field or block (spec 14.8). Dark: a #121212 fill on black. Light
 *  (his call, 2026-10-02: "on light the card background is too dark, it can just be white, a
 *  quiet outline and a small shadow"): white, a 1px hairline (Kraken's #e7e6e9, or 9% ink in an app without the token) and a
 *  barely there shadow,
 *  drawn as box shadows so the outline takes no layout */
export const SURFACE =
  "bg-background shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--light-outline,color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_9%,transparent)),0_1px_2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] dark:bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_7%,var(--background))] dark:shadow-none"

/** a block sitting ON a surface: a faint 4% grey inside a white card in light, #1f1f1f in dark */
export const RAISED = "bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_4%,var(--background))] dark:bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_12%,var(--background))]"
```

# Ticker Tape (ticker-tape)
> A scrolling stock and crypto ticker tape with BTC, ETH, TAO and NVDA, green up and red down, paused on hover, for headers and trading dashboards.

// ─── components/ui/ticker-tape.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useId, useState, type ReactNode } from "react"
import { useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { usePointed } from "@/components/ui/use-pointed"

/* Ticker Tape, rebuilt through the ssych-component skill (2026-09-29).
   What changed against the version before it (in git history), and why:
   · no card: the 12px corner, the outline, the inner highlight and the card ground are
     gone, the tape runs on the page
   · the ends fade through a mask, not through two strips painted in the card colour, so
     it sits on any ground
   · tabular numerals are set once on the root
   2026-10-02 audit: his call that anything streaming runs only while pointed at, so the
   tape stands still at rest and drifts while the pointer is on it (usePointed; in view on
   touch). A finger resting on a symbol (pressing it) or keyboard focus on it holds the tape,
   keeps that symbol full and dims the rest; each symbol is a real button now, so the
   keyboard can reach and hold it. Each symbol carries its mark through a renderIcon slot
   (the preview passes the real token and company marks). The preview stage is 160px.
   Formulas: none; every figure is the caller's (price, and the signed 24h move in percent). */

const GREEN = "var(--chart-up)"
const RED = "var(--chart-down)"

/** one full loop of the tape, seconds */
const LOOP = 30
/** both ends fade out over 40px */
const FADE = "linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, black 40px, black calc(100% - 40px), transparent)"

export interface TickerRow {
  symbol: string
  price: number
  /** signed 24h move, percent */
  change: number
}

const DEFAULT_ROWS: TickerRow[] = [
  { symbol: "BTC", price: 97482.5, change: 1.84 },
  { symbol: "ETH", price: 3714.2, change: -0.62 },
  { symbol: "NVDA", price: 138.27, change: 2.41 },
  { symbol: "AAPL", price: 229.86, change: 0.34 },
  { symbol: "SPY", price: 601.12, change: -0.18 },
  { symbol: "TAO", price: 486.9, change: 4.07 },
  { symbol: "SOL", price: 214.63, change: -1.29 },
  { symbol: "AMZN", price: 227.48, change: 0.91 },
  { symbol: "MSFT", price: 452.3, change: -0.44 },
  { symbol: "VIX", price: 14.82, change: -3.15 },
]

const fmtPrice = (v: number) => v.toLocaleString("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })

/* one pass of the symbols, rendered twice so −50% lands exactly on the seam */
function Pass({
  rows,
  hot,
  onHot,
  hidden,
  renderIcon,
}: {
  rows: TickerRow[]
  hot: string | null
  onHot: (symbol: string | null) => void
  hidden?: boolean
  renderIcon?: (symbol: string, size: number) => ReactNode
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center" aria-hidden={hidden || undefined}>
      {rows.map((r) => {
        const up = r.change >= 0
        return (
          <button
            key={r.symbol}
            type="button"
            tabIndex={hidden ? -1 : 0}
            aria-label={`${r.symbol} ${fmtPrice(r.price)}, ${up ? "up" : "down"} ${Math.abs(r.change).toFixed(2)}%`}
            onPointerDown={() => onHot(r.symbol)}
            onPointerUp={() => onHot(null)}
            onPointerLeave={() => onHot(null)}
            onFocus={() => onHot(r.symbol)}
            onBlur={() => onHot(null)}
            className={cn(
              "flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full px-5 py-1 outline-none transition-opacity duration-200 focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.06]",
              hot !== null && hot !== r.symbol && "opacity-45",
            )}
          >
            {renderIcon && <span className="grid shrink-0 place-items-center">{renderIcon(r.symbol, 14)}</span>}
            <span className="text-[12px] font-semibold text-foreground/90">{r.symbol}</span>
            <span className="text-[12px] text-foreground/70">{fmtPrice(r.price)}</span>
            <span className="text-[11px]" style={{ color: up ? GREEN : RED }}>
              {up ? "+" : "−"}
              {Math.abs(r.change).toFixed(2)}%
            </span>
          </button>
        )
      })}
    </div>
  )
}

export interface TickerTapeProps {
  rows?: TickerRow[]
  /** a symbol's mark (token or company logo) at `size` px; letters are never drawn for it */
  renderIcon?: (symbol: string, size: number) => ReactNode
  className?: string
}

/**
 * A finance tape, the kind that runs under a market header. At rest it stands still; while
 * it is pointed at, the symbols drift left on a seamless loop. Pressing a symbol, or focusing
 * it, holds the tape and steps the others back. Signed moves read green up, red down.
 * Reduced motion shows the tape standing still.
 */
export function TickerTape({ rows = DEFAULT_ROWS, renderIcon, className }: TickerTapeProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const pointed = usePointed()
  const [hot, setHot] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const anim = `tape-${useId().replace(/:/g, "")}`
  const running = pointed.live && hot === null

  return (
    <div
      ref={pointed.ref}
      {...pointed.bind}
      className={cn("w-full max-w-[560px] overflow-hidden py-2 tabular-nums", className)}
      style={{ maskImage: FADE, WebkitMaskImage: FADE }}
      role="marquee"
      aria-label={`Market ticker tape, ${rows.length} symbols`}
      /* focus can scroll a clipped box to show a symbol; the tape keeps its own place */
      onScroll={(e) => {
        e.currentTarget.scrollLeft = 0
      }}
    >
      {reduced ? (
        <Pass rows={rows} hot={hot} onHot={setHot} renderIcon={renderIcon} />
      ) : (
        <>
          <style>{`@keyframes ${anim} { from { transform: translateX(0) } to { transform: translateX(-50%) } }`}</style>
          <div className="flex w-max" style={{ animation: `${anim} ${LOOP}s linear infinite`, animationPlayState: running ? "running" : "paused" }}>
            <Pass rows={rows} hot={hot} onHot={setHot} renderIcon={renderIcon} />
            <Pass rows={rows} hot={hot} onHot={setHot} renderIcon={renderIcon} hidden />
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

```

// ─── components/ui/use-pointed.ts ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react"

/* usePointed: live content runs only while it is being looked at (his call, 2026-10-02:
   "it should start animating only when you start hovering on it; anything with numbers
   that change can start once you hover on the component"). Spread `bind` on the
   component's root; `live` is true while the pointer is on it or focus is inside it, and
   stays true for `linger` ms after it leaves so a pass across the edge does not stop and
   start the feed. On a device with no hover (touch) it is true while the component is at
   least half in view instead, since a finger cannot point without pressing. */
export function usePointed<T extends HTMLElement = HTMLDivElement>({ linger = 600 } = {}) {
  const ref = useRef<T>(null)
  const [pointed, setPointed] = useState(false)
  const [seen, setSeen] = useState(false)
  const [touch] = useState(() => typeof matchMedia === "function" && !matchMedia("(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)").matches)
  const timer = useRef<number | undefined>(undefined)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!touch || !ref.current || typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined") return
    const io = new IntersectionObserver(([e]) => setSeen(e.isIntersecting), { threshold: 0.5 })
    io.observe(ref.current)
    return () => io.disconnect()
  }, [touch])
  useEffect(() => () => window.clearTimeout(timer.current), [])

  const on = () => {
    window.clearTimeout(timer.current)
    setPointed(true)
  }
  const off = () => {
    window.clearTimeout(timer.current)
    timer.current = window.setTimeout(() => setPointed(false), linger)
  }

  return {
    ref,
    live: touch ? seen : pointed,
    bind: {
      onPointerEnter: on,
      onPointerLeave: off,
      onFocus: on,
      onBlur: (e: React.FocusEvent) => {
        if (!e.currentTarget.contains(e.relatedTarget as Node | null)) off()
      },
    },
  }
}

```


# Watchlist Stack (watchlist-stack)
> A stock watchlist with an intraday sparkline, price and daily move per ticker, scrubbable for the price at any moment.

// ─── components/ui/watchlist-stack.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"
import { Plus } from "lucide-react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { ICON_BUTTON } from "@/components/ui/control-classes"
import { RowAction, rowExit, useRowExit } from "@/components/ui/row-action"
import { WatchlistPicker } from "@/components/ui/watchlist-stack-picker"

/* Watchlist Stack, promoted from a lab sketch through ssych-component (2026-09-29).
   What it is for: the shares being watched, one to a row: what it is, the session as a
   small line, the price and the day's move.
   Read first: the right column, price over its signed move.
   The pointer: pointing at a row steps the others back; scrubbing a row's line puts that
   moment's price and its time where the price and move are; pressing a row opens the
   share; "Add stock" takes a fill.
   Sketch used: src/components/lab/WatchlistStack.tsx. Kept: mark, ticker over company, a
   small centred line, price over a signed coloured move, the line seeded from the ticker
   so it ends on the price and starts where the move implies, the scrub, the narrow
   variant. Changed: no embossed card, grooved dividers, gradient outline or shadow; rows
   part by one hairline. Each session line takes the direction of its move again, green up
   and red down (colour pass, 2026-09-30); the dashed base under gainers stays gone. The scrub readout is the row's own
   price cell (it was a floating chip). Brand marks in brand colours became ink
   monograms; a custom mark can still be passed. The title and the stock count are gone
   (2026-10-01): the rows say what it is and how many; the title names it for screen readers.
   Sample data fixed: prices were not the shares' (Alphabet at 1,230, Amazon at 340) and
   the subtitle counted five stocks over four rows. Prices are now near the real ones and
   the count is the length of the list.
   Formulas:
   · move            given, or (last − first of the series) ÷ first × 100
   · series          from price ÷ (1 + move ÷ 100) to the price, with a seeded wobble
   · price at a point  series value × price ÷ last value of the series
   · time at a point   09:30 + place in the series × 390 minutes ÷ (points − 1)    Marks (2026-09-30): a token shows its real mark (TokenIcon), a company or a wallet its
   real logo (BrandIcon); two letters on an ink disc only where no mark exists.
   Library (2026-09-30): ships alone, so a mark is a disc in its --coin-<symbol> colour with
   its letters in white; `renderIcon` draws the real mark in its place.
   2026-10-02 audit: "Add stock" was a bare text button that did nothing in the preview; it
   is now a round + (ICON_BUTTON) with a tip that opens a small search menu of the tickers
   not on the list yet (the `candidates` prop), and picking one adds its row (`onAddStock`
   hears it; `onAdd` still fires when the menu opens). Each row has a Remove in its own
   narrow end column, up on hover or focus (RowAction), that holds the row 420ms then folds
   it away (useRowExit); `onRemove` hears it. The row is no longer one big button, so the
   Remove is not nested in it: the main part stays a button for `onSelect`. The company
   name reads 11px /60, hairlines are 4%. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GREEN = "var(--chart-up)"
const RED = "var(--chart-down)"
/** A hue as text: its lightness is capped in the light theme so small figures stay readable. */
const ink = (c: string) => `oklch(from ${c} min(l, var(--ink-l, 1)) c h)`

export interface WatchStock {
  ticker: string
  name: string
  price: number
  /** the day's move in percent; worked from the series when left out */
  changePct?: number
  /** the session, oldest to newest, on any positive scale */
  series: number[]
  /** a mark of your own, 28px round; the first two letters of the ticker when left out */
  tile?: ReactNode
}

export interface WatchlistStackProps {
  /** names the list for screen readers */
  title?: string
  stocks?: WatchStock[]
  /** fires when the + opens the add menu */
  onAdd?: () => void
  /** fires with the stock picked from the add menu, once its row is on the list */
  onAddStock?: (stock: WatchStock) => void
  /** fires when a row's Remove is pressed; the row leaves the list */
  onRemove?: (ticker: string) => void
  /** what the add menu offers; the ones already listed are left out */
  candidates?: WatchStock[]
  onSelect?: (ticker: string) => void
  /** narrower lines, so company names breathe in a tight column */
  compact?: boolean
  /** draws a token, company or wallet mark in place of the built-in disc; a row's own `tile` wins */
  renderIcon?: (symbol: string, size: number) => ReactNode
  className?: string
}

/* the brand colour of each mark, only ever the fallback of its --coin-<symbol> property;
   a glyph colour is given where white would not read on the disc */
const MARKS: Record<string, { disc: string; glyph?: string }> = {
  GOOGL: { disc: "var(--coin-googl, #4285f4)" },
  SPOT: { disc: "var(--coin-spot, #1db954)" },
  AMZN: { disc: "var(--coin-amzn, #ff9900)", glyph: "var(--coin-amzn-glyph, #000)" },
  SNAP: { disc: "var(--coin-snap, #fffc00)", glyph: "var(--coin-snap-glyph, #000)" },
  MSFT: { disc: "var(--coin-msft, #00a4ef)" },
  NVDA: { disc: "var(--coin-nvda, #76b900)" },
  TSLA: { disc: "var(--coin-tsla, #cc0000)" },
  META: { disc: "var(--coin-meta, #0467df)" },
  NFLX: { disc: "var(--coin-nflx, #e50914)" },
  BTC: { disc: "var(--coin-btc, #f7931a)" },
  ETH: { disc: "var(--coin-eth, #627eea)" },
  SOL: { disc: "var(--coin-sol, #9945ff)" },
}

/** A session that ends on the price and starts where the move implies, seeded off the ticker. */
export function traceFor(price: number, changePct: number, ticker: string, n = 14): number[] {
  const start = price / (1 + changePct / 100)
  let seed = [...ticker].reduce((a, c) => a + c.charCodeAt(0), 0)
  const rnd = () => (seed = (seed * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7fffffff) / 0x7fffffff - 0.5
  const amp = Math.abs(price - start) * 0.55 + price * 0.0015
  return Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => {
    const t = i / (n - 1)
    return +(start + (price - start) * t + (i === 0 || i === n - 1 ? 0 : rnd() * amp)).toFixed(4)
  })
}

const stock = (ticker: string, name: string, price: number, changePct: number): WatchStock => ({
  ticker,
  name,
  price,
  changePct,
  series: traceFor(price, changePct, ticker),
})

const DEFAULT_STOCKS: WatchStock[] = [
  stock("GOOGL", "Alphabet", 182.4, 3.4),
  stock("SPOT", "Spotify", 642.89, 1.9),
  stock("AMZN", "Amazon", 201.3, -2.1),
  stock("SNAP", "Snap", 8.94, -4.8),
]

const DEFAULT_CANDIDATES: WatchStock[] = [
  stock("AAPL", "Apple", 228.02, 0.8),
  stock("MSFT", "Microsoft", 415.6, 1.2),
  stock("NVDA", "NVIDIA", 122.85, 2.6),
  stock("META", "Meta Platforms", 514.29, -0.7),
  stock("TSLA", "Tesla", 248.5, -1.9),
  stock("NFLX", "Netflix", 689.75, 0.4),
]

const H = 28
const OPEN_MINUTE = 9 * 60 + 30
const SESSION_MINUTES = 390

const usd = (v: number) => `$${v.toLocaleString("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}`
const signedPct = (v: number) => `${v >= 0 ? "+" : "−"}${Math.abs(v).toFixed(1)}%`
const clock = (i: number, n: number) => {
  const m = OPEN_MINUTE + Math.round((i / Math.max(1, n - 1)) * SESSION_MINUTES)
  return `${String(Math.floor(m / 60)).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(m % 60).padStart(2, "0")}`
}

function Row({
  stock: s,
  index,
  compact,
  dim,
  onHot,
  onSelect,
  renderIcon,
  removing,
  busy,
  onRemove,
}: {
  stock: WatchStock
  index: number
  compact: boolean
  dim: boolean
  onHot: (on: boolean) => void
  onSelect?: (ticker: string) => void
  renderIcon?: (symbol: string, size: number) => ReactNode
  /** this row's Remove went through: it holds, then leaves */
  removing: boolean
  /** another row is leaving */
  busy: boolean
  onRemove: () => void
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const mark = MARKS[s.ticker.toUpperCase()]
  const boxRef = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null)
  const [hi, setHi] = useState<number | null>(null)

  const data = s.series.length ? s.series : [s.price]
  const last = data.length - 1
  const max = Math.max(...data)
  const min = Math.min(...data)
  const span = Math.max(1e-9, max - min)
  const width = compact ? 72 : 90
  const x = (i: number) => 2 + (i / Math.max(1, last)) * (width - 4)
  const y = (v: number) => 3 + (1 - (v - min) / span) * (H - 6)
  const line = data.map((v, i) => `${i === 0 ? "M" : "L"} ${x(i).toFixed(2)} ${y(v).toFixed(2)}`).join(" ")
  const move = s.changePct ?? (data[0] ? ((data[last] - data[0]) / data[0]) * 100 : 0)
  const scale = data[last] ? s.price / data[last] : 1
  const hue = move >= 0 ? GREEN : RED

  const onMove = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    const el = boxRef.current
    if (!el) return
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect()
    setHi(Math.max(0, Math.min(last, Math.round(((e.clientX - r.left - 2) / (r.width - 4)) * last))))
  }

  return (
    /* the outer row owns the dim and the hover; the main part is the button that opens the
       share, the Remove sits beside it in its own column */
    <div
      className="group flex w-full items-center border-t border-foreground/[0.04] pr-3 transition-[opacity,background-color] duration-200 hover:bg-foreground/[0.03] focus-within:bg-foreground/[0.03]"
      style={{ opacity: dim ? 0.45 : 1, background: removing ? "color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 6%, transparent)" : undefined }}
      onPointerEnter={() => onHot(true)}
      onPointerLeave={() => onHot(false)}
      onFocus={() => onHot(true)}
      onBlur={() => onHot(false)}
    >
    <button
      type="button"
      aria-label={`${s.name}, ${usd(s.price)}, ${signedPct(move)} today`}
      onClick={() => onSelect?.(s.ticker)}
      className="block min-w-0 flex-1 text-left outline-none transition-[background-color,transform,translate,scale,rotate] duration-200 focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.06] active:scale-[0.98] motion-reduce:active:scale-100"
    >
      <motion.span
        className="grid items-center py-2.5 pl-3"
        style={{ columnGap: compact ? 10 : 14, gridTemplateColumns: `28px minmax(0,1fr) ${width}px minmax(${compact ? 68 : 76}px,auto)` }}
        initial={reduced ? false : { opacity: 0, y: 4 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
        transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.3, ease: EASE, delay: Math.min(index, 7) * 0.035 }}
      >
        {s.tile == null && renderIcon ? (
          renderIcon(s.ticker, 28)
        ) : s.tile == null && mark ? (
          <span
            aria-hidden
            className="grid h-7 w-7 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full text-[9px] font-semibold"
            style={{ background: mark.disc, color: mark.glyph ?? "var(--coin-glyph, #fff)" }}
          >
            {s.ticker.slice(0, 2)}
          </span>
        ) : (
          <span aria-hidden className="grid h-7 w-7 shrink-0 place-items-center overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-foreground/[0.07] text-[9px] font-semibold text-foreground/70">
            {s.tile ?? s.ticker.slice(0, 2)}
          </span>
        )}
        <span className="min-w-0">
          <span className="block truncate text-[12px] font-semibold leading-tight text-foreground/90">{s.ticker}</span>
          <span className="mt-0.5 block truncate text-[11px] text-foreground/60">{s.name}</span>
        </span>
        <span ref={boxRef} className="block cursor-crosshair touch-none" onPointerMove={onMove} onPointerLeave={() => setHi(null)}>
          <svg aria-hidden width={width} height={H} viewBox={`0 0 ${width} ${H}`} fill="none" className="block overflow-visible">
            <motion.path
              d={line}
              stroke={hue}
              strokeWidth="1.8"
              strokeLinecap="round"
              strokeLinejoin="round"
              initial={{ pathLength: reduced ? 1 : 0 }}
              animate={{ pathLength: 1 }}
              transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.4, ease: EASE, delay: Math.min(index, 7) * 0.035 }}
            />
            {hi !== null && (
              <g pointerEvents="none">
                <line x1={x(hi)} y1={0} x2={x(hi)} y2={H} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.28} strokeWidth="1" />
                <circle cx={x(hi)} cy={y(data[hi])} r="2.5" fill={hue} />
              </g>
            )}
          </svg>
        </span>
        {/* the price cell swaps in place under the scrub (text swap: 4px, 2px blur, 150ms) from a
            dimmed copy, so it never blinks out; reduced motion keeps the fade */}
        <motion.span
          key={hi ?? "rest"}
          role="status"
          className="block text-right"
          initial={reduced ? { opacity: 0.4 } : { opacity: 0.4, y: 4, filter: "blur(2px)" }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, filter: "blur(0px)" }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
        >
          <span className="block text-[12px] font-medium leading-tight text-foreground/90">{usd(hi === null ? s.price : data[hi] * scale)}</span>
          {hi === null ? (
            <span className="mt-0.5 block text-[10.5px] font-medium" style={{ color: ink(move >= 0 ? GREEN : RED) }}>
              {signedPct(move)}
            </span>
          ) : (
            <span className="mt-0.5 block text-[10.5px] text-foreground/45">{clock(hi, data.length)}</span>
          )}
        </motion.span>
      </motion.span>
    </button>
      {/* the row's own narrow end column: Remove comes up on hover or focus (row-action.tsx) */}
      <span className="flex w-[68px] shrink-0 justify-end">
        <RowAction
          done={removing}
          disabled={busy}
          onClick={onRemove}
          label="Remove"
          doneLabel="Removed"
          aria-label={removing ? `${s.ticker} removed` : `Remove ${s.ticker} from the watchlist`}
        />
      </span>
    </div>
  )
}

/**
 * A watchlist as rows on hairlines: mark, ticker over company, the session as a line,
 * price over the day's signed move. Scrubbing a line reads any moment in the price cell;
 * the + adds a ticker from a small search menu and each row can be removed in place.
 */
export function WatchlistStack({
  title = "Watchlist",
  stocks = DEFAULT_STOCKS,
  onAdd,
  onAddStock,
  onRemove,
  candidates = DEFAULT_CANDIDATES,
  onSelect,
  compact = false,
  renderIcon,
  className,
}: WatchlistStackProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const [hot, setHot] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [list, setList] = useState(stocks)
  useEffect(() => setList(stocks), [stocks])
  const [picking, setPicking] = useState(false)
  const { leaving, start } = useRowExit()
  const ups = list.filter((s) => (s.changePct ?? 0) >= 0).length
  const listed = new Set(list.map((s) => s.ticker))
  const offer = candidates.filter((c) => !listed.has(c.ticker))
  const closePicker = useCallback(() => setPicking(false), [])

  const add = (ticker: string) => {
    const s = candidates.find((c) => c.ticker === ticker)
    setPicking(false)
    if (!s) return
    setList((l) => [...l, s])
    onAddStock?.(s)
  }
  const remove = (ticker: string) => {
    if (leaving) return
    onRemove?.(ticker)
    start(ticker, () => {
      setList((l) => l.filter((s) => s.ticker !== ticker))
      setHot(null)
    })
  }

  return (
    <div className={cn("w-full max-w-[400px] tabular-nums [--ink-l:0.5] dark:[--ink-l:1]", className)} role="group" aria-label={`${title}, ${list.length} stocks, ${ups} up`}>
      <div className="relative flex justify-end px-3 pb-2">
        {/* the round + with its tip; it opens the add menu under it */}
        <span className="group/tip relative -mr-1.5 inline-flex">
          <button
            type="button"
            data-watchlist-add
            aria-label="Add stock"
            aria-haspopup="listbox"
            aria-expanded={picking}
            onClick={() => {
              setPicking((p) => !p)
              if (!picking) onAdd?.()
            }}
            className={cn(ICON_BUTTON, "h-7 w-7 active:scale-[0.97] motion-reduce:active:scale-100", picking && "bg-foreground/[0.06] text-foreground/90")}
          >
            <Plus size={14} strokeWidth={1.8} aria-hidden />
          </button>
          {!picking && (
            <span
              role="tooltip"
              className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-full right-0 mb-1.5 whitespace-nowrap rounded-[8px] border border-foreground/[0.08] px-2 py-1 text-[10.5px] text-foreground/90 opacity-0 transition-opacity duration-150 group-hover/tip:opacity-100 group-hover/tip:delay-300 group-has-[:focus-visible]/tip:opacity-100"
              style={{ background: "var(--tip-fill, color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 6%, var(--background)))" }}
            >
              Add stock
            </span>
          )}
        </span>
        <WatchlistPicker open={picking} items={offer} onPick={add} onClose={closePicker} renderIcon={renderIcon} />
      </div>
      <div onPointerLeave={() => setHot(null)}>
        <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
          {list.map((s, i) => (
            <motion.div key={s.ticker} className="overflow-hidden" layout={reduced ? false : "position"} exit={rowExit(reduced)} initial={false}>
              <Row
                stock={s}
                index={i}
                compact={compact}
                dim={(leaving ?? hot) !== null && (leaving ?? hot) !== s.ticker}
                onHot={(on) => setHot(on ? s.ticker : null)}
                onSelect={onSelect}
                renderIcon={renderIcon}
                removing={leaving === s.ticker}
                busy={leaving !== null}
                onRemove={() => remove(s.ticker)}
              />
            </motion.div>
          ))}
        </AnimatePresence>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

```tsx
/* Control classes: the library's control material for components that ship on their own
   (2026-10-02, the audit's pattern 11). src/components/library/controls.ts is the site's
   copy; components used to paste its look in as a flat 8% fill "so the file ships alone",
   and those copies never turned white on a raised light surface. These read the same
   tokens WITH a fallback, so they follow the site's raised-surface rule here and still
   draw correctly in a buyer's app that has no such tokens. Shipped beside every component
   that imports it (scripts/build-registry.mjs bundles ui helpers automatically).

   Whole class strings, never assembled from pieces: Tailwind reads this file as text. */

/** what is ON in a switcher. Light (his call, 2026-10-02, after the inline slider): a WHITE
 *  pill with a hairline and a soft shadow on the grey track. Dark: the 8% thumb */
export const THUMB =
  "bg-white shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--light-outline,rgba(0,0,0,0.09)),0_1px_3px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] dark:bg-[var(--control-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_8%,transparent))] dark:shadow-[var(--control-shadow,inset_0_1px_0_0_color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_6%,transparent))]"

/** what a switcher's options sit in; its 2px padding is the gap the thumb keeps. Light: a

export const TRACK = "rounded-full border border-transparent bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_5%,var(--background))] p-0.5 dark:border-foreground/[0.04] dark:bg-transparent"

/** an option that is off: the label alone answers the pointer */
export const SEGMENT_OFF = "text-foreground/60 hover:text-foreground/90"

/** a secondary button: the thumb standing alone; size it with h-7 / h-9 and px */
export const BUTTON =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--control-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_8%,transparent))] shadow-[var(--control-shadow,inset_0_1px_0_0_color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_6%,transparent))] text-foreground/90 outline-none transition-[color,background-color,scale] duration-150 hover:bg-[var(--control-fill-hover,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_12%,transparent))] focus-visible:bg-[var(--control-fill-hover,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_12%,transparent))] active:scale-[0.97] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40 motion-reduce:active:scale-100"

/** an icon-only control: no fill at rest, a faint one under the pointer */
export const ICON_BUTTON =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-full text-foreground/60 outline-none transition-[color,background-color] duration-150 hover:bg-foreground/[0.06] hover:text-foreground/90 focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.06]"

/** a field: the track with just enough fill to read as somewhere to type */
export const FIELD =
  "rounded-full border border-foreground/[0.04] bg-[var(--field-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_5%,transparent))] text-foreground/90 outline-none transition-[background-color,border-color] duration-150 placeholder:text-foreground/45 focus:border-foreground/[0.12]"

/** the one loud button of a form: 48px, full width, the foreground filled (the dashboards'

export const BUTTON_PRIMARY =
  "inline-flex h-12 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-foreground/[0.92] text-[14px] font-medium text-background outline-none transition-[background-color,scale,opacity] duration-150 hover:bg-foreground focus-visible:bg-foreground active:scale-[0.98] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40 motion-reduce:active:scale-100"
```

// ─── components/ui/row-action.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react"
import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"
import { Check } from "lucide-react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

/* Row action: an action that lives on a table row, and the way the row leaves after it
   (2026-10-02, out of Positions Table and the trading terminal).

   RowAction   a real button in the row's own last column, so it never sits over a figure.
               It comes up (4px, 150ms) on row hover or keyboard focus (the row carries
               `group`), and is always shown where there is no hover. Once pressed it turns
               to a tick and the past tense ("Closed").
   useRowExit  the hold: the row washes in the colour of its result and keeps its "Closed"
               for 420ms, then `onDone` takes it out of the list.
   rowExit     the motion the row's wrapper leaves with: 16px right as it fades while its
               height folds away (300ms), so the rows under it close up. Reduced motion
               keeps a fade.
   rowWash     the 10% wash in the result's colour. */

const LIFT_SPRING = { type: "spring", stiffness: 500, damping: 30 } as const
const SMOOTH = [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] as const
/** how long a finished row holds its "Closed" before it leaves */
export const ROW_HOLD_MS = 420

export function useRowExit(hold = ROW_HOLD_MS) {
  const [leaving, setLeaving] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const timer = useRef<number | undefined>(undefined)
  useEffect(() => () => window.clearTimeout(timer.current), [])
  /** hold row `id` in its finished state, then run `onDone` (which removes it) */
  const start = useCallback(
    (id: string, onDone: () => void) => {
      if (leaving) return
      setLeaving(id)
      timer.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
        onDone()
        setLeaving(null)
      }, hold)
    },
    [hold, leaving],
  )
  return { leaving, start }
}

export const rowExit = (reduced: boolean | null) =>
  reduced
    ? { opacity: 0, transition: { duration: 0.15 } }
    : { opacity: 0, x: 16, height: 0, transition: { duration: 0.3, ease: SMOOTH, height: { duration: 0.3, ease: SMOOTH, delay: 0.08 } } }

export const rowWash = (color: string) => `color-mix(in srgb, ${color} 10%, transparent)`

export function RowAction({
  done,
  disabled,
  onClick,
  label = "Close",
  doneLabel = "Closed",
  tone = "var(--foreground)",
  "aria-label": ariaLabel,
  children,
}: {
  /** the action has gone through: the button reads the past tense with a tick */
  done: boolean
  disabled?: boolean
  onClick: () => void
  label?: string
  doneLabel?: string
  /** the tick's colour: the result's hue */
  tone?: string
  "aria-label"?: string
  children?: ReactNode
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  return (
    <motion.button
      type="button"
      onClick={onClick}
      disabled={disabled}
      aria-label={ariaLabel}
      whileTap={reduced ? undefined : { scale: 0.97, transition: LIFT_SPRING }}
      className={cn(
        "inline-flex h-6 items-center gap-1 rounded-full px-2.5 text-[10.5px] font-medium text-foreground/90 outline-none",
        "transition-[opacity,transform,translate,background-color,color] duration-150 ease-out",
        done
          ? "translate-y-0 opacity-100"
          : "translate-y-1 bg-foreground/[0.08] opacity-0 hover:bg-foreground/[0.14] focus-visible:translate-y-0 focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.14] focus-visible:opacity-100 group-hover:translate-y-0 group-hover:opacity-100 [@media(hover:none)]:translate-y-0 [@media(hover:none)]:opacity-100",
      )}
    >
      {done ? (
        <>
          <Check size={11} strokeWidth={2.2} aria-hidden style={{ color: tone }} />
          {doneLabel}
        </>
      ) : (
        children ?? label
      )}
    </motion.button>
  )
}
```

```tsx
"use client"

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"
import { Search } from "lucide-react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { FIELD } from "@/components/ui/control-classes"

/* Watchlist Stack's add picker (2026-10-02 audit): the + opens this small menu, the look of
   the dashboards' Select (lab/screen/Select.tsx) copied in so the component ships alone. A
   search field and the tickers not on the list yet; the arrows move, Enter picks, Escape or
   a press outside closes. The menu is the library popover (6% foreground over the
   background, 8% hairline, the popover shadow); its corner is 18 = the 12px row corner +
   its 6px padding. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const

export interface PickerItem {
  ticker: string
  name: string
}

export function WatchlistPicker({
  open,
  items,
  onPick,
  onClose,
  renderIcon,
}: {
  open: boolean
  items: PickerItem[]
  onPick: (ticker: string) => void
  onClose: () => void
  renderIcon?: (symbol: string, size: number) => ReactNode
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const [q, setQ] = useState("")
  const [hi, setHi] = useState(0)
  const box = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const list = q.trim()
    ? items.filter((o) => `${o.ticker} ${o.name}`.toLowerCase().includes(q.trim().toLowerCase()))
    : items

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return
    setQ("")
    setHi(0)
    const away = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      const t = e.target as HTMLElement | null
      if (!box.current?.contains(t as Node) && !t?.closest("[data-watchlist-add]")) onClose()
    }
    window.addEventListener("pointerdown", away)
    return () => window.removeEventListener("pointerdown", away)
  }, [open, onClose])

  const onKey = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key === "Escape") {
      e.preventDefault()
      onClose()
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
      e.preventDefault()
      setHi((h) => Math.min(list.length - 1, h + 1))
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
      e.preventDefault()
      setHi((h) => Math.max(0, h - 1))
    } else if (e.key === "Enter" && list[hi]) {
      e.preventDefault()
      onPick(list[hi].ticker)
    }
  }

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {open && (
        <motion.div
          ref={box}
          key="picker"
          onKeyDown={onKey}
          className="absolute right-0 top-full z-20 mt-1.5 w-[220px] rounded-[18px] border border-foreground/[0.08] p-1.5"
          style={{
            background: "var(--tip-fill, color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 6%, var(--background)))",
            boxShadow: "0 8px 24px var(--card-shadow, rgba(0,0,0,calc(0.35 * var(--shadow-k, 1))))",
            transformOrigin: "top right",
          }}
          initial={reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, scale: 0.97, y: -4 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, transition: { duration: 0.12 } }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
        >
          <label className={cn("mb-1 flex h-9 items-center gap-2 px-3", FIELD)}>
            <Search size={13} className="shrink-0 text-foreground/60" aria-hidden />
            <input
              aria-label="Search tickers"
              autoFocus
              className="w-full bg-transparent text-[12px] outline-none placeholder:text-foreground/45"
              onChange={(e) => {
                setQ(e.target.value)
                setHi(0)
              }}
              placeholder="Search"
              value={q}
            />
          </label>
          <div role="listbox" aria-label="Tickers to add" className="max-h-[216px] overflow-y-auto">
            {list.length === 0 && <div className="px-2.5 py-2.5 text-[11.5px] text-foreground/60">Nothing left to add</div>}
            {list.map((o, i) => (
              <button
                key={o.ticker}
                type="button"
                role="option"
                aria-selected={i === hi}
                onPointerEnter={() => setHi(i)}
                onClick={() => onPick(o.ticker)}
                className={cn(
                  "flex h-9 w-full items-center gap-2.5 rounded-[12px] px-2.5 text-left outline-none transition-colors duration-150",
                  i === hi && "bg-foreground/[0.06]",
                )}
              >
                {renderIcon && <span className="grid h-5 w-5 shrink-0 place-items-center">{renderIcon(o.ticker, 20)}</span>}
                <span className="text-[12px] font-medium text-foreground/90">{o.ticker}</span>
                <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-[11px] text-foreground/60">{o.name}</span>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  )
}
```
