// ─── components/ui/live-toggle.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { createContext, useContext, type ReactNode } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { THUMB } from "@/components/ui/control-classes"

/* Live Toggle: the one play and pause control of the streaming components (Tape Flow,
   Trade Tape, Fills Blotter, New Items Pill).
   2026-10-02 round 2: his call, "I don't like the green dot in there, I feel like it should
   be better design ... still minimal. Give me a couple of options". Four options, all in
   ink on the control material, none with a dot, each a fixed width so the control never
   resizes between its two states:
   · a  Bars   a 28px pill; while live three thin bars rise and fall out of phase
              like an equaliser beside "Live"; paused, a filled play mark beside "Paused"
   · b  Line   a 28px pill; a hairline under the label carries a short glint gliding along it
              while live, a pause mark says what a press does; paused, a play mark
   · c  Morph  (default, his pick 2026-10-02) icon only, 28px round; the play mark morphs into the two pause bars, which
              breathe in turn while live
   · d  Word   text only; "Live" breathes in its letter weight (a variable font eases it,
              a static one steps), "Paused" sits still at /60
   Live takes the THUMB fill and full ink; paused is bare ink at /60 with a faint fill under
   the pointer. The label swaps in place (4px, 2px blur, 150ms). The signal moves only while
   `animate` is true (data is actually flowing) and never under reduced motion. Motion is
   transform only for a, b and c; d animates the weight. A page switches every toggle below
   it with <LiveToggleVariant variant="c">. */

export type LiveToggleVariantName = "a" | "b" | "c" | "d"

const VariantContext = createContext<LiveToggleVariantName>("c")

/** sets the look of every LiveToggle below it that does not name its own variant */
export function LiveToggleVariant({ variant, children }: { variant: LiveToggleVariantName; children: ReactNode }) {
  return <VariantContext.Provider value={variant}>{children}</VariantContext.Provider>
}

/** the variant in force here (the nearest LiveToggleVariant, or "c") */
export const useLiveToggleVariant = () => useContext(VariantContext)

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const

/** fixed widths: the longer label ("Paused") plus its mark and 12px sides */
const WIDTH: Record<LiveToggleVariantName, number> = { a: 88, b: 88, c: 28, d: 68 }

/* keyframes for the signals; each toggle carries the same small rule set */
const KEYFRAMES = `
@keyframes lt-eq { 0%, 100% { transform: scaleY(0.35) } 50% { transform: scaleY(1) } }
@keyframes lt-glint { 0% { transform: translateX(-100%) } 100% { transform: translateX(300%) } }
@keyframes lt-breathe { 0%, 100% { transform: scaleY(1) } 50% { transform: scaleY(0.62) } }
@keyframes lt-weight { 0%, 100% { font-weight: 460 } 50% { font-weight: 640 } }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .lt-sig { animation: none !important } }
`

const PILL =
  "relative inline-flex h-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[11px] outline-none transition-[color,background-color,scale] duration-150 focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.08] active:scale-[0.97] motion-reduce:active:scale-100"
const ON = `${THUMB} text-foreground/90`
const OFF = "text-foreground/60 hover:bg-foreground/[0.04] hover:text-foreground/90"

function PlayMark() {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 12 12" width={10} height={10} aria-hidden>
      <path d="M3.2 1.8 L10.2 6 L3.2 10.2 Z" fill="currentColor" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={1.2} strokeLinejoin="round" />
    </svg>
  )
}

function PauseMark() {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 12 12" width={10} height={10} aria-hidden>
      <rect x={2.6} y={2} width={2.4} height={8} rx={0.8} fill="currentColor" />
      <rect x={7} y={2} width={2.4} height={8} rx={0.8} fill="currentColor" />
    </svg>
  )
}

/** a: three 2px bars out of phase, the equaliser of something playing */
function Bars({ moving }: { moving: boolean }) {
  const bars = [
    { d: 1.05, delay: 0, rest: 0.55 },
    { d: 0.85, delay: -0.35, rest: 1 },
    { d: 1.25, delay: -0.7, rest: 0.7 },
  ]
  return (
    <span aria-hidden className="flex h-[10px] items-center gap-[2px]">
      {bars.map((b, i) => (
        <span
          key={i}
          className="lt-sig block h-full w-[2px] rounded-full bg-current"
          style={
            moving
              ? { animation: `lt-eq ${b.d}s ease-in-out ${b.delay}s infinite`, transformOrigin: "center" }
              : { transform: `scaleY(${b.rest})`, transition: "transform 250ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)" }
          }
        />
      ))}
    </span>
  )
}

/* c: play and pause drawn as the same two four-point shapes, so one morphs into the other.
   Points run top left, top right, bottom right, bottom left. */
const quad = (p: number[]) => `M${p[0]} ${p[1]} L${p[2]} ${p[3]} L${p[4]} ${p[5]} L${p[6]} ${p[7]} Z`
const PAUSE_L = quad([2.6, 2, 5, 2, 5, 10, 2.6, 10])
const PAUSE_R = quad([7, 2, 9.4, 2, 9.4, 10, 7, 10])
const PLAY_L = quad([3.2, 1.8, 7, 4.08, 7, 7.92, 3.2, 10.2])
const PLAY_R = quad([6.9, 4.02, 10.2, 6, 10.2, 6, 6.9, 7.98])

function Morph({ live, moving, reduced }: { live: boolean; moving: boolean; reduced: boolean }) {
  const t = reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.25, ease: EASE }
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 12 12" width={12} height={12} aria-hidden className="overflow-visible">
      {[
        { on: PAUSE_L, off: PLAY_L, delay: 0 },
        { on: PAUSE_R, off: PLAY_R, delay: -0.7 },
      ].map((s, i) => (
        <g
          key={i}
          className="lt-sig"
          style={{
            transformBox: "fill-box",
            transformOrigin: "center",
            animation: live && moving ? `lt-breathe 1.4s ease-in-out ${s.delay}s infinite` : undefined,
          }}
        >
          <motion.path initial={false} animate={{ d: live ? s.on : s.off }} transition={t} fill="currentColor" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={0.6} strokeLinejoin="round" />
        </g>
      ))}
    </svg>
  )
}

/** the label, swapped in place inside the fixed width */
function Label({ text, reduced, style, className }: { text: string; reduced: boolean; style?: React.CSSProperties; className?: string }) {
  return (
    <motion.span
      key={text}
      initial={reduced ? false : { opacity: 0, y: 4, filter: "blur(2px)" }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, filter: "blur(0px)" }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
      className={cn("whitespace-nowrap", className)}
      style={style}
    >
      {text}
    </motion.span>
  )
}

/** a mark that swaps through a 0.6 scale and a fade (150ms) */
function Swap({ k, children, reduced }: { k: string; children: ReactNode; reduced: boolean }) {
  return (
    <span aria-hidden className="relative grid h-3 w-3 shrink-0 place-items-center">
      <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
        <motion.span
          key={k}
          className="absolute inset-0 grid place-items-center"
          initial={reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, scale: 0.6 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
          exit={reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, scale: 0.6 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
        >
          {children}
        </motion.span>
      </AnimatePresence>
    </span>
  )
}

export interface LiveToggleProps {
  /** the feed is on */
  live: boolean
  onLiveChange: (next: boolean) => void
  /** the look; defaults to the nearest LiveToggleVariant, then "c" */
  variant?: LiveToggleVariantName
  /** the signal moves only while data is actually flowing; defaults to `live` */
  animate?: boolean
  labels?: { on: string; off: string }
  /** a fixed width in px, when the labels are longer than the defaults */
  width?: number
  "aria-label"?: string
  className?: string
}

/**
 * The live control of a streaming component: a press pauses the feed or plays it. Four
 * looks share one API (see the header); none of them changes width between states.
 */
export function LiveToggle({
  live,
  onLiveChange,
  variant,
  animate,
  labels = { on: "Live", off: "Paused" },
  width,
  "aria-label": ariaLabel,
  className,
}: LiveToggleProps) {
  const fromContext = useContext(VariantContext)
  const v = variant ?? fromContext
  const reduced = useReducedMotion() ?? false
  const moving = (animate ?? live) && !reduced
  const text = live ? labels.on : labels.off
  const w = width ?? WIDTH[v]

  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      aria-pressed={live}
      aria-label={ariaLabel ?? (live ? `${labels.on}, press to pause` : `${labels.off}, press to play`)}
      onClick={() => onLiveChange(!live)}
      className={cn(PILL, v !== "c" && "gap-1.5 px-3", live ? ON : OFF, className)}
      style={{ width: w }}
    >
      {/* inline, not hoisted: a preview frame or a shadow root gets its own copy */}
      <style>{KEYFRAMES}</style>

      {v === "a" && (
        <>
          <Swap k={live ? "bars" : "play"} reduced={reduced}>
            {live ? <Bars moving={moving} /> : <PlayMark />}
          </Swap>
          <Label text={text} reduced={reduced} />
        </>
      )}

      {v === "b" && (
        <>
          <Swap k={live ? "pause" : "play"} reduced={reduced}>
            {live ? <PauseMark /> : <PlayMark />}
          </Swap>
          <Label text={text} reduced={reduced} />
          {/* the hairline sits inside the straight run of the bottom edge, clear of the round ends */}
          <span aria-hidden className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-3 bottom-[4px] h-px overflow-hidden rounded-full">
            <span
              className="absolute inset-0 bg-current transition-opacity duration-200"
              style={{ opacity: live ? 0.12 : 0 }}
            />
            {moving && (
              <span
                className="lt-sig absolute inset-y-0 left-0 w-1/3 rounded-full"
                style={{
                  background: "linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, currentColor, transparent)",
                  opacity: 0.7,
                  animation: "lt-glint 1.8s cubic-bezier(0.45, 0, 0.55, 1) infinite",
                }}
              />
            )}
          </span>
        </>
      )}

      {v === "c" && <Morph live={live} moving={moving} reduced={reduced} />}

      {v === "d" && (
        <Label
          text={text}
          reduced={reduced}
          className="lt-sig"
          style={live && moving ? { animation: "lt-weight 2.4s ease-in-out infinite" } : { fontWeight: live ? 560 : 500 }}
        />
      )}
    </button>
  )
}
```

// ─── components/ui/use-pointed.ts ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react"

/* usePointed: live content runs only while it is being looked at (his call, 2026-10-02:
   "it should start animating only when you start hovering on it; anything with numbers
   that change can start once you hover on the component"). Spread `bind` on the
   component's root; `live` is true while the pointer is on it or focus is inside it, and
   stays true for `linger` ms after it leaves so a pass across the edge does not stop and
   start the feed. On a device with no hover (touch) it is true while the component is at
   least half in view instead, since a finger cannot point without pressing. */
export function usePointed<T extends HTMLElement = HTMLDivElement>({ linger = 600 } = {}) {
  const ref = useRef<T>(null)
  const [pointed, setPointed] = useState(false)
  const [seen, setSeen] = useState(false)
  const [touch] = useState(() => typeof matchMedia === "function" && !matchMedia("(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)").matches)
  const timer = useRef<number | undefined>(undefined)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!touch || !ref.current || typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined") return
    const io = new IntersectionObserver(([e]) => setSeen(e.isIntersecting), { threshold: 0.5 })
    io.observe(ref.current)
    return () => io.disconnect()
  }, [touch])
  useEffect(() => () => window.clearTimeout(timer.current), [])

  const on = () => {
    window.clearTimeout(timer.current)
    setPointed(true)
  }
  const off = () => {
    window.clearTimeout(timer.current)
    timer.current = window.setTimeout(() => setPointed(false), linger)
  }

  return {
    ref,
    live: touch ? seen : pointed,
    bind: {
      onPointerEnter: on,
      onPointerLeave: off,
      onFocus: on,
      onBlur: (e: React.FocusEvent) => {
        if (!e.currentTarget.contains(e.relatedTarget as Node | null)) off()
      },
    },
  }
}
```

```tsx
/* Control classes: the library's control material for components that ship on their own
   (2026-10-02, the audit's pattern 11). src/components/library/controls.ts is the site's
   copy; components used to paste its look in as a flat 8% fill "so the file ships alone",
   and those copies never turned white on a raised light surface. These read the same
   tokens WITH a fallback, so they follow the site's raised-surface rule here and still
   draw correctly in a buyer's app that has no such tokens. Shipped beside every component
   that imports it (scripts/build-registry.mjs bundles ui helpers automatically).

   Whole class strings, never assembled from pieces: Tailwind reads this file as text. */

/** what is ON in a switcher. Light (his call, 2026-10-02, after the inline slider): a WHITE
 *  pill with a hairline and a soft shadow on the grey track. Dark: the 8% thumb */
export const THUMB =
  "bg-white shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--light-outline,rgba(0,0,0,0.09)),0_1px_3px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] dark:bg-[var(--control-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_8%,transparent))] dark:shadow-[var(--control-shadow,inset_0_1px_0_0_color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_6%,transparent))]"

/** what a switcher's options sit in; its 2px padding is the gap the thumb keeps. Light: a
 *  light grey track with no outline, the white pill sits in it. Dark: a hairline, no fill */
export const TRACK = "rounded-full border border-transparent bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_5%,var(--background))] p-0.5 dark:border-foreground/[0.04] dark:bg-transparent"

/** an option that is off: the label alone answers the pointer */
export const SEGMENT_OFF = "text-foreground/60 hover:text-foreground/90"

/** a secondary button: the thumb standing alone; size it with h-7 / h-9 and px */
export const BUTTON =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--control-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_8%,transparent))] shadow-[var(--control-shadow,inset_0_1px_0_0_color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_6%,transparent))] text-foreground/90 outline-none transition-[color,background-color,scale] duration-150 hover:bg-[var(--control-fill-hover,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_12%,transparent))] focus-visible:bg-[var(--control-fill-hover,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_12%,transparent))] active:scale-[0.97] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40 motion-reduce:active:scale-100"

/** an icon-only control: no fill at rest, a faint one under the pointer */
export const ICON_BUTTON =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-full text-foreground/60 outline-none transition-[color,background-color] duration-150 hover:bg-foreground/[0.06] hover:text-foreground/90 focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.06]"

/** a field: the track with just enough fill to read as somewhere to type */
export const FIELD =
  "rounded-full border border-foreground/[0.04] bg-[var(--field-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_5%,transparent))] text-foreground/90 outline-none transition-[background-color,border-color] duration-150 placeholder:text-foreground/45 focus:border-foreground/[0.12]"

/** the one loud button of a form: 48px, full width, the foreground filled (the dashboards'
 *  Modal primary). A ticket, a swap, a confirm: one of these and nothing louder */
export const BUTTON_PRIMARY =
  "inline-flex h-12 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-foreground/[0.92] text-[14px] font-medium text-background outline-none transition-[background-color,scale,opacity] duration-150 hover:bg-foreground focus-visible:bg-foreground active:scale-[0.98] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40 motion-reduce:active:scale-100"

/** a component's own card, field or block (spec 14.8). Dark: a #121212 fill on black. Light
 *  (his call, 2026-10-02: "on light the card background is too dark, it can just be white, a
 *  quiet outline and a small shadow"): white, a 1px hairline (Kraken's #e7e6e9, or 9% ink in an app without the token) and a
 *  barely there shadow,
 *  drawn as box shadows so the outline takes no layout */
export const SURFACE =
  "bg-background shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--light-outline,color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_9%,transparent)),0_1px_2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] dark:bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_7%,var(--background))] dark:shadow-none"

/** a block sitting ON a surface: a faint 4% grey inside a white card in light, #1f1f1f in dark */
export const RAISED = "bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_4%,var(--background))] dark:bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_12%,var(--background))]"
```

# Agent Run Timeline (agent-run-timeline)
> An AI agent run timeline that shows each step with its tool call, duration and status, with the input and output one click away.

// ─── components/ui/agent-run-timeline.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useEffect, useState } from "react"
import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { RAISED, SURFACE } from "@/components/ui/control-classes"
import { usePointed } from "@/components/ui/use-pointed"

/* Agent Run Timeline, new through ssych-component (2026-09-29).
   What it is for: the steps of one agent run, in the order they ran.
   Read first: the step that is running. Its mark beats once a second and its state is
   the only one at full ink; under reduced motion the mark holds still.
   What the pointer does: pointing at a step dims the others; pressing it opens its
   input and output, which are literal code and so the only text set in mono.
   Sketch: src/components/lab/AgentRunTicker.tsx. Kept: one row per unit with the state
   as a mark and a word at the right end, the run id, the four-state vocabulary. Changed:
   it shows the steps of one run and not a rotating queue of runs, so the ticker, the
   live and calm chip and the hover expansion are gone; no outline, no capitals, no blue
   (done is green, waiting amber, a failure red, running full ink); the fixed progress hints per
   status are gone because nothing derived them.
   Reference: browsable "agent run". Ideas only, from the catalogue description of motiq
   "Agent Run Timeline", no code opened: an ordered rail of steps, each with its tool
   call and its output.
   Formulas:
   · done = steps whose state is done
   · so far = Σ durationMs of done, failed and running steps (1210 + 840 + 2310 + 4600
     = 8960 ms = 8.96 s); a running step carries the time elapsed when it was sampled
   · running time = the step's durationMs + the time the run has been pointed at since
     load, counted in 100 ms steps (it holds still at rest)
   2026-10-02: surfaces at 7% (raised blocks white in light, 12% in dark) so cards read on white and on black.
   2026-10-02 audit: the run now sits in a box he asked for, the 7% surface card at 24px
   with a 6px inset, so rows nest at 18px and the code blocks sit raised at 12px. The count
   and total left the header (they are in the aria-label), the tool column left the row so
   long step names have room (the tool is in the open detail and the aria-label), the dot
   alone carries the state's hue with the word in ink, and the running step counts up in
   place only while the run is pointed at (usePointed), holding still at rest. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const RED = "var(--chart-down)"
const GREEN = "var(--chart-up)"
const AMBER = "var(--chart-amber)"
const COLS = "grid-cols-[14px_minmax(0,1fr)_60px_52px]"

export type StepState = "done" | "running" | "waiting" | "failed"

export interface AgentStep {
  id: string
  /** what the step does */
  step: string
  /** the tool it calls */
  tool: string
  /** time taken; for a running step the time elapsed so far; none while waiting */
  durationMs?: number
  state: StepState
  /** literal input, as sent */
  input?: string
  /** literal output, as returned */
  output?: string
}

export interface AgentRunTimelineProps {
  runId?: string
  task?: string
  steps?: AgentStep[]
  /** id of the step that starts open; null starts closed */
  defaultOpen?: string | null
  className?: string
}

const DEFAULT_STEPS: AgentStep[] = [
  {
    id: "s1",
    step: "Plan",
    tool: "planner.plan",
    durationMs: 1210,
    state: "done",
    input: '{ "goal": "reconcile fills with the ledger", "date": "2026-09-28" }',
    output: '{ "steps": 5 }',
  },
  {
    id: "s2",
    step: "Fetch fills",
    tool: "broker.get_fills",
    durationMs: 840,
    state: "done",
    input: '{ "account": "DESK-7", "date": "2026-09-28" }',
    output: '{ "fills": 1284 }',
  },
  {
    id: "s3",
    step: "Match against ledger",
    tool: "sql.query",
    durationMs: 2310,
    state: "done",
    input: "select f.id from fills f\nleft join ledger l on l.fill_id = f.id\nwhere l.id is null",
    output: '{ "rows": 17, "scanned": 1284 }',
  },
  {
    id: "s4",
    step: "Draft exceptions report",
    tool: "llm.generate",
    durationMs: 4600,
    state: "running",
    input: '{ "model": "claude-sonnet-4-5", "rows": 17, "max_tokens": 1200 }',
  },
  {
    id: "s5",
    step: "Send to review queue",
    tool: "queue.push",
    state: "waiting",
    input: '{ "queue": "ops-review", "items": 17 }',
  },
]

const took = (ms: number) => (ms < 1000 ? `${ms} ms` : `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(2)} s`)
const ink = (pct: number) => `color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) ${pct}%, transparent)`

/* state is a direction (2026-09-30): done is green, failed red, waiting amber; the running
   step stays full ink and carries the beat */
const MARK: Record<StepState, string> = { done: GREEN, running: ink(100), waiting: AMBER, failed: RED }
const WORD: Record<StepState, string> = { done: "Done", running: "Running", waiting: "Waiting", failed: "Failed" }

function Code({ label, children }: { label: string; children: string }) {
  return (
    <div>
      <div className="text-[10.5px] text-foreground/45">{label}</div>
      <pre className={cn("mt-1 overflow-hidden whitespace-pre-wrap break-words rounded-[12px] px-3 py-2.5 font-mono text-[11px] leading-[1.5] text-foreground/80", RAISED)}>
        {children}
      </pre>
    </div>
  )
}

/**
 * One run as a rail of steps: the step, its tool, how long it took and where it stands.
 * The running step beats once a second; any step opens to what went in and what came out.
 */
export function AgentRunTimeline({
  runId = "run-4821",
  task = "Reconcile fills with the ledger",
  steps = DEFAULT_STEPS,
  defaultOpen = "s3",
  className,
}: AgentRunTimelineProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<string | null>(defaultOpen)
  const [hot, setHot] = useState<string | null>(null)
  /* steps rise in once, 40ms apart; after that the hover dim is quick */
  const [landed, setLanded] = useState(false)
  useEffect(() => {
    const t = setTimeout(() => setLanded(true), reduced ? 0 : Math.min(steps.length, 8) * 40 + 320)
    return () => clearTimeout(t)
  }, [reduced, steps.length])

  /* the running step counts up only while the run is pointed at (his call 2026-10-02);
     at rest it holds the time it was sampled at */
  const { ref, live: pointed, bind } = usePointed()
  const [extra, setExtra] = useState(0)
  const hasRunning = steps.some((s) => s.state === "running")
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!pointed || !hasRunning) return
    const t = window.setInterval(() => setExtra((e) => e + 100), 100)
    return () => window.clearInterval(t)
  }, [pointed, hasRunning])
  const ms = (s: AgentStep) => (s.durationMs === undefined ? undefined : s.durationMs + (s.state === "running" ? extra : 0))

  const done = steps.filter((s) => s.state === "done").length
  const soFar = steps.reduce((sum, s) => (s.state === "waiting" ? sum : sum + (ms(s) ?? 0)), 0)
  const running = steps.find((s) => s.state === "running")

  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      {...bind}
      className={cn("w-[440px] max-w-full rounded-[24px] p-1.5 tabular-nums", SURFACE, className)}
      role="group"
      aria-label={`${runId}, ${task}. ${done} of ${steps.length} steps done, ${took(soFar)} so far${running ? `, running: ${running.step}` : ""}`}
    >
      {/* the run id is the one name (2026-10-01); the task, the count and the total are read
          out in the group's aria-label, so nothing sums the run at rest (spec 13.1) */}
      <div className="flex h-9 items-center px-3">
        <span className="min-w-0 truncate text-[12px] font-medium text-foreground/90">{runId}</span>
      </div>

      <div role="list" onPointerLeave={() => setHot(null)}>
        {steps.map((s, i) => {
          const on = open === s.id
          const live = s.state === "running"
          return (
            <motion.div
              key={s.id}
              role="listitem"
              className="relative"
              initial={reduced ? false : { opacity: 0, y: 6 }}
              animate={{ opacity: hot !== null && hot !== s.id ? 0.5 : 1, y: 0 }}
              transition={
                reduced
                  ? { duration: 0.2 }
                  : landed
                    ? { duration: 0.2, ease: EASE }
                    : { duration: 0.3, ease: EASE, delay: Math.min(i, 7) * 0.04 }
              }
            >
              {/* the rail runs between the marks and never under them, so it needs no ground to hide behind */}
              {i > 0 && <span aria-hidden className="absolute left-[18.5px] top-0 h-[11px] w-px bg-foreground/[0.08]" />}
              {i < steps.length - 1 && <span aria-hidden className="absolute bottom-0 left-[18.5px] top-[25px] w-px bg-foreground/[0.08]" />}

              <button
                type="button"
                aria-expanded={on}
                aria-label={`Step ${i + 1}, ${s.step}, ${s.tool}, ${ms(s) === undefined ? "" : `${took(ms(s)!)}, `}${WORD[s.state].toLowerCase()}`}
                onClick={() => setOpen(on ? null : s.id)}
                onPointerEnter={() => setHot(s.id)}
                onFocus={() => setHot(s.id)}
                onBlur={() => setHot(null)}
                className={cn(
                  "grid h-9 w-full items-center gap-x-2.5 rounded-[18px] px-3 text-left outline-none transition-[background-color,transform,translate,scale,rotate] duration-150 hover:bg-foreground/[0.04] focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.06] active:scale-[0.99] motion-reduce:active:scale-100",
                  COLS,
                )}
              >
                <span aria-hidden className="grid h-3.5 w-3.5 place-items-center">
                  <motion.span
                    className="block h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full"
                    style={{ background: MARK[s.state] }}
                    animate={live && !reduced ? { opacity: [1, 0.25, 1] } : { opacity: 1 }}
                    transition={live && !reduced ? { duration: 1, repeat: Infinity, ease: "easeInOut" } : { duration: 0 }}
                  />
                </span>
                <span className={cn("truncate text-[12.5px]", s.state === "waiting" ? "text-foreground/45" : "font-medium text-foreground/90")}>{s.step}</span>
                {/* the time changes in place on each 100 ms step, no re-entry (spec 13.4) */}
                <span className="text-right text-[11px] text-foreground/70">{ms(s) === undefined ? "" : took(ms(s)!)}</span>
                {/* the dot carries the hue; the word stays in ink (RULEBOOK 3.5) */}
                <span className={cn("text-right text-[11px]", live ? "font-medium text-foreground/90" : "text-foreground/45")}>{WORD[s.state]}</span>
              </button>

              {/* the detail opens on grid rows, 0fr to 1fr in 250ms, and fades with it */}
              <div
                inert={!on}
                className="grid transition-[grid-template-rows,opacity] duration-[250ms] motion-reduce:transition-none"
                style={{ gridTemplateRows: on ? "1fr" : "0fr", opacity: on ? 1 : 0, transitionTimingFunction: "cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)" }}
              >
                <div className="min-h-0 overflow-hidden">
                    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 pb-3 pl-9 pr-3 pt-1">
                      <div className="text-[10.5px] text-foreground/45">
                        Tool <span className="font-mono text-foreground/70">{s.tool}</span>
                      </div>
                      {s.input !== undefined && <Code label="Input">{s.input}</Code>}
                      {s.output !== undefined ? (
                        <Code label="Output">{s.output}</Code>
                      ) : (
                        <div className="text-[10.5px] text-foreground/45">{live ? "Output still arriving" : s.state === "waiting" ? "Not started" : "No output"}</div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </motion.div>
          )
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

```tsx
/** an icon-only control: no fill at rest, a faint one under the pointer */

/** a field: the track with just enough fill to read as somewhere to type */

/** the one loud button of a form: 48px, full width, the foreground filled (the dashboards'

export const BUTTON_PRIMARY =
  "inline-flex h-12 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-foreground/[0.92] text-[14px] font-medium text-background outline-none transition-[background-color,scale,opacity] duration-150 hover:bg-foreground focus-visible:bg-foreground active:scale-[0.98] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40 motion-reduce:active:scale-100"

/** a component's own card, field or block (spec 14.8). Dark: a #121212 fill on black. Light

/** a block sitting ON a surface: a faint 4% grey inside a white card in light, #1f1f1f in dark */
```

// ─── components/ui/use-pointed.ts ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react"

/* usePointed: live content runs only while it is being looked at (his call, 2026-10-02:
   "it should start animating only when you start hovering on it; anything with numbers
   that change can start once you hover on the component"). Spread `bind` on the
   component's root; `live` is true while the pointer is on it or focus is inside it, and
   stays true for `linger` ms after it leaves so a pass across the edge does not stop and
   start the feed. On a device with no hover (touch) it is true while the component is at
   least half in view instead, since a finger cannot point without pressing. */
export function usePointed<T extends HTMLElement = HTMLDivElement>({ linger = 600 } = {}) {
  const ref = useRef<T>(null)
  const [pointed, setPointed] = useState(false)
  const [seen, setSeen] = useState(false)
  const [touch] = useState(() => typeof matchMedia === "function" && !matchMedia("(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)").matches)
  const timer = useRef<number | undefined>(undefined)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!touch || !ref.current || typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined") return
    const io = new IntersectionObserver(([e]) => setSeen(e.isIntersecting), { threshold: 0.5 })
    io.observe(ref.current)
    return () => io.disconnect()
  }, [touch])
  useEffect(() => () => window.clearTimeout(timer.current), [])

  const on = () => {
    window.clearTimeout(timer.current)
    setPointed(true)
  }
  const off = () => {
    window.clearTimeout(timer.current)
    timer.current = window.setTimeout(() => setPointed(false), linger)
  }

  return {
    ref,
    live: touch ? seen : pointed,
    bind: {
      onPointerEnter: on,
      onPointerLeave: off,
      onFocus: on,
      onBlur: (e: React.FocusEvent) => {
        if (!e.currentTarget.contains(e.relatedTarget as Node | null)) off()
      },
    },
  }
}
```

# Model Comparison (model-comparison)
> An LLM comparison table of quality, latency, cost per million tokens and context window, showing each gap to the best model.

// ─── components/ui/model-comparison.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react"
import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { ChartCard } from "@/components/ui/chart-overlay"
import { ModelMark, modelMaker, type ModelMaker } from "@/components/ui/model-comparison-marks"

/* Model Comparison, written new through ssych-component (2026-09-29).
   What it is for: choosing between two to four models on the same four measures.
   Read first: the full-ink value in each row. It is the best one on that measure; the
   others step back to /60 with their bars at /25.
   The pointer: pointing at a value lights its row and its column with one glide fill and
   opens a card beside it (the model, the value, how far behind the best, and on the cost
   row the blend). A click pins the cell; a second click lets it go.
   Colour: none. The columns are already apart in space, so every bar is ink.
   Reference: browsable "model comparison" (descriptions only, no source read). Idea taken:
   the winner of a row is shown by strength and the others are dimmed, with no badge.
   Formulas:
   · blended cost per million = (3 × input price + output price) / 4, a 3 to 1 mix of input
     to output tokens                                        (3 × $3.00 + $15.00) / 4 = $6.00
   · best of a row = the highest value where more is better (quality, context), the lowest
     where less is better (latency, cost); equal values share it
   · bar length = value / best where more is better, best / value where less is better
   · gap = value − best, shown without its sign and named "behind"
   The values are sample values, not published figures.
   2026-10-02 audit: redesigned as a plain table on his note about the dots. The coloured dot
   by each name and the per-model hues are gone (the columns are apart in space, so the bars
   are ink: the best of a row full ink, the rest /25, the pointed one full); the "best on"
   line under each name is cut; model names are table heads at 10.5px /45 (the pointed one
   /90); the unit moved into the measure label at 11px /60; the explainer line under the grid
   is gone, the blend formula now sits in the Cost label's tooltip and in the cost card;
   pointing lights the row and the column together with one glide fill and opens a ChartCard
   by the cell; a click pins the cell. Width 440, the AI and operations list width.
   2026-10-02 round 2: his note asked for real icons for the actual models. The default models
   are one from each maker now, Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-5 and Gemini 3 Pro, with plausible
   figures (sample values still, not published ones), and each column head carries its
   maker's mark at 12px beside the name. The marks are the Claude, OpenAI and Google Gemini
   marks from Simple Icons (CC0), drawn inline in model-comparison-marks.tsx. They come in
   through a `renderIcon(name, size, model)` prop whose default draws these marks (the maker
   is read from the name, or from the new optional `maker` field); pass your own to draw
   other marks, or null for none. The blend on the defaults: Claude (3 × $5.00 + $25.00) ÷ 4
   = $10.00, GPT-5 (3 × $1.25 + $10.00) ÷ 4 = $3.44, Gemini (3 × $2.00 + $12.00) ÷ 4 = $4.50. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GLIDE = { type: "spring", stiffness: 520, damping: 40 } as const
/** input tokens per output token in the blended cost */
const MIX = 3

export interface ComparedModel {
  name: string
  /** eval score, 0 to 100 */
  quality: number
  /** seconds to the first token */
  latency: number
  /** dollars per million input tokens */
  inputPrice: number
  /** dollars per million output tokens */
  outputPrice: number
  /** context size in tokens */
  context: number
  /** whose model it is, for its mark; read from the name when absent */
  maker?: ModelMaker
}

export interface ModelComparisonProps {
  /** two to four models; more than four are cut to the first four */
  models?: ComparedModel[]
  /** the table's screen-reader name; the model names head the columns, so nothing is drawn */
  title?: string
  /** draws a model's mark beside its column head; the Claude, OpenAI and Gemini marks by
   *  default, null for none */
  renderIcon?: ((name: string, size: number, model: ComparedModel) => ReactNode) | null
  className?: string
}

const defaultIcon = (name: string, size: number, model: ComparedModel) => <ModelMark maker={model.maker ?? modelMaker(name)} size={size} />

const DEFAULT_MODELS: ComparedModel[] = [
  { name: "Claude Opus 5.5", maker: "anthropic", quality: 92.4, latency: 1.9, inputPrice: 5, outputPrice: 25, context: 1000000 },
  { name: "GPT-5", maker: "openai", quality: 90.6, latency: 2.4, inputPrice: 1.25, outputPrice: 10, context: 400000 },
  { name: "Gemini 3 Pro", maker: "google", quality: 91.3, latency: 1.4, inputPrice: 2, outputPrice: 12, context: 1000000 },
]

const blended = (m: ComparedModel) => (MIX * m.inputPrice + m.outputPrice) / (MIX + 1)
const dollars = (v: number) => `$${v.toFixed(2)}`
const tokens = (v: number) => (v >= 1e6 ? `${Number((v / 1e6).toFixed(1))}M` : `${Math.round(v / 1e3)}K`)
const BLEND = `Blended ${MIX} to 1, input to output: (${MIX} × input + output) ÷ ${MIX + 1}`

interface Measure {
  id: string
  /** the label with its unit, as drawn */
  label: string
  /** the unit as read aloud */
  unit: string
  more: boolean
  get: (m: ComparedModel) => number
  show: (v: number) => string
  gap: (v: number) => string
}

const MEASURES: Measure[] = [
  { id: "quality", label: "Quality, of 100", unit: "score of 100", more: true, get: (m) => m.quality, show: (v) => v.toFixed(1), gap: (v) => `${v.toFixed(1)} pts` },
  { id: "latency", label: "Latency, s", unit: "seconds to first token", more: false, get: (m) => m.latency, show: (v) => `${v.toFixed(1)} s`, gap: (v) => `${v.toFixed(1)} s` },
  { id: "cost", label: "Cost per 1M", unit: "per million tokens", more: false, get: blended, show: dollars, gap: dollars },
  { id: "context", label: "Context", unit: "tokens", more: true, get: (m) => m.context, show: tokens, gap: tokens },
]

type Cell = { row: number; col: number }
type Box = { left: number; top: number; width: number; height: number }

/**
 * Models side by side as a plain table: one column per model, one row per measure, a value
 * over a 2px ink bar in every cell. The best value of a row is full ink, the rest step back,
 * so the winner of each measure reads without a legend or a colour.
 */
export function ModelComparison({ models = DEFAULT_MODELS, title = "Models", renderIcon = defaultIcon, className }: ModelComparisonProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const boxRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const [hover, setHover] = useState<Cell | null>(null)
  const [pin, setPin] = useState<Cell | null>(null)
  const [boxes, setBoxes] = useState<Record<string, Box>>({})
  const hot = hover ?? pin
  const cols = models.slice(0, 4)

  const rows = MEASURES.map((ms) => {
    const values = cols.map(ms.get)
    const best = ms.more ? Math.max(...values) : Math.min(...values)
    return { ...ms, values, best, leader: cols[values.indexOf(best)]?.name ?? "" }
  })

  const template = { gridTemplateColumns: `96px repeat(${cols.length}, minmax(0, 1fr))` }
  const key = (c: Cell) => `${c.row}-${c.col}`
  /* each cell reports where it sits once it is pointed at, so the glide fill and the card
     can find it without measuring the whole table */
  const note = (c: Cell, el: HTMLElement) => {
    const table = boxRef.current
    const root = table?.getBoundingClientRect()
    const own = el.getBoundingClientRect()
    if (!table || !root) return
    /* the drawn box is in screen pixels, which a scaled preview shrinks; the fills are laid out in
       the table's own pixels, so the offset is turned back by that scale (2026-10-02: in a scaled
       card the row and column fills landed off their cells) */
    const k = root.width / (table.offsetWidth || root.width) || 1
    const b = { left: (own.left - root.left) / k, top: (own.top - root.top) / k, width: el.offsetWidth, height: el.offsetHeight }
    setBoxes((all) => (all[key(c)]?.left === b.left && all[key(c)]?.top === b.top ? all : { ...all, [key(c)]: b }))
  }
  const box = hot ? boxes[key(hot)] : undefined
  const full = boxRef.current
  const totalW = full?.offsetWidth ?? 440
  const totalH = full?.offsetHeight ?? 0
  const flip = box ? box.left + box.width / 2 > totalW * 0.6 : false

  const r = hot ? rows[hot.row] : undefined
  const m = hot ? cols[hot.col] : undefined
  const v = hot && r ? r.values[hot.col] : 0
  const isBest = r ? v === r.best : false

  return (
    <div
      ref={boxRef}
      className={cn("relative w-[440px] max-w-full tabular-nums", className)}
      role="table"
      aria-label={`${title}: ${cols.map((x) => x.name).join(", ")} compared on ${rows.map((x) => x.id).join(", ")}`}
      onPointerLeave={() => setHover(null)}
    >
      {/* one glide fill for the pointed row and one for its column: they light together */}
      {box && (
        <>
          <motion.span
            aria-hidden
            className="pointer-events-none absolute left-0 right-0 rounded-[12px] bg-foreground/[0.04]"
            initial={false}
            animate={{ top: box.top, height: box.height }}
            transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : GLIDE}
          />
          <motion.span
            aria-hidden
            className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 rounded-[12px] bg-foreground/[0.04]"
            initial={false}
            animate={{ left: box.left, width: box.width, height: totalH }}
            transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : GLIDE}
          />
        </>
      )}

      <div role="row" className="relative grid h-8 items-center gap-x-2 border-b border-foreground/[0.04]" style={template}>
        {/* the corner over the measure names stays empty: the column heads already say these are models */}
        <span role="columnheader" aria-label="Measure" />
        {cols.map((x, c) => (
          <span
            key={x.name}
            role="columnheader"
            className={cn(
              "flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1.5 px-2 text-[10.5px] transition-colors duration-200 motion-reduce:transition-none",
              hot?.col === c ? "text-foreground/90" : "text-foreground/45",
            )}
            title={x.name}
          >
            {renderIcon?.(x.name, 12, x)}
            <span className="min-w-0 truncate">{x.name}</span>
          </span>
        ))}
      </div>

      {rows.map((row, ri) => (
        <div key={row.id} role="row" className="relative grid items-center gap-x-2" style={template}>
          <span
            role="rowheader"
            className={cn("pl-2 text-[11px] transition-colors duration-200 motion-reduce:transition-none", hot?.row === ri ? "text-foreground/90" : "text-foreground/60")}
            title={row.id === "cost" ? BLEND : undefined}
          >
            {row.label}
          </span>

          {row.values.map((val, c) => {
            const best = val === row.best
            const on = hot?.row === ri && hot.col === c
            const pinned = pin?.row === ri && pin.col === c
            const len = row.more ? val / (row.best || 1) : row.best / (val || 1)
            return (
              <span key={cols[c].name} role="cell" className="min-w-0">
              <button
                type="button"
                aria-label={`${cols[c].name}, ${row.id} ${row.show(val)} ${row.unit}${best ? ", best" : `, ${row.gap(Math.abs(val - row.best))} behind ${row.leader}`}`}
                aria-pressed={pinned}
                onPointerEnter={(e) => {
                  note({ row: ri, col: c }, e.currentTarget)
                  setHover({ row: ri, col: c })
                }}
                onFocus={(e) => {
                  note({ row: ri, col: c }, e.currentTarget)
                  setHover({ row: ri, col: c })
                }}
                onBlur={() => setHover(null)}
                onClick={() => setPin((p) => (p && p.row === ri && p.col === c ? null : { row: ri, col: c }))}
                className="block w-full rounded-[12px] px-2 py-2.5 text-left outline-none transition-[scale] duration-150 focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.04] active:scale-[0.97] motion-reduce:active:scale-100"
              >
                <span className={cn("block text-[12.5px]", best ? "font-medium text-foreground/90" : "text-foreground/60")}>{row.show(val)}</span>
                <span aria-hidden className="mt-1.5 block h-[2px] w-full rounded-full bg-foreground/[0.06]">
                  <motion.span
                    className="block h-full origin-left rounded-full"
                    style={{
                      width: `${Math.max(0.03, Math.min(1, len)) * 100}%`,
                      background: `color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) ${on || best ? 90 : 25}%, transparent)`,
                      transition: reduced ? "none" : "background 160ms",
                    }}
                    initial={reduced ? false : { scaleX: 0 }}
                    animate={{ scaleX: 1 }}
                    transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.35, ease: EASE, delay: ri * 0.035 + c * 0.02 }}
                  />
                </span>
              </button>
              </span>
            )
          })}
        </div>
      ))}

      {/* the pointed cell reads out in the library popover beside it (spec 13.5, 14.6) */}
      <ChartCard
        open={!!(hot && box && r && m)}
        x={box ? (flip ? box.left : box.left + box.width - 12) : 0}
        y={box ? box.top : 0}
        flip={flip}
        width={156}
        heading={m?.name ?? ""}
        rows={
          r && m
            ? [
                { label: r.id === "cost" ? "Cost per 1M" : r.label.split(",")[0], value: r.show(v) },
                { label: "Behind best", value: isBest ? "Best" : r.gap(Math.abs(v - r.best)) },
                ...(r.id === "cost"
                  ? [
                      { label: "Input", value: dollars(m.inputPrice) },
                      { label: "Output", value: dollars(m.outputPrice) },
                    ]
                  : []),
              ]
            : []
        }
        footer={
          r?.id === "cost" && m ? (
            <span className="text-foreground/60">
              ({MIX} × {dollars(m.inputPrice)} + {dollars(m.outputPrice)}) ÷ {MIX + 1}
            </span>
          ) : undefined
        }
      />
    </div>
  )
}
```

// ─── components/ui/chart-overlay.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { type ReactNode } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

/* Chart overlay: the two parts every library chart reads a point with (2026-10-02). They
   came out of Candlestick, Volume Profile, the trading terminal and Price Scrubber, which
   had each drawn their own; this is the one copy. Shipped beside the charts that use it.

   AxisTag   the outlined tag on the value axis: the pointed value in its hue, or a named
             reference (POC, last close) in ink. A pill 16px high, 8.5px figures.
   ChartCard the card laid over the chart beside the cursor: a heading row (a time or a
             range) at /60, then label and value rows (labels 10px /60, values 11px /90),
             the one signed figure in its hue. It glides between points on a spring, fades
             in from 0.97 and out in 120ms, and flips to the cursor's left when told to.

   2026-10-02: the card looked out of place over the charts, so it now wears the library
   popover, the same as the sidebar's hover card: a hairline border at 8%, radius 12, the
   6% foreground mix and the popover shadow with no inset highlight (spec 14.6). */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GLIDE = { type: "spring", stiffness: 520, damping: 40 } as const

/** the outlined tag on a chart's value axis, centred on `y` */
export function AxisTag({
  x,
  y,
  width,
  color = "var(--foreground)",
  strong = true,
  hidden = false,
  children,
}: {
  /** the tag's left edge, in the chart's own units */
  x: number
  /** the value's line; the tag is centred on it */
  y: number
  width: number
  /** stroke and figure; ink for a named reference, the series hue for the pointed value */
  color?: string
  /** a quieter tag (a secondary reference) drops the weight and the stroke */
  strong?: boolean
  /** fades the tag out, for when the pointed value sits on it */
  hidden?: boolean
  children: ReactNode
}) {
  return (
    <g transform={`translate(${x}, ${y - 8})`} pointerEvents="none" style={{ opacity: hidden ? 0 : 1, transition: "opacity 150ms" }}>
      <rect width={width} height={16} rx={8} fill="var(--background)" stroke={color} strokeOpacity={strong ? 0.6 : 0.2} />
      <text x={width / 2} y={11} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={8.5} fontWeight={strong ? 600 : 500} fill={color} fillOpacity={strong ? 1 : 0.65}>
        {children}
      </text>
    </g>
  )
}

export interface ChartCardRow {
  label: string
  value: ReactNode
  /** only the one signed figure carries a hue */
  color?: string
}

/** the readout card over a chart; place it inside a `relative` box that holds the svg */
export function ChartCard({
  open,
  x,
  y = 4,
  flip = false,
  width = 148,
  heading,
  rows,
  footer,
}: {
  open: boolean
  /** the cursor's x inside the box: px, or a percentage string for a chart drawn to a viewBox */
  x: number | string
  /** the card's top inside the box, px */
  y?: number
  /** put the card on the cursor's left (past ~60% of the plot) */
  flip?: boolean
  width?: number
  heading: ReactNode
  rows: ChartCardRow[]
  /** a closing line under the rows, such as where the point sits */
  footer?: ReactNode
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {open && (
        <motion.div
          key="chart-card"
          role="status"
          className="pointer-events-none absolute z-10"
          initial={{ left: x, top: y, opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ left: x, top: y, opacity: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, transition: { duration: 0.12 } }}
          transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { left: GLIDE, top: GLIDE, opacity: { duration: 0.15 } }}
        >
          <motion.div
            className="rounded-[12px] border border-foreground/[0.08] px-3 py-2.5"
            style={{
              width,
              translate: flip ? "calc(-100% - 12px) 0" : "12px 0",
              transition: reduced ? undefined : "translate 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)",
              background: "var(--tip-fill, color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 6%, var(--background)))",
              boxShadow: "0 8px 24px var(--card-shadow, rgba(0,0,0,calc(0.35 * var(--shadow-k, 1))))",
            }}
            initial={reduced ? false : { scale: 0.97 }}
            animate={{ scale: 1 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
          >
            <div className="text-[10px] text-foreground/60">{heading}</div>
            <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-col gap-1">
              {rows.map((r) => (
                <div key={r.label} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-foreground/60">{r.label}</span>
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-foreground/90" style={r.color ? { color: r.color } : undefined}>
                    {r.value}
                  </span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            {footer && <div className="mt-1.5 text-[10px]">{footer}</div>}
          </motion.div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  )
}
```

```tsx
  google:
    "M11.04 19.32Q12 21.51 12 24q0-2.49.93-4.68.96-2.19 2.58-3.81t3.81-2.55Q21.51 12 24 12q-2.49 0-4.68-.93a12.3 12.3 0 0 1-3.81-2.58 12.3 12.3 0 0 1-2.58-3.81Q12 2.49 12 0q0 2.49-.96 4.68-.93 2.19-2.55 3.81a12.3 12.3 0 0 1-3.81 2.58Q2.49 12 0 12q2.49 0 4.68.96 2.19.93 3.81 2.55t2.55 3.81",

const INK: Record<ModelMaker, string> = {
  anthropic: "var(--brand-claude, #d97757)",
  openai: "color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 90%, transparent)",
  google: "var(--brand-gemini, #8e75b2)",
}

const TITLE: Record<ModelMaker, string> = { anthropic: "Anthropic", openai: "OpenAI", google: "Google" }

/** the maker named in a model's name: Claude is Anthropic, GPT and o-series are OpenAI, Gemini is Google */
export function modelMaker(name: string): ModelMaker | undefined {
  const n = name.toLowerCase()
  if (/claude|anthropic/.test(n)) return "anthropic"
  if (/\bgpt|openai|\bo[1-9]\b|chatgpt/.test(n)) return "openai"
  if (/gemini|google/.test(n)) return "google"
  return undefined
}

/** a maker's mark at `size` px, or nothing when the maker is not one of the three */
export function ModelMark({ maker, size = 12, className }: { maker?: ModelMaker; size?: number; className?: string }): ReactNode {
  if (!maker) return null
  return (
    /* hidden from a screen reader: the model's name sits beside it and says the maker */
    <svg aria-hidden data-maker={TITLE[maker]} width={size} height={size} viewBox="0 0 24 24" className={className} style={{ flexShrink: 0 }}>
      <path d={PATHS[maker]} fill={INK[maker]} />
    </svg>
  )
}
```

# Tool Call Card (tool-call-card)
> An AI agent tool call card that shows the arguments, result, duration and status of one call, with a run again action.

// ─── components/ui/tool-call-card.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useEffect, useState } from "react"
import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { BUTTON, RAISED, SURFACE } from "@/components/ui/control-classes"

/* Tool Call Card, new through ssych-component (2026-09-29).
   What it is for: one call an agent made to a tool, with what went in and what came back.
   Read first: the head line: the tool, its state as a word, and how long it took.
   What the pointer does: pressing the head folds or opens the card; "Run again" sends
   the call again, so the card shows running and then settles on its state. While it
   runs the mark beats once a second; under reduced motion it holds still.
   Arguments and result are literal code, the only text set in mono.
   It sits on one faint fill, with no outline and no shadow.
   Reference: browsable "tool call". Ideas only, from catalogue descriptions, no code
   opened: input and output behind one disclosure (tinkererslabs "Tool Call"), and one
   state mark that changes with the state in place of a badge per state (smoothui
   "Ai Tool Call").
   Formulas:
   · returned = characters of JSON.stringify(call.result), read as bytes (the sample is
     plain ASCII, one byte per character)
   · the duration is call.durationMs as given, in ms under one second and in s above
   Colour pass (2026-09-30): the state is a pass, a fail or pending, so the mark carries it:
   green and its word for done, red for failed, amber while it runs.
   2026-10-02: surfaces at 7% (raised blocks white in light, 12% in dark) so cards read on white and on black.
   2026-10-02 audit: he asked what the green dot by get_quote meant; it only repeated the
   green Done beside it, so at rest there is no dot and the word carries the state in its
   hue (Done green, Failed red). While the call runs an ink dot beats beside the word
   Running, so the one dot always has its label. The padding nests now: the card is 24px
   with a 6px inset, the head's hover fill is a 36px pill at 18px (24 = 18 + 6) and no longer
   glues to the card's top, the code blocks sit 12px in at 12px corners (24 = 12 + 12), and
   Run again is the library's 28px secondary button whose right edge lines up with the code
   blocks. The footer keeps the call id alone; the returned size moved into the Result
   label's tooltip (returned = the formula above). */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const RED = "var(--chart-down)"
const GREEN = "var(--chart-up)"
/** the fold and its chevron share one curve and one length, the same both ways */
const FOLD = "250ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)"

export type ToolCallState = "running" | "done" | "failed"

export interface ToolCall {
  id: string
  tool: string
  args: Record<string, unknown>
  /** what the tool returned; absent while running or when it failed */
  result?: unknown
  /** what went wrong, when it failed */
  error?: string
  durationMs: number
  state: ToolCallState
}

export interface ToolCallCardProps {
  call?: ToolCall
  defaultOpen?: boolean
  /** called when "Run again" is pressed */
  onRetry?: (id: string) => void
  className?: string
}

const DEFAULT_CALL: ToolCall = {
  id: "call_7Qm2",
  tool: "get_quote",
  args: { symbol: "NVDA", venue: "XNAS", fields: ["bid", "ask", "last"] },
  result: { symbol: "NVDA", bid: 179.78, ask: 179.82, last: 179.8, ts: "2026-09-29T14:32:07Z" },
  durationMs: 184,
  state: "done",
}

const took = (ms: number) => (ms < 1000 ? `${ms} ms` : `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(2)} s`)
const size = (n: number) => (n < 1024 ? `${n} B` : `${(n / 1024).toFixed(1)} kB`)
const pretty = (v: unknown) => JSON.stringify(v, null, 2) ?? ""
const ink = (pct: number) => `color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) ${pct}%, transparent)`

const WORD: Record<ToolCallState, string> = { running: "Running", done: "Done", failed: "Failed" }
/** the word carries the state in its hue; running stays in ink beside its beating dot */
const WORD_INK: Record<ToolCallState, string> = { running: ink(60), done: GREEN, failed: RED }
/** a text swap: 4px out of a 2px blur over 150ms */
const SWAP = { initial: { opacity: 0, y: 4, filter: "blur(2px)" }, animate: { opacity: 1, y: 0, filter: "blur(0px)" } } as const

/* raised on the card; 12 here + the 12px inset (6 card + 6 body) = the card's 24 */
const CODE = cn("mt-1 overflow-hidden whitespace-pre-wrap break-words rounded-[12px] px-3 py-2.5 font-mono text-[11px] leading-[1.5]", RAISED)

/**
 * One tool call as a record: tool, state and time on the head line, the literal arguments
 * and result under it. The head folds it away; running again replays the call.
 */
export function ToolCallCard({ call = DEFAULT_CALL, defaultOpen = true, onRetry, className }: ToolCallCardProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(defaultOpen)
  const [state, setState] = useState<ToolCallState>(call.state)

  /* the app owns the call: a new one replaces whatever the replay was showing */
  useEffect(() => setState(call.state), [call])

  /* a replay holds on running for the time the call took, then settles where the call ended */
  useEffect(() => {
    if (state !== "running" || call.state === "running") return
    const t = window.setTimeout(() => setState(call.state), Math.min(2400, Math.max(600, call.durationMs)))
    return () => window.clearTimeout(t)
  }, [state, call])

  const live = state === "running"
  const bytes = call.result === undefined ? 0 : (JSON.stringify(call.result) ?? "").length

  return (
    <div
      /* the library card corner: 24 = 18 (the head pill) + 6 (the p-1.5 inset) = 12 (the code blocks) + 12 */
      className={cn("w-[440px] max-w-full rounded-[24px] p-1.5 tabular-nums", SURFACE, className)}
      role="group"
      aria-label={`Tool call ${call.tool}, ${WORD[state].toLowerCase()}${live ? "" : `, ${took(call.durationMs)}`}`}
    >
      <button
        type="button"
        aria-expanded={open}
        onClick={() => setOpen((v) => !v)}
        className="flex h-9 w-full items-center gap-2.5 rounded-[18px] px-3 text-left outline-none transition-colors duration-150 hover:bg-foreground/[0.04] focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.06]"
      >
        <span className="truncate text-[12px] font-medium text-foreground/90">{call.tool}</span>
        <span role="status" className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px]" style={{ color: WORD_INK[state] }}>
          {/* the only dot: an ink beat while the call runs, always beside its word */}
          {live && (
            <motion.span
              aria-hidden
              className="block h-1.5 w-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-foreground/90"
              animate={reduced ? { opacity: 1 } : { opacity: [1, 0.25, 1] }}
              transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 1, repeat: Infinity, ease: "easeInOut" }}
            />
          )}
          <motion.span
            key={state}
            className="inline-block"
            initial={reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : SWAP.initial}
            animate={SWAP.animate}
            transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
          >
            {WORD[state]}
          </motion.span>
        </span>
        <span className="ml-auto text-[11px] text-foreground/70">{live ? "" : took(call.durationMs)}</span>
        <svg
          aria-hidden
          width="10"
          height="10"
          viewBox="0 0 10 10"
          fill="none"
          className={cn("shrink-0", open && "rotate-180")}
          style={{ transition: reduced ? "none" : `transform ${FOLD}` }}
        >
          <path d="M2 3.75 5 6.75l3-3" stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.45} strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
        </svg>
      </button>

      {/* the body unfolds on grid rows 0fr → 1fr; folded it is inert. Reduced motion keeps the fade */}
      <div
        inert={!open}
        className="grid"
        style={{
          gridTemplateRows: open ? "1fr" : "0fr",
          opacity: open ? 1 : 0,
          transition: reduced ? "opacity 150ms" : `grid-template-rows ${FOLD}, opacity ${FOLD}`,
        }}
      >
        <div className="min-h-0 overflow-hidden">
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2.5 px-1.5 pb-1.5 pt-1">
              <div>
                <div className="text-[10.5px] text-foreground/45">Arguments</div>
                <pre className={cn(CODE, "text-foreground/80")}>{pretty(call.args)}</pre>
              </div>

              <div>
                <div className="text-[10.5px] text-foreground/45">
                  {state === "done" ? (
                    <span title={`${size(bytes)} returned`} aria-label={`Result, ${size(bytes)} returned`}>
                      Result
                    </span>
                  ) : state === "failed" ? (
                    "Error"
                  ) : (
                    "Result"
                  )}
                </div>
                {/* waiting shimmers; what comes back is revealed out of a 2px blur over 300ms */}
                <motion.div
                  key={state}
                  initial={reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, filter: "blur(2px)" }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, filter: "blur(0px)" }}
                  transition={{ duration: 0.3, ease: EASE }}
                >
                {live ? (
                  <div className={CODE}>
                    <motion.span
                      className="inline-block"
                      style={{
                        color: "transparent",
                        backgroundImage: `linear-gradient(90deg, ${ink(40)} 0%, ${ink(40)} 35%, ${ink(85)} 50%, ${ink(40)} 65%, ${ink(40)} 100%)`,
                        backgroundSize: "200% 100%",
                        backgroundClip: "text",
                        WebkitBackgroundClip: "text",
                      }}
                      initial={{ backgroundPosition: "100% 0%" }}
                      animate={reduced ? { backgroundPosition: "50% 0%" } : { backgroundPosition: ["100% 0%", "-100% 0%"] }}
                      transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 1.6, repeat: Infinity, ease: "linear" }}
                    >
                      waiting for {call.tool}
                    </motion.span>
                  </div>
                ) : state === "failed" ? (
                  <pre className={CODE} style={{ color: RED }}>
                    {call.error ?? "no message"}
                  </pre>
                ) : (
                  <pre className={cn(CODE, "text-foreground/80")}>{pretty(call.result)}</pre>
                )}
                </motion.div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-[10.5px] text-foreground/45">{call.id}</span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  disabled={live}
                  onClick={() => {
                    onRetry?.(call.id)
                    setState("running")
                  }}
                  className={cn(BUTTON, "h-7 px-3 text-[11.5px]")}
                >
                  Run again
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

// ─── components/ui/control-classes.ts ───
```tsx
/* Control classes: the library's control material for components that ship on their own
   (2026-10-02, the audit's pattern 11). src/components/library/controls.ts is the site's
   copy; components used to paste its look in as a flat 8% fill "so the file ships alone",
   and those copies never turned white on a raised light surface. These read the same
   tokens WITH a fallback, so they follow the site's raised-surface rule here and still
   draw correctly in a buyer's app that has no such tokens. Shipped beside every component
   that imports it (scripts/build-registry.mjs bundles ui helpers automatically).

   Whole class strings, never assembled from pieces: Tailwind reads this file as text. */

/** what is ON in a switcher. Light (his call, 2026-10-02, after the inline slider): a WHITE
 *  pill with a hairline and a soft shadow on the grey track. Dark: the 8% thumb */
export const THUMB =
  "bg-white shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--light-outline,rgba(0,0,0,0.09)),0_1px_3px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] dark:bg-[var(--control-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_8%,transparent))] dark:shadow-[var(--control-shadow,inset_0_1px_0_0_color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_6%,transparent))]"

/** what a switcher's options sit in; its 2px padding is the gap the thumb keeps. Light: a
 *  light grey track with no outline, the white pill sits in it. Dark: a hairline, no fill */
export const TRACK = "rounded-full border border-transparent bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_5%,var(--background))] p-0.5 dark:border-foreground/[0.04] dark:bg-transparent"

/** an option that is off: the label alone answers the pointer */
export const SEGMENT_OFF = "text-foreground/60 hover:text-foreground/90"

/** a secondary button: the thumb standing alone; size it with h-7 / h-9 and px */
export const BUTTON =
```

# API Request Log (request-log)
> An API request log for developer dashboards, with method, path, status and latency per call and the response body unfolding inline.

// ─── components/ui/request-log.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react"
import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"
import { Check, Copy } from "lucide-react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { ICON_BUTTON, RAISED, SURFACE } from "@/components/ui/control-classes"

/* Request Log, rebuilt through the ssych-component skill (2026-09-29).
   What changed against the version before it (in git history), and why:
   · no card, outline or inner shadow, and no pill around the status code: rows sit on the
     page and part by one hairline above each
   · the status code is green when the call went through and red when it failed; amber and
     the blue response body are gone, the body is ink
   · the body stays in mono: it is literal code, the one place refs/component-spec.md keeps mono for
   · the title is plain 13px text, no letter-spacing
   · every figure is tabular, latency and time stay right-aligned
   · pointing at a row dims the others; the caption says which call is open
   2026-10-02: surfaces at 7% (raised blocks white in light, 12% in dark) so cards read on white and on black.
   2026-10-02 audit: no visible title or caption (both live in the aria-label, the caption no
   longer repeats the open row); column heads at 10.5px /45 name the table instead. The open
   row and its body are one surface block on 12px corners, the body on the raised step
   inside it (12 = 8 + 4), with a copy button and a Copy tip that turns to Copied. Time at
   10.5px /45, hairlines at 4% with the heads' hairline above the first row, width 440 like
   the other AI and operations lists.
   2026-10-02 round 2: the sample calls are a trading and LLM API in place of an email API.
   An order is placed, the positions are read, a chat completion is rate limited, and the
   same order 84133 is cancelled a minute later (newest first, so the cancel leads). The
   ids in the bodies match the paths, and each 2xx or 4xx code fits its call. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GREEN = "var(--chart-up)"
const RED = "var(--chart-down)"

export interface LogRow {
  id: string
  code: number
  method: string
  path: string
  ms: number
  time: string
  body: string
}

const DEFAULT_LOGS: LogRow[] = [
  { id: "req_01", code: 204, method: "DELETE", path: "/v1/orders/84133", ms: 24, time: "09:41:02", body: "// 204 No Content: order 84133 cancelled" },
  { id: "req_02", code: 200, method: "GET", path: "/v1/positions", ms: 19, time: "09:40:56", body: '{ "data": [{ "symbol": "ETH-PERP", "side": "long", "size": 4.2, "entry": 2418.6 }] }' },
  { id: "req_03", code: 429, method: "POST", path: "/v1/chat/completions", ms: 9, time: "09:40:31", body: '{ "error": "rate_limited", "model": "claude-sonnet-5-5", "retry_after_ms": 1200 }' },
  { id: "req_04", code: 201, method: "POST", path: "/v1/orders", ms: 38, time: "09:39:47", body: '{ "order_id": "84133", "symbol": "BTC-PERP", "side": "buy", "qty": 0.25, "status": "open" }' },
  { id: "req_05", code: 200, method: "POST", path: "/v1/chat/completions", ms: 842, time: "09:35:08", body: '{ "id": "chatcmpl_7Hq2", "model": "gpt-5", "usage": { "total_tokens": 1284 } }' },
]

/** a call that went through is green, one that failed is red */
const codeColor = (c: number) => (c < 400 ? GREEN : RED)

const COLS = "grid-cols-[36px_52px_minmax(0,1fr)_48px_58px]"
const HEADS = ["Status", "Method", "Path", "Latency", "Time"]

/** copies the body; the tip says Copy, then Copied for 1.4 s */
function CopyBody({ text }: { text: string }) {
  const [done, setDone] = useState(false)
  const timer = useRef<number | undefined>(undefined)
  useEffect(() => () => window.clearTimeout(timer.current), [])
  const copy = () => {
    void navigator.clipboard?.writeText(text).catch(() => {})
    setDone(true)
    window.clearTimeout(timer.current)
    timer.current = window.setTimeout(() => setDone(false), 1400)
  }
  return (
    <button type="button" onClick={copy} aria-label={done ? "Copied" : "Copy response body"} className={cn(ICON_BUTTON, "group/copy relative h-6 w-6")}>
      {done ? <Check size={12} strokeWidth={2} aria-hidden style={{ color: GREEN }} /> : <Copy size={12} strokeWidth={1.75} aria-hidden />}
      <span
        aria-hidden
        className={cn(
          "pointer-events-none absolute bottom-full right-0 mb-1 whitespace-nowrap rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10.5px] text-foreground/90 opacity-0 transition-opacity duration-150 group-hover/copy:opacity-100 group-focus-visible/copy:opacity-100",
          RAISED,
          done && "opacity-100",
        )}
      >
        {done ? "Copied" : "Copy"}
      </span>
    </button>
  )
}

/**
 * API log in the Stripe/Supabase register: status code, method, path, latency and time
 * per row. Pointing at a row dims the rest; pressing it unfolds the response body in
 * place. One row open at a time.
 */
export function RequestLog({
  logs = DEFAULT_LOGS,
  title = "Request log",
  caption = "last hour",
  className,
}: {
  logs?: LogRow[]
  title?: string
  caption?: string
  className?: string
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [hot, setHot] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const failed = logs.filter((r) => r.code >= 400).length

  return (
    <div className={cn("w-[440px] max-w-full tabular-nums", className)} role="group" aria-label={`${title}, ${logs.length} calls, ${failed} failed, ${caption}`}>
      {/* the heads name the table (spec 14.2); title and caption are read out in the aria-label */}
      <div aria-hidden className={cn("grid gap-3 border-b border-foreground/[0.04] px-3 pb-2 text-[10.5px] text-foreground/45", COLS)}>
        {HEADS.map((h, i) => (
          <span key={h} className={i >= 3 ? "text-right" : undefined}>
            {h}
          </span>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div onPointerLeave={() => setHot(null)}>
        {logs.map((r, i) => {
          const on = open === r.id
          const dim = hot !== null && hot !== r.id
          return (
            /* rows rise in once, 35ms apart, the stagger capped at the first eight */
            <motion.div
              key={r.id}
              className={cn(i > 0 && "border-t border-foreground/[0.04]")}
              initial={reduced ? false : { opacity: 0, y: 6 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
              transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.3, ease: EASE, delay: Math.min(i, 7) * 0.035 }}
            >
            <div
              className={cn("rounded-[12px] transition-[opacity,background-color] duration-200", on && SURFACE)}
              style={{ opacity: dim ? 0.45 : 1 }}
              onPointerEnter={() => setHot(r.id)}
            >
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setOpen(on ? null : r.id)}
                onFocus={() => setHot(r.id)}
                onBlur={() => setHot(null)}
                aria-expanded={on}
                aria-label={`${r.code} ${r.method} ${r.path}, ${r.ms} ms, ${r.time}`}
                className={cn(
                  "grid w-full items-center gap-3 rounded-[12px] px-3 py-2.5 text-left outline-none transition-[background-color,transform,translate,scale,rotate] duration-150 active:scale-[0.98] motion-reduce:active:scale-100",
                  COLS,
                  on ? "focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.04]" : "hover:bg-foreground/[0.04] focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.06]",
                )}
              >
                <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold" style={{ color: codeColor(r.code) }}>
                  {r.code}
                </span>
                <span className="text-[11px] text-foreground/60">{r.method}</span>
                <span className="truncate text-[12px] text-foreground/90" title={r.path}>
                  {r.path}
                </span>
                <span className="text-right text-[11px] text-foreground/60">{r.ms}ms</span>
                <span className="text-right text-[10.5px] text-foreground/45">{r.time}</span>
              </button>
              {/* the body unfolds on grid rows 0fr → 1fr (transitions.dev accordion), 250ms both
                  ways; reduced motion opens it at once and keeps the fade */}
              <div
                aria-hidden={!on}
                inert={!on}
                className="grid"
                style={{
                  gridTemplateRows: on ? "1fr" : "0fr",
                  opacity: on ? 1 : 0,
                  transition: reduced
                    ? "opacity 150ms ease-out"
                    : "grid-template-rows 250ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), opacity 250ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)",
                }}
              >
                <div className="min-h-0 overflow-hidden">
                  {/* the body on the raised step inside the open row's surface: 12 = 8 + 4 */}
                  <div className="px-1 pb-1">
                    <div className={cn("rounded-[8px] px-2.5 pb-2.5 pt-1.5", RAISED)}>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <span className="text-[10.5px] text-foreground/45">Response body</span>
                        <CopyBody text={r.body} />
                      </div>
                      <pre className="mt-0.5 whitespace-pre-wrap break-words font-mono text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-foreground/70">{r.body}</pre>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            </motion.div>
          )
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

```
