# Release Feed (release-feed)
> A changelog feed for developer tools and APIs that groups release notes by added, changed and fixed, with copyable versions.

// ─── components/ui/release-feed.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react"
import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { SEGMENT_OFF, THUMB, TRACK } from "@/components/ui/control-classes"

/* Release Feed, promoted from a lab sketch through ssych-component (2026-09-29).
   What it is for: a changelog, newest first, where every line says whether it was added,
   changed or fixed.
   Read first: the version numbers down the rail, then the notes under each.
   The pointer: point at a release and the others dim. Point at one of the three kinds
   in the top corner and only notes of that kind keep their ink; press it to hold that
   filter. Press a version to copy it; the word "copied" answers in its place.
   Lab sketch: src/components/lab/ReleaseFeed.tsx. Kept: the rail with a node per release,
   version and date on one line, a kind in front of every note, copy on press. Changed: the
   kinds were green, blue and amber chips; each has its own hue, --chart-1, --chart-5 and
   --chart-3 (2026-09-30), shown as a dot since 2026-10-02, since three kinds down one list must be told apart
   and a kind has no direction to give it green or red. The counts per kind and the filter are new. Node rings, the copy
   and check icons are gone.
   2026-10-02: the filter at the top is the segmented control's material (his call: the
   pill like selectable pills looked weird). All, Added, Changed and Fixed sit in one
   hairline track, the one that is on carries the thumb, each kind has its hue only as a
   6px dot and its count after the name at 45%; pointing at a kind still dims the others,
   pressing one holds it and All lets go. The kind in front of each note is quiet the same
   way: a 6px dot in its hue and the word at 60%, 10.5px, no coloured text.
   Formulas:
   · added, changed, fixed = count of notes of that kind over every release (2, 2, 1)
   · notes                 = Σ notes per release (2 + 2 + 1 = 5)
   2026-10-02 audit: the filter reads its material from control-classes instead of a flat 8%
   copy, so its thumb turns white on a raised light surface, and its options are the 28px
   control height. Pointing at a version now says Copy beside its date before the press and
   Copied after it, so the press is no longer a surprise. The kind on each note is written
   as the filter writes it (Added, Changed, Fixed), the date sits at 10.5px /45, and the
   width is 440 like the other AI and operations lists.
   2026-10-02 round 2: the sample is an exchange API changelog in place of the library's
   own: SOL-PERP and TAO-PERP markets, the order rate limit raised to 20 a second, gaps in
   websocket book snapshots fixed, funding settlement times, a batch order endpoint. The
   counts hold at 2 added, 2 changed, 1 fixed over 5 notes. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
/** the segmented control's tween: 250ms, smooth-out */
const TAB_EASE = [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] as const


export type ReleaseKind = "added" | "changed" | "fixed"

export interface ReleaseNote {
  kind: ReleaseKind
  text: string
}

export interface Release {
  version: string
  date: string
  notes: ReleaseNote[]
}

export interface ReleaseFeedProps {
  releases?: Release[]
  /** names the feed for screen readers; the versions say what it is on screen */
  title?: string
  onCopy?: (version: string) => void
  className?: string
}

const DEFAULT_RELEASES: Release[] = [
  {
    version: "2.14.0",
    date: "Sep 30",
    notes: [
      { kind: "added", text: "SOL-PERP and TAO-PERP markets, up to 20× leverage." },
      { kind: "changed", text: "Order rate limit raised to 20 requests a second per key." },
    ],
  },
  {
    version: "2.13.2",
    date: "Sep 24",
    notes: [
      { kind: "fixed", text: "Gaps in websocket book snapshots after a reconnect." },
      { kind: "changed", text: "Funding settles every 8 hours, at 00:00, 08:00 and 16:00 UTC." },
    ],
  },
  {
    version: "2.13.0",
    date: "Sep 17",
    notes: [{ kind: "added", text: "Batch order endpoint: up to 10 orders in one call." }],
  },
]

const KINDS: ReleaseKind[] = ["added", "changed", "fixed"]
const NAME: Record<ReleaseKind, string> = { added: "Added", changed: "Changed", fixed: "Fixed" }
/** one hue per kind, in the house order; it shows only as a 6px dot, in the filter and on each note */
const HUE: Record<ReleaseKind, string> = {
  added: "var(--chart-1)",
  changed: "var(--chart-5)",
  fixed: "var(--chart-3)",
}

function Dot({ kind, className }: { kind: ReleaseKind; className?: string }) {
  return <span aria-hidden className={cn("h-1.5 w-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full", className)} style={{ background: HUE[kind] }} />
}

/**
 * A changelog in the Linear register: versions on a hairline rail, each note led by its
 * kind. Pointing at a release or at a kind dims everything else; pressing a version
 * copies it.
 */
export function ReleaseFeed({ releases = DEFAULT_RELEASES, title = "API changelog", onCopy, className }: ReleaseFeedProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const uid = useId()
  const [hot, setHot] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [peek, setPeek] = useState<ReleaseKind | null>(null)
  const [held, setHeld] = useState<ReleaseKind | null>(null)
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null)
  useEffect(
    () => () => {
      if (timer.current) clearTimeout(timer.current)
    },
    [],
  )

  const kind = peek ?? held
  const notes = releases.flatMap((r) => r.notes)
  const count = (k: ReleaseKind) => notes.filter((n) => n.kind === k).length

  const copy = (version: string) => {
    void navigator.clipboard?.writeText(`v${version}`).catch(() => {})
    onCopy?.(version)
    setCopied(version)
    if (timer.current) clearTimeout(timer.current)
    timer.current = setTimeout(() => setCopied(null), 1300)
  }

  return (
    <div className={cn("w-[440px] max-w-full tabular-nums", className)} role="group" aria-label={`${title}, ${releases.length} releases, ${notes.length} notes`}>
      <div className="flex justify-end pb-4">
        {/* the segmented control's material: one track, the thumb on the held kind (All when none) */}
        <div role="group" aria-label="Show notes of one kind" className={cn("inline-flex items-center gap-0.5", TRACK)} onPointerLeave={() => setPeek(null)}>
          {([null, ...KINDS] as (ReleaseKind | null)[]).map((k) => {
            const on = held === k
            return (
              <button
                key={k ?? "all"}
                type="button"
                aria-pressed={on}
                aria-label={k ? `${NAME[k]}, ${count(k)} notes, show only these` : `All, ${notes.length} notes`}
                onPointerEnter={() => setPeek(k)}
                onFocus={() => setPeek(k)}
                onBlur={() => setPeek(null)}
                onClick={() => setHeld(k)}
                className={cn(
                  "group relative h-7 rounded-full px-3 text-[11.5px] outline-none transition-colors duration-200 focus-visible:text-foreground/90",
                  on ? "text-foreground/90" : SEGMENT_OFF,
                )}
              >
                {on && (
                  <motion.span
                    aria-hidden
                    layoutId={`${uid}-kind`}
                    className={cn("absolute inset-0 rounded-full", THUMB)}
                    transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.25, ease: TAB_EASE }}
                  />
                )}
                <span className="relative flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-transform duration-150 group-active:scale-[0.97] motion-reduce:transition-none motion-reduce:group-active:scale-100">
                  {k ? <Dot kind={k} /> : null}
                  {k ? NAME[k] : "All"}
                  {k ? <span className="text-foreground/45">{count(k)}</span> : null}
                </span>
              </button>
            )
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="relative" onPointerLeave={() => setHot(null)}>
        <span aria-hidden className="absolute bottom-2 left-[3px] top-2 w-px bg-foreground/[0.06]" />
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
          {releases.map((r, i) => (
            /* the outer wrapper owns the dim so it never fights the entrance inside */
            <div
              key={r.version}
              onPointerEnter={() => setHot(r.version)}
              className="transition-opacity duration-200 motion-reduce:transition-none"
              style={{ opacity: hot !== null && hot !== r.version ? 0.45 : 1 }}
            >
              <motion.div
                className="relative pl-6"
                initial={reduced ? false : { opacity: 0, y: 6 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.4, ease: EASE, delay: i * 0.035 }}
              >
                <span
                  aria-hidden
                  className="absolute left-0 top-[7px] h-[7px] w-[7px] rounded-full"
                  style={{ background: `color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) ${i === 0 ? 90 : 30}%, var(--background))` }}
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => copy(r.version)}
                  onFocus={() => setHot(r.version)}
                  onBlur={() => setHot(null)}
                  aria-label={`Copy v${r.version}, released ${r.date}`}
                  className="group/version -mx-1.5 flex items-baseline gap-2.5 rounded-[8px] px-1.5 py-0.5 text-left outline-none transition-[background-color,transform,translate,scale,rotate] duration-150 hover:bg-foreground/[0.04] focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.06] active:scale-[0.97] motion-reduce:active:scale-100"
                >
                  <span className="text-[13px] font-medium text-foreground/90">v{r.version}</span>
                  <span className="text-[10.5px] text-foreground/45">{r.date}</span>
                  {/* the hint: Copy while pointed or focused, then Copied after the press (4px, 2px blur, 150ms) */}
                  <span
                    role="status"
                    className={cn(
                      "text-[10.5px] transition-opacity duration-150 group-hover/version:opacity-100 group-focus-visible/version:opacity-100",
                      copied === r.version ? "text-foreground/90 opacity-100" : "text-foreground/45 opacity-0",
                    )}
                  >
                    <motion.span
                      key={copied === r.version ? "copied" : "copy"}
                      className="inline-block"
                      initial={reduced ? false : { opacity: 0, y: 4, filter: "blur(2px)" }}
                      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, filter: "blur(0px)" }}
                      transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
                    >
                      {copied === r.version ? "Copied" : "Copy"}
                    </motion.span>
                  </span>
                </button>
                <div className="mt-2 flex flex-col gap-1.5">
                  {r.notes.map((n) => (
                    <div
                      key={n.text}
                      className="flex items-baseline gap-2.5 transition-opacity duration-200 motion-reduce:transition-none"
                      style={{ opacity: kind !== null && kind !== n.kind ? 0.35 : 1 }}
                    >
                      <span className="w-[60px] shrink-0 text-[10.5px] text-foreground/60">
                        <Dot kind={n.kind} className="mr-1.5 inline-block align-[1px]" />
                        {NAME[n.kind]}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-[12px] leading-snug text-foreground/70">{n.text}</span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </motion.div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

```tsx
/* Control classes: the library's control material for components that ship on their own
   (2026-10-02, the audit's pattern 11). src/components/library/controls.ts is the site's
   copy; components used to paste its look in as a flat 8% fill "so the file ships alone",
   and those copies never turned white on a raised light surface. These read the same
   tokens WITH a fallback, so they follow the site's raised-surface rule here and still
   draw correctly in a buyer's app that has no such tokens. Shipped beside every component
   that imports it (scripts/build-registry.mjs bundles ui helpers automatically).

/** what is ON in a switcher. Light (his call, 2026-10-02, after the inline slider): a WHITE

/** what a switcher's options sit in; its 2px padding is the gap the thumb keeps. Light: a
 *  light grey track with no outline, the white pill sits in it. Dark: a hairline, no fill */

/** an option that is off: the label alone answers the pointer */
export const SEGMENT_OFF = "text-foreground/60 hover:text-foreground/90"

/** a secondary button: the thumb standing alone; size it with h-7 / h-9 and px */
export const BUTTON =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--control-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_8%,transparent))] shadow-[var(--control-shadow,inset_0_1px_0_0_color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_6%,transparent))] text-foreground/90 outline-none transition-[color,background-color,scale] duration-150 hover:bg-[var(--control-fill-hover,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_12%,transparent))] focus-visible:bg-[var(--control-fill-hover,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_12%,transparent))] active:scale-[0.97] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40 motion-reduce:active:scale-100"

/** an icon-only control: no fill at rest, a faint one under the pointer */
export const ICON_BUTTON =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-full text-foreground/60 outline-none transition-[color,background-color] duration-150 hover:bg-foreground/[0.06] hover:text-foreground/90 focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.06]"

/** a field: the track with just enough fill to read as somewhere to type */
export const FIELD =
  "rounded-full border border-foreground/[0.04] bg-[var(--field-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_5%,transparent))] text-foreground/90 outline-none transition-[background-color,border-color] duration-150 placeholder:text-foreground/45 focus:border-foreground/[0.12]"

/** the one loud button of a form: 48px, full width, the foreground filled (the dashboards'
 *  Modal primary). A ticket, a swap, a confirm: one of these and nothing louder */
export const BUTTON_PRIMARY =
  "inline-flex h-12 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-foreground/[0.92] text-[14px] font-medium text-background outline-none transition-[background-color,scale,opacity] duration-150 hover:bg-foreground focus-visible:bg-foreground active:scale-[0.98] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40 motion-reduce:active:scale-100"

 *  (his call, 2026-10-02: "on light the card background is too dark, it can just be white, a
 *  quiet outline and a small shadow"): white, a 1px hairline (Kraken's #e7e6e9, or 9% ink in an app without the token) and a
 *  barely there shadow,

export const SURFACE =

/** a block sitting ON a surface: a faint 4% grey inside a white card in light, #1f1f1f in dark */
```

# Approval Quorum (approval-quorum)
> A multisig approval widget for treasury and payment releases, where risk, treasury and compliance sign off until the quorum is met.

// ─── components/ui/approval-quorum.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useState } from "react"
import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"
import { Check, Clock } from "lucide-react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { BUTTON_PRIMARY } from "@/components/ui/control-classes"
import { rowWash } from "@/components/ui/row-action"

/* Approval Quorum, new through ssych-component (2026-09-29).
   What it is for: an action that unlocks only when N of M approvers have signed.
   Read first: the state line, as text: how many are in, how many are still needed, or
   that the quorum is met.
   What the pointer does: pointing at an approver dims the others; pressing one signs
   for that role, pressing again takes the signature back. The coin lifts on the press.
   Sketch: src/components/lab/ApprovalQuorum.tsx. Kept: the data shape (approvers with
   name and initials, quorum), one Set of approvals that every number derives from, the
   meter that walks to the quorum, the lift spring on the coin, the status text, Reset.
   Changed: no card, header band, outline or rings; approvers are rows with the role and
   its state written out, so nothing depends on a tooltip; roles, not people; amber is
   gone from the gate, the meter is ink until the quorum is met and green after; the meter
   is one segment per needed approval. Each row's state is green once approved and amber
   while pending (given back 2026-09-30: they are done and waiting states).
   Formulas:
   · approved = size of the approvals set
   · still needed = max(0, quorum − approved)
   · meter segments filled = min(approved, quorum) of quorum
   · pending = approvers − approved (read out in the aria-label only)
   · the headline is the `amount` as given, $ grouped to 2dp
   2026-10-02 audit: the amount was hidden in a 13px title, so the header now has the three
   tiers: the action as the label (Release to settlement) at /45, the amount as the 26px
   headline with its decimals at /35, and "2 of 3 approved" as the sub line. The status line
   no longer sums three counts at rest. The two letter discs per role are gone (gate P2):
   a 14px check in ink when the role has signed, a clock while it waits. Pending is ink
   /45, only approved is green. The demo Reset is gone and the action the quorum guards is
   here: a Release button, disabled until the quorum is met, that plays out on press with a
   green wash, a tick and Released. New props: `label`, `amount`, `onRelease`; `title` now
   names the group for a screen reader (a custom title with no label still shows as the
   label, as before). */

const LIFT_SPRING = { type: "spring", stiffness: 500, damping: 30 } as const
const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GREEN = "var(--chart-up)"
const DEFAULT_TITLE = "Release $250,000.00 to settlement"

export interface Approver {
  /** the role that signs */
  name: string
  /** kept for callers that pass it; roles no longer wear letter discs (2026-10-02 audit) */
  initials: string
  /** when it signed, for approvals that arrive with the data */
  at?: string
}

export interface ApprovalQuorumProps {
  /** the action being held, read by a screen reader; shown as the label when no `label` is given */
  title?: string
  /** the action, as the label over the headline */
  label?: string
  /** the amount the action moves, in dollars; the headline */
  amount?: number
  approvers?: Approver[]
  /** approvals needed to unlock */
  quorum?: number
  /** indexes of the approvers that have already signed */
  initial?: number[]
  /** called once Release is pressed with the quorum met */
  onRelease?: () => void
  className?: string
}

const DEFAULT_APPROVERS: Approver[] = [
  { name: "Risk", initials: "Ri", at: "09:14" },
  { name: "Treasury", initials: "Tr", at: "09:31" },
  { name: "Ops", initials: "Op" },
  { name: "Compliance", initials: "Co" },
  { name: "Finance", initials: "Fi" },
]

const DEFAULT_INITIAL = [0, 1]

/**
 * N of M sign-off. The amount leads; each role is a row that says where it stands; the
 * meter has one segment per approval needed, and Release unlocks when the last fills.
 */
export function ApprovalQuorum({
  title = DEFAULT_TITLE,
  label,
  amount,
  approvers = DEFAULT_APPROVERS,
  quorum = 3,
  initial = DEFAULT_INITIAL,
  onRelease,
  className,
}: ApprovalQuorumProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  /* all state is this set: counts, meter and status derive from it */
  const [approvals, setApprovals] = useState<Set<number>>(() => new Set(initial))
  const [hot, setHot] = useState<number | null>(null)
  /* once pressed, the button washes green with a tick and Released, and the rows lock */
  const [done, setDone] = useState(false)

  const isDefault = title === DEFAULT_TITLE
  const shownLabel = label ?? (isDefault ? "Release to settlement" : title)
  const shownAmount = amount ?? (isDefault ? 250000 : undefined)
  const [whole, cents] = (shownAmount ?? 0).toLocaleString("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).split(".")

  const count = approvals.size
  const met = count >= quorum
  const remaining = Math.max(0, quorum - count)
  const filled = Math.min(count, quorum)
  const pending = approvers.length - count

  const toggle = (i: number) =>
    setApprovals((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev)
      if (next.has(i)) next.delete(i)
      else next.add(i)
      return next
    })

  const press = () => {
    if (!met || done) return
    setDone(true)
    onRelease?.()
  }

  return (
    <div
      className={cn("w-[360px] max-w-full tabular-nums", className)}
      role="group"
      aria-label={`${title}. ${count} of ${quorum} approvals, ${met ? "quorum met" : `${remaining} more needed`}, ${pending} pending${done ? ", released" : ""}`}
    >
      {/* the three tiers (spec 14.1): the action, the amount, where the quorum stands */}
      <div className="px-3">
        <div className="mb-3 flex items-baseline justify-between text-[12px]">
          <span className="truncate text-foreground/45">{shownLabel}</span>
        </div>
        {shownAmount !== undefined && (
          <div className="text-[26px] font-semibold leading-none tracking-[-0.02em] text-foreground/90">
            ${whole}
            <span className="text-foreground/35">.{cents}</span>
          </div>
        )}
        <div role="status" className="mt-2 text-[12px] font-medium" style={{ color: met ? GREEN : undefined }}>
          {/* the count swaps in place as a signature goes in or comes back (a change of intent) */}
          <motion.span
            key={met ? "met" : count}
            className={cn("inline-block", !met && "text-foreground/90")}
            initial={reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: 4, filter: "blur(2px)" }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, filter: "blur(0px)" }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
          >
            {count} of {quorum} approved
          </motion.span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div aria-hidden className="mt-3 flex gap-[3px] px-3">
        {Array.from({ length: quorum }, (_, i) => (
          <span
            key={i}
            className="h-1 flex-1 rounded-full transition-colors duration-200 motion-reduce:transition-none"
            style={{ background: i < filled ? (met ? GREEN : "color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 90%, transparent)") : "color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 10%, transparent)" }}
          />
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="mt-3" onPointerLeave={() => setHot(null)}>
        {approvers.map((a, i) => {
          const on = approvals.has(i)
          return (
            /* the rows rise in once, 35ms apart; the wrapper owns the entrance so the
               button keeps its own dim */
            <motion.div
              key={a.name}
              initial={reduced ? false : { opacity: 0, y: 6 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
              transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.3, ease: EASE, delay: Math.min(i, 7) * 0.035 }}
            >
              <motion.button
                type="button"
                aria-pressed={on}
                disabled={done}
                aria-label={`${a.name}: ${on ? `approved${a.at ? ` at ${a.at}` : ""}${done ? "" : ", press to take back"}` : `pending${done ? "" : ", press to approve"}`}`}
                onClick={() => toggle(i)}
                onPointerEnter={() => setHot(i)}
                onFocus={() => setHot(i)}
                onBlur={() => setHot(null)}
                initial={false}
                animate="rest"
                whileTap={reduced ? undefined : "lift"}
                /* a 36px row: 18 = half its height, a full pill */
                className={cn(
                  "flex h-9 w-full items-center gap-2.5 rounded-[18px] px-3 text-left outline-none transition-[opacity,background-color] duration-200 hover:bg-foreground/[0.04] focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.06] disabled:pointer-events-none motion-reduce:transition-none",
                  hot !== null && hot !== i && "opacity-50",
                )}
              >
                <motion.span
                  aria-hidden
                  variants={{ rest: { y: 0 }, lift: { y: -3 } }}
                  transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : LIFT_SPRING}
                  className={cn("grid h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 place-items-center transition-colors duration-200", on ? "text-foreground/90" : "text-foreground/45")}
                >
                  {on ? <Check size={14} strokeWidth={2} /> : <Clock size={14} strokeWidth={1.75} />}
                </motion.span>
                <span className={cn("flex-1 text-[12px] transition-colors duration-200", on ? "font-medium text-foreground/90" : "text-foreground/70")}>{a.name}</span>
                <span
                  className={cn("text-[11px] transition-colors duration-200 motion-reduce:transition-none", !on && "text-foreground/45")}
                  style={on ? { color: GREEN } : undefined}
                >
                  {on ? (a.at ? `Approved ${a.at}` : "Approved") : "Pending"}
                </span>
              </motion.button>
            </motion.div>
          )
        })}
      </div>

      {/* the action the quorum guards: locked until it is met, then it plays out on press */}
      <div className="mt-3 px-3">
        <button
          type="button"
          disabled={!met}
          aria-disabled={done || undefined}
          onClick={press}
          className={cn(BUTTON_PRIMARY, "h-9 text-[13px]", done && "pointer-events-none")}
          style={done ? { background: rowWash(GREEN), color: GREEN } : undefined}
        >
          <motion.span
            key={done ? "released" : "release"}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5"
            initial={reduced ? false : { opacity: 0, y: 4, filter: "blur(2px)" }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, filter: "blur(0px)" }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
          >
            {done && <Check size={14} strokeWidth={2.2} aria-hidden />}
            {done ? "Released" : "Release"}
          </motion.span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

// ─── components/ui/row-action.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react"
import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"
import { Check } from "lucide-react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

/* Row action: an action that lives on a table row, and the way the row leaves after it
   (2026-10-02, out of Positions Table and the trading terminal).

   RowAction   a real button in the row's own last column, so it never sits over a figure.
               It comes up (4px, 150ms) on row hover or keyboard focus (the row carries
               `group`), and is always shown where there is no hover. Once pressed it turns
               to a tick and the past tense ("Closed").
   useRowExit  the hold: the row washes in the colour of its result and keeps its "Closed"
               for 420ms, then `onDone` takes it out of the list.
   rowExit     the motion the row's wrapper leaves with: 16px right as it fades while its
               height folds away (300ms), so the rows under it close up. Reduced motion
               keeps a fade.
   rowWash     the 10% wash in the result's colour. */

const LIFT_SPRING = { type: "spring", stiffness: 500, damping: 30 } as const
const SMOOTH = [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] as const
/** how long a finished row holds its "Closed" before it leaves */
export const ROW_HOLD_MS = 420

export function useRowExit(hold = ROW_HOLD_MS) {
  const [leaving, setLeaving] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const timer = useRef<number | undefined>(undefined)
  useEffect(() => () => window.clearTimeout(timer.current), [])
  /** hold row `id` in its finished state, then run `onDone` (which removes it) */
  const start = useCallback(
    (id: string, onDone: () => void) => {
      if (leaving) return
      setLeaving(id)
      timer.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
        onDone()
        setLeaving(null)
      }, hold)
    },
    [hold, leaving],
  )
  return { leaving, start }
}

export const rowExit = (reduced: boolean | null) =>
  reduced
    ? { opacity: 0, transition: { duration: 0.15 } }
    : { opacity: 0, x: 16, height: 0, transition: { duration: 0.3, ease: SMOOTH, height: { duration: 0.3, ease: SMOOTH, delay: 0.08 } } }

export const rowWash = (color: string) => `color-mix(in srgb, ${color} 10%, transparent)`

export function RowAction({
  done,
  disabled,
  onClick,
  label = "Close",
  doneLabel = "Closed",
  tone = "var(--foreground)",
  "aria-label": ariaLabel,
  children,
}: {
  /** the action has gone through: the button reads the past tense with a tick */
  done: boolean
  disabled?: boolean
  onClick: () => void
  label?: string
  doneLabel?: string
  /** the tick's colour: the result's hue */
  tone?: string
  "aria-label"?: string
  children?: ReactNode
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  return (
    <motion.button
      type="button"
      onClick={onClick}
      disabled={disabled}
      aria-label={ariaLabel}
      whileTap={reduced ? undefined : { scale: 0.97, transition: LIFT_SPRING }}
      className={cn(
        "inline-flex h-6 items-center gap-1 rounded-full px-2.5 text-[10.5px] font-medium text-foreground/90 outline-none",
        "transition-[opacity,transform,translate,background-color,color] duration-150 ease-out",
        done
          ? "translate-y-0 opacity-100"
          : "translate-y-1 bg-foreground/[0.08] opacity-0 hover:bg-foreground/[0.14] focus-visible:translate-y-0 focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.14] focus-visible:opacity-100 group-hover:translate-y-0 group-hover:opacity-100 [@media(hover:none)]:translate-y-0 [@media(hover:none)]:opacity-100",
      )}
    >
      {done ? (
        <>
          <Check size={11} strokeWidth={2.2} aria-hidden style={{ color: tone }} />
          {doneLabel}
        </>
      ) : (
        children ?? label
      )}
    </motion.button>
  )
}

```


# Automation Builder (automation-builder)
> A trading automation builder that writes a strategy as sentences, from news sentiment to orders, with editable values and a test run.

// ─── components/ui/automation-builder.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, Reorder, useDragControls, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"
import { GripVertical, Redo2, Undo2 } from "lucide-react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { BUTTON, BUTTON_PRIMARY, ICON_BUTTON, RAISED, SURFACE } from "@/components/ui/control-classes"

/* Automation Builder, promoted from a lab sketch through ssych-component (2026-09-29).
   What it is for: a trading rule written as sentences. Muted words join filled values;
   the values are the only things that change.
   Read first: the values, the filled pills. The words between them step back.
   The pointer: press a value and its choices open in its place, in the row, with the
   chosen one filled; press one to take it. Point at a row and the others dim and its
   handle shows; drag the handle, or focus it and use the up and down arrows, to move the
   row. "Add action" opens the kinds of step in place. "Run simulation" walks the rows
   from the top and the line above the buttons reads what would have happened. Undo and
   redo walk every change. Escape closes whatever is open.
   Lab sketch: src/components/lab/AutomationBuilder.tsx. Kept: the program model (words,
   values, line breaks, one level of indent), reorder by handle, add action, the sweep,
   the derived result, the history stack. Changed: no sheet, outline, drop shadows, green
   bloom or pulse ring; the floating menus are gone, choices open in the row; type is 10.5
   to 11.5px, it was up to 19px; the icon in a well per row is the row's number, because the
   order is what a program is; the step's `icon` field is named `kind`. The sample's
   description contradicted its rule ("buy if it's no good sentiment") and the limit
   price sat far from the ticker's price; both are fixed.
   Smaller (2026-10-01): 400px wide, was 460; values are 20px pills, were 24; rows sit
   6px apart, were 10; the number disc is 16px, was 18; the buttons are 24px, were 28.
   Formulas:
   · steps executed = count of rows
   · orders placed  = 1 when there is an order row and every condition row holds, else 0
   · a condition holds when ("is" chosen) equals ("Good" chosen)
   2026-10-02: surfaces at 7% (raised blocks white in light, 12% in dark) so cards read on white and on black.
   2026-10-02 audit: Clear is gone (he found the foot too complicated, and Undo covers it),
   so the foot holds Add action, Undo, Redo and Run. Undo and Redo are 28px icon buttons
   with a tip, Add action is the library's 28px secondary button, Run is the library primary
   at 28px with a fixed width so Run simulation, Running and Run again swap in place without
   resizing it. Values and their choices are 24px pills (they were 20 and 18, under the 24px
   touch target). The rule now sits in one surface card (24px corners, 12px inset); the open
   choices and a dragged row sit on the raised step, with corners nested to their contents
   (choices 14 = 12 + 2, the drag ground 12 = 24 − 12). The status line's hairline is the 4%
   one. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
/** how long the sweep rests on a row, in ms */
const BEAT = 350
/** the gap between two rows, in px; the thread bridges it */
const GAP = 6
const INDENT = 18

export type ChipRole = "ticker" | "price" | "sentiment" | "comparator"

export type StepToken = { kind: "word" | "chip"; text: string; options?: string[]; role?: ChipRole } | { kind: "break" }

export type StepKind = "schedule" | "fetch" | "summarize" | "classify" | "branch" | "order" | "notify"

export interface Step {
  kind: StepKind
  tokens: StepToken[]
  /** 1 sits the row inside the condition above it */
  indent?: number
}

export interface AutomationBuilderProps {
  /** the rule's name, read out to screen readers; the rows say what it does */
  title?: string
  steps?: Step[]
  onRun?: () => void
  className?: string
}

const TICKERS = ["TSLA", "AAPL", "NVDA", "AMZN"]

const FETCH: Step = {
  kind: "fetch",
  tokens: [
    { kind: "word", text: "Get" },
    { kind: "chip", text: "News", options: ["News", "Price", "Filings"] },
    { kind: "word", text: "from" },
    { kind: "chip", text: "TSLA", options: TICKERS, role: "ticker" },
  ],
}
const SUMMARIZE: Step = {
  kind: "summarize",
  tokens: [
    { kind: "word", text: "Summarize" },
    { kind: "chip", text: "TSLA news", options: ["TSLA news", "Full articles"] },
  ],
}
const CLASSIFY: Step = {
  kind: "classify",
  tokens: [
    { kind: "word", text: "Score the sentiment of" },
    { kind: "chip", text: "Summary", options: ["Summary", "Headlines"] },
  ],
}
const BRANCH: Step = {
  kind: "branch",
  tokens: [
    { kind: "word", text: "If" },
    { kind: "chip", text: "Sentiment", options: ["Sentiment", "Price"] },
    { kind: "chip", text: "is", options: ["is", "is not"], role: "comparator" },
    { kind: "chip", text: "Good", options: ["Good", "Bad", "Neutral"], role: "sentiment" },
  ],
}
const ORDER: Step = {
  kind: "order",
  tokens: [
    { kind: "chip", text: "Confirm", options: ["Confirm", "Auto"] },
    { kind: "word", text: "buy" },
    { kind: "chip", text: "TSLA", options: TICKERS, role: "ticker" },
    { kind: "break" },
    { kind: "word", text: "at" },
    { kind: "chip", text: "Market avg", options: ["Market avg", "Limit $240", "Open price"], role: "price" },
  ],
}
const NOTIFY: Step = {
  kind: "notify",
  tokens: [
    { kind: "word", text: "Notify" },
    { kind: "chip", text: "Me", options: ["Me", "Team"] },
    { kind: "word", text: "by" },
    { kind: "chip", text: "Email", options: ["Email", "Push", "SMS"] },
  ],
}

const DEFAULT_STEPS: Step[] = [
  {
    kind: "schedule",
    tokens: [
      { kind: "word", text: "Run" },
      { kind: "chip", text: "Every month", options: ["Every month", "Every week", "Every day"] },
      { kind: "chip", text: "on the 1st", options: ["on the 1st", "on the 15th", "on the last day"] },
    ],
  },
  FETCH,
  SUMMARIZE,
  CLASSIFY,
  BRANCH,
  { ...ORDER, indent: 1 },
  { kind: "branch", tokens: [{ kind: "word", text: "End if" }] },
]

/** the kinds of step "Add action" offers */
const TEMPLATES: { label: string; step: Step }[] = [
  { label: "Get data", step: FETCH },
  { label: "Summarize", step: SUMMARIZE },
  { label: "Sentiment", step: CLASSIFY },
  { label: "If condition", step: BRANCH },
  { label: "Buy order", step: ORDER },
  { label: "Notify", step: NOTIFY },
]

/* the program as it runs */

type ChipTok = { kind: "chip"; id: string; value: string; options: string[]; role?: ChipRole }
type Token = { kind: "word"; text: string } | { kind: "break" } | ChipTok
type Row = { id: string; kind: StepKind; indent: number; tokens: Token[] }

let made = 0
const uid = () => `ab${++made}`

const roleOf = (options: string[]): ChipRole | undefined =>
  options.includes("TSLA") ? "ticker" : options.includes("Market avg") ? "price" : options.includes("Good") ? "sentiment" : options.includes("is") ? "comparator" : undefined

const toRow = (step: Step): Row => ({
  id: uid(),
  kind: step.kind,
  indent: step.indent ?? 0,
  tokens: step.tokens.map((t): Token => {
    if (t.kind === "break") return { kind: "break" }
    if (t.kind === "word") return { kind: "word", text: t.text }
    const options = t.options?.includes(t.text) ? t.options : [t.text, ...(t.options ?? [])]
    return { kind: "chip", id: uid(), value: t.text, options, role: t.role ?? roleOf(options) }
  }),
})

const chipsOf = (r: Row) => r.tokens.filter((t): t is ChipTok => t.kind === "chip")

/** what the run would have done, read straight off the rows */
function outcome(rows: Row[]): string {
  const steps = `${rows.length} step${rows.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} executed`
  const order = rows.find((r) => r.kind === "order")
  if (!order) return `${steps} · 0 orders placed`
  let met = true
  for (const r of rows) {
    if (r.kind !== "branch") continue
    const sentiment = chipsOf(r).find((c) => c.role === "sentiment")
    const comparator = chipsOf(r).find((c) => c.role === "comparator")
    if (sentiment && comparator) met = (comparator.value === "is") === (sentiment.value === "Good")
  }
  if (!met) return `${steps} · 0 orders placed, the condition did not hold`
  const ticker = chipsOf(order).find((c) => c.role === "ticker")?.value ?? "TSLA"
  const price = chipsOf(order).find((c) => c.role === "price")?.value ?? "Market avg"
  return `${steps} · 1 order placed, ${ticker} at ${price.toLowerCase()}`
}

/** closes what is open on a press outside it, or on Escape */
function useDismiss(ref: React.RefObject<HTMLElement | null>, active: boolean, onClose: () => void) {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!active) return
    const down = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(e.target as Node)) onClose()
    }
    const key = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") onClose()
    }
    document.addEventListener("pointerdown", down)
    window.addEventListener("keydown", key)
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", down)
      window.removeEventListener("keydown", key)
    }
  }, [ref, active, onClose])
}

const PILL = "h-6 rounded-full px-2.5 text-[11px] font-medium whitespace-nowrap outline-none transition-[color,background-color,transform,translate,scale,rotate] duration-150 motion-reduce:transition-none"
const OPTION = "h-6 rounded-full px-2.5 text-[11px] whitespace-nowrap outline-none transition-[color,background-color,transform,translate,scale,rotate] duration-150 active:scale-[0.97] motion-reduce:transition-none"
/** a tip over an icon button: up on hover or keyboard focus, after a short wait */
function Tip({ label, children }: { label: string; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <span className="group/tip relative inline-flex">
      {children}
      <span
        aria-hidden
        className={cn(
          "pointer-events-none absolute bottom-full left-1/2 mb-1.5 -translate-x-1/2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10.5px] text-foreground/90 opacity-0 transition-opacity duration-150 group-focus-within/tip:opacity-100 group-hover/tip:opacity-100 group-hover/tip:delay-300",
          RAISED,
        )}
      >
        {label}
      </span>
    </span>
  )
}
/** the buy side of an order reads green, and a placed order says so in green */
const GREEN = "var(--chart-up)"
/** choices open in place from the value they replace: 0.97 and opacity, from its left edge */
const OPEN_FROM = { opacity: 0, scale: 0.97 }
const OPEN_TO = { opacity: 1, scale: 1 }

/** a value; pressed, its choices take its place in the row */
function Chip({ chip, open, locked, onToggle, onClose, onSelect }: { chip: ChipTok; open: boolean; locked: boolean; onToggle: () => void; onClose: () => void; onSelect: (value: string) => void }) {
  const wrap = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null)
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  useDismiss(wrap, open, onClose)
  return (
    <span ref={wrap} className="inline-flex">
      {open ? (
        <motion.span
          role="radiogroup"
          aria-label={`Choices for ${chip.value}`}
          /* raised on the card: 12 (the 24px option pill) + 2 padding = 14 */
          className={cn("inline-flex flex-wrap items-center gap-0.5 rounded-[14px] p-0.5", RAISED)}
          style={{ transformOrigin: "left center" }}
          initial={reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : OPEN_FROM}
          animate={OPEN_TO}
          transition={{ duration: 0.25, ease: EASE }}
        >
          {chip.options.map((o) => {
            const on = o === chip.value
            return (
              <button
                key={o}
                type="button"
                role="radio"
                aria-checked={on}
                autoFocus={on}
                onClick={() => onSelect(o)}
                className={cn(OPTION, on ? "bg-foreground/[0.12] font-medium text-foreground/90" : "text-foreground/45 hover:text-foreground/90 focus-visible:text-foreground/90")}
              >
                {o}
              </button>
            )
          })}
        </motion.span>
      ) : (
        <button
          type="button"
          aria-haspopup="true"
          aria-expanded={false}
          disabled={locked}
          onClick={onToggle}
          className={cn(PILL, "bg-foreground/[0.08] text-foreground/90 hover:bg-foreground/[0.13] focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.13] active:scale-[0.97]")}
        >
          {chip.value}
        </button>
      )}
    </span>
  )
}

function ProgramRow({
  row,
  index,
  count,
  enter,
  dim,
  locked,
  still,
  hideThread,
  openKey,
  setOpenKey,
  onSelect,
  onHot,
  onMove,
  onLift,
  onDrop,
}: {
  row: Row
  index: number
  count: number
  /** the entrance delay: rows stagger in 35ms apart on mount, and at once after */
  enter: number
  dim: boolean
  locked: boolean
  still: boolean
  /** true while a row is in flight: the thread states an order, so it leaves until the order settles */
  hideThread: boolean
  openKey: string | null
  setOpenKey: (key: string | null) => void
  onSelect: (rowId: string, chipId: string, value: string) => void
  onHot: (id: string | null) => void
  onMove: (id: string, by: number) => void
  onLift: () => void
  onDrop: () => void
}) {
  const controls = useDragControls()
  const [dragging, setDragging] = useState(false)
  const first = index === 0
  const last = index === count - 1
  const inset = row.indent > 0 ? INDENT : 0

  const lines: Token[][] = [[]]
  for (const t of row.tokens) {
    if (t.kind === "break") lines.push([])
    else lines[lines.length - 1].push(t)
  }
  const sentence = row.tokens.map((t) => (t.kind === "word" ? t.text : t.kind === "chip" ? t.value : "")).join(" ")

  return (
    <Reorder.Item
      as="div"
      role="listitem"
      aria-label={`Step ${index + 1}: ${sentence}`}
      value={row}
      dragListener={false}
      dragControls={controls}
      initial={still ? false : { opacity: 0, y: 6 }}
      animate={{ opacity: dim ? 0.45 : 1, y: 0 }}
      transition={still ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.2, ease: EASE, delay: enter }}
      onDragStart={() => {
        setDragging(true)
        onLift()
      }}
      onDragEnd={() => {
        setDragging(false)
        onDrop()
      }}
      onPointerEnter={() => onHot(row.id)}
      /* the drag ground, raised on the card: 24 (the card) − 12 (its inset) = 12 */
      className={cn("group relative flex items-start gap-2 rounded-[12px]", dragging && cn("z-10", RAISED))}
    >
      {/* the thread: one hairline from number to number; a row set inside a condition hangs off it */}
      {count > 1 && (
        <span
          aria-hidden
          className="absolute left-[7.5px] w-px bg-foreground/[0.08] transition-opacity duration-150 motion-reduce:transition-none"
          style={{ top: first ? 12 : 0, bottom: last ? undefined : -GAP, height: last ? 12 : undefined, opacity: hideThread ? 0 : 1 }}
        />
      )}
      {inset > 0 && (
        <span
          aria-hidden
          className="absolute left-[7.5px] top-[11.5px] h-px bg-foreground/[0.08] transition-opacity duration-150 motion-reduce:transition-none"
          style={{ width: inset, opacity: hideThread ? 0 : 1 }}
        />
      )}

      <span
        aria-hidden
        className="relative mt-1 grid h-4 w-4 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full text-[9px] font-medium text-foreground/70"
        style={{ marginLeft: inset, background: "color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 10%, var(--background))" }}
      >
        {index + 1}
      </span>

      <span className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-1">
        {lines.map((line, li) => (
          <span key={li} className="flex min-h-6 flex-wrap items-center gap-x-1 gap-y-1">
            {line.map((t, ti) => {
              if (t.kind === "word")
                return (
                  <span key={ti} className="text-[11.5px] text-foreground/45" style={row.kind === "order" && t.text === "buy" ? { color: GREEN } : undefined}>
                    {t.text}
                  </span>
                )
              if (t.kind !== "chip") return null
              const key = `${row.id}:${t.id}`
              return (
                <Chip
                  key={t.id}
                  chip={t}
                  open={openKey === key}
                  locked={locked}
                  onToggle={() => setOpenKey(key)}
                  onClose={() => setOpenKey(null)}
                  onSelect={(value) => onSelect(row.id, t.id, value)}
                />
              )
            })}
          </span>
        ))}
      </span>

      <button
        type="button"
        aria-label={`Move step ${index + 1}, drag or use the up and down arrows`}
        disabled={locked}
        onFocus={() => onHot(row.id)}
        onBlur={() => onHot(null)}
        onPointerDown={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault()
          controls.start(e)
        }}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key !== "ArrowUp" && e.key !== "ArrowDown") return
          e.preventDefault()
          onMove(row.id, e.key === "ArrowUp" ? -1 : 1)
        }}
        className={cn(
          "mt-1 grid h-4 w-4 shrink-0 touch-none place-items-center rounded-[4px] text-foreground/45 outline-none transition-opacity duration-150 focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.06] focus-visible:opacity-100 disabled:pointer-events-none motion-reduce:transition-none",
          dragging ? "cursor-grabbing opacity-100" : "cursor-grab opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100",
        )}
      >
        <GripVertical className="h-3 w-3" strokeWidth={1.8} aria-hidden />
      </button>
    </Reorder.Item>
  )
}

function AddAction({ open, locked, onToggle, onClose, onPick }: { open: boolean; locked: boolean; onToggle: () => void; onClose: () => void; onPick: (label: string) => void }) {
  const wrap = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  useDismiss(wrap, open, onClose)
  return (
    <div ref={wrap} className="mt-2 flex min-h-7 items-center">
      {open ? (
        <motion.div
          role="group"
          aria-label="Kinds of step"
          /* raised on the card: 12 (the 24px option pill) + 2 padding = 14 */
          className={cn("flex flex-wrap items-center gap-0.5 rounded-[14px] p-0.5", RAISED)}
          style={{ transformOrigin: "left center" }}
          initial={reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : OPEN_FROM}
          animate={OPEN_TO}
          transition={{ duration: 0.25, ease: EASE }}
        >
          {TEMPLATES.map((t, i) => (
            <button
              key={t.label}
              type="button"
              autoFocus={i === 0}
              onClick={() => onPick(t.label)}
              className={cn(OPTION, "text-foreground/70 hover:bg-foreground/[0.1] hover:text-foreground/90 focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.1]")}
            >
              {t.label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </motion.div>
      ) : (
        <button type="button" aria-haspopup="true" aria-expanded={false} disabled={locked} onClick={onToggle} className={cn(BUTTON, "h-7 px-3 text-[11.5px]")}>
          Add action
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

/**
 * A no-code trading rule as a short program of sentences. Values open their choices in
 * place, rows move by their handle, and a simulated run sweeps the rows and says what it
 * would have done.
 */
export function AutomationBuilder({
  title = "Buy TSLA on good sentiment",
  steps = DEFAULT_STEPS,
  onRun,
  className,
}: AutomationBuilderProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const still = !!reduced

  const [rows, setRows] = useState<Row[]>(() => steps.map(toRow))
  const [past, setPast] = useState<Row[][]>([])
  const [future, setFuture] = useState<Row[][]>([])
  const live = useRef(rows)
  live.current = rows

  const [openKey, setOpenKey] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<"idle" | "running" | "done">("idle")
  const [sweep, setSweep] = useState(-1)
  const [result, setResult] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [hot, setHot] = useState<string | null>(null)
  /** true from lift to drop */
  const [moving, setMoving] = useState(false)
  const lifted = useRef<Row[] | null>(null)

  const running = status === "running"
  /* the rows stagger in once; after the entrance has played, a row that arrives or dims
     answers at once */
  const [entered, setEntered] = useState(false)
  useEffect(() => {
    const t = setTimeout(() => setEntered(true), 500)
    return () => clearTimeout(t)
  }, [])

  const reset = () => {
    setResult(null)
    setStatus("idle")
    setOpenKey(null)
  }

  /** an edit: the present goes on the undo stack, redo empties */
  const commit = useCallback((next: Row[]) => {
    setPast((p) => [...p, live.current])
    setRows(next)
    setFuture([])
    setResult(null)
    setStatus("idle")
  }, [])

  const undo = () => {
    if (!past.length || running) return
    setFuture((f) => [live.current, ...f])
    setRows(past[past.length - 1])
    setPast((p) => p.slice(0, -1))
    reset()
  }

  const redo = () => {
    if (!future.length || running) return
    setPast((p) => [...p, live.current])
    setRows(future[0])
    setFuture((f) => f.slice(1))
    reset()
  }

  const select = (rowId: string, chipId: string, value: string) => {
    setOpenKey(null)
    const row = live.current.find((r) => r.id === rowId)
    const chip = row?.tokens.find((t): t is ChipTok => t.kind === "chip" && t.id === chipId)
    if (!chip || chip.value === value) return
    commit(live.current.map((r) => (r.id !== rowId ? r : { ...r, tokens: r.tokens.map((t) => (t.kind === "chip" && t.id === chipId ? { ...t, value } : t)) })))
  }

  const add = (label: string) => {
    setOpenKey(null)
    const template = TEMPLATES.find((t) => t.label === label)
    if (template) commit([...live.current, toRow(template.step)])
  }

  const move = (id: string, by: number) => {
    if (running) return
    const from = live.current.findIndex((r) => r.id === id)
    const to = from + by
    if (from < 0 || to < 0 || to >= live.current.length) return
    const next = [...live.current]
    const [row] = next.splice(from, 1)
    next.splice(to, 0, row)
    commit(next)
  }

  /* a drag is one entry in the history, whatever it passed on the way */
  const lift = () => {
    lifted.current = live.current
    setMoving(true)
    setOpenKey(null)
  }
  const drop = () => {
    const before = lifted.current
    lifted.current = null
    setMoving(false)
    if (!before) return
    if (before.map((r) => r.id).join() !== live.current.map((r) => r.id).join()) {
      setPast((p) => [...p, before])
      setFuture([])
      setResult(null)
      setStatus("idle")
    }
  }

  const run = () => {
    if (running || !live.current.length) return
    onRun?.()
    setOpenKey(null)
    setResult(null)
    setStatus("running")
    setSweep(still ? live.current.length : 0)
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    if (status !== "running") return
    if (sweep >= live.current.length) {
      setResult(outcome(live.current))
      setStatus("done")
      setSweep(-1)
      return
    }
    const t = setTimeout(() => setSweep((s) => s + 1), BEAT)
    return () => clearTimeout(t)
  }, [status, sweep])


  return (
    /* the rule sits in one surface card: 24 = 12 (the rows' grounds) + 12 (the p-3 inset) */
    <div className={cn("w-[400px] max-w-full rounded-[24px] p-3 tabular-nums", SURFACE, className)} role="group" aria-label={`${title}, ${rows.length} steps`}>
      {/* no visible title or description (2026-10-01): the rows read as the rule; the name is in the aria-label */}
      <Reorder.Group
        as="div"
        role="list"
        aria-label="Steps"
        axis="y"
        values={rows}
        onReorder={(next) => {
          if (!running) setRows(next)
        }}
        onPointerLeave={() => setHot(null)}
        className="flex flex-col"
        style={{ gap: GAP }}
      >
        {rows.map((row, i) => (
          <ProgramRow
            key={row.id}
            row={row}
            index={i}
            count={rows.length}
            enter={entered ? 0 : Math.min(i, 7) * 0.035}
            dim={running ? sweep !== i : !moving && hot !== null && hot !== row.id}
            locked={running}
            still={still}
            hideThread={moving}
            openKey={openKey}
            setOpenKey={setOpenKey}
            onSelect={select}
            onHot={setHot}
            onMove={move}
            onLift={lift}
            onDrop={drop}
          />
        ))}
      </Reorder.Group>

      <AddAction open={openKey === "add"} locked={running} onToggle={() => setOpenKey("add")} onClose={() => setOpenKey(null)} onPick={add} />

      <div role="status" className="mt-3 border-t border-foreground/[0.04] pt-2.5 text-[10.5px] text-foreground/45">
        <AnimatePresence mode="wait" initial={false}>
          <motion.span
            key={result ?? status}
            className={cn("block", result && "text-foreground/90")}
            style={result?.includes("1 order placed") ? { color: GREEN } : undefined}
            initial={still ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: 4, filter: "blur(2px)" }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, filter: "blur(0px)" }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, transition: { duration: 0.12 } }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
          >
            {result ?? (running ? `Running step ${Math.min(sweep + 1, rows.length)} of ${rows.length}` : "\u00a0" /* no summary at rest (user call, 2026-10-02) */)}
          </motion.span>
        </AnimatePresence>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-2.5 flex items-center gap-1">
        <Tip label="Undo">
          <button type="button" aria-label="Undo" disabled={!past.length || running} onClick={undo} className={cn(ICON_BUTTON, "h-7 w-7 disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-35")}>
            <Undo2 size={14} strokeWidth={1.75} aria-hidden />
          </button>
        </Tip>
        <Tip label="Redo">
          <button type="button" aria-label="Redo" disabled={!future.length || running} onClick={redo} className={cn(ICON_BUTTON, "h-7 w-7 disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-35")}>
            <Redo2 size={14} strokeWidth={1.75} aria-hidden />
          </button>
        </Tip>
        {/* a fixed width: the label swaps in place and the button never resizes */}
        <button type="button" disabled={running || rows.length === 0} onClick={run} className={cn(BUTTON_PRIMARY, "ml-auto h-7 w-[116px] px-3 text-[11.5px]")}>
          <motion.span
            key={running ? "running" : status === "done" ? "again" : "run"}
            className="inline-block"
            initial={still ? false : { opacity: 0, y: 4, filter: "blur(2px)" }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, filter: "blur(0px)" }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
          >
            {running ? "Running" : status === "done" ? "Run again" : "Run simulation"}
          </motion.span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

```tsx
/* Control classes: the library's control material for components that ship on their own
   (2026-10-02, the audit's pattern 11). src/components/library/controls.ts is the site's
   copy; components used to paste its look in as a flat 8% fill "so the file ships alone",
   and those copies never turned white on a raised light surface. These read the same
   tokens WITH a fallback, so they follow the site's raised-surface rule here and still
   draw correctly in a buyer's app that has no such tokens. Shipped beside every component
   that imports it (scripts/build-registry.mjs bundles ui helpers automatically).

   Whole class strings, never assembled from pieces: Tailwind reads this file as text. */

/** what is ON in a switcher. Light (his call, 2026-10-02, after the inline slider): a WHITE
 *  pill with a hairline and a soft shadow on the grey track. Dark: the 8% thumb */
export const THUMB =
  "bg-white shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--light-outline,rgba(0,0,0,0.09)),0_1px_3px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] dark:bg-[var(--control-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_8%,transparent))] dark:shadow-[var(--control-shadow,inset_0_1px_0_0_color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_6%,transparent))]"

/** what a switcher's options sit in; its 2px padding is the gap the thumb keeps. Light: a
 *  light grey track with no outline, the white pill sits in it. Dark: a hairline, no fill */
export const TRACK = "rounded-full border border-transparent bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_5%,var(--background))] p-0.5 dark:border-foreground/[0.04] dark:bg-transparent"

/** an option that is off: the label alone answers the pointer */
export const SEGMENT_OFF = "text-foreground/60 hover:text-foreground/90"

/** a secondary button: the thumb standing alone; size it with h-7 / h-9 and px */
export const BUTTON =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--control-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_8%,transparent))] shadow-[var(--control-shadow,inset_0_1px_0_0_color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_6%,transparent))] text-foreground/90 outline-none transition-[color,background-color,scale] duration-150 hover:bg-[var(--control-fill-hover,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_12%,transparent))] focus-visible:bg-[var(--control-fill-hover,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_12%,transparent))] active:scale-[0.97] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40 motion-reduce:active:scale-100"

/** an icon-only control: no fill at rest, a faint one under the pointer */
export const ICON_BUTTON =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-full text-foreground/60 outline-none transition-[color,background-color] duration-150 hover:bg-foreground/[0.06] hover:text-foreground/90 focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.06]"

/** a field: the track with just enough fill to read as somewhere to type */
export const FIELD =
  "rounded-full border border-foreground/[0.04] bg-[var(--field-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_5%,transparent))] text-foreground/90 outline-none transition-[background-color,border-color] duration-150 placeholder:text-foreground/45 focus:border-foreground/[0.12]"

/** the one loud button of a form: 48px, full width, the foreground filled (the dashboards'
 *  Modal primary). A ticket, a swap, a confirm: one of these and nothing louder */
export const BUTTON_PRIMARY =
  "inline-flex h-12 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-foreground/[0.92] text-[14px] font-medium text-background outline-none transition-[background-color,scale,opacity] duration-150 hover:bg-foreground focus-visible:bg-foreground active:scale-[0.98] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40 motion-reduce:active:scale-100"

/** a component's own card, field or block (spec 14.8). Dark: a #121212 fill on black. Light
 *  (his call, 2026-10-02: "on light the card background is too dark, it can just be white, a

export const SURFACE =

/** a block sitting ON a surface: a faint 4% grey inside a white card in light, #1f1f1f in dark */
```

# Key Stats Strip (vitals-strip)
> A key stats strip for a stock page with price, market cap, index weight, volume and P/E, each figure showing its formula on hover.

// ─── components/ui/vitals-strip.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useEffect, useState, type ReactNode } from "react"
import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { usePointed } from "@/components/ui/use-pointed"

/* Vitals Strip, promoted from a lab sketch through ssych-component (2026-09-29).
   What it is for: the handful of figures that sit over a chart or a ticket: price, size,
   weight, volume, a ratio, and a count that is still running.
   Read first: the first cell, the price and its change.
   The pointer: pointing at a cell, or tabbing to it, dims the others and the line under
   the strip reads what that figure divides or multiplies.
   Sketch: lab/VitalsStrip. Kept: one thin row of label and value, hairlines between the
   cells, the trade count that ticks up and flashes to full ink as it lands, the
   derivation of each figure.
   Changed: the box, its outline and inner shadow are gone; the label sits over the value
   so six cells fit 520px without scrolling (the sketch was 760 wide and scrolled); the
   derivation was a browser tooltip, which a keyboard and a touch screen never see, and is
   now a line of text; the cells and the count are props.
   The sample numbers hold: 15.44B × 228.02 = 3.52T, 3.52T ÷ 56.3T = 6.25%,
   228.02 ÷ 7.31 = 31.2.
   Formulas: each cell carries its own in `hint`.
   · trades = the opening count + 1 for each tick; ticks only while the strip is pointed at,
     still under reduced motion
   2026-10-02 audit: the trade count ran from mount, re-entered through a 4px blur on every
   tick and flashed to full ink; now it ticks only while the strip is pointed at (his call,
   usePointed) and changes in place, with no flash and no re-entry. The vertical rules
   between cells are gone (24px gaps instead), the cells have no side padding so the first
   one no longer sits 0 / 12, and the focus fill bleeds 8px past the text on 8px corners.
   The price cell takes a real mark through a new `renderIcon(symbol, size)` prop and a new
   `icon` field on a vital. The hint line reads "Mkt cap: 15.44B shares × $228.02". */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
/** the hint line's swap when the pointed cell changes (a change of intent): a 4px rise through a 2px blur */
const SWAP_FROM = { opacity: 0, y: 4, filter: "blur(2px)" }
const SWAP_TO = { opacity: 1, y: 0, filter: "blur(0px)" }
const GREEN = "var(--chart-up)"
const RED = "var(--chart-down)"

export interface Vital {
  label: string
  value: string
  /** a signed change, written with + or − */
  delta?: string
  /** how the figure is reached, read out while the cell is pointed at */
  hint?: string
  /** a ticker or token whose mark `renderIcon` draws before the label */
  icon?: string
}

export interface VitalsStripProps {
  vitals?: Vital[]
  /** the label of the running count, the last cell; leave empty to drop the cell */
  counter?: string
  /** where the running count starts */
  count?: number
  /** milliseconds between ticks of the count while the strip is pointed at; 0 holds it still */
  every?: number
  /** draws a company or token mark (14px) before a vital's label; the preview passes BrandIcon */
  renderIcon?: (symbol: string, size: number) => ReactNode
  className?: string
}

const DEFAULT_VITALS: Vital[] = [
  { label: "AAPL", value: "$228.02", delta: "+2.56%", hint: "last price, change against the prior close", icon: "AAPL" },
  { label: "Mkt cap", value: "3.52T", hint: "15.44B shares × $228.02" },
  { label: "Index weight", value: "6.25%", hint: "3.52T ÷ 56.3T index cap" },
  { label: "Volume", value: "54.2M", hint: "shares traded, session to date" },
  { label: "P/E", value: "31.2", hint: "$228.02 ÷ $7.31 earnings a share, trailing 12 months" },
]

/**
 * A strip of vitals: label over value, hairlines between. The last cell is a count that
 * ticks; pointing at any cell reads how its figure is reached.
 */
export function VitalsStrip({ vitals = DEFAULT_VITALS, counter = "Trades", count = 4215882, every = 1400, renderIcon, className }: VitalsStripProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const [hot, setHot] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const [ticks, setTicks] = useState(0)
  /* the count runs only while the strip is pointed at (his call, 2026-10-02); at rest it holds */
  const { ref, live: pointed, bind } = usePointed()

  useEffect(() => {
    if (reduced || !pointed || !counter || every <= 0) return
    const id = setInterval(() => setTicks((t) => t + 1), every)
    return () => clearInterval(id)
  }, [reduced, pointed, counter, every])

  const cells: Vital[] = counter
    ? [...vitals, { label: counter, value: (count + ticks).toLocaleString("en-US"), hint: `${count.toLocaleString("en-US")} at the open + ${ticks} since` }]
    : vitals
  const shown = hot === null ? null : cells[hot]

  return (
    <div ref={ref} {...bind} className={cn("w-[520px] max-w-full tabular-nums", className)} role="group" aria-label={cells.map((c) => `${c.label} ${c.value}${c.delta ? ` ${c.delta}` : ""}`).join(", ")}>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-6 gap-y-3" onPointerLeave={() => setHot(null)}>
        {cells.map((c, i) => {
          const live = !!counter && i === cells.length - 1
          return (
            <div
              key={c.label}
              tabIndex={0}
              role="group"
              aria-label={`${c.label} ${c.value}${c.delta ? `, ${c.delta}` : ""}${c.hint ? `. ${c.hint}` : ""}`}
              onPointerEnter={() => setHot(i)}
              onFocus={() => setHot(i)}
              onBlur={() => setHot(null)}
              /* no side padding and no rules: cells part by the 24px gap; focus bleeds 8px past the text */
              className="-mx-2 flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-1 rounded-[8px] px-2 outline-none transition-opacity duration-200 focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.06]"
              style={{ opacity: hot !== null && hot !== i ? 0.45 : 1 }}
            >
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap text-[10px] text-foreground/45">
                {renderIcon && c.icon ? (
                  <span aria-hidden className="inline-flex shrink-0">
                    {renderIcon(c.icon, 14)}
                  </span>
                ) : null}
                {c.label}
              </span>
              <span className="flex items-baseline gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap">
                {/* the running count changes in place on each tick: no re-entry, no flash (spec 13.4) */}
                <span className={cn("text-[12px] font-medium", live ? "text-foreground/70" : "text-foreground/90")}>{c.value}</span>
                {c.delta && (
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-medium" style={{ color: /^[-−]/.test(c.delta.trim()) ? RED : GREEN }}>
                    {c.delta}
                  </span>
                )}
              </span>
            </div>
          )
        })}
      </div>

      <div role="status" className="mt-2.5 h-[14px] text-[10.5px] leading-[14px] text-foreground/45">
        {shown && (
          /* the line swaps in place as the pointer moves between cells */
          <motion.span
            key={hot}
            className="inline-block"
            initial={reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : SWAP_FROM}
            animate={SWAP_TO}
            transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
          >
            <span className="font-medium text-foreground/90">{shown.label}</span>
            {shown.hint ? `: ${shown.hint}` : ""}
          </motion.span>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

// ─── components/ui/use-pointed.ts ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react"

/* usePointed: live content runs only while it is being looked at (his call, 2026-10-02:
   "it should start animating only when you start hovering on it; anything with numbers
   that change can start once you hover on the component"). Spread `bind` on the
   component's root; `live` is true while the pointer is on it or focus is inside it, and
   stays true for `linger` ms after it leaves so a pass across the edge does not stop and
   start the feed. On a device with no hover (touch) it is true while the component is at
   least half in view instead, since a finger cannot point without pressing. */
export function usePointed<T extends HTMLElement = HTMLDivElement>({ linger = 600 } = {}) {
  const ref = useRef<T>(null)
  const [pointed, setPointed] = useState(false)
  const [seen, setSeen] = useState(false)
  const [touch] = useState(() => typeof matchMedia === "function" && !matchMedia("(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)").matches)
  const timer = useRef<number | undefined>(undefined)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!touch || !ref.current || typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined") return
    const io = new IntersectionObserver(([e]) => setSeen(e.isIntersecting), { threshold: 0.5 })
    io.observe(ref.current)
    return () => io.disconnect()
  }, [touch])
  useEffect(() => () => window.clearTimeout(timer.current), [])

  const on = () => {
    window.clearTimeout(timer.current)
    setPointed(true)
  }
  const off = () => {
    window.clearTimeout(timer.current)
    timer.current = window.setTimeout(() => setPointed(false), linger)
  }

  return {
    ref,
    live: touch ? seen : pointed,
    bind: {
      onPointerEnter: on,
      onPointerLeave: off,
      onFocus: on,
      onBlur: (e: React.FocusEvent) => {
        if (!e.currentTarget.contains(e.relatedTarget as Node | null)) off()
      },
    },
  }
}
```
