# Uptime Bars (uptime-bars)
> A 90 day uptime status chart for APIs and inference services, reading the uptime and incident of any day on hover.

// ─── components/ui/uptime-bars.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react"
import { useInView, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { ChartCard } from "@/components/ui/chart-overlay"

/* Uptime Bars, written new through ssych-component (2026-09-29).
   What it is for: ninety days of one service, a bar a day, so a bad day is found by eye.
   Read first: the uptime percent for the window.
   The pointer: scrub the bars (or focus them and use the arrow keys). The pointed day stays
   full and the rest dim; a card by the bar reads that day's uptime, the time lost, and the
   incident with its severity. The headline keeps the window.
   Reference: browsable "uptime" (90 Day Uptime Bars, Uptime Status Page, Status Page). Only
   the index descriptions were read, no source. Idea taken: one thin bar per day with the
   day's record behind the pointer. Colour: a clean day is quiet ink at 20% and turns green
   only under the pointer, so at rest only the incident days carry colour; a minor incident
   is degraded, amber; a major or critical one is red, deeper the worse it was.
   Formulas:
   · day uptime     = (1440 − minutes down that day) / 1440
   · window uptime  = 1 − Σ minutes down / (days × 1440)
                      sample: 1 − 205 / (90 × 1440) = 99.84%
   · incidents      = count of days that carry an incident (sample: 6)
   · time down      = Σ minutes down (sample: 6 + 41 + 4 + 118 + 9 + 27 = 205 min = 3 h 25 min)
   Motion (2026-10-01): the bars grow from the floor once the strip is a third in view, left
   to right with the stagger spread over 360ms and 400ms a bar (760ms in all), as CSS
   transitions so ninety bars cost no script per frame; reduced motion shows them standing.
   No data changes here, so nothing else moves.
   2026-10-02 audit: the header is the three tiers now: the service at /45 with the window
   (90 days) at /90 in a 12px label row, the window uptime as the 26px headline with its
   decimals at /35, and a 12px sub line with the time down in red and the incident count
   at /45. A pointed day no longer overwrites the headline: it opens a ChartCard by the bar
   (the date as heading, Uptime, Down and Severity rows, the incident named under them),
   so the joined "title · severity · time" line is gone. Clean days moved from 45% green to
   ink at 20%, green under the pointer, so the doc comment and the bars agree. Axis text is
   9px /45. */

const CSS_EASE = "cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)"
const RED = "var(--chart-down)"
const GREEN = "var(--chart-up)"
const AMBER = "var(--chart-amber)"
const DAY_MINUTES = 1440

export type UptimeSeverity = "minor" | "major" | "critical"

export interface UptimeIncident {
  title: string
  severity: UptimeSeverity
  /** minutes the service was down that day */
  downMinutes: number
}

export interface UptimeDay {
  /** ISO day, 2026-09-28 */
  date: string
  incident?: UptimeIncident
}

export interface UptimeBarsProps {
  /** oldest first, one entry per day */
  days?: UptimeDay[]
  /** the service the bars belong to, written beside the window's uptime */
  title?: string
  className?: string
}

const SAMPLE_INCIDENTS: Record<string, UptimeIncident> = {
  "2026-07-09": { title: "Elevated API error rate", severity: "minor", downMinutes: 6 },
  "2026-07-23": { title: "Webhook deliveries delayed", severity: "major", downMinutes: 41 },
  "2026-08-04": { title: "Dashboard slow to load", severity: "minor", downMinutes: 4 },
  "2026-08-19": { title: "Database failover in eu-west", severity: "critical", downMinutes: 118 },
  "2026-09-02": { title: "Token refresh failures", severity: "minor", downMinutes: 9 },
  "2026-09-17": { title: "Inference queue backlog", severity: "major", downMinutes: 27 },
}

/* 31 + 31 + 28 = 90 days, 2026-07-01 to 2026-09-28 */
const SAMPLE_MONTHS = [
  { month: 7, days: 31 },
  { month: 8, days: 31 },
  { month: 9, days: 28 },
]

const two = (v: number) => String(v).padStart(2, "0")

const DEFAULT_DAYS: UptimeDay[] = SAMPLE_MONTHS.flatMap(({ month, days }) =>
  Array.from({ length: days }, (_, d): UptimeDay => {
    const date = `2026-${two(month)}-${two(d + 1)}`
    const incident = SAMPLE_INCIDENTS[date]
    return incident ? { date, incident } : { date }
  }),
)

const MONTHS = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"]

/** "2026-08-19" reads as "Aug 19": taken from the string, so no clock is involved */
const dayLabel = (iso: string) => {
  const parts = iso.split("-")
  return `${MONTHS[Number(parts[1]) - 1] ?? ""} ${Number(parts[2])}`
}

const downOf = (d: UptimeDay | undefined) => d?.incident?.downMinutes ?? 0
const dayUptime = (d: UptimeDay | undefined) => ((DAY_MINUTES - downOf(d)) / DAY_MINUTES) * 100
const span = (min: number) => (min >= 60 ? `${Math.floor(min / 60)} h ${min % 60} min` : `${min} min`)

const SEVERITY_NAME: Record<UptimeSeverity, string> = { minor: "Minor", major: "Major", critical: "Critical" }
/** severity: degraded is amber, down is red, and the red deepens with how bad it was */
const SEVERITY: Record<UptimeSeverity, string> = {
  minor: AMBER,
  major: `color-mix(in srgb, ${RED} 68%, transparent)`,
  critical: RED,
}
const barFill = (d: UptimeDay, on: boolean) =>
  d.incident ? SEVERITY[d.incident.severity] : on ? GREEN : undefined
/* the grey days come from a class so light and dark can differ (his call, 2026-10-02:
   lighter on light): 11% ink in light, 20% in dark */
const IDLE_BAR = "fill-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_11%,transparent)] dark:fill-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_20%,transparent)]"

const W = 460
const H = 40

/**
 * Ninety days of uptime as thin bars. A clean day is quiet ink and a day with an incident
 * is amber or red, deeper the worse it was. Scrubbing reads any day in a card by its bar.
 */
export function UptimeBars({ days = DEFAULT_DAYS, title = "API uptime", className }: UptimeBarsProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const boxRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  /* the bars wait until the strip is a third in view, then grow once */
  const play = useInView(boxRef, { once: true, amount: 0.3 }) || !!reduced
  const [hot, setHot] = useState<number | null>(null)

  const n = days.length
  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const down = days.reduce((s, d) => s + downOf(d), 0)
    return {
      down,
      incidents: days.filter((d) => d.incident).length,
      uptime: n ? (1 - down / (n * DAY_MINUTES)) * 100 : 100,
    }
  }, [days, n])

  const step = W / Math.max(1, n)
  const bar = Math.max(1, step - 2)
  const clamp = (i: number) => Math.max(0, Math.min(n - 1, i))

  const onMove = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    const el = boxRef.current
    if (!el || !n) return
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect()
    setHot(clamp(Math.floor(((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width) * n)))
  }
  const onKey = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") setHot((h) => clamp((h ?? n) - 1))
    else if (e.key === "ArrowRight") setHot((h) => clamp((h ?? -1) + 1))
    else if (e.key === "Escape") setHot(null)
    else return
    e.preventDefault()
  }

  const day = hot === null ? undefined : days[hot]
  const [whole, decimals] = stats.uptime.toFixed(2).split(".")
  const first = days[0]
  const last = days[n - 1]
  /* month starts that sit clear of both ends get a tick of their own */
  const ticks = days
    .map((d, i) => ({ d, i }))
    .filter(({ d, i }) => d.date.endsWith("-01") && i > 8 && i < n - 9)

  return (
    <div className={cn("w-[460px] max-w-full tabular-nums", className)}>
      {/* the three tiers (spec 14.1); the headline always reads the window, a pointed day
          reads in the card by its bar */}
      <div>
        <div className="mb-3 flex items-baseline justify-between text-[12px]">
          <span className="text-foreground/45">{title}</span>
          <span className="font-medium text-foreground/90">{n} days</span>
        </div>
        <div className="text-[26px] font-semibold leading-none tracking-[-0.02em] text-foreground/90">
          {whole}
          <span className="text-foreground/35">.{decimals}%</span>
        </div>
        <div className="mt-2 text-[12px] font-medium">
          <span style={{ color: stats.down ? RED : GREEN }}>{stats.down ? `${span(stats.down)} down` : "No time down"}</span>
          <span className="font-normal text-foreground/45">
            {" "}
            in {stats.incidents} incident{stats.incidents === 1 ? "" : "s"}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div
        ref={boxRef}
        tabIndex={0}
        role="group"
        aria-label={`${title} by day, arrow keys move between days`}
        className="relative mt-3 cursor-crosshair touch-none rounded-[3px] outline-none focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.04]"
        onPointerMove={onMove}
        onPointerLeave={() => setHot(null)}
        onKeyDown={onKey}
        onBlur={() => setHot(null)}
      >
        <svg
          viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`}
          className="block w-full overflow-visible"
          role="img"
          aria-label={`${title}, ${stats.uptime.toFixed(2)}% uptime over ${n} days, ${stats.incidents} incidents, ${span(stats.down)} down`}
        >
          {days.map((d, i) => {
            const on = hot === i
            return (
              /* the group owns the dim so it never fights the entrance inside */
              <g key={d.date} style={{ opacity: hot !== null && !on ? 0.4 : 1, transition: "opacity 150ms ease-out" }}>
                {/* each bar grows from the floor once; ninety bars share a 360ms stagger */}
                <rect
                  x={i * step + 1}
                  y={0}
                  width={bar}
                  height={H}
                  rx={1}
                  fill={barFill(d, on)}
                  className={barFill(d, on) ? undefined : IDLE_BAR}
                  style={{
                    transformBox: "fill-box",
                    transformOrigin: "50% 100%",
                    transform: play ? "none" : "scaleY(0)",
                    transition: reduced ? "fill 150ms ease-out" : `fill 150ms ease-out, transform 400ms ${CSS_EASE} ${((i / Math.max(1, n)) * 0.36).toFixed(3)}s`,
                  }}
                />
              </g>
            )
          })}
        </svg>
        {/* the pointed day reads in the library popover by its bar (spec 13.5, 14.6) */}
        <ChartCard
          open={!!day}
          x={hot === null ? 0 : `${((hot + 0.5) / Math.max(1, n)) * 100}%`}
          y={H + 6}
          flip={hot !== null && (hot + 0.5) / Math.max(1, n) > 0.6}
          width={176}
          heading={day ? dayLabel(day.date) : ""}
          rows={
            day
              ? [
                  { label: "Uptime", value: `${dayUptime(day).toFixed(2)}%` },
                  { label: "Down", value: span(downOf(day)) },
                  day.incident
                    ? { label: "Severity", value: SEVERITY_NAME[day.incident.severity], color: SEVERITY[day.incident.severity] }
                    : { label: "Incident", value: "None" },
                ]
              : []
          }
          footer={day?.incident ? <span className="text-foreground/90">{day.incident.title}</span> : undefined}
        />
      </div>

      <div className="relative mt-1.5 h-3 text-[9px] text-foreground/45" aria-hidden>
        {first && <span className="absolute left-0">{dayLabel(first.date)}</span>}
        {ticks.map(({ d, i }) => (
          <span key={d.date} className="absolute" style={{ left: `${(i / n) * 100}%` }}>
            {dayLabel(d.date)}
          </span>
        ))}
        {last && n > 1 && <span className="absolute right-0">{dayLabel(last.date)}</span>}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

// ─── components/ui/chart-overlay.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { type ReactNode } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

/* Chart overlay: the two parts every library chart reads a point with (2026-10-02). They
   came out of Candlestick, Volume Profile, the trading terminal and Price Scrubber, which
   had each drawn their own; this is the one copy. Shipped beside the charts that use it.

   AxisTag   the outlined tag on the value axis: the pointed value in its hue, or a named
             reference (POC, last close) in ink. A pill 16px high, 8.5px figures.
   ChartCard the card laid over the chart beside the cursor: a heading row (a time or a
             range) at /60, then label and value rows (labels 10px /60, values 11px /90),
             the one signed figure in its hue. It glides between points on a spring, fades
             in from 0.97 and out in 120ms, and flips to the cursor's left when told to.

   2026-10-02: the card looked out of place over the charts, so it now wears the library
   popover, the same as the sidebar's hover card: a hairline border at 8%, radius 12, the
   6% foreground mix and the popover shadow with no inset highlight (spec 14.6). */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GLIDE = { type: "spring", stiffness: 520, damping: 40 } as const

/** the outlined tag on a chart's value axis, centred on `y` */
export function AxisTag({
  x,
  y,
  width,
  color = "var(--foreground)",
  strong = true,
  hidden = false,
  children,
}: {
  /** the tag's left edge, in the chart's own units */
  x: number
  /** the value's line; the tag is centred on it */
  y: number
  width: number
  /** stroke and figure; ink for a named reference, the series hue for the pointed value */
  color?: string
  /** a quieter tag (a secondary reference) drops the weight and the stroke */
  strong?: boolean
  /** fades the tag out, for when the pointed value sits on it */
  hidden?: boolean
  children: ReactNode
}) {
  return (
    <g transform={`translate(${x}, ${y - 8})`} pointerEvents="none" style={{ opacity: hidden ? 0 : 1, transition: "opacity 150ms" }}>
      <rect width={width} height={16} rx={8} fill="var(--background)" stroke={color} strokeOpacity={strong ? 0.6 : 0.2} />
      <text x={width / 2} y={11} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={8.5} fontWeight={strong ? 600 : 500} fill={color} fillOpacity={strong ? 1 : 0.65}>
        {children}
      </text>
    </g>
  )
}

export interface ChartCardRow {
  label: string
  value: ReactNode
  /** only the one signed figure carries a hue */
  color?: string
}

/** the readout card over a chart; place it inside a `relative` box that holds the svg */
export function ChartCard({
  open,
  x,
  y = 4,
  flip = false,
  width = 148,
  heading,
  rows,
  footer,
}: {
  open: boolean
  /** the cursor's x inside the box: px, or a percentage string for a chart drawn to a viewBox */
  x: number | string
  /** the card's top inside the box, px */
  y?: number
  /** put the card on the cursor's left (past ~60% of the plot) */
  flip?: boolean
  width?: number
  heading: ReactNode
  rows: ChartCardRow[]
  /** a closing line under the rows, such as where the point sits */
  footer?: ReactNode
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {open && (
        <motion.div
          key="chart-card"
          role="status"
          className="pointer-events-none absolute z-10"
          initial={{ left: x, top: y, opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ left: x, top: y, opacity: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, transition: { duration: 0.12 } }}
          transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { left: GLIDE, top: GLIDE, opacity: { duration: 0.15 } }}
        >
          <motion.div
            className="rounded-[12px] border border-foreground/[0.08] px-3 py-2.5"
            style={{
              width,
              translate: flip ? "calc(-100% - 12px) 0" : "12px 0",
              transition: reduced ? undefined : "translate 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)",
              background: "var(--tip-fill, color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 6%, var(--background)))",
              boxShadow: "0 8px 24px var(--card-shadow, rgba(0,0,0,calc(0.35 * var(--shadow-k, 1))))",
            }}
            initial={reduced ? false : { scale: 0.97 }}
            animate={{ scale: 1 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
          >
            <div className="text-[10px] text-foreground/60">{heading}</div>
            <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-col gap-1">
              {rows.map((r) => (
                <div key={r.label} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-foreground/60">{r.label}</span>
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-foreground/90" style={r.color ? { color: r.color } : undefined}>
                    {r.value}
                  </span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            {footer && <div className="mt-1.5 text-[10px]">{footer}</div>}
          </motion.div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  )
}
```

# Gantt Chart (gantt-mini)
> A compact Gantt chart for sprint and release planning, with a today line and the dates, length and owner of each task on hover.

// ─── components/ui/gantt-mini.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useRef, useState } from "react"
import { motion, useInView, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { ChartCard } from "@/components/ui/chart-overlay"

/* Gantt Mini, promoted from a lab sketch through ssych-component (2026-09-29).
   What it is for: a two-week sprint as a strip: who works on what, from when to when,
   and where today falls.
   Read first: the line for today, and the bars it crosses. Those are the strongest ink.
   The pointer: point at a task, or tab to it, and the rest of the plan steps back, its bar
   comes to full ink, and a card by the bar reads its full name, its dates, its length and
   its owner (a long name truncates in the row, so the card is where it is read whole).
   Lab sketch: src/components/lab/GanttMini.tsx. Kept: 14 days, a row per task, bars that
   draw in from the left, the weekend tint, the today line, one task read at a time.
   Changed: no card, header band or floating tooltip; bars were green, blue and grey by
   state, each lane now has its own hue and the state is its strength (full while active or
   pointed at); the today line is ink; owners are roles. The state of a task was typed
   beside its dates and could contradict them; it is worked out from the dates and today.
   One sample task sat wholly on a weekend; the plan now runs on working days.
   Since 2026-10-01 the "6 tasks · 3 done · 2 active · 1 upcoming" line is for screen
   readers only, and the rows are 40 tall (were 28) with 8px bars (were 6).
   Formulas:
   · last day of a task = start + span − 1
   · state              = done when the last day is before today, upcoming when the start
                          is after today, otherwise active
   · date of day d      = the sprint's first day + d (Mon Jul 20, so day 9 is Jul 29)
   · done, active, upcoming = count of tasks in each state (sample: 3, 2, 1)
   Motion (2026-10-01): the bars draw in from their start day once the strip is a third in
   view, 30ms apart over 500ms (650ms in all); reduced motion shows them drawn. No data
   changes here, so nothing else moves.
   2026-10-02 audit: he found the bars too short, so they are 16px pills in 32px rows (the
   plot stays the same height). Pointing at a task, or tabbing to it, now opens a ChartCard
   by its bar with the full name as heading and Dates, Days and Owner rows, so a truncated
   name always has a reveal. The six lane hues are gone (the rows are already apart and
   labelled): bars are ink by state, active 90%, done 35%, upcoming 15%, the pointed one
   90%. The 13 vertical day rules are gone, the weekend wash and the week ticks carry the
   grid. Task names are 12px, axis text 9px /45, width 460 like the other charts.
   2026-10-02 round 2: the sample is a model release in place of a generic product sprint:
   data freeze, fine tune, eval suite, red team, a 5% canary and the full rollout, owned by
   the roles that run them. Starts, spans and today are unchanged, so the states still
   count 3 done, 2 active, 1 upcoming (the eval suite ends on day 8, before today). */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const

const ROW_H = 32
/** bar thickness; a pill, so its radius is half of this */
const BAR_H = 16
const LABEL_W = 112
const MONTHS = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"]
const MONTH_DAYS = [31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]

export type GanttState = "done" | "active" | "upcoming"

export interface GanttTask {
  name: string
  /** day offset from the first day of the sprint */
  start: number
  /** length in days */
  span: number
  /** the role that owns the task */
  owner: string
}

export interface GanttMiniProps {
  tasks?: GanttTask[]
  /** the sprint's name, read to assistive tech only */
  title?: string
  /** length of the sprint in days */
  days?: number
  /** day offset of today */
  today?: number
  /** the first day of the sprint; it must be a Monday for the weekend tint to fall right */
  startMonth?: number
  startDay?: number
  className?: string
}

const DEFAULT_TASKS: GanttTask[] = [
  { name: "Data freeze", start: 0, span: 3, owner: "Data engineer" },
  { name: "Fine tune", start: 2, span: 3, owner: "ML engineer" },
  { name: "Eval suite", start: 7, span: 2, owner: "Eval lead" },
  { name: "Red team", start: 7, span: 4, owner: "Safety lead" },
  { name: "Canary at 5%", start: 9, span: 3, owner: "Platform engineer" },
  { name: "Full rollout", start: 11, span: 1, owner: "Release manager" },
]

/** the state is the bar's ink; the pointed bar comes to 90 */
const STRENGTH: Record<GanttState, number> = { done: 35, active: 90, upcoming: 15 }
const ink = (pct: number) => `color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) ${pct}%, transparent)`

const stateOf = (t: GanttTask, today: number): GanttState => (t.start + t.span - 1 < today ? "done" : t.start > today ? "upcoming" : "active")

/** the date of day d, walking the months of a common year */
function dateOf(d: number, month: number, day: number) {
  let m = month - 1
  let n = day + d
  while (n > MONTH_DAYS[m % 12]) {
    n -= MONTH_DAYS[m % 12]
    m++
  }
  return `${MONTHS[m % 12]} ${n}`
}

/**
 * A sprint strip in the Linear register: a quiet day grid, bars that draw in from the
 * left and a hairline for today. Pointing at a task steps the rest back and reads its
 * dates and owner above the plan.
 * 2026-10-02: weekend washes lifted to 6% so the weekends read on white and on black.
 */
export function GanttMini({ tasks = DEFAULT_TASKS, title = "Model release, checkpoint 14", days = 14, today = 9, startMonth = 7, startDay = 20, className }: GanttMiniProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const [hot, setHot] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const boxRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  /* the draw waits until the strip is a third in view, then plays once */
  const play = useInView(boxRef, { once: true, amount: 0.3 }) || !!reduced

  const date = (d: number) => dateOf(d, startMonth, startDay)
  const states = tasks.map((t) => stateOf(t, today))
  const count = (s: GanttState) => states.filter((x) => x === s).length
  const shown = hot === null ? null : tasks[hot]
  const left = (d: number) => `${(d / days) * 100}%`
  /** Saturdays, where the first day is a Monday */
  const weekends = Array.from({ length: Math.ceil(days / 7) }, (_, w) => w * 7 + 5).filter((d) => d < days)
  const weeks = Array.from({ length: Math.ceil(days / 7) }, (_, w) => w * 7)

  return (
    <div
      className={cn("w-[460px] max-w-full tabular-nums", className)}
      role="group"
      aria-label={`${title}, ${tasks.length} tasks, ${count("done")} done, ${count("active")} active, ${count("upcoming")} upcoming, today is ${date(today)}`}
    >
      {/* the readout is for screen readers only (2026-10-01): the counts line read as clutter above
          the plan; the pointed task is still announced */}
      <span role="status" className="sr-only">
        {shown
          ? `${shown.name}, ${shown.span === 1 ? date(shown.start) : `${date(shown.start)} to ${date(shown.start + shown.span - 1)}`}, ${shown.span} ${shown.span === 1 ? "day" : "days"}, ${shown.owner}`
          : `${tasks.length} tasks, ${count("done")} done, ${count("active")} active, ${count("upcoming")} upcoming`}
      </span>

      <div ref={boxRef} className="relative" onPointerLeave={() => setHot(null)}>
        {/* the day grid sits behind the rows, over the track only */}
        <div aria-hidden className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-y-0 right-0" style={{ left: LABEL_W }}>
          {weekends.map((d) => (
            <span key={d} className="absolute inset-y-0 bg-foreground/[0.06]" style={{ left: left(d), width: left(Math.min(2, days - d)) }} />
          ))}
          <span className="absolute inset-y-0 w-px" style={{ left: `calc(${left(today + 0.5)} - 0.5px)`, background: ink(45) }} />
        </div>

        {tasks.map((t, i) => {
          const on = hot === i
          const state = states[i]
          return (
            <button
              key={t.name}
              type="button"
              aria-label={`${t.name}, ${state}, ${date(t.start)} to ${date(t.start + t.span - 1)}, ${t.span} ${t.span === 1 ? "day" : "days"}, ${t.owner}`}
              onPointerEnter={() => setHot(i)}
              onFocus={() => setHot(i)}
              onBlur={() => setHot(null)}
              className="relative flex w-full items-center text-left outline-none transition-opacity duration-200 focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.04] motion-reduce:transition-none"
              style={{ height: ROW_H, opacity: hot !== null && !on ? 0.4 : 1 }}
            >
              <span className={cn("shrink-0 truncate pr-2 text-[12px]", state === "done" ? "text-foreground/45" : "text-foreground/90")} style={{ width: LABEL_W }}>
                {t.name}
              </span>
              <span className="relative block h-full flex-1">
                <motion.span
                  aria-hidden
                  className="absolute top-1/2 block origin-left -translate-y-1/2 rounded-full"
                  style={{ height: BAR_H, left: left(t.start), width: left(t.span), background: ink(on ? 90 : STRENGTH[state]), transition: reduced ? "none" : "background 150ms" }}
                  initial={reduced ? false : { scaleX: 0 }}
                  animate={{ scaleX: play ? 1 : 0 }}
                  transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.5, ease: EASE, delay: Math.min(i, 9) * 0.03 }}
                />
              </span>
            </button>
          )
        })}

        {/* the pointed task reads in the library popover by its bar: the name in full (spec 13.5, 14.6) */}
        <div aria-hidden className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-y-0 right-0" style={{ left: LABEL_W }}>
          {(() => {
            const end = shown ? (shown.start + shown.span) / days : 0
            const flip = end > 0.6
            return (
              <ChartCard
                open={!!shown}
                x={shown ? left(flip ? shown.start : shown.start + shown.span) : 0}
                y={hot === null ? 0 : hot * ROW_H + ROW_H / 2 - 12}
                flip={flip}
                width={176}
                heading={shown?.name ?? ""}
                rows={
                  shown
                    ? [
                        { label: "Dates", value: shown.span === 1 ? date(shown.start) : `${date(shown.start)} to ${date(shown.start + shown.span - 1)}` },
                        { label: "Days", value: String(shown.span) },
                        { label: "Owner", value: shown.owner },
                      ]
                    : []
                }
              />
            )
          })()}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div aria-hidden className="relative mt-1.5 h-3 text-[9px] text-foreground/45" style={{ marginLeft: LABEL_W }}>
        {weeks.map((d) => (
          <span key={d} className="absolute top-0" style={{ left: left(d) }}>
            {date(d)}
          </span>
        ))}
        <span className="absolute top-0 -translate-x-1/2 font-medium text-foreground/70" style={{ left: left(today + 0.5) }}>
          {date(today)}
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

// ─── components/ui/chart-overlay.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { type ReactNode } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

/* Chart overlay: the two parts every library chart reads a point with (2026-10-02). They
   came out of Candlestick, Volume Profile, the trading terminal and Price Scrubber, which
   had each drawn their own; this is the one copy. Shipped beside the charts that use it.

   AxisTag   the outlined tag on the value axis: the pointed value in its hue, or a named
             reference (POC, last close) in ink. A pill 16px high, 8.5px figures.
   ChartCard the card laid over the chart beside the cursor: a heading row (a time or a
             range) at /60, then label and value rows (labels 10px /60, values 11px /90),
             the one signed figure in its hue. It glides between points on a spring, fades
             in from 0.97 and out in 120ms, and flips to the cursor's left when told to.

   2026-10-02: the card looked out of place over the charts, so it now wears the library
   popover, the same as the sidebar's hover card: a hairline border at 8%, radius 12, the
   6% foreground mix and the popover shadow with no inset highlight (spec 14.6). */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GLIDE = { type: "spring", stiffness: 520, damping: 40 } as const

/** the outlined tag on a chart's value axis, centred on `y` */
export function AxisTag({
  x,
  y,
  width,
  color = "var(--foreground)",
  strong = true,
  hidden = false,
  children,
}: {
  /** the tag's left edge, in the chart's own units */
  x: number
  /** the value's line; the tag is centred on it */
  y: number
  width: number
  /** stroke and figure; ink for a named reference, the series hue for the pointed value */
  color?: string
  /** a quieter tag (a secondary reference) drops the weight and the stroke */
  strong?: boolean
  /** fades the tag out, for when the pointed value sits on it */
  hidden?: boolean
  children: ReactNode
}) {
  return (
    <g transform={`translate(${x}, ${y - 8})`} pointerEvents="none" style={{ opacity: hidden ? 0 : 1, transition: "opacity 150ms" }}>
      <rect width={width} height={16} rx={8} fill="var(--background)" stroke={color} strokeOpacity={strong ? 0.6 : 0.2} />
      <text x={width / 2} y={11} textAnchor="middle" fontSize={8.5} fontWeight={strong ? 600 : 500} fill={color} fillOpacity={strong ? 1 : 0.65}>
        {children}
      </text>
    </g>
  )
}

export interface ChartCardRow {
  label: string
  value: ReactNode
  /** only the one signed figure carries a hue */
  color?: string
}

/** the readout card over a chart; place it inside a `relative` box that holds the svg */
export function ChartCard({
  open,
  x,
  y = 4,
  flip = false,
  width = 148,
  heading,
  rows,
  footer,
}: {
  open: boolean
  /** the cursor's x inside the box: px, or a percentage string for a chart drawn to a viewBox */
  x: number | string
  /** the card's top inside the box, px */
  y?: number
  /** put the card on the cursor's left (past ~60% of the plot) */
  flip?: boolean
  width?: number
  heading: ReactNode
  rows: ChartCardRow[]
  /** a closing line under the rows, such as where the point sits */
  footer?: ReactNode
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {open && (
        <motion.div
          key="chart-card"
          role="status"
          className="pointer-events-none absolute z-10"
          initial={{ left: x, top: y, opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ left: x, top: y, opacity: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, transition: { duration: 0.12 } }}
          transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { left: GLIDE, top: GLIDE, opacity: { duration: 0.15 } }}
        >
          <motion.div
            className="rounded-[12px] border border-foreground/[0.08] px-3 py-2.5"
            style={{
              width,
              translate: flip ? "calc(-100% - 12px) 0" : "12px 0",
              transition: reduced ? undefined : "translate 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)",
              background: "var(--tip-fill, color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 6%, var(--background)))",
              boxShadow: "0 8px 24px var(--card-shadow, rgba(0,0,0,calc(0.35 * var(--shadow-k, 1))))",
            }}
            initial={reduced ? false : { scale: 0.97 }}
            animate={{ scale: 1 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
          >
            <div className="text-[10px] text-foreground/60">{heading}</div>
            <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-col gap-1">
              {rows.map((r) => (
                <div key={r.label} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-foreground/60">{r.label}</span>
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-foreground/90" style={r.color ? { color: r.color } : undefined}>
                    {r.value}
                  </span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            {footer && <div className="mt-1.5 text-[10px]">{footer}</div>}
          </motion.div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  )
}
```

# Kanban Board (kanban-board)
> A kanban board for engineering, ops and compliance work with three columns and counts, moving a card forward in one click.

// ─── components/ui/kanban-board.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react"
import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"
import { ArrowRight, RotateCcw } from "lucide-react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { ICON_BUTTON, RAISED, SURFACE } from "@/components/ui/control-classes"

/* Kanban Board, promoted from a lab sketch through ssych-component (2026-09-29).
   What it is for: the work of one team in three columns, moved on with one press.
   Read first: the count at the head of each column, then the cards under it.
   The pointer: point at a card and the others dim, and its arrow comes up at its right
   with a tip that says where it goes (Move to In progress, Move to Done, Reopen). Press
   the arrow and the card travels to the next column; a card in Done goes back to Backlog.
   Lab sketch: src/components/lab/KanbanBoard.tsx. Kept: three columns, the card shape
   (id, title, tag, owner, column), a press that moves the card on the layout spring, the
   counts taken from the cards. Changed: no card around the board, no header bands,
   column rules or outlined chips; capitals are sentence case; a done card's title steps
   back. Colour (2026-09-30): each column head carries its state's dot, backlog ink, in
   progress amber (pending), done green, so the three states tell apart; owners are roles
   and read as text; the sentence that explained the click is now the readout. A done
   card did nothing when pressed; it reopens.
   Formulas:
   · count of a column = cards whose column it is (sample: 3, 3, 2)
   · cards             = Σ counts (3 + 3 + 2 = 8), read in the board's aria-label
   2026-10-02: the "8 cards" line under the board at rest is gone (his call: the board did
   not need it). The total stays in the aria-label and each column head carries its own
   count; the line under the board reads only the card being pointed at and keeps its
   height when empty.
   2026-10-02: surfaces at 7% (raised blocks white in light, 12% in dark) so cards read on white and on black.
   2026-10-02 audit: he said the board looked weird after the surfaces pass; the two steps
   were one level too high. Each column is now the surface (7%, 18px corners, 6px inset)
   and the cards sit raised on it at 12px corners (18 = 12 + 6), with equal 10px padding and
   a faint 4% hover over the raised fill. A press used to move a card with no affordance
   and Done looped silently to Backlog; the move is now an arrow icon button at the card's
   right, up on hover and focus (always shown on touch), with a tip naming where it goes,
   and Reopen on a done card. The readout line under the board repeated the card's id and
   tag, so it is gone; the owner is a 16px mark on the card (two letters on ink, or the
   caller's drawing through the new `renderIcon(owner, size)` prop) with the role in its
   tip. Card ids at /45.
   2026-10-02 round 2: the cards are an exchange ops and model ops board in place of the
   library team's own tickets: list TAO-PERP, backfill March fills, reconcile treasury
   wallets, rotate exchange API keys, rerun evals on the new checkpoint, raise BTC-PERP
   position limits, onboard a second market maker, fix gaps in book snapshots. The counts
   hold at 3, 3 and 2. */

/** the house layout spring, for a card that changes column */
const SPRING = { type: "spring", stiffness: 400, damping: 32 } as const
const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
/** the state each column stands for: waiting is ink, pending amber, done green */
const STATE: Record<KanbanColumn, string> = {
  backlog: "color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 35%, transparent)",
  progress: "var(--chart-amber)",
  done: "var(--chart-up)",
}

export type KanbanColumn = "backlog" | "progress" | "done"

export interface KanbanCard {
  id: string
  title: string
  tag: string
  /** the role that holds the card */
  owner: string
  col: KanbanColumn
}

export interface KanbanBoardProps {
  cards?: KanbanCard[]
  onMove?: (id: string, to: KanbanColumn) => void
  /** draws an owner's mark (16px) in place of two letters on ink */
  renderIcon?: (owner: string, size: number) => ReactNode
  className?: string
}

const COLUMNS: { key: KanbanColumn; label: string }[] = [
  { key: "backlog", label: "Backlog" },
  { key: "progress", label: "In progress" },
  { key: "done", label: "Done" },
]

const NEXT: Record<KanbanColumn, KanbanColumn> = { backlog: "progress", progress: "done", done: "backlog" }
const NAME: Record<KanbanColumn, string> = { backlog: "Backlog", progress: "In progress", done: "Done" }
/** what the arrow says it will do */
const MOVE: Record<KanbanColumn, string> = { backlog: "Move to In progress", progress: "Move to Done", done: "Reopen" }

const DEFAULT_CARDS: KanbanCard[] = [
  { id: "OPS-41", title: "List TAO-PERP", tag: "Listings", owner: "Listings lead", col: "backlog" },
  { id: "OPS-42", title: "Backfill March fills", tag: "Data", owner: "Data engineer", col: "backlog" },
  { id: "OPS-43", title: "Reconcile treasury wallets", tag: "Treasury", owner: "Treasury analyst", col: "backlog" },
  { id: "OPS-44", title: "Rotate exchange API keys", tag: "Security", owner: "Security engineer", col: "progress" },
  { id: "OPS-45", title: "Rerun evals on the new checkpoint", tag: "Models", owner: "ML engineer", col: "progress" },
  { id: "OPS-46", title: "Raise BTC-PERP position limits", tag: "Risk", owner: "Risk manager", col: "progress" },
  { id: "OPS-47", title: "Onboard a second market maker", tag: "Listings", owner: "Listings lead", col: "done" },
  { id: "OPS-48", title: "Fix gaps in book snapshots", tag: "Data", owner: "Data engineer", col: "done" },
]

/** a role reads as the first letters of its words: Listings lead is LL */
const lettersOf = (owner: string) =>
  owner
    .split(/\s+/)
    .map((w) => w.charAt(0))
    .join("")
    .slice(0, 2)
    .toUpperCase()

/** a tip over a control: up on hover or keyboard focus */
function Tip({ label, children, align = "right" }: { label: string; children: ReactNode; align?: "right" | "center" }) {
  return (
    <span className="group/tip relative inline-flex">
      {children}
      <span
        aria-hidden
        className={cn(
          "pointer-events-none absolute bottom-full z-20 mb-1.5 whitespace-nowrap rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10.5px] text-foreground/90 opacity-0 shadow-[0_4px_12px_var(--card-shadow,rgba(0,0,0,0.25))] transition-opacity duration-150 group-focus-within/tip:opacity-100 group-hover/tip:opacity-100",
          align === "right" ? "right-0" : "left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2",
          RAISED,
        )}
      >
        {label}
      </span>
    </span>
  )
}

/**
 * A three-column board in the Linear register. Each card's arrow sends it to the next
 * column on the layout spring; every count is the cards in that column, so the numbers add up.
 */
export function KanbanBoard({ cards = DEFAULT_CARDS, onMove, renderIcon, className }: KanbanBoardProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion() ?? false
  const ns = useId().replace(/:/g, "")
  const [col, setCol] = useState<Record<string, KanbanColumn>>(() => Object.fromEntries(cards.map((c) => [c.id, c.col])))
  const [hot, setHot] = useState<string | null>(null)
  /** cards rise in once on mount; a card that changes column rides the layout spring only */
  const mounted = useRef(false)
  useEffect(() => {
    mounted.current = true
  }, [])

  const at = (c: KanbanCard) => col[c.id] ?? c.col
  const counts = COLUMNS.map((k) => cards.filter((c) => at(c) === k.key).length)

  const press = (c: KanbanCard) => {
    const to = NEXT[at(c)]
    setCol((prev) => ({ ...prev, [c.id]: to }))
    onMove?.(c.id, to)
  }

  return (
    <div className={cn("w-[520px] max-w-full tabular-nums", className)} role="group" aria-label={`Board, ${cards.length} cards: ${COLUMNS.map((k, i) => `${counts[i]} ${k.label.toLowerCase()}`).join(", ")}`}>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2" onPointerLeave={() => setHot(null)}>
        {COLUMNS.map((column, ci) => (
          /* the column is the surface: 18 = 12 (the raised cards) + 6 (the p-1.5 inset) */
          <div key={column.key} role="group" aria-label={`${column.label}, ${counts[ci]} cards`} className={cn("flex min-h-[280px] flex-col rounded-[18px] p-1.5", SURFACE)}>
            <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between px-1.5 pb-2 pt-1">
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11.5px] font-medium text-foreground/60">
                <span aria-hidden className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full" style={{ background: STATE[column.key] }} />
                {column.label}
              </span>
              <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-foreground/90">{counts[ci]}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
              {cards
                .filter((c) => at(c) === column.key)
                .map((card) => {
                  const done = at(card) === "done"
                  const order = cards.indexOf(card)
                  return (
                    <motion.div
                      key={card.id}
                      role="group"
                      layout={!reduced}
                      layoutId={`${ns}-${card.id}`}
                      /* on mount the first 8 cards rise 6px, 35ms apart */
                      initial={mounted.current || order >= 8 ? false : reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: 6 }}
                      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                      transition={
                        reduced
                          ? { duration: 0.15, delay: mounted.current ? 0 : order * 0.035 }
                          : { ...SPRING, opacity: { duration: 0.3, ease: EASE, delay: mounted.current ? 0 : order * 0.035 }, y: { duration: 0.3, ease: EASE, delay: mounted.current ? 0 : order * 0.035 } }
                      }
                      onPointerEnter={() => setHot(card.id)}
                      onFocus={() => setHot(card.id)}
                      onBlur={(e) => {
                        if (!e.currentTarget.contains(e.relatedTarget as Node | null)) setHot(null)
                      }}
                      aria-label={`${card.id} ${card.title}, ${card.tag}, ${card.owner}, in ${NAME[at(card)]}`}
                      /* raised on the column; the hover is a faint 4% laid over the raised fill */
                      className={cn(
                        "group relative rounded-[12px] p-2.5 text-left transition-[opacity,box-shadow] duration-200 hover:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_100px_color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_4%,transparent)] motion-reduce:transition-none",
                        RAISED,
                      )}
                      style={{ opacity: hot !== null && hot !== card.id ? 0.45 : 1 }}
                    >
                      <span className={cn("block pr-6 text-[12px] leading-[1.4]", done ? "text-foreground/45" : "text-foreground/90")}>{card.title}</span>
                      <span className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <span title={card.owner} className="inline-flex shrink-0">
                          {renderIcon ? (
                            renderIcon(card.owner, 16)
                          ) : (
                            <span aria-hidden className="grid h-4 w-4 place-items-center rounded-full bg-foreground/[0.12] text-[7px] font-semibold text-foreground/70">
                              {lettersOf(card.owner)}
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </span>
                        <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-[10px] text-foreground/60">{card.tag}</span>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-foreground/45">{card.id}</span>
                      </span>
                      {/* the move lives on the card: up on hover or focus, always shown on touch */}
                      <span className="absolute right-1.5 top-1.5 opacity-0 transition-opacity duration-150 focus-within:opacity-100 group-hover:opacity-100 [@media(hover:none)]:opacity-100">
                        <Tip label={MOVE[at(card)]}>
                          <button type="button" onClick={() => press(card)} aria-label={`${MOVE[at(card)]}: ${card.title}`} className={cn(ICON_BUTTON, "h-6 w-6")}>
                            {done ? <RotateCcw size={12} strokeWidth={1.75} aria-hidden /> : <ArrowRight size={12} strokeWidth={1.75} aria-hidden />}
                          </button>
                        </Tip>
                      </span>
                    </motion.div>
                  )
                })}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

// ─── components/ui/control-classes.ts ───
```tsx
/* Control classes: the library's control material for components that ship on their own
   (2026-10-02, the audit's pattern 11). src/components/library/controls.ts is the site's
   copy; components used to paste its look in as a flat 8% fill "so the file ships alone",
   and those copies never turned white on a raised light surface. These read the same
   tokens WITH a fallback, so they follow the site's raised-surface rule here and still
   draw correctly in a buyer's app that has no such tokens. Shipped beside every component
   that imports it (scripts/build-registry.mjs bundles ui helpers automatically).

   Whole class strings, never assembled from pieces: Tailwind reads this file as text. */

/** what is ON in a switcher. Light (his call, 2026-10-02, after the inline slider): a WHITE
 *  pill with a hairline and a soft shadow on the grey track. Dark: the 8% thumb */
export const THUMB =
  "bg-white shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--light-outline,rgba(0,0,0,0.09)),0_1px_3px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] dark:bg-[var(--control-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_8%,transparent))] dark:shadow-[var(--control-shadow,inset_0_1px_0_0_color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_6%,transparent))]"

/** what a switcher's options sit in; its 2px padding is the gap the thumb keeps. Light: a
 *  light grey track with no outline, the white pill sits in it. Dark: a hairline, no fill */
export const TRACK = "rounded-full border border-transparent bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_5%,var(--background))] p-0.5 dark:border-foreground/[0.04] dark:bg-transparent"

/** an option that is off: the label alone answers the pointer */
export const SEGMENT_OFF = "text-foreground/60 hover:text-foreground/90"

/** a secondary button: the thumb standing alone; size it with h-7 / h-9 and px */
export const BUTTON =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--control-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_8%,transparent))] shadow-[var(--control-shadow,inset_0_1px_0_0_color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_6%,transparent))] text-foreground/90 outline-none transition-[color,background-color,scale] duration-150 hover:bg-[var(--control-fill-hover,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_12%,transparent))] focus-visible:bg-[var(--control-fill-hover,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_12%,transparent))] active:scale-[0.97] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40 motion-reduce:active:scale-100"

/** an icon-only control: no fill at rest, a faint one under the pointer */
export const ICON_BUTTON =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-full text-foreground/60 outline-none transition-[color,background-color] duration-150 hover:bg-foreground/[0.06] hover:text-foreground/90 focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.06]"

/** a field: the track with just enough fill to read as somewhere to type */
export const FIELD =
  "rounded-full border border-foreground/[0.04] bg-[var(--field-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_5%,transparent))] text-foreground/90 outline-none transition-[background-color,border-color] duration-150 placeholder:text-foreground/45 focus:border-foreground/[0.12]"

/** the one loud button of a form: 48px, full width, the foreground filled (the dashboards'
 *  Modal primary). A ticket, a swap, a confirm: one of these and nothing louder */
export const BUTTON_PRIMARY =
  "inline-flex h-12 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-foreground/[0.92] text-[14px] font-medium text-background outline-none transition-[background-color,scale,opacity] duration-150 hover:bg-foreground focus-visible:bg-foreground active:scale-[0.98] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40 motion-reduce:active:scale-100"

/** a component's own card, field or block (spec 14.8). Dark: a #121212 fill on black. Light
 *  (his call, 2026-10-02: "on light the card background is too dark, it can just be white, a
 *  quiet outline and a small shadow"): white, a 1px hairline (Kraken's #e7e6e9, or 9% ink in an app without the token) and a
 *  barely there shadow,
 *  drawn as box shadows so the outline takes no layout */
export const SURFACE =
  "bg-background shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--light-outline,color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_9%,transparent)),0_1px_2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] dark:bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_7%,var(--background))] dark:shadow-none"

/** a block sitting ON a surface: a faint 4% grey inside a white card in light, #1f1f1f in dark */
export const RAISED = "bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_4%,var(--background))] dark:bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_12%,var(--background))]"
```

# Segmented Control (segmented-control)
> A segmented control for timeframes and view modes like 24h, 7d and 30d, with a thumb that slides between the options.

// ─── components/ui/segmented-control.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useId, useState } from "react"
import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { SEGMENT_OFF, THUMB, TRACK } from "@/components/ui/control-classes"

/* Segmented Control, rebuilt through the ssych-component skill (2026-09-29).
   What changed against the version before it (in git history), and why:
   · the track sets tabular numerals, so labels with a figure in them (1D, 1W, 3M) line up
   This is the material every control in the library is cut from
   (src/components/library/controls.ts), so the track, the thumb, the sizes and the
   glide are the original's, value for value.
   2026-10-02 audit: the control now reads its material from control-classes (TRACK, THUMB,
   SEGMENT_OFF) instead of its own 8% copy, so the thumb turns white on a raised light
   surface like every other control; the options are an explicit 28px tall (h-7) at 11.5px
   with no letter spacing, the control text size of spec 14.4; an optional `label` names
   the group for a screen reader. Props and the export are unchanged. */

export interface SegmentedControlProps {
  options: string[]
  /** Controlled value; omit to let the control manage its own state. */
  value?: string
  onChange?: (v: string) => void
  className?: string
  /** what the group switches, read by a screen reader (optional) */
  label?: string
}

/**
 * The range switcher as a primitive: a hairline pill whose thumb glides
 * between options with a shared-layout tween. Tabular labels, no chrome.
 */
export function SegmentedControl({ options, value, onChange, className, label }: SegmentedControlProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const uid = useId()
  const [inner, setInner] = useState(value ?? options[0])
  const current = value ?? inner

  return (
    <div role="group" aria-label={label} className={cn("inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 tabular-nums", TRACK, className)}>
      {options.map((o) => {
        const on = o === current
        return (
          <button
            key={o}
            type="button"
            aria-pressed={on}
            onClick={() => {
              setInner(o)
              onChange?.(o)
            }}
            className={cn(
              "group relative inline-flex h-7 items-center rounded-full px-3 text-[11.5px] outline-none transition-colors duration-200 focus-visible:text-foreground/90",
              on ? "text-foreground/90" : SEGMENT_OFF,
            )}
          >
            {on && (
              /* transitions.dev sliding-tabs feel: a clean 250ms smooth-out tween */
              <motion.span
                layoutId={`${uid}-thumb`}
                className={cn("absolute inset-0 rounded-full", THUMB)}
                transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.25, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] }}
              />
            )}
            {/* the press answers on the label, so the thumb's layout glide measures an unscaled button */}
            <span className="relative inline-block transition-transform duration-150 group-active:scale-[0.97] motion-reduce:transition-none motion-reduce:group-active:scale-100">{o}</span>
          </button>
        )
      })}
    </div>
  )
}
```

# View Switch (view-switch)
> A view switcher for desktop, mobile and code previews where only the selected option shows its label, for docs and component galleries.

// ─── components/ui/view-switch.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent, type ReactNode } from "react"
import { useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { SEGMENT_OFF, THUMB, TRACK } from "@/components/ui/control-classes"

/* View Switch, the library shell's part as a primitive (2026-09-30).
   What it is for: the switcher above a preview: Desktop, Mobile, Code, or the sizes of a
   screen. One of the options is on; the rest wait as icons.
   Read first: the option that is on, the only one that shows its name.
   The pointer: an off option's icon brightens under it; a press slides the ONE thumb
   from the option that was on to the one that is, the names fading across on the
   control's 250ms tween. Arrow keys move the choice; Home and End go to the ends.
   Taken from: src/components/library/ViewSwitch.tsx, value for value: the TRACK and the
   THUMB from controls.ts, 32px options (36px with `tall`), the measured fixed width
   (every option as an icon, less one, plus one option at the longest name), the narrow
   fall-back under 640px where no name shows. The device icons are the shell's own
   strokes (ComponentShowcase.tsx) and Code is the Phosphor glyph it imports, inlined here.
   Added: arrow keys, and a default set of options so it renders with no props.
   Motion (2026-09-30): the thumb slides on transform, not `left`, 250ms both ways; a choice
   made with the arrow keys lands at once (keys repeat), only a press gets the tween.
   No figures are derived here.
   2026-10-02 audit: the track, thumb and off ink come from control-classes (the tokens with a
   fallback) instead of a flat 8% copy, so the thumb turns white on a raised light surface;
   an icon-only option names itself in the library's own hover tip (the popover material,
   after 320ms, on hover or keyboard focus) instead of the browser's title tooltip; the
   preview shows one switch, not the two heights stacked. */

/** how long the pointer rests on an icon before its name shows */
const TIP_DELAY = 320

export interface ViewOption<T extends string> {
  id: T
  /** what the button is called for assistive tech and the tooltip */
  label: string
  /** what it says on the button while it is on */
  short: string
  icon: ReactNode
}

/** the track's own padding and the gap between options, in px (p-0.5, gap-0.5) */
const PAD = 2
const GAP = 2
/** the control's tween (segmented-control.tsx): 250ms, smooth-out */
const EASE = "cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)"
const MS = 250

/* the shell's device glyphs: 1.6px strokes, drawn by hand so they sit at 13 and 14px */
const STROKE = { fill: "none", stroke: "currentColor", strokeWidth: 1.6 } as const

export function DesktopIcon() {
  return (
    <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" {...STROKE} aria-hidden>
      <rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="12" rx="2" />
      <line x1="9" y1="20" x2="15" y2="20" />
      <line x1="12" y1="16" x2="12" y2="20" />
    </svg>
  )
}

export function MobileIcon() {
  return (
    <svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" {...STROKE} aria-hidden>
      <rect x="7" y="3" width="10" height="18" rx="2.5" />
      <line x1="11" y1="18" x2="13" y2="18" />
    </svg>
  )
}

/* Phosphor's Code glyph (regular), inlined so the file carries no icon package */
function CodeIcon({ className }: { className?: string }) {
  return (
    <svg width="1em" height="1em" viewBox="0 0 256 256" fill="currentColor" className={className} aria-hidden>
      <path d="M69.12,94.15,28.5,128l40.62,33.85a8,8,0,1,1-10.24,12.29l-48-40a8,8,0,0,1,0-12.29l48-40a8,8,0,0,1,10.24,12.3Zm176,27.7-48-40a8,8,0,1,0-10.24,12.3L227.5,128l-40.62,33.85a8,8,0,1,0,10.24,12.29l48-40a8,8,0,0,0,0-12.29ZM162.73,32.48a8,8,0,0,0-10.25,4.79l-64,176a8,8,0,0,0,4.79,10.26A8.14,8.14,0,0,0,96,224a8,8,0,0,0,7.52-5.27l64-176A8,8,0,0,0,162.73,32.48Z" />
    </svg>
  )
}

export type PreviewView = "desktop" | "mobile" | "code"

/** the component page's three views, as the shell names them */
export const PREVIEW_VIEWS: ViewOption<PreviewView>[] = [
  { id: "desktop", label: "Desktop · full width", short: "Desktop", icon: <DesktopIcon /> },
  { id: "mobile", label: "Mobile · 390px", short: "Mobile", icon: <MobileIcon /> },
  { id: "code", label: "Code", short: "Code", icon: <CodeIcon className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> },
]

export interface ViewSwitchProps<T extends string> {
  options?: ViewOption<T>[]
  /** controlled value; omit to let the switch keep its own */
  value?: T
  defaultValue?: T
  onChange?: (v: T) => void
  /** something that sits in the track ahead of the options and is not one of them (an expand link) */
  leading?: ReactNode
  /** 36px options, for a toolbar that is the page's main control; 32px otherwise */
  tall?: boolean
  /** what the group is called */
  label?: string
  className?: string
}

/**
 * The Segmented Control's parts, a hairline track and one thumb, with only the option
 * that is on showing its name. The row is one fixed width, so nothing jumps.
 */
export function ViewSwitch<T extends string = PreviewView>({
  options = PREVIEW_VIEWS as unknown as ViewOption<T>[],
  value,
  defaultValue,
  onChange,
  leading,
  tall = false,
  label = "View",
  className,
}: ViewSwitchProps<T>) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const off = tall ? 36 : 32
  const measureRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const leadRef = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null)
  const buttons = useRef<(HTMLButtonElement | null)[]>([])
  const [inner, setInner] = useState<T>(() => defaultValue ?? options[0].id)
  const current = value ?? inner
  /** the width of the option that is on: the longest name, measured */
  const [on, setOn] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const [lead, setLead] = useState(0)
  const [narrow, setNarrow] = useState(false)
  /** the last choice came from the keyboard: it lands at once */
  const [byKey, setByKey] = useState(false)
  /** the option whose name shows in the hover tip */
  const [tipAt, setTipAt] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const tipTimer = useRef<number | undefined>(undefined)
  useEffect(() => () => window.clearTimeout(tipTimer.current), [])
  const armTip = (i: number) => {
    window.clearTimeout(tipTimer.current)
    tipTimer.current = window.setTimeout(() => setTipAt(i), TIP_DELAY)
  }
  const dropTip = () => {
    window.clearTimeout(tipTimer.current)
    setTipAt(null)
  }

  const select = (v: T) => {
    setInner(v)
    onChange?.(v)
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof matchMedia !== "function") return
    const mq = matchMedia("(max-width: 639px)")
    const read = () => setNarrow(mq.matches)
    read()
    mq.addEventListener("change", read)
    return () => mq.removeEventListener("change", read)
  }, [])

  const names = options.map((o) => o.short).join("|")
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const measure = () => {
      const box = measureRef.current
      // layout pixels (offsetWidth), not the drawn box: inside a scaled preview stage a
      // getBoundingClientRect width comes back scaled and the thumb clipped the name
      if (box) setOn(Math.ceil(Math.max(0, ...[...box.children].map((c) => (c as HTMLElement).offsetWidth))))
      setLead(leadRef.current ? leadRef.current.offsetWidth + GAP : 0)
    }
    measure()
    // the name is set in the page's face, which can land after the first measure
    document.fonts?.ready.then(measure).catch(() => {})
  }, [names, tall, leading != null])

  const widthOn = narrow ? off : on
  const index = Math.max(0, options.findIndex((o) => o.id === current))
  const still = reduced || byKey
  const slide = still ? "none" : `transform ${MS}ms ${EASE}`
  const pad = tall ? 14 : 12

  /* arrow keys walk the options and choose as they go, Home and End jump to the ends */
  const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    const last = options.length - 1
    let next = -1
    if (e.key === "ArrowRight" || e.key === "ArrowDown") next = Math.min(last, index + 1)
    else if (e.key === "ArrowLeft" || e.key === "ArrowUp") next = Math.max(0, index - 1)
    else if (e.key === "Home") next = 0
    else if (e.key === "End") next = last
    if (next < 0 || next === index) return
    e.preventDefault()
    setByKey(true)
    select(options[next].id)
    buttons.current[next]?.focus()
  }

  return (
    <div role="group" aria-label={label} className={cn("relative inline-flex items-center gap-0.5", TRACK, className)}>
      {/* every option as it looks when it is on, out of sight, to find the longest */}
      <div ref={measureRef} aria-hidden className="pointer-events-none invisible absolute left-0 top-0 flex h-0 overflow-hidden whitespace-nowrap">
        {options.map((o) => (
          <span key={o.id} className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 text-[13px] font-medium" style={{ paddingInline: pad }}>
            {o.icon}
            {o.short}
          </span>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* the thumb: one, for the whole row */}
      {widthOn != null && (
        <span
          aria-hidden
          className={cn("pointer-events-none absolute rounded-full", THUMB)}
          style={{ top: PAD, bottom: PAD, left: PAD + lead, width: widthOn, transform: `translateX(${index * (off + GAP)}px)`, transition: slide }}
        />
      )}

      {leading && (
        <span ref={leadRef} className="relative flex">
          {leading}
        </span>
      )}
      {options.map((o, i) => {
        const active = o.id === current
        /* the name is on screen already while the option is on (except when narrow) */
        const tip = tipAt === i && (!active || narrow)
        return (
          <span key={o.id} className="relative flex shrink-0" onPointerEnter={() => armTip(i)} onPointerLeave={dropTip}>
          <button
            ref={(el) => {
              buttons.current[i] = el
            }}
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setByKey(false)
              dropTip()
              select(o.id)
            }}
            onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
            onFocus={(e) => {
              if (e.currentTarget.matches(":focus-visible")) armTip(i)
            }}
            onBlur={dropTip}
            aria-pressed={active}
            aria-label={o.label}
            className={cn(
              "relative flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-full text-[13px] transition-colors duration-200",
              tall ? "h-9" : "h-8",
              active ? "text-foreground" : SEGMENT_OFF,
            )}
            style={{
              // before the measure lands an option is as wide as what it holds, so nothing is clipped
              width: widthOn == null ? undefined : active ? widthOn : off,
              transition: still ? "color 200ms" : `width ${MS}ms ${EASE}, color 200ms`,
            }}
          >
            {/* icon and name are centred in the option; the name's own width closes to
                nothing when the option is off, which leaves the icon alone in the middle */}
            <span className="flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center">{o.icon}</span>
            <span
              aria-hidden={!active}
              className="overflow-hidden whitespace-nowrap font-medium"
              style={{
                maxWidth: active && !narrow ? 96 : 0,
                paddingLeft: active && !narrow ? 6 : 0,
                opacity: active && !narrow ? 1 : 0,
                transition: still
                  ? reduced
                    ? "opacity 150ms"
                    : "none"
                  : `max-width ${MS}ms ${EASE}, padding-left ${MS}ms ${EASE}, opacity ${active ? MS : 120}ms ease-out ${active ? 60 : 0}ms`,
              }}
            >
              {o.short}
            </span>
          </button>
          {/* the library's hover tip: the popover material (spec 14.6), above the option */}
          {tip && (
            <span
              aria-hidden
              className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-full left-1/2 z-50 mb-2 w-max -translate-x-1/2 rounded-[12px] border border-foreground/[0.08] bg-[var(--tip-fill,color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_6%,var(--background)))] px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[11px] text-foreground/90 shadow-[0_8px_24px_-12px_color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_25%,transparent)]"
            >
              {o.label}
            </span>
          )}
          </span>
        )
      })}
    </div>
  )
}
```

# Account Dropdown (account-dropdown)
> A crypto wallet account switcher that lists each address with its balance and share of the total, for multi wallet web3 apps.

// ─── components/ui/account-dropdown.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { SURFACE, THUMB } from "@/components/ui/control-classes"

/* Account Dropdown, promoted from a lab sketch through ssych-component (2026-09-29).
   What it is for: switching between the accounts of one wallet, each with its own balance.
   Read first: the top row, which is the account in use: its mark, short address and balance.
   The pointer: pressing the top row folds the list away or back; pointing at an account
   steps the others back; pressing one makes it the account in use and folds the list.
   Escape and a press outside fold it too.
   Sketch used: src/components/lab/AccountDropdownPro.tsx. Kept: the trigger that shows the
   live account, the list of every account with its balance, the check on the one in use,
   the list opening in flow under the trigger, Escape and outside press. Changed: no
   outlined trigger or sheet, the marks are ink patterns worked from the address (they were
   two-colour gradients), the chosen row is ink (it was blue), balances are numbers and
   the line under the list sums them.
   Formulas:
   · in all        Σ balance of every account
   · share         balance ÷ in all × 100, shown under the balance of the row being pointed at
   · mark          a 5 by 5 mirrored pattern seeded from the characters of the address
   2026-10-02: surfaces at 7% (raised blocks white in light, 12% in dark) so cards read on white and on black.
   2026-10-02 audit: it starts closed (defaultOpen is false) and opens on a press, as a
   dropdown panel on the surface step, rounded 24 with 6px padding, laid over what is under
   it. The trigger is a 48px pill whose chevron sits in a 24px slot 12px from the right edge,
   mirroring the 24px mark 12px from the left (his note on the arrow padding). The chosen row
   is the selected pill on the control material, rounded 18 inside the 24 panel at a 6px gap
   (his note on its roundness), and carries the tick where the others show their balance,
   so the balance in use is printed once, in the trigger. The marks are ink: a wallet's real
   mark comes in through `renderIcon`, the address pattern is the fallback. The readout line
   under the list and its rule are gone; the share of the pointed account shows under its
   own balance instead. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const

export interface Account {
  label: string
  /** short form of the address, as it should be read */
  address: string
  /** in the display currency */
  balance: number
  /** the wallet that holds it (MetaMask, Ledger…), handed to `renderIcon` for its mark */
  wallet?: string
}

export interface AccountDropdownProps {
  accounts?: Account[]
  /** index of the account in use at the start */
  defaultActive?: number
  /** start with the list open; closed by default (popups open on a real action) */
  defaultOpen?: boolean
  onSelect?: (account: Account) => void
  /** the wallet's real mark for an account (its `wallet`, else its address); return null to
   *  fall back to the ink pattern worked from the address */
  renderIcon?: (symbol: string, size: number) => ReactNode
  className?: string
}

const DEFAULT_ACCOUNTS: Account[] = [
  { label: "Account 0", address: "0x8f3C…9aD1", balance: 41205.12, wallet: "MetaMask" },
  { label: "Account 1", address: "0x44Ba…E77f", balance: 6918.45, wallet: "MetaMask" },
  { label: "Ledger · BTC", address: "bc1qxy…0wlh", balance: 90.0, wallet: "Ledger" },
]

const money = (n: number) => `$${n.toLocaleString("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}`

/** three columns of five cells from the address, mirrored about the middle column, in ink */
function Identicon({ seed, size = 24 }: { seed: string; size?: number }) {
  let s = [...seed].reduce((a, c) => (a * 31 + c.charCodeAt(0)) % 2147483647, 7) || 1
  const cells: { x: number; y: number }[] = []
  for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
    s = (s * 16807) % 2147483647
    if (s / 2147483647 < 0.5) continue
    const col = i % 3
    const row = Math.floor(i / 3)
    cells.push({ x: col, y: row })
    if (col < 2) cells.push({ x: 4 - col, y: row })
  }
  return (
    <span aria-hidden className="grid shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full bg-foreground/[0.10]" style={{ width: size, height: size }}>
      <svg width={size * 0.55} height={size * 0.55} viewBox="0 0 5 5">
        {cells.map((c) => (
          <rect key={`${c.x}-${c.y}`} x={c.x} y={c.y} width={1} height={1} fill="var(--foreground)" fillOpacity={0.7} />
        ))}
      </svg>
    </span>
  )
}

/**
 * The account switcher: a pill naming the account in use with its balance; a press opens
 * every account in a panel under it. Pointing at one steps the rest back and shows its
 * share; pressing it switches.
 */
export function AccountDropdown({
  accounts = DEFAULT_ACCOUNTS,
  defaultActive = 0,
  defaultOpen = false,
  onSelect,
  renderIcon,
  className,
}: AccountDropdownProps) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(defaultOpen)
  const [active, setActive] = useState(defaultActive)
  const [hot, setHot] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const root = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const trigger = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null)
  const current = accounts[active] ?? accounts[0]
  const total = accounts.reduce((s, a) => s + a.balance, 0)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return
    const key = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") {
        setOpen(false)
        trigger.current?.focus()
      }
    }
    const down = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      if (!root.current?.contains(e.target as Node)) setOpen(false)
    }
    window.addEventListener("keydown", key)
    window.addEventListener("pointerdown", down)
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("keydown", key)
      window.removeEventListener("pointerdown", down)
    }
  }, [open])

  if (!current) return null

  const mark = (a: Account, size: number) => renderIcon?.(a.wallet ?? a.address, size) ?? <Identicon seed={a.address} size={size} />

  return (
    <div ref={root} className={cn("relative w-[300px] max-w-full tabular-nums", className)}>
      <button
        ref={trigger}
        type="button"
        aria-haspopup="listbox"
        aria-expanded={open}
        aria-label={`${current.label}, ${current.address}, ${money(current.balance)}`}
        onClick={() => setOpen((o) => !o)}
        /* a 48px control is fully round; the 24px mark and the 24px chevron slot both sit 12px in */
        className={cn(
          "relative flex h-12 w-full items-center gap-2.5 rounded-full px-3 text-left outline-none transition-[scale] duration-150 active:scale-[0.98] motion-reduce:active:scale-100",
          SURFACE,
          "after:pointer-events-none after:absolute after:inset-0 after:rounded-full after:transition-colors after:duration-150 hover:after:bg-foreground/[0.04] focus-visible:after:bg-foreground/[0.06]",
        )}
      >
        {mark(current, 24)}
        <span className="flex min-w-0 flex-col">
          <span className="truncate text-[13px] font-medium leading-tight text-foreground/90">{current.label}</span>
          <span className="text-[10.5px] text-foreground/60">{current.address}</span>
        </span>
        <span className="ml-auto text-[12.5px] font-medium text-foreground/90">{money(current.balance)}</span>
        <span aria-hidden className="grid h-6 w-6 shrink-0 place-items-center text-foreground/60">
          <motion.svg
            width={12}
            height={12}
            viewBox="0 0 24 24"
            fill="none"
            stroke="currentColor"
            strokeWidth={2}
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
            animate={{ rotate: open ? 180 : 0 }}
            transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.25, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] }}
          >
            <path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6" />
          </motion.svg>
        </span>
      </button>

      {/* the panel: the surface step, 24 round with 6px inside, so the 18px rows nest
          (24 = 18 + 6); it drops 4px into place in 200ms, and leaves in 120ms */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {open && (
          <motion.div
            key="panel"
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: reduced ? 0 : -4 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: reduced ? 0 : -4, transition: { duration: 0.12 } }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.2, ease: EASE }}
            className={cn("absolute inset-x-0 top-full z-50 mt-1.5 rounded-[24px] p-1.5", SURFACE)}
          >
            <div role="listbox" aria-label="Accounts" className="flex flex-col gap-0.5" onPointerLeave={() => setHot(null)}>
              {accounts.map((a, i) => {
                const on = i === active
                const share = total > 0 ? ((a.balance / total) * 100).toFixed(1) : "0.0"
                return (
                  <button
                    key={a.address}
                    type="button"
                    role="option"
                    aria-selected={on}
                    aria-label={`${a.label}, ${a.address}, ${money(a.balance)}, ${share}% of ${money(total)}`}
                    onClick={() => {
                      setActive(i)
                      setOpen(false)
                      onSelect?.(a)
                      trigger.current?.focus()
                    }}
                    onPointerEnter={() => setHot(i)}
                    onFocus={() => setHot(i)}
                    onBlur={() => setHot(null)}
                    className={cn(
                      "flex h-12 items-center gap-2.5 rounded-[18px] px-3 text-left outline-none transition-[opacity,background-color,scale] duration-150 active:scale-[0.98] motion-reduce:active:scale-100",
                      on ? THUMB : "hover:bg-foreground/[0.04] focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.06]",
                      hot !== null && hot !== i && "opacity-45",
                    )}
                  >
                    {mark(a, 24)}
                    <span className="flex min-w-0 flex-col">
                      <span className={cn("truncate text-[12.5px] leading-tight text-foreground/90", on && "font-medium")}>{a.label}</span>
                      <span className="text-[10.5px] text-foreground/60">{a.address}</span>
                    </span>
                    {on ? (
                      <span aria-hidden className="ml-auto grid h-6 w-6 shrink-0 place-items-center text-foreground/90">
                        <svg width={12} height={12} viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2} strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
                          {/* the check strokes in on the account in use (transitions.dev checkbox) */}
                          <motion.path
                            d="m5 12.5 4.5 4.5L19 7.5"
                            initial={reduced ? false : { pathLength: 0 }}
                            animate={{ pathLength: 1 }}
                            transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.25, ease: EASE, delay: 0.08 }}
                          />
                        </svg>
                      </span>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="ml-auto flex flex-col items-end">
                        <span className="text-[11.5px] leading-tight text-foreground/70">{money(a.balance)}</span>
                        {/* the share of the pointed account, under its own balance; the line keeps its height */}
                        <span
                          aria-hidden
                          className="text-[10.5px] text-foreground/60 transition-opacity duration-150"
                          style={{ opacity: hot === i ? 1 : 0 }}
                        >
                          {share}%
                        </span>
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </button>
                )
              })}
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  )
}
```
