# Balance Header (balance-header)
> A wallet and bank balance header with the total, the 24h move and a privacy toggle that masks every figure, for crypto and fintech apps.

// ─── components/ui/balance-header.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useState } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"
import { Eye, EyeOff } from "lucide-react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

/* Balance Header, rebuilt through the ssych-component skill (2026-09-29).
   What changed against the version before it (in git history), and why:
   · one large size, 26px, for the whole figure. The cents step back by ink, not by a
     second size (it was 44px dollars over 26px cents)
   · the label is sentence case at its own size, no capitals and no letter spacing
   · the figure is plain text, not a heading tag: the page owns the headings
   · the move is signed text in green or red. The tinted pill and the chevrons are gone,
     the + or − already says the direction
   · the hide control is a round button; the eye stays because it is the control
   · every figure is tabular, the header reads itself out as one status line
   Props are unchanged.
   2026-10-02 audit: it reads from the left like every other header now, on the three tiers
   of spec 14.1: a 12px label row ("Total balance" /45 left, the hide control right, where
   it no longer floats beside the figure), the 26px figure with leading-none 12px under it,
   and a 12px sub line 8px under that, the move font-medium in its hue then the period /45.
   The move reads "+$1,204.32 (+1.9%)", no middle dot. The hide control shows on hover or
   focus, and always where there is no hover.
   Formulas:
   · percent  change ÷ (total − change) × 100, the move over the balance it moved from,
              unless the caller passes changePct */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GREEN = "var(--chart-up)"
const RED = "var(--chart-down)"

/** Σ of the sample book the portfolio family quotes from */
const DEFAULT_TOTAL = 64025.65
const DEFAULT_CHANGE = 1204.32

const MASK = "••••••"

const usd = (n: number, dp = 2) =>
  `$${n.toLocaleString("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: dp, maximumFractionDigits: dp })}`

export interface BalanceHeaderProps {
  /** the headline figure */
  total?: number
  /** absolute move over the period, signed */
  change?: number
  /** pass to own the percent; unpassed it derives from the move and the balance it moved from */
  changePct?: number
  /** draw the move under the total */
  delta?: boolean
  /** the period the move answers for */
  period?: string
  className?: string
}

/**
 * A wallet's headline number: a quiet label over the total with its cents stepped back,
 * the signed move beneath, and a hide control that stays out of the way until you reach
 * for it, then masks every figure to dots.
 */
export function BalanceHeader({
  total = DEFAULT_TOTAL,
  change = DEFAULT_CHANGE,
  changePct,
  delta = true,
  period = "24h",
  className,
}: BalanceHeaderProps) {
  const [hidden, setHidden] = useState(false)
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const up = change >= 0
  const hue = up ? GREEN : RED
  const sign = up ? "+" : "−"
  /* the move over the balance it moved FROM, so the two numbers agree */
  const pct = changePct ?? (change / (total - change || 1)) * 100
  const move = `${sign}${usd(Math.abs(change))} (${sign}${Math.abs(pct).toFixed(1)}%)`

  const [whole, cents] = usd(total).split(".")

  const rise = (delay: number) => ({
    initial: reduced ? (false as const) : { opacity: 0, y: 6 },
    animate: { opacity: 1, y: 0 },
    transition: reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.4, ease: EASE, delay },
  })

  /* hide / show swaps the text in place (transitions.dev text swap: 4px, 2px blur, 150ms);
     reduced motion keeps the cross-fade and drops the travel and the blur */
  const swap = {
    initial: reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: 4, filter: "blur(2px)" },
    animate: { opacity: 1, y: 0, filter: "blur(0px)" },
    exit: reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: -4, filter: "blur(2px)" },
    transition: { duration: 0.15, ease: EASE },
  }

  return (
    <div
      className={cn("group flex w-max min-w-[200px] flex-col items-stretch tabular-nums", className)}
      role="group"
      aria-label={hidden ? "Total balance, hidden" : `Total balance ${usd(total)}${delta ? `, ${move} over ${period}` : ""}`}
    >
      <motion.div {...rise(0)} className="mb-3 flex items-baseline justify-between gap-3 text-[12px]">
        <span className="text-foreground/45">Total balance</span>
        {/* the hide control sits at the row's end, so it never nudges the figure; it keeps
            the 12px row by bleeding into the padding around it */}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setHidden((h) => !h)}
          aria-label={hidden ? "Show balances" : "Hide balances"}
          aria-pressed={hidden}
          className="-my-1.5 -mr-1.5 grid h-6 w-6 self-center place-items-center rounded-full text-foreground/60 opacity-0 outline-none transition-[opacity,color,background-color,transform,translate,scale,rotate] duration-200 active:scale-[0.97] hover:bg-foreground/[0.06] hover:text-foreground/90 focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.06] focus-visible:opacity-100 group-hover:opacity-100 motion-reduce:active:scale-100 [@media(hover:none)]:opacity-100"
        >
          <AnimatePresence mode="wait" initial={false}>
            <motion.span
              key={hidden ? "off" : "on"}
              className="grid place-items-center"
              initial={reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, scale: 0.8, filter: "blur(2px)" }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, filter: "blur(0px)" }}
              exit={reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, scale: 0.8, filter: "blur(2px)" }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.12, ease: EASE }}
            >
              {hidden ? <EyeOff size={13} aria-hidden /> : <Eye size={13} aria-hidden />}
            </motion.span>
          </AnimatePresence>
        </button>
      </motion.div>

      <motion.p {...rise(0.035)} role="status" className="m-0 text-[26px] font-semibold leading-none tracking-[-0.02em] text-foreground/90">
        <AnimatePresence mode="wait" initial={false}>
          <motion.span key={hidden ? "mask" : "figure"} {...swap} className="inline-block">
            {hidden ? (
              MASK
            ) : (
              <>
                {whole}
                {cents && <span className="text-foreground/35">.{cents}</span>}
              </>
            )}
          </motion.span>
        </AnimatePresence>
      </motion.p>

      {delta && (
        <motion.div {...rise(0.07)} className="mt-2 flex items-baseline gap-1.5 text-[12px]">
          <AnimatePresence mode="wait" initial={false}>
            <motion.span
              key={hidden ? "mask" : "move"}
              {...swap}
              className="inline-block font-medium"
              style={{ color: hidden ? "color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 45%, transparent)" : hue }}
            >
              {hidden ? MASK : move}
            </motion.span>
          </AnimatePresence>
          <span className="text-foreground/45">{period}</span>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
```

# KPI Card Row (kpi-card-row)
> A KPI card row for SaaS, AI and API dashboards, with metrics like requests and uptime counting up over area charts you can scrub.

// ─── components/ui/kpi-card-row.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useId, useRef, useState } from "react"
import { motion, useInView, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { SURFACE } from "@/components/ui/control-classes"
import { LiveFigure } from "@/components/ui/live-figure"

/* KPI Card Row, rebuilt through the ssych-component skill (2026-09-29).
   What changed against the version before it (in git history), and why:
   · no card, outline or inner shadow around each metric: three columns on the page
   · the line is ink; only the change carries colour, green for a gain and red for a loss
     (it was blue, green and amber by position)
   · the value no longer counts up: the number is there to be read at once, and the count
     re-rendered the card sixty times a second
   · pointing at the line puts that point's value and date where the headline is, as plain
     text, so nothing floats over the chart
   · each chart names itself to a screen reader
   Motion (2026-10-01): once a column is in view its line and fill sweep in left to right
   through one clip, 50ms apart per column, landed by 0.9s (they drew on mount, off screen
   too); a new series morphs the line and the fill in place
   2026-10-02 audit: per his Stat Tile call each metric sits on its own surface card (7%
   foreground over the background, 12px padding, corner 18: the inner card of the card
   scale, 24 outside = 18 + the 6px gap), 6px apart, 152px each, so the row is 468px, the
   same width as Stat Tile, its family; the preview's zoom hack is gone. The figure swaps
   once as the pointer takes the line and once as it lets go, and moves at once in between
   (LiveFigure), where it replayed the swap on every step. The change is worked out from
   the series and names its window ("since Feb 24") on its own 12px sub line in its hue; a
   hand-written `delta` is still honoured when passed. Label 12px /45.
   Formulas:
   · headline  data[n − 1], or the pointed point's value while scrubbing
   · change    (data[n − 1] ÷ data[0] − 1) × 100 in percent, or data[n − 1] − data[0] in
               points when `diff` is "points" (metrics that are already a percent);
               the caller's `delta` string when one is passed
   · window    from labels[0] to the last point
   2026-10-02 round 2: his notes. The chart runs to the card's edges: no side padding and
   none under it, the card's 18px corner clips it (the plot is the card's full 152px). The
   window on the sub line is just the start date, "Feb 24", where it read "since Feb 24". */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GREEN = "var(--chart-up)"
const RED = "var(--chart-down)"

export type KpiItem = {
  label: string
  /** the metric's real series, in its own unit; the last point is the headline */
  data: number[]
  /** formats the headline and the hover readout */
  format?: (v: number) => string
  /** a hand-written signed change, written with + or −; unpassed it is worked out from `data` */
  delta?: string
  /** with `delta`: false marks the change as a loss (red), a gain is green; a worked-out
   *  change takes its colour from its sign */
  up?: boolean
  /** how the worked-out change is measured: a percent of the first point, or a plain difference */
  diff?: "percent" | "points"
}

export interface KpiCardRowProps {
  /** one column per metric */
  items?: KpiItem[]
  /** what each sample point is called, read out while pointing at it */
  labels?: string[]
  className?: string
}

const DEFAULT_ITEMS: KpiItem[] = [
  { label: "Requests", format: (v) => `${v.toFixed(1)}M`, data: [1.6, 1.7, 1.75, 1.9, 2.0, 2.1, 2.15, 2.25, 2.35, 2.4] },
  { label: "Accuracy", format: (v) => `${v.toFixed(1)}%`, diff: "points", data: [96.4, 96.8, 96.6, 97.2, 97.5, 97.8, 98.0, 98.1, 98.3, 98.4] },
  { label: "Uptime", format: (v) => `${v.toFixed(2)}%`, diff: "points", data: [99.98, 99.97, 99.98, 99.96, 99.97, 99.95, 99.94, 99.95, 99.93, 99.92] },
]

const DEFAULT_LABELS = ["Feb 24", "Mar 3", "Mar 10", "Mar 17", "Mar 24", "Mar 31", "Apr 7", "Apr 14", "Apr 21", "Apr 28"]

/** the chart's width: the card's full 152px, edge to edge (round 2) */
const W = 152
const H = 52
const TOP = 6
/** room under the lowest point, so the corner's curve does not cut the line */
const BOT = 8

const fallbackFormat = (v: number) => (Math.abs(v) >= 100 ? Math.round(v).toString() : v.toFixed(1))

function Kpi({ item, labels, index }: { item: KpiItem; labels: string[]; index: number }) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const uid = useId().replace(/:/g, "")
  const boxRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const [hi, setHi] = useState<number | null>(null)
  /* the entrance plays once, when a third of the column is in view; reduced motion lands at once */
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const seen = useInView(rootRef, { once: true, amount: 0.3 })
  const play = !!reduced || seen
  /** a change of data glides between the two states */
  const morph = reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.35, ease: EASE }

  const data = item.data.length ? item.data : [0]
  const format = item.format ?? fallbackFormat
  const last = data.length - 1
  const max = Math.max(...data)
  const min = Math.min(...data)
  const span = Math.max(1e-6, max - min)
  const x = (i: number) => (i / Math.max(1, last)) * W
  const y = (v: number) => TOP + (1 - (v - min) / span) * (H - TOP - BOT)
  const line = data.map((v, i) => `${i === 0 ? "M" : "L"} ${x(i).toFixed(2)} ${y(v).toFixed(2)}`).join(" ")
  const area = `${line} L ${W} ${H} L 0 ${H} Z`

  const onMove = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    const el = boxRef.current
    if (!el) return
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect()
    setHi(Math.max(0, Math.min(last, Math.round(((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width) * last))))
  }

  const shown = hi ?? last
  /* the change: the caller's string when given, else worked out from the series */
  const points = item.diff === "points"
  const worked = points ? data[last] - data[0] : data[0] ? (data[last] / data[0] - 1) * 100 : 0
  const delta = item.delta ?? `${worked >= 0 ? "+" : "−"}${Math.abs(worked).toFixed(points ? 2 : 1)}${points ? " pt" : "%"}`
  const hue = (item.delta ? item.up !== false : worked >= 0) ? GREEN : RED
  /** the window, just its start date (round 2: "since" made it too long) */
  const since = labels[0] ?? ""

  return (
    /* corner 18: the inner card of the card scale (24 outside = 18 + the 6px gap) */
    <div ref={rootRef} className={cn("w-[152px] shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-[18px] p-3", SURFACE)}>
      <div className="text-[12px] text-foreground/45">{item.label}</div>
      <div role="status" className="mt-2">
        {/* the figure swaps once as the line is taken and once as it is let go (4px, 2px
            blur, 150ms); along the line it moves at once */}
        <LiveFigure intent={hi === null ? null : "scrub"} className="text-[22px] font-semibold leading-none tracking-[-0.02em] text-foreground/90">
          {format(data[shown])}
        </LiveFigure>
        <div className="mt-2 flex h-[15px] items-baseline gap-1.5 truncate text-[12px] leading-[15px]">
          {hi === null ? (
            <>
              <span className="font-medium" style={{ color: hue }}>
                {delta}
              </span>
              <span className="text-foreground/45">{since}</span>
            </>
          ) : (
            <span className="text-foreground/45">{labels[hi] ?? ""}</span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div ref={boxRef} className="relative -mx-3 -mb-3 mt-3" onPointerMove={onMove} onPointerLeave={() => setHi(null)}>
        <svg
          viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`}
          className="block w-full overflow-visible"
          fill="none"
          role="img"
          aria-label={`${item.label}, ${format(data[last])} now, ${delta}${since ? ` since ${since}` : ""}`}
        >
          <defs>
            <linearGradient id={`kpi-${uid}`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
              <stop offset="0%" stopColor="var(--foreground)" stopOpacity="0.1" />
              <stop offset="100%" stopColor="var(--foreground)" stopOpacity="0" />
            </linearGradient>
            {/* the line and its fill sweep in left to right, a few px wider than the plot for the round caps */}
            <clipPath id={`kpi-reveal-${uid}`}>
              <motion.rect
                x={-4}
                y={-4}
                height={H + 8}
                initial={reduced ? false : { width: 0 }}
                animate={{ width: play ? W + 8 : 0 }}
                transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.8, ease: EASE, delay: index * 0.05 }}
              />
            </clipPath>
          </defs>
          <g clipPath={`url(#kpi-reveal-${uid})`}>
            <motion.path fill={`url(#kpi-${uid})`} initial={false} animate={{ d: area }} transition={morph} />
            <motion.path
              stroke="var(--foreground)"
              strokeOpacity={0.9}
              strokeWidth="1.8"
              strokeLinecap="round"
              strokeLinejoin="round"
              initial={false}
              animate={{ d: line }}
              transition={morph}
            />
          </g>
          {hi !== null && (
            <g pointerEvents="none">
              <line x1={x(hi)} y1={0} x2={x(hi)} y2={H} stroke="var(--foreground)" strokeOpacity={0.28} strokeWidth="1" />
              <circle cx={x(hi)} cy={y(data[hi])} r="2.5" fill="var(--foreground)" />
            </g>
          )}
        </svg>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

/**
 * A row of metric cards: the value, its signed change and the line it came from. Pointing
 * at a line reads any point in place of the headline, with its date.
 */
export function KpiCardRow({ items = DEFAULT_ITEMS, labels = DEFAULT_LABELS, className }: KpiCardRowProps) {
  return (
    <div className={cn("flex w-[468px] max-w-full flex-wrap items-start gap-1.5 tabular-nums", className)}>
      {items.map((item, i) => (
        <Kpi key={item.label} item={item} labels={labels} index={i} />
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}
```

// ─── components/ui/control-classes.ts ───
```tsx
/* Control classes: the library's control material for components that ship on their own
   (2026-10-02, the audit's pattern 11). src/components/library/controls.ts is the site's
   copy; components used to paste its look in as a flat 8% fill "so the file ships alone",
   and those copies never turned white on a raised light surface. These read the same
   tokens WITH a fallback, so they follow the site's raised-surface rule here and still
   draw correctly in a buyer's app that has no such tokens. Shipped beside every component
   that imports it (scripts/build-registry.mjs bundles ui helpers automatically).

   Whole class strings, never assembled from pieces: Tailwind reads this file as text. */

/** what is ON in a switcher. Light (his call, 2026-10-02, after the inline slider): a WHITE
 *  pill with a hairline and a soft shadow on the grey track. Dark: the 8% thumb */
export const THUMB =
  "bg-white shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--light-outline,rgba(0,0,0,0.09)),0_1px_3px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] dark:bg-[var(--control-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_8%,transparent))] dark:shadow-[var(--control-shadow,inset_0_1px_0_0_color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_6%,transparent))]"

/** what a switcher's options sit in; its 2px padding is the gap the thumb keeps. Light: a
 *  light grey track with no outline, the white pill sits in it. Dark: a hairline, no fill */
export const TRACK = "rounded-full border border-transparent bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_5%,var(--background))] p-0.5 dark:border-foreground/[0.04] dark:bg-transparent"

/** an option that is off: the label alone answers the pointer */
export const SEGMENT_OFF = "text-foreground/60 hover:text-foreground/90"

/** a secondary button: the thumb standing alone; size it with h-7 / h-9 and px */
export const BUTTON =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--control-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_8%,transparent))] shadow-[var(--control-shadow,inset_0_1px_0_0_color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_6%,transparent))] text-foreground/90 outline-none transition-[color,background-color,scale] duration-150 hover:bg-[var(--control-fill-hover,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_12%,transparent))] focus-visible:bg-[var(--control-fill-hover,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_12%,transparent))] active:scale-[0.97] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40 motion-reduce:active:scale-100"

/** an icon-only control: no fill at rest, a faint one under the pointer */
export const ICON_BUTTON =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-full text-foreground/60 outline-none transition-[color,background-color] duration-150 hover:bg-foreground/[0.06] hover:text-foreground/90 focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.06]"

/** a field: the track with just enough fill to read as somewhere to type */
export const FIELD =
  "rounded-full border border-foreground/[0.04] bg-[var(--field-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_5%,transparent))] text-foreground/90 outline-none transition-[background-color,border-color] duration-150 placeholder:text-foreground/45 focus:border-foreground/[0.12]"

/** the one loud button of a form: 48px, full width, the foreground filled (the dashboards'
 *  Modal primary). A ticket, a swap, a confirm: one of these and nothing louder */
export const BUTTON_PRIMARY =
  "inline-flex h-12 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-foreground/[0.92] text-[14px] font-medium text-background outline-none transition-[background-color,scale,opacity] duration-150 hover:bg-foreground focus-visible:bg-foreground active:scale-[0.98] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40 motion-reduce:active:scale-100"

/** a component's own card, field or block (spec 14.8). Dark: a #121212 fill on black. Light
 *  (his call, 2026-10-02: "on light the card background is too dark, it can just be white, a
 *  quiet outline and a small shadow"): white, a 1px hairline (Kraken's #e7e6e9, or 9% ink in an app without the token) and a
 *  barely there shadow,
 *  drawn as box shadows so the outline takes no layout */
export const SURFACE =
  "bg-background shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--light-outline,color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_9%,transparent)),0_1px_2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] dark:bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_7%,var(--background))] dark:shadow-none"

/** a block sitting ON a surface: a faint 4% grey inside a white card in light, #1f1f1f in dark */
export const RAISED = "bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_4%,var(--background))] dark:bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_12%,var(--background))]"
```

```tsx
"use client"

import { type ReactNode } from "react"
import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

/* Live figure: a figure fed by a live stream (2026-10-02, out of Tape Flow, where a price
   that re-entered on every print read as a flicker). The value changes in place on each
   tick; the figure swaps (4px, 2px blur, 150ms) only when `intent` changes: the pointer
   takes a point, lets it go, or a toggle flips. Pass the pointed point's id, or null for
   the live value. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const

export function LiveFigure({
  intent,
  className,
  children,
}: {
  /** what the figure is showing: a pointed point's id, or null while it follows the stream */
  intent: string | number | null
  className?: string
  children: ReactNode
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  return (
    <motion.div
      key={intent === null ? "live" : `at-${intent}`}
      className={cn(className)}
      initial={reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: 4, filter: "blur(2px)" }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, filter: "blur(0px)" }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.15, ease: EASE }}
    >
      {children}
    </motion.div>
  )
}
```

# Stat Tile (stat-tile)
> Compact stat tiles for trading metrics like net P&L, win rate and Sharpe ratio, each with a sparkline you scrub for any point.

// ─── components/ui/stat-tile.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useState } from "react"
import type { KeyboardEvent, PointerEvent } from "react"
import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { SURFACE } from "@/components/ui/control-classes"
import { LiveFigure } from "@/components/ui/live-figure"

/* Stat Tile, new through ssych-component (2026-09-29).
   What it is for: one metric in the least room it can take: label, value, signed change and,
   when there is a series, a tiny line. 152px a tile, three in a row by default.
   Read first: the value. The change under it is the only colour.
   The pointer: pointing at a tile (or tabbing to it) dims the others. Moving across a tile
   that has a line reads that point: the value swaps to it and the change gives way to the
   point's label. Arrow keys walk the points.
   Sketch: lab/StatTile. Kept label, value, signed change and the optional line under them.
   The card, the count-up, the delta pill with its arrow, the info icon, the capacity meter
   and the full-bleed filled chart are gone.
   Against ui/kpi-card-row: this is the compact form at the same width, a 17px value
   against 22 and a 20px line with no area fill against a 48px filled chart.
   2026-10-02 audit: his call, each tile now sits in a box with the background: the surface
   step (7% foreground over the background), 12px padding, corner 18 (the inner card of the
   card scale: 24 outside, 18 inside at a 6px gap), tiles 6px apart. Tiles are 152px, so the
   row is 468px, the same width as KPI Card Row, its family. The value no longer replays its
   swap on every scrub step: it swaps once as the pointer (or the arrow keys) takes the line
   and once as it lets go, and moves at once in between (LiveFigure). Label 12px /45, the
   change 11px font-medium in its hue.
   Formulas:
   · value  = data[n − 1] when a series is given, else `value`
   · change = (data[n − 1] / data[0] − 1) × 100 in percent, or data[n − 1] − data[0] in
              points when `diff` is "points" (for metrics that are already a percent);
              with no series it is the `change` given
   2026-10-02 round 2: his note, the chart fills its container. The line runs the tile's
   full 152px, edge to edge, and sits on the tile's bottom edge with no padding under it (the
   18px corner clips it; the lowest point keeps 7px of room so the curve never cuts it). The
   focus ring sits on the tile's own edge, inset, in ink. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const GREEN = "var(--chart-up)"
const RED = "var(--chart-down)"

export interface StatTileItem {
  label: string
  /** the metric's series, oldest first; the last point is the value shown */
  data?: number[]
  /** the value when there is no series */
  value?: number
  /** the change when there is no series, in the unit `diff` names */
  change?: number
  /** how the change is measured: a percent of the first point, or a plain difference */
  diff?: "percent" | "points"
  format?: (v: number) => string
}

export interface StatTileProps {
  /** one tile per metric */
  items?: StatTileItem[]
  /** what each sample point is called, read out while pointing at it */
  labels?: string[]
  className?: string
}

const DEFAULT_ITEMS: StatTileItem[] = [
  { label: "Net P&L", format: (v) => `$${Math.round(v).toLocaleString("en-US")}`, data: [11510, 11620, 11480, 11760, 11900, 11840, 12120, 12260, 12310, 12480] },
  { label: "Win rate", format: (v) => `${v.toFixed(1)}%`, diff: "points", data: [56.1, 56.4, 56.0, 56.9, 57.2, 57.0, 57.6, 57.9, 58.1, 58.3] },
  { label: "Sharpe ratio", format: (v) => v.toFixed(2), data: [2.08, 2.05, 2.1, 2.04, 2.0, 2.02, 1.97, 1.95, 1.94, 1.92] },
]

const DEFAULT_LABELS = ["Feb 24", "Mar 3", "Mar 10", "Mar 17", "Mar 24", "Mar 31", "Apr 7", "Apr 14", "Apr 21", "Apr 28"]

/** the line's width: the tile's full 152px, edge to edge (round 2) */
const W = 152
const H = 30
/** room above the highest point */
const TOP = 3
/** room under the lowest point, so the corner's curve does not cut the line */
const BOT = 7

const clamp = (v: number, lo: number, hi: number) => Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, v))
const fallbackFormat = (v: number) => (Math.abs(v) >= 100 ? Math.round(v).toLocaleString("en-US") : v.toFixed(2))

function Tile({
  item,
  labels,
  index,
  dim,
  onHot,
}: {
  item: StatTileItem
  labels: string[]
  index: number
  dim: boolean
  onHot: (on: boolean) => void
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const [hi, setHi] = useState<number | null>(null)

  const data = item.data && item.data.length ? item.data : null
  const format = item.format ?? fallbackFormat
  const last = data ? data.length - 1 : 0
  const now = data ? data[last] : (item.value ?? 0)
  const points = item.diff === "points"
  const change = data ? (points ? data[last] - data[0] : data[0] ? (data[last] / data[0] - 1) * 100 : 0) : item.change
  const signed = change == null ? "" : `${change >= 0 ? "+" : "−"}${Math.abs(change).toFixed(points ? 1 : 2)}${points ? " pt" : "%"}`

  const max = data ? Math.max(...data) : 1
  const min = data ? Math.min(...data) : 0
  const span = Math.max(1e-6, max - min)
  const x = (i: number) => (i / Math.max(1, last)) * W
  const y = (v: number) => TOP + (1 - (v - min) / span) * (H - TOP - BOT)
  const line = data ? data.map((v, i) => `${i === 0 ? "M" : "L"} ${x(i).toFixed(2)} ${y(v).toFixed(2)}`).join(" ") : ""

  const shown = hi ?? last
  const value = data ? data[shown] : now

  const onMove = (e: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!data) return
    const r = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect()
    const px = ((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width) * W
    setHi(clamp(Math.round((px / W) * last), 0, last))
  }
  const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!data) return
    const step = e.key === "ArrowLeft" ? -1 : e.key === "ArrowRight" ? 1 : 0
    if (step) {
      e.preventDefault()
      setHi(clamp((hi ?? last) + step, 0, last))
    } else if (e.key === "Escape") setHi(null)
  }
  const leave = () => {
    setHi(null)
    onHot(false)
  }

  return (
    <div
      role="group"
      tabIndex={0}
      aria-label={`${item.label}, ${format(now)}${signed ? `, ${signed}` : ""}`}
      onPointerEnter={() => onHot(true)}
      onPointerMove={onMove}
      onPointerLeave={leave}
      onFocus={() => onHot(true)}
      onBlur={leave}
      onKeyDown={onKey}
      /* corner 18: the inner card of the card scale (24 outside = 18 + the 6px gap) */
      className={cn(
        "w-[152px] shrink-0 touch-none overflow-hidden rounded-[18px] p-3 outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-foreground/20",
        SURFACE,
        data && "cursor-crosshair",
        !reduced && "transition-opacity duration-200",
      )}
      style={{ opacity: dim ? 0.45 : 1 }}
    >
      <div className="truncate text-[12px] text-foreground/45">{item.label}</div>
      <div role="status" className="mt-1.5">
        {/* the value swaps once as the line is taken and once as it is let go (4px, 2px blur,
            150ms); along the line it moves at once */}
        <LiveFigure intent={hi === null ? null : "scrub"} className="truncate text-[17px] font-semibold leading-none tracking-[-0.02em] text-foreground/90">
          {format(value)}
        </LiveFigure>
        <div className="mt-1.5 h-[14px] truncate text-[11px] leading-[14px]">
          {hi !== null ? (
            <span className="text-foreground/45">{labels[hi] ?? ""}</span>
          ) : signed ? (
            <span className="font-medium" style={{ color: (change ?? 0) >= 0 ? GREEN : RED }}>
              {signed}
            </span>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </div>

      {data && (
        <svg
          width={W}
          height={H}
          viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`}
          className="-mx-3 -mb-3 mt-2 block max-w-none"
          fill="none"
          role="img"
          aria-label={`${item.label} over ${data.length} points, from ${format(data[0])} to ${format(data[last])}`}
        >
          <motion.path
            d={line}
            stroke="var(--foreground)"
            strokeOpacity={0.9}
            strokeWidth={1.8}
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
            initial={{ pathLength: reduced ? 1 : 0 }}
            animate={{ pathLength: 1 }}
            transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.4, ease: EASE, delay: index * 0.035 }}
          />
          {hi !== null && <circle cx={x(hi)} cy={y(data[hi])} r={2.2} fill="var(--foreground)" pointerEvents="none" />}
        </svg>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

/**
 * Compact metrics in a row: label, value, signed change and a tiny ink line, each on its
 * own surface, 152px each.
 * Pointing at a tile dims the others; moving across it reads any point of its line in
 * place of the value, with the point's label.
 */
export function StatTile({ items = DEFAULT_ITEMS, labels = DEFAULT_LABELS, className }: StatTileProps) {
  const [hot, setHot] = useState<number | null>(null)
  return (
    <div className={cn("flex w-[468px] max-w-full flex-wrap items-start gap-1.5 tabular-nums", className)}>
      {items.map((item, i) => (
        <Tile
          key={item.label}
          item={item}
          labels={labels}
          index={i}
          dim={hot !== null && hot !== i}
          onHot={(on) => setHot((h) => (on ? i : h === i ? null : h))}
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}

```

```tsx
/* Control classes: the library's control material for components that ship on their own
   (2026-10-02, the audit's pattern 11). src/components/library/controls.ts is the site's
   copy; components used to paste its look in as a flat 8% fill "so the file ships alone",
   and those copies never turned white on a raised light surface. These read the same
   tokens WITH a fallback, so they follow the site's raised-surface rule here and still
   draw correctly in a buyer's app that has no such tokens. Shipped beside every component
   that imports it (scripts/build-registry.mjs bundles ui helpers automatically).

   Whole class strings, never assembled from pieces: Tailwind reads this file as text. */

  "bg-white shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--light-outline,rgba(0,0,0,0.09)),0_1px_3px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] dark:bg-[var(--control-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_8%,transparent))] dark:shadow-[var(--control-shadow,inset_0_1px_0_0_color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_6%,transparent))]"

/** an option that is off: the label alone answers the pointer */
export const SEGMENT_OFF = "text-foreground/60 hover:text-foreground/90"

/** a secondary button: the thumb standing alone; size it with h-7 / h-9 and px */
export const BUTTON =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--control-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_8%,transparent))] shadow-[var(--control-shadow,inset_0_1px_0_0_color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_6%,transparent))] text-foreground/90 outline-none transition-[color,background-color,scale] duration-150 hover:bg-[var(--control-fill-hover,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_12%,transparent))] focus-visible:bg-[var(--control-fill-hover,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_12%,transparent))] active:scale-[0.97] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40 motion-reduce:active:scale-100"

/** an icon-only control: no fill at rest, a faint one under the pointer */
export const ICON_BUTTON =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-full text-foreground/60 outline-none transition-[color,background-color] duration-150 hover:bg-foreground/[0.06] hover:text-foreground/90 focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.06]"

/** a field: the track with just enough fill to read as somewhere to type */

  "rounded-full border border-foreground/[0.04] bg-[var(--field-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_5%,transparent))] text-foreground/90 outline-none transition-[background-color,border-color] duration-150 placeholder:text-foreground/45 focus:border-foreground/[0.12]"

/** the one loud button of a form: 48px, full width, the foreground filled (the dashboards'
 *  Modal primary). A ticket, a swap, a confirm: one of these and nothing louder */
export const BUTTON_PRIMARY =
  "inline-flex h-12 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-foreground/[0.92] text-[14px] font-medium text-background outline-none transition-[background-color,scale,opacity] duration-150 hover:bg-foreground focus-visible:bg-foreground active:scale-[0.98] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40 motion-reduce:active:scale-100"

/** a component's own card, field or block (spec 14.8). Dark: a #121212 fill on black. Light
 *  (his call, 2026-10-02: "on light the card background is too dark, it can just be white, a
 *  quiet outline and a small shadow"): white, a 1px hairline (Kraken's #e7e6e9, or 9% ink in an app without the token) and a
 *  barely there shadow,
```

# Info Card (info-card)
> A small callout card with a title, one line and an action row, for help prompts and upsells in a dashboard sidebar.

// ─── components/ui/info-card.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import type { ReactNode } from "react"
import { PiggyBank } from "lucide-react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

/* the ground is the surface step (spec 14.8): a solid 7% foreground over the page, no outline */
/** the library's one card corner, copied from src/components/library/controls.ts (CARD_RADIUS) */
const CARD_RADIUS = "rounded-[24px]"

/* Info Card, the rail's small card (shell primitives brief, 2026-09-30).
   What it is for: one statement with one way to act on it: "Need help?", "Request a free
   component", "Generator". Two or three of them sit under the Pro card in the right rail.
   Read first: the title, then the line. At rest that is all there is, so a rail of them
   reads as statements, not as statements with links under them.
   The pointer: on the card (or the keyboard's focus inside it) the action row opens, its
   height easing from nothing over 250ms and its label fading in; leaving closes it. A touch screen
   has no pointer to wait for, so there the row is always open. The action itself is a
   real link or button, in the tab order even while its row is shut.
   Taken from: src/components/library/SidebarInfoMenu.tsx, boxClass, titleClass,
   bodyClass, actionClass and Reveal, class for class. The corner is controls.ts (24px);
   the text inset is React Bits' 20px.
   Decided: nothing. The shell's three cards differ only in words and icon, so this is one
   component with those as props.
   2026-10-02 audit: his note said the right padding was wrong, so the inset is now one 20px
   value on all four sides (the corner holds only text, so no nesting sum applies) and the line
   sets balanced so its last word never sits alone and reads as a gap at the right. The fill
   moved to the 7% surface step, the title to 13px medium /90 and the line to 12px /60 so it
   reads; the default width is the rail's 280px.
   2026-10-02 round 2: the defaults are a fintech callout (idle USDC earning 4.8%, with Move to
   yield) instead of the library's own help card. Nothing in the library shell renders this
   component, so no rail copy depended on the old words. */

export interface InfoCardProps {
  title?: string
  line?: string
  action?: string
  /** the action's icon, a Phosphor glyph at 16px */
  icon?: ReactNode
  href?: string
  onPress?: () => void
  className?: string
}

/** The action row: shut until the card is pointed at or focused into, open on touch. */
function Reveal({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className="grid grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0 transition-[grid-template-rows,opacity] duration-[250ms] ease-[cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)] group-focus-within/box:grid-rows-[1fr] group-focus-within/box:opacity-100 group-hover/box:grid-rows-[1fr] group-hover/box:opacity-100 motion-reduce:transition-[opacity] [@media(hover:none)]:grid-rows-[1fr] [@media(hover:none)]:opacity-100">
      <div className="flex min-h-0 flex-col overflow-hidden">{children}</div>
    </div>
  )
}

/** colour 150ms; a press gives to 0.97, dropped under reduced motion */
const ACTION = "mt-3 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 self-start text-[12px] font-semibold text-foreground/80 transition-[color,scale] duration-150 hover:text-foreground active:scale-[0.97] motion-reduce:active:scale-100"

/**
 * A quiet card with a title, one line, and an action that shows itself when the card
 * is pointed at.
 */
export function InfoCard({
  title = "Idle USDC earns 4.8%",
  line = "12,400 USDC sits idle in spot. In yield it accrues daily and you can withdraw any time.",
  action = "Move to yield",
  icon = <PiggyBank className="h-4 w-4" strokeWidth={1.75} />,
  href = "#yield",
  onPress,
  className,
}: InfoCardProps) {
  return (
    <div role="group" aria-label={title} className={cn("group/box w-[280px] bg-background shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--light-outline,color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_9%,transparent)),0_1px_2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] dark:bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_7%,var(--background))] dark:shadow-none p-5", CARD_RADIUS, className)}>
      <div className="text-[13px] font-medium leading-snug text-foreground/90">{title}</div>
      <p className="mt-1 text-balance text-[12px] leading-[1.55] text-foreground/60">{line}</p>
      <Reveal>
        {onPress ? (
          <button type="button" onClick={onPress} className={ACTION}>
            {icon}
            {action}
          </button>
        ) : (
          <a href={href} className={ACTION}>
            {icon}
            {action}
          </a>
        )}
      </Reveal>
    </div>
  )
}
```

# Alert Stack (alert-stack)
> A stacked notification panel for price alerts, margin warnings and order fills that fans open on hover and settles as you dismiss.

// ─── components/ui/alert-stack.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useState } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"
import { Check, X } from "lucide-react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { BUTTON, ICON_BUTTON } from "@/components/ui/control-classes"
import { rowWash, useRowExit } from "@/components/ui/row-action"
import { Tip } from "@/components/ui/browser-window-tip"

/* Alert Stack, rebuilt through the ssych-component skill (2026-09-29).
   What changed against the version before it (in git history), and why:
   · no outline and no drop shadow on the rows, and none on the restore control: each row
     is one flat fill, and the pile reads through the rows behind stepping back in strength
   · the sparkle is gone: it said nothing about the alert
   · pointing at a row in the open fan keeps it full and dims the others
   · the fan opens for the keyboard too, the pile names itself and says how many are left
   · every figure is tabular
   2026-10-02 audit: his note said the roundness no longer matched the rest, so the corners
   nest again. A row is 44px tall and holds a 24px round dismiss 10px in from its top, bottom
   and right, so its corner is 12 + 10 = 22, half its height: the rows are pills. The samples
   were three "coming soon" lines; they are now real alerts, each with a 6px dot in the hue of
   its direction (up, warning, done). Dismiss is the shared icon button with a "Dismiss" tip,
   and it plays out: the row holds a tick and "Dismissed" on a 10% wash for 420ms, then slides
   16px and leaves. Restore is the shared secondary button at h-7. Width 320, the card step. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const SMOOTH = [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] as const
/* the house re-settle spring: the rows are a physical pile */
const SETTLE = { type: "spring", stiffness: 300, damping: 30 } as const
/* the lift spring, for presses */
const PRESS = { type: "spring", stiffness: 500, damping: 30 } as const
/* solid, so a row hides the ones stacked under it */

export type AlertTone = "up" | "down" | "warn" | "neutral"
export interface AlertItem {
  label: string
  /** the dot's hue: up and down for a direction, warn for a limit near, neutral for a fact */
  tone?: AlertTone
}

const TONE: Record<AlertTone, string> = {
  up: "var(--chart-up, #34c28a)",
  down: "var(--chart-down, #e06a6a)",
  warn: "var(--chart-amber, #e8b45a)",
  neutral: "color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 45%, transparent)",
}

const DEFAULT_ALERTS: AlertItem[] = [
  { label: "BTC crossed $65,000", tone: "up" },
  { label: "Margin at 82%", tone: "warn" },
  { label: "Order 84133 filled", tone: "neutral" },
]

const asItem = (a: string | AlertItem): AlertItem => (typeof a === "string" ? { label: a } : a)

/**
 * Collapsed notification deck: rows sit stacked with a peeking edge, fan open under the
 * pointer, and each dismiss re-settles the pile. Dismiss everything and a quiet restore
 * control appears.
 */
export function AlertStack({
  alerts = DEFAULT_ALERTS,
  onDismiss,
  className,
}: {
  /** plain strings still work (a neutral row with no dot); an item can carry a tone */
  alerts?: (string | AlertItem)[]
  onDismiss?: (alert: string) => void
  className?: string
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const [hot, setHot] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [rows, setRows] = useState(() => alerts.map(asItem))
  const { leaving, start } = useRowExit()
  const count = `${rows.length} ${rows.length === 1 ? "alert" : "alerts"}`

  const dismiss = (label: string) =>
    start(label, () => {
      setRows((r) => r.filter((x) => x.label !== label))
      setHot(null)
      onDismiss?.(label)
    })

  return (
    <div
      className={cn("w-[320px] tabular-nums", className)}
      role="group"
      aria-label={`Alerts, ${count}`}
      onPointerEnter={() => setOpen(true)}
      onPointerLeave={() => {
        setOpen(false)
        setHot(null)
      }}
      onFocus={() => setOpen(true)}
      onBlur={(e) => {
        if (!e.currentTarget.contains(e.relatedTarget as Node | null)) {
          setOpen(false)
          setHot(null)
        }
      }}
    >
      <span role="status" className="sr-only text-[11px]">
        {count}
      </span>
      {rows.length === 0 ? (
        /* the restore control arrives once the last row has gone, and presses with the lift spring */
        <motion.button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setRows(alerts.map(asItem))}
          initial={reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, scale: 0.97 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
          transition={reduced ? { duration: 0.15 } : { duration: 0.25, ease: EASE, scale: PRESS }}
          className={cn(BUTTON, "mx-auto flex h-7 px-3 text-[11.5px]")}
        >
          Restore alerts
        </motion.button>
      ) : (
        <div className="relative" style={{ height: open ? rows.length * 52 - 8 : 44 + (rows.length - 1) * 7 }}>
          <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
            {rows.map(({ label, tone }, i) => {
              const done = leaving === label
              return (
                <motion.div
                  key={label}
                  /* rounded-full: 22 = the 24px dismiss's 12 + its 10px inset (spec 13.10) */
                  /* light (his call, 2026-10-02): white cards on top of each other, a hairline
                     and a light shadow each; dark keeps the 7% ground */
                  className="absolute inset-x-0 top-0 flex h-11 items-center gap-2.5 rounded-full bg-background pl-4 pr-2.5 shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--light-outline,rgba(0,0,0,0.09)),0_2px_6px_rgba(0,0,0,0.06)] dark:bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_7%,var(--background))] dark:shadow-none"
                  style={{ zIndex: rows.length - i }}
                  onPointerEnter={() => setHot(label)}
                  initial={false}
                  animate={{
                    y: open ? i * 52 : i * 7,
                    scale: open ? 1 : 1 - i * 0.035,
                    opacity: open ? (hot !== null && hot !== label ? 0.5 : 1) : i > 2 ? 0 : 1 - i * 0.28,
                  }}
                  exit={reduced ? { opacity: 0, transition: { duration: 0.15 } } : { opacity: 0, x: 16, transition: { duration: 0.3, ease: SMOOTH } }}
                  transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { ...SETTLE, opacity: { duration: 0.18, ease: EASE } }}
                >
                  {/* the hold's wash sits under the text, in the row's own corner */}
                  <span
                    aria-hidden
                    className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 rounded-full transition-opacity duration-150"
                    style={{ background: rowWash("var(--foreground)"), opacity: done ? 1 : 0 }}
                  />
                  {tone && <span aria-hidden className="relative h-1.5 w-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full" style={{ background: TONE[tone] }} />}
                  <span className="relative flex-1 truncate text-[12.5px] text-foreground/90">{label}</span>
                  {done ? (
                    <span className="relative inline-flex h-6 items-center gap-1 pr-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-foreground/90" role="status">
                      <Check className="h-3 w-3" strokeWidth={2.2} aria-hidden />
                      Dismissed
                    </span>
                  ) : (
                    <Tip tip="Dismiss" side="left" className="relative">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        aria-label={`Dismiss "${label}"`}
                        disabled={leaving !== null}
                        onFocus={() => setHot(label)}
                        onClick={() => dismiss(label)}
                        className={cn(ICON_BUTTON, "h-6 w-6 text-foreground/45 active:scale-[0.97] motion-reduce:active:scale-100")}
                      >
                        <X className="h-3 w-3" strokeWidth={2} aria-hidden />
                      </button>
                    </Tip>
                  )}
                </motion.div>
              )
            })}
          </AnimatePresence>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
```

```tsx
/* Control classes: the library's control material for components that ship on their own
   (2026-10-02, the audit's pattern 11). src/components/library/controls.ts is the site's
   copy; components used to paste its look in as a flat 8% fill "so the file ships alone",
   and those copies never turned white on a raised light surface. These read the same
   tokens WITH a fallback, so they follow the site's raised-surface rule here and still
   draw correctly in a buyer's app that has no such tokens. Shipped beside every component
   that imports it (scripts/build-registry.mjs bundles ui helpers automatically).

   Whole class strings, never assembled from pieces: Tailwind reads this file as text. */

/** what is ON in a switcher. Light (his call, 2026-10-02, after the inline slider): a WHITE
 *  pill with a hairline and a soft shadow on the grey track. Dark: the 8% thumb */
export const THUMB =
  "bg-white shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--light-outline,rgba(0,0,0,0.09)),0_1px_3px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] dark:bg-[var(--control-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_8%,transparent))] dark:shadow-[var(--control-shadow,inset_0_1px_0_0_color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_6%,transparent))]"

/** what a switcher's options sit in; its 2px padding is the gap the thumb keeps. Light: a
 *  light grey track with no outline, the white pill sits in it. Dark: a hairline, no fill */
export const TRACK = "rounded-full border border-transparent bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_5%,var(--background))] p-0.5 dark:border-foreground/[0.04] dark:bg-transparent"

/** an option that is off: the label alone answers the pointer */
export const SEGMENT_OFF = "text-foreground/60 hover:text-foreground/90"

/** a secondary button: the thumb standing alone; size it with h-7 / h-9 and px */
export const BUTTON =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--control-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_8%,transparent))] shadow-[var(--control-shadow,inset_0_1px_0_0_color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_6%,transparent))] text-foreground/90 outline-none transition-[color,background-color,scale] duration-150 hover:bg-[var(--control-fill-hover,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_12%,transparent))] focus-visible:bg-[var(--control-fill-hover,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_12%,transparent))] active:scale-[0.97] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40 motion-reduce:active:scale-100"

/** an icon-only control: no fill at rest, a faint one under the pointer */
export const ICON_BUTTON =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-full text-foreground/60 outline-none transition-[color,background-color] duration-150 hover:bg-foreground/[0.06] hover:text-foreground/90 focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.06]"

/** a field: the track with just enough fill to read as somewhere to type */
export const FIELD =
  "rounded-full border border-foreground/[0.04] bg-[var(--field-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_5%,transparent))] text-foreground/90 outline-none transition-[background-color,border-color] duration-150 placeholder:text-foreground/45 focus:border-foreground/[0.12]"

/** the one loud button of a form: 48px, full width, the foreground filled (the dashboards'
 *  Modal primary). A ticket, a swap, a confirm: one of these and nothing louder */
export const BUTTON_PRIMARY =
  "inline-flex h-12 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-foreground/[0.92] text-[14px] font-medium text-background outline-none transition-[background-color,scale,opacity] duration-150 hover:bg-foreground focus-visible:bg-foreground active:scale-[0.98] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40 motion-reduce:active:scale-100"

/** a component's own card, field or block (spec 14.8). Dark: a #121212 fill on black. Light
 *  (his call, 2026-10-02: "on light the card background is too dark, it can just be white, a
 *  quiet outline and a small shadow"): white, a 1px hairline (Kraken's #e7e6e9, or 9% ink in an app without the token) and a
 *  barely there shadow,
 *  drawn as box shadows so the outline takes no layout */
export const SURFACE =
  "bg-background shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--light-outline,color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_9%,transparent)),0_1px_2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] dark:bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_7%,var(--background))] dark:shadow-none"

/** a block sitting ON a surface: a faint 4% grey inside a white card in light, #1f1f1f in dark */
export const RAISED = "bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_4%,var(--background))] dark:bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_12%,var(--background))]"
```

// ─── components/ui/row-action.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react"
import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"
import { Check } from "lucide-react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

/* Row action: an action that lives on a table row, and the way the row leaves after it
   (2026-10-02, out of Positions Table and the trading terminal).

   RowAction   a real button in the row's own last column, so it never sits over a figure.
               It comes up (4px, 150ms) on row hover or keyboard focus (the row carries
               `group`), and is always shown where there is no hover. Once pressed it turns
               to a tick and the past tense ("Closed").
   useRowExit  the hold: the row washes in the colour of its result and keeps its "Closed"
               for 420ms, then `onDone` takes it out of the list.
   rowExit     the motion the row's wrapper leaves with: 16px right as it fades while its
               height folds away (300ms), so the rows under it close up. Reduced motion
               keeps a fade.
   rowWash     the 10% wash in the result's colour. */

const LIFT_SPRING = { type: "spring", stiffness: 500, damping: 30 } as const
const SMOOTH = [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] as const
/** how long a finished row holds its "Closed" before it leaves */
export const ROW_HOLD_MS = 420

export function useRowExit(hold = ROW_HOLD_MS) {
  const [leaving, setLeaving] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const timer = useRef<number | undefined>(undefined)
  useEffect(() => () => window.clearTimeout(timer.current), [])
  /** hold row `id` in its finished state, then run `onDone` (which removes it) */
  const start = useCallback(
    (id: string, onDone: () => void) => {
      if (leaving) return
      setLeaving(id)
      timer.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
        onDone()
        setLeaving(null)
      }, hold)
    },
    [hold, leaving],
  )
  return { leaving, start }
}

export const rowExit = (reduced: boolean | null) =>
  reduced
    ? { opacity: 0, transition: { duration: 0.15 } }
    : { opacity: 0, x: 16, height: 0, transition: { duration: 0.3, ease: SMOOTH, height: { duration: 0.3, ease: SMOOTH, delay: 0.08 } } }

export const rowWash = (color: string) => `color-mix(in srgb, ${color} 10%, transparent)`

export function RowAction({
  done,
  disabled,
  onClick,
  label = "Close",
  doneLabel = "Closed",
  tone = "var(--foreground)",
  "aria-label": ariaLabel,
  children,
}: {
  /** the action has gone through: the button reads the past tense with a tick */
  done: boolean
  disabled?: boolean
  onClick: () => void
  label?: string
  doneLabel?: string
  /** the tick's colour: the result's hue */
  tone?: string
  "aria-label"?: string
  children?: ReactNode
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  return (
    <motion.button
      type="button"
      onClick={onClick}
      disabled={disabled}
      aria-label={ariaLabel}
      whileTap={reduced ? undefined : { scale: 0.97, transition: LIFT_SPRING }}
      className={cn(
        "inline-flex h-6 items-center gap-1 rounded-full px-2.5 text-[10.5px] font-medium text-foreground/90 outline-none",
        "transition-[opacity,transform,translate,background-color,color] duration-150 ease-out",
        done
          ? "translate-y-0 opacity-100"
          : "translate-y-1 bg-foreground/[0.08] opacity-0 hover:bg-foreground/[0.14] focus-visible:translate-y-0 focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.14] focus-visible:opacity-100 group-hover:translate-y-0 group-hover:opacity-100 [@media(hover:none)]:translate-y-0 [@media(hover:none)]:opacity-100",
      )}
    >
      {done ? (
        <>
          <Check size={11} strokeWidth={2.2} aria-hidden style={{ color: tone }} />
          {doneLabel}
        </>
      ) : (
        children ?? label
      )}
    </motion.button>
  )
}
```

```tsx
"use client"

import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

/* Tip: the library's small tooltip for an icon control or a cut-off name (2026-10-02 audit).
   Written once for Browser Window and shared by Alert Stack, so each of them
   still installs in one command (the registry ships an imported ui helper beside them).
   The look is the library popover (spec 14.6): radius 12, the 8% hairline, a 6% fill over
   the page and the popover shadow; text 11px /90, sentence case. It waits a beat so a
   pointer crossing the component opens nothing (`delay`), opens on keyboard focus too,
   closes on leave, blur and Escape, and it is the only tooltip: no native `title` beside it.
   It never takes the pointer, so it cannot get in the way of the control under it. */

const POPOVER_BG = "var(--tip-fill, color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 6%, var(--background)))"
const POPOVER_SHADOW = "0 8px 24px var(--card-shadow, rgba(0,0,0,0.35))"

const SIDE = {
  top: "bottom-full left-1/2 mb-1.5 -translate-x-1/2",
  bottom: "top-full left-1/2 mt-1.5 -translate-x-1/2",
  left: "right-full top-1/2 mr-1.5 -translate-y-1/2",
} as const

export function Tip({
  tip,
  children,
  side = "top",
  delay = 320,
  disabled = false,
  className,
}: {
  tip: ReactNode
  children: ReactNode
  side?: keyof typeof SIDE
  /** ms the pointer rests before it opens; a long hover reveal uses ~700 */
  delay?: number
  /** nothing to reveal (the name is not cut off): never opens */
  disabled?: boolean
  className?: string
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const timer = useRef<number | undefined>(undefined)
  const id = useId()
  useEffect(() => () => window.clearTimeout(timer.current), [])
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return
    const esc = (e: KeyboardEvent) => e.key === "Escape" && setOpen(false)
    window.addEventListener("keydown", esc)
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", esc)
  }, [open])
  const show = () => {
    if (disabled) return
    window.clearTimeout(timer.current)
    timer.current = window.setTimeout(() => setOpen(true), delay)
  }
  const hide = () => {
    window.clearTimeout(timer.current)
    setOpen(false)
  }
  return (
    <span
      className={cn("relative inline-flex", className)}
      aria-describedby={open ? id : undefined}
      onPointerEnter={(e) => e.pointerType !== "touch" && show()}
      onPointerLeave={hide}
      onPointerDown={hide}
      onFocus={show}
      onBlur={hide}
    >
      {children}
      {open && (
        <span
          id={id}
          role="tooltip"
          className={cn(
            "pointer-events-none absolute z-50 w-max max-w-[260px] rounded-[12px] border border-foreground/[0.08] px-2.5 py-1.5 text-left text-[11px] font-normal leading-[1.4] text-foreground/90",
            SIDE[side],
          )}
          style={{ background: POPOVER_BG, boxShadow: POPOVER_SHADOW }}
        >
          {tip}
        </span>
      )}
    </span>
  )
}
```

# News Card (news-card)
> A market news card that cycles headlines with their source and time, for trading dashboards, broker apps and crypto portals.

// ─── components/ui/news-card.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { usePointed } from "@/components/ui/use-pointed"

/* News Card, rebuilt through the ssych-component skill (2026-09-29).
   What changed against the version before it (in git history), and why:
   · no card: no outline, no inner shadow, no surface. The story sits on the page
   · the title is sentence case at normal spacing (it was letter-spaced)
   · the story dots moved up beside the title, so the block is one column with nothing
     hanging under it; each dot has a larger press area and names its story
   · pointing at the story, or focusing a dot, holds the cycle so it can be read
   · every figure is tabular, so the times line up from story to story
   · the swap is 0.2s (it was 0.35s) and the dot change 200ms (it was 300ms)
   · the block names itself to a screen reader; the story is a status that only speaks
     when the reader changed it, not on every automatic turn
   Props are the same.
   2026-10-02 audit: the stories turned on their own every 5.2s from mount; the card now rests
   on the first story, and turns on its own only while it is pointed at (usePointed; in view
   on touch), still holding while the pointer is on the story itself, so in practice it turns
   while the pointer is on the title row and the dots. The dots turn it on a press, and the
   left and right arrow keys move between them. Text that is read cleared the readable step:
   the title is 12px /60 (the label tier), the time 11px /45 and the source 11px /60.
   2026-10-02 round 2: three market headlines (an index rebalance, ETF flows, a perpetuals
   volume record) under real sounding desk names instead of Sample Wire and a SaaS story. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const

export interface NewsItem {
  time: string
  headline: string
  source: string
}

const DEFAULT_ITEMS: NewsItem[] = [
  { time: "12 hours ago", headline: "Quarterly index rebalance shifts sector weights across the top 20.", source: "Index Desk" },
  { time: "18 hours ago", headline: "Spot bitcoin ETFs log $412M of net inflows, a fourth straight day.", source: "Flows Weekly" },
  { time: "1 day ago", headline: "Perpetuals volume crosses $230B on the day, a record for the quarter.", source: "Chain Brief" },
]

/**
 * Turning news: the time, one headline in strong ink, its source. It rests on the first
 * story; pointed at, stories turn on their own, pointing at the story holds it, a dot (or
 * an arrow key on the dots) jumps to a story and restarts the clock.
 */
export function NewsCard({
  items = DEFAULT_ITEMS,
  title = "Market news",
  cycleMs = 5200,
  className,
}: {
  items?: NewsItem[]
  title?: string
  /** Auto-advance interval while pointed at; ignored when the user prefers reduced motion. */
  cycleMs?: number
  className?: string
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const [i, setI] = useState(0)
  const [held, setHeld] = useState(false)
  /** bumped by a jump, so the clock starts again from that story */
  const [turn, setTurn] = useState(0)

  const { ref, live, bind } = usePointed<HTMLDivElement>()
  const dots = useRef<(HTMLButtonElement | null)[]>([])

  const count = items.length
  const turning = !reduced && live && !held && count > 1

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!turning) return
    const t = setInterval(() => setI((n) => (n + 1) % count), cycleMs)
    return () => clearInterval(t)
  }, [turning, count, cycleMs, turn])

  const jump = (n: number) => {
    setI(n)
    setTurn((t) => t + 1)
  }
  /** the arrow keys move between the dots, and the story follows */
  const onDotKey = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>, n: number) => {
    const dir = e.key === "ArrowRight" ? 1 : e.key === "ArrowLeft" ? -1 : 0
    if (!dir || count < 2) return
    e.preventDefault()
    const next = (n + dir + count) % count
    jump(next)
    dots.current[next]?.focus()
  }

  const at = Math.min(i, Math.max(0, count - 1))
  const item = items[at]

  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      {...bind}
      className={cn("w-full max-w-[380px] tabular-nums", className)}
      role="group"
      aria-label={`${title}, story ${count ? at + 1 : 0} of ${count}`}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <span className="text-[12px] font-medium text-foreground/60">{title}</span>
        <span className="-mr-1 flex items-center" onFocus={() => setHeld(true)} onBlur={() => setHeld(false)}>
          {items.map((it, n) => (
            <button
              key={n}
              ref={(el) => {
                dots.current[n] = el
              }}
              type="button"
              aria-label={`Story ${n + 1} of ${count}: ${it.headline}`}
              aria-current={n === at}
              onClick={() => jump(n)}
              onKeyDown={(e) => onDotKey(e, n)}
              className="group grid h-5 place-items-center px-[3px] outline-none"
            >
              {/* the dot grows by a layout transform, never a width tween; the others slide aside with it */}
              <motion.span
                layout={!reduced}
                transition={{ layout: { duration: 0.2, ease: EASE } }}
                style={{ borderRadius: 999 }}
                className={cn(
                  "block h-1.5 transition-colors duration-200 motion-reduce:transition-none",
                  n === at
                    ? "w-5 bg-foreground/90"
                    : "w-1.5 bg-foreground/25 group-hover:bg-foreground/45 group-focus-visible:bg-foreground/45",
                )}
              />
            </button>
          ))}
        </span>
      </div>

      {item ? (
        <div
          role="status"
          aria-live={turning ? "off" : "polite"}
          className="relative mt-3 min-h-[108px]"
          onPointerEnter={() => setHeld(true)}
          onPointerLeave={() => setHeld(false)}
        >
          <AnimatePresence mode="wait" initial={false}>
            <motion.div
              key={at}
              initial={reduced ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: 6, filter: "blur(2px)" }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, filter: "blur(0px)" }}
              exit={
                reduced
                  ? { opacity: 0, transition: { duration: 0.12 } }
                  : { opacity: 0, y: -4, filter: "blur(2px)", transition: { duration: 0.15, ease: EASE } }
              }
              transition={{ duration: 0.2, ease: EASE }}
            >
              <div className="text-[11px] text-foreground/45">{item.time}</div>
              <p className="mt-2 text-[14.5px] font-semibold leading-snug text-foreground/90">{item.headline}</p>
              <div className="mt-3 text-[11px] text-foreground/60">{item.source}</div>
            </motion.div>
          </AnimatePresence>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  )
}

```

// ─── components/ui/use-pointed.ts ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react"

/* usePointed: live content runs only while it is being looked at (his call, 2026-10-02:
   "it should start animating only when you start hovering on it; anything with numbers
   that change can start once you hover on the component"). Spread `bind` on the
   component's root; `live` is true while the pointer is on it or focus is inside it, and
   stays true for `linger` ms after it leaves so a pass across the edge does not stop and
   start the feed. On a device with no hover (touch) it is true while the component is at
   least half in view instead, since a finger cannot point without pressing. */
export function usePointed<T extends HTMLElement = HTMLDivElement>({ linger = 600 } = {}) {
  const ref = useRef<T>(null)
  const [pointed, setPointed] = useState(false)
  const [seen, setSeen] = useState(false)
  const [touch] = useState(() => typeof matchMedia === "function" && !matchMedia("(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)").matches)
  const timer = useRef<number | undefined>(undefined)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!touch || !ref.current || typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined") return
    const io = new IntersectionObserver(([e]) => setSeen(e.isIntersecting), { threshold: 0.5 })
    io.observe(ref.current)
    return () => io.disconnect()
  }, [touch])
  useEffect(() => () => window.clearTimeout(timer.current), [])

  const on = () => {
    window.clearTimeout(timer.current)
    setPointed(true)
  }
  const off = () => {
    window.clearTimeout(timer.current)
    timer.current = window.setTimeout(() => setPointed(false), linger)
  }

  return {
    ref,
    live: touch ? seen : pointed,
    bind: {
      onPointerEnter: on,
      onPointerLeave: off,
      onFocus: on,
      onBlur: (e: React.FocusEvent) => {
        if (!e.currentTarget.contains(e.relatedTarget as Node | null)) off()
      },
    },
  }
}
```
