# File Tree (file-tree)
> A file tree for code bundles, data exports and research folders, with folding folders, keyboard navigation and sizes on the right.

// ─── components/ui/file-tree.tsx ───
```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useMemo, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent } from "react"
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"
import { ChevronRight, File, Folder, FolderOpen } from "lucide-react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const SPRING = { type: "spring", stiffness: 400, damping: 32 } as const
/* the accent is the chart token, mixed: a 4.5% wash under the chosen row, a 90% spine */
const accentMix = (pct: number) => `color-mix(in srgb, var(--chart-1, #489ffa) ${pct}%, transparent)`
const ROW = 32
/** ms the pointer rests on a cut-off name before its full path shows */
const REVEAL_MS = 700

export interface FileTreeNode {
  /** what the row shows */
  name: string
  /** unique; selection and expansion are reported by it */
  path: string
  /** present on a folder, even an empty one */
  children?: FileTreeNode[]
  /** the quiet right-hand column: a line count, a size, a note */
  meta?: string
}

const countFiles = (node: FileTreeNode): number =>
  (node.children ?? []).reduce((n, c) => n + (c.children ? countFiles(c) : 1), 0)

/** Folders before files, both alphabetical, the way a repository listing reads.
 *  A folder with no meta of its own reports how many files it holds. */
export function treeFromPaths(files: { path: string; meta?: string }[]): FileTreeNode[] {
  const root: FileTreeNode[] = []
  for (const f of files) {
    const parts = f.path.split("/").filter(Boolean)
    let level = root
    let acc = ""
    parts.forEach((part, i) => {
      acc = acc ? `${acc}/${part}` : part
      const leaf = i === parts.length - 1
      let node = level.find((n) => n.path === acc)
      if (!node) {
        node = leaf ? { name: part, path: acc, meta: f.meta } : { name: part, path: acc, children: [] }
        level.push(node)
      }
      if (!leaf) level = node.children ?? (node.children = [])
    })
  }
  const finish = (nodes: FileTreeNode[]): FileTreeNode[] =>
    nodes
      .map((n) => (n.children ? { ...n, children: finish(n.children), meta: n.meta ?? `${countFiles(n)} files` } : n))
      .sort((a, b) => Number(!!b.children) - Number(!!a.children) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name))
  return finish(root)
}

/* a quant research repo: strategies, their backtests, a month of tick data, fitted models
   and the notebooks that found them; sizes are what such files weigh */
const DEFAULT_NODES: FileTreeNode[] = treeFromPaths([
  { path: "strategies/momentum_xsec.py", meta: "4.2 KB" },
  { path: "strategies/pairs_eth_sol.py", meta: "6.8 KB" },
  { path: "strategies/funding_carry.py", meta: "3.1 KB" },
  { path: "backtests/momo_btc_q3.parquet", meta: "18.4 MB" },
  { path: "backtests/pairs_ethsol_q3.parquet", meta: "9.7 MB" },
  { path: "backtests/tearsheet.csv", meta: "42 KB" },
  { path: "data/ticks/2026-10/BTCUSDT_01.parquet", meta: "1.2 GB" },
  { path: "data/ticks/2026-10/ETHUSDT_01.parquet", meta: "846 MB" },
  { path: "data/ticks/2026-10/SOLUSDT_01.parquet", meta: "312 MB" },
  { path: "data/ohlcv/1h_majors.parquet", meta: "64 MB" },
  { path: "data/funding_2026.csv", meta: "2.3 MB" },
  { path: "models/vol_garch_btc.pkl", meta: "1.8 MB" },
  { path: "models/regime_hmm_v3.joblib", meta: "640 KB" },
  { path: "notebooks/01_signals.ipynb", meta: "3.4 MB" },
  { path: "notebooks/02_slippage.ipynb", meta: "1.1 MB" },
  { path: "universe.yaml", meta: "2 KB" },
])

type Row = { node: FileTreeNode; depth: number; parent: string | null; index: number; count: number }

function flatten(nodes: FileTreeNode[], open: ReadonlySet<string>, depth = 0, parent: string | null = null): Row[] {
  return nodes.flatMap((node, i) => {
    const row: Row = { node, depth, parent, index: i, count: nodes.length }
    return node.children && open.has(node.path) ? [row, ...flatten(node.children, open, depth + 1, node.path)] : [row]
  })
}

/** A bundle read as a tree. Folders fold open under the pointer or the arrow
 *  keys, their branch line growing down as the rows inside arrive, and closing
 *  folds them back up in place. One soft highlight glides between rows rather
 *  than each row lighting on its own; the chosen file carries an accent spine.
 *  The right-hand column is for what a listing usually hides: how much is in
 *  each file, how many files a folder holds.
 *  2026-10-02 audit: the accent was a hard-coded rgb, so the spine and the wash now mix
 *  --chart-1 (90% and 4.5%). The gliding highlight's layoutId carries useId(), so two trees
 *  on one page no longer share one highlight. A name cut off by the column shows its full
 *  path in the library popover after a long rest (700ms) of the pointer or the keyboard
 *  focus, never through a native title. The meta column went from /35 to /45, since it is
 *  why the column exists. The default width is 300 (the parent can still widen it with a
 *  max-w class, as the install panel does). The row and its glide keep their 6px corner:
 *  the tree sits on no surface of its own, so there is no outer corner to nest in.
 *  2026-10-02 round 2: his note was to make it relevant to data and trading. The sample is
 *  now a quant research repo (strategies, backtests, a month of tick data under
 *  data/ticks/2026-10, fitted models, notebooks) with realistic names and file sizes in the
 *  meta column; folders still count their files. Props and behaviour are unchanged. */
export function FileTree({
  nodes = DEFAULT_NODES,
  selected,
  defaultSelected = null,
  onSelect,
  expanded,
  defaultExpanded,
  onExpandedChange,
  label = "Files",
  indent = 16,
  className,
}: {
  nodes?: FileTreeNode[]
  /** controlled: the selected path */
  selected?: string | null
  defaultSelected?: string | null
  onSelect?: (path: string, node: FileTreeNode) => void
  /** controlled: the open folders */
  expanded?: string[]
  /** open on arrival; the first folder when unset */
  defaultExpanded?: string[]
  onExpandedChange?: (paths: string[]) => void
  /** the tree's accessible name */
  label?: string
  /** px per level */
  indent?: number
  className?: string
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const [ownSelected, setOwnSelected] = useState<string | null>(defaultSelected)
  const [ownExpanded, setOwnExpanded] = useState<string[]>(
    () => defaultExpanded ?? nodes.filter((n) => n.children).slice(0, 1).map((n) => n.path),
  )
  const [hot, setHot] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [focused, setFocused] = useState<string | null>(null)
  /* the long-rest reveal of a cut-off name: the row's path and its top inside the tree */
  const [reveal, setReveal] = useState<{ path: string; top: number } | null>(null)
  const revealTimer = useRef<number | undefined>(undefined)
  useEffect(() => () => window.clearTimeout(revealTimer.current), [])
  const uid = useId()
  const tipId = `${uid}-tip`
  const hideReveal = () => {
    window.clearTimeout(revealTimer.current)
    setReveal(null)
  }
  /** wait, then show the full path if the row's name is cut off */
  const armReveal = (button: HTMLElement, path: string) => {
    hideReveal()
    const name = button.querySelector<HTMLElement>("[data-name]")
    const row = button.parentElement
    if (!name || !row || name.scrollWidth <= name.clientWidth) return
    revealTimer.current = window.setTimeout(() => setReveal({ path, top: row.offsetTop }), REVEAL_MS)
  }
  const current = selected === undefined ? ownSelected : selected
  const openList = expanded ?? ownExpanded
  const open = useMemo(() => new Set(openList), [openList])
  const rows = useMemo(() => flatten(nodes, open), [nodes, open])
  /* roving tabindex: one row is reachable by Tab, and it stays a row that
     exists after a fold closes over the one that had it */
  const tabStop = rows.some((r) => r.node.path === focused) ? focused : (rows[0]?.node.path ?? null)

  const setOpen = (next: string[]) => {
    if (expanded === undefined) setOwnExpanded(next)
    onExpandedChange?.(next)
  }
  const toggle = (path: string) => setOpen(open.has(path) ? openList.filter((p) => p !== path) : [...openList, path])
  const choose = (row: Row) => {
    if (selected === undefined) setOwnSelected(row.node.path)
    onSelect?.(row.node.path, row.node)
    if (row.node.children) toggle(row.node.path)
  }
  const focusRow = (path: string, root: HTMLElement | null) => {
    setFocused(path)
    root?.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(`[data-path="${CSS.escape(path)}"]`)?.focus()
  }

  const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>, row: Row) => {
    const root = e.currentTarget.closest("[role=tree]") as HTMLElement | null
    const i = rows.findIndex((r) => r.node.path === row.node.path)
    const prev = rows[i - 1]
    const next = rows[i + 1]
    const folder = !!row.node.children
    const isOpen = open.has(row.node.path)
    const go = (r?: Row) => r && focusRow(r.node.path, root)
    switch (e.key) {
      case "ArrowDown": e.preventDefault(); go(next); break
      case "ArrowUp": e.preventDefault(); go(prev); break
      case "Home": e.preventDefault(); go(rows[0]); break
      case "End": e.preventDefault(); go(rows[rows.length - 1]); break
      case "ArrowRight":
        e.preventDefault()
        if (folder && !isOpen) toggle(row.node.path)
        else if (folder && next?.parent === row.node.path) go(next)
        break
      case "ArrowLeft":
        e.preventDefault()
        if (folder && isOpen) toggle(row.node.path)
        else if (row.parent) focusRow(row.parent, root)
        break
      case "Enter":
      case " ": e.preventDefault(); choose(row); break
    }
  }

  return (
    <div
      role="tree"
      aria-label={label}
      onPointerLeave={() => {
        setHot(null)
        hideReveal()
      }}
      className={cn("relative w-full max-w-[300px] select-none text-[12.5px] text-foreground/70", className)}
    >
      <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
        {rows.map((row) => {
          const { node, depth } = row
          const folder = !!node.children
          const isOpen = folder && open.has(node.path)
          const isSelected = current === node.path
          const lit = hot === node.path
          return (
            <motion.div
              key={node.path}
              initial={reduced ? false : { height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
              animate={{ height: ROW, opacity: 1 }}
              exit={reduced ? { height: 0, opacity: 0, transition: { duration: 0 } } : { height: 0, opacity: 0, transition: { duration: 0.15, ease: EASE } }}
              transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.22, ease: EASE, delay: Math.min(row.index * 0.02, 0.08) }}
              className="relative overflow-hidden"
            >
              {/* hover affordance: one soft highlight that glides between rows (6px corner, see the header) */}
              {lit && (reduced ? (
                <span className="absolute inset-0 rounded-md bg-foreground/[0.04]" />
              ) : (
                <motion.span layoutId={`file-tree-hot-${uid}`} transition={SPRING} className="absolute inset-0 rounded-md bg-foreground/[0.04]" />
              ))}
              {/* branch lines: one per ancestor, so nesting is read from the
                  lines rather than counted from the indent */}
              {Array.from({ length: depth }, (_, k) => (
                <motion.span
                  key={k}
                  aria-hidden
                  initial={reduced ? false : { scaleY: 0 }}
                  animate={{ scaleY: 1 }}
                  transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.3, ease: EASE }}
                  className="absolute top-0 bottom-0 w-px origin-top bg-foreground/[0.06]"
                  style={{ left: 15 + k * indent }}
                />
              ))}
              {isSelected && (
                <span aria-hidden className="absolute left-0 top-1/2 h-4 w-[2px] -translate-y-1/2 rounded-full" style={{ background: accentMix(90) }} />
              )}
              <button
                type="button"
                role="treeitem"
                data-path={node.path}
                aria-level={depth + 1}
                aria-posinset={row.index + 1}
                aria-setsize={row.count}
                aria-selected={isSelected}
                aria-expanded={folder ? isOpen : undefined}
                tabIndex={tabStop === node.path ? 0 : -1}
                aria-describedby={reveal?.path === node.path ? tipId : undefined}
                onFocus={(e) => { setFocused(node.path); setHot(node.path); armReveal(e.currentTarget, node.path) }}
                onBlur={hideReveal}
                onPointerEnter={(e) => { setHot(node.path); if (e.pointerType !== "touch") armReveal(e.currentTarget, node.path) }}
                onPointerLeave={hideReveal}
                onKeyDown={(e) => { hideReveal(); onKey(e, row) }}
                onClick={() => { hideReveal(); choose(row) }}
                className={cn(
                  "relative flex h-8 w-full items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md pr-2.5 text-left transition-colors duration-150",
                  isSelected ? "text-foreground/90" : "hover:text-foreground/90",
                )}
                style={{ paddingLeft: 8 + depth * indent, background: isSelected ? accentMix(4.5) : undefined }}
              >
                <motion.span
                  aria-hidden
                  animate={{ rotate: isOpen ? 90 : 0 }}
                  transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.2, ease: EASE }}
                  className={cn("grid h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 place-items-center text-foreground/35", !folder && "invisible")}
                >
                  <ChevronRight className="h-3 w-3" strokeWidth={2} />
                </motion.span>
                <span aria-hidden className={cn("shrink-0", folder && isOpen ? "text-foreground/70" : "text-foreground/40")}>
                  {folder ? (isOpen ? <FolderOpen className="h-3.5 w-3.5" strokeWidth={1.75} /> : <Folder className="h-3.5 w-3.5" strokeWidth={1.75} />) : <File className="h-3.5 w-3.5" strokeWidth={1.75} />}
                </span>
                <span data-name className={cn("min-w-0 flex-1 truncate", folder && "font-medium")}>{node.name}</span>
                {node.meta && <span className="shrink-0 pl-3 text-[11px] tabular-nums text-foreground/45">{node.meta}</span>}
              </button>
            </motion.div>
          )
        })}
      </AnimatePresence>
      {/* the full path of a cut-off name: the library popover (radius 12, the 8% hairline, a
          6% fill, the popover shadow), above its row, or under it for the first row */}
      {reveal && (
        <span
          id={tipId}
          role="tooltip"
          className="pointer-events-none absolute left-2 z-50 w-max max-w-[calc(100%-16px)] break-all rounded-[12px] border border-foreground/[0.08] px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[11px] leading-[1.4] text-foreground/90"
          style={{
            top: reveal.top === 0 ? ROW + 6 : reveal.top - 6,
            transform: reveal.top === 0 ? undefined : "translateY(-100%)",
            background: "var(--tip-fill, color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 6%, var(--background)))",
            boxShadow: "0 8px 24px var(--card-shadow, rgba(0,0,0,0.35))",
          }}
        >
          {reveal.path}
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

```


# Screen Shuffle (screen-shuffle)
> A stack of product screenshots that rotates the front screen to the back, for SaaS and fintech landing page heroes.

// ─── components/ui/screen-shuffle.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react"
import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { usePointed } from "@/components/ui/use-pointed"

/* 2026-10-02 audit: the stack shuffled on its own every 2.6s from mount; it now rests still
   and shuffles only while the pointer is on it (usePointed; in view on touch), and on a
   click. The sample screens were four raw hex gradients with blue, green, amber and violet
   tints; they are now one ink at five strengths from tokens (the way Project Index draws its
   covers), and a real product shot still goes in through `image`. The screens are 18px
   corners with no outline, a fill only, and the inner panel lost its outline too. The
   "click to shuffle" caption is gone by default: the cursor and the motion say it (`caption`
   still draws one if an install passes it).
   2026-10-02 round 2: a light look, the dark one unchanged. The depth dim was a brightness
   filter, which on a white page turned the back screens grey; it is now a layer of the
   background over each screen at the same strength (14% a slot), so dark reads exactly as
   before (black at k over a screen equals brightness 1 − k) and light washes the back screens
   toward white at 60% of that. In light the screens are white (--ss-step 0, the mocks' 7% step
   in dark) with a quiet 1px outline at 8% ink and a soft drop shadow, the mocks' corner light
   is a softer ink (--ss-ink, half ink into the background), and the top-left sheen, which only
   reads on black, draws in dark only. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const

export interface ShuffleScreen {
  id: string
  /** Product shot URL; falls back to a gradient mock when absent. */
  image?: string
  grad?: string
  tint?: string
}

/** a sample screen: one soft light of ink from a corner over the surface step (7% in dark,
 *  white in light); --ss-ink and --ss-step fall back to the dark values where they are not set */
const mock = (at: string, ink: number) =>
  `radial-gradient(120% 140% at ${at}, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ss-ink, var(--foreground)) ${ink}%, transparent), transparent 60%), color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) var(--ss-step, 7%), var(--background))`
const tint = (ink: number) => `color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) ${ink}%, transparent)`

const DEFAULT_SCREENS: ShuffleScreen[] = [
  { id: "overview", grad: mock("20% 10%", 16), tint: tint(40) },
  { id: "markets", grad: mock("80% 15%", 13), tint: tint(34) },
  { id: "reports", grad: mock("30% 85%", 11), tint: tint(28) },
  { id: "billing", grad: mock("70% 80%", 9), tint: tint(24) },
  { id: "settings", grad: mock("50% 0%", 12), tint: tint(30) },
]

const SX = 26 // per-slot x offset
const SY = 20 // per-slot y offset
const SCALE = 0.055 // per-slot shrink

/**
 * A stacked-screens loop as a live component: screens hold a 3D-ish stack;
 * while it is pointed at, every few seconds the front one arcs out to the right
 * and settles at the back while the rest step forward. Click advances immediately. Depth is
 * scale + blur + dim, no real z. Pass `image` per screen for real product
 * shots; the default slots are gradient mocks.
 */
export function ScreenShuffle({
  screens = DEFAULT_SCREENS,
  stepMs = 2600,
  caption,
  className,
}: {
  screens?: ShuffleScreen[]
  /** Auto-advance interval while pointed at; ignored when the user prefers reduced motion. */
  stepMs?: number
  /** a line under the stack; none by default */
  caption?: string
  className?: string
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const [step, setStep] = useState(0)
  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | undefined>(undefined)
  const { ref, live, bind } = usePointed<HTMLButtonElement>()
  const n = screens.length

  useEffect(() => {
    if (reduced || !live) return
    timer.current = setInterval(() => setStep((s) => s + 1), stepMs)
    return () => clearInterval(timer.current)
  }, [reduced, stepMs, live])

  return (
    <button
      ref={ref}
      {...bind}
      type="button"
      aria-label="Advance the screen stack"
      onClick={() => setStep((s) => s + 1)}
      className={cn(
        "relative h-[300px] w-full max-w-[520px] cursor-pointer [--ss-ink:color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_50%,var(--background))] [--ss-step:0%] dark:[--ss-ink:var(--foreground)] dark:[--ss-step:7%]",
        className,
      )}
      style={{ perspective: 1200 }}
    >
      {screens.map((screen, i) => {
        const slot = (((i - step) % n) + n) % n
        const front = slot === 0
        return (
          <motion.div
            key={screen.id}
            className="absolute left-1/2 top-1/2 w-[360px] overflow-hidden rounded-[18px] shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--light-outline,color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_10%,transparent)),0_14px_32px_-14px_rgba(0,0,0,0.2)] dark:shadow-[0_0_0_1px_color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_12%,transparent)]"
            style={{ aspectRatio: "1495 / 1024", transformOrigin: "50% 60%" }}
            animate={{
              x: `calc(-50% + ${slot * SX}px)`,
              y: `calc(-50% - ${slot * SY}px)`,
              scale: 1 - slot * SCALE,
              rotateZ: (slot - (n - 1) / 2) * 1.2,
              filter: `blur(${slot * 0.7}px)`,
              zIndex: n - slot,
            }}
            transition={
              reduced
                ? { duration: 0 }
                : front
                  ? { duration: 0.8, ease: EASE } // arriving at the front
                  : { duration: 0.7, ease: EASE, delay: 0.08 }
            }
          >
            {screen.image ? (
              <img src={screen.image} alt="" className="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full object-cover" draggable={false} />
            ) : (
              /* gradient mock screen — chrome bar + skeleton content */
              <div className="absolute inset-0" style={{ background: screen.grad }}>
                <div className="flex h-[14%] items-center gap-1.5 border-b border-foreground/[0.05] px-[5%]">
                  <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-foreground/20" />
                  <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-foreground/12" />
                  <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-foreground/12" />
                  <span className="ml-3 h-[22%] w-[26%] rounded-full bg-foreground/[0.08]" />
                </div>
                <div className="flex h-[86%] gap-[4%] p-[5%]">
                  <div className="flex w-[30%] flex-col gap-[8%]">
                    <span className="h-[9%] w-full rounded-full" style={{ background: screen.tint }} />
                    <span className="h-[9%] w-4/5 rounded-full bg-foreground/[0.10]" />
                    <span className="h-[9%] w-3/5 rounded-full bg-foreground/[0.07]" />
                    <span className="h-[9%] w-4/6 rounded-full bg-foreground/[0.05]" />
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex-1 rounded-[10px] bg-foreground/[0.06]" />
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
            <span
              className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 hidden dark:block"
              style={{ background: "linear-gradient(160deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 5%, transparent), transparent 40%)" }}
            />
            {/* depth: the background laid over the screen, 14% a slot (60% of that in light) */}
            <span className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 opacity-60 dark:opacity-100">
              <motion.span
                className="absolute inset-0 bg-background"
                initial={false}
                animate={{ opacity: slot * 0.14 }}
                transition={
                  reduced ? { duration: 0 } : front ? { duration: 0.8, ease: EASE } : { duration: 0.7, ease: EASE, delay: 0.08 }
                }
              />
            </span>
          </motion.div>
        )
      })}
      {caption && <span className="absolute bottom-1 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 text-[11px] text-foreground/45">{caption}</span>}
    </button>
  )
}
```

// ─── components/ui/use-pointed.ts ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react"

/* usePointed: live content runs only while it is being looked at (his call, 2026-10-02:
   "it should start animating only when you start hovering on it; anything with numbers
   that change can start once you hover on the component"). Spread `bind` on the
   component's root; `live` is true while the pointer is on it or focus is inside it, and
   stays true for `linger` ms after it leaves so a pass across the edge does not stop and
   start the feed. On a device with no hover (touch) it is true while the component is at
   least half in view instead, since a finger cannot point without pressing. */
export function usePointed<T extends HTMLElement = HTMLDivElement>({ linger = 600 } = {}) {
  const ref = useRef<T>(null)
  const [pointed, setPointed] = useState(false)
  const [seen, setSeen] = useState(false)
  const [touch] = useState(() => typeof matchMedia === "function" && !matchMedia("(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)").matches)
  const timer = useRef<number | undefined>(undefined)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!touch || !ref.current || typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined") return
    const io = new IntersectionObserver(([e]) => setSeen(e.isIntersecting), { threshold: 0.5 })
    io.observe(ref.current)
    return () => io.disconnect()
  }, [touch])
  useEffect(() => () => window.clearTimeout(timer.current), [])

  const on = () => {
    window.clearTimeout(timer.current)
    setPointed(true)
  }
  const off = () => {
    window.clearTimeout(timer.current)
    timer.current = window.setTimeout(() => setPointed(false), linger)
  }

  return {
    ref,
    live: touch ? seen : pointed,
    bind: {
      onPointerEnter: on,
      onPointerLeave: off,
      onFocus: on,
      onBlur: (e: React.FocusEvent) => {
        if (!e.currentTarget.contains(e.relatedTarget as Node | null)) off()
      },
    },
  }
}
```

# Mouse-Trail CTA (mouse-trail-cta)
> A call to action button whose glow is fed by a cursor particle trail, for the landing page hero of an AI or fintech product.

// ─── components/ui/mouse-trail-cta.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useEffect, useRef } from "react"
import { useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { BUTTON_PRIMARY } from "@/components/ui/control-classes"

/* 2026-10-02 audit: the button was an outlined 60px-corner pill that wiped a fill up on hover
   and glowed blue (a border colour, an accent box-shadow glow and an inset accent ring at
   once). It is now the library's one white primary (BUTTON_PRIMARY at h-12 px-6, 14px
   medium, fully round) with one elevation: the charge the particles bring only brightens a
   1px top highlight in the accent, so the ring and the glow are gone. The particles are ink
   (the foreground, read from the stage) instead of blue and white, so the accent stays a
   small part of the field.
   2026-10-02 round 2: the default label is "Open an account", the step a broker or exchange
   asks for, instead of a generic SaaS free trial. */

type Particle = { x: number; y: number; vx: number; vy: number; born: number; size: number }

const LIFE_MS = 600
const GRAVITY_R = 140
const SPAWN_GAP_MS = 28

/**
 * A CTA stage where the cursor leaves a restrained particle trail (1–2px
 * ink dots with a soft halo, 0.6s decay). Near the button the dots gravitate
 * toward it and brighten its top highlight — signal language, no glitter.
 * Honors reduced motion by rendering a static pill.
 */
export function MouseTrailCta({
  label = "Open an account",
  href = "#",
  className,
  onClick,
}: {
  label?: string
  href?: string
  className?: string
  onClick?: () => void
}) {
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null)
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement | null>(null)
  const pillRef = useRef<HTMLAnchorElement | null>(null)
  const reduced = useReducedMotion() ?? false

  useEffect(() => {
    if (reduced) return
    const root = rootRef.current
    const canvas = canvasRef.current
    const pill = pillRef.current
    if (!root || !canvas || !pill) return
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d")
    if (!ctx) return

    let raf = 0
    let running = false
    let onScreen = true
    let lastSpawn = 0
    let charge = 0 // 0..1 — particles arriving at the pill feed this
    const particles: Particle[] = []
    /* the ink: the stage's own text colour (text-foreground), read when a run starts so a
       theme change between runs is picked up; canvas takes any CSS colour, alpha goes on globalAlpha */
    let ink = getComputedStyle(root).color

    const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2)
    const resize = () => {
      const r = root.getBoundingClientRect()
      canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(r.width * dpr))
      canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(r.height * dpr))
    }
    resize()
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(resize)
    ro.observe(root)

    const pillCenter = () => {
      const rr = root.getBoundingClientRect()
      const pr = pill.getBoundingClientRect()
      return { x: pr.left - rr.left + pr.width / 2, y: pr.top - rr.top + pr.height / 2, rx: pr.width / 2 }
    }

    /* the charge brightens the button's 1px top highlight, in the accent, up to 70% */
    const applyCharge = () => {
      const t = charge
      pill.style.boxShadow =
        t > 0.02 ? `inset 0 1px 0 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--chart-1, #489ffa) ${Math.round(70 * t)}%, transparent)` : ""
    }

    const tick = (now: number) => {
      raf = 0
      const w = canvas.width / dpr
      const h = canvas.height / dpr
      ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0)
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h)
      ctx.fillStyle = ink

      const c = pillCenter()
      for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const p = particles[i]
        const age = (now - p.born) / LIFE_MS
        if (age >= 1) {
          particles.splice(i, 1)
          continue
        }
        const dx = c.x - p.x
        const dy = c.y - p.y
        const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy)
        if (d < GRAVITY_R && d > 1) {
          const pull = (1 - d / GRAVITY_R) * 0.9
          p.vx += (dx / d) * pull
          p.vy += (dy / d) * pull
        }
        if (d < c.rx + 10) {
          charge = Math.min(1, charge + 0.08)
          particles.splice(i, 1)
          continue
        }
        p.vx *= 0.92
        p.vy *= 0.92
        p.x += p.vx
        p.y += p.vy
        const fade = 1 - age
        // a soft halo + a crisp core, both ink
        ctx.beginPath()
        ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * 2.4, 0, Math.PI * 2)
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.12 * fade
        ctx.fill()
        ctx.beginPath()
        ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * 0.75, 0, Math.PI * 2)
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.85 * fade
        ctx.fill()
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1

      charge = Math.max(0, charge - 0.012)
      applyCharge()

      if (onScreen && (particles.length > 0 || charge > 0.01)) raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick)
      else running = false
    }

    const ensureLoop = () => {
      if (!running && onScreen) {
        running = true
        ink = getComputedStyle(root).color
        raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick)
      }
    }

    const onMove = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      const now = performance.now()
      if (now - lastSpawn < SPAWN_GAP_MS) return
      lastSpawn = now
      const r = root.getBoundingClientRect()
      particles.push({
        x: e.clientX - r.left + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 6,
        y: e.clientY - r.top + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 6,
        vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4,
        vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4,
        born: now,
        size: Math.random() < 0.5 ? 1 : 2,
      })
      if (particles.length > 80) particles.shift()
      ensureLoop()
    }

    const io = new IntersectionObserver(([entry]) => {
      onScreen = entry.isIntersecting
      if (!onScreen && raf) {
        cancelAnimationFrame(raf)
        raf = 0
        running = false
      } else if (onScreen) ensureLoop()
    })
    io.observe(root)
    root.addEventListener("pointermove", onMove)

    return () => {
      root.removeEventListener("pointermove", onMove)
      io.disconnect()
      ro.disconnect()
      if (raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf)
    }
  }, [reduced])

  return (
    <div
      ref={rootRef}
      className={cn("relative flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden text-foreground", className)}
    >
      <canvas ref={canvasRef} className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 h-full w-full" aria-hidden />
      <a ref={pillRef} href={href} onClick={onClick} className={cn(BUTTON_PRIMARY, "relative z-10 w-auto px-6")}>
        {label}
      </a>
    </div>
  )
}

```

```tsx
/* Control classes: the library's control material for components that ship on their own
   (2026-10-02, the audit's pattern 11). src/components/library/controls.ts is the site's
   copy; components used to paste its look in as a flat 8% fill "so the file ships alone",
   and those copies never turned white on a raised light surface. These read the same
   tokens WITH a fallback, so they follow the site's raised-surface rule here and still

   that imports it (scripts/build-registry.mjs bundles ui helpers automatically).

/** the one loud button of a form: 48px, full width, the foreground filled (the dashboards'

/** a component's own card, field or block (spec 14.8). Dark: a #121212 fill on black. Light
```

# Project Index (project-index)
> A list of companies or projects where each row shows its cover beside the cursor on hover, for fund portfolios and case study pages.

// ─── components/ui/project-index.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react"
import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

/* Project Index, rebuilt through the ssych-component skill (2026-09-29).
   What changed against the version before it (in git history), and why:
   · the floating cover has no outline and no shadow, and its corner is 8px
   · the sample covers are one ink at four strengths from tokens; they were blue, green,
     amber and purple written as hex and rgb
   · pointing at a row dims the whole of every other row to 0.35, not only its title
   · the list names itself to a screen reader, each row carries its own label, and a row
     reached by keyboard shows its cover beside it
   · the arrow is drawn, not a text glyph; row rules are 1px at 5% ink
   · hover changes are 200ms and under, every figure tabular from the root
   Props are the same.
   2026-10-02 audit: the tag went from /45 to /60 and the year from /35 to /45, so the text that
   is read clears the readable step. The cover keeps its 8px corner with the 4px block 8% in:
   it is art with no frame, so there is no outer corner for it to nest in.
   2026-10-02 round 2: his note was to fit the trading idea, maybe a company portfolio. The
   sample is now a portfolio of holdings: the company, its ticker, its sector, the year the
   position was opened and its return since, signed and in its hue (green up, red down). The
   floating cover draws the position's own price line, edge to edge along its bottom with a
   faint area under it, the ticker and the return over it. New optional fields on an item:
   `ticker`, `change` (percent) and `series` (prices, oldest first); new prop `label` (the
   list's name for a screen reader, "Holdings"). Old items with only title, tag and year draw
   as before.
   Formulas:
   · return since opened = (last − first of the series) ÷ first × 100, unless `change` is given
   · cover line          the series scaled to the cover: its low 12% above the bottom edge,
                         its high 40% down from the top
   2026-10-02 round 2: a light look, the dark one unchanged. In light the floating cover is white
   with a quiet 1px outline at 8% ink and a soft drop shadow (it had no edge on a white page),
   and the sample covers' corner light is drawn in a softer ink (--pi-ink, 30% ink into the
   background) so it reads as a faint grey tint instead of a dark smudge. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const LAYOUT_SPRING = { type: "spring", stiffness: 400, damping: 32 } as const

export interface ProjectIndexItem {
  title: string
  tag: string
  year: string
  /** the ticker, read beside the title */
  ticker?: string
  /** the return in percent; derived from `series` when absent */
  change?: number
  /** prices since it was opened, oldest first: the row's return is worked from them */
  series?: number[]
  /** today's prices, oldest first: the cover draws them as its 1D line (his call, 2026-10-02:
   *  "make them say one day chart"); the cover falls back to `series` without them */
  day?: number[]
  href?: string
  /** Cover image URL; falls back to `grad` (a CSS background) when absent. */
  image?: string
  grad?: string
}

/** a seeded path from one price to another; the wobble is pinned to nothing at both ends */
function bridge(start: number, end: number, seed: number, n = 40, wobble = 0.12) {
  let s = seed
  let drift = 0
  const out: number[] = []
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    s = (s * 16807) % 2147483647
    const t = i / (n - 1)
    drift = drift * 0.8 + (s / 2147483647 - 0.5) * wobble * Math.max(start, end)
    out.push(start + (end - start) * t + drift * Math.sin(Math.PI * t))
  }
  return out
}

/** a position from 100 at the open to 100 × (1 + return) now */
const held = (ret: number, seed: number) => bridge(100, 100 * (1 + ret / 100), seed)
/** one trading day from 100 to 100 × (1 + the day's move), a finer wobble */
const today = (move: number, seed: number) => bridge(100, 100 * (1 + move / 100), seed, 48, 0.012)

const DEFAULT_ITEMS: ProjectIndexItem[] = [
  { title: "NVIDIA", ticker: "NVDA", tag: "Semiconductors", year: "2021", series: held(412.6, 7), day: today(2.1, 41) },
  { title: "Coinbase", ticker: "COIN", tag: "Crypto exchange", year: "2023", series: held(238.4, 11), day: today(-1.4, 43) },
  { title: "JPMorgan Chase", ticker: "JPM", tag: "Banking", year: "2019", series: held(118.2, 19), day: today(0.6, 47) },
  { title: "Intuitive Surgical", ticker: "ISRG", tag: "Medical robotics", year: "2020", series: held(71.3, 23), day: today(0.9, 53) },
  { title: "Adyen", ticker: "ADYEN", tag: "Payments", year: "2024", series: held(-8.6, 31), day: today(-0.8, 59) },
]

const GREEN = "var(--chart-up)"
const RED = "var(--chart-down)"
/** a hue as text: its lightness is capped in the light theme so small figures stay readable */
const ink = (c: string) => `oklch(from ${c} min(l, var(--ink-l, 1)) c h)`
/** the return: the given one, else the series' first to last */
const returnOf = (r: ProjectIndexItem) =>
  r.change ?? (r.series && r.series.length > 1 && r.series[0] ? ((r.series[r.series.length - 1] - r.series[0]) / r.series[0]) * 100 : undefined)
const signedPct = (v: number) => `${v >= 0 ? "+" : "−"}${Math.abs(v).toFixed(1)}%`

/** the cover's chart: the series edge to edge, its low at 88% of the height, its high at 40% */
function coverLine(series: number[], w: number, h: number) {
  const lo = Math.min(...series)
  const hi = Math.max(...series)
  const span = Math.max(1e-9, hi - lo)
  const pts = series.map((v, i) => [(i / (series.length - 1)) * w, h * 0.88 - ((v - lo) / span) * h * 0.48] as const)
  const line = pts.map(([x, y], i) => `${i ? "L" : "M"} ${x.toFixed(2)} ${y.toFixed(2)}`).join(" ")
  return { line, area: `${line} L ${w} ${h} L 0 ${h} Z` }
}

const COVER_W = 220
const MAX_W = 560

/**
 * Project index: bare rows of title, tag and year. The cover only exists while a row is
 * pointed at, floating beside the cursor, and the other rows step back.
 */
export function ProjectIndex({
  items = DEFAULT_ITEMS,
  label = "Holdings",
  className,
}: {
  items?: ProjectIndexItem[]
  /** the list's name for a screen reader */
  label?: string
  className?: string
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion()
  const wrap = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const [hover, setHover] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const [pos, setPos] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 })
  /* the rows rise in once, 40ms apart and capped at eight; after that the dim is quick */
  const [landed, setLanded] = useState(false)
  useEffect(() => {
    const t = setTimeout(() => setLanded(true), reduced ? 0 : Math.min(items.length, 8) * 40 + 320)
    return () => clearTimeout(t)
  }, [reduced, items.length])

  const onMove = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    const el = wrap.current
    const r = el?.getBoundingClientRect()
    if (!el || !r) return
    /* the pointer is in screen pixels, the cover is placed in the list's own: a scaled preview
       would otherwise leave the cover short of the cursor (2026-10-02) */
    const k = r.width / (el.offsetWidth || r.width) || 1
    setPos({ x: (e.clientX - r.left) / k, y: (e.clientY - r.top) / k })
  }

  return (
    <div
      ref={wrap}
      onPointerMove={onMove}
      onPointerLeave={() => setHover(null)}
      className={cn("relative w-full max-w-[560px] tabular-nums [--ink-l:0.5] [--pi-ink:color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_30%,var(--background))] dark:[--ink-l:1] dark:[--pi-ink:var(--foreground)]", className)}
      role="group"
      aria-label={`${label}, ${items.length}`}
    >
      {items.map((r, i) => {
        const ret = returnOf(r)
        return (
        <motion.a
          key={r.title}
          initial={reduced ? false : { opacity: 0, y: 6 }}
          animate={{ opacity: hover !== null && hover !== i ? 0.35 : 1, y: 0 }}
          transition={
            reduced
              ? { duration: 0.2 }
              : landed
                ? { duration: 0.2, ease: EASE }
                : { duration: 0.3, ease: EASE, delay: Math.min(i, 7) * 0.04 }
          }
          whileTap={reduced ? undefined : { scale: 0.99 }}
          href={r.href ?? "#"}
          aria-label={[r.title, r.ticker, r.tag, r.year, ret !== undefined ? `${signedPct(ret)} since` : null].filter(Boolean).join(", ")}
          onClick={r.href ? undefined : (e) => e.preventDefault()}
          onPointerEnter={() => setHover(i)}
          onFocus={(e) => {
            const el = e.currentTarget
            setHover(i)
            setPos({ x: MAX_W, y: el.offsetTop + el.offsetHeight / 2 })
          }}
          onBlur={() => setHover(null)}
          className={cn(
            "group flex items-baseline gap-4 border-t border-foreground/[0.05] py-4 outline-none last:border-b",
          )}
        >
          <span className="shrink-0 text-[19px] font-semibold text-foreground/90">{r.title}</span>
          {r.ticker && <span className="shrink-0 text-[11px] font-medium text-foreground/45">{r.ticker}</span>}
          <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-[12px] text-foreground/60">{r.tag}</span>
          <span className="text-[11px] tabular-nums text-foreground/45">{r.year}</span>
          {ret !== undefined && (
            <span className="w-[60px] shrink-0 text-right text-[12px] font-medium tabular-nums" style={{ color: ink(ret >= 0 ? GREEN : RED) }}>
              {signedPct(ret)}
            </span>
          )}
          <svg
            aria-hidden
            width="12"
            height="12"
            viewBox="0 0 12 12"
            fill="none"
            className="shrink-0 self-center text-foreground/35 transition-[transform,translate,scale,rotate,color] duration-200 group-hover:translate-x-1 group-hover:text-foreground/90 group-focus-visible:translate-x-1 group-focus-visible:text-foreground/90 motion-reduce:transition-none"
            style={{ transitionTimingFunction: "cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)" }}
          >
            <path d="M2 6h8M6.5 2.5 10 6l-3.5 3.5" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
          </svg>
        </motion.a>
        )
      })}

      {/* floating cover, only alive while a row is pointed at */}
      <motion.div
        aria-hidden
        className="pointer-events-none absolute left-0 top-0 z-10 aspect-[4/3] overflow-hidden rounded-[16px] bg-background shadow-[0_0_0_1px_color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_8%,transparent),0_12px_28px_-12px_rgba(0,0,0,0.18)] dark:bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_9%,var(--background))] dark:shadow-none"
        style={{ width: COVER_W }}
        initial={false}
        animate={{
          x: Math.min(pos.x + 24, MAX_W - COVER_W - 4),
          y: pos.y - 70,
          opacity: hover !== null ? 1 : 0,
          scale: hover !== null ? 1 : 0.96,
        }}
        transition={reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { ...LAYOUT_SPRING, opacity: { duration: 0.2, ease: EASE } }}
      >
        {items.map((r, i) => (
          /* moving between rows cross-fades the covers, 150ms */
          <div
            key={r.title}
            className="absolute inset-0 transition-opacity duration-150"
            /* no gradient behind a chart cover (his call, 2026-10-02): the cover's own lighter ground */
            style={{ opacity: hover === i ? 1 : 0, background: r.series || r.day ? undefined : r.grad }}
          >
            {r.image ? (
              <img src={r.image} alt="" className="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full object-cover" draggable={false} />
            ) : ((r.day ?? r.series)?.length ?? 0) > 1 ? (
              <CoverChart item={r} />
            ) : (
              <>
                {/* skeleton chrome so the gradient reads as a product cover */}
                <span className="absolute left-[8%] top-[10%] h-[6%] w-[34%] rounded-full bg-foreground/[0.16]" />
                <span className="absolute left-[8%] top-[24%] h-[5%] w-[52%] rounded-full bg-foreground/[0.08]" />
                <span className="absolute inset-x-[8%] bottom-[10%] top-[42%] rounded-[4px] bg-background/25" />
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        ))}
      </motion.div>
    </div>
  )
}

const COVER_H = (COVER_W * 3) / 4

/** the cover: the position's 1D line edge to edge along the bottom, plain, no fill under it
 *  (his call, 2026-10-02), the ticker with "1D" and the day's move over it.
 *  · day's move = (last − first) ÷ first × 100 of `day` (of `series` when there is no day) */
function CoverChart({ item }: { item: ProjectIndexItem }) {
  const daily = !!item.day
  const series = item.day ?? item.series ?? []
  const move = series.length > 1 && series[0] ? ((series[series.length - 1] - series[0]) / series[0]) * 100 : (returnOf(item) ?? 0)
  const { line } = coverLine(series, COVER_W, COVER_H)
  const hue = move >= 0 ? GREEN : RED
  return (
    <>
      <span className="absolute left-3 top-2.5 flex items-baseline gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-foreground/60">
        {item.ticker ?? item.title}
        {daily && <span className="font-normal text-foreground/45">1D</span>}
      </span>
      <span className="absolute right-3 top-2.5 text-[11px] font-medium" style={{ color: ink(hue) }}>
        {signedPct(move)}
      </span>
      <svg aria-hidden className="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full" viewBox={`0 0 ${COVER_W} ${COVER_H}`} preserveAspectRatio="none">
        <path d={line} fill="none" stroke={hue} strokeWidth={1.5} strokeLinejoin="round" strokeLinecap="round" vectorEffect="non-scaling-stroke" />
      </svg>
    </>
  )
}
```

# macOS Dock (macos-dock)
> A macOS style app dock with magnifying icons and a ⌘K command menu, for launchers and workspace switchers in trading and AI tools.

// ─── components/ui/mac-os-dock.tsx ───
```tsx
"use client"

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react"
import {
  AnimatePresence,
  motion,
  useAnimationControls,
  useMotionValue,
  useReducedMotion,
  useSpring,
  useTransform,
  type MotionValue,
} from "motion/react"
import { Check } from "lucide-react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { RAISED } from "@/components/ui/control-classes"

/** Command Dock — macOS-style magnifying dock. Cursor distance drives per-icon
 *  size (44→56px raised-cosine springs), a hairline tooltip chip sits above the
 *  hovered tool, icons bounce on click, and a
 *  ⌘K slot at the end opens a small command menu. Light and dark via theme
 *  tokens; the default items are CSS-drawn tiles — swap in your own via props.
 *  2026-10-02 audit: the tooltip was capitals with an outline, a shadow and an arrow; it is
 *  now a sentence case 11px /90 pill in the popover fill with the 8% hairline only. The tray
 *  was a gradient with two inset rings, a specular line and a drop shadow; it is now the 7%
 *  surface with one soft shadow, and its corner nests: 22 = the icons' 10 + the 12px pad.
 *  The ⌘K menu's commands only closed it; it now lists the dock's own tools (each one runs
 *  onSelect, as a click on its icon does, and the keys 1 to 9 pick them while it is open)
 *  and Copy link, which copies the page address and shows a tick. Its shortcuts are bare
 *  text, it closes on Escape and on a press outside, and the icons are typed buttons that
 *  follow pointer events.
 *  2026-10-02 round 2: his notes were to put it on topic and to bring back a bit of the old
 *  detail, the sheen and the lighting, keeping the new roundness. The default tools are a
 *  trader's and analyst's dock now: Terminal, Charts, Research, Wallet, Copilot and Alerts,
 *  each a drawn glyph on its own tile. The tray keeps its 22 corner and gets its light back:
 *  a top to bottom gradient (10% to 6% ink over the page), a 12% inset line along the top
 *  edge and the specular streak across the lip (35% ink at its middle, fading to nothing at
 *  both ends, inset 24px so it never meets the curve). Each tile is lit the same way: a white
 *  sheen over its top half and an inset highlight on its top edge with a soft shade under
 *  its bottom edge. No outline comes back. Props and behaviour are unchanged. */

const EASE = [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] as const
const FAR = 99999
const REST = 44
const PEAK = 56 // keep the magnify subtle — icons shouldn't balloon
const RADIUS = 110 // px of cursor influence on either side of an icon
/** Apple's icon grid: the squircle covers ~82% of its tile and the remaining
 *  ~9% a side is transparent margin — every shipped macOS icon is drawn that
 *  way. The plates the dock draws itself (the gradient tiles and the ⌘K slot)
 *  sit on the same grid, otherwise they read a fifth larger than any real
 *  artwork standing next to them. */
const PLATE = "82%"
/** icons are lit from above and float off the tray floor — traces the artwork's
 *  alpha, so transparent-margin PNG/WebP icons cast the right silhouette */
/* lighter and flatter (his call, 2026-10-02: "the shadows are too strong, make the dock feel
   flatter"): one short soft shadow instead of two deep ones */
const ICON_SHADOW = "drop-shadow(0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,calc(0.16 * var(--shadow-k, 1))))"

export type DockApp = {
  id: string
  label: string
  /** any node — an <img>, an svg, or the built-in gradient tiles */
  icon: ReactNode
}

/** app tile: one neutral graphite plate in the theme's ink, the glyph in light ink (his call,
 *  2026-10-04: the brand-coloured tiles were too colourful; 2026-10-02: flat, no gradient,
 *  sheen or lit edge). Only the running dot and the menu say which app is which. */
function Tile({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <span aria-hidden className="flex h-full w-full items-center justify-center">
      <span
        /* light: raised fills inside the darker bar go white, as the ⌘K key does */
        className="relative flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-[22%] bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_11%,var(--background))] text-foreground/85 light:bg-white"
        style={{ width: PLATE, height: PLATE }}
      >
        <span className="relative flex">{children}</span>
      </span>
    </span>
  )
}

const glyph = { fill: "none", stroke: "currentColor", strokeWidth: 1.7, strokeLinecap: "round" as const }

/** demo tools: a trader's and analyst's dock, six tiles in the theme's ink */
const DEFAULT_ITEMS: DockApp[] = [
  {
    id: "terminal",
    label: "Terminal",
    icon: (
      <Tile>
        <svg width={18} height={18} viewBox="0 0 22 22" {...glyph}>
          <path d="M6 7 L 10.5 11 L 6 15" />
          <line x1={12.5} y1={15.5} x2={16.5} y2={15.5} />
        </svg>
      </Tile>
    ),
  },
  {
    id: "charts",
    label: "Charts",
    icon: (
      <Tile>
        <svg width={18} height={18} viewBox="0 0 22 22" {...glyph}>
          <line x1={6} y1={4.5} x2={6} y2={17.5} />
          <rect x={4.5} y={7.5} width={3} height={6} rx={0.6} />
          <line x1={11} y1={3.5} x2={11} y2={15.5} />
          <rect x={9.5} y={5.5} width={3} height={7} rx={0.6} />
          <line x1={16} y1={6.5} x2={16} y2={18.5} />
          <rect x={14.5} y={9.5} width={3} height={6} rx={0.6} />
        </svg>
      </Tile>
    ),
  },
  {
    id: "research",
    label: "Research",
    icon: (
      <Tile>
        <svg width={18} height={18} viewBox="0 0 22 22" {...glyph}>
          <circle cx={10} cy={10} r={5.5} />
          <line x1={14} y1={14} x2={18} y2={18} />
          <path d="M7.5 11.5 L 9.2 9.6 L 10.6 10.8 L 12.5 8.4" />
        </svg>
      </Tile>
    ),
  },
  {
    id: "wallet",
    label: "Wallet",
    icon: (
      <Tile>
        <svg width={18} height={18} viewBox="0 0 22 22" {...glyph}>
          <path d="M4.5 7.5 h11.5 a1.5 1.5 0 0 1 1.5 1.5 v7 a1.5 1.5 0 0 1 -1.5 1.5 h-10 a1.5 1.5 0 0 1 -1.5 -1.5 z" />
          <path d="M4.5 7.5 V 6.5 a1.5 1.5 0 0 1 1.5 -1.5 h8" />
          <circle cx={14.5} cy={12.5} r={1} />
        </svg>
      </Tile>
    ),
  },
  {
    id: "copilot",
    label: "Copilot",
    icon: (
      <Tile>
        <svg width={18} height={18} viewBox="0 0 22 22" {...glyph}>
          <path d="M11 3.5 C 11.6 8, 14 10.4, 18.5 11 C 14 11.6, 11.6 14, 11 18.5 C 10.4 14, 8 11.6, 3.5 11 C 8 10.4, 10.4 8, 11 3.5 Z" />
        </svg>
      </Tile>
    ),
  },
  {
    id: "alerts",
    label: "Alerts",
    icon: (
      <Tile>
        <svg width={18} height={18} viewBox="0 0 22 22" {...glyph}>
          <path d="M6 15 V 10 a5 5 0 0 1 10 0 V 15 l1.3 1.3 H 4.7 Z" />
          <path d="M9.3 18.5 a1.9 1.9 0 0 0 3.4 0" />
        </svg>
      </Tile>
    ),
  },
]

const MENU_ITEM =
  "flex w-full items-center justify-between rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 text-left text-[12px] text-foreground/80 outline-none transition-colors duration-150 hover:bg-foreground/[0.05] hover:text-foreground focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.05]"

/** the popover fill (spec 14.6): 6% foreground over the page */
const POPOVER_BG = "var(--tip-fill, color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 6%, var(--background)))"

function DockItem({
  mouseX,
  reduce,
  label,
  hovered,
  active = false,
  onEnter,
  onClick,
  children,
}: {
  mouseX: MotionValue<number>
  reduce: boolean
  label: string
  hovered: boolean
  active?: boolean
  onEnter: () => void
  onClick?: () => void
  children: ReactNode
}) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null)
  const dist = useTransform(mouseX, (x: number) => {
    const r = ref.current?.getBoundingClientRect()
    return r ? x - (r.x + r.width / 2) : FAR
  })
  // authentic macOS magnification: a raised-cosine bell over the influence
  // window, not a linear tent — neighbors ease in/out of the peak
  const raw = useTransform(dist, (d: number) => {
    const t = Math.min(1, Math.abs(d) / RADIUS)
    return REST + (PEAK - REST) * ((1 + Math.cos(Math.PI * t)) / 2)
  })
  const size = useSpring(raw, { mass: 0.1, stiffness: 240, damping: 18 })
  // macOS click bounce — the icon hops off the tray floor and settles back
  const bounce = useAnimationControls()
  const click = () => {
    if (!reduce) void bounce.start({ y: [0, -12, 0], transition: { duration: 0.4, ease: EASE } })
    onClick?.()
  }

  return (
    <button
      ref={ref}
      type="button"
      aria-label={label}
      onPointerEnter={onEnter}
      onFocus={onEnter}
      onClick={click}
      className="relative flex flex-col items-center outline-none"
    >
      <motion.span
        animate={bounce}
        style={{ width: reduce ? REST : size, height: reduce ? REST : size, filter: ICON_SHADOW }}
        className="relative z-10 block overflow-hidden rounded-[10px]"
      >
        {children}
      </motion.span>
      {/* running-app dot — macOS marks the active tool under its icon */}
      {active && (
        <span
          aria-hidden
          className="absolute -bottom-[1px] left-1/2 z-10 h-[3px] w-[3px] -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full bg-foreground/80 shadow-[0_0_4px_var(--card-shadow,rgba(0,0,0,calc(0.3*var(--shadow-k,1))))]"
        />
      )}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {hovered && (
          <motion.span
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10, scaleY: 0.5, x: "-50%" }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scaleY: 1, x: "-50%" }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: 10, scaleY: 0.5, x: "-50%" }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.22, ease: EASE }}
            style={{ transformOrigin: "bottom center", background: POPOVER_BG }}
            className="pointer-events-none absolute -top-9 left-1/2 z-20 whitespace-nowrap rounded-full border border-foreground/[0.08] px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] text-foreground/90"
          >
            {label}
          </motion.span>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </button>
  )
}

/**
 * macOS-style magnifying command dock — cursor-driven icon springs, click
 * bounce, running-app dots, and a ⌘K command menu.
 * 2026-10-02: surfaces at 7% (raised blocks white in light, 12% in dark) so cards read on white and on black.
 */
export function MacOsDock({
  items = DEFAULT_ITEMS,
  activeIds = [],
  onSelect,
  onCommand,
  className,
}: {
  items?: DockApp[]
  /** tools marked with the macOS running-app dot */
  activeIds?: string[]
  onSelect?: (item: DockApp) => void
  /** the ⌘K slot was pressed (the menu opens or shuts) */
  onCommand?: () => void
  className?: string
}) {
  const reduce = !!useReducedMotion()
  const mouseX = useMotionValue(FAR)
  const [hovered, setHovered] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false)
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false)
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const slotRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const copyTimer = useRef<number | undefined>(undefined)
  useEffect(() => () => window.clearTimeout(copyTimer.current), [])

  const close = (refocus = false) => {
    setMenuOpen(false)
    if (refocus) slotRef.current?.querySelector("button")?.focus()
  }
  const run = (it: DockApp) => {
    onSelect?.(it)
    close(true)
  }
  const copyLink = () => {
    const done = () => {
      setCopied(true)
      window.clearTimeout(copyTimer.current)
      // the tick holds a beat so it is read, then the menu shuts
      copyTimer.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
        setCopied(false)
        close(true)
      }, 700)
    }
    const href = typeof location !== "undefined" ? location.href : ""
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText(href).then(done, done) ?? done()
  }

  /* while the menu is open: Escape shuts it, 1 to 9 pick a tool, a press outside shuts it */
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!menuOpen) return
    const key = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") close(true)
      const n = Number(e.key)
      if (Number.isInteger(n) && n >= 1 && n <= Math.min(9, items.length)) run(items[n - 1])
    }
    const down = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      if (!rootRef.current?.contains(e.target as Node)) close()
    }
    window.addEventListener("keydown", key)
    window.addEventListener("pointerdown", down)
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("keydown", key)
      window.removeEventListener("pointerdown", down)
    }
  })

  return (
    <div
      ref={rootRef}
      onPointerMove={(e) => {
        if (!reduce && e.pointerType !== "touch") mouseX.set(e.clientX)
      }}
      onPointerLeave={() => {
        mouseX.set(FAR)
        setHovered(null)
      }}
      /* 22 = the icons' 10px corner + the 12px pad (spec 13.10) */
      className={cn("relative flex items-end gap-2 rounded-[22px] p-3", className)}
      style={{
        /* flat (his call, 2026-10-02): one 7% fill, a hairline, and a light short shadow; the
           gradient, the lit top edge and the specular streak are gone */
        background: "color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 7%, var(--background))",
        boxShadow: [
          "0 0 0 1px var(--light-outline, color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 6%, transparent))",
          "0 4px 12px -6px rgba(0,0,0,calc(0.2 * var(--shadow-k, 1)))",
        ].join(", "),
      }}
    >
      {items.map((it) => (
        <DockItem
          key={it.id}
          mouseX={mouseX}
          reduce={reduce}
          label={it.label}
          hovered={hovered === it.id}
          active={activeIds.includes(it.id)}
          onEnter={() => setHovered(it.id)}
          onClick={() => onSelect?.(it)}
        >
          {it.icon}
        </DockItem>
      ))}

      <div className="mx-1 h-8 w-px self-center bg-foreground/[0.08]" />

      <div ref={slotRef} className="contents">
        <DockItem
          mouseX={mouseX}
          reduce={reduce}
          label="Command menu"
          hovered={hovered === "⌘K" && !menuOpen}
          onEnter={() => setHovered("⌘K")}
          onClick={() => {
            setMenuOpen((o) => !o)
            onCommand?.()
          }}
        >
          <span className="flex h-full w-full items-center justify-center">
            {/* same icon grid as the tiles — a full-bleed plate here read a fifth
                larger than the app artwork beside it */}
            <span
              className={cn("flex items-center justify-center rounded-[22%] text-[12px] text-foreground/70", RAISED)}
              style={{ width: PLATE, height: PLATE }}
            >
              ⌘K
            </span>
          </span>
        </DockItem>
      </div>

      {/* ⌘K command menu — a quiet sheet floating above the dock's right end */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {menuOpen && (
          <motion.div
            role="menu"
            aria-label="Commands"
            initial={reduce ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: 8, scale: 0.97 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
            exit={reduce ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: 8, scale: 0.97 }}
            transition={{ duration: reduce ? 0 : 0.22, ease: EASE }}
            style={{
              transformOrigin: "bottom right",
              background: POPOVER_BG,
              boxShadow: "0 8px 24px var(--card-shadow, rgba(0,0,0,0.35))",
            }}
            /* the popover: 12 = the items' 8 + the 4px pad */
            className="absolute bottom-full right-0 z-30 mb-3 w-[190px] rounded-[12px] border border-foreground/[0.08] p-1"
          >
            {items.map((it, i) => (
              <button
                key={it.id}
                type="button"
                role="menuitem"
                onClick={() => run(it)}
                className={MENU_ITEM}
              >
                {it.label}
                {i < 9 && <span className="text-[10.5px] tabular-nums text-foreground/45">{i + 1}</span>}
              </button>
            ))}
            <div className="mx-2.5 my-1 h-px bg-foreground/[0.05]" />
            <button type="button" role="menuitem" onClick={copyLink} className={MENU_ITEM}>
              {copied ? "Copied" : "Copy link"}
              {copied && <Check className="h-3 w-3 text-foreground/90" strokeWidth={2.2} aria-hidden />}
            </button>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  )
}
```

// ─── components/ui/control-classes.ts ───
```tsx
/* Control classes: the library's control material for components that ship on their own
   (2026-10-02, the audit's pattern 11). src/components/library/controls.ts is the site's
   copy; components used to paste its look in as a flat 8% fill "so the file ships alone",
   and those copies never turned white on a raised light surface. These read the same
   tokens WITH a fallback, so they follow the site's raised-surface rule here and still
   draw correctly in a buyer's app that has no such tokens. Shipped beside every component
   that imports it (scripts/build-registry.mjs bundles ui helpers automatically).

   Whole class strings, never assembled from pieces: Tailwind reads this file as text. */

/** what is ON in a switcher. Light (his call, 2026-10-02, after the inline slider): a WHITE
 *  pill with a hairline and a soft shadow on the grey track. Dark: the 8% thumb */
export const THUMB =
  "bg-white shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--light-outline,rgba(0,0,0,0.09)),0_1px_3px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] dark:bg-[var(--control-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_8%,transparent))] dark:shadow-[var(--control-shadow,inset_0_1px_0_0_color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_6%,transparent))]"

/** what a switcher's options sit in; its 2px padding is the gap the thumb keeps. Light: a
 *  light grey track with no outline, the white pill sits in it. Dark: a hairline, no fill */
export const TRACK = "rounded-full border border-transparent bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_5%,var(--background))] p-0.5 dark:border-foreground/[0.04] dark:bg-transparent"

/** an option that is off: the label alone answers the pointer */
export const SEGMENT_OFF = "text-foreground/60 hover:text-foreground/90"

/** a secondary button: the thumb standing alone; size it with h-7 / h-9 and px */
export const BUTTON =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--control-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_8%,transparent))] shadow-[var(--control-shadow,inset_0_1px_0_0_color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_6%,transparent))] text-foreground/90 outline-none transition-[color,background-color,scale] duration-150 hover:bg-[var(--control-fill-hover,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_12%,transparent))] focus-visible:bg-[var(--control-fill-hover,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_12%,transparent))] active:scale-[0.97] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40 motion-reduce:active:scale-100"

/** an icon-only control: no fill at rest, a faint one under the pointer */
export const ICON_BUTTON =
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-full text-foreground/60 outline-none transition-[color,background-color] duration-150 hover:bg-foreground/[0.06] hover:text-foreground/90 focus-visible:bg-foreground/[0.06]"

/** a field: the track with just enough fill to read as somewhere to type */
export const FIELD =
  "rounded-full border border-foreground/[0.04] bg-[var(--field-fill,color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_5%,transparent))] text-foreground/90 outline-none transition-[background-color,border-color] duration-150 placeholder:text-foreground/45 focus:border-foreground/[0.12]"

/** the one loud button of a form: 48px, full width, the foreground filled (the dashboards'
 *  Modal primary). A ticket, a swap, a confirm: one of these and nothing louder */
export const BUTTON_PRIMARY =
  "inline-flex h-12 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-foreground/[0.92] text-[14px] font-medium text-background outline-none transition-[background-color,scale,opacity] duration-150 hover:bg-foreground focus-visible:bg-foreground active:scale-[0.98] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40 motion-reduce:active:scale-100"

/** a component's own card, field or block (spec 14.8). Dark: a #121212 fill on black. Light
 *  (his call, 2026-10-02: "on light the card background is too dark, it can just be white, a
 *  quiet outline and a small shadow"): white, a 1px hairline (Kraken's #e7e6e9, or 9% ink in an app without the token) and a
 *  barely there shadow,
 *  drawn as box shadows so the outline takes no layout */
export const SURFACE =
  "bg-background shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--light-outline,color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_9%,transparent)),0_1px_2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] dark:bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_7%,var(--background))] dark:shadow-none"

/** a block sitting ON a surface: a faint 4% grey inside a white card in light, #1f1f1f in dark */
export const RAISED = "bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_4%,var(--background))] dark:bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--foreground)_12%,var(--background))]"
```
